review_text: Great food with delicious flavors and excellent presentation. The dishes were fresh, well-seasoned, and served on time, making the whole experience smooth and enjoyable. Highly recommended for any event.
author: Santy Capp

review_text: The catering service was well organised and delivered on time. The food was served fresh and attractively presented. Overall, the taste was good, and the portions were sufficient for all guests.
author: M Kumar

review_text: Food is very tasty and high quality
author: Muthu Kumaran

review_text: Food are tasty and conducting feedback sections monthly and changing menus accordingly
author: Kolipalli siva Siva

review_text: The hospital got my order wrong and swapped for lunch and dinner but Wati from catering solutions acceded to my changes and was really kind about it. She is amazing!
author: Joanne Low

review_text:
Jason the AM at Fiamma Resturant provided exceptional service, demonstrating kindness and attention to detail throughout our breakfast meals. His meticulous approach ensured everything was served to perfection, making our dining experience truly memorable. Highly recommended for his dedication to outstanding guest service.👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
Hui Yi, Front Office Manager demonstrated exceptional professionalism and a warm demeanor. Her understanding and helpful approach greatly assisted us during our stay. Highly recommended for her outstanding service and dedication to guest satisfaction.🌹💕🥳

Rick from Housekeeping  is a standout! He's attentive, helpful, and goes above and beyond, remembering my preferences and ensuring the highest standards of hygiene. A true asset to the hotel!🌹✨👍🏻

Manager Eunice and waiter Melvin at Fiamma resturant  seemed to overlook us, despite being familiar faces. A greeting would've made a big difference in our experience.

Update review 3th March 2026 Morning time:

Fiamma breakfast missed the mark sans Jason. Egg dish wow, but 'in-room dining only' tone was weird. Had to ask for service.

"Big shout out to Ric from Capella's housekeeping! He knows my pets' fave food and went all out - big bag, big love 😊. Management could work on rates, but Ric's kindness wins the day. Thanks Ric!"🌹🙏
author: MT

review_text:
Birthday celebration in Capella. We enjoyed ourselves alot!

The room was fantastic,  with a nice living room area to watch your favourite shows

The vanity area is huge. Feel relax and nice to chill in the room

The crew/staff from the reception & restaurants were friendly,  knowledgeable and attentive.  I have to say, the service was amazing!

Most of important,  our furkid cab come along with us to the restaurants!

Oh I also have to give compliments to the fantastic breakfast we had. A wide spread of food to enjoy

Would definitely recommend to family & friends and I am looking forward to come back for another staycation
author: Shirley Ngo

review_text: There’s a reason Capella Singapore has such great reviews! We stayed in a villa with a private pool, and it was absolutely perfect. The peacocks were adorable, breakfast was delicious, the staff were incredibly friendly, and the spa was amazing. Everything about our stay exceeded expectations — we couldn’t find a single thing we didn’t love. Can’t wait to visit again!
author: summer breeze

review_text:
I had an amazing stay at Capella, and the service was truly top-notch. We had a late dinner at Fiamma, ordering just a few drinks and an appetiser. As it was quite late, we decided to take the main course to go. However, the restaurant staff member, Kalai, kindly recommended that the meal be served in our room instead. It was such a thoughtful and considerate gesture.

The next morning, we returned to the same restaurant for breakfast. The food was fantastic, offering a great variety with both a buffet and free-flowing mains. The manager Canny was very friendly, and all the staff were equally welcoming and attentive.

Before leaving, we decided to relax by the pool, where we met Nelvin. He treated us warmly and generously offered ice cream and frozen grapes to help us cool down in the heat. As we departed the property, we were greeted by the bellman, who was also friendly and helpful. In particular, we would like to thank Logesh, along with a few other staff members whose names I unfortunately can’t recall, as well as Fandi from the Front Office.

Thank you, Capella, for the wonderful accommodations and exceptional service. It was truly a memorable stay.
author: Herman Rahman

review_text:
We chose Capella Singapore to celebrate our wedding anniversary, and somehow a simple staycation turned into a full-blown “are we secretly royalty?” experience. Honestly, if I could give 6 stars, I absolutely would.

I originally booked a Premier King Garden Room, but upon arrival we were unexpectedly upgraded to a One-Bedroom Villa — and the best part is, I didn’t even ask. That moment alone already set the tone for the stay: thoughtful, generous, and quietly impressive.

Service throughout the resort was impeccable. Every staff member we encountered was warm, friendly, and genuinely welcoming — the kind of hospitality that feels natural rather than scripted.

One of the fun perks here is the buggy service around the property. You can call for a buggy anytime to get around the resort. In fact, I called one to go to Fiamma, only to realise later that my villa was basically… right next to it. The ride took about 20 seconds. I felt a little embarrassed for making the driver come all the way just for that, but he greeted us with the biggest smile like it was the most normal thing in the world. That level of kindness really stuck with me.

The buggy can even take you all the way down to the carpark directly to your car, which is such a small but incredibly thoughtful touch.

From the beautiful grounds to the exceptional service, everything about this stay felt special. We had such a wonderful anniversary here, and it’s safe to say this won’t be our last visit.

Capella have officially set the bar very high for staycations. We’ll definitely be back. 🌿✨
author: Sin Ping Ong

review_text: I came here as part of a conference and it was certainly a fantastic day. The drinks and the buffet lunch that were put on were absolutely top quality. The star for always really friendly and engaging and happy to help. Much fun was had in the pool! Definitely worth the trip to Sentosa to come here! Great vibes!
author: Lachlan Burnet

review_text: It’s been years since I last visited this place to am pleasantly surprised to see a revamped ‘Tanjong Beach Club’. Like in the past, they still take walk-ins. The service received here is second to none! Can you believe they address you by your first name and welcome you back so warmly after you give them your phone number? The tone, the warmth, the welcome by the front desk staff left a very good impression. We were shown to the table by a friendly staff who asked how he can make our visit more comfortable once we were shown to our seats. He left with all drinks order and another staff approached us with his sunshine smile, gave us a menu and asked if we wanted recommendations. After receiving an affirmation, he asked if we were looking at sharing or individual orders. He gave his suggestions based on our preferences and then left to give us space and time to decide. He told us to inform him when we are ready. No imposition, no pressure. The drinks and food were served fast! Juices are really freshly squeezed, not from the carton. My watermelon juice paired with mint leaves is really refreshing! Loved it! The Tanjong Beach Breakfast Platter is indeed huge enough for sharing. Love the juiciness of the sausage, the crisp of the bacon and bread, the fresh avocado, the baked cherry tomatoes served with  pepper and salt. Presentation was beautiful! They also accommodate change of fruits for the fruit platter. Fruits were fresh and sweet! This is really a great way to start the morning! The view is great, tables were placed far apart. The staff were very attentive, when a guest leaves the table for the beach, they actually bring a dish cover to cover their food, preventing bird from preying on them. I find this really thoughtful!! Will I return?? Definitely!!!! Highly recommend all to visit this place!! It won’t disappoint with its variety of seating, there are bar seats, deck seats, sun-beds, picnic tables, and air-conditioned indoor seats. Very child friendly too!
author: Evangeline Tan

review_text:
A heartfelt appreciation to Chef Sean Yap and the entire team at Tanjong Beach Club. The food was beautifully executed, from the vibrant starters to the perfectly cooked steak, each dish crafted with care and confidence. Service was attentive, warm, and genuine, making the evening feel effortless.

The atmosphere was exceptional. Great music, a relaxed seaside breeze, and an environment that brings out the best conversations. It is the kind of place where good food, good people, and good energy come together naturally.

Thank you to Chef Sean and team for delivering a memorable dining experience. Looking forward to returning soon.
author: Vincent Yong

review_text: Amazing service by Enson and team. They were so prompt despite being fully booked out. Spilled a drink and they cleared it and replaced it within 2 mins. Food was good, drinks were great too.
author: Jie Ru Chan

review_text: Excellent cozy beach! Perfect service( especially Majrics , Gadha and tbe team), tasty food, delicious refreshing drinks and wonderful vibe🙌🏻. Probably the best beach in Sentosa…
author: Bogdan C

review_text:
For months in 2025, this was the only "affordable" dining place in Sentosa after the Malaysian Food Street at Resorts World closed down in Feb 2025 after 13 yrs. A new food court with 10 stalls (Feast Food Hall at Weave) has opened since Oct 2025 but awaits to be reviewed, although initial look shows higher food prices.

Anyway, for Good Old Days, mains start from $9.80:

Nasi Lemak Chicken/ Fish ($9.80)
Ayam Penyet ($12.80)
Chicken Briyani ($12.80)

Fishball Noodles ($9.80) !!
Prawn Noodles ($9.80) !!
Laksa ($9.80) !! - 3 prawns + 1 egg
Seafood/Beef Horfun ($9.80) - 3 small shrimpa and 1 pc of calamari only though
Ginger Fish Horfun ($10.80)

Hainanese/ Roast Chicken Rice ($9.80) !!
Chicken Ku Teh ($9.80)

Grilled Chicken Chop w 1 potato side ($9.80)
Chicken Meatball Spaghetti ($12.80)
Prawn Aglio Olio ($12.80) @@
Assam Pedas Pasta ($12.80)
Roast Striploin Beef ($18.80)
Poached Salmon ($22.80)

Prices above are before 10% service charge and 9%GST.

+ Has cashless payment

Nearest toilets are at the Beach Station, or base of Skyline Luge, or inside the AltitudeX building (where Shake Shack and Marrybrown are located).
author: Yong Hui, Ronny Tan

review_text:
You normally expect very meh food from a foodcourt in a tourist location, but was pleasantly surprised by how good the laksa was.

9.80 for laksa is still a bit costly, but at least it tasted good. The minced meat noodles arent too bad too.

Note that this place is cashless too.
author: Colin

review_text:
Warning: Do not book dinner here through any third-party service provider. They will make you feel like a beggar,just look at the photos to understand their behavior.

I had a confirmed dinner booking, but when I reached the place, they denied it, giving excuses about some other ongoing booking issues. This was extremely unprofessional and embarrassing.

If they don’t want to honor third-party bookings, they should clearly mention it beforehand instead of harassing customers after confirmation.
author: Dr Bobyjeet Goswami

review_text: Good variety of local food and a really chill atmosphere. Portions were decent and prices were surprisingly affordable for Sentosa. Convenient stop when you’re around the island. Would come back again!
author: Jia Yun

review_text:
I ordered the Seafood Hokkien Mee, and while the dish was tasty and arrived quickly, calling it “seafood” felt a little generous. The noodles had good flavor, and the seasoning was on point, but the actual seafood portion was tiny — three small shrimp and one piece of calamari. Technically seafood, yes… but definitely not what I expected from something labeled “seafood.”

The service was fine in terms of speed, but the cashier experience could’ve been better. I just needed to refill my water bottle, but instead I was repeatedly pushed to buy small cans of tap water, which felt unnecessary and a bit frustrating.

Overall, the food was decent and affordable, but if you’re craving a real seafood-heavy Hokkien Mee, you might walk away wishing there was more ocean in the bowl.
author: Michaela Walter-Fuller

review_text:
We visited on a Saturday afternoon for lunch. Although it was Valentine’s Day, the crowd was comfortable. As we brought our dog along, we were seated at the outdoor area.

Our first impression of Amara Sanctuary wasn’t ideal due to poor accessibility from the carpark for pet strollers. However, this was quickly redeemed by the warm service at Sanctuary Tearoom. We were warmly ushered through the indoor area to the outdoor seats, and the air cooler was already switched on when we arrived. The staff also offered alternative tables in case the wind was too strong. The ambiance felt like a tropical getaway despite being in Singapore.

MJ attended to us promptly, recommended signing up as an Amara member for discounts, and kindly helped arrange the pet tea set we had mistakenly thought we had booked.

The food arrived shortly after and impressed us with its simple yet elegant presentation. The steak came with a brief flambé, and the XO bee hoon had a nice pouring show. The dishes were flavourful, carried an old-school charm, and were reasonably priced. We also enjoyed several drinks, most prepared by MJ, who doubled as our bartender. I especially appreciated the milky cocktail she crafted upon request.

Before leaving, we spotted another table with the cute CNY pet platter and decided to get one to take away as well.

Overall, it was a fantastic lunch, and we will definitely be back.
author: MH Tham

review_text:
The only place I went during my stay with Amara Sanctuary. Had my 3 meals here, not only the food is good but also the price is worth it if you are in-house guests. Either $30 SGD credits or 20% discount.

Seamless customer experience makes the dining experience even better specially the male indian manager. Like more soup for their signature fish soup, more truffle mayo for their fries, change of sauce for our pork chop. Thumbs up.

Ribeyes black pepper sauce is the highlight more than the protein (haha… my pov only). The sauce is rich and flavorful, goes well with the potato side.

Recommended by the manager, signature fish soup has generous but well balanced alcohol given. Goes very well with the soup base. Very big portion, good for 2 pax is you guys are small eater.

Last thing is the molten chocolate lava cake dessert. Not sure if it’s house made or over the over the shelf kind, it’s just beautifully plated and blend well with strawberry ice cream instead of vanilla.

Personally to recommend this place with or without the discount. The outdoor dining area  features a comfortable and cozy dining spot. Pets friendly too.
author: TNJ Housing Solutions Pte Ltd

review_text:
Service from MJ was fantastic. We reached just as they were turning around the restaurant from breakfast to linch, and she quickly offered us a table to wait, while she explained the situation. She even offered us coffee and tea to help us pass the time.

We ended up waiting 45minutes, but she kept checking in on us and engaging us to ensure we were ok with waiting.

Her recommendation of the XO halibut fish soup was also on point. The broth was robust with lots of flavour. Fried halibut too was light and crispy without being too oily. Its like i got to enjoy good fish soup, with nicely battered fish and chips without the chips.

I'd be happy with the food. But MJ made the experience so much better.
author: Colin

review_text: Quite a sanctuary indeed. For a place that’s been around awhile, it still feels modern, clean & spacious. So nice to sit amongst large trees, small waterfall in the background & space for my little dog to roam around n explore. Sighted quite a few peacocks, one w: baby in tow. Service is not the quickest but well intended. Jennifer, the supervisor, was engaging & obliging to our requests. Pork chops was yummy & accompanying veggies perfectly cooked. I think the F&B manager who happened to be around, noticed we had unfilled water glasses & instinctively directed a crew to fill our glass & leave a full bottle of cool water for us. We felt well taken care of tho largely left to our own peace. Will come back again. We used Amex Dining deals wh took half off the bill too. Made it real good value. Drive in from lunch from 11:30am n pay only $2 instead of $6 Sentosa fee. Guests park free albeit limited lots
author: LL SG

review_text:
A hidden sanctuary in Sentosa. Great food, reasonable price & friendly service. Thanks Jeevan & team for making us feel at home.

All the dishes we ordered were delicious. The salmon & pork chop are my favourites, followed by the curry chicken & satay. The nasi goreng is also nice. Char kway teow lacked wok hei, but it comes with quality ingredients - fresh prawns & lean lap cheong.

The cafe also gave us a complimentary slice of birthday cake & three free drinks, which include alcoholic drinks.
author: Joseph Ooi

review_text: We had a corporate dinner here and were genuinely surprised by the quality of the food and the level of hospitality. Everything was excellent from start to finish. The staff were very attentive and genuinely caring, which made the evening feel relaxed and well looked after. The view was lovely, and the food was amazing — every option we tried was fantastic. An easy five stars for food, service, and atmosphere.
author: Ryan Bidgoli

review_text: Amazing service!! Attended a birthday party there and the food was delicious. The burgers omg and the lemon meringue tart?? Also the cocktails were insane. Hello paella
author: Rui Rui

review_text: We love spending our Sundays here. The kids play on the beach while adults sip nice drinks. Great food with plenty of vegetarian options and superb service. Special thanks to Jeeva for making our Sunday extra special with his extraordinary attentive and friendly service.
author: Fabrizio

review_text: Had a really good time here with the kids. It’s on the quieter side of Palawan so nice and relaxing. Their service was exceptional and they provided us with a spot by the pool where we could watch the kids play. Food was nice, and pricing was as we would expect from a location like this.
author: Rose Pan

review_text: Came on a Friday with my wife, quiet and peaceful atmosphere for a weekend. Ordered only 2 drinks as we wanted to catch Wings Of Time. Server Cat was very helpful in answering all our questions and drinks were served very quickly. Would come again to try the food.
author: Savesh Deepthiya

review_text:
The original and first Marrybrown outlet in Singapore, of this popular fried chicken franchise in Malaysia.

Located inside the AltitudeX (formerly iFly) building, at street level, next to Shake Shack. Took over the previous tenant (MacDonalds!).

Chicken Burger ($4.90) - SMALL
Chicken Burger Combo ($7.90)

Hot Touch Burger ($7.20) !! - But not spicy and minimal difference from the normal Chicken Burger
Hot Touch Burger Combo ($9.80) !!

Lucky Plate ($8.90) - 2pc chicken + coleslaw + bun + mashed potato + drink
Lucky Plate Combo ($11.90)

Family Deal (4-pax) ($41.50) -
8pc
1 Chick-a-Pops
1 Large Fries
1 Large Coleslaw
4 Soft Drinks

Nasi Lemak MB ($7.90) - Bigger in portion than the Chicken Burger
Nasi Lemak MB Combo ($10.50) - Bigger in portion than the Chicken Burger Combo

- The outside seating can be hot during the daytime, but offer a cooling good view of the sea in the evenings.

- NO PETS allowed, although there are no signage for this.

- (Indian) tourists tend to leave the trays on the tables instead of putting them away.

+ Friendly staff (Wallace)
author: Yong Hui, Ronny Tan

review_text:
Was very pleasantly surprised by how warm and personable Wallace , the staff who serviced us. He went out of the way to explain the available menu, the options and even recommendations.
After taking our orders, he even informed us that he would bring us our meals.
To top it all off, he even moved to open the door for us to enter the dining area.
He showed sincerity and care that was unexpected in a fast food establishment.
High praise for Wallace.
I will certainly be going back for more.
The spicy chicken was lovely, with Indian spices and flavours prevalent, and the accompanying curry on the rice, so yummy. The chicken was moist and the skin crunchy. The fish for the fish and chips was tasty , but on the “skinny” side.  Nevertheless, a nice meal.
Sadly the aircon was not cold and some of the seats damaged/torn.
Cheers!
author: Christian Madonna

review_text:
Reviews are a bit mixed: many find the chicken juicy and tasty for a fast-food stop, but some feel the burgers or sides aren’t as flavourful compared to bigger global chains, and portions occasionally feel small for the price.  Still, the location and halal menu make it a convenient and accessible opt
Marrybrown is a decent casual choice if you want halal fast-food with beach vibes — not fine dining, but satisfying for what it is. It’s worth a try especially if you want something quick between attractions on Sentosa.
author: Noor Mandeep

review_text:
Self kiosks weren’t operational in the afternoon, but they were during dinner time. These machines only accept cashless payments.

The burger & fries portion were more like a meal for kids. Have to say the nasi lemak portion was more generous than the chicken burger combo.
author: Lim Hong Ze

review_text: Had their lucky plate which came with 2 pieces of chicken, coleslaw , 1 bun , mashed potato and 1 drink. Chicken was crispy and juicy. Some may prefer the KFC version depends on personal preference. Staff is friendly and helpful
author: Jean T

review_text: Ola Beach Club remains a reliable, consistent staple of the Sentosa coastline that excels as a family-friendly retreat. While it may not be the primary choice for those seeking a high-end luxury aesthetic, its approachable atmosphere and kid-friendly menu make it an easy, stress-free win for parents. It’s the kind of place where you can simply grab a drink, sit back, and enjoy a predictable, high-quality weekend vibe. For a dependable beach day that prioritizes comfort over pretension, Ola continues to deliver year after year.
author: Flo Yeow

review_text:
My family and I have visited Ola Beach Club several times, and each visit has been truly wonderful and memorable. The food and drinks are consistently excellent, and the ambiance strikes the perfect balance between relaxing and fun.

It’s a fantastic place for both the young and the young at heart to unwind, bond, and spend quality time together. Friends can also enjoy meaningful catch-ups in a vibrant yet laid-back setting.

For the kids, the swimming pool, sand play area, and banana boat ride are definite highlights, making the experience even more enjoyable for the whole family. Totally recommend this place!
author: Avacado AW

review_text: had a good time at Ola Beach Club with the family. Food was really awesome! Love the iberico spare ribs and chargrilled yakitori chicken. The drinks were freshing with fresh fruits in it. Place was family friendly with a private pool and mini playground for the kids. Service staff were friendly and prompt.
author: Lirong

review_text: Really good food and drinks. They have different plates…as share main or share starter. Drinks are really good. Also, amazing beach spot. They have a wee swimming pool if you don’t want to be on the beach. Finally, really good customer service!
author: Arianna C

review_text:
Ola Beach Club is truly one of the best spots on Sentosa. The atmosphere is vibrant and relaxing at the same time, and the staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming. If you order at least 30 SGD worth of food or drinks, you even get a complimentary sunbed, which makes the experience feel even more premium.

The food tastes great, with generous portions and fresh flavors, and the beachside setting makes everything even more enjoyable.

There is even a pool you can use!
author: Vanessa Rodriguez

review_text:
Middle Eastern-Mediterranean-Indian dishes restaurant. Not much dish menu to order. The portion was pretty big for us. All food are herbal tasty and spicy (too spicy for our son)

The place with egypt theme and high roof, and when some birds came inside was so comfortable and relaxing
author: iga oman

review_text: Brought my group there for lunch. The chicken briyani and lamb briyani were delicious. The food was served piping hot and that made it a great meal for my group members who enjoyed the fare very much
author: Sam Pang

review_text:
We visited here in October on our trip to Universal Studio-Singapore. We were 14 people and had food coupons of 20 SGD per person as provided by our tour operator. We were looking for options to eat within Universal Studio.

This restaurant provided very good Indian food within the range of our food coupons.  The staff was helpful too. Menu was limited, but tasty, the service was quick too inspite of crowd during lunch time.

I would recommend this place if you are visiting Universal studios and want to have good Indian veg and non veg food within the budget.
author: Juilee Ghadge

review_text: I ordered the Roasted Chicken Briyani and I really enjoyed it. It's the usual pricey theme park food but the flavor of the curries were very tasty. It was a bit puzzling when I asked for a cover, they asked me to pay an extra $1 for it even though every customer was being served in a takeaway bento box, and the cover is meant to cost another $1?
author: Mishu

review_text:
Oasis Spice Cafe is a great place to eat if you’re looking for Indian cuisine options inside Universal Studios Singapore.
They offer a good variety of vegetarian dishes, which is very helpful for Indian visitors or anyone preferring veg food. Items like chole rice, veg biryani, samosa, and other Indian snacks are available.
The taste is really good, especially considering it’s inside a theme park where food options can sometimes be limited.
This restaurant is a very convenient option for vegetarian travelers and Indians visiting the park. The vibe is nice, the place is clean, and the staff are polite and welcoming.
Overall, amazing food and a satisfying experience within Universal Studios Singapore.
author: Officially Tintin

review_text:
Extremely Disappointing Experience

I understand this is a fast food place with theme park prices, but the staff and service here are absolutely appalling. I was told to line up for food without any menu provided, and when I finally got to the ordering station, I wasn’t allowed to take a moment to decide—staff were aggressively pushy, acting as if I couldn’t speak or hear, even when I responded.

Added to that, the menu didn’t even list all available items (like a regular Coke), and when I ordered it anyway, they didn’t bother mentioning the price. If you want to be rushed, disrespected, and insulted, this is the place to visit. Never coming back.

P.s. no one at my back lining up during that time.
author: L’ours M

review_text:
Foods was good, the chef was good, picture provides a true illustrative.

I gave service a three stars because chef was really nice, but the cashier was awful, caused us have to pay more money so leaving a bad review. We bought foods for two people and should be able to use two discount, cashier couldn’t do the math - to be fair maybe I should help her do the math, but I didn’t know the rule. Thought she was correct and turn out she’s wrong and causing we us can only use one discount voucher. Paid more so :).

Starbot please train your cashier how to do math…
author: Adam Han

review_text: It's not that great and taste is not that great. Just a fast food place and for chinese chefs to get their fried rice wrong , must be very bad. They gave some deep fried item in our veg meal, not sure,.what do they use to deep fry. It's expensive but food doesn't stand for the price. There was simple ask salt pepper and were not able to find in complete store and didn't see any interest from staff to locate.Staffs are rude, My experience was not great and least recommended place to go.
author: Santosh Ojha

review_text: Starbot Café in Universal Studios Singapore is a fun, sci‑fi themed eatery with futuristic décor and neon accents, perfect for a quick break between rides. It serves generous portions of easy, tasty bites like rice plates, noodles, and snacks. Seating is air‑conditioned and comfortable, making it a good spot to relax, especially on hot days. While food quality and service can vary, the café’s immersive space-age vibe and convenient location in Sci‑Fi City make it a memorable stop for families and park-goers alike.
author: Joyden Ho

review_text: Kudos to Mr Murali’s service and another kind lady who serve us to the seats. Waiting time was not too long and staffs go all the way to assist us. Counter service was also friendly .
author: JN

review_text:
Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐
The food at KT’s Grill in Universal Studios Singapore is amazing, especially the steak! Service could improve — a staff member touched my child’s hair without permission and assumed we were unwell because we wore masks. We wear masks for hygiene and comfort, not because we’re sick. The manager also addressed it loudly over the microphone, which disrupted the atmosphere. Food was great, but I hope staff interactions are handled more respectfully.
author: Grace

review_text: Very good food, but steaks were limited to NZ beef. It would be awesome if they could throw in some USDA or AU/JPN wagyu. The place is beautiful, especially the second floor. Service was excellent. Best place for a tired dad to hang out.
author: kenneth dy

review_text:
We have just finished dining here in “KT’s Grill” at “Universal Studios Singapore” and we enjoyed our lunch a whole load.

Not only were the foods yummy, they’re also very reasonably priced.

On top of that, Ada was truly friendly and she has reminded us that as Season Pass Holders, we get to enjoy perks as well.

Thanks a million for enhancing our dining experience and “Happy Lunar New Year” to you too, Ada! 🧧🍊🥰🙏🍊🧧
author: Desmond “Deoulve” Foo

review_text:
We ordered the Ribeye, Crispy chicken burger, xL ice lemon tea and whitebait.

My cut of the ribeye was very bad, had it medium well and it was so stringy. Couldnt finish half of the portion. Burger and ice tea was good, tea was especially refreshing.

Price was ok for a theme park.
Waiting time was rather long probably cos there arent many better alternatives around.
author: Ben Teo

review_text: We were looking for someplace  for early dinner and found this place by accident . Very nice place, I love the old British restaurant vibe. Food also tastes good, I like the sprout and chicken wing. My friend is happy about his beef hamburger. But tomato soup is not that impressive, I thought it could have been richer in taste .
author: Frances Wang

review_text:
Syun Japanese Restaurant – Resorts World Sentosa, Singapore

I had the privilege of being invited by friends to dine at Syun Japanese Restaurant in Resorts World Sentosa, and it was a truly pleasant experience.

As the three of us were not overly hungry, we opted for light and simple dishes, just enough to enjoy the flavours without feeling rushed or heavy. The food quality was excellent, showcasing refined Japanese flavours with careful attention to freshness and presentation. Every dish felt thoughtfully prepared, allowing the natural ingredients to shine.

What stood out just as much as the food was the service, attentive, polished, and genuinely warm, making the entire dining experience feel relaxed and well taken care of.

Having dined at several restaurants within RWS, including Feng Shui Inn and CHIFA (the Peruvian-Chinese restaurant), I find that Syun maintains the same high standard that RWS is known for,  consistent quality, good ambience, and professional service.

Thank you to my friends, Ms KL Lee and Ms KH Lee for the lovely invitation and for introducing me to yet another wonderful dining experience at RWS. A place I would be happy to return to again.
author: Melissa Hee

review_text: Zen atmosphere. Superb service. They gave free dessert for our anniversary celebration. Barachirashi is very fresh with the well seasoned rice. Daughter tried the curry set and it was delicious.
author: Yeow Margaret

review_text: Environment atmosphere feels cozy yet classy. The food was excellent, freshest sashimi ,especially the grilled pork chop which had a great texture. Many thanks to the Chef Boon for thoughtfully preparing such a delicious meal for us. I highly recommend come and try it — make sure to look for the handsome Chet Boon.
author: stephanie tiew

review_text: Excellent fine dining restaurant. Our serving waitress Kar Poh was very helpful and patience is explaining the menu. Food is excellent. Must try.
author: Chris Ang

review_text:
Thank you Jeremy from Syun who promptly and patiently served the dishes for our dinner. He explained all the dishes with great details. The food serve was fantastic and the entire restaurant atmosphere is fantastic for a date night with my wife!

Additionally, he is very prompt in ensuring that our food and drinks are served or refilled. He is also very attentive to details. Thank you once again Jeremy

I would definitely recommend this place for the fantastic and excellent food, service and last but not least, the great atmosphere.
author: Leon Lim

review_text: Had a Turkey Bacon Cheese Burger as per recommended by the menu. I’m impressed at such quick serve restaurant they are able to churn out some good quality burger. Simplicity at its best for all the freshest ingredients used. Let’s start from the bun, it’s fresh, tasty and fluffy. The beef patty size is generous and pairs well with the Smokey turkey bacon & BBQ sauce. Lettuce greens is fresh. For $17 it comes with some fries. It’s definitely worth a try, I will return again whenever I’m in USS.
author: Henry Ng

review_text:
Had a great time at Halloween Horror Nights 13 (USS)!
Loved the haunted houses, scare zones and shows. Stopped by Mel’s Drive-In for a late dinner. The Demonic Double Fish Burger was crispy, tender and super satisfying, and The Tarantula Nest onion was addictive! A fun night overall.

📸 Follow @ayaalan.foodie for more foodie reviews & experiences!
author: Ayaalan.foodie

review_text: This girl is she sent us off right after we order at the restaurant. She is very racist because she sent all other people off that is not indian. There is an indian family next to us but she let her finish her food. I think this girl did not go to a proper school. Its name is Satriviyani. We are so offended because the attitude. author: Pan pan

review_text:
I would prefer my 17 dollar meal to include drinks as well for completeness though.

The quality is definitely there and we have quite a great time eating their American style burger.

The fries are also as fresh as it can get, hot and crispy, pleasant potatos.

If you come USS, this restaurant is still a good choice.
author: Clarence Ow

review_text:
It was one of the few restaurants open during Halloween Horror Nights, and the best bet would be dining here since there is not much food during this event.

I feel that their burgers are a little on the average side, where the beef is a little dry, and they feel less appealing compared to most burgers in Singapore. I think they could look into making the burgers tastier, such as adding more sauces and juicier meat. The price is justifiable since it is inside USS, but because it is USS, McDonald's or Burger King would easily be better.

However, their fries were really good, so I have to give it to them. Overall, the burgers were so-so, the fries were awesome, and the places are nicely decorated.
author: Gabriel lzx

review_text:
We ate in the cafe 4 mornings and 2 evenings. The English breakfast is ok and reasonably priced. Its best viewed as a way of fuelling for the morning. The full breakfast looked really nice but we didn't try it - it was a choice of a good breakfast or a good lunch and we chose the lunch elsewhere. The food in the evening was very nice. The first night we shared a garden salad then had a burger each. The salad was fresh, crispy and with enough dressing. The burgers were homemade, nicely seasoned and juicy. They came with a small salad and fries. The second night we shared chicken Satay and each had a pasta dish. The satay was lovely as were the pasta dishes - al dente pasta with nice sauces.
We both enjoyed the food and thought it reasonably priced for location and quality. We ate at 7pm as and both times were the first in the cafe, hence a lower score for atmosphere.  The printed menu doesn't do a good job of describing the food but the online menu you use for ordering is much better. Finally, the staff were lovely. Polite, efficient and helpful especially when ordering via the QR code online menu.
author: Andy P

review_text:
Delicious food and a fantastic sea view with a cosy sea breeze. And most interesting was getting close to the monitor lizard🦎👍.

Thiis location or nearby here in Sentosa has different decorations based on the current seasons or various festivals.
​Some examples of the past and present decorations :
*New Year 🎉, January.
*🇸🇬 Singapore National Day, August.
*❄️ Christmas ☃️ December.

Sentosa is a popular resort island of Singapore. A major tourist and recreation hub.
​Its name, meaning "peace and tranquility" in Malay. The island has many exciting attractions, which include:
*​Universal Studios Singapore
*​Adventure Cove Waterpark
*​Three beaches (Siloso, Palawan, and Tanjong)
*​A variety of historical sites, resorts.
*Adventure activities like the Skyline Luge and iFly Singapore.

​It's easily accessible from the mainland via a bridge, cable car, monorail, and pedestrian boardwalk.
author: Foody

review_text:
The price is reasonable and the herbs are directly from their garden. Relaxed outdoor seating in beautiful garden by the beach.
Support the disabled staff. The atmosphere here is nice and you can watch peacocks walking around elegantly.
Hear the stories of the animals sharing the place and it's interesting.
author: Zhou Lin

review_text:
The food is mediocre at best, couldn't eat all of it. Seating also not great, liked the garden vibe though.

The breakfast is very limited, some croissants, an egg/omlette and few fruits slices.

The staff was OK, no complaints here
author: Toni is traveling

review_text: ONE OF THE BEST BURGERS I'VE HAD! Meat was well seasoned and I can taste the herbs, not just a plain beef patty. It was juicy and cooked to perfection, I dare say it's comparable if not better than shake shack that's nearby. Price wise it's reasonable. Service and staff was great! Looking forward to coming back for it again!
author: wilson 777

restaurant_name: Bikini Bar - Beachfront Bar on Siloso Beach, Sentosa
review_text: Dropped by this beach bar for a cold beer on a hot Saturday afternoon and it really hit the spot. Loved the chill vibes, stunning sea view, and breezy atmosphere. Such a perfect place to kick back and relax. Will definitely be back for the views and good vibes.
author: iamjess

restaurant_name: Bikini Bar - Beachfront Bar on Siloso Beach, Sentosa
review_text: I really liked this bar. As a solo traveller strolling around Sentosa beach walk, I felt hungry during sunset and then I came to this bar. To my surpise, the bargirls wore bikini tops which isn't something you expect as a european foreigner where a dresscode like this is seen as immoral, but I don't mind that because if costumers can, why can't bartenders do that? Also they were very friendly and helpfull. Prices of alchohol are to Singaporean standards low, food was great. I payed 55 dollar for Pina Colada, coke and pizza which isn't that expensive compared to other bars in the area
author: JolanCnu

restaurant_name: Bikini Bar - Beachfront Bar on Siloso Beach, Sentosa
review_text: very nice place located right in front of the sea. there is always music. the cocktails cost a little less than other places and they are also good. the only flaw is that we had asked for nacho fries with jalapeno etc instead they brought us french fries... they tell us that here they are served like this... anyway everything, good. nice atmosphere
author: francisco

restaurant_name: Bikini Bar - Beachfront Bar on Siloso Beach, Sentosa
review_text: Had a great time over at Bikini Bar! Love the service & the staff were really nice too. Food was flavourful and love how crispy the wings are! Drinks was rather affordable compared to other beach restaurants! Somerita cocktail was really refreshing & cool! :) Love the late night view & was super peaceful. Managed to catch some fireworks too 🤩
author: Karin Ng

restaurant_name: Bikini Bar - Beachfront Bar on Siloso Beach, Sentosa
review_text:
There is nothing wrong with this place!
Great outlook. great customer service, and it is really easy to order drinks and food.
The only issue was the music,  whilst it was a great selection of tracks, was way too loud, it just killed conversation
author: Graeme Brown

review_text: Really good experience. Have a drink outdoors to enjoy the sunset before having dinner indoors. The octopus was done right. Ravioli with ricotta was cooked well. The tiramisu is the wet kind that I like. Overall service was great and attentive.
author: William Tay

review_text:
3rd time visiting The Cliff restaurant, tried the Vongole Linguine, Wagyu Costata and Carbonara Pizza. Food was good and the beef was very well seasoned and cooked, the crust combined with the fatty juicy meat was very delicious. Also had the tiramisu and lemon tart for dessert. We had an Accor membership so the total bill was half off, a great deal especially for the quality and ambience.

Guna was very friendly and helpful with the menu as well. We took his recommendation for the Vongole and it was very nice. He was also attentive throughout service and ensured all our needs were met, making our dinner a very pleasant experience.

Definitely one of my favorite restaurants :-)
author: yt pang

review_text:
The Cliff has a nice laid back atmosphere that serves up hearty Italian food. Was pleasantly surprised by some unique dishes, such as the carbonara pizza, with 4 egg yolks on the pizza, it was rich and yummy.

The standout is the signature crab pasta. Texture is nice and al dente and crab portion is fairly generous. The grilled prawns were also very well done.

Special thanks to Wilson for the efficient service and excellent recommendations
author: Timothy Khoo

review_text:
Great ambience for a romantic night out with a view.
We enjoyed the mains - especially the cod and the mashed potatoes.

Service was excellent - Mr Guna was very warm, attentive and friendly. We felt his warmth and genuine  hospitality.

Prices were fair for a restaurant of that caliber and we will definitely be back.
author: Glenn Rajoo

review_text:
Exceptional Service in a Relaxing Setting. We had a lovely, relaxing evening at The Cliff following a busy Christmas week. The highlight of our night was undoubtedly the service; Guna was exceptional and is a true asset to the hotel team.
With regards to the food, the grilled octopus was a standout and the lamb was perfectly tender but could less spice. However, other dishes felt a bit unpolished. The arancini were inconsistent in size and shared the same base sauce as the octopus, which felt repetitive. While the cod was good, it wasn't particularly memorable. For dessert, the lemon tart was a bit of a letdown—I was expecting a classic torched meringue, but was told the curd itself was the "meringue." It was pleasant enough, though I would have preferred it without the milk foam.
A great spot for the atmosphere and hospitality, though the food has room to reach that same elite level.
author: Vania Tan

review_text:
We had vouchers to use here - our three boys did the swing together (21, 18, 15) and they loved it!

The staff are fabulous.  Super friendly, super professional.  All very safe.  You get weighed, helmets, crocs off.  They give you a GoPro as well and you can watch your jump/swing straight after.

Highly recommend if you are looking for a thrill seeking activity.

Too scary for me - that free fall at the start…. No thanks!!
author: Katrina Caesar

review_text:
These guys are the very best. I did my first ever bungy jump here at Sentosa and I loved it. The location is quite convenient and the facility is clean and big. There are lockers available so you can keep your items with them. You can make the payment of your activity by cash or card.

I loved the adrenaline rush that came with the jump. The guys were continuously backing me up and were very friendly. After the jump they provided me with the raw and edited version of the video which I loved! There was a voucher of S$5 for the bar nearby so it was an added bonus as well.
author: Mohsin Raza

review_text:
Brooo this was SO FUN 🤯🔥 We went for my friend’s bday ‘cause got promo 3 pax for SGD60 (steal tbh).

First thing, they weigh everyone to make sure the swing’s balanced — no lopsided flying 😂 Safety check on point.

Then the jump… OMG it’s legit thrilling. Heart in my throat but in the best way ever. Definitely a once in a lifetime kinda vibe, 10/10 would recommend.

⚠️ Heads up tho: the video gopro is NOT included. If you want their official video, it’s like SGD49 extra. If not, just get your friend to record from the ground lol.

Overall? Perfect for special occasions or just if you wanna scream your lungs out with the squad 🪂🎉
author: Nor Batrishyia

review_text: Amazing experience! The bungee jump on Sentosa Island was perfectly organized from start to finish. The staff were professional, friendly and made everything feel safe and exciting. I highly recommend buying the video of your jump — it’s a fantastic souvenir and totally worth it!. Feb 2023
author: Marcin Małgorzaciak

review_text:
Today, I had one of the most unforgettable experiences of my life: bungee jumping. I’ve done skydiving before, and while that was exhilarating, this was on an entirely different level. Skydiving felt like surrendering to the vastness of the sky, but bungee jumping? It’s raw. It’s immediate. It’s personal. You’re not just freefalling—you’re standing there, toes on the edge, looking down at the ground far below, knowing that the only thing between staying in your comfort zone and taking that leap is your own decision. No one can push you. You have to choose.

In those few seconds, so many emotions rushed through me—fear, excitement, doubt, and adrenaline all collided. It felt like time stood still as I faced the question: do I jump or not? And honestly, it’s a perfect metaphor for life. There are moments where you have to decide whether to play it safe or take a leap into the unknown.

As I stood there, my heart pounding out of my chest, I learned something about myself. I realized I’m incredibly brave when it comes to going after the things I truly want. The fear doesn’t disappear, but somehow, the desire to experience something new, something incredible, outweighs it. At the same time, I also recognized how scared I can be of other things—things that maybe don’t even deserve that fear. It’s a strange contradiction, but one that makes me human.

When I finally took the plunge, it was as if every doubt and hesitation was left behind on the platform. That freefall, those few seconds, felt like freedom in its purest form. It was terrifying, exhilarating, and empowering all at once. It reminded me that courage isn’t the absence of fear—it’s the decision to move forward despite it.

This experience taught me that life will always present us with edges, moments where we have to decide whether to stay where it’s safe or jump into the unknown. And while the jump may be scary, it’s also where the magic happens. I’m ready to keep taking leaps—toward my dreams, my goals, and all the adventures waiting for me. Because every time I jump, I discover a braver, bolder version of myself. And that’s worth it every single time.
author: SJMG15 S

review_text: Better to try a sandwich somewhere else. The sandwiches were weak and even carelessly cut. The only real positive were the sweet potato fries. I honestly don’t understand the high ratings. Tables were cleaned quickly, which is a plus. The place was crowded, probably because of the good reviews, but in my opinion it’s not worth it. The price is not justified by the quality.
author: Piotr BZ

review_text: Can't believe I had to look the employee straight in the eye and say "can I please have the shrek waffle". Lost $20 and my dignity
author: Tristan Corbellari

review_text: Had a great time resting at Friar’s. The place is clean and they have accommodating staff inside the place. So much food in a single order! They have chicken and beef sandwiches. Got sweet potato fries as well and they’re all perfect together.
author: Randel Diaz

review_text:
Food was great, service was better. We thought the price was quite expensive but the portion was big and the pretty good.

Redza is really nice and assisted us from beginning to end.
author: Jam

review_text: foods are good and awesome! and also the staff esp Redza he is so amazing! thank you USS!
author: Millicent Lou Pariñas

review_text: Great place to get an authentic Chinese meal. Portion size is just nice. This time, I ordered the roasted chicken, yam, and a few other dishes. Waiting time without booking took closer to 1 hour, so do book in advance. This place is great, especially if you are dining out with kids as complimentary kids set will be provided. Great variety of drinks and desserts available here as well. Overall peaceful environment, friendly staff and excellent service. Highly recommend visiting while you are in Marine Bay Sands as prices here are on the lower end compared to most other food options here.
author: Elden Teo

review_text:
Very good and authentic Chinese food! The sweet and sour pork’s cooked with crispy batter and balanced sauce. All others were just as good

This branch is way better than ours in Manila
author: Belrica Ma

review_text:
If you’re looking for a standout dining experience near Universal Studios, Putien is a must-visit! From the moment we walked in, we felt warmly welcomed by the staff’s excellent service. They took the time to explain each dish, helping us understand the flavors and setting our expectations perfectly—something we really appreciated, especially since some dishes were new to us. Their knowledge and enthusiasm for the food truly enhanced our meal.

The dishes are flavorful and authentic, with a variety that’s sure to please any palate. Despite the quality and care in each dish, Putien is surprisingly affordable, making it a great spot to enjoy fantastic food without breaking the bank. It’s not just a meal here; it’s an experience, and you feel the passion they put into every detail. Highly recommend if you’re looking for delicious, well-explained cuisine at a great value near Universal Studios!
author: Kate Pal

review_text:
Great service despite a long wait for a table on a week day (almost 90 mins).
Food was served fast and the dishes we ordered were great. We were given complimentary moon cakes for the long wait.

What I was impressed most was the efforts by the service staff to disinfect the high chair and the side of the table for the baby.

There are booster seats for toddlers /small children too. Very thoughtful.
author: Kim Geck Lim

review_text:
The service in this branch is really amazing!! The staff really take care of you and ensure you have efficient yet friendly service.
Food is amazing as usual, as expected of Putien. I especially like the sweet sour pork, fried yam and the tofu/vegetable soup.
On weekends, there will be queue but again, the staff will really ensure you are served well.
author: Diana R

restaurant_name: Coastes - Beach Bar & Restaurant | Siloso Beach, Sentosa
review_text:
We happened by here and decided to have dinner with minimal expectations.  The food was surprisingly great. I had the Fettuccine Carbonara and my wife had the  Premium Tenderloin Cubes. She barely tasted the first bite and said "these are fanyastic". Both our meals exceeded expectations.  The mobile ordering makes it super easy to get anything you need.

Additionally, this spot is right on the beach and even has loungers, and umbrellas available as well as a changing room and shower.

So bring the suit, order a bucket of beers or cocktails, and enjoy your day at the beach.
author: CrypticG

restaurant_name: Coastes - Beach Bar & Restaurant | Siloso Beach, Sentosa
review_text:
24/01/2026

Sorry to say but it was truly a terrible dining experience. Before going further into my comment, I just want to say I had been to here two years ago but sadly things had changed drastically.

Saturday night at Sentosa, was hopping around the beach area and thinking to had a dinner before going back. We were told at the entrance that a $40/pax minimum spending for the dine-in since the restaurant was 'full house' but surprisingly there were still so many empty seats deep into the dining area.

Ordered two beer, one pizza and one aglio olio. We got the beer couple of minutes after the order made, which we could quench our thirst while enjoying the sea breeze. Although I had noticed that there was a sign noting the food may take half an hour to prepare, I had not expected it to be so because it was already 9pm and most of the diners had already got their food on their tables.

No surprise, the food arrived half an hour later. The food look like the picture shown below, a pizza that seemed like being put into the microwave from the fridge and an aglio olio with obviously zero patience during the preparation. not judging the book by its cover, we attempted. The aglio olio tasted like it came out from an unwashed carbonara sauce pan, with an after taste like 'flour'. No positive comment for the pizza, we didnt even finish the meal. I think a western restaurant in a hawker center might cook better than here.

We spent $100+ for two pax. Not easy to earn bucks nowadays, definitely disappointed by the amount that we paid for. Guess this will go into my ban list moving forward.
author: Lee Zhe Wang

restaurant_name: Coastes - Beach Bar & Restaurant | Siloso Beach, Sentosa
review_text:
Average food, but decent experience if you enjoy a chill beach-y atmosphere. You can also enjoy snippets of the fireworks from the wings of time display from here.

They do pastas much better than pizzas.
author: C. Tang

restaurant_name: Coastes - Beach Bar & Restaurant | Siloso Beach, Sentosa
review_text:
Been coming here for the past 15yrs but first time we’re here for the sunset

Some new dishes on their menu, the prawn and bacon risotto pairs well with their Cloudy Bay Sauvignon Blanc which is still on offer at $108 for two bottles. Had their pork burger to end off our night

The service here is always great even when there are always new faces in their team. But those with them for the long haul will always quietly give us a nod or a smile when they spot us at our usual table. Service is always good here when u need it

Beautiful spot to catch the sun set and enjoy a free small fireworks display as it’s very near the Wings of Time venue
author: Gary Goh

restaurant_name: Coastes - Beach Bar & Restaurant | Siloso Beach, Sentosa
review_text:
Spacious and more relaxing vibe than nearby restaurants.
Came for lunch and dinner.
Daytime, the view of the sea and beach, with sundecks available. Multiple fans to keep cool.
Night time, tried the mini Singapore sling and beef cheek risotto. Quite good.
author: Lye Yoong Tan

restaurant_name: Din Tai Fung @ WEAVE, Resorts World Sentosa
review_text: Had lunch at Din Tai Fung today and the fried rice with shrimps and eggs was absolutely delicious, perfectly seasoned, fluffy, and full of flavour. Everything was fresh and well prepared. Unfortunately dry noodles with the crab roe and crab meat were not available, which was a bit disappointing. Still, great service overall.
author: Tik S

restaurant_name: Din Tai Fung @ WEAVE, Resorts World Sentosa
review_text: It is Din Tai Fung. Service was prompt and friendly, food is alright and a little pricey. The beef noodles were enjoyable. Din Tai Fund is always a good option for families to dine at together. My stalker will be keen to know if I spent quite a bit dining at Din Tai Fung, and will be quick to take notes and rebrand me as rich and weaponise that to dehumanise me. But I spend on loved ones when I can and Din Tai Fung's an indulgence.
author: Sam

restaurant_name: Din Tai Fung @ WEAVE, Resorts World Sentosa
review_text:
Came on a Friday lunch and it’s not crowded. We are ushered to the back of the restaurant where so air conditioned is not as cold as the front. The food has a good portion. Fried rice is still on must to order for me.
Pork chop noodle is not as must to order as it will tends to get oily on the soup.
author: Clo’s Laobu

restaurant_name: Din Tai Fung @ WEAVE, Resorts World Sentosa
review_text: The food was good! And the menu was so large with many choices. They have a variety of vegetarian choices too, which is always great. The dumplings are a must. The only problem was the food took a while to come, but they tell you right in the beginning a rough time estimate. Ours was 30
author: Petarcho

restaurant_name: Din Tai Fung @ WEAVE, Resorts World Sentosa
review_text:
Had Din Tai Fung @ WEAVE for two days in a row, that’s how much I loved it! Both times, I had to order their Pan-Fried Gyoza, which you won’t find at other DTF outlets. Crispy on the outside, juicy inside, and packed with flavor, absolutely worth the trip.

The other classics like Wonton Noodles, Steamed Pork Xiao Long Bao, and Crunchy Mini Cucumber in Spicy Sauce are always our go-to dishes, and everything was as delicious and consistent as ever :)
author: Velika Mustika

review_text:
During my stay at Capella Singapore, I enjoyed lunch once and dinner once at Cassia.

The lunch set was absolutely fulfilling. It included dim sum platter, superior chicken soup, braised Australian Rock Lobster, Crab Meat Fried Rice, and Coconut-infused Dragon Fruit Sorbet. The portions were very generous and all dishes were well executed with fresh ingredients.

During dinner time, I had double-boiled French morel soup, Chinese cabbage, flower mushroom, bamboo pith; Wok-fried sweet and sour Iberico pork, bell pepper and Wok-fried mud crab, vermicelli, garlic, clay pot. The food was delicate, high-quality and meticulously prepared.

I must thank Esther for serving me so professionally on both occasions.

Seeking Cantonese fine dining? Cassia at Capella Singapore is unarguably your choice!
author: Jason Kwong JK

review_text: consistent quality food over the last 3 years across dimsum and mains. truffle mushroom crystal dumpling is aromatic, smooth with playful textures; char siew is impeccably soft and juicy with a nice char; XO carrot cake is fragrant, crispy on the outside and pillowy soft in centre; mud crab vermicelli has great range of textures through the use of ingredients (smooth noodles, soft crab, crunchy bean sprouts, crispy roe). look forward to visiting again!
author: Celeste Tan

review_text: Neatly tucked away within Capella Singapore in Sentosa, this is a Cantonese restaurant to dine at when one wants to get away from the noise of the city. The service is unrushed, in classy, quiet ambience. I have been to this restaurant twice to date, during each of my staycations with Capella Singapore. My most recent visit was even more impressive than the one about two years ago, exemplifying the restaurant’s commitment to improving and achieving culinary excellence. My dinner companion enjoyed the experience too. Make reservations to avoid disappointment.
author: Lavanesan Swaminathan

review_text: Cantonese restaurant with good ambience and welcoming staff. The menu is not extensive, but the selections are well curated and the taste is solid. There is also a private room that accommodates around ten to twelve guests. Would definitely return.
author: Cindy Jiang

review_text: Thanks Lavin for your warm service. The dim sum in the restaurant is good, especially the vegetarian dim sum. I hope the chef can develop more good vegetarian dim sum. The sofa cushions in the restaurant are uncomfortable to sit on; they are too soft and you will sink into them.
author: You Jia

review_text:
We had a great dining experience at Osia steak. The daily picks - watermelon radish salad , and the bbq baby pork ribs were delicious.

Thanks to service staff for letting us know that we can order 1/2 portion of sun dried tomato and 1/2 portion of marmite garlic flatbread, which was perfect as we had varying preference. Would be excellent if the service staff can let us know that we had order too much food for two persons because we struggled to finish the meal.

The V day complimentary chocs at the end of meal was a lovely surprise, thanks!
author: C K

review_text:
Had a wonderful dining experience at OSIA @ Resorts World Sentosa. We tried the grass-fed striploin, ribeye, the Glacier 51 toothfish, and the seafood pasta, every dish was beautifully executed. The steaks were perfectly cooked, the toothfish was rich and buttery, and the seafood pasta was generous and full of flavour.

What really elevated the experience was the service. The staff were friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming, striking a great balance between professionalism and warmth.

Overall, a memorable meal with great food and excellent service. Would definitely return.
author: David Lim

review_text:
Had an amazing set dinner at Osia Steak & Seafood Grill! Every dish was packed with flavor and cooked to perfection. The fish was incredibly fresh and delicate, while the short rib was tender, juicy, and full of rich, savory goodness.

To top it all off, the hot chocolate soup was an absolute showstopper — rich, indulgent, and tasted just like a decadent brownie. Truly a meal to remember! Special mention to Kash, Vinesh and Marcus.
author: Lecinlurve

review_text: If you're going to travel, check out Singapore. If you go to Singapore you should visit Sentosa. If you go to Sentosa you should definitely go to Osia. The hardest thing about travelling is food. My family and I are coeliacs and finding safe food is hard. Finding safe and delicious is like a finding a unicorn. The food was amazing. We have the 2 spatchcock chickens (yzu butter and bearnaise), asparagus and 2 bowls of chips. etremely reasonable for Singapore. It fed the family after a hard days walk. We were served by Innah and Marcus. They were intelligent, helpful, funny and the service was second to none. Thanks again guys. I have no hesitation in recommending what we had especially if gluten free. Thanks so much.
author: Simon Stubbs

review_text: Couldn't get a Michelin restaurant on a PH to celebrate our wedding anniversary and tried out Osia. To our surprise, theur service was excellent especially from Eebii who was very attentive and warm throughout our meal. Pricing is super reasonable and they service really amazing steaks. We will come back for sure. I didnt even ask for carpark coupon and they proactively asked whether did I drive here. Amazing! Thank you for the great time at your restaurant.
author: Nicholas Neo

review_text:
Dear Team,

I would like to share a compliment for Siew Fung, who served my family and me during dinner on 8 February. He created a very cosy and welcoming atmosphere from the moment we arrived and took the time to introduce the dishes clearly, which made our dining experience even more enjoyable.

His service was truly top-notch. He was attentive to our needs, especially watching out for the kids and ensuring they were comfortable throughout the meal. The food was served promptly and was absolutely delicious — my kids finished almost everything, which says a lot!

Please convey our appreciation to Siew Fung for his outstanding service. He made our family dinner a memorable one, and we look forward to returning again.

Warm regards,
Liz
author: Liz Lee

review_text: I had a fantastic dining experience at Feng Shui Inn! The food was absolutely excellent, with every dish full of flavor and beautifully presented. The ambience added to the charm, making it a perfect setting for a cozy meal. Our server, Gary, was incredibly friendly and knowledgeable, recommending some of the best dishes on the menu – and he didn’t steer us wrong! As a special touch, the restaurant surprised us with a Halloween-themed dessert, which was such a treat and a lovely gesture. Thank you for a memorable afternoon lunch!
author: Michelle Yannis

review_text:
Some items were good while some were mid.

Dumplings and mango sago was the best dishes of the day. But for such an expensive meal, i wished there were more mangos (cmon its mango season now!!)

Soup was okay, but the meat was kinda hard. The carbs dish was disappointing as the fried rice had no flavor and the texture was kinda bad, and the tofu was a lil cold.

Overall an average to below average chinese resaurant. Had better dimsum at more affordable prices too.
author: K Chen

review_text:
A Six-Star Culinary Experience

Feng Shui Inn at Equarius Hotel, Singapore, offers an exceptional dining experience. The food is absolutely top-notch—every single dish is perfectly crafted and never fails to impress. Truly a feast for the senses!

The service is equally outstanding. The waitstaff are attentive, efficient, and ensure a smooth and enjoyable dining experience from start to finish.

This restaurant is a must-visit for anyone seeking a luxurious and unforgettable meal. Highly recommended and deserving of six stars!
author: Melissa Hee

review_text:
I recently dined at Feng Shui Inn at Resorts World Sentosa, and the experience was a mix of exceptional cuisine and an unexpected downside. The food was undeniably outstanding, showcasing a refined take on Cantonese flavors with premium ingredients.

The Baked Cod with Wasabi Sauce was a highlight, with its buttery texture complemented by a subtle wasabi kick. The Deep-Fried Crab Claw with Salt and Pepper had a perfectly crispy exterior, enhancing the natural sweetness of the crab. Another standout was the Braised Kurobuta Pork Ribs with Red Wine and Fresh Apple, which had a beautifully rich depth of flavor, with the fruit adding a delicate sweetness to the tender ribs.

The Double-boiled Fresh Lily Bulbs, Sea Whelk Soup was comforting and full of nourishing flavors, while the Baked Tiger Prawn with Tamayaki Sauce, Celery, and Ginger Onion had a wonderful umami balance. The Wok-fried Handmade Noodle with Grouper Fillet was another well-executed dish, featuring springy noodles and fresh seafood.

To end the meal, the Hot Ginger Soup with Red Dates and Lotus Seed, served with a Crispy Custard Puff Pastry, was the perfect mix of warmth and indulgence.

However, despite the impeccable food, the dining experience was affected by an issue with flies inside the restaurant, which was surprising given that it is an upscale indoor venue. While the staff were attentive and the ambiance was elegant, this aspect detracted from the overall experience.

That said, if the management can address this issue, Feng Shui Inn remains a fantastic spot for refined Cantonese cuisine, with dishes that showcase both tradition and creativity. Would I return? For the food—absolutely. But I do hope to see improvements in the dining environment.
author: Alex

review_text:
I recently dined at Sofitel Sentosa and had a truly wonderful experience from start to finish. The setting alone is worth mentioning — nestled in lush greenery with a peaceful resort atmosphere, it feels like a short escape from the city.

The food was beautifully presented and thoughtfully prepared. Each dish was well-balanced in flavor, and you can really tell that quality ingredients were used. The seafood was especially fresh, and the desserts were elegant without being overly sweet. The menu offers a nice mix of Indian-inspired cuisine with subtle local influences, which made the experience both refined and interesting.

Service was attentive and professional without being intrusive. The staff were warm, (Penny and Samuel) knowledgeable about the menu, and happy to provide recommendations. Small details — like prompt refilling of water and checking in at the right moments — made the experience feel polished and luxurious.

While prices are on the higher side, the overall ambiance, food quality, and service justify it for a special occasion or a relaxing weekend treat.

Overall, Sofitel Sentosa offers a sophisticated dining experience in a serene setting, perfect for celebrations or simply indulging in a memorable meal. I would gladly return.
author: Florian

review_text:
We came here for the Festive Sunday brunch.

The first thing I noticed is that there are flies in the dining area and around the food. Not something I'd expect from a restaurant that charges $108++ per pax.

The oysters were ok. The salmon sashimi is not professionally cut.
The lobsters were good. But the crab legs were rubbery, not fresh.
The cheeses don't look fresh either. Some of the edges have discoloured.
The Prata was stale, felt like was left there for very long.
The multigrain bread was also dried up already.
The main dishes were so so. Yam fritter (Wu Guo) is not as good as a dim sum place.
Desserts were ok. The raspberry cake had a nice feuilletine base. The pecan tart was average not particularly tasty and the crust not buttery crunchy enough.
The minced pie pastry was nice and flaky but the filling could have a stronger alcohol kick.
The gelato flavours (all flavours, chocolate, strawberry and vanilla) were not intense enough.
Generally, not quite worth the pricem the quality and ambience ought to be better.
author: Kelvin Goh

review_text:
We chose the a la carte menu for dinner instead of the buffet as we were still full from a late lunch. The food was average and did not stand out.

Service at the al fresco area was hard to come by, as staff appeared fully occupied with the indoor buffet crowd.

To make matters worse, we were only informed at payment that it was a blackout day and the 30% stay-in guest discount did not apply. This was disappointing, especially since nearby establishments did not impose similar blackout restrictions.
author: MH Tham

review_text: Although I didn't capture it in a photo, the seafood rice was truly delicious. I was impressed by the friendly and attentive service of the staff at JULIE. It's the perfect place for a family meal in an exotic atmosphere. I plan to visit again.
author: SANGHYUN CHOI

review_text: Repeated guests at Kwee Zeen! Love that I can bring my pet along for the buffet dinner. Food selections are not bad but we come especially for the ambiance and their awesome services. In particular Mr Albert, Jeffrey, Penny and Alvin. They are very friendly, attentive and always serve with a smile. Will definitely be back for more! Great job guys 👍
author: Vicki

review_text:
The views are unmatched - Beautiful view of the huge lawn and sea that are perfect for sunsets when you’re sitting outdoors.

Food was generally good. However, I did find the butter for the bread way too salty - the salt flakes on the butter was definitely an overkill as the butter seemed to already be salted.

While service was pretty slow due to the lack of staff and some of the part time staff seemed to be a little confused, Carol was amazing in ensuring that our orders were constantly checked on and that our glasses were always full. Appreciate that her amazing hospitality made our visit a memorable one.
author: Bev A

review_text:
We made an reservation ahead of time and had a decent lunch crowd on a Saturday afternoon. Very attentive service; particularly, Santos was very helpful. Outdoors can get a little warm in the afternoon but offers a fantastic view of the lawn and the beach further ahead.

We tried the Colombian chicken and lamb. Fantastic flavouring with a touch of pink but the staff were very helpful in assuring the doneness and had it stick in the oven for couple extra mins. Lamb flavour was great with a bit more on the fatty side. Regardless, we enjoyed both the dishes and will try again.

Ended the meal with sticky date/Guinness cake which was excellent as well. Added bonus were the interesting cocktail menu. Will visit again.
author: Niwas Nallasamy

review_text:
We had a delightful evening here yesterday starting with a scenic sunset and a bottle of champagne courtesy of the owner who is a friend of my son! Starters were quick to arrive and tasted great - especially the corn which was delicious. We also started with a round of cocktails for all choosing from the wide list of options available. After a spectacular sunset, we moved indoors for dinner which was a mix of seafood, meats and greens - everything was well prepared, tasty and served with both style and efficiency. We loved the experience and are sure to be back with friends in the near future.
On a separate note, all of the staff were courteous but I want to put in a special thanks to Santos who was both efficient, courteous and also took special care of us. Thank you!
PS: They have a 15% discount on cocktails till 7 pm so make sure you get in early
author: Arjun Trivedi

review_text:
We had our anniversary lunch here and was lucky enough to have good weather with cloudy skies! A little warm to be outside but worth it with the great views. We really love the food especially the Chicken and Baby Corn.

Service was great, servers paid close attention and always topped up water and cleared plates once we finished. Food was served in a timely manner too! We also got served with a complimentary dessert when we were done with our meal for our anniversary celebration.

Will highly recommend for anyone looking for a chill outdoor brunch to celebrate an occasion. Dress light if you’re heading here :)
author: Wen Xin Lee

review_text: I want to give a huge shoutout to Santos and his amazing team for making my girlfriend’s birthday celebration with her family an unforgettable experience! We are already looking forward to our next visit, especially for that delicious signature chicken—fingers crossed it’s not sold out! The evening was wonderful, with a fantastic atmosphere, beautiful surroundings, and a great staff who made us feel right at home. Thank you all for creating such a special memory! 🎉✨
author: Renier

review_text: Visited +Twelve on my birthday and it did not disappoint! The beach daybeds were very affordable for the morning slot, and I was very happy with the quality of the food it was quite exceptional. Especially, the sushi rolls and the truffle fries … they were super worth it….Service was excellent as well, staff was very attentive and kind. Special thanks to Gilbert & staff for being so accommodating and generous. Decided to extend our booking till the evening 😄😄 Will come back again!!!
author: Mariessa J

review_text:
The staff were great and pretty proactive. The DJ played good music. Food was good except the desserts we had. Especially recommend the Mac and cheese and truffle fries! Pool is gorgeous. Unfortunately the daybeds were pretty dirty and there were ants everywhere. The part of the beach they have access to is less nice compared to another beach club I went to previously.
But I wanted to write this review mainly to commend the serving staff and security, they were friendly and helpful, making the experience better than it would have been
author: QT Par

review_text:
We had a wonderful birthday celebration at +Twelve! The staff were incredibly kind and attentive, especially JLo, who took great care of us throughout the evening. He ensured everything ran smoothly and thoughtfully recommended the right amount of food for our party of 10. We also truly appreciated his suggestion of the cabana, which offered the perfect vantage point to enjoy both the sunset and the fireworks.

The food was excellent. Highlights included the truffle fries and the orange crispy maki roll from the sushi boat, which were definite crowd favourites.

Overall, the vibes were absolutely top-notch. I received plenty of positive feedback from my friends as well—the cabana was cosy yet spacious, making it ideal for us to socialise comfortably as a group.

Kudos to the team on 21/12/25 for delivering such excellent service!
author: Chin Xi Pan

review_text: Lovely beach club. Love the fact that no kids are allowed so we adults can have a proper break from work. The pool is beautifully designed and the daybeds were comfortable. Gilbert the GM was so friendly and made the effort to chat with us all, and made us feel at home. Will come back again
author: Louis Ow

review_text: Great beach club with music and pool. I was here during lunch time and the sushi and sashimi plates were great. The staff was kind and professional, and the location. It's adult only so it's perfect for relaxing, even though the music can get a bit too loud. Only downside is my sunbed was a bit dirty. They provide towel.
author: Federico Cremonini

review_text:
Revisited this restaurant again, their omakase set is still very nice this round

We had dinner here after the golf game on Thursday, the restaurant business is still very good even on weekdays. We ordered the omakasei set which provided us quite a variety of different dishes, all very good to match sakei.
The most important is the staff including the chef are all very friendly and hospitable, very fast to respond to our need, strongly recommended.
The only thing minus is its location, quite far from where we live .. ha
author: Ben Lin

review_text: Traditional comfy ambience (highly recommend the counter vs. tables for a proper experience), good sushi (we had the simple $130 dinner set and various side items to try out seeing first time - omakase with premium items and more wild caught content is only $200), friendly itamae, reasonable pricing. Food would be 4/5 stars vs various "famous", mostly overpriced sushiyas in Singapore - however that is not a fair comparison - 4 stars for what it is and sets out to be. I even spied a private room, for those who prefer "private" dining. Good effort overall from a modest but enjoyable sushiya. If I lived in Sentosa, or were a Sentosa Golf Club regular, I would be here often. Regardless, we will be back...
author: Kevin Hee

review_text: I love this gem of a sushiya! Their nigiri sushi sets are priced at $50 for lunch and $70 before tax for dinner. My go to place when I am craving sushi. Also had the omakase here thrice, really good. Makes me happy when my money is well spent. Totally worth the travel to Sentosa! Don't need to think twice.
author: SXLI

review_text: Besides good selection of fresh fishes n seafood for sashimi n sushi, there is also a wide selection of seasonal items n cooked food from main menu. Prices are reasonable n Chef Kondo is very friendly and accommodating. Place can get noisy with the wrong crowd that's not suited to a proper sushiya like this.
author: Kiko
