review_text: Japanese fine dining located within Sentosa Golf Club. The bara chirashi was made with freshest fish. The whole experience was topped with attentive service. Thumbs up from the hungry golfers. 🍣
author: JC C

review_text:
Good place to chili in sentosa without a minimal spent. Service is fast.

Tried their coconut milk shake and virgin mojito mocktail.

Coconut milk shake is sweet and refreshing but we could not finish it.

Mojito is okay and great for the hot afternoon.

Not much crowd on a Sunday.

There’s also indoor air con seatings.
author: Orange

review_text: Greek restaurant at the beachside. Compared to nearby restaurants it is overpriced, but on the other hand it is unique and thematic, making it somewhat reasonable. Serving is fast, staff is friendly. Very nice plating, size of the dish is perfect, not going to be hungry one hour later. Tested 'Blu Cheeseburger' and from the description and after experience from Greece, expected a juicy burger patty with everything else separately. Received instead a classic burger. It was still juicy and overall OK, but nothing special.
author: Gyorgy Badari

review_text: We are regulars at Siglap and Dempsey. Being in Sentoza we gave this outlet a try. Whilst we really appreciate the quality of the food and the authentic execution of the dishes, we really think some of the the dishes are truly overpriced. Very pleasant venue right by the beach. The service could slightly be more attentive 🙏🏻
author: GA YA

review_text: I’ve been to the Siglap branch which was absolutely amazing. The Sentosa outlet is fine too but a totally different vibe - mostly empty and just a few tourists. Service was great and food average. Price felt expensive for what we ate and drank at about $130-150 per person.
author: Sonzy M

review_text: Blu Kouzina Sentosa is located direcly at the wonderful Palawan Beach - we not only enjoyed the view but even more the very delicouse Baklawa, Strawbery Ice and Capuchinos - the service was very friendly, the prizes fair and the menü card had a large variety - we will for sure comwback and can recommend the restaurant
author: Andreas Brunner

review_text:
Visited in Dec 2025

Fiamma had long been on my list of restaurants to visit in SG given its reputation as one of the best Italian restaurants in the city. The restaurant is located within the premises of the Capella Hotel in Sentosa - so the pick-up/drop-off point is the Capella lobby.

We were a group of 4 and had made a reservation from before. The restaurant was quite full on the Sat evening we visited and hence making a reservation would be recommended. The restaurant has a tasting menu and an a-la-carte menu. We decided to just order from the a-la-carte menu.

For the Antipasti we ordered the Wood charred Radicchio & Amberjack salad, the Smoked Scallop Carpaccio, and the Fried Ox Tongue with Parma Ham. Among these 3 items ordered, my favourite was the Smoked Scallop Carpaccio.

From the Primi & Pizza menu, we ordered the Diavola Pizza and 3 Pastas (the Paccheri All’amatriciana, Lobster Tagliatelle, and the Trofie Al Pesto with Calamari). The Paccheri All’amatriciana was my favourite of the lot and I would 100% recommend ordering this pasta.

From the Secondi menu we ordered the Fresh Fish of the Day which was also a beautiful and flavourful dish. For desserts, we ended up ordering quite items, among which the tiramisu and panna cotta were my favourites. Even the cannoli was fantastic. The tiramisu here is a must order dessert dish in my view.

For drinks we ordered a couple of bottles of white wine in consultation with the restaurant’s sommelier. The bottle of Gewurztraminer we ordered was absolutely brilliant.

In summary, Fiamma is indeed a fantastic Italian restaurant and one of the best in SG. I’ll definitely be back sometime again. A 100% recommendation.
author: Avijeet Sen

review_text:
Fiamma at the Capella delivers a truly exceptional dining experience that effortlessly blends refined Italian cuisine with warm, thoughtful hospitality. From the moment you’re seated, it’s clear that every detail—from presentation to pacing—has been carefully considered.

The food is outstanding. The handmade pastas are deeply flavorful and perfectly cooked, whether it’s a rich seafood pasta bursting with freshness or a comforting, elegant ravioli finished with precision. Each dish feels both elevated and soulful, celebrating Italian tradition while showcasing modern finesse. The grilled whole fish is a standout: beautifully cooked, aromatic, and presented in a way that feels both dramatic and inviting. Even the vegetable-forward dishes and starters shine with creativity, balance, and impeccable technique.

Presentation across the menu is stunning—artful without being pretentious—and the ingredients are clearly top-tier. Desserts (I highly recommend the tiramisu) and lighter courses are just as memorable, offering freshness and contrast that round out the meal beautifully.

Service is polished yet warm, striking the perfect balance between luxury and approachability. The staff are knowledgeable, attentive, and genuinely passionate about the food, enhancing the overall experience without ever feeling intrusive.

Fiamma isn’t just a meal—it’s an experience worth savoring. Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or simply looking for an exceptional dinner, this restaurant is a must-visit. Easily a five-star experience, and one we’ll continue to revisit.
author: Andy

review_text:
Had a wonderful dining experience at Fiamma, and a big part of it was thanks to Mani.

From the moment we were seated, Mani’s service was warm, attentive, and thoughtful without being intrusive. She explained the dishes well, checked in at the right moments, and made the whole experience feel smooth and premium. It genuinely felt like dining at a 5-star Michelin restaurant.

What stood out most was the sincerity behind the service. It's not just doing her job, but doing it with pride and care. This kind of service elevates the entire dining experience.

Thank you, Mani, for making our visit so memorable. Will definitely be back.
author: Zen Ng

review_text:
Very lovely and cozy Italian restaurant!

Service is excellent from the moment we reaching Fiamma, welcomed by the friendly hostess to the table, warm service throughout dining and even when we are leaving the restaurant after a wonderful meal time.

Thank you Shahie and team for being so attentive and gentle throughout.

Food is soooo appetizing and delicious! Every dishes served to our table are so well curated. The food looks like a mini flower garden, so sweet and lovely.

We specially like the octopus and lamb rack. Octopus texture and taste are perfect, not too chewy or mushy, and it looks so beautiful!

Lamb rack with the sea urchin is such a smart and flawless combination!

Compliment to Chef Antonio and team! We had an amazing lunch at Fiamma!
author: Abby Lim

review_text:
Great mornings pave the way for unforgettable getaways :)

During my stay at Capella Singapore, I had my a curated buffet with à la carte at Fiamma every day. The menu includes the selection of eggs and style; breakfast sweets; chef’s signature; local favourites and vegan selections. Some of the items that stand out are 3-stacker mini pancakes, onsen egg and kaya toast and the Chairman’s Indulgence. They were all freshly prepared and served at my table.

As a GHA Discovery Titanium member, I could savour complimentary breakfast through booking on the hotel webpage. This upgrade is definitely one of the many benefits I appreciate most.

I would like to express my gratitude to Red and Liu for being so attentive to my needs during my meal. Fiamma is surely where I enjoy my mornings with great delight!
author: Jason Kwong JK

review_text:
It was a complete wonderful experience at The Royal China at Raffles Hotel Sentosa.
The service provided by the resturant manager Colin, the assistant maanger Ee_sim and the cute beautiful always smiling Taylor extended to me and my family was immaculate detail, friendly and professional.
The food menu tailored by the head chef Ling for us was excellence and catered to our individual taste and met our highest expectations.
Each dish was carefully prepared and well presented.
If you are being full, you can take a stroll outside the resturant and enjoy the evening peaceful view.
A total wonderous delightful experience.
author: Desmond Low

review_text:
A proper atas lo-hei session with my makan kakis at Royal China, tucked within the newly opened Raffles Sentosa — Singapore’s first all-villa resort (launched in 2025).

From the moment you arrive, it already feels special. A buggy whisks you through lush grounds to an intimate dining room framed by floor-to-ceiling windows, all greenery and calm — hard to believe you’re still in Singapore.

The Classic Trio Combination was a highlight: delicate poached mackerel with green chive flower dumplings, smoky-sweet Kurobuta pork char siew with that perfect caramelised edge, and refreshing tossed jellyfish flower for contrast. Refined, balanced, and very satisfying.

If you’re there, don’t skip the soups — seriously worth the splurge. The superior double-boiled consommé with fish maw, dried scallop and conch meat was clean yet deeply comforting, while the braised abalone with dried scallop and premium dried seafood in superior stock was rich, velvety and unapologetically indulgent.

Despite already being stuffed, we somehow made space for the final dish — simmered vermicelli with crab meat and dried scallop. Pure refined comfort in a bowl, light yet deeply flavourful, and effortlessly polished off to the very last strand.

Overall, a strong destination for upscale Cantonese in tranquil luxury — perfect for festive gatherings when you want good food, good company, and a setting that feels like a mini getaway.
author: Roger Yuen

review_text:
Watching an Instagram reel about being transported to the restaurant from the hotel lobby via a Rolls-Royce buggy, I decided to dine at Royal China during my stay in Sentosa.

Royal China offers exquisite Cantonese cuisine in an elegant setting featuring floor-to-ceiling windows and tropical greenery views. As I came on my own, I could not try those signature dishes that require sharing with several diners. Still, I had a great time enjoying the following dishes (per person):

1. Classic Trio Combination (Poached Mackerel Fish and Green Chives Flower Dumplings; Honey-gazed Kurobuta Pork Char Siew; Tossed Jelly Fish Flower, Sesame Dressing)
2. Steamed Brown Marbled Grouper Fillet in Yuzu Soy Sauce
3. Royal China Vegetarian Buddha Jumps Over the Wall (Vegetarian Abalone, Vegetarian Sea Cucumber, Flower Mushroom, Vegetarian Chinese Ham, Bamboo Pith, Morel Mushroom, Snow Fungus, Chinese Wolfberries)
4. Cream of Almond with Egg White and Hashima

I have included photos of the al la carte menu for small groups / solo diners. Raffles Sentosa is like a paradise in Singapore. I will definitely be back no matter for staycation or for Royal China with my friends and family!
author: Jason Kwong JK

review_text: we have dined in Royal China raffles sentosa the experience were excellent. The dishes were prepared with great thought and care.all were scrumptious and exquisitely presented. Overall service was impressive Restaurant manager Kolin . Sivan,wenjing, Anna and Taylor were attenive and helpful. Our heartfelt thanks to Chef Ling for taking time to meet us. His warm hospitality and professionalism.
author: wong abby

review_text: We have dined in Royal China twice and the experience for both were excellent. The dishes were prepared with great thought and care, all were scrumptious and exquisitely presented. Restaurant manager, Colin, even surprised my mum with a beautiful plate of “Shou Tau” (birthday buns) with hand-written message that made the birthday lunch even more special. Overall service was impressive, staff were attentive and helpful, especially Sivan, who made extra effort to remember our names! 👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼
author: Michelle Chia

review_text:
We had a wonderful dining experience at Empire Grill! From the moment we arrived, everything was excellent the food was delicious, the atmosphere was warm and inviting, and the service truly stood out.

👏A special thank you to Brynn, Lyle, Ra Jan, Mei Chuan, and Joana for taking such great care of us. Everyone was attentive, friendly, and professional, making us feel genuinely welcome throughout our visit. Their teamwork and hospitality made the experience even more enjoyable.

We truly had a great time and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommended!👍
author: Joan Glaser

review_text:
Returned to Empire Grill for the Raffles Sunday Brunch two months after my previous visit, and I’m very pleased to say the experience was excellent. Chef Bjoern and the team were warm, attentive, and delivered a seamless service flow throughout the brunch.

The hospitality felt genuine, the pacing was well managed, and the overall experience was very much aligned with Raffles standards. The food was great — beautifully executed and enjoyable. The lobster tail was a favourite with us, perfectly done and indulgent. If you’re a caviar person, the signature caviar host experience during the brunch is a really nice touch — and yes, it’s unlimited 🥹

We’ve also tried items from the à la carte menu on a separate occasion and found those dishes even yummier, so I would definitely recommend trying both the Raffles Sunday Brunch and the à la carte offerings for the full Empire Grill experience.

And if you’re up for a swim, brunch guests can also enjoy access to the pool until 7pm, which makes it a lovely way to turn brunch into a relaxed day out.

I truly appreciate the team taking feedback seriously and demonstrating a genuine commitment to improvement. Thank you, Chef Bjoern and team — it was a wonderful return visit.
author: Eileen Lim

review_text:
Had a good lunch at this hidden gem.

Venue

A buggy will take you to & from the restaurant.

Very cosy with comfy couch seating and high ceiling & windows  especially in the day with the natural light and looking out at the greens.

Food

Firstly they served freshly “warmed” complimentary bread to start.

We enjoyed the food especially the smokey flavour from the breads that came with the beef tartare and also the smokey flavour from the steak.

The lobster linguine is yummy too!

The negative was the dessert local melon which personally tasted off balance as the melon & limoncello tasted bland but the tofu ice-cream was good.

Service

Mixed feelings on the service.

The serving on food was good but when come to payment, we got charged wrongly 3 times and took them some time to get it sorted without letting us know the hold up until we asked so we found ourselves sitting & waiting.

However they did give us a bottle of wine as a token of apology so thank you.

I also found it weird that cleaner came to sweep the floor while people still dining.

Overall, it was good and we just had a little hiccup on payment.
author: Kaz

review_text: Came here for afternoon tea and tried a few of their desserts. Dessert is pretty good! Americano is on the bitter side and less acidic which is what I prefer. Beautiful and quiet ambience. Overall service is top notch. Thank you Santos and Carol for being attentive and making us feel well taken care of :)
author: Estiee C

review_text:
First and foremost, the service and ambiance was superb. As we were dining with our dog, we were seated alfresco by the pool. The area was breezy with ceiling fans, and the setting was beautiful, watching the evening sky change colours under the huge umbrella made for a lovely start to dinner.

The staff gave us ample time to decide, and when we shared our preferences, recommendations were made confidently. The wine list was extensive, with a basic cocktail selection. We ordered the foie gras and beef slider, spaghettini, octopus leg, broccolini and a steak. We also requested the steak Pittsburgh-style with a medium centre instead of rare. The short rib ravioli was unavailable that evening, which was a slight disappointment but not a major issue.

As the sun set, flies started to appear. We asked for bug repellent, but it was not very effective.

Once the food arrived, the superb slider quickly lifted the situation. It was more of a full-sized burger than a slider, which explained why it was served as a single portion. The staff kindly had it cut in half for sharing. The pasta was well-seasoned and perfectly cooked. The octopus wasn’t grilled as we had expected, but it was enjoyable nonetheless.

The steak was the only letdown. Our request may have been misunderstood. The added charring likely pushed the medium doneness closer to well done. Next time, we would order it medium rare instead.

At the end of the meal, we realised we had forgotten to apply the Amex discount. The staff promptly reversed and recalculated the bill without hesitation, another example of their excellent service.

Overall, a place we would gladly revisit, but hopefully with fewer flies next time.
author: MH Tham

review_text: amazing restaurant serving one of the best sushi you can find in singapore. the fish is exquisite and their signature dishes like ankimo, otoro and belt fish + uni are to die for. on top of it all, the service staff are extremely hospitable and will remember the smallest of details. special shoutout to chef kazu and katie for always making every visit a wonderful experience for us. in summary, their food and hospitality should be the gold standard that every top tier restaurant should have.
author: Jerome Li

review_text: Absolutely wonderful omakase meal with the freshest ingredients.  Presentation was beautiful and service was excellent.  Favorite pieces were toro, uni, baracuda,  and marinated toro with yuzu zest. So many other pieces to name but everything tasted so so fresh. Last, I won’t ever forget the desert. Try it and you will know why.
author: Dat Vu

review_text:
This is one of the best Omakase sushi meal I've had. Everything is made to perfection. Chef Kazu is so friendly and we were all so thrilled by the experienced we had.
If you are up for an unforgettable experience and have a budget for it.. this place is strongly recommended.
author: Remy Ng

review_text:
Had a nice quiet evening dinner here. Food and service was good. Went earlier to watch the sunset sky and check out the new Raffles Hotel.

For those driving in, the hotel provides complimentary valet, and the restaurant will send you a QR code to enter Sentosa.

Course Dinner was S$450++ (excl Drinks).
author: K.E.

review_text:
Hashida is truly one of our favourite omakase experience, and when Chef Hatch opened Iyasaka, we quickly made a reservation for ourselves!

Upon arriving at Raffles Sentosa, we were driven by a buggy to Iyasaka. The spacious counter could sit 12 comfortably, and we were lucky to be served by Chef Hatch (who shuttles between Tokyo and SG).

The quality of food has always been remarkable, always top notch, and we always love Chef’s little fusion ideas that always give little surprises to his menu for the day. We walked out with 4 very happy people with 4 very happy bellies. Thank you to the team at Iyasaka for always making our experience so memorable - ankimo was truly the biggest I’ve eaten in my life!

Please note that buggy service back to the main lobby ends at midnight, so be sure to leave by then!
author: Julia Tan

review_text:
🟨 Raffles Room
4 Bukit Manis Road
🔵 Raffles Sentosa hotel ( 🔴 new)
Sentosa Island, Singapore 099947

🟧  I had reserved a table for two at Raffles Room at the newly-opened and swanky Raffles Sentosa on April 20th, 2025 Sunday. ● We drove there and at the entrance of the hotel, a valet parked the car for us. 🙏🏻

🟧 Raffles Room, nestled at the lobby of the new hotel, is a tea room lounge. ▪︎ The decor is elegant, and the ambience is a sophisticated one. ▪︎With luxurious furnishings, rich wood tones, and a refined decor, all these elements reflects the Raffles Hotel's colonial heritage.

🟩  The Raffles Room also offers stunning views of the surrounding verdant and lush landscape.

🔵 Food and Beverages
*************************
● We ordered two Iced Cafe Lattes and a Choux Cream Pastry Puff. ● The Choux pastry was a large crusty cream puff with 3 types of fillings -- Egg Custard | Vanilla Custard and Toffee.

● The Iced Cafe Lattes were well-crafted coffee brews, with a well balanced flavour profile, pleasant acidity and a smooth & creamy mouthfeel.

✴️ Service = The staff at Raffles Room were highly attentive and knowledgable. 🩷 Special thanks goes to Jeremy, Rica and Shermin for their kind & genuine omotenashi hospitality.

▪︎ ❇️ Jeremy Ong, the Asst Outlet Manager, took great care of us right from the start, and he even gifted us complimentary mini Raffles Sling cocktails (▪︎ the sister cocktail drink of the famed Singapore Sling). 🌳🌳 He also spoke to me about the lovely 100 year old Ficus tree that lies just outside the large window panels of the tea room.

✳️ Rica and Shermin chatted with me and informed me of the wild peacocks that roams the premises of the hotel grounds.

🟨 All in all, my husband and I had a wonderful tea time treat at Raffles Room, and coupled with the top notch service from all the staff, I must say this experience is befitting of a first class hotel like Raffles Sentosa.

🩶 I hope to be back again in the near future, perhaps to the Cantonese restaurant "Royal China" and Empire Grill.
author: Florence Leow

review_text:
Excellent service upon walking in from the lobby! Upon seeing me working on my laptop, one of the staff actually shared with me where the plugs are located so that I could charge them when my battery runs out.

While I was having a work discussion with my clients, the staff attentively offered me a glass of warm water as I was coughing.

It is simple gestures like that that touch the heart. The team made my day. Thank you! ❤️
author: Cheryl Lim

review_text: A cosy afternoon tea with gorgeous nature views! Excellent service provided by James and Camille who were very attentive in refilling our cups and clearing our dishes; they also gave good recommendations on the tea flavours and a complimentary cake for my friend’s birthday! Overall, this was a very filling afternoon tea which was beautifully presented and tasted as good as it looked! We would return!
author: Jasmine Subramaniam

review_text:
Not a value for money place. Please avoid if coming for water play.
It is really a waste of time. The water play theme is really really medicore. Come here if you have nothing better to do. My kids mention that they rather go to a friend's condo swimming pool.

I might as well go to a public water play pool eg, tampines at OTH and it's way cheaper. Wild wild wet would be so much better than this place. In addition, we must spend minimum amt on food as it is in the terms and condition.

However, the F&B service is fantastic. For the food, it is quite average.
author: Hoon SzeSiang

review_text: Thank you Splash Tribe! We had so much fun here on our Singapore vacation. It was the perfect spot to relax and enjoy the day with our one year old daughter. The food was great and the facilities were clean. It was a really fun day. A special shout out to our amazing server, Yoges, who took really good care of us. She set us up in a private space when our daughter had her nap, so that she was out of the heat and in shade. She also gave toys to our daughter to play with. All of the staff were kind and helpful. I appreciate you all! Overall we had an outstanding experience.
author: Jenna Stirling

review_text:
Clean, nice, spacious place with a water playground and a pool. Parents can chill out at the seats while their kids play. Food is not bad but slightly expensive, there's also cover charge of $10 per pax regardless of adult/child.

Also wanna give a kudos to Anna (not sure of the spelling), she is especially sweet and helpful. Great work!
author: Jan

review_text: We visited Splash Tribe as a family of four on a weekday to celebrate my wife’s birthday, and it was a fantastic first experience! A huge shout-out to the lady at the entrance (I missed her name!) who was incredibly friendly and went above and beyond to accommodate us. Even when a storm hit, the staff continued to provide full, excellent service. We had a wonderful time and will definitely be visiting again soon!"
author: Razië Rasid

review_text:
For a family day out highly recommended. The day manager was professional and well mannered and explained everything brilliantly.

The food was kid friendly and well done. Beware the price of alcohol if that’s your thing.

The only criticism is the over zealous pool guards. They not only lacked manners when asking kids to stop doing even the slightest thing but were also quite rude to guests. It gave the feeling of a school camp rather than a relaxed hotel vibe.
author: James Midge

review_text: Delightful dining at an exquisite venue.
author: Ken C

review_text: Marie was very knowledgeable about the menu and explained the dishes so well! Her team was prompt in their service. Food was amazing as well, the scones were amazing. Very satisfied with our anniversary afternoon tea. deceivingly small, we were very full by the end of it.
author: Debbie Tay

review_text: Food are no nice and cup was dirty but ambience is nice
author: 장지은

restaurant_name: Ye Olde Cow – KidZania Takeaway Kiosk
review_text: Was at the Kidzania kiosk at 5pm on a Fri, but it was closed despite published hours stating 6pm. The kind lady at the Kidzania counter even went in to the diner to inquire on my behalf, but staff present insisted that they close at 5. In that case, update your bloody operating hours.
author: K99

review_text: I went to the Kidzania kiosk because the food truck isn’t open on Mondays. I’ve been to the food truck before, it was seriously one of the best burgers I’ve ever had so on my next trip to Singapore I craved to taste it again. Seeing that it was available in Sentosa I decided to make the trek all the way there but it was such a disappointment. First of all the kiosk was empty and after paying for the meal on the machine, there was no signage to inform how to pick up the food. There was no one about for me to ask any info either and I was going up and down all the levels to find out. Only much later I see a guy come out with the packed meal but I could have not been there and would have totally missed him. Next was the burger itself… it was such a disappointment. I could have compared it to a McDonald’s cheeseburger to be honest. I don’t know what is the difference between the food truck and the Kidzania one but it’s like two different burgers. It was such a letdown to travel all the way to Sentosa to have a less than mediocre burger. The meat was rubbery and bun chewy… not like the juicy version I had before. I don’t know if I’ll ever praise Ye Olde Cow again after this experience.
author: Kupo Edie

review_text:
The burgers here are on the expensive side, but definitely tasty. I ordered two burgers with one beverage (ice lemon tea) and one fries.

The beef burgers were juicy, with the melted cheese enhancing the overall flavor.

The only issue I have is that my beverage and side did not become a meal (meal costs +7 but I was charged +10). I suspect it was because I did not choose a value meal from the very start. I feel this is not the most ethical as I chose on the add-ons directly from the burger menu and not separately. As such, I am giving them a 4 stars instead of 5 stars.

Otherwise, they will definitely get 5 stars due to the superb taste of the burgers.
author: SZ Lim

review_text:
I was fully aware that KidZania is currently experiencing staff shortages. However, I was surprised to encounter the same situation at Ye Olde Cow, despite it being a paying lease within the premises.

During our visit, we were informed by the staff member—who was alone—that there was nothing he could do to assist us. We were even encouraged to proceed with making a complaint, as the short-staffed situation left him unable to address our concerns. Subsequently, we were turned away without being given the opportunity to explain our situation, with short staffing cited as the reason.

While I understand operational challenges, being dismissed in such a manner was disappointing and unprofessional. As paying customers, we expected a basic level of service, communication, and courtesy.
author: Derrick Lee

review_text: Really hard to find. Couldn’t access it easily. It is inside kidzmania lobby with the aeroplane. They have an outside kiosk but it wasn’t working … “because they were too busy inside”. They were preparing 5 orders. There is a food truck area across the street that has options including burgers. Go there instead it’s next to the beach.
author: James Kennedy

review_text: Uhm did I just find the best burger in singapore at kidzania??? Wow!
author: Martina P

review_text: wow we happened to pick this randomly for dinner. everyone enjoyed the food and the atmosphere , including my 2 year old toddler who had an absolute blast! we had a window seat overlooking the fancy swimming pool in village hotel. my son enjoyed his spaghetti and the brioche bun (heavenly!) the lamb was cooked to perfection. highly recommended!!!
author: slater citty

review_text:
A great location. Tables were well spaced from one another and restaurant has some fireworks view that starts around 753pm to 8pm and 853pm to 9pm. Food was delicious too, except that the food serving wait time is quite long. But if you are bored waiting, you can always head out to its neighbouring rooftop bar which was very breezy and with a really good and better view of fireworks and sunset. Staff service was also welcoming.

This restaurant also has partnership with Sentosa and Payment provider which offer good discount and complimentary drinks.
author: Sebastian Lee

review_text: My wife and I had the Valentine's Course Dinner. The service staff are fantastic, very prompt and amicable. In my most honest and humble opinion, most of the food was either bland or salty. The lobster Thermidor was too salty and the cheese was too creamy. The Tortellini was bitter and powdery. The steak was quite tough and hard to chew even for medium rare. The only dish that we enjoyed was the Parker loaf with strawberry rose butter. Hope to see improvements in the future!
author: SS Tan

review_text: Thanks for the great service from Mugi & Khairul to celebrate our boy’s birthday! We had a great time with the nice food and drinks. Also the beautiful sunset view and fireworks around 8pm. We will be back again! 🩷😁
author: Wendy Lee

review_text:
Dhan and his team did a wonderful job hosting us! Reserved a lovely spot to celebrate my husband’s birthday and we were greeted with a beautiful pool view despite the gloomy rainy day.

Food was absolutely wonderful as well, with La Bomba & Pistachio Tiramisu absolutely blowing us away.

Can’t wait to be back again for the delicious food & friendly service! 🥰
author: A

review_text:
Good place to buy some snacks for lunch.
You can find Old Chang Kee at different places. At the library, busstation Sentosa, Bugis Close to the Mrt and many more places. Prices are very good, food is freshly made, love this concept.
The eggrol and the currypastry are my favorites. When I’m in Singapore, I go to Old Chang Kee!
author: Irene Koning

review_text: Nice variety of classic local finger food - curry puff, squid, crab meat nuggets, and chicken wing are some personal favourites. Convenient location at Beach Station to grab a bite for some energy.
author: 葉

review_text: Throw my food when asked to put inside the paper bag? ??  ? ?
author: Cessca

review_text: Food was good but the lady staff was very rude. Zero Tolerance, No Patience. I'm a tourist to Singapore & she has no ethics in treating the customers in a proper manner.
author: Srinath Prashanth

review_text: While not usually being a great fan of deep fried things, the curry puff is probably the ‘pie’ that has shaped and defines Singaporean tastes.  Delicious curry with a slice of hard boiled egg - a delight for any snack!
author: Pete Klimek

review_text:
We had a wonderful dining experience at TungLok Heen, Sentosa. The food was beautifully presented and tasted excellent, with each dish prepared to a high standard.

Special thanks to Ryan Ngo , JJ Lim, Sam Loi, and Mok Jia Ying for their outstanding service. They were attentive, professional, and genuinely warm, making us feel very well taken care of throughout the meal. Their recommendations were spot-on, and they ensured everything was smooth and enjoyable.

Overall, it was a delightful experience with great food and exceptional service. Highly recommended, and we look forward to visiting again!
author: tiffanny 9292

review_text: I had a genuinely good experience here. The staff were warm, attentive, and handled everything smoothly from the moment I arrived. The place was clean, well-kept, and carried a comfortable atmosphere that made the visit easy and stress-free. Service was delivered promptly and food is deliciously made. Highly recommended the baked style white pepper crab, it’s a MUST TRY!
author: Elatse

review_text: Had a wonderful dinner tonight! The food was great and the service made the experience even better. Big thanks to Sim Xin Zhe and Linbo for taking such good care of our table , they were friendly, attentive, and professional throughout the meal. Really appreciate the great service. Will definitely be back!
author: shion nakiri

review_text:
Simply outstanding food and service ! Every visit to this restaurant has been always an utmost treat. The chefs are passionate and so talented. The food quality superb and the tasted impeccable. The service was warm and excellent with attention to detaiI. There was always a smile on Ryan’s face when he attended to us. His staff were brilliant and efficient.
We brought some guests from overseas and they were equally impressed with the food and service. This is definitely a must visit and the perfect place to celebrate as the food and service will not disappoint. We had the marble goby, lamb and longevity noodles with hairy crabs and the mango pomelo dessert which excellent. Made another reservation to go back.
author: Dolly Mirpuri

review_text: Even a gloomy, rainy day couldn't dampen the experience here, thanks to the incredible warmth from Jiaying and xinzhe right at the door. The entire team provides top-tier service, with a special shoutout to Linbo, Ryan and Sam for their attentive care throughout our dinner. The food is excellent and the presentation is truly a work of art. We will definitely be back!
author: PK Koh

review_text:
We were having a staycation at Sentosa.. and after looking for dinner options, we were surprised that most restaurants/eateries closed 9.30-10pm. Verve was the only one that opened till 11.30pm.

Easily accessible (a short walk from Oasia hotel), we arrived and found there was plenty of space for seating. (It’s actually situated in Amara resorts hotel so point to note: toilet and hand washing are in the hotel).

Menu was veering towards Indian cuisine, but it suited us just fine. Large selection of appetisers and main courses, as well as alcohol menu. The waiter was very helpful, he assured us that outdoor seating was ok and that there wouldn’t be any mosquitoes, and secondly brought my one pint beer out by half pints so I can drink it slowly.

The mutton dish and fish curry was superb, but what really stood out was the special broccoli dish; we loved it. Free flow of plain water. The food itself arrived fairly quickly, no complaints.

We also noticed a covered patio dining area that was showing sports.

Standard payments methods are available (Cc, visa, bank card etc.)

Very nice experience and well designed place.. looked posh and upmarket.
author: Gobi.M

review_text: Food Taste was good, nice location inside Sentosa, this is an Indian Restaurant, but the food tase was good as everyone can enjoy, you can go as group of Friends enjoy food and drinks, good place to have Company get together more options to choose, the service was good a bit expensive as the location is within Sentosa you can walk from Imbiah Station to reach here.
author: Veera Manoharan

review_text: Hidden gem at Sentosa. Delicious food, great  hospitality and comfortable environment. The bartender will recommend suitable cocktails/mocktails based on your preference. Highly recommended for authentic and high quality Indian food!
author: Edwin Khong

review_text: The food at Verve Bar + Grill was exceptional. They have both indoor and outdoor seating, which makes it a great place to relax and enjoy a meal. The cocktails were delicious and thoughtfully crafted. My favourites were the Chicken Tikka — perfectly grilled and full of flavour — and the variety of biryanis we tried, especially the chicken, mutton, and prawn. Each one was rich, aromatic, and cooked just right. A great spot if you’re craving Indian food in Sentosa!
author: Anshu

review_text:
Hello! I'm from Punggol, and I recently had a delightful lunch gathering with my friends at Verve Bar & Grill. It was my first time visiting, and I must say, it was a wonderful experience.

The lunch served as a fantastic networking opportunity. We even got to meet the restaurant owner, who was incredibly welcoming. The staff at the bar were exceptionally professional and provided us with excellent service. Overall, I was truly impressed and thoroughly enjoyed the ambiance, which felt friendly, refreshing, and energetic thanks to the company of my friends.

We ordered a variety of dishes, including both appetizers and main courses, as well as drinks. The food was simply delicious, and I especially loved trying out some new drinks.

Here's what we indulged in:

Bar Bites
- Kala Chana Masala
- Masala Papad
- Paneer Tikka
- Soya Chaap
- Chicken Seekh Kebab
- Chicken Tikka
- Mutton Boti Kebab
- Mutton Seekh Kebab
- Tandoori Chicken (Full)

Chaat
- Pani Puri
- Aloo Tikki Chaat

Main Course
- Champaran Chicken
- Champaran Mutton
- Champaran Kathal
- Champaran Paneer
- Butter Chicken
- Garlic Naan
- Biryani (Chicken, Mutton, Paneer, Prawn)

Cocktails That Stole the Show
- Beer: Plisner Bourbon Smash
- Brandy: The Brandy Alexandra
- Gin: Verve GNT, Gardener's Martini
- Rum: Lychee Key Lime Mojito, Watermelon & Celery Mojito
- Vodka: Intro-quential
- Tequila: Mexican Sour
- Whisky: The Firewall Sour, Baked Maple Old Fashion
- Wine: Italian Connection, Green Apple Sangria
- Indian-Inspired: Tamarind Margarita, Rose Petal Elixir, Chili & Gur Sour, Saffron Sour

I want to give a big shoutout to the fantastic team at Verve Bar & Grill. Their teamwork and professionalism truly made our visit memorable. I highly recommend this place—come and experience it for yourself, and you'll thank me later!
author: Sujata Ghosh

review_text: $9.80 for each noodle. The cashier is always away, slow.
author: Ember Shen

review_text: Awful food. The service terrible and the people working there impolite. They are boring and they cannot explains you what they are selling and what options you have. Their main target is to do what they have to do same a robot. I will not recommend this place. The chickens ham inside the tacos was extremely bad. Quality as low as possible.
author: kimbitzer

review_text: Quick and easy. Great food for the price
author: Daniel McNiven

review_text: Mexican food cart for takeout and drinking. You can order your tacos in three different styles and flavors.
author: diamod jam2

review_text: On Friday 10 October 2025, I had assam pedas pasta with roasted potato for my dinner at Good Old Days food court at Siloso Beach in Sentosa, and I liked this meal as the assam pedas pasta with roasted potato tasted very delicious. Overall, the service provided to me was very good and I would love to try these other Western dishes from this outlet (except for pork and beef) in the future.
author: Aravindhan Ravikumar

review_text: Ordered their plain parathas that came with curry and curd. The parathas were quite good, though made with refined flour. The curry, however, was mostly watery and lacked flavor, so we ended up eating them mainly with the small portion of curd provided.
author: Varun Goel

review_text: 2 tiny samosas for $5.80. What a rip off!! Look at the photo attached. Don't do this to people. The picture on the display and what I received were misleading & inaccurate. I could not enjoy my meal thinking of how many people have fallen victim to this BS. To the owner, everyone is aware of how high rental is, a bigger samosa would not cost you more than 25 - 50 cents in food cost. Do better. My bill was almost $20 & for the tiny portion of samosas received, I'm disappointed. Will remove my review if owner upsizes his portion.
author: J S

review_text: Average food
author: Vijay Venkatesan

restaurant_name: Yue Lounge — Sentosa’s Nature-Inspired Bar & Live Entertainment
review_text:
Booked out the entire venue for a post-wedding party and it was the best decision ever! All my guests had such an amazing time and couldn't stop complimenting the entire experience - drink selection was great, food was solid and overall atmosphere a 10/10!

KK was my contact throughout the planning and gave helpful recommendations, mingled with the guests and entertained them too. Will definitely come back just to relive the experience. Thank you KK and team for such a memorable afterparty!
author: J S

restaurant_name: Yue Lounge — Sentosa’s Nature-Inspired Bar & Live Entertainment
review_text: “I absolutely loved the place—the vibe, the atmosphere, and the staff. Breakfast was made even better by Jennifer, who was so lively, friendly, and cheerful.”
author: Janet Chew

restaurant_name: Yue Lounge — Sentosa’s Nature-Inspired Bar & Live Entertainment
review_text: Had a bar party here, great ambience, alcohol and skewers
author: Ethan Ng

restaurant_name: Yue Lounge — Sentosa’s Nature-Inspired Bar & Live Entertainment
review_text: celebrated wedding afterparty here. great ambience and food. created memorable memories here :))
author: Jolyn Seow

restaurant_name: Yue Lounge — Sentosa’s Nature-Inspired Bar & Live Entertainment
review_text: The person in charge here is very nice & friendly. Strongly recommend to all to come enjoy at here. Cheap beer & nice people. $38 for 5 full pints
author: Kow Kelvis

restaurant_name: MinSuiZen Raku Sentosa 明水然・楽 (Free Parking)
review_text: It was a last minute decision and as Cecil St was fully booked, they informed us of this at Sentosa. It was the best choice made!!! The entire experience was so warm and comfortable despite that the setting was so exquisite and elegant. The location is beautiful and serene it almost like walking into a garden in a Japanese sanctuary . We were warmly greeted by manager Eric right from the phone call to ask about parking, he welcomed us into this interestingly different setup for a teppanyaki restaurant. Although the cooking station was farther than usual, chef A-Wei introduced each dish to us while executing his skilful handling cooking and plating the dishes, which was so artful- truly a feast for the eyes.  I learned that the serving plates and dishes were specially selected and handpicked. We were celebrating a special occasion and was indeed treated to such a delicious and beautiful meal by a very professional and attentive crew. Five star restaurant that felt so warm and hospitable- which I later realized it is Taiwanese - that explains the high standards in food, presentation and warm service. Will come again. Kudos to head chef Alex, chef A-Wei and manager Eric - 棒！
author: Sally Yong

restaurant_name: MinSuiZen Raku Sentosa 明水然・楽 (Free Parking)
review_text:
It was an exceptional experience from start to finish. The food was absolutely incredible fresh, thoughtfully crafted, beautifully presented, and bursting with flavor in every course. The lobster and beef were my fav bc they were so juicy and tender!!!

The service was warm, attentive, and seamless without feeling intrusive. Every detail was handled with professionalism and genuine hospitality.

The chef also prepared mini performances for us!! An unforgettable dining experience and absolutely worth it.
author: NG SU HUI _

restaurant_name: MinSuiZen Raku Sentosa 明水然・楽 (Free Parking)
review_text:
⭐️
Superb omakase experience here at MinSuiZen Raku Sentosa. Food is great and the experience was wonderful. Tried the lite course and the elegant course. They even have a b’day surprise for those celebrating their b’day here!
author: rn_1604

restaurant_name: MinSuiZen Raku Sentosa 明水然・楽 (Free Parking)
review_text:
The outdoor area has a relaxed, Bali-style vibe.

The main dining space can seat around 10 people, and there is a private room that fits about 6. The food is on the light side, not oily and with minimal sauce, aiming to highlight the original flavours. The most surprising highlight was the freshly made crispy cheese on the chicken burger, which was very nice. The prawn heads were fried until the shells were so crispy you could eat them, as the chef suggested. However, the other seafood dishes like the fish and scallops did not really stand out.

The mango shake was refreshing and felt like a nice way to close the seafood chapter of the meal and move into the next. The pork chop was unfortunately too tough and hard to chew. The crab meat fried rice was also disappointing, as the crab meat look more like supermarket crab sticks.
author: CT Liaw

restaurant_name: MinSuiZen Raku Sentosa 明水然・楽 (Free Parking)
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Hidden in Sentosa, this Taiwanese-style teppanyaki omakase was such a pleasant surprise.

The space feels intimate and thoughtfully designed, with a calm, elegant atmosphere that makes the whole experience very enjoyable. Watching the chef prepare each course right in front of you adds a special touch, and every dish was carefully crafted and full of flavor.

It’s a great place if you’re looking for something a little more private and refined, perfect for a special night or a relaxed, quality meal. Definitely a memorable dining experience.
author: June

review_text:
This Shake Shack was very busy on the evening that we visited so it took a while to queue up and order the meal. Also there were no tables available which made it difficult with small children, so we had to change our order to takeaway and the staff were accommodating.

The ShackBurger 🍔(both double and single varieties) was quite tasty and fresh, the fries 🍟 were nice when hot but quickly lost their flavour, and of course the strawberry milkshake was tasty too. It was nice to enjoy Shake Shack in Sentosa but there definitely needs to be more tables and chairs for diners.
author: Greg S

review_text:
Shake Shack is a popular stop on Sentosa, especially in the evenings when the area comes alive. The location is great—surrounded by greenery and close to major attractions—making it an easy choice for a casual meal after walking around the island.
Most people enjoy the consistency of the burgers here: juicy patties, soft buns, and reliable flavours that match the brand’s reputation. The shakes and frozen custard are clear favourites, especially in the warm Sentosa weather. Seating can get crowded during peak hours, but the atmosphere remains lively and relaxed.
Prices are slightly higher compared to the mainland outlets, which many visitors expect due to the Sentosa location. Service is generally efficient despite the crowd. Overall, it’s not about innovation, but about dependable comfort food in a pleasant outdoor setting—a solid option when you want something familiar and satisfying while exploring Sentosa.
author: Dinesh Babu Pugalenthi

review_text: Consistent quality as rest of the shake shack branches in SG. Price is above $10 per pax. We got two burgers and they were really crispy and good. Overall good experience.
author: Yingying

review_text: Had always wanted to try and finally got the chance while in Sentosa.  The outlet was crowded and noisy and we managed to get the last few seat available.  Ordered the basic set of chicken burger that comes with drink and fries at the self ordering kiosk.  After about 10 mins wait, we got our orders.  The bun is soft and fried with butter so it tastes great.  However, the sourness of the capsium does not go well with the burger, plus it has that spice which was unexpected of pickled capsium.  As for the fries, it was cripsy but due to the way of the wavy cut, you can't really taste much of the potato except for the crisp skin.  After about 5 mins, the crispiness was gone and it was just hard.  Overall,  me & partner both personally didn't enjoy the taste and not worth for the whole experience with the high value paid.
author: Susan Tay

review_text:
A pity that McDonald’s is no longer here at Beach Station but happy that Shake Shack is here to take its place. Food is definitely more pricey in Sentosa but nothing beats a good burger after a long day at the beach.

Expect to spend $10-15 for a burger. Seats are limited due to the large number of families here, but turnover is fast and it wouldn’t be difficult to find a seat.

The new Caesar Chicken burger is quite unique and worth a try esp for non-beef eaters, if not go for the classic ShackStack.

Sentosa Islanders can use their birthday vouchers here.
author: Loki

review_text:
Sentosa GrillFest is perfect for foodies and beach lovers alike. Whether you’re on a date, out with friends, or enjoying a family night out, it’s an experience full of flavour and fun. Just come hungry—and maybe bring a picnic mat too!

⭐ Rating: 5/5
author: Ng Jonyat

review_text:
⭐️
Grill Fest 2025 is full of smokey BBQs! Nice place to chill and vibe. There are quite a number of offers on the Sentosa app as well.

Plenty of stalls here in Sentosa Grill Fest 2023. Make sure you visit the roadside stalls as well, other than the beach ones. The meatsmith cheese burger is good, just a little too small for the prize. Jett barbecue ribs is also good, but again 2 pieces of meat for $21 is too much.
author: rn_1604

review_text: Had a great time. First time to grill fest. Considering the recent inflation I feel the price thou high, was understandable. Foods quality was good. Vibes was amazing. I still got 2 months to try out other stuff. Highly recommended.
author: Simon Teo

review_text: Went there last Saturday and it was marvelous, lotsa crows, lotsa food to choose from. You can grab your favourite grill dishes and a can of beer and just enjoy the scenery and vibes there, table outside with huge fans blowing at you to cool yourself while eating there.
author: Mike Shary Production

review_text:
As expected, #GrillFest is #OverHyped; long queues, food is over priced, taste and quality is average at best. If you are here mainly for the atmosphere, then it's not bad. The #Steak is hard like rock!! 👎🏻
.
#StanzFoodHunts #Sentosa @sentosa_island #Grill #Beach
author: Stanley Tan

review_text:
Food was so good I genuinely can’t decide on a favourite dish! The beef cubes were perfectly done, tender and flavourful. The fish and lobster were incredibly fresh, and I especially loved the pumpkin pao fan with crispy rice — such a comforting yet elevated dish.

The private dining rooms are also a great touch, making the place very suitable for family gatherings or business meetings. Overall, a wonderful dining experience I’d happily return for.
author: claudie tan

review_text: It felt like we were in China the moment we stepped into the restaurant. The food was delicious, especially the fish and the beef. The staff were very polite and friendly. My partner and I enjoyed the whole dining experience. Definitely a place worth visiting!
author: Chia Yee Chew

review_text: Love the food here. Seafood is super fresh and the taste is flavourful.we will recommend this place for friend and will comeback again for other type of dishes.
author: Y

review_text:
Food here at Yue Private Dining is really wonderful, and the service from the entire team was exceptional. We had the chance to try a few dishes during our visit, and the 黄花鱼 truly stood out absolutely delicious and very well prepared.
There is also sheltered private parking at the back, which makes it very convenient to access. The place is comfortable and welcoming, and it’s also very suitable for families with children. Thank you to the team for the warm hospitality we really enjoyed the experience and look forward to visiting again
author: Nicholas Leow Jiexiang

review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Yue Private Dining, and I must say, it was an exceptional experience! The environment is perfect for both business meetings and hanging out with friends. The private dining rooms provide an intimate setting with a great atmosphere, and the addition of KTV is a fun touch if you’re in the mood for some karaoke after your meal.

The food is absolutely fantastic. We had a selection of lobster, crab, and fish – all beautifully prepared and incredibly flavorful. It’s definitely on the fancy side, but well worth the price for the quality. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking to impress clients or just enjoy a great meal with friends. Will definitely be back!
author: Arian Huang

review_text:
Possible the most revolting meal I have eaten in a very long time, in many countries, in many years! I would got more nutrition and fun eating the Singapore Dollars in my hand than the filth that came out of this booth!

I mean honestly, it is just a tourist rip off that only gets business because of the location and very few alternatives offering fast food.

Do yourselves a favour, avoid!
author: The Walking Critic

review_text: 2 wraps ordered. 1 with grilled chicken, other tandoori chicken. It is like a street food shop, 0 service. Food is out cold on the wraps and then they try to heat it but everything remains cold. 2 wraps and a water for SGD 21, better spend your money elsewhere. Definitely not worth it. Unfortunately there are hardly any good food options when walking along the beach. Best thing to do is to prepare a planning and build in a food stop at a place with a good rating. Not recommended.
author: B Buik

review_text: Just ordered from here and came right to Google to write a bad review because I don't want anybody to get ripped off. Ordered a tortilla wrap for 8.5 and it's tiny. I'm an average sized man and it took me 4 bites to finish. If I was served a decent sized burrito I wouldn't complain. It's Singapore...it's expensive...but when you dish out 8.5 for 4 bites of food you deserve to be called out on the internet. Trash food truck.
author: Robert Chacon

review_text: Ordered 2 soft tacos and food is served cold (fridge cold) and poor quality. Pls eat something else.

review_text:

author: Harsh goel Mahesh Chand And Sons

review_text:
We had lunch here while waiting for our room to be ready at nearby resort; Amara Sanctuary.

What a fabulous choice we made, beautiful elegant French Cafe/Restaurant with simple but wide selection of quality yummy meals.

It’s is licensed and I enjoyed a true top quality French cider with my salad.

The venue offers excellent service with friendly, professional Staff who make you warmly welcomed. The food is superb.

Please do yourself a favour and enjoy a meal & drink here when visiting Sentosa Island or Singapore.
author: Greg J

review_text: This little Paris cafe is such an amazing place ❤️ We have our family birthday celebration there and the service is excellent. Yen the manager help to coordinate and gave us a private space at the corner of the cafe as we have like 17 pax. Her recommendations of the cafes best menu items coupled with the value for money Hi Tea set for 2 is so good 😊 . She has such a great personality and always thinking for her customers. She even advised me on using the Sentosa app and not to lose out using some promotions and rewards. Highly recommended cafe especially if you are considering for your family or even corporate outings for getaway. Thank You Yen and your colleagues for the great service yesterday 🙏
author: Boon Yar Toh

review_text: The environment, food, and staff were all quite pleasant. We ordered the palette and crepe. We had made a reservation, and it might be advisable to do so if you are planning to dine with a large group.
author: Eiji Ogata

review_text: Excellent French breakfast and brunch offered here! The staff are extremely friendly and warm. The ambiance here feels like you're visiting Paris. It's a must try if you've never been here.
author: Ryan Auber

review_text: Awesome service, friendly staff, great deco and nice food. Had their sandwich with avocado mash between and it was so good. I also love the bread and pastry that we had.
author: Yvonne Tan

restaurant_name: Native Kitchen - Asian Cuisine/Local Favourites @ Sentosa
review_text: Had a wonderful dinner at Native Kitchen. Food was delicious, love the local flavors. Great service from Rommel and Patrick. They were very attentive and helpful.
author: Rowell Santiago

restaurant_name: Native Kitchen - Asian Cuisine/Local Favourites @ Sentosa
review_text:
I had an amazing experience at Native Kitchen in Village Hotel Sentosa, and I just have to commend the incredible team who made my night truly special.

A huge thank you to Manager Rommel, who was exceptionally attentive, warm, and professional. He made sure everything was perfect from the moment I arrived until I left. His hospitality alone is enough reason to come back.

I also want to highlight the wonderful service from Anson, Soon, Javier, and Rajj. Each of them went above and beyond…friendly, accommodating, and genuinely caring. Their teamwork brought such a comfortable and welcoming vibe to the whole dining experience.

The ambiance of the restaurant is cozy yet elegant, relaxed enough for casual dining but polished enough for special occasions.

Overall, Native Kitchen exceeded my expectations. With delicious food and a standout team led by Rommel, it’s definitely a place worth returning to. Highly recommended!
author: kitiara 2

restaurant_name: Native Kitchen - Asian Cuisine/Local Favourites @ Sentosa
review_text:
We spent a quiet Thursday night at Native Kitchen during our staycation. The restaurant was cozy and almost empty, which made it perfect for a relaxed family dinner. As hotel guests we got a 10 % discount, and the staff were quick to point out the kids’ menu and even handed us a set of colouring pencils and paper to keep our daughter entertained while we waited.

My wife and I shared a margherita pizza with a wonderfully thin, crisp crust—so good I ate the whole thing, something I rarely do. The deep‑fried crispy chicken wings were tasty, especially with the spicy chili sauce, and the kid’s chicken creamy pasta was a hit; the sauce was thick and flavorful. The service was friendly and proactive—staff even offered to take family photos.

Overall it was a pleasant, family‑friendly dining experience, and we’ll definitely be back.
author: James Teo Ching Wei

restaurant_name: Native Kitchen - Asian Cuisine/Local Favourites @ Sentosa
review_text: We had a very good breakfast for three consecutive days. A good day always starts with a warm greeting from Sherry. She is the host of the restaurant—very gentle, always smiling, and welcoming. Thank you, Sherry, for your wonderful hospitality and for making our trip truly memorable.
author: Kylie C

restaurant_name: Native Kitchen - Asian Cuisine/Local Favourites @ Sentosa
review_text: You can enjoy a wide variety of Singaporean dishes at this restaurant, which is great if you're looking to try different flavors. The taste of the food was fairly average—not bad, but nothing particularly memorable either. What stood out more was the friendly and polite staff, who made the experience pleasant. The restaurant itself is clean and well-maintained, creating a comfortable atmosphere for dining. I also appreciated that the waiting time wasn’t long, even during a moderately busy period. Overall, it was a decent experience. While there’s still some room for improvement, especially in terms of flavor, I’d say it’s a solid option for a casual meal.
author: 菊地正志

review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We had an absolutely amazing experience at Quentin Restaurant in Sentosa. From the moment we arrived, everything felt warm, welcoming, and beautifully curated.
The ambience is lovely — a true hidden gem in Sentosa. While some may feel that heading into Sentosa is a little out of the way, I can confidently say it is completely worthwhile. The walk from the carpark or the drop off wasn’t far at all, and the charming house setting adds so much character to the entire dining experience.
The service was fantastic — calm, patient, and incredibly accommodating. What truly stood out was how the team took the time to personally engage with each guest, making everyone feel right at home.
The food was delicious and thoughtfully prepared, with a comforting, home-cooked feel that made the meal even more special. Every dish felt crafted with care.
We celebrated Valentine’s Day here, and it was nothing short of remarkable. It was a beautiful evening, and we genuinely couldn’t have asked for more.
Highly recommended — definitely a must-try. 🌟
author: devan srigaran

review_text:
A beautiful & quaint restaurant out in Sentosa.
Service was top notch and they ensured our waters are always refilled & assisted in clearing the dishes timely.

Devil Wings were beautifully smothered with a thick spicy sauce, making them fabulous tasting.
Mulligatawny Soup was well presented. It may look watery but it was an explosion of flavour.

The surprise was the Fried Okra. It may look basic but the fresh okra was delicious, especially when paired with rice.

For mains, the Pineapple Prawn Curry was tangy & sweet, making it palatable to kids.

For their Signature Curry Debal (Devil’s Curry), you can opt for chicken or oxtail. The chicken was tender and was served with cabbage, chicken cocktail sausages & bacon.

The Porku Tambrinyu was wonderfully tender and the sauce it was served in paired well with the rice.

Will recommend this restaurant (albeit out of the way) for anyone looking for wonderful Eurasian cuisine.
author: Jing Jie Ng

review_text: I had my birthday meal here last night and it was amazing. Every dish we ordered was delicious and the staff were very friendly and accommodating and gave a free birthday dessert. The decor was beautiful as well. Really enjoyed and so happy I chose this place! Will try the other location next time.
author: Lauren

review_text: Great service and atmosphere. The food is great with layers and layers of flavour and different tastes. We loved the desert “Putugal” especially, out of this world taste of the kueh with melt in your mouth texture and light on the stomach. Even though we were full from the mains, the dessert is a must have.
author: The Curious

review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Quentin's Bar and Restaurant offers a truly outstanding experience! The food is remarkably delicious, with each dish expertly prepared using high-quality ingredients. The service is also exceptional; the staff are attentive, friendly, and genuinely dedicated to ensuring a wonderful visit. Furthermore, the atmosphere is peaceful and quiet, allowing for a relaxing and enjoyable meal. For anyone seeking top-tier food, excellent service, and a tranquil environment, Quentin's is a fantastic choice. Highly recommended!
author: Yeo Jimmy

review_text: Pleasant experience at this restaurant. Attentive and friendly staff. Nice ambience. Food was delicious and came in big portion. When they knew it was my birthday, they prepared a card and served a slice of birthday cake after the meal. Very thoughtful! Will recommend if you like a quiet yet hearty Indian cuisine.
author: Trish Tan

review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Royal Taj, Sentosa, and it was truly a wonderful experience. From the moment we walked in, the ambiance felt warm, elegant, and authentically Indian. The décor perfectly complements the rich flavors of the cuisine.

A special mention goes to our server, Daman, who provided outstanding service. He was attentive, polite, and very knowledgeable about the menu. He took the time to explain the dishes and made excellent recommendations, which made our dining experience even more enjoyable.
author: Noor Mandeep

review_text:
I am not certain if I should retain the rating to 3 or drop it further, here is why:

Dined last evening, here is what went horribly wrong:

1. Chaats lacked the tang, it felt like eating sweet yogurt all along
2. Paneer Tikka in the veg platter was brittle, shouldn’t be the case if it isn’t frozen paneer- work on the quality please.
3. Kofta was immensely sweet again, felt like a gulab jamoon tossed in a curry- what happened to the kofta’s innate flavours?
4. Lacha Parantha is flawed- too small and was served burnt, weren’t we paying for it?

Will reserve comments on the curries, just didn’t hit the right spots when it comes to flavours.

Worst part of the dining experience: Soya Chap. The dish ought to be made with soya and not plain flour. First 2-3 chaps tasted ok and soft, 10 mins later, it was very evident that these were not soya but plain flour instead. Asked the server twice to check with the chef, they insisted it is soya. Thread of plain flour were visible, not soya. As a diabetic, this was a pretty upsetting experience.
author: Shekharr Bhagat

review_text:
Royal Taj, Sentosa – Valentine’s Lunch

Very nice and romantic ambience. Calm, classy and perfect for couples.
Food was tasty and authentic – especially the butter chicken, dal makhani and fresh naan. Portions were good.
Service was polite and quick. Staff was friendly.
Price is a bit high but worth it for the experience.

Overall: Good place for a peaceful Valentine’s lunch ❤️
author: Isha Raparia

review_text:
Having our company deepavali celebration here and everything goes well and I don't find any faulty to be honest. However the capacity of the restaurant can be expand further if possible.
Will recommend to my friend for royal taj 😀

Cafe serving hot local meals at reasonable price for staff and public. If u want avoid paying tourist price at Sentosa, come here 😊

review_text: Very scenic location to do wedding solemnisation

review_text: Spacious hall for any celebrations supporting 250 to 300 guests in sentosa.
author: Rajesh Bhat

review_text: Had a wonderful experience at Miska Café – Sentosa Cove! The food was absolutely delicious, and the pizza was especially outstanding — perfectly baked, flavorful, and clearly made with quality ingredients. The taste, presentation, and overall dining experience were all impressive. Definitely a place worth visiting if you’re craving great food and amazing pizza. Highly recommended!
author: Clarie Saplagio

review_text:
I want to give this a 5-star review because I love Mediterranean food and the dishes were unique and varied. The portions were also quite generous.

However, we were sorely disappointed at the quality of the food. My wife’s Mediterranean salad was just so-so, and the falafels clearly were full of flour or some filler instead of the expected crunchy texture. My Mediterranean breakfast was supposed to have “potato wedges” and “chicken sausage” but instead got French fries and a wrinkly hot dog (frankfurter). The ketchup included with the French fries was inedible as it was spoiled (see picture of bubbly ketchup).

It was a let down as this was our last night at Sentosa and really wanted to enjoy some quality Mediterranean food. The staff were friendly and the atmosphere was nice, but unfortunately we won’t be back.
author: Joel Hoobyar

review_text: Had wonderful dinner at Miska. Love having dinner with a beautiful view. Place is windy. Food is delicious. Staff is very friendly & nice too. Very good servicing. My family love their food too. My kids live their Truffle fries & seafood pasta while i love their meat platter. My family & I enjoyed out dinner at Miska
author: Angeline Soh

review_text:
Dining at Miska: A Mediterranean Escape in Sentosa

Nestled in the vibrant heart of Sentosa, Miska offers a refreshing taste of the Mediterranean with its sun-kissed flavors, warm hospitality, and breezy island ambiance. From the moment you step in, it is a perfect retreat from Singapore’s urban bustle.

The open-air seating lets you enjoy Sentosa’s tropical breeze.

The menu is a well-curated homage to Mediterranean cuisine, featuring bold flavors, fresh ingredients, and generous sharing plates.

The staff were attentive and knowledgeable, offering great recommendations without being intrusive. The pacing of the meal was just right, leisurely enough to enjoy but never lagging.

Miska is a gem in Sentosa’s dining scene, offering a true Mediterranean escape with its inviting atmosphere, flavourful dishes, and impeccable service. Whether you're looking for a romantic dinner, a family gathering, or a relaxed weekend brunch, this spot delivers.
author: Alvin L.

review_text: The flavors were masterfully balanced, offering a truly delightful and satisfying dining experience. The portion size was generous, making it perfect for sharing without compromising on quality or satisfaction. Service was impeccable—our meal arrived promptly, and the staff was exceptionally warm, attentive
author: Serena lyh

review_text: First time here and already craving to go back. Food was on point. Love eateries with staff who proactively informs you of portion sizes.  Missing from the pix is the dessert of Double Boiled Yam Paste in Young Coconut which was also delicious. We visited on Sunday evening and was not crowded.  Maybe that explains the aircon chill.
author: J C

review_text:
Wok 15 Kitchen is situated within Sentosa Cove. A truely cantonese style restaurant serving wonderful dim sum. Tried the buffet dim sum and was blown away by the quality of food. Outstanding dishes include the egg tarts, congee, pan fried carrot cake and deep fried beancurd skin with prawn.

Buffet included main dishes like salted egg York prawn, sautéed beef, fried rice and stir fried hor fan. Really value for money!!
author: Cute Daffy

review_text: the service is good. and the food is amazing. especially the fish is really fresh. highly recommended
author: George Lee

review_text:
We recently had our family reunion dinner here, and I have to say, it was one of the most pleasant dining experiences we’ve had during a peak seasonal period.

​Usually, festive dinners feel like a "conveyor belt" service where you’re rushed to finish, but that wasn't the case at WOK°15. Despite the busy season, the staff was incredibly attentive and we never felt pressured to leave. The service was truly top-notch.

​As for the food—my mom is a fantastic cook and an incredibly fussy eater, and I am quite particular myself. For both of us to agree that the food was excellent is a massive compliment to the kitchen. The flavors were balanced and the quality was evident in every dish.

​We particularly appreciated the relaxed atmosphere by the marina. We will definitely be back, likely during the off-peak season, to enjoy the food and the view at a more leisurely pace. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality Cantonese cuisine without the typical "rush" of a busy restaurant.
author: Peter Goh

review_text: I had come across this restaurant years ago while browsing online for good Chinese cuisine, and finally had the chance to try it during our staycation at W Singapore – Sentosa Cove. It did not disappoint. The staff were exceptionally friendly and attentive, and the food was absolutely delicious. A comfortable dining experience overall.
author: Wayne Erh

review_text:
Love The Kitchen Table at W.  Love their breakfast spread, the spread size is lesser as compared to other big hotels but the quality is great. They have bubble tea too which makes it fun. Our fave is their oyster congee, yum. In addition to their buffet options, you can also order ala carte items.
Tried their bbq dinner buffet too and it was also satisfying. The service is impeccable, most especially Kristel. She checked on us from time to time if all's well. Will definitely come back.
author: Scher Manuel
