What a horrible service. I will never ever buy their product after what she have done to my family.
author: Kim

review_text: Just skip asking for recommendations at the counter and go for the signature items; the lady at the counter only suggests the expensive extras anyway. Thank me later!
author: DHIRAJ BODKHE

review_text: Absolutely delicious coconut drinks. Best drink I have had in Singapore. Perfect amount of sweetness, not too much.
author: Quambi House

review_text:
This may seems like an ordinary coconut shake stall, the taste of the coconut shake is awesome since it’s very fresh, the stall keepers told me that they use fresh coconut meat and no sugar, so I saw them adding coconut meat and ice to be blended together with a large blender for at least 1 minute, and the net result is a flavourful cooling icy cold melted coconut shake, oooh la la!

When you are feeling very thirsty and hot when you are around the Fort Siloso area, the Fort Siloso Station, hop right in to get your Co Nut ink Coconut shake and ice cream!

5 out of 5 guaranteed!
author: Soh Wee Kian

review_text:
Just opposite Shangri-La Rasa Sentosa.
Big dining area with very good and fresh food.

Dining area was huge, tableware was posh and cooking equipment will put 5 star hotels to shame.

Order via QR code and food is served promptly. Good place to spend the afternoon and evening. Weekends there are movie screening for the family.

Good pricing is reasonable and cheaper than other Venues in sentosa and Vivo city.

Ordered a Seabass and beef cheek pasta.
Serving size was huge for 1 pax , ingredients were fresh and dish was very tasty.

Will return to dine here often as with sentosa islander membership there is discount , 1 for 1 craft beer and spend $50 to get $10 voucher back.

Great place to hit your islander membership tier spending.

Overall for this visit , it was excellent food, very reasonable and affordable pricing
author: WH

review_text:
Such a modern and clean place to relax. The parking lot is conveniently located right in front of the restaurant, and free parking is provided with a minimum spend of $100 — which is definitely worth it, as you can easily grab takeaway and enjoy a picnic at the beach just a couple of minutes’ walk away.

We enjoyed drinks and fresh oysters, then took some food to go and headed to the nearby beach for a picnic. A perfect way to spend the day.

Inside the restaurant, the open layout allows for a nice breeze, and the ceiling fans make it very comfortable. The oysters were fresh, and the food prices are very reasonable.

Would definitely come back again.
author: Miri Miri

review_text:
Interesting place has potential for the evenings I suspect more than lunchtime when we went. Only lagers on offer for beers, not much to choose from for a lighter ale at all. The venue is good, it has space to show movies on the lawn at night and if full, might have some vibe. The calamari we ordered was terrible though, all stuck together... maybe the oil was not hot enough?? and no flavour at all, just stringy and chewy, very disappointing. And expensive! Around $30SGD for a pizza.... that would have to be the most expensive pizza I've seen anywhere!! Not worth the try.
Sadly not tempted to return for dinner at all. Can't say we'd recommend it
author: Denise Brown

review_text:
Hidden gem, truly an underrated place. Been here a couple of times and the food is always 10/10

Love the swimmer crab pizza from 4AM Pizzas especially. Wine selections are great, meats perfect (steak) and pasta was great!
author: Priscilla a

review_text: It is a lovely place to hang out with family and friends. They screen movies on Fridays (check their website for the movies) through Sun. While watching the movie you can also enjoy a beautiful skyline! Food is very good here; they serve both local and western on their menu. And they do both cuisine very well which is rare. They also have interesting craft beer, I am not a beer drinker but I will always try  their beer whenever I am here. My kids enjoy having their dinner while watching a movie it is a treat for them! The open space also allow kids to run about while the adults enjoy their food. Plenty of parking. If the spending is above $100, you will get complimentary parking. This place is good for events. They have huge both indoor and outdoor space and a glass house. I saw a few corporate events held here.  Sentosa Island members get 10% off the bill!
author: Eliza Tan

review_text: Affordable prices and delicious food  ，I come here often
author: Morain LV

review_text:
Not too bad.... Cant really say they deserve a 5 stars, but for a mixed vege rice, the only one Ard this area, I think it's good value (esp if U have the 10% for working there).
The food was above average for sure, but nothing fantastic. But as a daily meal, this is worth a thought.
Only issue, their selection of food is pretty limited.
So it's probably a 7.5 out of 10, and still I have come back here over and over again.
(No pics now, but will post the next time)
author: Jialong Liu

review_text: All 3 of my dishes were cold. Fish cold, tofu cold, steam egg cold, terrible. Will never eat from them again.
author: Ken C

review_text: High price, less portion
author: Tommy Chan

review_text:
Walking into here feels like stepping into a familiar family gathering — warm, lively, and filled with the aromas of true Chinese comfort cooking. With over 20 years of culinary heritage, the team serves up dishes that feel nostalgic, yet crafted with the finesse of award-winning Chef Pung Lu Tin. It’s the kind of place where the food doesn’t just taste good — it feels like home, but elevated.

What we tried and loved:
🔥 Salted Egg Chow-Tah Fried Bee Hoon — the moment it hits the table, you smell that smoky wok hei. Every bite has crispy edges, savoury salted egg, and that addictive char you can’t fake.
🦑 Stir-Fry Squid — tender with that perfect bounce, like the kind you only get from super fresh seafood.
🍗 Baked Salted Kampung Chicken — juicy, flavourful, and comforting in that rustic, old-school way.
🌶️ Hot Sour Mustard Green Roasted Pork — tangy, spicy, and the kind of dish that wakes up your palate instantly.
🍳 Scrambled Egg with Bitter Gourd — soft, silky eggs with just the right hint of bitterness — like something your grandma would make but refined.
🍍 Popcorn Chicken Fruit Rojak — unexpectedly refreshing; sweet, crispy, savoury — a fun twist that actually works.

They blends tradition with modern flair, serving flavours that spark memories while creating new ones. Imo, is perfect for family dinners, gatherings, or anyone craving truly comforting Chinese food done
author: Zozo

review_text:
Good customer service and friendly ambience for dining.
The female staff is plesant in recommending food.
Recommend to taste the steam garoupa fish,half size steam chicken.
I have also pack fried rice with fish roe.
author: HIN HOE CHEW

review_text: Good food and service at pearl hill garden. Right outside got parking lots. Can bring family for the dim sum menu, great variety available. Some are so pretty served like lychee,  yellow pear shape and pink swans on dry ice and tree. The char siew bao, carrot cake, fried chee cheong fun, coconut steamed cake, har gao, siew mai all very good.
author: Cherrlyn Lim

review_text: Service is very slow even though we preorder. Two dishes came after an hour which we forgot about it! Service staff is rude, took away plastic gloves used for crab without asking. Don’t think will ever go again. Food presentation was great for some dishes though and restaurant is next to Labrador Park mrt.
author: Corrine Chua

review_text:
We love the food and atmosphere here so much. The service is very attentive and friendly. The chefs are really experts at Chinese cuisine and yet also very good at presenting the dishes in very interesting ways - any fine dining restaurant should be jealous!

There is ample free parking also, and also very near Labrador MRT.
author: Yvonne Yew

review_text:
Found a hidden gem! Had a really satisfying meal here and would highly recommend this place.

We ordered the beef pho (beef balls + sliced beef) and it was excellent. The soup was very tasty and flavorful, and the beef slices were generous, fresh, and tender.

The turmeric fish with dill noodles is an interesting and unique dish worth trying. The fish was delicious, boneless, well-seasoned, and cooked perfectly.

The dry grilled chicken noodles were also very good. The noodles were smooth and the chicken was flavorful.

The mixed spring roll platter came with both fried and non-fried Vietnamese spring rolls. The ingredients were fresh and generous, and the fried ones were crispy without being greasy. Highly recommended.

We also tried the crème caramel, which was very good — not too sweet, just right, with a lovely fragrance from the burnt caramel.

The lemongrass pandan drinks tasted homemade, fragrant, and not overly sweet.

Service was friendly and great, and the food was served fast. Overall, the food here is excellent value for money. Portions are big, ingredients are fresh, and the seasoning is top class. Everything was well-balanced — not too sweet and not too salty. Will definitely be back.
author: Angela S

review_text: They had a wide range of Vietnamese food, including bun cha, pho, spring rolls and banh mi. The bun cha was flavourful, and they were really generous with the amount of patties. The beef stew noodles soup was delicious, with tender beef and rlly tasty broth. We also enjoyed the banana flower salad with chicken, fried spring rolls, beef pho and caramelised pork belly banh mi. All the food were so authentic👍 would highly recommend anyone who’s craving  Vietnamese food to check this restaurant out!
author: Lily

review_text:
Came here based on ChatGPT’s recommendation — and it was a great call.
This Bun Cha features juicy pork patties instead of the usual grilled pork, and they were absolutely delicious.
Perfect with the dipping sauce, noodles, and fresh herbs — I couldn’t stop eating.
The staff were kind and welcoming, making it a lovely experience even dining solo.
Still, there were so many other dishes I wanted to try, so next time I’ll be back with family.
Highly recommended. Will return soon!
author: Yas Yas

review_text:
amazing vietnamese food here, not a lot of great ones in singapore tbh.

would reccomend their dry chicken noodle and caramel pork banh mi as my favourites!

staff are also nice and friendly, took their time to explain to us what each dish was when we asked as we were unsure
author: Daniel D'Souza

review_text: Really wonderful find coming across this small hidden Vietnamese restaurant. All of the various dishes we tried including the pho and bun cha were very authentic and well done. Prices were very reasonable and the staff were so friendly! Highly recommended.
author: Kelvin Tan

review_text:
Friendly team and love the selection! My favorite lunch place now!

Top favorite is breaded dory, followed by Cajun chicken :)

If there is loyalty program, I am all in!
author: ivan.

review_text:
Looks good. Good variety. Long queue during lunch. Dinner no crowd. Nice view. Peaceful.
Update: was slightly disappointed that some items were not available at around 5.45pm
Also disappointed that their mushrooms were not the wild ones or fresh button ones as I had to top up extra cost.
author: Annyeong C

review_text:
Dined in here as they have 1 for 1 deals until end of November. However, it wasn’t the case as they added on 3$ for the medium size. It’s only applicable to the small size salads.

Tho The beef and the chicken teriyaki were marinated well. I thought the portion was alright & thought it could be bigger!
author: Phoebe Ling

review_text: Came by near closing time, and it felt like some of the ingredients weren’t very fresh. The staff also weren’t particularly friendly. There are definitely better salad options in the area. Prices are reasonable though. They currently have a 10% opening promo plus a free drink with every salad bowl ordered.
author: Wong

review_text:
Edited as of Dec 2025: portion sizes, especially the protein, have shrunk significantly over my last few visits :(

Really impressed w their salads - huge portions, great selection of both cooked and raw sides, and LOVE the beef. Service was great as well, and hope to see them continue to thrive. Will definitely recommend to fellow office workers craving something clean yet packed w protein!
author: yx04

review_text:
We had a wonderful lunch at this Italian restaurant while celebrating my friend’s birthday. The waiter was incredibly attentive and provided excellent service with a genuine smile, which really made us feel welcome. The food was delicious and arrived quite quickly, something we truly appreciated since it was lunchtime and the restaurant was very crowded. A special highlight was the lovely chocolate cake they brought out for the birthday—it made the celebration feel extra special. Overall, a fantastic experience with great food and outstanding service.

Must try: burrata cheese, chicken / pork chops, panna cotta
author: Karen Cheah

review_text:
Celebrated our 1st anniversary here with the kids. Everyone loved it. The food, the atmosphere, the people, the service.
All just great & fantastic.
Special thanks to Ms Phoo who attended to our table. She’s fabulous! 👍👍👍👏👏👏
Thank you for the wonderful evening!
Love you guys! My family loved it! 🥰🥰🥰🥰
author: Preston Chow

review_text:
My wife and I were checking out some new eateries to celebrate a special occasion this week and we decided on 1-Alfaro's La Torre at the Labrador Tower.  We had two 3-course set lunches - a pan-seared Sea Bass and a wood-fired Chicken. To our pleasant surprise, the appetisers, consisting of Artigiana Burratina and Salmon Stracchino Cheese Bruschetta, and both the mains where simply delectable with rich flavours. We ended our meal with a Burrata Gelato and a Panna Cotta and it was absolutely sublime!

Apart from the lovely food, despite the busy lunch crowd, the service team was very attentive to our needs.  Special thanks to our server, Jamshid, for making our afternoon an enjoyable one. We would also like to complement the rest of crew including manager Alberto and Nicholas, who took care of us.

Thank you for the lovely food and great service. We look forward to coming back again.
author: KC SOH

review_text: We had a lovely dining experience. The night view is beautiful and food is delicious. The waitress is attentive that makes us feel so welcome. I will come back again for more 😃
author: Chai Ling Chan

review_text:
Found this restaurant thru social media and decided to come for my early wedding anniversary.
Firstly, it kinda difficult locating the entrance to the building. Have to travel along pasir panjang road and turn on the first left after you passed the building.
Would have given 4 stars for everything but the additional 1 star is earned by the very friendly server, Kei, who's very attentive and was quick on the service recovery when my lamb rack was undercooked twice.
Was offered a complimentary dish for that and Kei definitely deserved the extra star from me.
author: James Wong

review_text:
I'm a regular customer in their Alexandra Central branch, now they opened a new branch much closer to office and highly accessible (near Labrador Park MRT)

IMHO Prata Alley is one of the best (if not the best) prata place in SG.

You can also request they cook the prata with olive oil.
author: Irfan Rinaldi

review_text: Tried so many dishes. All are delicious! No crowd in the evening, so nicer ambience.
author: Ayn Edleen

review_text: I tried the bak chor mee, requested for no liver , they gave me extra bak chor!!! Silky glistening noodles super shiok + added vinegar!!  Noodle texture was very QQ, each strand coated with sauce, each mouthful had Bak chor and first time I see so much ingredients in a bowl!! My mom had the chicken cutlet noodle, it was juicy crunchy with Bak chor mee style noodles and sauce, love the texture!!! Soup was clear but very flavourful, I can taste all the pork bones in it. Prices start at $5.50, I think it’s one of the cheapest in this food junction. 9/10!! Will try the laksa next time.
author: Venessa Goh

review_text:
Dropped by the newly opened Food Junction at Labrador Tower to check out Mee First Bak Chor Mee after seeing a few intriguing posts about them.

Here’s what we tried:
- Signature Minced Pork Noodles – $7.50
- Signature Laksa – $6.50
- Chicken Cutlet Noodles – $7.50
- Fried Wantons – $2.50

Loved the atmosphere—clean and calm during off-peak hours, plus the tower offers a stunning view over Singapore’s southwestern coastline.

Though Mee First is a newer name, it’s already made its mark with outlets in Woodlands and Nex. The preparation process here looks impressively methodical, and the noodles themselves were nicely executed—springy, flavourful, and generously portioned.

Each bowl came loaded with ingredients, and if you’re hungry, you can even request extra noodles with ease.
author: George Kooi

review_text:
Came to this newly opened Food Junction and tried the noodles stall. Portion is quite big for this price at food court.
What we didn't quite like was the pork liver had an acidic aftertaste, otherwise everything else was really good!
Laksa gravy is thick and lemak, worth trying!
author: Berlinda Goh

review_text: Tasty BCM. I would say it's slightly above average. Price is a bit higher as it's an Air conditioned food court. I saw the mini wok was $8 as there are prawns inside, but it would be nice if they had an additional non-seafood version that was a bit cheaper.
author: Laura L

review_text:
I give a 5 star on the staff at Nex. Food is food at all Mee first .

Price reasonable
author: Xav

My 1st time trying Ayam Taliwang. Tried their “The Indomie Taliwang Set). Dried noodles with Chilli chicken & egg. Overall very delicious. However, I wish the noodles are around 30% less salty. My personal preference.

At $8.50 for food from a Michelin brand, it’s fine. Definitely will return to try their nasi lemak
author: Darren Tan

review_text: There’s no chicken in the Nasi Lemak Chicken Set. What they claimed it is a chicken fillet and totally different with what they show in the menu display. Not recommended!
author: Kong Weng Seng

review_text: Beef Rendang set - 8.90 looks like this. I think they forgot my egg and sides... 🥲 Service is also super slow
author: Yi Jia Cheah

review_text: On Wednesday 9 July 2025, I had nasi lemak ayam kecap sambal for my lunch at Food Junction food court in Labrador Tower, and I liked this meal as the nasi lemak ayam kecap sambal with rice tasted very delicious. Overall, the service provided to me was very good and I would love to try the other nasi lemak dishes from the other Nasi Lemak Ayam Taliwang outlets in the future.
author: Aravindhan Ravikumar

review_text: Make takeaway reservation for 44pax. Nice presentation and good food.
author: Raymond Gan

review_text:
The quantity of fish slices is lesser as compared to other outlets.

A little fishy, not so fresh.

Did not meet my expectations for this outlet.
author: Yong L

review_text:
Signature biscuit chicken cutlet was a bit dry tho the scrambled egg on the rice is fantastic. The sambal prawn is a waste of time, tiny prawns drowning in sambal sauce and oil.

The new food junction has decent food selection but weekday lunch queue is impossible. Arrived at 11.30am, queued for 20min just to order, and waited another 15min for food to be ready.

9 stalls in total. There are quite a lot of seats but operational flow is inefficient. You have to queue to use the self service order kiosks at every stall, but the system is much slower than if a human took your order. As a result every stall has long queues that block the walkways, and seats along the walkways feel claustrophobic from people towering over you. There are boards to show when your order is ready but not every stall uses it.

Weekend was expectedly super quiet and comfortable. I wouldn’t visit again on a weekday anytime soon until the curiosity dies down.
author: Susan

review_text: Service is extremely slow (30 mins wait at lunch hour) for a dish that isn’t really worth the wait
author: Oscar

review_text: Order their biscuit egg rice. Def cheaper than your hawker and your coffeeshop. Aircondiioned too
author: theapropos

review_text:
We had a really great time at the restaurant, and the amazing view definitely set the mood for the whole night. A huge thank you to Kei, who was incredibly friendly and professional throughout our meal. It is always a plus when the service is as good as the food, and Kei really made us feel welcome.
We started things off with a solid Negroni and a crisp glass of rosé, which went perfectly with the fried cauliflower. For the main course, the ribeye was cooked exactly how I like it, and the Rigatoni Mancini was honestly delicious. The pasta had a great texture and was easily a highlight of the night.
We ended the evening with the pistachio tiramisu, which was a nice twist on the classic and a great way to finish. Between the food, the drinks, and the view, it was a fantastic experience all around.
author: Alex Huang

review_text:
We arrived at 6.30pm and had a table by the window. The view is spectacular especially as we get to enjoy the beautiful sunset from our table. We had Phoo serving our table, and she was fantastic. While our main course took a while to came, Phoo ensure to communicate this to us so we can manage our expectation. This was also not a problem as it allowed us time to enjoy the view.

Food is good as expected. We had too much expectation on the wagyu fried potato, but when we tasted it, it just feels like any other potato.

Overall a nice restaurant for a special occasion or just to enjoy nice sunset. Very child friendly too, suitable for family occasions!
author: Tasya

review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
1 - Alfaro - elevated views with warm, family-aware service

Visited today for lunch and were immediately struck by the spectacular view from above, which sets a strong first impression. Entry was smooth and welcoming - lobby attendants were friendly and allowed us in promptly, creating an easy and relaxed arrival.

Inside, the ambience leaned warm and romantic, with a comfortable pace that encouraged lingering rather than rushing. Service was attentive and accommodating; staff assisted with ordering efficiently while allowing diners the space to enjoy the moment. There was no sense of being hurried, which added positively to the overall experience.

The pasta dish ordered was generous in portion, something we appreciated. While satisfying, the flavours and execution did not lean strongly towards traditional Italian - the cured meats, in particular, were sliced thicker than expected for our preference. That said, the dish was hearty and filling, and portion value was evident.

One refreshing observation was how welcoming the team was towards families. Several diners had young children (including infants and toddlers), and staff engaged warmly - even helping to entertain the little ones - which added a lively yet pleasant energy to the room.

One notable point for parents: the restrooms do not appear to have a diaper-changing facility. For families with babies who require lying-down changes, this may be something to consider when planning a visit.

Overall, a visually impressive setting with friendly, thoughtful service and a relaxed atmosphere. Best enjoyed for the view, the ambience, and the unhurried dining experience.

Visit was self-paid. All opinions are my own.
author: HonestBite.Review

review_text:
​Having had an amazing experience at Monti, our expectations for this sister venue were understandably high. Unfortunately, the overall experience didn't quite hit the mark. I have already shared my specific service feedback with Kei—who handled it very professionally—so this review focuses strictly on the food.

​While the food wasn't bad, it felt fairly average and lacked the "wow" factor we’ve expected from monti. Given the price point, I anticipated a higher level of culinary refinement. Ultimately, it feels like you are primarily paying for the rooftop views, which are admittedly fantastic as the sun sets in the evening.
author: suckms

review_text:
The view was fantastic with cosy ambience and delicious meal, we really had a great time here. This is my second visit, went for lunch and decided to be back for dinner.
Contrary to some of the review,  with  reservation and didn't have to wait fr table at all..The wait time fr food was very smooth and they served the bread almost immediately as soon as we placed our order.
Everyone was very happy with the meal, we ordered tortellini, bruschetta, fried ravioli, lasagna, tomahawk and barramundi, pistachio tiramisu and chocolate cake. All was great.
We all agreed this place is a hidden gem, personally i can't wait to be back. Hopefully they maintain the good standard next time too.
author: Chew Chew

restaurant_name: Get Some @ Labrador | Singapore's Best Craft Beers
review_text: Get Some at Labrador is an outstanding restaurant with great food and occasional music. I'm especially a fan of this local singer called Lincoln Chen (@heyolincoln), who sings at this restaurant from time to time. Also, their jalapeño poppers and onion wings are amazing. 10/10
author: SeungJun Kim

restaurant_name: Get Some @ Labrador | Singapore's Best Craft Beers
review_text: Free parking after work hours. But you shouldn’t drive and drink more here. Opening specials with craft beers and food. They even have the usual spirits for the office crowd. Live band from Wed to Sat
author: shauneeie p

restaurant_name: Get Some @ Labrador | Singapore's Best Craft Beers
review_text: Singapore's best craft beer chain has added this very chill relaxing open and bright venue where great service combines with quality brews. Whether out with friends or meeting for a business chat you can't go wrong at this central location nearby the MRT and many bus lines. Parking is also easy lah. Comfortable searing indoors and out, and all with a soundtrack of familiar good tunes.
author: Thomas Timlen

restaurant_name: Get Some @ Labrador | Singapore's Best Craft Beers
review_text:
Newly opened at the ground level of Labrador Tower, this spot shows promise despite a few teething issues — midway through our meal, we were informed they had to close due to some licensing permit hiccups. That said, service was friendly and inviting throughout.

Live music performances are in the works, and the place offers both indoor and outdoor seating with relaxed, chill vibes. The Lychee craft beer was refreshing, selling at $15 during happy hour. Chicken wings were nicely marinated and tasted fresh — definitely not your typical frozen variety. The roasted pork was decent; the mustard sauce paired well, though it could have been even better with a crispier skin.

In general worth a try if you are around the area. Free parking after 6:30 pm on weekdays and full day on weekends.
author: Viva La Vida

restaurant_name: Get Some @ Labrador | Singapore's Best Craft Beers
review_text: Loved the chill ambience, tasty local-fusion food, and the great live band vibes! The staff were super friendly and approachable too. Perfect place to celebrate special occasions.
author: Eugene Ng

review_text: We went on Sunday Night for dinner! It has classy French Vibes, cozy romantic Ambience and we love this not crowded restaurant. We have the best spot, indoor with open glass door to the outdoor space. Food is great! Service is so pleasant by Marinette and her lady friend. We will come back!:) we ordered  Bouillabaisse, Salad, Potato wedges and they kindly offered us dessert for our wedding anniversary💕🤍
author: Meyi Ongsono

review_text:
Nice peaceful location very zen.
Staff very friendly and knowledgeable.
Food is sad, very sad. Tiny butter and thin slide of old bread(airplane roll and butter so much better). Steak for 2 looked like canteen size. Ordered medium rare but came out well done. Steak was very thin so getting it done should’ve easy
author: Mark KUO

review_text:
Amazing lunch date experience, with top notch food, service, and atmosphere!

We arrived just as they were opening, and the waitress kindly explained that while the kitchen was not yet ready, she could serve us beverages first. Throughout the meal, she was attentive, friendly, and very professional, ensuring we were enjoying our food, topping up our water and napkins whenever it ran low.

Food wise, we had the set lunches which were great value for money. The avocado salad tasted unique and refreshing, while the soup was hearty with chunks of mushrooms. The ravioli was well balanced, and the wagyu burger was juicy. We also had Canadian oysters that were fresh and delicious! The coffee was average, but overall, still a five star meal.

The restaurant has full length windows with a marina view, and the waitress was considerate in keeping them closed during a hot day so that we can still enjoy the aircon.

Overall, would definitely come again thanks to the amazing experience.
author: Ivy Wong

review_text: my friend and I dined here and we loved the seafood with lobster sauce really authentic French cuisine. The best part was the excellent service from a Filipino staff who looks Chinese (forgot her name) and her fair skinned colleague. They made us feel very welcome and special.  Nice place, beautiful view, and very aesthetic!
author: Faye

review_text:
Went there for a class reunion of sorts with 5 other friends for dinner.
On arrival, can see that this is a place chock full of ambience. Staff gave us a table by the French doors, overlooking the marina, and the view was awesome.
We had the terrine, Bouillabaisse, an excellent pasta and duck. And some great bread. All the dishes were skillfully crafted and excellent complement to each other. The duck and the pasta stood out for me, and all in all, the staff planned an outstanding menu offering. And the wine pairings were spot on.
This rates as one of the top French eateries around and really is an occasion destination. Highly recommend it when you have a special occasion with a special person.
author: Jeffrey Wang

review_text: Excellent food n very attentive service! The grilled octopus leg was done just right. The chef must be commended for his superb Parma ham pizza. The crust was just heavenly!! We ordered a Venetian crab linguine and a Truffle porcini risotto and they were so good too! The service was perfect.
author: Beow Tuan See

review_text:
Goodness ….. this is probably some of the best kept secrets in Singapore.

I always hated tomatoes based sauce anything. But I have not eaten a better mussel dish with tomato sauce!

The squid ink linguine, it’s amazing…. Seriously I dare say better than most Michelin starred restaurants locally!

Kavan, (hope I got the name right) the chef for the evening… really deserve an award for this.
author: Jack Wong

review_text:
The food is delicious.  Especially the pizzas.

The staff were friendly and provided fast service.

Hardly any other customers here on a weekday evening.

Pretty views of yatch and condominiums.
author: Teck Chong Law

review_text: Highly recommended Ristorante Palermo! Great food and amazing service. Ms. Ruby and Ms. Cath were very kind, attentive, and professional. Thank you for making our visit extra special. We’ll definitely be back again!❤️
author: Maricris Enriquez

review_text: Fantastic authentic food. Love all types of risotto and Sicilian soup. Very good for romantic dinner, no noise and can easily talk with each other
author: Olga Sho

restaurant_name: The Surf Club by Tin Box
review_text:
Where good coffee, pastries and food meet even better people.
The staff were incredibly attentive and genuinely friendly — the kind that remembers your smile and makes you feel at home.
Add in the breathtaking sea view, and you’ve got the perfect escape from the city rush.
Highly recommend to visit for catch up and gathering with family and friends. Ohhh, pet friendly too!
author: Jolene Ang

restaurant_name: The Surf Club by Tin Box
review_text: Great place to simply chill, on top of yummy food and stunning views.  My new hang out now on… oh forgot to mention, they have very very nice pastries and cakes too!!!
author: michel lim

restaurant_name: The Surf Club by Tin Box
review_text: Great weekend brunch, great food options and even better coffee. Just what the Keppel Bay area needs following the shuttering of Prive. Service is friendly and efficient. Will be returning.
author: Jamie Moore

restaurant_name: The Surf Club by Tin Box
review_text: We live in Caribbean at Keppel Bay and were glad to hear that this new restaurant had opened (after Prive closed). It exceeded all our expectations -- the food was appetizing, the service impeccable, the setting idyllic, and the prices reasonable. We were pleased to meet Adrian (the owner), who was very gracious and friendly. Will definitely come back!
author: tony hung

restaurant_name: The Surf Club by Tin Box
review_text:
Went on friday night with my hubby, service was so impeccable that I had to leave a review! Food is good, atmosphere is amazing by the waters, but what really left an impression was the service provided to us by Brandon/Brendan! For the entire duration of my visit, I felt so comfortable with the way he took care of our table, his personality and general jovial character! From the way he sat us down, detailing fully all the perks such as complimentary ice cream and readily answer the million questions we had, I was left in awe!

Hopefully we get to be served by him our next visit… will definitely come back again!
author: netflixquad

review_text:
TERRIBLE!!! DON’T CONE TO THIS RESTAURANT!!! WORST RESTAURANT I HAD IN 2024!!!

1. I ordered Tandooori chicken half for $13.9, the picture was the one they serve, 4 small pieces, even less than quarter chicken. I even want to ask the owner, whether they can piece out half of a chicken using the bones I left. You can see the vegetables are also not fresh, very disgusting. The naan had lots of burned places, I didn’t even finish it.

2. My colleague ordered Butter Masala Combo A for $9.9 , only 4 chicken cubes, each chicken the same size of an eraser. Yes, it’s that less, not exaggerating.

3. THEY SERVED MEAT TO MY VEGETARIAN COLLEAGUE!!! My colleague already ate the Masala half way but found out it was not the vegetarian Masala she ordered. We felt so angry and my colleague was in the burst of crying, but we received NOT A SINGLE SORRY, THE PERSON JUST SAID “OH I SERVE THE WRONG FOOD, the cook is a new guy”. It was an Indian festival and it’s a huge Boo to eat meat on that day. Imaging if he serve the first wrong food to an Indian. My colleague is a strict vegetarian and she practiced vegetarian for her whole life. I’m not sure if my colleague is an asian or she is a small lady that the staff even shows NO GUILT! I can’t think of any word to express my anger already!!! SO DON’T COME TO THIS RESTAURANT IF YOU DON’T WANT YOUR DAYS RUINED!!!

4. The restaurant is super understaffed and we waited for at least 30+ min for our dishes. All the dishes are served to the wrong table. Not only my table, all the other tables somehow were served the wrong dish or had long waiting time. The whole restaurant is super confusing.

In the end, by insisting, we get only 15% off for our meal. DON’T COME TO THIS RESTAURANT!
author: Yiling Yu

review_text:
This restaurant replaced another popular restaurant named Sankranthi
The food is decent and the service has improved in the last year as I see some staff replaced ..
Both bento and a la karte are decent.
Though no complains .. this space can be amped up in terms of food quality and ambience.
Food is tasty .. won't be disappointed specially Andhra dishes
author: Ravi Singh

review_text:
We ordered 5 sets of chapati since the chapatis served here were very small. You get  2 small chapatis per one set for $5. It tasted like paper.  See the pictures attached for the size of the chapatis.
Also ordered dum chicken biryani and it wasn't tasty. It tasted like white rice work coloring and the chicken were added at the end. Oh, the egg served is half

Taste: Below average
Price: Expensive
Quantity: Small
Service: Decent
Location: Great

Won't go and wouldn't recommend.
author: Suresh Mani

review_text: Chicken tikka briyani and chicken dum briyani were as expected👍. It should have been better with teh tarik but it was sold out so lime juice was fine too. Staff was helpful to check on how we were doing👍 with our chicken😂. Yummy.
author: Ms Loo

review_text:
They are totally spoiling the Impression about Indian Food. I ordered Buttermilk because that was the only one which is not Premixed. Rest are all concentrates with Sugar. I could not even drink it as it was tasting like Milk a horrible taste. Even after repeatedly telling them they did not do anything

Ordered Kadai Paneer Not sure they are getting free pepper or Not. It was loaded with Pepper. A meal will set you back by 28 dollar

Just don’t go just because it is an Indian Resto
author: ChimeraRace MI6

review_text:
Went to an almost empty place and asked for dinner recommendations.

Ordered the Chicken Dum Bryani and was disappointed. Gave me a wing and not much meat. For $15 I can get a whole drumstick elsewhere. Should have ordered the promo where they display a whole drumstick.

They serve free water so not as bad.
author: William Ow

review_text: Good service provided by staff. Food served was relatively quick with minimal wait time. Ordered a vegetarian set meal and the food portions and options offered were very generous. Recommended!
author: Prakash Haridas

review_text: Generous servings of chunky boneless mutton. Tender and savoury.  Plentiful rice. Couldn't finish it as it's really let's of rice. Craving fulfilled
author: Johnson 'LovesDarth' Ang

review_text: We went there few times the food is really awesome, we ordered Hydrabati chicken briyani the taste is very nice and the chicken is very choosy. Amalsari kulcha Channa masala really top and the Pepper fish is also a must try item there. First time went there to buy things in NTUC then check in for dinner, we felt very happy and worth try their food, now we add this place weekly at least once our list on top the carpark is free from 6.30pm -11pm👍👍
author: Mahen DT

review_text: Sorry for the low rating but the food today was horrible. Ordered Rogan Josh and Kadai chicken and aloo gobhi and all 3 dishes were less than ordinary. Most food appeared stale. This restaurant with its previous owners and different name had terrific food and has recently gone down in standard several notches. The kulfi was so over frozen that it wouldn’t cut. They then heated it so much that it almost melted into milk. Need to improve significantly to get repeat business. Ambience is also average. Quite disappointed
author: Rajeev Kapoor

review_text:
The food at The Penyet Co. is decent and the service is generally fine — nothing particularly outstanding, but nothing wrong with the dishes themselves. Portions are reasonable and flavours are what you’d expect from a casual Indonesian eatery

However, the dining experience during peak lunch hours could be better managed. There doesn’t seem to be a designated place for customers to clear used plates and cups, and no staff were actively clearing tables
author: Loki

review_text: The place was empty for a weekend lunch time.  Ordered Fried Ayam Penyet and other which I can't recall the name.  You can select from 5 levels of spiciness and we chose the least spicy.  There is also option for either rice or noodles.  Ayam Penyet was dry whereas mine was drizzled with a spicy sauce, which turn out to be very spicy for me but thus not as dry as the penyet.  It comes with a small cube of fried tau fou and fermented bean, a cherry tomato and slice of cucumber and a side chilli.
author: Susan Tay

review_text: Indulge in your craving for indomie at this branch and chill over teh botol. This shop is newly set up in Oct 2025 and further enhances ARC's draw for makan quests for regional flavours.
author: Julian Chow

review_text: Disappointed, the chicken piece was so small for the price!! Poor value for money, not recommended, won't be back.
author: Victor Chan

review_text: Fast service and good customer service, good yummy chicken
author: Angely Yeo

review_text: Ordered bee hoon and the ngoh hiang dishes. Was surprised that the bee hoon and the ngoh hiang dishes (except the big round crispy cracker) were all quite nice at very affordable price. Staff service varies with some who are very friendly and some less friendly. Overall, a good option for a simple and affordable lunch when at ARC. Update: visited a second time but the taste of beehoon was not as good as the first time.
author: P. C.

review_text: I'm not sure the name of this place has not been updated to that of "Rong Wantan Noodle", but I know it to be the same. I tried the Wantan Mee Dry Small today with high expectations from the one I had at Tanjong Katong. Sadly, the Wantan here is pathetic - it's actually a meatball type Wantan vs. a minced meat type Wantan. And the lard croutons here don't seem freshly prepped. It's saving grace are its noodles, the still very hot chilli paste and the char siew chunks therein. Service here was average and so was the ambience.
author: edtayjb

review_text: One of the best wonton noodle around but they have their days, some days are quite average only. The noodle is springy, cha siew is good and not dry, the fried wonton is ok but not as good as the ‘famous pontian wanton noodle’. Each dish is around $4-5. Overall another good comfort food.
author: Timothy TM

review_text: Food was not bad. A pity this place was severely understaffed, poor guy had to operate the whole store by himself at dinner time. As a result he was very angsty towards customers, and waiting time was 30 minutes although > 50% of seats were empty. Wouldn’t have come if I knew the situation was this bad. Hope management does sth about it to spare their workers and customers
author: jh tan

review_text: Food is great for one craving comfort food. Serving size was decent and the large size is really huge! Fried wanton is crispy and ngioh hiong taste good, just a bit on the salty side. Recommended for diners who wants a good comfort food.
author: Edwin Goh

review_text: First time trying the food here... 😂 Though a bit costly but pretty tasty ... And the fiery level is relatively nice... Pork with stirred fried green pepper, the taste is there but a biy oily... Noodles with chicken and mushroom is good stuff.... Delicious broth and silky noodles....😂
author: Chee Sheng Ng

review_text:
Clean premises. Polite and Quick service. Easy to order from App.

Food is good and value for money.
Tried the Stir-Fry beef & chilli + Egg rice set, which includes a drink. There is a few way to customize it. This time I ordered the hunan smelly tofu. It's great! Smelly when bitten into but Abit too spicy for me.

Tried the signature pork noodles too. The portion is big. Handmade noodles are like kway teow but closed to the Cantonese style of Chee Cheong fun (instead of hokkien style or those found in Kopitiam). Smooth and silky noodles. For those who are heaviee taste buds, if you find it too bland just help yourself to the sauce station and pickled vegetables. Should make up for the taste since you can customize it fully.

Overall, great value and highly recommend you to try it.

Note to management: Please include stir fry pork with green chilli in a rice set too!
author: Shawn O.

review_text: Fresh Greens in Chicken Broth Rice Noodles 高汤青菜粉 is my all-time favorite. Rice milk is delicious too. There are varieties of dishes for different appetites. Love to take my dinner here after work. Appetizers are free for us to take and eat. Highly recommended!
author: SiUnique ly

review_text:
Food is worth every penny. Food serve fresh, hot and fast. I am satisfy with their food. Although a small restaurant, they seems like taking hygiene seriously. Thumbs up

Noodle taste nice and I will come back again.

Edit:
Server is great and efficient. They ensure my table is wipe before we sat (when is dirty). Additionally they gave us free passion fruit tea although I am not aware of the Google review offer.
author: Tio Gabriel Tio Yong Ping

review_text:
Been wanting to try and finally I did with a friend. It’s a self ordering machine and accepts pay wave. The set meal is worth a go for better value as it comes with a drink. I had the beef noodles and the broth though looks a little red but was not spicy. I had it as a meal and comes with pouch veg and a braised hard boil egg plus a drink (passion fruit drink) My friend had her meal set with white rice and chose two sides and a drink.

Service was brisk and there is a self serve condiments corner (omg that pork lard 😍) Not too loud, not too crowded so can chat. Mostly stool kind of seatings.

I would say I like the food and would be back to try other dishes 😉
author: B

review_text:
A great place to enjoy authentic Taiwanese flavours. The restaurant is clean, bright, and comfortable, with a simple and modern setup

I tried the braised meat rice set, and it was really delicious. The braised meat was rich, fragrant, and full of flavour, pairing perfectly with the rice. The set also comes with soup and small side dishes, making it a satisfying and well-balanced meal

Another plus is that it was not crowded in the evening, which made the dining experience very relaxed and enjoyable
author: Loki

review_text:
This is a delayed review, but a memorable one nonetheless.

We visited for dinner in September 2025 and ordered the Spicy Sesame Mala Chicken Noodle and the Fried Intestine Mee Sua. For an additional S$2, we upgraded both to set meals, which came with soup and side dishes - good value for money. We did wish the dishes were more customizable, though - for example, allowing diners to replace mee sua with noodles, or to opt out of the sesame sauce for those who dislike it.

The dishes were flavourful and satisfying, and the prices were reasonable for the quality and portion size.

That said, we couldn’t help but feel for the waitstaff - the only one on duty that evening. They were handling everything single-handedly: taking orders, preparing side dishes, serving food, clearing and cleaning tables, and managing payments at the counter. While there may be operational reasons for this, it would certainly make a difference if at least one more staff member were present to share the workload.

Overall, it was an enjoyable meal, and we would gladly return again whenever a craving for Taiwanese food strikes.
author: P Lim

review_text: Mee sua and noodle portion and taste are ok. Pig intestine is clean, no weird smell. Chicken chops meat part is too thin, good for people who like thick crispy flour.
author: ssin

review_text:
Was in ARC looking for dinner and decided to try out this Taiwan cafe as its menu looks interesting and with variety.  Ordered a pork knuckle rice set that comes with some braised vegetables and a bowl of soup. pork is braised flavorful and tender tasted good with rice.
Also ordered the Taiwanese fried vermicelli meal - tasty simple bee Hoon served with braised pork bits  and ngor Hiang.
A good option if you enjoy Taiwan food at reasonable pricing.
author: Ken Tan

review_text: The good is great! Service is 11/10! Our server Hnin is so nice. Shenis very friendly and accomodating. Gave good and helpful reccomendations too! 😊 My favorite was the fried intestines! 🤤😋
author: Johannah Pelin

review_text:
First time trying the shop for a healthy meal option.  Ordered the grilled salmon bowl and teriyaki chicken bowl. Protein and mix of carbo / vegetables tasted quite good and the servings are filling.
Overall tasty healthy meal.
author: Ken Tan

review_text: Ordered a salad at discounted price through Yindii and was very satisfied with the bowl we received! Portion was generous, ingredients tasted fresh, and there were plenty of seats for diners to enjoy the food comfortably.
author: JY S

review_text:
$10.30.

Base: lettuce and fusilli pasta

Toppings: achar, sous vide egg, baby corn, tofu

Protein: smoked duck

Sauce: mint jalapeno
author: Ember Shen

review_text:
Supergreen at ARC has become one of my favourite spots for a quick, healthy meal! The staff here are always so friendly and welcoming — they greet you with a smile and the service is consistently warm. Despite the crowd during peak hours, the queue moves surprisingly fast, and I’m always impressed by how efficient the team is.

The food is fresh, great-tasting, and genuinely healthy without feeling boring. Portion sizes are just right, and everything tastes clean and well-prepared. The environment is bright, clean, and comfortable, making it a pleasant place to eat whether you’re dining in or taking away.

Highly recommend Supergreen ARC if you want good food, good vibes, and great service!
author: Jonathan See

review_text: Very nice food, healthy with fast service . Good choice!
author: piengpit sangprabpai

review_text:
Tried their truffle fried rice with bratwurst this time. The dish was flavorful and well-executed, and every component incl. the chili stood out on its own.
If there’s one thing I would change, it would be to opt for the regular egg fried rice with chili and bratwurst instead. The overall flavors were so strong that the truffle aroma was hard to appreciate and kept getting overshadowed by the other ingredients.
I have enjoyed my meal !
author: Sam Z

review_text:
You can't really go wrong with Wok Hey. They've very properly systemized the entire operation, so regardless of who's the chef cooking, the taste typically ends up being quite consistent. Even the way they make the food, and the entire viewing experience, is consistent with their branding and their yellow tee shirts.

Tried their truffle udon for the first time, and added extra signature chilli. Super fragrant, even after my 1 hour bus ride. Super yummy, especially after a long day. Only slight pity here is how they'll always be a takeaway box, which makes eating out quite tricky.
author: Flo Yeow

review_text: The online order always shows closed near lunch hour (around 11am) so I had to go to their stall to order but the cashier is always very unfriendly, the way he talks and the annoyed face. Do understand it’s your peak hour but this is not what your customer deserve.
author: 진혜윤

review_text: Stir fried udon was delicious, fried rice has consistent quality. However, the waiting time is always long. You’d think the waiting time should be shorter if you beat the queue by coming early (11:15) but yet still need to wait for 20-30 minutes.
author: Yulong Wang

review_text: Good portion and tasty fried rice. The ingredients were pretty decent, Will try other flavours in my next visit.
author: Hulk

review_text:
Located on level 2 of the mall.
We were told to wait 30 mins to get a seat. Thankfully, within 15 mins, we were allowed to enter. However, we found it puzzling that we had to wait. And why was there a waiting queue to enter , when there were a lot of empty tables.
Whatever was the reason, I did not think it justifiable for the customers to be waiting outside when there were empty tables.

Wide variety of food to choose from. And the food was served promptly.
The prices were reasonable.
Food was not bad.

Overall experience was still alright.
author: DR DAVY GOH

review_text:
Curry pasta was very good, pasta was cooked well and the curry was flavourful.

Tochigi wagyu don was up to expectations - wagyu was melt in your mouth.

Drinks were good and refreshing. Paid $75.78 for all.

1. Long queue but restaurant had cordoned off many seats.

2. Kappa breeze took very long to come.
author: Ember Shen

review_text: Absolutely delicious pork dish. The meat was tender, flavorful, and perfectly coated in a rich savory sauce. The soft egg on top added a creamy texture that made every bite even better. Portion was generous and satisfying.
author: Justsg 329

review_text: As usual food is always good. However compare service, ambience & the staff in Tampines & Paragon outlet. Easily 5 star service for those 2 outlets 100%. Feel very welcome there & staff is very polite and friendly. However in Vivo, I must compliment the 2 outstanding staff, the Indian server & the cashier whom is also from Tampines Sushi Tei, they both are smiley & able to provide excellent customer service. A good example for the rest of the other servers there.
author: Fazlia Farhana

review_text: This is one of our go to restaurants for comforting and simple Japanese food in Singapore. We have tried a wide variety of food on their menu and all of it tastes good. Our favourites are the salmon mentaiyaki & the salad. The service is very prompt as well - refilling our tea and clearing our table of the empty dishes. Special shoutout to the manager Traslin who’s always so welcoming & friendly.
author: Janice Mok

review_text: Please train the staff to wear mask all the time. I was so shocked to see the staff here did not wear mask but keep talking non stop to ask clients what ingredients they wanted. It’s absolutely about hygiene issue. I don’t dare to re-order cuz of this.
author: Vanessa Leung

review_text: Got a quick bite at Subway before running errands. I was not expecting much. However, it turned out to be the best subway I have ever had. The honey oat bread was toasted to perfection and the staff was generous with the fillings. Enjoyed every bite. Would definitely come back to this Subway again.
author: brandalyn loo

review_text: Great crew they worked until 9pm on the dot. Perfect experience. Great sandwiches.
author: Wisam Safi

review_text: Brought my family here for dinner. We were served by Augusto and Maha. They were very patient and helpful in assisting us in the ordering process. Most importantly, we felt very welcome by their smiles
author: Jan Y

review_text: Not too many people. The guys working here are very enthusiastic with their work so I'm giving them a very good rating.
author: Andrew Teng

restaurant_name: Brotzeit German Beer Bar and Restaurant - VivoCity
review_text:
Our team arranged our holiday cum birthday celebration lunch at Brotzeit Vivo City on 10 Dec'25. I made the reservation through Mr Roman who then referred me to Mr Daniel. Daniel helped us with the pre-order and to ensure that the event proceed smoothly.

We had a wonderful session with the colleagues during the lunch. We could see that the staff were very attentive in serving us and even created a celebratory ambience when it came to the birthday celebration! The staff even assisted in the cake-cutting. We were all greatful to Daniel and his team!

Once again, thank you for the great service and we certainly look forward to visiting Brotzeit VivoCity in the near future! 😊
author: Rebecca Lim

restaurant_name: Brotzeit German Beer Bar and Restaurant - VivoCity
review_text:
I was here on 6 Dec 2025 for a family gathering to celebrate my nephew's birthday. It was great that they have a table available on a Saturday night and we didn't have to wait long for a table. The ambience ie great, though I think I would prefer indoor seats instead.

The service crew were very hospitable and attentive to us and made our dining experience a wonderful one. The food were also very tasty. I would recommend this place.
author: Jaslyn Lau

restaurant_name: Brotzeit German Beer Bar and Restaurant - VivoCity
review_text: Brotzeit VivoCity delivers an authentic German dining experience with consistently delicious food and a fantastic selection of beers. I ordered the Bavarian honey glazed rib and Thüringer snail sausage  both were excellent: flavorful, tender, and generously portioned. Service is attentive and friendly, even during busy hours. The outdoor seating with a waterfront view creates the perfect atmosphere to relax. A great spot for dinner with friends or family. Highly recommended!
author: Alinakey

restaurant_name: Brotzeit German Beer Bar and Restaurant - VivoCity
review_text: Brotzeit serves many kinds of sausage, and all of them taste very nice. Each sausage comes with a different sauce, and the sauces match well with the food. However, the sausages are also delicious even without any sauce. The restaurant has a warm and pleasant decoration that makes the place feel comfortable. It is a good spot to enjoy tasty food with family or friends.
author: ABXY

restaurant_name: Brotzeit German Beer Bar and Restaurant - VivoCity
review_text: Brotzeit VivoCity offers an authentic German dining experience, serving consistently delicious food and a fantastic selection of beers. I ordered the Waldpilzsuppe, BBQ Hünhnerschnitzel sandvich, and Räucherlachs Rösti, which were excellent: flavorful, tender, and generously portioned. Service is attentive and friendly—a wonderful spot for dinner with friends or family.
author: Rathore Kirti

review_text: Service here is excellent. The lead waitress was so attentive to the needs of the little one and even brought him a duck for him to be entertained as seen in one of the pictures. Food was served fast and served hot. Duck was delicious. We were given a heads up that the roast pork would be on the fat side but it was those fats that make the pork succulent! Absolutely love the food and service here. Will definitely be back for more! Decor was nice and certainly have the vibes of CNY!
author: Evangeline Tan

review_text:
Dian Xiao Er – VivoCity

We had a really satisfying meal here with a spread of their signature dishes. Of course, we couldn’t miss their famous herbal roast duck with Angelica herbs — fragrant, tender, and full of flavour as always.

We also ordered the double-boiled black chicken soup, which was rich and comforting, and the pork tripe pork rib pepper soup that had a nice peppery kick without being overpowering. The pickled mustard fish was appetising and well-balanced, while the roasted char siew was nicely caramelised and juicy.

For vegetables, the stir-fried garlic chives and stir-fried cauliflower were simple but done well, adding a good balance to the meal.

Overall, the food was consistently good across all the dishes we tried. A very enjoyable dining experience and definitely a place I’d recommend if you’re craving hearty, Chinese-style comfort dishes in VivoCity.
author: Melissa Hee

review_text:
Whenever I’m craving duck, I’ll usually head to Dian Xiao Er.
Their signature herbal roast duck is simply heavenly — tender, flavorful, and infused with rich herbal notes. The savory-sweet herbal gravy is the real star; it pairs perfectly with steamed rice and make⁹s every bite extra satisfying.

The curry fish is another standout dish. The curry gravy tastes fresh and fragrant, with a nice depth of flavor that keeps you going back for more.

Prices have been creeping up lately, so I’ll probably visit occasionally just to indulge in the duck.
That said, the oriental-themed ambiance is warm and pleasant, making it a comfortable spot for a casual meal.
author: K Tan

review_text: Dian Xiao Er never disappoints, especially with their signature herbal duck (Angelica) dishes. The duck is beautifully braised—tender, juicy, and richly infused with aromatic herbs that create a comforting yet flavorful broth. Each bite feels well-balanced, not overly heavy, and clearly prepared with care and consistency. Paired with their other classic dishes, the meal is always satisfying. Warm service and a cozy, traditional ambience make it a perfect place for family gatherings or a hearty meal. Highly recommended for anyone craving quality herbal cuisine.
author: WJ Pang

review_text:
Had their Duck Roasted with Angelica Herb, Duck Roasted with Ten Wonder Herbs and curry fish. Both ducks were roasted perfectly with crispy skin and tender meat. The Angelica one had a light herbal sweetness while the Ten Wonder Herbs version had a stronger and richer flavor that really stood out. The Curry fish was creamy and fragrant with a nice level of spice that made it super comforting with rice.

If you pay right after ordering, they give a free side dish. I got the King Oyster Mushrooms with Sesame Dressing and it was surprisingly good, fresh and crunchy with a light nutty taste that balanced the meal nicely. The service was friendly and the restaurant had a cozy old-style Chinese vibe. Everything came together really well and made the meal very enjoyable.
author: Acsahh C

restaurant_name: PastaMania - Italian Casual Dining @ HarbourFront Centre
review_text: I would like to specially recommend Jasmine & Noor for their outstanding service and leadership. They were attentive, approachable, and genuinely cared about their customers. Their professionalism was evident in the way they handled requests efficiently while maintaining a warm and friendly attitude. It truly enhanced our dining experience, and it’s clear that their positive management sets a great standard for the restaurant. Thank you for making our visit so pleasant and memorable!
author: habriyah

restaurant_name: PastaMania - Italian Casual Dining @ HarbourFront Centre
review_text:
Casual dinner at this place. Using qr self order but Kenna network busy error message. Me and some dinners approach cashier to order.

The laksa pasta was good Except for broken bits of the shells inside.

Service was pleasant. Would come again.
author: Sunbreeze Cazi

restaurant_name: PastaMania - Italian Casual Dining @ HarbourFront Centre
review_text:
What a horrible experience!!!!
I get the same pasta every other week from this outlet. However this time, my seafood Tom yum pasta arrived with no Tom yum paste at all. It was a normal aglio olio. I only realised when I got back to my office so I went down again to get them to change it to the correct order.

To my utter dismay, they gave it back to me with no Tom yum paste again but with A TON MORE GARLIC AND CHILLI! It was so inedible! It was basically garlic and chilli with pasta on the side. This is not acceptable! If they did not have Tom yum on that day, they could have informed me rather than just adding a mountain full of garlic and chilli and giving it back to me!

I only managed to eat 1/3 of it as the garlic and chilli was so over powering and suffered  tummy ache the rest of the day. I will be looking for a full refund for this unacceptable service.

restaurant_name: PastaMania - Italian Casual Dining @ HarbourFront Centre
review_text:
We had our lunch here with the children after their field trip, and the manager, Yong Xin, was extremely helpful and responsive from the initial planning stage all the way through to the actual day.

The children thoroughly enjoyed themselves, and throughout our meal, the staff on duty were exceptionally attentive, efficient, and accommodating.

author: Elaine Foo

review_text:
The food was decent—not particularly fancy, but the portion, quality, and taste were all satisfactory. There are various options to choose from across different stations, including appetizers, mains, sides, desserts, and drinks.

We didn’t manage to make a reservation, but we didn’t have to wait long despite needing to queue during the dinner peak hour. The staff were nice and friendly, even during the busy period, guiding us to our allocated seats. The floor staff was also efficient in answering our queries and keeping the tables clean.
author: Lyla (ZL)

review_text:
Chanced upon Marche during lunch. Ordered the Pork Knuckle and Pizza, while my colleague ordered the rosti. The rosti was quite on the money. However, the prok knuckle was a tad too tough. The skin was crispy but somewhat lose the moisture and it was became tough to bite. The pizza was a little normal. There was not enough cheese and the dough tasted a little different than all the pizzas I have eaten. I wouldn't say it was a positive experience.

I paid S$60.70 for the pork knuckle and pizza.
author: Andy Yxyz

review_text:
Had a great experience at Marché VivoCity.

Special shoutout to Chef Quek at the soup counter, warm, friendly, and clearly passionate about what he serves. The mushroom soup was rich, smooth, and comforting with deep earthy flavour.

The fresh oysters were clean and briny, and the rösti was perfectly crispy outside and fluffy inside.

Simple dishes done right. Definitely worth a visit.
author: Sriram

review_text:
Dropby during sunday lunch.
Noisy during peak meal hours.
Service is Slow when comes to receiving ur card and finally shown to ur assigned table.
Give their crepe a missed pls, too Salty! Dissapointing.

author: Siah Hx

review_text:
Service staff here are friendly and the food is fresh!! This place is suitable for kids, as they have an mini indoor playground.

For folks that are on wheelchair, the environment here space is friendly, but at some part are a little tight, but shouldn't have much of an issue.

Overall, this is a nice place to have family and friends to dine in with 👍👍

author: JX

And while i eat my food i saw small small fly on my table almost go to my food , for me i don't really care as long not touch my food . Pls take more inspection to yr store hygine. author: R.Ayu. Kresno Galuh Condro Kirono PALUPI

review_text:
I ordered the beef bibimbap without any sides or requests, and it costed $8.40. A bit steep considering what was given.

I'll start off by saying the food was mediocre at best. Mediocre to the point that it's basically the same as what you'd get at an average korean/jap stall at a hawker center/food court, just smaller portions and less toppings and a $2 higher pricetag.

My bowl had 3 types of veggies; corn, spinach and kimchi, one egg, an okay amount of beef and probably half a bowl of rice.

The veggies:
In my opinion, the corn didn't really work well with this bowl. Something like carrots or beansprouts probably would've done this bowl better. The kimchi was really mild, couldn't taste any of that "fresh" cabbage flavor nor any substantial spice. The spinach was okay, just didn't taste that fresh too.

The meat:
For a restaurant that offers gyudon, I expected more taste coming out of the beef. However, the beef I got just tasted like normal beef with maybe a hint of sweetness. The egg was okay, just a little overcooked. It lacked the lava texture.

The gochujang:
It was very, very mild. Unlike in the photos, it was transparent, and topped with sesame seeds. I barely got any spice from it, in fact all I could taste were slightly spicy wet sesame seeds. You could find better sauce in the frozen sections of supermarkets.

The rice:
At least the rice was okay. It wasn't too sticky, nor too dry, it was cooked just right to be put in a bowl of bibimbap. Though the small portion had me wanting more.

Conclusion:
Its a reliable place for a little below average food. If you're willing to converse with people, go get some eastern food at hawker centers or maybe this mall's food court instead(if they do have one). Usually you'd be able to find much bigger portions, way more toppings and way more taste at way lower prices at literally any eastern hawker/foodcourt stall(unless its the kind to get mentioned on sethlui for its notoriety). For example the bibimbap found at the semi-foodcourt just downstairs my house is leagues better than this in every way possible, and it just costs $6.50.

Service was average without much to note, atmosphere was pretty clean, quiet and comfortable.
author: Mykael V

review_text: Edible if you looking for fuss free dining, but the combo is quite pathetic, also they don't offer teriyaki sauce drizzled over the meats making it really dry and boring meal. I can understand the "fast food concept" that you guys are trying to achieve but marketing really needs to look into in-dining experience if food is subpar - just my two cents.
author: Dee

review_text:
I've been dining here every other week for years now as the food is affordable and decent. The service staff are fast and efficient too.

Unfortunately, this is the second time I've encountered cockroaches scurrying around in the dining area. Please refer to the video, it was taken along the seats on the right, close to the tray return area (linked directly to kitchen).

I encountered a cockroach at this branch a few months back as well but decided to give benefit of doubt as it may be from neighbouring food stores. However, as this is the second occasion, it shows that the potential pest issue has not been resolved.

Please do something about this, as it concerns food hygiene and safety🙏🏻 I hope to be able to come back here soon.
author: m

review_text:
I first tried this shop many years ago, around 2002, before I was married. At that time, the taste was good but quite normal to me, and I wasn’t really into beef noodles yet.

In 2016, after I got married, I decided to try the beef noodles here again. One of the Malaysian Malay staff recommended adding a little fish sauce to enhance the flavour. I followed her suggestion, and that completely changed everything. From that day on, I became addicted.

When the beef noodles are served with fresh basil leaves, they are absolutely delicious and the flavour really stands out. That basil aroma is what makes the dish special to me, and it’s the main reason I keep coming back. This has become my all-time favourite food, and I will go out of my way to eat here, even if it’s far.

However, on days when basil leaves are not available and they are replaced with daun sup (Chinese celery), I honestly feel quite disappointed because the taste just isn’t the same for me. Nowadays, whenever I visit, I will always ask if basil leaves are available. If yes, I will order the beef noodles. If it’s celery, I will usually order the Pad Thai instead.
author: Sg_ Naga

review_text: Not as good as i remembered it to be when they had a stall in Clementi but still a hearty bowl of beef noodle and plate of pad thai. You could spice it up with their chili flakes and pretty generous chunks of beef given. Friendly service and food was served super quick! Satisfied my cravings.
author: khrhms

review_text:
Ordered the beef pad thai for $8.50, which I thought was alright for the portion (don’t understand why people are complaining about this)

Fortunately there wasn’t much of a queue and within 10 mins, I received my food.

Very different from the usual pad thais I get elsewhere in a good way. Beefy with a bit of tanginess from the pad thai sauce. Beef chunks were tender and flavourful.

The stall is run by Thais, so it should be authentic and the lady serving us could speak Malay.

Overall, I enjoyed the food very much and I’m happy with the price. Will definitely return to try the beef noodle and fried rice!

Halal certified
author: Muhammad Yacob Abdul Aleem

review_text: $9 beef noodles was pretty decent - the former Thai PM Thaksin Shinawatra has visited this namesake stall and dined here before too
author: Tk Sim

review_text:
i havent been eating their thaksin beef noodle ever since they renovated Seah Im food centre and the beef noodle is amazing!! so tasty and what i ordered is no babat and no taugeh hehehe and as for the beef, when u bite it, damnnnn its so soft and tender at the same time like u dont have to bite so hard!! their service is fast and friendly staff!!

u can use CDC vouchers here as well!! would come here again if im craving for some beef noodles!! yummy!! highly recommended for those who wanna try!!
author: ri fieschi

review_text:
We held our ceremony and wedding lunch at Mount Faber Peak last month in October, and the whole experience was better than we could have hoped for. The night before our wedding, the weather was really bad and I was honestly quite stressed, especially since our ceremony was at 11am the next morning. But thankfully, everything cleared up, and the venue looked absolutely beautiful.

The team handled everything so smoothly—from the setup to the coordination and service. They were attentive, reassuring, and made sure we didn’t have to worry about a thing on the actual day. Our guests kept complimenting the view, the cosy atmosphere, and how well-organised everything is.

Overall, it turned into such a memorable and heartwarming day for us. We’re really grateful to the staff and highly recommend this venue to any couple looking for a scenic and unique wedding location! Special thanks to Dave (Event/Sales Manager) who assisted us from the beginning together with the banquet team! ☺️👍🥂
author: PaNiks Coco

review_text: Great hike up to Mount Faber. We walked halfway from the city and then we took a bus to the bottom of the peak. The Hike is not too long and has multiple entry points in exits. Nice view from the top. If you have extra time is Singapore, this is a nice one to check out.
author: Z M

review_text:
We held our garden solemnisation and ballroom lunch reception at Mount Faber Peak on 30 Nov 2025. Every aspect exceeded our expectations and a big part of it was thanks to the amazing Mount Faber Leisure Group team.

Thank you Mae (Asst Mgr/Events Sales) for handling our queries from more than a year ago till date. Her enthusiasm, efficiency and professionalism were what convinced us to hold our wedding with MFLG. We were not the easiest with some of our requests, but she handled everything with such ease and care, and made everything seem so effortless.

A special thank you to Martin, our Banquet Manager, and his team for managing the day so smoothly. Martin kept us calm, reassured us at every step and offered thoughtful advice on how to run the lunch reception. When we forgot to place our vows on the solemnisation table, he stepped in immediately and made everything look seamless. His guidance in finetuning our programme also played a big part in making the day such a success.

We would also like to thank the chef for accommodating our requests during food tasting. Our guests praised every course of the western menu and it truly was the best version we had tried. Thank you Nizam and Jeffery for being so warm and attentive during the tasting session as well.

Thank you again to the entire MFLG team. Our guests loved the venue, the flow of the programme and the food, and none of it would have been possible without all of you. Cheers!

M & Z
author: Caryn W

review_text: I walked the trek from west to east so this was pretty much the final destination. The views are spectacular and there are a lot of activities even for smaller kids.
author: Stephan Dua Modest

review_text: Mount Faber Peak is where one could take a cable car ride to Sentosa Island. The location houses not just a cable car station, but also other amenities as well for tourists and locals alike. To get to Mount Faber Peak, one could drive thereto or, for the more physically abled, walk towards it, along the roads or trails of Mount Faber Park. And it is not very challenging as Mount Faber peaks out at barely over one hundred metres above sea level.
author: edtayjb

review_text:
This is the worst experience ever among the EAT branches.

review_text: I stopped by Eat. at HarbourFront on a public holiday and ordered the laksa set (which came with tea) and the curry chicken chop rice. The pricing felt fair for the quality nothing exceptional, but decent enough for a quick meal. However, the public holiday rush seemed to stretch their staff thin. It was hard not to notice the leftover plates stacking up on nearby tables, spilling over due to delays in clearing. This understandably affected the overall dining atmosphere.

review_text: Their place are dirty, cutlery are wet and don’t even bother to dry it properly. Condiments never replenish and not fresh at all.  Once is enough
author: Lola

review_text: Great service by uncle/aunty. However the food standard and is really quite bad relative to other eat outlet. Noodles were plain (minced meat/fishball) and lacking in taste. Added more chili but the chili and vinegar are pre mixed hence you cannot add too much or it’ll be very sour. Hope management can look into QC-ing the quality of food.
author: Richmond Tan

review_text:
I am writing to express my disappointment regarding a recent experience at your Harbourfront EAT. outlet on 20 May 2025, at approximately 12:35 PM.

During my visit, I discovered a piece of plastic in my dish. I brought this to the attention of both the male cook and the female staff member who was clearing trays. Unfortunately, the response from both individuals was dismissive and unprofessional.

When I informed the male cook, he responded in an unfriendly tone and made it seem as though the issue was insignificant or somehow my fault. He mentioned that he could just recook and give me a brand new bowl of noodles if I wanted it. I then approached the female staff member to report the issue, and her reaction was similarly indifferent. When I requested a refund due to having lost my appetite, she simply redirected me back to the cook without offering any assistance or acknowledgment of the problem.

The lack of accountability and poor customer service left a very negative impression. As a brand known for quality local fare, I had expected a more professional and empathetic approach to food safety concerns.

I hope this feedback will be taken seriously, and that appropriate steps will be taken to ensure a better experience for future customers.
author: Sonia Tan

review_text:
prefer vivo's ock as compared to the harbourfront outlet as this outlet's items are always hot or minimally warm. recommending the sotong onstick? cheese sausages and chicken chunks.

author: Terrick W.
