Basic courtesy is to return the change directly to the customer hand. It shows respect too. Please remind staff to observe proper manners when serving customers.
author: Lola

restaurant_name: Soup Restaurant 三盅两件 - VivoCity
review_text:
I had a wonderful dining experience at Soup Restaurant (VivoCity), thanks especially to Lee Yoke Chu. She was warm, attentive, and genuinely thoughtful throughout our meal. From explaining the menu clearly to checking in at the right moments without being intrusive, her service made us feel very well taken care of.

Her professionalism and friendly attitude truly enhanced the overall experience, turning a simple meal into a pleasant and memorable one. It’s clear that she takes pride in her work and customer service.

We appreciate her service where she timely topped up our tea, chilli and also the ginger sauce for the steamed chicked.

Appreciate the excellent service — we’ll definitely be back!
author: Zacus Gan

restaurant_name: Soup Restaurant 三盅两件 - VivoCity
review_text: We had a wonderful time at this branch. Ms. Lee Yoke Chu is superbly attentive and kind. Food is good as usual. We were seated at the window with sea view. Highly recommended!
author: Marcos -

restaurant_name: Soup Restaurant 三盅两件 - VivoCity
review_text:
Enjoyed the CNY lunch at VivoCity outlet this afternoon. The fish maw collagen soup was intense rich and well-flavoured with tender chicken and fresh fish maw. The steamed sausage rice was perfectly cooked and not oily. It was soft yet retained the whole grain texture and it was unexpectedly good with the chinese sausage, mushroom etc! The truffle pork chop was tender and tasty too! I would give a full rating for food if not for the prawns that were slightly overcooked.

The service was great with Yoke Choo being very attentive and patient to our needs and requests. Thank you, Yoke Choo, for clearing our tables quickly for our birthday celebration too! 🥰
author: rachel koh

restaurant_name: Soup Restaurant 三盅两件 - VivoCity
review_text:
Soup Restaurant is a non-negotiable stop whenever I visit Singapore. While they have several locations, the VivoCity branch is my absolute favorite because of the stunning views of the harbor and Sentosa Island from the dining area.

For me, their Samsui Ginger Chicken paired with Yang Chow Fried Rice is the perfect meal in Singapore outside of the hawker centers.

I recently visited with my wife and teenage sons in December '25. Our last visit was back in 2019; the boys were too young to remember it then, so it was wonderful to reintroduce them to these flavors now that they are older. We were starving, so we ordered the Large Chicken, Large Yang Chow, and a Medium Sweet and Sour Pork. My wife worried we had over-ordered, but the food was so good that my boys (and I!) polished off every single bite.

The service was exceptional. We arrived just before noon, and our server actually rushed to get our order in specifically so we could qualify for the 10% "early bird" discount (available 11 AM – 12 PM). She also mentioned a larger 20% discount for tea-time diners (2:30 PM – 4 PM). On top of that, the food arrived in under 10 minutes.

If you are in VivoCity, do try this place out. You won't regret it!
author: Truffle Zee Cat

restaurant_name: Soup Restaurant 三盅两件 - VivoCity
review_text:
Food was delicious, we enjoyed all the dishes.

Good service from Mdm Lee Yoke Chu.

Also an older gentleman who served our table, he was very attentive and very hardworking. Good job 👍🏻
author: Love Food n Drinks

review_text:
I’m not one to write a mid review but this needs to be addressed. Please tell the big guy with misai at Seah Im Food Centre jangan kurang ajar dgn customers. Everyone else was okay but just that big guy. No customer service, plain rude and condescending.

I absolutely love eating their nasi ayam and always come down to eat whenever possible to patronise their food. But that guy is just straight up rude as hell dgn customers dia. Please reprimand the fella because i’m so happy to come over whenever I have the chance to eat their food but straight up no mood and disappointed whenever I make an order from that guy.
author: Muhammad Muhaimin

review_text:
Affordable and delicious chicken rice!

Got the lemon and the sweet and sour sauce, love the both of them!
Chicken is tender and crispy, rice is fragrant, soup is the right balance of salty. A satsifying meal overall!
The utensils are a little difficult to eat in though
author: Ong Hui Li

review_text: Malay style chicken rice has its unique flavour. Despite the chicken being a tad dry, Aspirasi offers a choice of sauces that comoliment their fragrant chicken rice. Overall, a great experience for me.
author: Mr J

review_text:
Be prepared to queue.

This is one of the best chicken rice stalls in Singapore! Aspirasi Chicken Rice that serves up hearty, flavorful meals at great value.

I tried both the Sambal Chicken Rice and the Original Fried Chicken Rice, and both were excellent.

The sambal is spicy but well-balanced, and the fried chicken is crispy and juicy. If you prefer something milder, the original version is just as satisfying. Prices are very reasonable ($5.50–$7.00), and the portions are generous.

Service is quick even during peak hours, and the staff clearly takes pride in what they do. There is also a nice variety of flavors like black pepper, lemon, and sweet & sour — something for everyone.
author: Dee

review_text: Very delicious chicken and rice. However, I thought the sambal chilli wasn’t very nice and was too sweet and overpowering. Still pretty enjoyable though
author: Elijah Lim

review_text: Wonderful experience on board. We took the NYE dinner cruise, the crew were very attentive and caring. Their service was right on point. Food wise, not what you would expect in a 300+ Michelin-starred high-end fine dining restaurant on land, but more than good enough for a moving ship on the sea. The ride has been great, with free flow wine and live music and the beautiful scenery, it’s been very enjoyable. Would highly recommend since it’s really an unique experience, will be back again for another special occasion!
author: Yijun “玉黎Tamari” Sun

review_text:
It was a truly fantastic evening aboard the Royal Albatross, celebrating the eve of my birthday. The atmosphere was magical — the sea breeze, the gentle sway of the ship, and the beautiful night sky made everything feel so special. The 4-course meal was absolutely delicious, each dish thoughtfully prepared and beautifully presented.
It was an unforgettable night filled with good food, wonderful company, and heartfelt moments. A perfect way to welcome another year of life
author: Joe Edward

review_text:
An unforgettable experience on the Royal Albatross!

I had a fantastic dinner cruise yesterday with a friend on the Royal Albatross. We chose the vegetarian 7-course dinner and it was excellent — every dish was beautifully presented and full of flavour. The staff were incredibly kind, professional, and attentive throughout the evening.

The cruise itself was magical. You get to enjoy the scenery in three different moments: daylight, the sunset, and the night skyline — truly the best of everything in one trip.

Overall, it was a wonderful experience and absolutely worth the money. Highly recommended!
author: Federica Saletti

review_text:
Had an absolutely magical evening on the Royal Albatross for their Christmas special dinner. 🎄✨

From the moment I stepped on board, the crew were warm, welcoming and very organised. The ship itself is beautiful and all the festive decorations made it feel like stepping into a floating Christmas movie. The sunset sail, city skyline and cool breeze really set the mood before dinner even started.

The Christmas menu was delicious – nicely plated, generous portions and surprisingly good quality for a “tourist” experience. The timing of each course was smooth and we never felt rushed. The live entertainment and little Christmas touches (music, lights, photo spots) added a lot of fun to the night.

What stood out most was the service – staff were constantly checking in, offering to help take photos and making sure everyone was comfortable and enjoying themselves.

Overall, it’s not a cheap night out, but for a special occasion and a unique Christmas experience in Singapore, it was totally worth it. Would definitely recommend, especially for couples or small groups looking for something a bit different for the festive season.
author: Liu Robin

review_text:
I enjoyed an evening dinner cruise around Sentosa Island. The buffet was great, with a variety of veg and meat options. The dinner included free flow wine and beer as well as soft drinks. The service was excellent, with everyone so friendly and welcoming.

My only disappointment was that it was sold as a Christmas lights sail, so I expected Christmas music instead of the romantic music that played in the background.

Other than that, I did enjoy the fireworks show at the end of the sail and the Christmas carol the staff performed for us.
author: Laney Turner

review_text:
Bought the 3 course set for 2
Chicken Barely warm, sauce cold and extra salty.
NTUC / Cold Storage Rotisserie Chicken would be a wiser choice. hotter, cheaper and better.
Fries came out same time, burnt but not hot.
Brussel Sprout + Broccoli only came out only when we're nearly done w the chicken. Taste like LokLok + jap sesame dressing. Tasted better than the chicken though.
Experience was bearable cause Nisa was great.
What'$ happening to Poulet?
author: BigBlueWhale (BigBlueWhale)

review_text: Great food, great service! Was served by Anisah and her team, was an enjoyable experience. Went there for an iftar, food takes awhile but understandable since it was in a peak hour with long queue. Best service by Poulet outlets that I went to so far, highly recommended.
author: Hanna Grace Mah

review_text: We walked in around 5pm.  Order the 3 course set meal for 2 at $54. For starters, we have truffles fries and roasted Brussels sprouts with cauliflower. It was good.  I order a fish and my son ordered Carbonara and ends with bubble tea pudding and mango pudding.  Drinks are exclusive so we ordered a jar of still water to share.
author: Cindy Tan

review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Had a great experience at Poulet, and special thanks to Manager *Ann* for her excellent service. She was friendly, attentive, and handled everything very professionally. Even during busy hours, she made sure customers were well taken care of and comfortable. The food was delicious as always, and the service really made the difference. Definitely a place I’d come back to. Well done, Ann and team!
author: Wan Hisham Bin Abu Bakar

review_text:
Poulet continues to impress with its consistently comforting and well-prepared French-inspired dishes. Every plate that arrived was beautifully presented and served promptly, a testament to the team’s attentiveness and efficiency.

The roasted chicken was the clear highlight — golden and crisp on the outside, tender and juicy within. The creamy mushroom sauce complemented it perfectly, adding a savoury depth that tied the whole dish together. The mac and cheese was wonderfully rich and velvety, a satisfying blend of gooey cheese and perfectly cooked pasta that even kids would adore. The steak was nicely done, paired with a smooth brown sauce, crisp fries, and a side of creamy corn that added a lovely sweetness to balance the flavours.

What really stood out was how fast the food was served without compromising on quality — everything arrived warm, fresh, and flavourful. The ambience of the restaurant was equally delightful: relaxed, cosy, and welcoming, with just the right touch of elegance.

For the quality, portion size, and experience, the food is definitely worth the money. Poulet remains a solid choice whether you’re dining with family, friends, or simply craving a hearty, comforting meal done right. A place I’ll gladly return to again.
author: Irfan Baharudin

review_text:
First time here. Was wow by the excellent broth and the serving size. Ordered the Tonkatsu with all ingredients and a Karaage side - both servings were very filling for one! 😍 there was lots of char siew in my noodles, very generous and the Karaage was fried well with crispy on outside and yet retained the juiciness within. I had such an enjoyable meal.

They even provide free sides of bean sprouts and corn - yum yum! And I did not order drinks, free water was served as well!

I’ll be back for more for sure!

P.S: Just got news that harbourfront would be tear down for new development around June 2026😭 so be there before to eat!!!
author: B

review_text: The ramen is good, I wouldn’t say super amazing but good enough. But what stands out especially here is their service! They were very helpful and accommodating with kids. If you need to customize your meal for your kid, they’ve got you covered. Really appreciate that! They would also find some way to get the best table for my family to make it easy to feed my kid!
author: Daniel Bok

review_text: 5 stars all round for this ramen restaurant at HarbourFront ground floor! 🌟 All staff really went over and beyond our family. We were seated efficiently even on a Sunday night including a baby chair. The staff pleasantly surprised our boy with a small dessert which he loved, and also gave me a tip on how to save on payment using a GrabPay promotion. They were very happy to help top-up our kid’s empty water bottle and even made the extra effort to clean the slightly wet exterior. The ramen and don dishes were all yummy which our boy also loved, while the sides were tasty too. Thank you so much! 🙏🏻 Will be back again soon 🤩 P.S. Free bean sprouts and corn too which were also tasty! 😋
author: Ashley Liew

review_text:
I visited for lunch on a Sunday, and the restaurant was less than half full. The ramen quality is average, though the chashu pork is delicious. While the Tonkotsu ramen has a standard noodle portion, the Shoyu ramen portion felt quite small. On a positive note, the all-you-can-eat bean sprouts and corn are a generous inclusion.

However, I would not recommend the Kids Ramen Set, as the portion is extremely small and the broth lacks flavor. There is also a significant issue with the timing of the side dishes. The karaage arrived 10 minutes after the ramen, meaning we had already finished our noodles before the chicken was served. It appears the kitchen begins frying the chicken only after serving the ramen, which is an inefficient workflow that seems to occur on every visit. Finally, the tables are quite small, making it difficult to fit side dishes on the table alongside the main bowls.
author: Yoshi S

review_text: I had the tonkatsu ramen with thin noodles at Ramen Hitoshi. The broth was rich and the chashu was thinly sliced and tender. I also appreciated the free corn on the table. It was a nice extra that made the meal feel a bit more special.
author: Jo

review_text:
Met up with a couple of friends here for a satisfying meatless dinner before HarbourFront Centre undergoes its makeover in the second half of 2026.
The Hokkaido Croquette Burger Set paired with Corn Soup tasted great as always. Really glad that they continue to offer and maintain
these meatless options on their menu.
author: Yellow Bear

review_text: The place is not fully filled and the staff already cannot handle the volume of orders. Waited for over 30 mins, while seeing other customers who came in later than us received their food way earlier than us. When asked, the staff said they have too many orders to handle. Ordered large fries by adding $1 extra which came only half pack full with many dark, oil-filled, over-fried french fries. The chicken teriyaki burger is over filled with sauce. While the inner part of the buns completely painted with dark sauce, a puddle of sauce can be seen at the bottom of wrapper. The rest of the burgers are cold, and the buns taste like they are taken out freshly from factory wrapper without being baked or warmed up. The ketchup packs do not have any cut to allow easy tearing. I am still sitting in the store, trying to figure why this fast food store can survive so long with this kind of subpar standard at such pricing.
author: Mocha

review_text: Har Yau burger is not bad, just not sure what I’m eating. The chilli crab sauce is the best one so far. Mantou is also crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside. The har soup is tasty.
author: rn_1604

review_text:
Came here to dine with my family and kid. Had a great time as they chomp on the food and also the staff was kind enough to provide hot water for the kid's milk.
Service would be perfect if the other staff was willing to give an empty cup so that more sharing can be achieved among us.
How much a large cup can cost these days?
author: YP

review_text: average burger if i could say, well honestly i already forget about the taste, but for me if i don't remember it, it doesn't stand out that much
author: Christian Jason

review_text:
Excellent curry here! We were so surprised by the portion and so glad we came here for our gathering. We we ate here:
- Super Monster Combo ($35) (good For 2-3 pax, 41cm bowl) - - Teppan YAKI beef (100g), tonkatsu (180g), fried fish fillet, ebi tempura, Three-egg omelette, flame-torched mozzarella, rice, salad & pickled red ginger

- YAKI Pork Omelette Curry ($15.90) (Solo, 35cm bowl), Teppan YAKI pork belly, three-egg omelette, rice, salad & pickled red ginger

🥤 Seasonal  Drinks & Desserts
✔ Shiiquasa Mojito ($15.50) – Refreshing Okinawan lime & 7-Up cooler
✔ Honey Toast Desserts – Topped with Häagen-Dazs vanilla ice cream, Mixed Berries ($12.50) – Strawberry, blueberry & raspberry sauce

——-
Revisited 2025 to try out their NEW Lucky 13th Anniversary refreshed menu, and it was a really enjoyable dining experience. They’ve done a great job blending classic favorites with appealing new items.
Here’s a review of the dishes we tried:
🔥 Hotplate Selections
The Hotplate Series provides a hearty, sizzling meal—perfect comfort food.
• Tori Karaage & Arabiki Sausage Hotplate: A delicious and satisfying combination. The Tori Karaage was nicely crisp on the outside and moist inside, pairing well with the savory Arabiki sausage.
• Yaki Beef Hotplate (+ extra cream cheese!): This was a highlight for us. The Yaki Beef was tender and flavorful. We definitely recommend adding the extra cream cheese, as it melts beautifully into the dish, giving it a rich and creamy depth that enhanced the overall flavor.
🍞 Dessert: Honey Toast
A perfect sweet ending.
• New: Apple Cinnamon & Biscoff Honey Toast: This dessert was fantastic. The honey toast was soft and fluffy, while the warm apple and cinnamon filling, combined with the spiced Biscoff crumbs, offered a wonderful mix of textures and sweet, aromatic flavor.
🍹 Drinks
• Yuzu Orange Lemonade Jug: This was the ideal refreshing beverage. The sparkling soda mixed with the vibrant yuzu-orange purée and fresh mint was light, tart, and sweet—great for cutting through the richness of the mains.
It’s great to see them refreshing their menu while keeping the high standards. If you're looking for flavorful, generously portioned Japanese comfort dishes, Monster Curry is a reliable choice.
author: Victoria Ho

review_text: Family of 5, got a comfy corner seating area. Food was very good, and arrived very fast! Picture shows our super monster combo with Yakiniku Beef for 2-3pax. Spoon and Fork for size reference.
author: Jolene Zhou

review_text: Although it’s a chain restaurant, the quality of the food is well maintained. The portions are sufficient for men, and the prices are reasonable. I recommend it to those who want to enjoy delicious curry without spending too much money.
author: 韋承佑

review_text: Tried their new overload burgers and am not disappointed! With the unlimited sauce refill, was even better! Visited their Vivocity outlet at 2pm and there is minimal crowd and had a great chit chat with a friend.
author: Shawn Dabi

review_text: Have the lunch set meal, at SGD12.90(excluding service charge and GST), it is indeed a steal! Food came promptly and there was no complains on the chicken katsu curry rice.
author: Ron Yip

review_text:
This was my first time having a lunch appointment at Canton Paradise in VivoCity. They are well-known for their dim sum and creative Cantonese dishes. We ordered:

Steamed Chicken Feet
Steamed BBQ Honey Pork Bun
Pan-fried Radish Cake
Crispy BBQ Honey Pork Bun
Baked Mini Egg Tart
2 sets of Porridge, Coffee and Tea
Overall, I would rate the dim sum 4/5. The flavours were good and enjoyable. The Crispy BBQ Honey Pork Bun, in particular, tasted better than those from some local HK-style chain restaurants. The quality of Canton Paradise’s dim sum still maintains a consistent standard, and I feel there has not been any significant drop in quality over the years.

For the coffee and tea, there was no option to request a less-sweet version. One of the waiters suggested getting bottled water to dilute the sweetness; however, they eventually served us a cup of hot water for free, which we appreciated. I believe providing plain water should be a basic form of customer support.

Another thing I found convenient was the ability to order through the app while queuing outside. This helps improve productivity, as customers can place their orders in advance. It reduces waiting time, speeds up the dining process, and increases table turnover. A win-win for both customers and the restaurant.
author: Meditate Zen

review_text: We had a family dinner at this outlet. Made an advance reservation. Ordered several dishes, such as Signature Original Xiao Long Bao, Pork Dumplings in Chilli Oil, Scramble Egg White Canopy, Stir Fried Spinach, Crispy Duck, Sweet Sour Pork, Stir Fried Pork Noodles, Scallion Oil La Mian, Fried Rice with Pork Cutlet, Steamed Custard Lava Buns and Steamed Taro Lava Buns. The dishes were generally delicious, above average. We especially like the XLB, sweet and sour pork and vegetables. We also ordered their desserts, such as Aloe Vera Osmanthus Jelly, Black Sesame Glutinous Balls, Pumpkin Pastries, Mango Pudding, and Tang Yuan in Ginger Syrup. The Mango Pudding and Osmanthus Jelly were refreshing, a good way to end the hearty meal. Service staff were attentive and efficient.
author: Vivian Foo

review_text: Not much crowd on a Monday lunch. We coincidentally discovered they even had 23% off promo. Every dish that we ordered was great. The little dragon buns had sufficient stock and flavors were well balanced. I would definitely be back to try more dishes!
author: Who’s Khoo

review_text: Had our lunch at this outlet as we were going over to Sentosa later. Ordered the Special Dynasty Xiao Long Bao (8 flavours), Signature Original Xiao Long Bao, Poached Chinese Cabbage in Superior Broth and La Mian with Scallion Oil. Overall, the meal was great. The 8 flavours XLB are very interesting, to each of their own taste. We still like the original XLB the most though. The Poached Chinese Cabbage with Superior Broth was 💯. And lastly, La Mian with Scallion Oil was flavourful though pales in comparison with DTF. I will definitely come back again to try other dishes.
author: Catherine Tan

review_text:
The starter was good, but the rest felt quite ordinary, more like home-cooked food. In my opinion, the standard has declined. The skin of the Xiao Long Bao—especially the pinched tops of their specialty 8 flavours—was hard, and a few pieces even had a smelly, not-fresh taste. The pan-fried Shanghai pork bun skin wasn’t crisp as expected but soft, while the taro bun skin tasted of uncooked flour. The fried rice with egg was a little too oily, and the oil had a stale taste, as if it had been sitting in a bowl for a while. I came on a busy Sunday where turnover was high and I expected freshness.

The only dish I truly enjoyed was the stir-fried Australian lettuce. Presentation overall could also be improved—the menu pictures looked far more appealing than the dishes served. 💔
author: Monda S.

review_text: Not too bad to enjoy your fast food at this place. The serving time is fast, even during the peak hours. Food is well packed, and presented. Of course, the food is delicious!! The mac & cheese wrap is so special and tasty, really addictive! The environment is quite good, moderate noise as usual. Not so spacious, but clean. And the staffs are very polite, friendly and helpful. Just many tables are reserved, so the seats are limited.
author: grassy

review_text:
Review of McDonald’s @ VivoCity

I’m in love with the newly expanded space — it feels modern, spacious, and much more visually appealing than before. The extra room makes dining here far more comfortable, especially during peak hours.

That said, I really miss the crispy chicken burger 🍔 and the criss-cut fries. Hopefully, both make a comeback someday!
author: WanderWithWit

review_text: This is my first time I'm trying eggs paprika and bacon paprika. Very delicious and tasty. Hot caution!!
author: Yu Wei King

review_text: Used the app and ordered my breakfast but didn’t come and realised I had it at Plaza Singapura.. managed to get assistance to request for refund.
author: Kong Wen Sheng

review_text: Clean interior because it’s newly renovated unlike the one at bedok mall. Order came extremely fast (less than 5 mins wait time), also unlike the one at bedok mall where i can wait more than 1 hour for my order. Staffs are also very friendly and helpful, offered to help us clear our tray. Definitely one of the best mcdonald’s outlet i’ve patronised and will come by again!
author: Melody

restaurant_name: Seoul Garden Buffet & Seoul Garden HOTPOT - HarbourFront Centre
review_text:
I recently held an event here for about 40 people, and it was a really great experience overall! The staff were friendly, helpful, and accommodating with all our requests. The ambience was lively and comfortable — perfect for group gatherings.

A special shoutout to Rechel, the duty manager, who was very professional and attentive throughout. She made sure everything ran smoothly for our group and really went the extra mile to ensure everyone was taken care of.

The food was great — good variety, fresh ingredients, and everything was well-stocked. Everyone enjoyed the meal and had a fun time grilling and chatting.

The only downside was the Coke dispenser, which didn’t have much gas and tasted very diluted. Quite a few of us noticed it, so hopefully it can be fixed soon.

Other than that, it was an excellent experience, and I’d definitely recommend this outlet for group dining or celebrations.
author: Alex

restaurant_name: Seoul Garden Buffet & Seoul Garden HOTPOT - HarbourFront Centre
review_text:
Had a fantastic dining experience here! The spread was generous, the grill and hotpot combo is always fun — and the service truly made it memorable.

Special shout-out to Crystal, who was absolutely amazing! She’s super affable, friendly, and impressively attentive. She cleared our plates and changed our grill sheets before we even had to ask — such proactive and thoughtful service really made us feel well taken care of.

With great food and warm hospitality like this, it’s no wonder Seoul Garden has been around for over 40 years. Will definitely be back again!
author: Karen Gads About

restaurant_name: Seoul Garden Buffet & Seoul Garden HOTPOT - HarbourFront Centre
review_text:
Nice ambience ,good food.Most importantly must be freshly done and provide fresh seafoods.
Can be better with more variety of foods n desserts.
author: Yantee Sandora

restaurant_name: Seoul Garden Buffet & Seoul Garden HOTPOT - HarbourFront Centre
review_text: Winnie Sow and her team were excellent in their service. The food was great with good variety. We enjoyed ourselves very much. Thank you for this special promo for Seniors like us!
author: Lee Lee Ip

restaurant_name: Seoul Garden Buffet & Seoul Garden HOTPOT - HarbourFront Centre
review_text: A beautiful cosy restaurant to enjoy a feast of korean crusine. The presentation is impressive n the menu has most of the favourite korean items.  Good to visit place in a group so that one can order a few items n get to taste the different flavours . Recommended items are the kimchi pancake , ginseng chicken soup, hot plate spicy beef, soicy honey chicken wings, bibimbbap, japchae, army hotpot stew .  Have a feast if you enjoy hot, spicy n herbal taste food.
author: Cheong Loong

review_text: We’ve had the worst kfc egg tarts here. We usually order kfc egg tarts all around HK and SG but the batch that we ordered here was really bad. Texture and filling were not nice. A box costs 10 SGD but we couldnt really eat more than two
author: Marjon Chua

review_text: Great branch, friendly staff! Cleanliness is well-maintained. Gotten a free KFC collab w Butterbear sticker with every bfast set purchased.
author: Fidelia Fidel

review_text: We wanted to have a kfc birthday lunch for a colleague who likes kfc. We contacted kfc harbourfront city branch to make arrangement. After discussing with the area manager, Nur agreed to reserve some seats for us. Nur is very nice to help us with the arrangements. On the day of the lunch, Nur patiently took our orders and all of us enjoyed it very much. Thank you Nur !
author: lye cheng yeo

review_text:
Original chicken recipe is better.

Cereal chicken is alright.

Chilli crab mantou zinger is the best out of all the similar ones available out there. The chilli crab sauce is leans more towards the spicier side as compared to sweeter side.
author: rn_1604

review_text:
Came here for the Ghost Pepper Dunked Wings. And also challenged myself to finish the wings without any cheese sauce, water and expression to be crowned the king of Ghost Pepper Spice 🔥🔥🔥😍.

The challenge is definitely doable but the heat kicks in after a while and you need to just plough through it. Take too long and u may just crash badly.

Those who cannot take spicy better steer clear and please do not rub your eyes with your fingers if there is sauce on it ah! 😅 i think you may literally cry your eyes out 😎

If you still wanna try the heat, it may be better to go tender with the Crispy Tenders + Ghost Pepper Cheese Sauce (you can dip as much or as little sauce as your choose) or level up your snack game with Ghost Pepper Loaded Fries. These are quite safe 👍😊.
author: Kean 《keanmono IG & TT》

review_text:
The renovation is beautiful and the place has plenty of seating. However, the kaya and butter in the bread were noticeably less than other branches, and the prices were slightly higher — which is understandable since it’s a tourist spot.

What I didn’t feel comfortable with was the attitude of the cashier. When I asked to reconfirm the prices (because I wasn’t familiar with them), the response felt a bit sarcastic and unfriendly. It would be great if the service could be more welcoming, especially in such a nicely renovated location.
author: Jec

review_text:
The service staff at this branch is v efficient. The China lady taking order is able to be accurate and fast in taking orders without errors.
What impress me the most was the male staff is extremely kind too. My clumsy son spilled his egg onto the table and he immediately saw and cleaned up for him in a very patient and polite way. It's been a long time to see such good services in toast box anywhere! Made our morning a great one! He also cleans up the table immediately so that table turnover can be fast and efficient. He's a real gem to keep!
author: Jazreel Wong

review_text:
Kaya waffles is not nice... but i must say this is the first time i tried their waffle, so not sure if other outlet is better.
Coffee is good as per normal...
author: IXK

review_text: Scanned the QR code INSIDE this exact outlet to place an order. Paid $14.60 for a Milo Dinosaur, Cheesy Ham & Egg Toast, Peanut Waffle and water. Sat down, waited. Turns out the entire order was sent to Toast Box IOI — a completely different mall across town. No option to choose location in the ordering system. Staff couldn't help, couldn't care less. So somewhere in IOI Mall, a full breakfast is sitting there unclaimed, paid for by me. $14.60 gone. Fix your QR codes or at least warn people that scanning them is basically a lottery. 1 star for the air conditioning.
author: Виктор Ансельм

review_text:
Visited this outlet after revamp.

Small cup of coffee is not available, the coffee of medium size is diluted and tasteless. Hope to see improvement as we don’t mind to pay for bigger cup provided the coffee is good.

Plus point: wide variety of food choice including waffles and more spacious!
author: Celyne Liong

review_text: Had a celebratory birthday dinner at Dusk, food was superb and the service was impeccable. Notably, Mr David helped lower the fan speed when he noticed my mother feeling a little chilly. I also noticed him voluntarily offering to help take family photos, not just for us, but for every diner there. Great service and fantastic food!
author: Tan Jordan

review_text:
I recently dined at Dusk @ Mount Faber Peak, and it was a lovely experience. The sunset views from Mount Faber Peak are absolutely breathtaking, creating a romantic and relaxing atmosphere.

The service staff were warm, attentive, and professional, making us feel truly welcomed throughout the evening. We also enjoyed the Singapore Cable Car ride — it made the whole experience even more memorable, and the place is perfect for taking beautiful photos.

The food was nicely presented and enjoyable, though it could be further improved in flavor to match the amazing setting and service.

Overall, it’s a great spot for special occasions and scenic dining.
author: Wendy Ong

review_text: We really enjoyed the food the ambience the service and the view at the dinner yesterday. I didn’t realise that this is an al fresco restaurant but it was breezy clean fresh air up in the hill  w v strong fans so much so we had to ask them to reduce fan speed. Food was great. We love the appetisers ie Hokkaido scallops, foie gras and the absolutely delicious garden salad! They were the best. For the main dishes, highly rec the red snapper that has well done with a thin crispy skin and fresh soft tender meat below goes well with the tangy mango toppings. Prawn Capellini was ok, a bit bland to me I must say, while the wagyu oxtail had too much of the salty paste. We enjoyed the desserts too  ie a composite ice cream with a taste of ginger and the Guinness choc cake with a subtle taste of Guinness v interesting. I  asked for decaffeinated flat white not in the menu and they kindly obliged. Service was friendly and excellent. Great night view though sunset was blocked by a building. But overall, it was a wonderful birthday dinner. Highly rec!
author: Anna Tong

review_text:
Celebrated Mom’s 74th birthday here. 🌷🌷🌷  . Part 2. 庆祝母亲的生日🎂 . Dinner at Dusk .

First time having dinner at Dusk and we’re genuinely impressed both by the food and the portions.
All three soups : onion soup, lobster bisque & mushroom were rich, comforting & full of flavour. They came with mantou with melted cheese topping. We shared the lamb rack, steak, grilled chicken, wagyu beef burger and clam barramundi baked rice topped with bone marrow. Everything was fresh, well-executed, and seriously satisfying.
Ended the night with a citrusy, light desserts that wrapped up the meal perfectly with Mom’s chocolate birthday cake! Super delectable it!!! 🍽️✨

Service by booking officer Malar is very good who informed us about the cable car ride timing. So we managed to arrange the cable car ride before the dinner at Dusk. Good service also from Andrea restaurant manager. So we managed to do both activities !
Earlier on Part 1 ARBORA . Ice cream & Drinks . Cable Car Ride 🚡 🚠 . Mount Faber . Pokemon Theme .
#gracelyystories
author: Grace LYY

review_text:
Our main host for the dinner was Andrea and she was very accommodating with getting our cocktail request (graveyard). The graveyard was one of the best ones me and my girlfriend tasted, credits to the bartender on the 28th of Feb 2026 at 8.00pm, and the coke mixer that we requested was very generous. It was roughly 1/4 of a can, more some of the places me and my girlfriend went.

The plating of the food was very beautiful and it tasted really good. My girlfriend is not a fan of strong seafood flavours but the lobster bisque had a very nice blend of seafood and creaminess. It was so good that she had all of it. The sea urchin tagliatelle was very refreshing and light. For my girlfriend who wasn't a huge fan of sea urchin  loved the combination of flavours. The tiger prawn capellini that I had had bold southeast Asian flavours which complemented the tender tiger prawns.

Overall the dining experience was really good coupled with views of sentosa as well as the friendliness of Andrea. Will definitely come back to try more.

Edit: The shoestring fries are well seasoned and very crispy while moist. Even when the fries cooled it was still crispy. David was also very friendly, he checked up on our food experience, offered to help us to take photos and even offered to get us a small cake to celebrate our special occasion.
author: Truffles.Xenpai

review_text:
Had lunch here today, there were some hits & misses in what we ordered…so choose carefully when ordering.

Service
Order your food at the counter, when it’s ready, they’ll bring it over to your table.

Towards the end of our meal, a service staff was over zealous in clearing our dishes even though we’re not done (asked us twice). Will understand if there’s still customers waiting for a table, but this isn’t the case as there were vacant tables available.

Food
1) Kueh Pie Tee - Tasty and with a good sized prawn, a must order.
2) Nyonya Chap Chye- Nice, just a little bit too salty.
3) Pork Rib Pongteh- Nice, the sauce is great for complimenting the rice, a must order.
4) Rojak - Not bad, just a little too sweet.
5) Kueh Salat- Not so good, not sure if it’s because it’s from morning, but it was hard and dry.
6) Pineapple Tarts - The crust was hard and not buttery & the pineapple filling was not fragrant.

Prices were ok but not great value.
author: Eric Lee

review_text:
Celebrating a friend's birthday here today. We had tried almost all the recommended dishes, desserts and Kuehs.

There are hits and misses but personally I do like the Pork Ribs Pongteh, Kueh Pie Tee, Taufoo Goreng and Beef Rendang.

Staff are friendly and helpful.
author: Steven Yeo

review_text:
We went on a Saturday for lunch. It was a small eatery located beneath a block of HDB flat, with a cosy interior. However, do note that some tables are arranged very close together and we actually had someone sit right next to us during our lunch.  And when the first diner finished, another diner quickly replaced her.

We ordered nasi lemak.  The aroma of the rice was very fragrant and it came with a chicken wing, omelette and ikan bills, we added a begedil for $2. The accompanying chili is just average.  Though the smell of the rice is fragrant, the rice is not as lemak as I had expected.

We also ordered chap Chye and Ayam buah keluak with 2 nasi lemak rice.  Each rice costs $2, the same price whether you choose nasi lemak or white rice.  Chap chye is only so-so, more to the bland side.  I am a big fan of Nyonya chap chye because I love the flavour of taucheo in it but that is lacking/very faint in this dish.  The ayam buah keluak is rather good, though on the salty side.  The gravy is rich and flavourful and went really well with the rice.

The price of the beverages is very reasonable too.  They also have quite a variety of Nyonya kuehs for sale at the counter.  We bought a few of them to try and they were really very good, with the lovely aroma of Pandan and coconut.

Overall, it was just a pretty average dining experience. However, I read some great reviews of other items on the menu that I haven’t tried. Maybe I can pop by if I’m in the area to try the other dishes in future.

Parking is relatively easy at the open air HDB carpark behind the restaurant.
author: FIVE-A-DAY

review_text:
The shop is located just under an HDB block, and it’s quite clean.
I went a bit early for lunch, so there was no queue.
They serve mainly Peranakan-style dishes, and the food was really tasty.
The fish was fresh, and the desserts were also very good.
It definitely has a Malaysian touch.
The tofu with peanut sauce was especially nice, with a hint of Thai flavor.
We also ordered a salted vegetable soup, which was very comforting and delicious.
Overall, the prices are reasonable and the value for money is great.
author: Mat190 Co

review_text:
Neighborhood eatery serving Peranakan food.

Some of the dishes have delicate flavours like the Ngo Hiang. The standard serving size was a bit on the small side compared to other dishes.

Chap Chye was great with subtle twist in flavour and texture compared to other Peranakan Chap Chye.

Rojak and Tauhu Goreng was good. The prawn paste sauce was sufficiently fragrant, the soul of these dishes.

Dry Mee Siam tasted normal and forgettable.

Chendol and Bo Bo Cha Cha was good but not great. Chendol could have been more generously doused with gula melaka and more of the green chendol. Bo Bo Cha Cha was a tad too sweet.

Overall, it was a great dining experience. It's quite crowded at peak feeding hours.

Highly recommended!

👍👍

For similar Peranakan dining experience, I would also recommend Daisy's Dream Kitchen located within Temasek Club.

👍👍
author: Daniel

review_text: Thankyou so much Jess for the service! Redeemed my free pizza and everything went smooth because of you, love it! Will sure coming back to this outlet!❤️
author: Herline Tan

review_text: Had a great experience at Pizza Hut HarbourFront Centre! The food was fresh and tasty, and the service was excellent. Special thanks to Lily for her warm and friendly service - she was very attentive and made our visit extra enjoyable. Definitely recommend this outlet!
author: S D

review_text:
Visited on a Saturday around 6pm! Store was busy hence service and food was abit slow. Food came out piping hot and all was good!

The hazelnut tart was rly yummy full of nutella and it complete with the cheese.

However, I ordered the cookie with ice cream but I waited over 10 mins hence I asked to takeaway instead. But when I got home it only had the COOKIE…😭 where’s the ice cream…. It’s $7.95 or $8+ leh… I paid $8 for 1/4 of a cookie??!!! Very upset:( i threw away my receipt as well….
author: J

review_text:
Are you lack of manpower on Sunday?

Crowd situation - 4 table full that’s all

Pizza came, hit the straw from the drink cup off and fell on the table, it’s fine but staff don’t have the thoughts to replace a new one?

Ask for chili sos 2 times - I walk myself to find it’s much faster and lucky I did, it didn’t even come in the end.

Straw I had to ask 3 times from 2 different staff, only then it came.

Really? Is it that hard ?

Took a picture just to prove I dine here.
author: Ann Dee Choong

review_text: The food is good, service is good too, the supervisor named engku is very thoughtful to ask for any photos and regarding the service
author: Nurul

review_text:
I had a wonderful experience here. The service was exceptional — every staff member was enthusiastic, attentive, and genuinely warm. You could truly feel their positive energy, and it honestly seemed like they enjoy working here. The atmosphere felt welcoming and vibrant because of them.

This is by far the most satisfying restaurant service I’ve experienced in Singapore — easily comparable to a five-star hotel.

BTW their soursop juice  is the best in Singapore!
author: Kaylee Yu

review_text:
Food was amazing. Very delicious. All of the dishes were really so good! My favourite was the superior stock spinach, that was amazing. The broth was absolutely tasty and flavourful.

Service was great as well, there staff was very friendly and polite.

Overall a great dining experience.
author: SL Wong

review_text:
1st time at this branch with friends. Quality of food still on point 👍🏻 I was hoping at least they would provide fruits platter for my birthday but nothing (except member disc) 😬 Perhaps I am being too pampered at the main Kitchener branch. A little disappointed.. 😏

Pretty quiet for a Thursday evening but good for catching up with friends.
author: Liz

review_text: Honestly speaking, Putien was not the best but still  alright. The fish was very mid which was very disappointing. Ok idk why when I typing about this I feel a bit annoyed about Putien because I thought this restaurant was good. :(
author: Jaydas Yeo Le En (Aitongsch)

review_text:
Can’t go wrong with ordering their recommended dishes - Seafood Lor Mee (S) and the Sweet & Sour Pork with Lychee.

I share this with my partner and it makes for a good wholesome meal, perhaps requiring an extra side dish for bigger eaters.

This came up to ~$30 total for 2 pax, with a comfortable ambience and good service! It happened to be their 25th anniversary celebration period and we were gifted with a free Putien chilli sauce.
author: Wen

review_text: Great atmosphere and consistently quality food! My fave has got to be their fatty charsiew while the wagyu beef with fried garlic and foiegras sauce is a close second 😁
author: Xuanqiu Sun

review_text: Impeccable service from Alan, Michael and team. Dishes were cooked to perfection and value for money.
author: Christopher Toh

review_text:
I enjoyed a beautifully crafted meal at Crystal Jade Pavilion. Every dish showed finesse and premium ingredients, making the dining experience feel refined and satisfying, though prices lean towards the higher side.

1. Peking Duck Rolls

The roasted duck skin was crisp, aromatic, and full of flavour. Rolled in thin flour skins, each bite was savoury, tender, and well-balanced — a classic done exceptionally well.

2. Steamed Cod Fish with Premium Soy

The cod was incredibly fresh, buttery-soft, and delicate, with a melt-in-the-mouth texture that cod lovers will appreciate. The light soy, ginger, and scallion dressing enhanced the natural sweetness of the fish without overpowering it. A clean, elegant dish.

3. Stir-fried Scallops with Asparagus

A highlight — the scallops were plump, sweet, and perfectly seared, pairing beautifully with crunchy asparagus and wok-kissed aromatics. Well-seasoned with a subtle hint of spice.

4. Fried Tofu with Truffle Sauce

This dish was unique and delightful. The fried tofu had a crisp exterior with a soft, smooth interior. The truffle sauce added a rich, earthy aroma that elevated the entire dish. A satisfying fusion of comfort and luxury.

5. Mango Purée Dessert with Ice Cream

Thick, vibrant mango purée paired with cold ice cream made for a refreshing, tropical dessert. Smooth, bright in flavour, and a great palate cleanser.

6. Double-Boiled Hashima (雪蛤)

A nourishing and soothing traditional dessert. The hashima was well-prepared — tender and clean-tasting — with a lightly sweet, herbal broth. A calming end to the meal.

Overall, Crystal Jade Pavilion delivered excellent food quality and elegant plating. While the pricing is slightly premium, the flavours, execution, and ambience make it a worthwhile treat.
author: Jason Sim Hong Teck

review_text: The staff have been very friendly, the Tim Sum is fantastic of course quite expensive, the congee is great with the fresh fish the best is the Char Sau Pau
author: Martin Lee

review_text:
Crystal Jade at Vivocity has been consistently excellent throughout the years. There is a good variety of dimsum and ala carte dishes and we particularly liked their pencai, usually for Chinese New Year.

Their staff are always courteous, helpful and cheerful, fundamental qualities for great service!

The restaurant itself faces the sea, providing an atmosphere of serenity for the delicious food. Keep it up!
author: L Teo

review_text: Love the food here. There are many options and all are delicious, especially the Sambal chicken burger, pesto pasta(vegetarian), beef bolognese, and aglio olio. Its ambience as a vintage collector's shop is very calming. It sells many nostalgic things that were used  over 30 years ago. Also provides a wide range of drinks. The game machines add to the vintage atmosphere.
author: aikhy

review_text:
Step into the 60s–80s at this vintage restaurant 🕰️
Old-school clocks, retro decor, even classic game machines – super nostalgic vibes!

Food portion is BIG and worth it 👏
The mushroom soup is a must-try – super smooth, well blended, with a strong truffle aroma. So good!

Will definitely come back for the food and the vibes 🤎
author: Vvv Lee

review_text:
Searched for a nearby cafe and found Old Habits Cafe by chance.

Food here was decent, not the best kind but at same time find no reason to fault anything on the food, it looks simple and get the job done in taste and huge portion.

The place gives off a nostalgic vibe of old school and traditional olden times. I find this cafe cool, fun and nice to go to.

Will recommend this cafe for the simple cafe food and the old school vibes.
author: Tong Peng Tan

review_text:
Had their mushroom soup ($6.50): which has a blend of button & shiitake mushrooms with a dash of truffle oil. Mushroom flavour came through nicely — rich, earthy, & creamy, with mild truffle notes.

Wagyu beef Carbonara ($17.90) had spaghetti tossed in an egg cream sauce & topped with tender, juicy striploin beef & a poached egg. The beef was well-cooked & flavourful. (chicken thigh option available !!)

We also had Simply Salmon ($16.90): which was spaghetti done Aglio Olio-style and tossed in spicy belachan chili paste, topped with pan-seared salmon with crispy skin. The cherry tomatoes added a burst of freshness, and the rocket leaves balanced the spice. Portion was decent, with options for less spicy or non-spicy versions.

Kimchi Dumplings ($6.90) was served on a bed of greens — crisp on the outside, juicy inside, & full of that kimchi kick.

Ended off with a Honey Citron Yuzu ($4.90) drink which was lightly sweetened with a bright, prominent yuzu flavour that’s refreshing & well-balanced.

Had the privilege to be invited for their upcoming annual vintage market (@ SAFRA Multi-purpose Hall & Outdoor Areas) which honestly impressed me. 40 curated vendors, rare collectibles, retro arcade game competitions, workshops, & lots of family fun — all in one nostalgic weekend !!

You can expect unique finds — real collectors (most without physical stores) selling one-of-a-kind treasures, fun retro arcade game competitions to play classics like Street Fighter, Metal Slug & Bomberman & win attractive prizes, PLUS exclusive SAFRA membership perks!!

Not something you’d experience daily, highly recommend swinging by !! 21, 22, 23 Nov, mark your calendars noww !!
author: Sera // IG: diningwithsera

review_text:
Tried their sirloin steak, cooked nicely at medium rare — tender and enjoyable. That said, it would be great if they offered a sauce to go with it instead of just coarse salt, especially since the salt pieces were a bit too chunky. The mashed potato was quite different from the usual kind — more like a scrambled egg texture — but it actually tasted really good. Would definitely recommend ordering it as a side.

What stood out the most for me was the interior decor. The place is filled with vintage and retro items, giving off strong old-school, nostalgic vibes. I enjoyed looking through their vintage collection while waiting for the food.

Service-wise, it was just average for a cafe. The staff didn’t pay much attention to our table, even though the place wasn’t very crowded.

Overall, still a nice cafe to dine at, especially if you’re into retro vibes like I am.
author: Tan Wei Liang

review_text:
Had an amazing experience at Swensen’s Buffet in VivoCity, thanks to Philo’s outstanding service.

From the moment we were seated, he made us feel genuinely welcomed and well taken care of. His attentiveness and positive attitude truly elevated our dining experience to a five-star level.

Philo was:

Warm and friendly – greeted us with a smile and maintained a cheerful attitude throughout
Attentive and proactive – cleared plates promptly and checked in at just the right moments
Knowledgeable – explained the buffet selections clearly and gave helpful recommendations
Efficient – handled requests quickly, even during busy periods
He struck the perfect balance between being attentive and giving us space to enjoy our meal.

The buffet spread was enjoyable, with a good variety of hot dishes, sides, and desserts. However, what truly stood out was the level of service. Philo’s professionalism and genuine hospitality made the experience feel personalized rather than routine.

Great food paired with exceptional service is what keeps customers coming back, and Philo absolutely delivered. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Swensen’s Buffet at VivoCity.
author: Candy Tan

review_text:
Had a great experience at Swensen’s Unlimited @ VivoCity — one of my favourite affordable lunch buffets!

For just $35 per adult and $15 per child on weekdays, you get a generous 90-minute dining time with an impressive variety of food. I love that it includes free-flow drinks like coffee, tea, and soft drinks, plus so many different ice cream flavours and toppings to choose from.

It’s definitely a go-to spot when you don’t want to splurge but still want a satisfying buffet with good variety. Great value for money and perfect for families too!
author: Clara Lee

review_text:
Make a reservation on a weekend afternoon and waiting time is around one minute to be seated and was informed by the service staff that dining duration is 90 minutes.

At the seafood section there are prawn, flower crab, mussel, clams and half shell crayfish.

There are 24 flavours Gelato and 24 flavours ice cream.

The hand stretched pizza, roast chicken, roast beef, roast lamb, beef hor fun, laksa, chicken and mutton satay all are very nice and tasty.

At the hot section, baked crayfish, pan-seared chicken, deep fried breaded fish and boxing chicken taste good too.

There is freeflow of soft drink and coffee.

There is a salad, assorted cheese platter, assorted cold cut and condiments section.

Customer service is good as the used plates and cup are cleared in a timely manner.

Environment is cozy and spacious.

Overall experience is pretty awesome and will return to dine in again.
author: Robert Robert

review_text:
This is my second time
here and it is always a great experience. the food is getting even better especially with. special food like Prosperity Rice which I love the most. The team is always friendly and all
smile. My favorite is always tue dessert section. Wonderland for a sweet tooth like me. Kudos to Arnold and his team.
author: Ronaldo Olarte

review_text:
Woohoo, Swensen's nailed it this Ramadan! 🤩 Gave them a solid 5/5 for their buffet spread - food quality and value for money were ON POINT! 💯

The collab with Michelin-starred Chef Hafizzul was the highlight, and some dishes stole the show:
- Lemon grass stuffed chicken was 🔥
- Salmon coulibiac sambal kelapa with lodeh salmon sauce was 💣 - that combo though!
- The whole spread was super tasty and creative 👏

If you're heading to Swensen's buffet anytime soon, you know what to look out for 😋. Highly recommend!
author: Zaidil Fitrie

review_text:
love the wraps! spicy chicken wrap is super spicy, buttermilk is non-spicy and very appetising. fries super dry today, normally this outlet's fries are good.

staff as this outlet are all pretty friendly and helpful when dining in or picking up orders. prefer this outlet to the vivo.
author: Bimbles

review_text:
Chaotic energy and sadly chaotic and SLOW service. Somehow had no fries at 530PM. Delivery goods coming through front of house in middle of the dinner rush whilst the floor is wet.

Waited 20 mins for food in a half empty FAST food restaurant. Food ended up cold by the times they got the fries ready.

Warning: not ideal if you are in a rush
author: J

review_text:
At 9:25 AM, I ordered my breakfast meal using the McDonald’s app. I noticed there were many people here, and I found my own table number.

After placing my order, I received my meal within 15 minutes — acceptable, considering it was a busy morning.

The meal was hot and tasted great.

Thank you to the McDonald’s team and staff — good job!
author: Uncle Weng随意拍

review_text:
Double Prosperity beef burger is the best.

McCrispy signature is alright. The 1990s McCrispy is still the best.

Mala Chicken McCrispy and corn pie are not bad. Mala isn’t as spicy though. Potato pops are so-so only.

Curry McNuggets are quite underwhelming. Curry flavour is really light.

1 star as this outlet isn’t able to cope with promotional period overload ($1 coffee).

Chilli crab sauce is not bad, towards the sweet side.

McCrispy is ok. Nothing special about it.

Crinkle cut fries are good! Crispy and buttery.

Spicy chicken tender is not bad.
author: rn_1604

review_text: Clean place the chicken was juicy and crispy better than kfc.
author: Wil H

review_text:
We had a pleasant stay at Amara Singapore from check in to check out.
It is located in what we were told was the CBD area so there are lots of businesses, hotels, shops nearby. It is on a busy street lined with cafes, restaurants, etc.
The metro/train station (Tangar Pagar) is about 5mins walk from the hotel & we felt very safe in the neighbourhood as 2 ladies walking/strolling after hours.

Our room was spacious & comfortable!

The breakfast buffet has a varied selection. Keith & Kenny were a delight to speak with.
The staff were friendly & eager to assist.
author: J E

review_text:
I stayed at Amara for 3 nights with my 71 year old father and kids (5 and 3 years). We arrived at 8 am because our flight came in super early and the front desk manager, Muzafiru, hooked us up with an early check in. It was greatly appreciated as we were tired from 22 hours of travel so thanks for the excellent service.

Hotel rooms were clean, water pressure in the shower was fantastic, and kids can bathe in the big bathtub. The toilets have fancy bidets where the seat is nice and warm. AC worked well and was able to keep the room nice and cool.

We got a room with the Club Lounge access and it was nice having the option at various times for drinks and snacks.

The pool was kid friendly with towels provided at the bar area next to the pool.

The breakfast buffet had a wide selection - a bread/pastry area, salad, fruit, yogurt, and hot food covering western (bacon, sausage, baked beans), Asian (steamed sticky rice/buns, congee), and Indian options. There was also a soup noodle station where you could pick thick or thin noodle.

Location is great. Easy walk to Maxwell and rest of Chinatown. Short Grab ride to Gardens by the Bay. There’s also a bus stop right in front. There’s an unaffiliated laundry spot right across the street to do large amounts of laundry (especially important for long trips).
author: Charles Chiang

review_text: Wonderful experience.  Most importantly a staff went out of his way to help with conversion of money through a kiosk in the hotel. Taxi was waiting to be paid,  he was a great help. Good rooms, good breakfast. It can be busy sometimes but overall nice staff, rooms, food.
author: Rajkiran Kanagala

review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Amazing Stay at Amara Hotel!

We had a fantastic experience at Amara Hotel!

The staff and managers were extremely kind, helpful, and genuinely cared about making our stay comfortable. Their hospitality truly stood out.

We booked 3 Club Rooms and really enjoyed the extra perks , access to the Club Lounge, evening high tea, complimentary minibar, and laundry service. These little details made our stay even better!

After a not-so-great experience at a different hotel, Amara Hotel turned everything around for us. The service was smooth, the atmosphere was relaxing, and we left with great memories.

Highly recommend this hotel for a delightful and comfortable stay! 👏😊
author: Dhavalkirti Lamghare

review_text:
We had a fantastic stay at the Amara Singapore! The rooms were excellent, including the shower rooms with a combined shower and bath. They were new and modern, spotless and very well maintained. We were so grateful that the hotel managed to place our room right next door to the kids, which made our family trip so much easier.
The location is superb—it’s just a short walk to both the Maxwell and Tanjong Pagar MRT stations, and there are countless great restaurants right on the doorstep. The service overall was great. While the laundry was a little slow, Petey in reception deserves a huge shout-out; he always made us feel incredibly welcome and went above and beyond to assist us.

Note for the hotel: While everything else was perfect, the pool and gym areas felt a little dilapidated and the lighting around the pool at night was limited. A little refresh of these areas would make this hotel truly perfect.
We would definitely recommend the Amara and look forward to returning!
author: Steve Miller

review_text:
This is a great hotel it is very close to public transportation, hawker markets, restaurants and Chinatown. The hotel itself is very clean, the front desk staff is inviting and knowledgeable of the area. The pool is beautiful. There is an inside and outdoor gym and a very nice roof top bar.
The only downside of this hotel for me is that there is clear glass between the bathroom and the bedroom so there is no privacy when someone is using the bathroom.
author: Foodie Girl

review_text:
We just spent 8 nights here.  After previously staying at their sister hotel on Bras Basar road we decided a change of location was in order.  Right from our arrival at 7pm we were treated with respect,  politeness and an attitude that 'nothing was a proplem'.  Mai on the front desk was exceptional assisting us with any request we made. She always ensured our requests were actioned promptly and always with a smile. Thank you Mai.
The team in the Cooling Tower Bar were also very attentive. On the first night we decided to venture up there for a look & drink - the guys were extremely helpful.  The next time we headed up for a drink  they welcomed us like long lost family & we felt very special.
The hotel  location is perfect - close to Tanjong Pagar MRT (2mins walk) and Chinatown & Maxwell Hawker Centre close by. We think the special point of interest is that accross the road is a local shopping centre with numerous family operated restaurants plus a supermarket. We ate at the restaurants often trying each one offering different national dishes plus mingling with the locals who live in the 6 Housing Towers. It was safe & we felt good supporting the locals. Great vibe night & day.
We would recommend Carlton City Hotel for its location,  service & amenities. A hotel we would choose if we return to SG.

Anne- Marie & Micheal Rumbles
QLD Australia
author: Anne-Marie Rumbles

review_text:
One of the best hotels we’ve ever stayed in! The rooms are spacious with plenty of luggage storage, a great shower with strong water pressure/sealed well & doesn’t leak, and even a bathtub in the room.

Everything is exceptionally clean, the bed is very comfortable, and housekeeping is both thorough and timely. The reception staff are friendly and very accommodating, and the rooms are quiet with minimal noise.

The lobby is beautiful, and they even offer umbrellas for guests to borrow. There’s a Fairview Supermarket right across the street for quick grocery, fruits, or toiletry runs. A short walk takes you to a mall with a food court/bakeries, MRT station nearby, and the local Tangong Hawker Center on the 2nd floor.

The location is fantastic with most major attractions just 10 minutes away by Grab, or about a 10-minute walk to Chinatown. There’s parking and a driveway area for easy Grab pickup/drop offs.

It honestly can’t get much better than this! There’s both an indoor and outdoor gym, a large pool, good views, and room service/restaurant. Plus there’s a faucet with filter water to help reduce plastic use!
author: Hong Ly

review_text: Enjoyed a 4 night stay here in late January. It was good value, we booked a Deluxe room and it is as you would expect, clean and decent size but nothing special. I enjoyed using the pool and outdoor gym in the morning, they were never busy. Rooftop bar is ok - good view but the drinks are quite expensive, around 20SGD for a beer.
author: Jack

review_text:
My Stay at Carlton City Hotel Singapore

I had a great time at Carlton City Hotel Singapore. The WiFi in-room was strong and worked smoothly the whole stay. Check-in was fast and easy, with no fuss or delays. The hotel’s location near MRT and city transport made getting around simple and convenient.

The restaurants and bars at the hotel were solid. I enjoyed good food, and the vibe was pleasant. The hotel also offers a well-equipped gym, which was nice for workouts. There’s an outdoor pool available too. I didn’t use it this trip, but it looked scenic and relaxing, definitely a spot I’d check out next time. And the rooftop bar / lounge gave nice evening vibes and a good setting to unwind.

I’ve got to say: since it was my birthday during the stay, I got a complimentary pastry from staff a thoughtful touch that made the stay feel more personal. Also, funny little detail: there was a visible “no durian fruit” sign. I didn’t know about durian until I got a whiff now totally understand why they forbid it.

Overall: clean, modern rooms; friendly, professional staff; good amenities; excellent location. I’d absolutely stay at Carlton City Hotel Singapore again.
author: Randy Bell

review_text:
Stopped by McDonald’s at SpringLeaf Tower for an afternoon coffee break, and it turned out to be a practical and comfortable place to take a short rest. Compared to busier mall outlets, this branch felt relatively calm, making it easier to sit down and unwind for a while.

The coffee was exactly what you’d expect from McDonald’s — consistent, smooth, and very good value for money. It’s not meant to be artisanal or fancy, but it works perfectly when you just need a reliable caffeine fix without overthinking it. Seating was comfortable enough for a quick break, checking messages, or simply relaxing before heading off again.

Service was efficient and fuss-free, with orders prepared quickly and staff being polite and professional. Overall, a convenient and no-frills spot for a casual coffee stop in the area.
author: Crumpled Nomad

review_text: One of my go-to McDonald's drive-thru spots! Conveniently located near the expressway, it's perfectly situated for my daily commute - whether I'm heading to my old workplace or heading home. Quick, easy, and always a lifesaver!
author: Low Bao Heng

review_text: felt like a big back and decided to come here the cheese burger patty was dry and i ordered a strawberry sundae with extra strawberry but they said they didnt have strawberry sauce even tho i ordered extra, i asked for refund,they didnt give me
author: livvy

review_text: Ordered the 2pcs chicken meal. Chicken came hot, crunchy, juicy. And unlike the spicy one. Wasn’t too salty and the taste of the normal flavour is more balanced. But the queue on a Thursday lunchtime is just far too long!  The problem is it’s too popular for its own good, probably down to it’s the only McDonald in downtown area.
author: michael lin

review_text: Near my hotel so I went here multiple times because it was convenient, but definitely not because it was good. Food was much worse than most other McDonald’s I have been to. Had Belgian waffles that were rock hard and chicken was terrible. Fries and ice cream were the only decent things to eat. Bathroom was terrible even for a McDonald’s. Urine all over the floor and seemed no one had cleaned it for a long time.
author: Wes Brown

review_text:
Light Peranakan food. if you're looking for the super rich, intensive style Peranakan food, this is not the place for you.

The Blue Ginger serves good Peranakan Food that is light and not too heavy on the stomach. Wait staff are also very attentive and friendly.

the food that stood out were the wing bean salad, otak and keuh pie tee. would not recommend the beef rendang as the rempah is not authentic, while the meat is very tender.
author: Tan Chun Hao

review_text:
📍 Overall: 4.5/5
traditional Peranakan dishes in a cozy place, well deserved Michelin restaurant. Not sure if there's a level 2 for customers but I've seen people going upstairs through a door.
Everything is great but the white rice dried very quickly while we are eating, there goes the 0.5 points. Hopefully, they can improve on the rice.

Kueh Pie Tee 5/5
- great to start off with, and would want to eat more if my stomach wasn't that full.

Ayam Panggang "Blue Ginger" 5/5
- must have!! Their signature dish, very delicious.

Chap Chye 4/5
A little spicy but goes well with rice.

Beef Rendang 4/5
I don't eat spicy but this is okay to have with rice.
author: Owena

review_text: The taste of the peranakan food were lack of wow-effect. Could have done better as it rated Michelin Bib Gourmand. The chendol was outrightly disappointing as well. Hope to see improvement on the next visit.
author: NeeKeng Tan

review_text: My wife and I brought 8 of my friends to Blue Ginger at Tanjong Pagar for dinner. Everyone was greatly impressed by the ambience of the place and the excellent service of Mr Lee, Min & Zoe & team. The food was awesome. Will highly recommend this place to all my friends!
author: Chin Kiat

review_text:
We ordered 2 portions for certain dishes but did not enjoy that they combine the portions together.
Food was just alright as there are better ones out there.
Nothing I can woah about at Blue Ginger but just the price a bit too steep.
author: iRene cHoo

review_text:
Reserved the last star until I go back for the Pizza.
We took the recommendation and tried the pasta, it is surprisingly light on the palate. The tomahawk pork was perfectly cooked. Love the portobello mushroom and the grilled squid too.

Great atmosphere, cozy place and a very attentive crew.
author: Elaine Seng

review_text:
We came for the keto meals. Had the keto garlic bread, chicken curry puff and vegetarian pizza. The pizza’s crust is think like a tortilla wrap, not much flavor. The curry puffs were more flavorful. Their keto brownie and ice cream was the best item we ordered that day!

We came on Valentine’s Day for dinner. Very busy day so the service was not very attentive but acceptable.
author: Pearline Johnson

review_text: Cosy environment with attentive staff. Food is good - seafood stew and duck ragu pasta recommended. Had one of the best keto cake!
author: Hui Fen Chua

review_text:
I've not let myself eat pizza, garlic bread, and pasta for the past 13 years... Until now. Getting to eat all these, keto, hot, piping, crispy and delicious for my birthday made me very, very, very happy. 🎂🎈🥳🤤
Also, today I relearnt how to eat pasta, and found out what a dutch baby pancake is. Damns.
author: Raymond Leung

review_text: Was here with my family for  a special occasion  , and I must say this is a gem of a place ( it is  co-located with pasta brava) !! From the ambience to the extensive food and drinks menu that can cater for all palates - non vegetarian , vegetarian , western , Asian fusion, and most importantly keto !!! It’s amazing how from their starters , to main courses , to desserts and drinks - they have keto options for all !!!had the Keto white sangria , Berries cookies and cream , the keto vegetarian burger sliders and the eggplant with parmesan cheese . It was really awesome and yummy - I didn’t feel like I was deprived of good food at all !!! :) Sofi , the owner of this place - came to speak to us to ask us how the dishes were and was so warm and happy to explain things to us which made our dining experience even more pleasurable :) and every single member of her sofi cafe team who worked here on 9 Feb 2023 evening was all smiles and so service orientated ( sorry I was unable to catch all their names ) . Eric who attended to us was very warm. Highly recommended for food , drinks , service and ambience . Recommended for birthdays , anniversaries , normal occasions , with family and kids too !!
author: Astra 08

review_text:
The last time we came here to eat is 2 years ago. Today came back again and found a not so “new” dish, which is the Mala La Zi Gu🤭.

The food quality still the same from 2 years ago. It is so good! We are happy with every dishes and my favourite is the Mala La Zi Gu, 🤯the taste really like lazij.. best la!

Their service is good too! 👍🏻👍🏻 Which is rare to see in sg nowadays.

Will visit again!
author: QT

review_text:
First time trying out the restaurant. All the dishes we ordered were delicious: sweet & sour pork, sambal kangkang, olive fried rice, and rendang. Including two hot drinks, the total cost was about $100-$110. Not cheap but the quality of the food was good. Service was great too. Furthermore, we enjoyed the “homely” ambience :)
👍
author: Joseph Lum

review_text:
Dinner at Whole Earth. Didn’t expect vegetarian to be of such high quality, definitely lived up to the Michelin Bid Gourmand recommendation.

The food here were flavorful, taste and quality were on point with all the correct flavors. We especially love the Penang Rendang, the Sambal King and the Olive rice. The other dishes we ordered such as the Enchanted Forest and Nonya Curry were deserving as well.

Service here was prompt and the staff here were especially friendly. Definitely worth a revisit in the future and will recommend this place for vegetarian food.
author: Tong Peng Tan

review_text: Came here for reunion lunch with my family! We enjoyed the hearty and wholesome vegetarian food! The yusheng was especially refreshing and appetising!
author: Digime

review_text:
Lunch dated 29 November 2025 with my mom.
As a person with a carnivorous appetite, I seldom would eat vegetarian food and the only vegetarian dish that I usually exposed to will be vegetarian mee hoon.

Other than the price point was slightly higher, every dishes were executed very well.

Achar (picked vegetables), this was something I would usually avoid. Tried the version here and was amazed by the taste. A very good appetiser to kick start my appetite.

Yam ring was another dish that I don't really fancy because can't finish alone and the dish usually came in big serving. This one was different, small enough to share for 2-3 pax. Every mouthful was sticky and thick. This one definitely used a lot of yam raw ingredient and little to no flour.

The thai sweet and sour delight was a vegetarian version of sweet and sour pork. This dish was really delicious. It tasted better than some real meat dish cooked in the same style.

Penang rendang was shitake mushroom cooked with herbs and spices. This was delicious as well. The marination was excellent.

XO fried rice had wok hei infused in it. The taste was palatable as well. 10 x better than the one I had at redhill mrt yesterday.

Refill of plain water was also quite timely. Good service.

This will be one of my go-to vegetarian restaurants for special occasions.
author: Leonard Chong

review_text:
The tables placement and the way they serve food is really lousy. We were seated at the most outer table next to the buffet line and we have to stand up and give way to the staff pushing the food trolley to get to the most inner table.
We had buffet. Food variety is soso. Not worth the money unless you can eat many xiaolongbao which is unlimited order. Don't get the free flow beverage option too unless you love sweet drinks. The free flow drinks only has few options - milk tea, coffee, peach, Musk melon, mango pomelo. All super sweet. We came on a weekday lunch with less than 10 tables occupied yet we saw every table has their own soup base kettle for self refill.
author: Iris Leong

review_text:
pretty good variety of choices on the buffet menu! its individual hotpot style so everybody gets to choose their own soup base.

the prawns here are decently sized as compared to other buffets!
also the soup dumplings here is very good!

downside was our soup bases took some time to be served (group of 6pax), anything ordered through the system took time so press first, place was only about 30% filled so was not expecting the long wait)
author: Bimbles

review_text:
Having such big feast at this place with poly friends part of early Christmas mini gathering for first time.
Marvellous with variety of food options to end with satisfied tummy.
Would love to come back for such meal again if have opportunity chance.
author: Qizhuang

review_text:
The food selection is quite decent. There are two options available: a one-time payment for buffet-style steamboat, or a set meal.
For beverages, we opted for the free-flow option, priced at $2.90 or $3.90. The pricing also includes a sauce bar, similar to HDL’s setup.
We chose the set meals (come with individual hotpot) and ended up paying $38.60+ per person.
The environment is cozy, making it a great spot for large group gatherings.
author: KY Chow

review_text: Everything was good and staffs are friendly. Best is the xiao long bao. Took more then 46 of it.
author: LYS Lee

review_text:
Our go-to spot for an affordable and delicious bowl of chicken ramen in Singapore.

Each bowl comes with a whole chicken leg, but we personally prefer the tender chicken chashu. They’re happy to replace the leg with four slices of chicken chashu, which we really appreciate.

For the ramen, I find the noodles have a slightly alkaline taste, so I usually opt for the tsukemen instead, though my family still enjoys the ramen. The tsukemen noodles are thicker, chewier, and much cleaner in taste, making them more enjoyable for me.

I also love that they provide complimentary hard-boiled eggs and marinated bean sprouts, which is a really nice touch.

Overall, great value, generous portions, and a reliable choice whenever we’re craving comforting chicken-based ramen.
author: Clara Lee

review_text: Ramen noodles and the soup were very delicious. The chicken tasted like frozen meat - dry and tasteless. There were free hard boiled eggs and seasoned bean sprouts. Service was bare minimal, merely putting orders on our table, hardly justifying the service charge.
author: CK C

review_text: Ramen broth is rich and creamy, grilled chicken thigh adds to oiliness, free flow beansprouts, hard boiled eggs, and variety of seasoning such as kombu vinegar available to customise the taste. Order via an order sheet to have the ramen cooked to your preferences. Kids eat free (1 for every regular ramen ordered) though the portion is unlikely to satisfy older kids.
author: Jerald Ici

review_text: This place offers chicken broth based ramen and since I like chicken and ramen so I gave it a try - it was surprisingly quiet during dinner time. I should have taken that as a signal to its food but anyway I chose the wasabi ramen as I like wasabi in my food. Firstly, it looked like someone smothered the chicken with toothpaste, looks unappealing and taste worse than the look. The soup was super oily, chicken was dry and everything in the soup is in a battle with eachother. The chicken charsiew was nice and so is the egg. The service or the lack of service is also a problem. I feel that Keisuke must be treating its staff poorly for many of its branches have unhappy staff.
author: Star Carter

review_text:
