review_text: Excellent deal when they are offering their one-for-one specials, and probably still worth it without. Fish and shellfish cookery was as good as it gets. Would give it 5 stars if the wine prices were a little less steep.
author: justin goh

review_text:
This is Singapore’s only Sicilian restaurant and serves only 2 types of Omakase menu to keep the quality consistent.

Thanks to Mahes and crew who takes time to explain and introduce the dishes and wine tasting!

For reservation, call or via web. The restaurant is towards the end of Tras Street.

⭐️ The wines are very good and very good price.
author: Isaac Ho

restaurant_name: Kinki Restaurant + Bar - Japanese Fusion @ Customs House
review_text:
Came for the bottomless brunch and boy! its good. One time main Wagyu Foei Gras was succulent and melts in your mouth packed with umami taste. The sashimi was fresh.  Fried items were not too oily and the sushi great also. Their sushi rice is not cold which is what I preffered cos it reminds me of omakase freshly kneaded sushi with chef hands. Edamame was strangely addictive even though I'm not a fan of edamame. Rare to be able to find these kind of bottomless brunch at this quality for the price point. Service from all the servers were very good also as they kept checking on us if we were alright or needed anything else. Shout out to MK for serving us that day hehe.

Environment and ambience was beautiful also with MBS view!
author: Wayne Yip

restaurant_name: Kinki Restaurant + Bar - Japanese Fusion @ Customs House
review_text: I am a repeat visitor in Kinki and have been patronising for as long as I can remember. I do recommend lunches dinners either for business or casual. Ambience and food quality is superb. The YuSheng we had at that price is with good quality sashimis.
author: Salinah Sarbini

restaurant_name: Kinki Restaurant + Bar - Japanese Fusion @ Customs House
review_text:
The place is very aesthetic, the staff are all very friendly and polite with good service.
I went here with my friend and we ordered quite alot. We got the tacos and chawamushi for appetizers, and the sashimi scallops, we added on salmon and tuna sashimi afterwards.
For the main we ordered the steak and sushi rolls, we got the lobster chaser and cucumber prawn roll as well as a soft shell crab roll.
The view is amazing, u can see the whole view of the sea and Marina bay sands across, when it's dark it's even nicer at night with all the lights!
Highly recommend to come with friends and family!!
author: Dione Ding

restaurant_name: Kinki Restaurant + Bar - Japanese Fusion @ Customs House
review_text: Went here for the view and it did not disappoint. Happy hour was okay but the service was very lacking. The servers did not take our order until I went up to them and asked them to do so. Our order was forgotten for more than thirty minutes and they had to be reminded about it. They forgot our napkins despite us reminding them for it. I can go on and on. Truly, this place has potential but they need to step up their service levels.
author: Niharika Kohli

restaurant_name: Kinki Restaurant + Bar - Japanese Fusion @ Customs House
review_text:
we had the weekend brunch buffet ($68) with free flow alcohol ($38) which was amazing value!

food was alright but what blew us away (other than the attractive price point) was the top notch service. there was never an empty glass as the service staff diligently made their rounds to top up our glasses! generous pours too.... on the last round our waitstaff painstakingly ensured each glass was practically overflowing. really service oriented!!! very impressed

food was also served fast and furious with minimal wait time.

taste wise, the mains were mid i heard (actually my main didn't come but i was too full anyway) but i enjoyed the tempura shishamo that was fillllled with roe. fried well and served hot so the bones were not prickly. pitan tofu can never go wrong too. spicy tuna maki was our fave of the makis. we also had many rounds of sashimi
author: Nic

review_text:
Palm Beach is truly a must-visit restaurant in Singapore. We had the opportunity to try their traditional crab dishes, and it was an unforgettable experience from start to finish.
The staff welcomed us beautifully and patiently showed us how to properly enjoy these large crabs, which made the entire meal even more special. The food was absolutely extraordinary, after the very first bite, we knew this was a dish we would remember for a long time.
Everything was prepared to perfection, rich in flavor and authentic. The service was impeccable; the team was warm, attentive, and genuinely kind to us throughout the evening.

Nothing but praise and compliments, without a doubt, one of the best meals we’ve had in Asia.
author: Aneta Goranovic

review_text: Loved the sashimi lobster here; super fresh. We also enjoyed the Marina Bay Sands hotel view. The restaurant is spacious and comfortable, and the staff were very helpful, explaining the dishes and giving great recommendations. The chili crab was fantastic. Overall, a great dining experience; not to be missed! 😋
author: Aaron

review_text:
This place is located at the front of the marina bay and facing the Merlion. It is located right at the hottest landmark in Singapore. It serves the most popular dish in Singapore - chilly crabs. It is one of the best places for chilly crabs and black pepper crab other than Jbo and Long Beach. Food is 5/5.

The service is also great. The waitresses are attentive to the need of the customers. 5/5.

The decoration is typical for a Chinese restaurant. The lighting can address better indoor while outdoor patio area is great. it is located near Marina Bay Sands. 5/5.
author: Kelvin Wong

review_text: Palm Beach Seafood has a great location, literally right in front of the Merlion, and the atmosphere is clean and inviting. We tried their famous black pepper crab (market price – today it was $174). The crab was delicious and flavorful, but honestly, it had a bit too much pepper and was quite spicy, which may not be for everyone. Also, for the price, there wasn’t as much crab meat as we expected. On the positive side, the seafood fried rice was excellent and complemented the meal nicely. Overall, still a good dining experience, but with a few things that could be improved.
author: Emma Yuko CALIFORNIA WAX STUDIO

review_text:
Chilli crab is fresh but the chilli crab sauce tasted very normal. Salted crab sauce is nicer. Duck has tasty roasted flavor but is a bit dry.. not that juicy n tender.
Fried butter buns a must order for dipping and eaten with the sauce.
author: Mee Mo

restaurant_name: Shin Minori Japanese Restaurant @ UE Square
review_text:
First time trying out Japanese buffet at Shin Minori
Didn't expect the taste is so good for some dishes!! Especially the sushi rice and sashimi, is a must to order 😍👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻, but for the yakimono (grilled meat) is abit too salty for me. The udon and soba dipping sauce is abit bland too if they can add abit strong taste in the sauce will be much better. The mochi dessert is a must to order! Very light and oishii when u eat the mochi! I prefer the strawberry! My bf prefer the mango! But the green one taste like grass 😂... And when u ate it doesn't feel too heavy at all. Overall the service is good and fast. Birthday lunch buffet 1 for 1 really worth it 😋 will come back again for sure!
author: でぶでぶ顔Joey

restaurant_name: Shin Minori Japanese Restaurant @ UE Square
review_text:
Was here for our CNY reunion meal and it turned out to be the perfect venue for it! The Japanese high tea buffet really impressed everyone at the table.
The sashimi selection was incredibly fresh and absolutely delicious — beautifully sliced, vibrant, and clearly high quality.
The grilled items were just as memorable. The yaki gyu was tender, juicy, and had that lovely smoky char that made it so satisfying. The yaki mekajiki (grilled swordfish) was gorgeous — flaky, well-seasoned, and cooked just right.
We ended on a sweet note with fresh fruits, ice cream and soft, chewy mochi desserts, which were light and refreshing after such a hearty spread.
Great food, relaxed atmosphere, and perfect for catching up over a long high tea session. Would definitely come back again! 🍣

Classic Omizu High Tea Buffet Price:
3:00pm - 5:45pm (Last order: 5:15pm)
​Saturday- Sunday, Public Holiday
Adult S$45.90++*
Child S$35.90++
author: L Chen

restaurant_name: Shin Minori Japanese Restaurant @ UE Square
review_text: The menu offers a good variety, so much so that unless you’re a big eater, it’s almost impossible to try everything in one visit. Overall food quality was decent. Our favourites were the grilled dishes. It was well seasoned, flavourful and meat that was tender. The sashimi quality was acceptable enough to enjoy. Service was efficient too, food arrived within minutes of ordering and empty plates were cleared promptly, making the whole dining experience smooth and enjoyable.
author: Madeleine Tan

restaurant_name: Shin Minori Japanese Restaurant @ UE Square
review_text: Came to celebrate a birthday here.  The food here is great! The sashimi was fresh and delicious, and have many buffet items to choose from. Every dish is good and come with free flow of cold and hot drinks, and ice cream too!  Service was pleasant and the atmosphere was comfortable. Thank you for the great meal!
author: Choo Wee Liang

restaurant_name: Shin Minori Japanese Restaurant @ UE Square
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5

Shin Minori has officially ruined other buffets for me,in the best way possible. The sashimi was so fresh I’m convinced it swam onto my plate voluntarily. For the price and the spread, it's really worth travelling all the way down! All the food are freshly cooked and fresh, please try their taco sushi and grilled head salmon. Chef kissed!!

The staff were super friendly and kept the food coming like they were invested in my happiness (which they were, because I left *very* happy and *very* full).

If you see me there again,I’m just “inspecting the quality” for the 10th time🤣! Highly recommended!
author: Josephine Chen

review_text: I like the don buri, tastes as good as the pic looks. My kid had tonkatsu curry, curry it is too sweet. Softshell crab is quite good, fresh and crunchy. We ordered special menu pork belly to share, quite pricey for one piece of belly. Our 3 main courses served separately over 20 mins, quite slow :(
author: wei K

review_text:
The Sashimi Moriwase and Aburi Mentaiko Jumbo Prawn are hallmarks of this place.

The seafood soup is also great.

Squeeze the lime in.

It rivals its opponent opposite.

The one I grew up on.

The one I’ve been trained to love.

Over 25 years.

The same thing.

Again.
Again.
Again.
And again.

This comes close.

Much potential here once ratios and sauces are adjusted for cooked dishes.

Some more so than others.

The front-desk staff at this hotel are pleasing to the eye.

They look so happy to be working there.

Wow.

I’d take them anytime.

It is really pleasing to see.
author: 4vi31t

review_text:
Quite an affordable à la carte Japanese buffet, it came to around $50 per person after +++.

There’s a moderate variety of sashimi, sushi, grilled items, and more. The grill dishes took a while to arrive on the first order, but everything tasted good overall. Each table also gets a complimentary fish head dish and a delicious grilled mentaiko prawn per person. Free-flow ice cream is a nice touch too!

Service was prompt and friendly. The staff regularly topped up our tea and checked in on us. The restaurant is about a 10-minute walk from the nearest MRT station. Décor wise it looks a bit dated, but it’s still clean and comfortable.
author: Deming

review_text:
The dishes were fresh, the staff were friendly and served tea promptly whenever our glasses were empty. However, some dishes took quite a long time to be served though.
The variety of food is good, from sushi, sashimi, maki, handroll to tempura and miso, chawanmushi and cold noodles.
The tables were very close to each other so it was a little cramped.  Other than that all was good.
author: Natalie lim

review_text: I feel this is a very underrated Japanese buffet restaurant. The sashimi was fresh, no weird taste or making your tongue itchy. A lot of varieties of food.
author: Anne Thymotie

review_text:
Cozy, festive vibes in a timeless setting. This place instantly puts you in a celebratory mood, the atmosphere is lively yet relaxed, with a vintage classic interior full of character. It's very photogenic too, from the warm lighting to retro details that make every corner Instagram worthy.

The food is flavorful, and excellent. Paired with a solid wine selection that complements nicely. Our server was also genuine in conversation and made us feel like valued guests right from the start, and has a personal touch that turns a good dinner into a memorable one.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for tasty food in a charming, feel good spot. We'll definitely be back!
author: Ylee

review_text:
Brasserie Gavroche is a gem for authentic French dining. The onion soup was rich and comforting, perfectly balanced in flavor. The oysters were incredibly fresh, a true highlight of the meal. I especially enjoyed the sole fish, which came with a refreshing sauce that lifted the dish beautifully. The lobster pie with bisque was outstanding—creamy, flavorful, and indulgent in the best way.

The atmosphere is warm and inviting, making it a great spot for both casual dinners and special occasions. Highly recommend for anyone craving classic French cuisine done right.
author: Jiak Pa Liao

review_text: Ordered pan seared foie gras, scallops and bone marrow for starters. Foie Gras is rly good and scallops is tasty. Bone marrow portion is a bit small but tastes delicious still. Mains I ordered lamb chops and duck confit, duck if a bit dry and for lamb chops, 1 is bland and the last one is too salt. Overall service is rly good and so is the atmosphere, perfect for romantic date
author: Jason Z

review_text: Went for a birthday dinner and it turned out to be the best dining experience. The wine the staff recommended suits us. We liked both the foie gras and beef. The red wine sauce for the beef was sooo good, really enhanced the flavour. Thanks to Michael (not sure how to spell) for his friendliness in recommending dishes and chatting!
author: Shu Wei

review_text: Came here for a belated Valentine’s day lunch and were very impressed - this place ticks all your boxes: great ambience, friendly service, delicious food and good portions. Make sure to leave space for dessert! The profiteroles were amazing! If you’re looking for your next date night/special occasion celebration, this should be your top choice. Looking forward to returning and trying other items on their menu!
author: Chitra Karamchandani

review_text: It was a great CNY team lunch at Grand Shanghai restaurant. The food is good especially crispy smoked duck, fried rice and smoked fish dumpling are recommended. The live performance with CNY song is entertaining. Staff Amy & Apple are very attentive and friendly, kudos to their excellent service!
author: KevKek

review_text:
Love the yusheng here, very well seasoned. Crab tofu was my favourite dish, super yummy!!

Very attentive and good service here by all staff. They even gave us a rose for Valentine’s Day. The manager David was very entertaining 🤣
author: X

review_text: Food here is okayish. But what really stands out is the service. I've never had better service elsewhere. Staff was polite and constantly changed out the dirty plates. There was live singing performance so that's unique.
author: Leviathan 14

review_text: Awesome service provided by Hui Tong! The entire dining experience was really elevated because of her. Extremely attentive and friendly. Food and ambience is great as usual.
author: Valen Chia

review_text:
Amazing wedding reception, they took care of everything and ensured everyone had a good time.

Authentic cantonese style restaurant. Thank you for having us!
author: Janan (Puzzle Lover)

review_text: Panicked about Ikoi’s future when news came about Hotel Miramar’s closure so we quickly made a reservation. The last time we checked it seems like the restaurant will remain open, not closing or relocating (yet). Ikoi is practically an institution when it comes to great, affordable Japanese food - especially the fresh sashimi and salmon skin temaki
author: everlydaydream

review_text: Heard about this Japanese buffet for many years but didn't try until I heard the news that Miramar hotel is closing. Quickly made a booking and went to try their buffet. Very cosy atmosphere. The selection of food is quite good and I tried like a good 40% of the items on the menu. The salmon skin wrap is my favourite dish. The sashimi is really fresh too. I hope they will be able to continue their business or at least reopen at another location one day. All the best.
author: Vincent Ong

review_text:
Decided to visit Ikoi Japanese Restaurant since it was closing down (or possibly moving soon). After trying the food, I can honestly say, good riddance.
The sashimi wasn’t even fresh. It was served warm instead of chilled. The shishamo was a disaster, cold inside and clearly not grilled properly. The yakitori was cold, bland, and with zero charred flavour. Even the udon managed to be bland beyond belief. It honestly felt like the chef had already checked out long ago.

By the end of the meal, I came to one conclusion: this place should market itself as a slimming and detox program rather than a restaurant. If you’re looking for flavour or quality, forget it. But if you want a punishment diet that’ll make you rethink every life choice leading you here, then by all means, give it a shot before it closes down.

Even if it were free, I wouldn’t step foot in here again.
author: Ming Shen Tham

review_text: wrost buffet in Singapore. Nothing to choose. $70++ per pax. Some of dishes only service single time. $210++ for nothing. They only serve heavy food make you quick full. This price actually can have many nice buffets at other places.
author: Rebecca Wang

review_text:
If you have fond childhood memories of Ikoi, I would recommend keeping them as memories rather than revisiting for a final hurrah, given the impending closure of Hotel Miramar.

The restaurant was severely understaffed during my visit, and while the waitstaff did their best, the extremely affordable pricing means it is perpetually crowded, making it difficult to get orders through.

The decor and atmosphere remain similar since the early 2000s, including the ventilation. Be prepared that the smell of oil and fish lingers on clothes long after leaving.

As for the food, both quality and freshness felt lacking. While this may be acceptable given the very low prices, one member of my party experienced vomiting and diarrhoea afterward. This was his first meal of the day, so we were concerned it might have been related.
author: MH Tham

review_text: The security guards are very friendly and helpful. Give positive vibe.
author: Sam Wong

review_text: Another wonderful office building in Singapore. I like the Garden in the middle!
author: Max RSNTHL

review_text: Visited Microsoft office on 21st floor, nice view of the bay
author: Chenyu Huang

review_text: Easy access, friendly customer services & clear directional signs.
author: Paul Poh

review_text: Excellent security services here with difficult property owners
author: Alfred Low

review_text:
Had an absolutely hearty and satisfying meal here — a true paradise for meat lovers. The variety and quality of the meats were impressive, and everything was served hot, juicy, and full of flavour. You definitely won’t leave hungry.

Special shout-out to Guan (restaurant manager, I think) — excellent service, super attentive, and a genuinely funny guy who made the whole experience even more enjoyable. His energy really elevated the dining atmosphere.

Totally enjoyed the dining experience and will gladly be back again. Highly recommended for anyone who loves a proper carnivore feast 🥩🔥
author: Steven Wong

review_text:
Great vibe for chilling, and if you sit outdoors you can really relax by the river.

You need to set your request marker to red or green, and the staff will bring food to your table based on that.

Top three grilled items for me were the chicken, garlic bread and sausage. The pineapple was a bit on the sour side.
author: CT Liaw

review_text:
I visited the restaurant yesterday (Thursday) and enjoyed the 1-for-1 Buffet promotion with my DBS card. Reservations can only be made by phone or email. When I first called the restaurant number, no one picked up, but an employee kindly returned my call using his personal number to help me secure the booking. Really appreciate the effort—thank you, Peter.

The ambience of the restaurant was pleasant, and the staff as well as the chefs were very attentive. They kept recommending different cuts of meat and explaining what was special about each one. Even when I paused eating, they checked in politely to see if I wanted to try anything else. Drinks is ala-carte btw.

Overall, it was a good dining experience with great service and friendly staff.
author: tin peiwen

review_text: Booked a table for 5 for a family dinner partly enticed by DBS/POSB credit card offer (buy 1 get 1 free). The buffet spready wasn't very wide but the meat (chicken, pork, lamb, beef, sausages) which they served at your tables were pretty good. Dessert spread at the buffet table were a bit disappointing. Services is decent but the ambience was a little noisy & so not really a place for a quiet chat. I was sitting indoor so perhaps the al-fresco area may be better. May patronize again if similar offer are available.
author: Dave Khoo

review_text: Came here on a saturday lunch. Great experience with a variety of vegetables, salads, sides, dressings, breads and sauces too! Recommended for both meat and veg lovers :)
author: Siu Chen LIM

restaurant_name: Lucha Loco - Mexican Cocina Y Mezcaleria
review_text:
I had an amazing experience at Lucha Loco in Singapore! I’ve been there three times now, and it has quickly become one of my favorite spots to visit when I’m in the area. The food and atmosphere are always on point—great energy, great flavors, and consistently good service.

A special shoutout to George, who was incredibly helpful and made the experience even better. He was attentive, friendly, and really went the extra mile to make sure everything was perfect for our table.

Every visit has been a great time, and it’s definitely a place I plan to keep coming back to. Highly recommend stopping by if you’re in Singapore and looking for a fun spot with great food and excellent service!
author: A P

restaurant_name: Lucha Loco - Mexican Cocina Y Mezcaleria
review_text:
Lucha Loco has never disappointed us. Food is appetising, fresh and so yummy that we want to eat more! The ambience is fun and chill too, they even let us put on sombrero for photos! And the service from the staff, impeccable!

George is a gem. He made us feel at home and made really good recommendations for food, finding out first we have food allergies and then recommending the yummiest food in the house. Throughout dinner, he kept checking in on us to see if everything was alright and when he saw i could handle the spice, he brought out even spicer sauces just so I'll feel the kick and satisfaction.

George's food recommendation even include the sequence of eating so that one dish wouldn't ruin the other- thats top notch service excellence! We had the blue crab tostada, followed by elotes (a must have!) and then the pork cochinita which is a DIY taco. We then finished with churros.

Seating is limited so recommend to make a reservation.

Parking at the open air is very limited so it will be better to park at Craig's Place and exit at level 2 to the pedestrian street where Lucha Loco is on.
author: D

restaurant_name: Lucha Loco - Mexican Cocina Y Mezcaleria
review_text: Delicious food, attentive service, nice vibe. Frozen margaritas were surprisingly strong for the price - $10++ during Happy Hours (3-7pm). Good deals for the other alcoholic drinks too. But do take note that drinking water was chargeable at $1 per person.
author: CK C

restaurant_name: Lucha Loco - Mexican Cocina Y Mezcaleria
review_text:
On our last day in Singapore, we were wandering around looking for something nice to eat.

We found Lucha Loco and were instantly met be George who served us.

The food and drinks were fantastic, a little spicy but not overwhelming which was a nice change

I must say we received the best service I have experienced. George gave us a run down of the menu, didn't upsell and treat us with great respect mixed with solid banter.

We will recommend to our friends in Singapore and when back in town, we will revisit.

Thanks for making our last night memorable
author: Alex Ditrich

restaurant_name: Lucha Loco - Mexican Cocina Y Mezcaleria
review_text: One of the best mexican food in Singapore. Their chicken is oh so tender and beautifully marinated, really tasty! Love the spicy sauce that came with the shared pork dish, which was also delicious. Beef quesadillas sauce was a tad sweet though. Will be back to try more dishes!
author: Shirley Lim

review_text: This restaurant has an indoor space like a bar, quite lively with live music and a lot of young people at night. The outdoor space right on the river bank is quite chill with a direct view of the river. The food is quite delicious but the service is very slow, it seems like they are short of staff. This is an interesting place for you to enjoy a beer with friends in the evening in Singapore.
author: FrancisP

review_text: I love this place so much. I love the music. The band is just amazing. Love the songs.. The DJ, she's damn awesome! It was an amazing birthday night. Service was fantastic. My friend and I got Tequila shots on the house (1st round). Just because my friend mentioned that it was my birthday, they brought something over.. I just loved it. I can't wait to go back there soon.
author: Claire (Claire)

review_text: Bit disappointed by the policy in that all staff think after emptying your beer glass you will run off and demand payment. In effect, we are all thieves... not a good way to operate and accuse people of non payment? Would I come again? No.. not to be treated in such a manner.
author: Jason Garbutt

review_text: the food was just terrible. we had the sliders and the prawns, and the taste and quality was so low. however, no complaints about the drinks, service, and atmosphere.
author: Marc Singh

review_text: Nice vibe with the live music. Food is nice. Prices are comparatively better. But not happy about their staff service. Some staff members were really helpful while some others do not pay attention to the order and it got some dishes very delayed. But worth going there. would suggest to come there around 8, sit outside and have a nice drink with the view. around 11, move inside they are having a small club vibe with all the live music.
author: Kanishka Randunu

review_text:
Had a great dinner at Etna Duxton. The food was super satisfying and the atmosphere was lively and fun, perfect for a casual night out. Everything we ordered tasted fresh and well done, and the portions were just right.

Service was the highlight for us. Alessandro took really good care of our table and gave awesome recommendations. He was friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience feel warm and personal. Would definitely come back again. Highly recommended!
author: John R

review_text: Lovely place with authentic Italian fare! 😋 We enjoyed everything from appetiser to mains to dessert! Shoutout to Alessandro and his crew for their warmest hospitality and service — thank you for making sure we dined comfortably, even taking care of the needs of our little one! We’ve been to Etna multiple times and will definitely be back again!
author: Xin Tian Low

review_text:
The pizza is good, food are nice and authentic. Service is slow. Would not recommend if you have limited time. Food are cooked fresh, hence the longer waiting time.

Would recommend to do reservations if you want to dine in. Walk in will
Be based on luck.

Went for their lunch set meal, certain mains are small (beef) the rest are decent size.

Good place for business discussion and group gathering. Only setback is you likely need 1.5 to 2 hrs for a 3 course meals depending on the crowd. Would recommend some appetiser or sides if you don’t want a growling stomach. The pizza came faster than our mains. That helps to pacify our stomach.

Would go back again for the food but not the wait!
author: Schnitzer Ang

review_text:
We had a wonderful dinner at Etna for San Valentine’s, and everything was simply perfect!

The food was excellent — the sea bass was especially outstanding. It is wild-caught in the Mediterranean waters and flown in fresh from Italy, never frozen. You can truly taste the difference: the texture, the flavor, and the freshness make it one of the best sea bass dishes you can ever have.

A special thanks to Alessandro, who took great care of us throughout the evening. His service was attentive, professional, and genuinely warm. The whole team made us feel very welcome and ensured that everything ran smoothly.

To top it all off, they kindly offered us a Montenegro after dinner, which was a lovely touch and made the evening even more special.
author: Milly Shen

review_text:
Our second time here and food and service by Alessandro and his team is magnificent!

He is always so helpful with the best recommendations. He puts in so much passion to his recommendations and suggested wine pairings to ensure that we have the best experience.

Our group had the freshly baked focaccia, freshly made pappardelle ragu pasta (off their daily menu), swordfish pasta, four cheese ravioli, and we all had tiramisus each. Everything was amazing and authentic Italian.

The best tiramisus we have ever had.

Grazie Alessandro always for such a great experience. We will be back!
author: Cheryl Lim

review_text: Lovely restaurant by the river. The atmosphere is 10/10. My expectations for a $30 steak wasn’t high, but it was soooo delicious! Also the best fries I have ever had.
author: Phai Dip

review_text: Had a wonderful dining experience here! The food was delicious and beautifully prepared, and the drinks were reasonably priced, great value for the quality. What truly made the evening special was the impeccable service from Zara. She was attentive, warm, and went above and beyond to make sure we were well taken care of. Such a gem to the company! Definitely a place I’d come back to.
author: Beverly Tay

review_text:
If you’re looking to chill or have a meal around Boat Quay, check out Dallas. They’ve got awesome food and drink deals, and everything tastes great! We highly recommend their two-course set, especially the yummy calamari and the huge, juicy smashed burger.

The service is always top-notch. CJ and Cindy are the sweetest and make every visit feel special. It’s the perfect spot to unwind by the river.

If you’re planning a private event, definitely check their website - they offer amazing free-flow packages too.
Thanks, Dallas team! We always feel at home when we visit. 😊
author: Leah Loy

review_text:
Had their steak and frites, which features a 250g cut of 100-days grain-fed Five Founders ribeye, with a marble score of 2+, served with shoestring fries. Each steak is prepared one day in advance.
•
And we were genuinely surprised by the thickness. We even questioned the menu: is this really 250g? It felt heavier!
•
Despite its size, the steak was incredibly tender and juicy, done American-style with signature grill marks and a deep charred aroma. • You can choose from Béarnaise, peppercorn, mushroom, or veal jus — and yes, you can request all three sauces. That’s what we did! •
Sides are available as individual add-ons and are not meant for sharing.
•
We especially loved the creamed spinach • We were already very full just from the steak and frites alone. But if you’ve got room for more, don’t skip the desserts.
• housemade apple pie
chocolate brownie • The steak really exceeded expectations, especially on the thickness and tenderness. Big thanks to the amazing Dallas team for the warm hospitality

@cheechin.chew on Instagram
author: Chew Chee Chin

review_text:
Went for dinner on Monday night to celebrate Mother’s Day. The atmosphere was quiet and peaceful with a lovely view — though later in the night, the mist on the windows made it hard to see outside, and it got quite cold.

I was pleasantly surprised by the portion sizes — very generous and definitely worth the money. The steak was juicy and tender, and the black pepper sauce complemented it perfectly.

We also ordered the chicken parmigiana. The flavor was good, but since it was made with breast meat, it turned out a bit dry inside. That said, the plating was nicely done.

Service was generally good, though it could be improved. Our server was attentive but clearly stretched thin as she had to assist downstairs as well. One more staff member would have made a big difference.

Overall, it was a pleasant experience, and I’d be happy to return.
author: __shantini__

restaurant_name: Sabai Fine Thai on the Bay
review_text: Wow, what a surprise! Walked in with mid expectations and hope and left thoroughly happy. Everything was exceptional! We were lucky enough to sit outside and have a great view but the service accompanying that was great. The food was the last element and it doesn't disappoint. Fragrant with some heat but it doesn't clobber the taste. Left thinking it might have been the best Thai meal I've had.
author: Benjamin Smee

restaurant_name: Sabai Fine Thai on the Bay
review_text: The clear tom yum was literally like drinking warm water — zero flavour. Portions were stingy, service was chaotic, and the dishes came out with no order or flow. It honestly feels like no one planned the customer experience at all. The 'fine' in its name probably only refers to the price of fine dining - prices are steep and do not equate to the taste and quality of the food. Maybe the cook had a bad day, but judging from the other reviews… the cook has been having bad days for daysssss. Your money and tastebuds can do better elsewhere.
author: NoFluffFoodie

restaurant_name: Sabai Fine Thai on the Bay
review_text:
Nice location, very fresh ingredients in the food. A great lunchtime meal!

Red Curry: 5/5
Basil Fried Rice: 6/5 (Incredible flavor)
Spring Rolls: 2.5/5 (Small, not many vegetables)

They do not customize their dishes as they do not want to lose the integrity of their recipes. That is respectable, food is good!

Very popular. Takes a long time to get a table.
author: Family Reviews

restaurant_name: Sabai Fine Thai on the Bay
review_text: Way way overpriced blend taste. Only taste is spicy hot. Atmosphere does not match the price. Avoid
author: Alex Soo

restaurant_name: Sabai Fine Thai on the Bay
review_text:
Nestled along the tranquil waters of the bay, Sabai Fine Thai is a culinary oasis that transports diners on a gastronomic journey through the vibrant flavors of Thailand. From the moment you step inside, you're enveloped in an ambiance that seamlessly blends elegance with warmth, setting the stage for an unforgettable dining experience.

Start your culinary adventure with an array of appetizers that tantalize the taste buds and awaken the senses. The Crispy Spring Rolls, with their delicate crunch and savory filling, are a perfect introduction to the Thai culinary tradition. Pair them with the zesty Thai Dipping Sauce for an explosion of flavors that dance on your palate.

For the main course, Sabai Fine Thai offers a symphony of dishes that showcase the diversity and complexity of Thai cuisine. The Pad Thai, a classic favorite, is elevated to new heights with the perfect balance of sweet, sour, and savory notes, mingling harmoniously with tender noodles and succulent shrimp or tofu. Each bite is a revelation, a testament to the chef's mastery of his craft.

If you're feeling adventurous, delve into the chef's specialties, such as the delectable Panang Curry. Rich and creamy, with a hint of spice that lingers on the tongue, this dish is a celebration of Thailand's culinary heritage. Served with fragrant jasmine rice, it's a feast for both the palate and the soul.

No Thai meal would be complete without sampling the desserts, and Sabai Fine Thai does not disappoint. Indulge in the heavenly Coconut Sticky Rice with Mango, where the sweetness of ripe mangoes meets the creamy richness of coconut-infused rice, creating a symphony of flavors that leaves you longing for more.

Complementing the exquisite cuisine is the impeccable service, with staff members who are knowledgeable, attentive, and eager to ensure that every aspect of your dining experience is nothing short of perfection.

In conclusion, Sabai Fine Thai on the Bay is more than just a restaurant—it's a culinary sanctuary where passion, artistry, and tradition converge to create an unparalleled dining experience. Whether you're a connoisseur of Thai cuisine or simply seeking an extraordinary dining adventure, Sabai Fine Thai promises to delight and enchant, leaving you with memories to savor long after the last bite has been savored.
author: Bericbogan

review_text:
Golden hour hits different at Riccioti . Think alfresco dining by the river, artisan pizzas fresh from the oven, irresistible small bites, and cocktails that taste like a mini Italian escape. Simple, delicious, and made for sharing.

The vibe? Relaxed yet lively. The kind of place where conversations flow, laughter lingers, and you lose track of time “just chilling” with friends. Perfect for after-work drinks, catch-ups, or that effortless casual date night.

And can we talk about the show? 🔥
Jarek brought the energy with next-level flair bartending — no notice, no warm-up, just pure skill. Absolute showmanship paired with warm hospitality (and a self-blended rum that deserves its own spotlight).

Salute to golden hour, the Italian way 🍕🍹
We’ll definitely be back for round two by the river.
author: Kean 《keanmono IG & TT》

review_text:
The food was delicious with authentic flavors, pizza was crispy and pasta perfectly cooked.
Service was friendly and attentive throughout.
The only minor issue was that it felt slightly warm inside despite the air-conditioning.
Overall, still a fantastic place for quality Italian food
author: Korrapon T

review_text:
Love their special weekend brunch menu which comes with exclusive drink deals to match. The quality and freshness of their ingredients speak for themselves.

Their pizzas are made to order and I love the thin crust! We also liked the brunch special puttanesca di tonno which features savory and punchy flavours. And of course we had to get the creamy burrata to round off the meal.

Their drinks are also amazing, especially the negronis. Besides the classic negroni with the signature bittersweet flavours, I also highly recommend the White One and HOC.

We would like to give a special shoutout to Maneesha who was so welcoming and also gave the best drink recommendations!
author: Pei Ni Richael Chua

review_text:
Had such a lovely time at Ricciotti during their Aperitivo Hour! The alfresco seating by the river set the perfect mood to unwind after a long day. The drinks paired with tasty bites and freshly made artisan pizzas were such a treat, simple, delicious, and great for sharing.

Service was friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere felt very relaxed yet lively. It really gave that authentic Italian “chill and chat with friends” vibe. A great spot for after work drinks, catch ups or a casual date. Will definitely be back for another golden hour by the river!
author: Fransisca Fortunata

review_text:
An absolutely delightful Italian lunch by the river!

I had a wonderful lunch at Ricciotti Riverwalk today, and it was the perfect blend of fantastic food, great drinks, and a lovely atmosphere.

I tried the starters and a thin-crust Carnivora pizza, which was authentically Italian and delicious straight from the wood-fired oven .

To top it all off, we tried their creative cocktails. They were the perfect complement to my meal—well-balanced, refreshing, and expertly made.

The service was attentive and friendly, and the ambiance by the river was both charming and relaxing. It’s an ideal spot for a leisurely lunch or a special gathering. I will definitely be back soon!
author: Nick Bel

review_text:
Had lunch at Artichoke and it was absolutely worth it! The lunch menu we tried was delicious, and I can’t wait to explore the other dishes featured on their menu. The chocolate mud cake may look sinful, but it’s surprisingly light, every mouthful was pure delight. The floor staff were incredibly attentive, and the lady with short hair who attended to us stood out with her thoughtfulness and meticulous service. Truly commendable! Highly recommend!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️🌟
author: Priscilla Yeo

review_text:
Went at lunchtime and got counter seats for 2 easily without a reservation. Lunch sets comprise of a main (pizza with a side salad) and drink, good value. We also ordered an a la carte korean rose pasta and white bait starter.
Overall the pizza was the star. Crunchy crust but moist topping. The pasta was creamy and not overdone but the rose flavour did not shine through. The crispy white bait was fun to nibble on but the dipping sauce wasn't very memorable.
Place has pleasant, easy going vibes. Good place to meet friends and catch up over decent food.
author: Desiree Low

review_text:
Incredible food and even better service! The Harissa Prawn Spaghetti was the highlight—fresh, crunchy prawns and so many herbs - No wonder it won the Best Pasta 2025 by ST Food Team (as shared by Ivy)!!  We ordered the Hawaii Habibi too - Every dish was hearty and perfectly balanced.  We were glad that Ivy came along to ask for last-orders for Happy Hour - it ends at 7pm so do come early to catch the very-reasonably-priced drinks!

Huge thanks to Ivy for being such a professional and warm host. Her menu knowledge is incredible and she steered us toward the best dishes, including a life-changing cherry tart. Ivy is a total gem and deserves a Service Star Award. 10/10!
author: Cheryl Ong

review_text: Personal favorite was the tropic thunder pizza, the burrata cheese was ever so refreshing on top of the flavorful parma ham. The pizza was well cooked to perfection as well!! The aglio olio was topped with fresh juicy Japanese oysters and we wolfed it down real quick for real. The Beef lasagna nuggets was pretty good too serving bite sized tomatoey goodness in a fun size. Came here wanted to have some mediterranean food but was surprised that they changed their concepts a few months back. Nevertheless, we had an enjoyable experience dining and will be back if we ever want a comforting pizza fix😜
author: Denis X.

review_text:
Good food and chill environment. Went on a weekday night and managed to get a seat at the outdoor area.

Food was really good, the crispy chicken was well seasoned and the garnishes of the pickled onions and chillies were a nice touch and the dipping cream added a nice depth of flavour.

The candy bacon pizza was bomb. If it were any sweeter it could be considered a dessert but the flavours of the bacon, cheese, apples, walnuts and sauce really meshed well together and the dough base was crispy and nice.

Had the mud pie for dessert and it was a filling and dense chocolate goodness filled with bananas and raisins in the middle. My only wish was that it could have been accompanied by a scoop of vanilla ice cream to balance out the richness.

For drinks we have the peaches and cream float. Sweet and nice and tasted good even when all the ice cream had melted. And the guava espresso tonic, the coffee tonic was nice but couldn’t really taste the guava flavour.
author: Samuel Roy

review_text: Food was served fast and tastes really delicious. Loving all the foods we ordered especially the truffle burger with the add on bacon. Brussels sprouts and Mac and cheese were really good sides to complement along with the burger. Alongside with beautiful scenery was the plus point. As we are celebrating our anniversary, we were given a free cheese cake that tastes so good! Thanks for the complimentary cake, we really enjoyed it. Lastly, thanks to Mei who is very attentive to our needs. She also offer to capture nice food and scenery photos for us at the best angle~ Good service!
author: Samantha Ng

review_text:
The food was perfect, and the service was excellent. We really enjoyed the happy hour beers, which made the experience even better. The view was absolutely beautiful, especially watching the Marina bay sand hotel change colours — truly stunning.

I thoroughly enjoyed my time in Singapore, and this restaurant made the experience even more memorable
author: Samkeliso Shaun

review_text: Nice ambience and good seating that overlooks the marina bay sands hotel directly. You could get a good view of the light show and it will be great if you visit in the evening as that will be less hot. Jus had drinks but thought their pricing was severely overpriced. Do think about it.
author: Ming Wei Lee

review_text:
Overeasy at One Fullerton boasts an unbeatable location with stunning views of Marina Bay, creating a fantastic ambience. The service was also notably friendly and added to the pleasant experience.
However, the food was a letdown. For $30, a beer and a pork slider platter with a side of mini mac and cheese felt poor in value. The mac and cheese was hard and lacking flavour, even with a $4 add-on for truffle and mushrooms.
Ultimately, this spot is best for a drink to enjoy the view. While the ambience is top-tier, the food quality and value make it difficult to recommend for a proper meal.
author: Ribeye

review_text: It was a nice area- good spot for the MBS. A quality food, nice staffs and they also gave free dessert to us last night. Met a Filipino working there named “Ate Jen” she is such an amazing person. OverEasy is having a nice and very accommodating staff like Ate Jen. Kudos to you guys!
author: Reynaldo Mercado Jr.

review_text:
The actual sandwich was nothing like what was advertised. Ingredients are fixed but not clearly stated — only lettuce, onion, and cucumber are included, with no option to customise.

The duck shown in the image appears in slices, but what was served was crushed duck bits, and the portion was extremely small (about 1/12 of the bread). The sandwich ended up being mostly bread and lettuce. This was disappointing and felt misleading based on the menu visuals.

Told the staff but the response was it’s fixed. Seriously rip off.
author: A Lin

review_text: Subway is a reliable fast-food chain known for its customizable sandwiches, salads, and wraps. The appeal lies in the ability to choose your bread, fillings, and toppings, making it a decent option for healthier fast food—especially with whole-grain bread and fresh veggies. Favorites like the Italian B.M.T. and Chicken Teriyaki are flavorful, though some locations can be inconsistent with ingredient freshness or portion sizes. While not the most exciting dining experience, Subway is a convenient and relatively affordable choice for a quick, made-to-order meal. It’s a solid pick when you want something lighter than typical fast food but still crave convenience.
author: Alvin Lim

review_text:
Worst outlet in Singapore.
Staff was rude and very stingy with the veggies. Asked for more cucumber, he only gave two more slices.
And when it was my turn for the veggie adding, he kept looking at the guy behind me.
The bread is also cut weirdly so the top is super thin.
The cookie is a bit.. stale.
There's a $1.50 charge for drink refills, which isn't the case in the other outlets.
Do yourself a favour and go to a different outlet.
author: Bren A

review_text: 2 female staffs seem like unwilling to serve customer.The Filipino lady seems impatient and quickly walk away after I say my order request at each point! Another staff, a Malay lady seems also uninterested to listen properly.Unwilling to listen to customers order then don't work! Serve with eye contact and sincerity! We don't owe you anything yet can't even get a simplest amount of decent service!
author: Shazanah A

review_text: Reasonable price 10.90 for 1 set of bread, drink and cookies 🍪. A quiet and clean place to enjoy a meal. delicious food and enthusiastic staff..
author: sammy ng

review_text:
We celebrated a birthday at Imperial Treasure Cantonese Cuisine at Great World, and it turned out to be a delightful dining experience! The food was exceptional, the ambiance was elegant, and the service was smooth throughout our meal.

We ordered several dishes, and every one of them impressed us, we love:
Sauteed String Bean with Minced Pork & Preserved Black
Stewed Frog with Ginger, Spring Onion & Clam Source in Claypot
Sauteed Cod Fish Fillet with Celery & Preserved Black Olives
Sauteed Diced Beef with Garlic Chips

Every dish was well-executed and served hot. You can really taste the quality and consistency that Imperial Treasure is known for.

A special mention goes to the staff, who were attentive and friendly throughout the meal. After we finished dining, they even helped us take a group photo, which made the celebration feel even more memorable.

If you’re looking for authentic, high-quality Cantonese cuisine, this place is worth visiting. Highly recommended, and I will surely return!
author: SJnMD

review_text: The lotus rice was an unexpected BOMB! Explosion of flavours coming out of the humble lotus leaf wrap. I could taste the richness of the abalone seafood broth used to simmer the rice, the dried scallops and seafood ingredients, the umami fragrance that is intense yet not overpowering. I loved that they didn’t use glutinous rice which would be too heavy. A simple classic dish executed exceptionally well. My mum also loved the spring onions and scallions chicken. The chicken is kampung style, lean yet tender and packing a pungent fragrance. The aromatics complement this well, presenting an overall punchy dish that goes well with rice. I didnt manage to take a photo of the almond tea dessert. It was frothy and fragrant with freshly ground almond! A hybrid between almond paste and hot almond milk - it is the best of both worlds. A wonderful shot to end the meal. I went for the more humble, unpretentious dishes and was pleasantly impressed. Will be back.
author: sharon soon

review_text:
Stellar Cantonese Dim Sum.

Their carrot cake is divine. The radish has an almost gelatin like consistency to it. It is just firm enough to bite into but almost “melts” away when eaten. Plenty of eggs and bean sprouts for an added crunch.

Roast pork is delicious. Meat is flavorful and the crispy skin has an incredible crunch to it, goes perfectly with the mustard.

Pork buns were great too. Filling was that perfect blend of sweet and savory. Interior was moist without being mushy.
author: David Lee

review_text:
Always perfect Cantonese cuisine.  It's always consistent.  We started with the chilled pig's shank.  Very tasty and had a nice bite.  The century egg porridge was perfect.  Really reminded me of the good old days.  The steamed beancurd skin dumplings was put in a wonderful savoury broth.  Really a highlight of the meal.  The braised mee pok was the only one not up to par.  If only they didn't put so much truffle oil that made it too pungent and strong.  I could tell the broth for the noodles was really good, but it got overpowered by the truffle oil.

Service was attentive and personable.
author: Chinese Moon

review_text:
Penfolds Grange tasting night, thanks to WT
Nice classy ambience.
Seated in private room, powerful cool AC so great for indulging in wines.
Food was great as usual.
author: AL “AL”

review_text:
Dining at Jade for the Lunar New Year is a masterclass in elegance. The restaurant’s soft jade-hued decor and bird-motif wallpaper create a stunning, sophisticated backdrop that feels both historic and fresh.

The festive menu shines with impeccable seafood. The Red Grouper was a standout—perfectly steamed, incredibly fresh, and delicate in texture. Equally impressive was the Lobster, which was succulent, expertly seasoned, and served with a refined touch that let the natural sweetness of the meat take center stage.

The staff provided exceptional, friendly service that felt personal and warm, matching the high standards of the setting without being overly formal.

A beautiful, high-end destination for the Lunar New Year where the quality of the ingredients and the grace of the staff make every moment feel special.
author: Bernhard R.

review_text: Had a wonderful dining experience at Jade Restaurant at The Fullerton Hotel. The Cantonese dishes were beautifully presented and full of flavour — especially the lobster and the roasted meats. Ingredients were fresh, sauces were well balanced, and everything was cooked perfectly. Service was attentive and professional, with an elegant ambience that’s perfect for a special occasion. Highly recommended.
author: Lucksanara Kuhawattana

review_text:
We had a superb and memorable dinner here at Jade. We had their private room booked since we came in with the whole family including kids.

Food was exceptional - most especially the Peking Duck, Hot & Sour Soup and Sweet & Sour Pork.

Service was equally great as well. Highly recommend Jade!
author: Emerald Uy

review_text:
13 Jan 2026

First time visit with a high expectations, but it's a disappointment.

Their dim sum for me the taste is below average. Expecting should be above average.

Soup just so so, nothing special.
Other dishes too, nothing special and for my personal opinion is below average.

Their bee hoon with duck is super oily

The only nice thing in this restaurant is the atmosphere 😂
author: IKM

review_text: Jade is an exquisite Chinese restaurant, with elegant and clean decor. The service is attentive, without being intrusive. Depending on the dish, you can order individual servings per person or a portion for group sharing. The  Deep Fried Wasabi Mayo Prawns, as well as the Steamed Soon Hock Fillet with Minced Ginger, Rice Wine and Egg White were perfectly made. We had this together with stir fried Seasonal Vegetables (in this instance, asparagus). The Yam Paste was also an excellent dessert. On a separate occasion, we also tried the Sweet & Sour Pork, which is made in a unique manner here. Highly recommended for couples or family gatherings. This impressive restaurant is child and elderly friendly.
author: Lavanesan Swaminathan

review_text:
I frequent this mcdonalds branch every week.
I’m consistently impressed by Zaki. He is a master of efficiency—he truly 'works smart' by managing multiple tasks at once and never seems flustered, even during the busiest rushes. Despite his smaller stature, he easily does the work of two people with his incredible speed and focus.
Beyond his impressive work ethic, Zaki maintains a very professional, patient, and welcoming attitude toward every customer. It makes the dining experience much better when you see someone taking such genuine pride in their work.

McDonald’s management should seriously look into this rare, talented young man. Employees with his level of intuition, hustle, and kindness are hard to find. He is a massive asset to this location and deserves to be recognized for his potential!
author: Chan Kai

review_text: waited 20 mins for my food.. changed my milo 3 times coz its so diluted.. like 1/5 milo powder .. in the end i jus give up and accepted the lousy milo.. but the uncle very helpful ..
author: Des C

review_text:
Adzimi at the Great World City outlet was fantastic.
Despite it being very busy, he was the only one at the counter and handled the situation calmly and methodically. His service was efficient, organised, and consistent throughout.
He has a great personality — quiet yet genuinely hospitable — and made the experience pleasant even during peak hours. Definitely manager-in-the-making material and someone worth developing further.
author: Peter De Silva

review_text:
Came here for breakfast on a weekday and service was extremely slow despite not very full.
The staffs lack planning in preparing of food. We waited for 40 minutes to get our food, from order confirmation to service. Many others are waiting for food impatiently as the orders piled up.

McDonald's should definitely look into the operation of this outlet. There are other busier outlets but not as slow. Needs to be managed more efficiently, improve staff training and food preparation planning.

Would have avoided this outlet if I know how long it takes for a fast food.
author: Yvonne Ng

review_text:
It’s not uncommon to have 10-15 mins wait for your food even though capacity is not even half or full.

Remember folks, if it takes more than 10 mins, then is it really considered fast food?

That’s one major USP taken out of the equation.
author: Bryan

review_text: Celebrated our 10 yr wedding anniversary back at the very venue(former Forlino) and was treated to an immaculate dining experience from the people at SP. First greeted by a congratulatory & personally signed card by everyone from SP that warms our hearts to warming our stomachs. :) Food was so so good and our top favorites were the Shizouka King Crab with edamame, Beef and the desserts were da bomb! 2 Star Michelin just hits different, the depth, balance and precision of every dish were bursting in every bite. Service was impeccable as well, staff and Chef were warm and friendly. Amazing dining experience to make it a memorable 10 yr anniversary for us! Thank you Chef Emmanuel and wonderful staff!
author: Jeremy Tan (JT)

review_text: We went there to celebrate my son’s birthday. I made a reservation two weeks in advance and I got emails as well as WhatsApp messages to confirm with my booking and my dietary preferences. Everything was just perfect right from our arrival. The staff were professional and very attentive. They talked us through every dish and the food was great with beautiful presentation . We had crab lobsters marrón and fish…. My son had the 4-course meal and it was fantastic.  Oh and the breads cheese platter and the chocolates were amazing too. The whole dining experience was great.
author: Surina Wong

review_text: It was a birthday dinner for my partner and the service team were absolutely delightful from the get go. A birthday card was waiting at our table which was a nice touch. Service throughout the meal was attentive without being intrusive and the staff were friendly and engaging. The meal started with Chef Emmanuel preparing the first course at the table whilst telling us a little bit about his life in Singapore and it was really pleasant conversing with such a friendly and humorous chef. The staff introduced all the courses and ingredients in detail and were able to answer all our queries. Every course was on point and the blend of flavours brought different layers to the dish. We had a difficult time answering which was our favourite dish as they were all excellent! The crayfish was fresh and sweet as was the king crab, amuse bouche had intriguing flavours and I can have the pre dessert Shizuoka melon with sorbet every day if I could!
author: David Wong

review_text: One of the best restaurants I have ever been to in the world.  Surely worth every one of the accolades it has received.  The meal was magnificently well balanced, and to supplement its already great atmosphere is the magestic view of Singapore's Marina Bay skyline.  To top it off were the service staff.  Exceptional.
author: CA Boon

review_text:
The food and dining experience was good, but fall short of the expectation from a Michelin two stars restaurant.

The food portion is small, end up still hungry after the four course meal. Had to rely on more bread and dessert to be filling.

Service and view are good, but restaurant is relatively small, doesn’t feel spacious here.
author: Alan

review_text:
A cozy establishment and great to have a nice lunch with friends. The service staffs were polite and professional and the hospitality was great. It would be even better if complimentary tap water  was provided (after all we paid for service charge).

Despite that, I thought that service charge was well spent. There some issues with the sea bass dish and the waiting staff apologised with complimentary wines for both of us. On top of that they also waived off our tea charge.

My favourites were the terrine and steak. The Terrine taste grew on me and it’s an enjoyable food before the main. The medium rare steak was nicely seasoned. A tad tough though. With the savoury Terrine and Steak, the creme brulee was an excellent to complete the meal.
author: Zane

review_text: Overpriced and below average French cuisine. Vegetable soup was tasteless and the chicken was overcooked and dry to the point of being inedible. Even the bread and butter (which I had to request for) were not served hot and tasted stale, which is quite telling about their standards. Only the dessert was acceptable (but maybe because I lowered my expectations significantly.) If you want authentic French fare, please spend your money elsewhere!
author: Bob Hearts

review_text:
Today is my 2nd time returning to this establishment. My first time was remembering the seating was cramp and there were no privacy when talking. Hence I did not want to revisit. But since I was thinking of good old french no frills food
, i decided to give the place another chance. We ordered Burgundy ( recommended by the staff) which went pretty well with the food.
1. Fried frog legs. - lots of fried garlic on top fried frogs. If you don't like garlic, you wouldn't like this.

2. Escargot - Served deshelled and cooked in lots of pistacio and some paste. Bread was served room temperature.  Was asking if the bread could be served warm but the lady staff said this was how it was served here.

3. Beef cuts with sides  - 3 Different cuts of meat served with sauce dip, roasted potatoes and slow cooked onions with wine. ( which was delish, felt the cook put in alot of effort in this. Perfectly cooked, goes very well with my wine. )

4. Rhubarb dessert -  which looks like slimy apple tart served with vanilla ice cream. i actually enjoyed it. It was served warm and had a comfortable feeling to it. Only if the icecream was served separately it would be better. As it melted to fast when served on top of the dessert.

Overall a lovely hid away French place to visit. ( we went on weekend lunch).
author: Lynda Seow

review_text: an authenchic bistro restaurant with a cozu atmosphere. I really like the duck foie gras terrine here.
author: PangPang Arabica

review_text:
My partner brought us here for date night. From the get go, our waitress Macon put us at ease with excellent recommendations for the rillette and wine. The cote de boeuf was perfection, the shallot garlic confit was among the best I’ve ever had. The potato gratin and cheese platter are honorable mentions as well.

It’s not for everyday of course - the food is quite salty and fatty in the best possible way; we skipped dessert and called it a night after the beef.
author: AJ

review_text: Food is generally good BUT the pigeon management is really disappointing. Even though attempts to scare away pigeons through dummy paper crows were introduced, the pigeons are way smarter then what the management thinks they are. To be more concise, they're useless in addressing the issue. Pigeons are seen aggressively flying across tables and leftover cutlery, poking through the legs of customers and even giving tables and customers their heavenly droppings from the overhanging pipes. (See Pic) Perhaps if the management is able to adopt more effective "anti- pigeon" measures by enclosing all open areas with safety nets (like the those implemented at Bishan Bus Interchange Hawker Centre), dining at Chinatown Food Complex will be a much more hygienic and pleasant experience.
author: BX Ho

review_text:
Food are becoming too expensive and the standard has dropped a lot compared to the past.
The worst store is 02-172 (literally translate to "sister Zhen food store") ... bought "Vinegar Pig Trotter" there, $7 for a small bowl with only 1 piece of tough/hard meat, 2 other pieces of small bones with a bit of skin and an egg! OMG the worst and most ridiculous pig trotters I every had! Visit at your own risk!
The Chendol store run by an old lady is nice though, $2 per bowl serve on a retro bowl.
Then again, as mentioned ... becoming too touristy and expensive price with generally lower food standard already.
author: JG Lee

review_text: One of the last"authentic" hawker market experiences in Singapore.  More of a day time excursion as most of the stalls closer by the evening.  Be sure to try Singapore's national dish - chicken rice!
author: Cameron Marsicek

review_text: Too many obstruction and countless public tables being illegal occupied by the hawker. They place their goods and others on the public tables causing customers are unable to use them. Horrible and poor management.
author: Herman Chia

review_text: huge hawker, can have the cheapest Michelin starred food
author: E Hoogbruin

review_text: Came here for the first time after covid. The place is renovated but the food selection seems to be lesser. Food quality is good though, and the ambience is pleasant as well. Overall a pretty nice experience.
author: Elizabeth Lee

review_text: First time here and it’s really a good buffet specialising in Taiwanese porridge. Some of the dishes are very local. Items like prawn paste chicken wings, fried mee, chicken rice and Nyonya kuehs. Overall it’s a good spread and taste wise is good. Love the porridge with all the condiments that one has them with the porridge.
author: C K Leong (Ah Leong San)

review_text:
Looking for a great place for gathering & feasting while maintaining our waistline & budget ?

This is the place to head down. No doubts about it.

We had the weekday evening buffet at
author: Zapperman Zap

review_text:
Quite a decent meal for the price, given that it's buffet. Food taste decent, but not as flavourful to give the wow factor.
Being a Teochew, I'm disappointed that there's no teochew kueh at all and a lack of fried small fish and the most popular stir fry cabbage. But there's more than enough food to satisfy my stomach though, with ice cream, cakes and ginko barley dessert.
author: Gohht 13

review_text:
Been to the porridge buffet here many times, and it never disappoints! While the variety isn’t huge, every dish is delicious.
Definitely a place I’ll keep coming back to.
Do note there’s a 90 minute dining time limit.
author: Eunice Loh

restaurant_name: The FernTree Café - International Buffet Singapore
review_text: We came here for a buffet lunch to celebrate a birthday, and we had a great experience! Atmosphere is good, food tasted good, but there's still room for improvement. However, the service was top-notch! The staff were very attentive, plates were cleared fast. Thanks to Philip and the team for their excellent service and the delicious birthday cake was a lovely surprise that made this occasion truly memorable. We left with full bellies and big smiles!
author: Hello!

restaurant_name: The FernTree Café - International Buffet Singapore
review_text: A lot of times, its the attention to detail that counts. Celebrated birthday here and was surprised with a personalized card with our photo sticked to it. The staff are also very attentive and always ready to help specially Lennie. They offer different cuisine - but choices are not overwhelming. The food is always replenished. Overall it was a great experience! Will recommend!
author: MJ Bautista

restaurant_name: The FernTree Café - International Buffet Singapore
review_text: Very quiet, nice place for a buffet. if you prefer a not too crowded place, this will be the best choice.  The staff is polite and helpful. The food is yummy, a lot of variety of Asian food. Price is 1 fo 1 and kids 5yo above half price. 5yo below is foc.
author: Rebecca Maki

restaurant_name: The FernTree Café - International Buffet Singapore
review_text:
Went to dine in with 9 pax for lunch buffet today. The restaurant was pretty empty. Our table assigned was a round table, which is very squeeze. Don't understand why the MOD want to close the whole section at the back. So we wanted a long table to be combine, MOD give us some excuses whatsoever but we demand to be seated there! Because end day our bill was $400+ and I will be expecting to have a good service since there is less customers for lunch plus is a 4 star hotel. So we managed to be seated there. Disappointment for the start off approach for the table assignment.

Buffet spread was acceptable,  lots of variety of foods. Seafood was abit less. Dessert was delicious, surprised they have durian puree, ice crea., fruits and pastry. I'm happy with the service too.
author: Alvin Njq

restaurant_name: The FernTree Café - International Buffet Singapore
review_text: We had hosted an early Mother’s Day and birthday celebration for our mother at FernTree. It was an amazing experience as always and the staff members made sure the dinner was special for her with an extra celebration. They also prepared a photo for her as memory for the day. Thank you so much for making the day special for our little celebration! :)
author: Arya Harilal

review_text: Boomarang Bistro & Bar is a solid spot for good food and good vibes. The dishes are well-executed with bold, satisfying flavors and quality ingredients. Portions are generous, the drinks are well crafted, and everything comes together nicely. Relaxed atmosphere, consistently good food—definitely a place food lovers will appreciate and return to.
author: Narinthip Chatchaisuwan

review_text: Great place to hang out with friends! Boomerang Bar & Bistro has a nice view of the river, a good food menu, and tasty drinks. I spent about 5 hours here with a friend and didn’t even realize how fast the time went by. Best part – it’s dog-friendly too! Overall, a really enjoyable experience.
author: Samrat Gautam

review_text: Just a happy place with good service. Open setting, very airy on a beautiful area. The food was very good (I had breakfast there) and service was very attentive, despite the large number of people watching a game. It feels like a more upscale, friendly pub, but with Australian flair.
author: Alex Lopes

review_text: Great Aussie Pub on Robertson Quay. Had the Fish and Chips - huge serve - tasted fresh. Chicken Parmy was massive. We always come here for a meal when in Singapore.  Lots of screens for sports too.
author: Tina

review_text: Food and drinks served were fast even on a friday night. Cosy restaurant along the river. Not warm at the outdoor when sun is set. Great atmosphere and service. Staff will come to you and ask if u needed another pint of beer when you are about to finish. Pretty proactive! Hope to have more bar bites variety in the future.
author: Joanne Tan

restaurant_name: Group Therapy Coffee - Cross Street Exchange
review_text:
We decided to try new cafes this season, so this is one of the attempts to dine at places we haven't been to.

Nicely located and crowd was thin on a Sunday morning. But it really feel like a self help kiosk even though we did spot servers or staff around. Once stepped in, you find your own table. Even when stepped indoor, no greeting, no acknowledgement. Perhaps that few exchanges of stares account for some human interaction. DIY QR code order. Then food was being served when ready. The only words heard were asking which order for which diner at the table. Perhaps thats dining near CBD area. The only warm acknowledgement was from this Indian guy when we asked for a sharing plate.

Food was usual western breakfast fare. Nothing too unusual. Servings were big, almond latte was good. If you prefer mind your own business, not to be disturbed, zero interaction style of dining, this is a good place for meals on weekends. The vibes could be different on working days.
author: Angie Chng

restaurant_name: Group Therapy Coffee - Cross Street Exchange
review_text: Visited this cafe in December '25. This has got to be the best breakfast venue in the area. Efficient staff. Delicious food. Coffee was excellent. Has outdoor seating. Do give it a try.
author: Bill Stickers

restaurant_name: Group Therapy Coffee - Cross Street Exchange
review_text: We enjoyed a delicious meal consisting of Marinara pasta, chicken truffle pasta, rice bowls, and a tasty burger 🍔. The atmosphere was cozy, making it a great dining experience!
author: Fang Ying Yap

restaurant_name: Group Therapy Coffee - Cross Street Exchange
review_text:
Bought chicken katsu sando but was disappointed when it came like this. the bread made the whole dish looks cheap even though it costs $20. the menu wrote multi-grain toast but instead its just ur plain ol’ gardenia white bread.

Furthermore, the aircon where i was seated was leaking and water dripped down. I had to change seat.

Other than that, the drinks such as iced latte and iced matcha were good. Came at 12.30pm and it wasnt crowded allowing us to enjoy the food and space leisurely. Good for those who needed time to get some work done remotely.
author: aino

restaurant_name: Group Therapy Coffee - Cross Street Exchange
review_text:
We had a fantastic experience at The Group Therapy over the weekend. The service was truly top-notch. Attentive, friendly, and accommodating. My husband avoids carbs, and unlike many cafés that stick rigidly to their menu, the staff kindly substituted his portion with another available ingredient without hesitation.

We ordered the Big Breakkie and Choose Your Own Bowl, both of which were fresh and well-prepared. The coffee, a latte and flat white, was smooth.

The atmosphere was relaxed and quiet, perfect for a leisurely weekend meal. With both indoor and outdoor seating, the space felt inviting without being overcrowded.

A standout café that combines great food, excellent coffee, and genuinely thoughtful service. Highly recommend for an stress-free, satisfying brunch!
author: Chim Mei

restaurant_name: East Ocean Seafood Restaurant People's Park Complex
review_text: Gd
author: DAMIENCKC

review_text:
The hotel service has been exceptional throughout our stay. We were upgraded on arrival, and the team even left a cake in our room for our belated anniversary, which was a thoughtful touch. The rooms are beautifully done and very comfortable. The buffet is consistently well stocked and tasty.

The spa staff are welcoming and provide attentive service from start to finish. I had my nails done and a massage with Vivi, which was a highlight of my stay. Her massage was skilled and effective—she worked through the tension in my upper back, and I slept very well that night. Vivi is friendly, easy-going, and professional, and I would happily recommend her.
author: Nikki B

review_text: We really enjoyed the food at the hotel. The dishes were flavorful and well-prepared. However, we would have loved the experience even more if wheat roti had been available. Adding that option would make the meals perfect!
author: vani gupta

review_text: This was our first visit back after the refurbishment, and it did not disappoint. The check-in was flawless, super friendly, professional, and very welcoming. The rooms are superb, and every detail is taken care of to a high-end finish. We loved re-visiting the Mo Bar again where we were looked after by the team, and it was lovely chatting to the two Italian staff. We enjoyed some food in here which is always lovely. We were booked to stay at the Ritz Carlton a week later but after our stay, we decided to cancel that booking, and re-book with the MO in Singapore again. We can't wait to return later this week. Thank you for a lovely stay, John & Simon ( 18th February 2026)
author: Simon Livingston

review_text:
Great hotel with recent renovations. All the staff are very polite and professional. Breakfast is great, although I would only recommend to add chicken rice as many other hotels do. Pool side food is amazing (satay and friends in particular). The hotel is connected to Marina square which is very convenient. I would also like to add that the housekeeping (cleaning) service was flawless, each and every day.
The only downside - the price was significantly increased after renovations. While it is understandable, I think it will discourage customers to come more frequently, and only visit during special occasions or celebrations. After all, the rooms are not particularly superior than other hotels except for the MBS view. Considering the money for quality - I would give it 4 maybe even a 3.
author: Jay Yuun

review_text: Our experience was exceptional. The hotel is beautiful, and impeccably maintained. The standard of customer service that your staff provide is absolutely outstanding. The food that we experienced was also of a great quality and we thoroughly enjoyed everything that we had. I will highly recommend your hotel to friends, family and colleagues. Thank you for making our holiday to Singapore so special.
author: Sarah Staphorst

review_text: Fantastic location above a shopping centre and MRT access. Plentiful food options within the vicinity. The lounge of Level 65 is fantastic, amazing views, spacious and clean. A good selection of food and drinks in the evening. Staff are also attentive, helpful and friendly. I was fortunate to have a suite, which was well appointed and comfortable. Located on Level 64, a quick walk upstairs to the lounge. Do note, the pool is shared with the Fairmont and gets busy.
author: Mister Ming

review_text:
Excellent hotel in Singapore with one of the best locations in the city. It’s directly connected to MRT stations, shopping malls, and many restaurants, which makes getting around incredibly convenient.

The rooms are comfortable and modern, and many of them have amazing views of the Singapore skyline. Breakfast was very good with a wide selection of international and Asian options.

The highlight for me was the lounge on the 65th floor — the views are spectacular and the atmosphere is great in the evening.

The only downside is the reception area: for such a large hotel there often aren’t enough staff, so check-in lines can get quite long.
Pool is also overcrowded. Don’t rely to chill there.

Overall, a great stay with excellent location, views, and facilities. I would likely stay here again.
author: Alex Di

review_text: Had such a pleasant stay! The hotel service was excellent from start to finish. A special thank you to Mr. Andik – he was incredibly friendly, helpful, and welcoming. His warm attitude truly made our experience even more memorable. We were really happy to meet him. Staff like him make all the difference
author: Cikgu yuba

review_text: If you can afford it, stay here. The views of Marina Bay were amazing. The executive breakfast and evening drinks and snacks saved us two meals a day. The rooms and balcony were excellent. Literally only complaint is that the showers force a ton of water on the floor. I just used extra towels which they switched out promptly twice a day. The service is perfect. The location is as central as it gets.
author: S “blagnarstvox” R

review_text:
I have mixed reviews about this accommodation.
