I love how it is conveniently located above City Hall MRT Station and has direct access to Raffles City Mall, which offers many shopping options. It is also conveniently located in the Civic District, surrounded by many heritage buildings such as the National Gallery Singapore, National Museum, Victoria Concert Hall, and others. Marina Bay Sands is also within walking distance, which gave me the chance to go for a morning jog along the bayfront area.
Breakfast was also a pleasant surprise, as we were given the option to enjoy it at either Clove Restaurant or The Asian Market Café, operated by the adjacent sister hotel, The Fairmont, which is a halal-certified establishment. As Muslims, we chose the second option, of course, and we truly appreciated it.
However, the hotel itself, based on our experience traveling to many other hotels, did not really reflect the quality expected of a 5-star Accor hotel. The check-in process, as many others have mentioned, was done at what is supposed to be a self-check-in facility, with a large table and multiple computers. Although a staff member assisted us (and he was very kind and helpful), it made us feel like we were entering a budget hotel establishment.
The Signature Suite room we stayed in also felt more like a budget hotel, with outdated furniture. The room layout was not very convenient, with the bathroom located near the entrance and the bed at the opposite end of the room, which meant having to walk across the room every time it was needed.
And it's worth to mention that the towels provided were small size, again felt like in a budget hotel
author: Erna Rokhayati

review_text: We had a three day stopover in Singapore and stayed at the Fairmont. We treated ourselves to a Gold Club room and Wow! The whole experience from being greeted at the hotel lobby and being taken up to the dedicated check-in desk was excellent. We had arrived as the “Happy Hour” started and were shown to a table and offered drinks and choices from the food buffet. We were checked in whilst sitting in comfort. The staff were friendly and efficient and very welcoming. Our room was stylish and comfortable. The bed was super comfortable, the bathroom was huge and spotless. There was everything available to make our stay enjoyable. We had lunch the next day at Prego and that was fabulous. Loved the decor, service and food. Our whole stay at the Fairmont was so good and we would not hesitate to stay there again. Thank you to all the management and staff and we look forward to our next stay
author: Karen Bongiorno

review_text:
Enjoyed the memorable dining experience very much. The buffet spread is impressively extensive, showcasing well-executed local favourites alongside regional highlights—from fragrant laksa and chilli crab to tender roast meats and beautifully prepared desserts. Every dish reflects freshness, balance of flavours, and thoughtful presentation.

What truly elevates the experience is the consistency in quality and service. The staff are attentive, warm, and efficient without being intrusive, making the meal feel relaxed and enjoyable. The ambience is equally inviting—elegant yet comfortable—perfect for family gatherings, celebrations, or a leisurely indulgent meal.

Overall, Asian Market Café stands out for its generous variety, reliable standards, and authentic flavours. It’s a place you leave satisfied, already looking forward to your next visit.
author: Sue Goghari

review_text: Had a fantastic dinner buffet at Fairmount Singapore for my wife's birthday! 🍴 The chilli crab and pengat durian were highlights - seriously delicious! They kept topping up the food at perfect timing. 🤩 The staff, especially the manager, were excellent - super friendly and helpful. He even sang a birthday song with cake 😄. Even managed to retrieve our lost phone with their help - exceptional service! Highly recommend for a special occasion!
author: Alim Zamrabi

review_text:
James in the Fairmont Gold Lounge at Fairmont Singapore is an absolute standout. From the moment I arrived, he was warm, professional, and effortlessly attentive without ever being intrusive. As a solo guest, that balance really matters — and he nailed it.

He anticipated needs before I even had to ask, ensured my glass was never empty, and took the time to engage in genuine, thoughtful conversation. His knowledge of the lounge offerings and attention to detail elevated the entire experience from pleasant to exceptional.

Service like this is what defines true hospitality. James is a real asset to the Fairmont Gold experience — polished, personable, and consistently five-star.
author: Wei N

review_text: Multiple visits to this hotel already and always have a pleasant stay. Nym provided exceptional service. I booked 2 rooms with different dates and she helped to note so we can get both rooms on the same floor. Will definitely stay here again in the future.
author: Diana Jaffar

review_text:
My first time at SKAI Restaurant and it was a great experience. The view was amazing, especially the sunrise, and the ambiance was very relaxing and classy. The food and drinks were really good as well. It may be a bit pricey, but it’s definitely worth it for the experience.

Most of the staff were Filipino, which made the experience feel even more warm and welcoming. Special thanks to Sir Benj for taking great care of us. He was very attentive, friendly, and approachable. Overall, the staff were very nice and made our first visit memorable.” 🌅
author: josephine veloso

review_text:
Returning to SKAI for another family celebration. Truly appreciate the serving team’s work attitude-responsive and friendly as always.
The food never disappoints, both in taste and presentation. Thank you for the thoughtful slice of cake with the wording . Much appreciated.
Lovely ambience and view. Our family really enjoyed it.
author: elizabeth lim

review_text:
Its our first time dining in skai bar and its unforgettable. They made us feel welcome and we really appreciate the thoughtful token they prepare. Unexpected but really worth remembering. Plus the stirloincand sushi platter was to die for. Atmosphere is very cosy too enough to see and admire the view with fruitful conversations with loveones or friends.
Thank you so much for making our day special.we will be back
author: jane

review_text:
We had a great Valentine’s night big thanks to Aeron. His service was consistent from start to finish, and he made sure we were well taken care of the whole time.

Everything was managed smoothly and professionally, always with a kind attitude and a genuine smile. He truly made our visit special, and we really appreciate his service.
author: Louis Ng

review_text:
Our first time dining at SKAI Bar was truly unforgettable, thanks to Carmela and Benjie. They made us feel genuinely welcomed, comfortable, and relaxed from the moment we arrived, even though it was our very first visit.

The drinks were excellent, beautifully crafted, and thoroughly enjoyable. We were especially touched by the thoughtful surprise of a Merry Christmas cake and the Polaroid photo with a personal dedication — such a lovely and meaningful gesture that made the experience extra special.

Everything about the evening felt warm, personal, and memorable. Thank you, Carmela and Benjie, for going above and beyond and turning our first visit into something we’ll always remember. We will most definitely be back! ✨🥂🎄
author: Jelika Raakin

author: STP Group Excellent experiences

review_text: Crew's attentive & cleaned table quickly despite busy & outlet full with diners!
author: Yoke Fei Phan

review_text: My daughter & I dined at Marina Square Mcd on 4 Oct around 5:30 PM and were very impressed. The food was served warm and fresh, and the staffs on duty were exceptionally nice — especially the kitchen team (esp a guy) who was super patient and helpful with our requests. Despite the restaurant being packed during this F1 period, they still served with a smile. They kept the tables clean and tidy too. It’s so different from other stores we often go to:( We’ll definitely want to only revisit MS Mcd soon. Thanks to all the Macdonald crews at Marina Square:) 🍔👏
author: Irin Ong

review_text: Good place to go with families. It's really helpful for us because kids are still small. They ate burgers and frenchfries and satisfied!! Only my opinion, but frenchfries are bit a cold and not saulty. However, other things were great. Baby shark interior was cute, Spicy (burger) was really hot and tasty!!
author: Tatsuya I.

review_text: its been my all time favourite at mcdonalds marina square..,been its peak hours or non peak even on weekends,been the love of the atmosphere..love it
author: Muhd Saifullah

review_text: It’s always a pleasure dining here! The hardworking elderly staff serving food and cleaning up show real dedication — respectful and efficient. The team is straightforward and attentive, and the food comes out smoothly without delay. Tables and seating are comfortable, and the place is always lively and full — a good sign! Thank you for consistently providing an affordable and delicious Japanese dining experience. Highly recommended!
author: Veenoth Kumar

review_text: Had a yummy dinner tonight with family and enjoyed the meals. Thank you Sin Yen, Bobo and Hooi Fen for the awesome service. They were friendly, helpful and attentive and always served us with a smile. We have become regular and loved coming to this branch for our meals whenever we are in Raffles city mall. Keep up the good service 👍
author: justin teo

review_text: Hidden in the corner at the third floor next to the food court is this outlet! Definitely way better than the busy food court and the interior was much larger than I expected. You get the usual Sushi Tei food and everything meets expectation!
author: Eric Lee

review_text:
This is the second time where Sushi Tei  collaborated with another Japanese company. This time it's mofusand. A popular Japanese Cat art. I have seen people having mofusand collectibles everyday even shirts too!!

Now, let's come to the food:

Firstly Kaisen Yasai Nabe is in a vegetable stock looks like a tomato stock.  It doesn't taste like tomato but it taste like minestrone.

Cheesy Corn Tori Yaki is taste perfect. But it is so umami.

The tochigi wagyu don is medium well or medium. But the onsen egg is runny well.

Next, The deluxe barachirashi don is so deluxe and premium as it contains real crab leg and multiple sashimi pieces fish including the golden eye snapper!

Double Fry Curry pasta at first I thought is fried twice for the Curry pasta but it entirely wasn't! It's Pasta fried with curry and chopped vegetables while the butterfly shrimp and the whiting fish that should meant to be with the pasta is deep-fried.

Lastly, the golden duo fry platter, also contains whiting fish but normal deep-fried ebi plated nicely and perfect.

Overall, the food quality is at its best thanks to Wong Yu Han and his team of chefs. The service is slightly slow due to less staffs but it manage to boost it's speed and service quality thanks to Kei Yin, Bobo, and Ying Wei. The rest of the service staffs should have done better despite they have done their best. Thank you everyone for a good service. See you around!
author: Mind The Gap 3

review_text: Went to Sushi Tei Raffles City for lunch. Ordered the promotional item, a Yuzu Hamachi. It had a wafu/yuzu sauce with thinly sliced fresh onions at the base of the sashimi. Fish was fresh and the sauce certainly complimented the dish. Good healthy choice. Chawanmushi was quite a treat with plenty of ingredients and a soothing broth.
author: Ern Lau

review_text:
Very good restaurant.
We came here for dinner.
Small queues, still fine.
All the foods are delicious, fresh!
We can taste they use fresh ingredients.
The last but not least that impressive is the mochi chocolate that they serve on the steam plate.
That is great!
Enjoy the foods!
Enjoy Singapore 🇸🇬
author: Tamara Berry

review_text:
After trying sesame noodles in Taiwan, I completely fell in love with the dish, so I specifically came to Din Tai Fung to have this bowl again. It’s spicy, fragrant, and even more delicious with a splash of vinegar added.

The Four-Joy Gluten (Si Xi Kao Fu) is also very flavorful, absolutely delicious.
author: ptqptq ttt

review_text: I love how Din Tai Fung quality is consistent. These were the best soup dumplings we had in Singapore. They didn't fall apart and had a good balance of flavors. We didn't wait for a table at this location. Service was friendly and fast. Prices were reasonable. I'd definitely come back.
author: Nancy

review_text:
Delicious usual Din Tai Fung! The XLB are perfect and the Chilli oil wontons were so good we ordered them 3x.
Beef noodle soup was tender and all portions were good enough!
The place was clean and spacious, love being able to see the chefs at work through the large windows!
author: Aaron Leong

review_text: I was very impressed with Miss Kah Toh from the Raffles City branch. She was exceptionally helpful and kind, and promptly corrected our incorrect order without any hesitation, maintaining a positive and professional attitude throughout. The service was impressive, and the food was excellent—truly delicious.
author: Gary Tan

review_text: The duck was definitely the highlight here. Most of the food dishes were good. Service was a bit short as I had to give a few reminders for my drink. Overall was all good.
author: Dunnowhattoeattoday

review_text: I come here at least once a month, always order the Angelica herb duck and the sambal assam squid. Tastes really good, service is also very quick and efficient. Environment is also clean and nice. Definitely recommend to come!
author: Justin

review_text: Have always enjoyed Dian Xiao Er Dang Gui Duck. Order a set lunch today that comes with fish Maw soup, so tasty I finished everything!
author: CWWSIM

review_text: The yusheng  dang gui Duck , garlic chives, toufu hotplate are nice. Service alis good.
author: Edmund Chong

review_text:
I always come back for the Dang Gui duck.
They are ok with customisation too. Kids meal, no extra soy sauce and no corn are accomodated with no issues.
No birthday song sung for birthdays.
author: Acmalaysia Chew

review_text:
Satay by the Bay offers a lively open-air dining experience with a wide variety of local hawker food options. The satay was nicely grilled with a good smoky aroma, tender meat, and decent seasoning. The peanut sauce was rich and nutty, with just the right balance of sweetness and spice, pairing well with the satay.
Beyond satay, there are many choices such as seafood, local favourites, and drinks, making it a good place for group dining. The atmosphere is relaxed, especially in the evening with the waterfront breeze and city views. Prices are slightly higher than neighbourhood hawker centres, but acceptable considering the location and ambience.
Overall, Satay by the Bay is a good spot for tourists and locals to enjoy satay and local food in a scenic setting.
author: ivan T Teo

review_text:
Stopped here for a quick snack on our way to Gardens by the Bay. The dumplings were okay, but nothing special in terms of flavor. The prices are quite high for the quality and portion size provided.
In a city like Singapore with so many amazing food options, this place unfortunately falls short. We’d recommend looking for better value elsewhere.
author: Shurrlian Yog Sototh

review_text:
Satay by the Bay is an absolute gem! Located in the heart of Singapore, this vibrant food court offers an unforgettable dining experience. The atmosphere is lively, with beautiful views of the marina, making it a perfect spot for both locals and tourists.

The star of the show is undoubtedly the satay. The skewers are perfectly grilled, with a delightful smoky flavor and tender meat. The peanut sauce is a must-try—rich, creamy, and just the right amount of spicy!

Beyond satay, the variety of dishes available is impressive. From juicy seafood to flavorful noodles, there’s something for everyone. The prices are reasonable, especially considering the quality and freshness of the food.

The staff is friendly and efficient, ensuring that your dining experience is smooth and enjoyable. I also loved the outdoor seating, which adds to the charm of the place.

Whether you’re looking for a quick bite or a leisurely meal, Satay by the Bay delivers on all fronts. I can’t wait to return for more delicious food and stunning views! Highly recommended!
author: Zackery Goh

review_text:
If you’re visiting Singapore and want an authentic taste of local hawker flavours in a scenic garden setting, Satay by the Bay is the perfect spot. Located within Gardens by the Bay, this open-air food court offers a relaxing waterfront atmosphere with beautiful greenery, gentle sea breeze, and plenty of seating — a refreshing change from the busy city.
Here you’ll find some of Singapore’s most iconic dishes:
1. Freshly grilled satay (chicken, beef, mutton) served with fragrant peanut sauce
2.Juicy BBQ seafood, including stingray and prawns
3.Delicious local noodles and vegetarian options
4.And more importantly, ice-cold drinks to cool down after exploring the gardens.

I stopped by around noon over the weekday and did not managed to have the time to appreciate the food at this lovely food haven but definitely make sure I have ample time to dine next time.
author: Reiko H

review_text:
If tourist or bringing foreign friends to experience Singapore food, only the satay( city satay) is good. For better local food, go to Jurassic nest food hall.

Tried the hokkien mee and fried oyster (bland and not aromatic). Kueh pie tee is bland.
author: Y B

review_text: Missing Austrian or German Food then this is the right place for u! All the comfort authentic german food i love is here!! The freshly baked pretzels was truly the best also!! I'm not a beer drinker but they said one of the best beer brewery in SG and been here for so many year! Love the concept of their weekend ala carte bavarian dishes eat all u can! Super enjoyed our time here and the most important part are the friendly staff! Special ghanks to Rana or Raha the Indian Fellow who is super nice and warm!!! Thank you so much for the wonderful service and sumptuous meal!!! 😍
author: Rochelle (OchieBon)

review_text: Warm and prompt service by Dennis! Very good vibes, food and beer. Food was amazing! Dennis even taught us the traditional way of eating German sausages. He also has good attention to detail and recommended the menu very well, without being too overbearing or rushed. Love the ambience here, perfect for my dad’s birthday today :) We enjoyed ourselves very much!
author: Yeap yi

review_text:
Had a great meal at Paulaner. We ordered the pork knuckle, sausages, and beer, and it was a satisfying German feast.

The pork knuckle was well done with crispy skin and tender meat inside. The sausages were hearty and paired perfectly with the mashed potatoes, which we absolutely loved, creamy, comforting, and a great complement to the mains.

They also have 1-for-1 beer and cocktails, which is a fantastic deal and makes the experience even better. Overall, a solid spot for good food, good beer, and a lively atmosphere. Would come back again.
author: Things To Do by Aly

review_text:
Paulaner Bräuhaus Singapore is a well-known German microbrewery and restaurant located at Millenia Walk, offering an authentic taste of Bavaria in the heart of the city. Established in 1996, it is Singapore’s first German microbrewery and remains a favourite among locals, expatriates, and visitors alike. The venue brews its signature Paulaner beers onsite, following traditional Bavarian purity laws, ensuring fresh, high-quality lagers and wheat beers served straight from the tap.

Spanning three levels, Paulaner Bräuhaus features a lively bar, a spacious beer hall, and a relaxed alfresco beer garden, making it suitable for everything from casual drinks to corporate events and celebrations. The menu showcases classic German comfort food such as crispy pork knuckle, bratwurst, sausages, schnitzels, and pretzels, alongside seasonal specialties and hearty desserts. Portions are generous and designed to pair perfectly with their freshly brewed beers.

Known for its warm hospitality, festive atmosphere, and regular events like Oktoberfest celebrations, live music, and beer promotions, Paulaner Bräuhaus Singapore delivers a genuine Bavarian dining experience that blends tradition, quality, and convivial charm.
author: Sakura Stan

review_text:
It’s been a while since our last visit, and coming back to Paulaner Singapore reminded us why we enjoyed it so much the last time.

We ordered the Brauhaus platter and added extra sides of spätzle and mashed potatoes for our family of five. Portions were super generous.. in fact, we couldn’t finish and had to pack some home (no complaints there 😄). Great for sharing, especially if you come hungry.

The vibe was fantastic. We sat on the second floor and really enjoyed the cozy, lively atmosphere ! It’s more family friendly too.. festive yet relaxed..

Special shoutout to Vincent, Sarah and YC. They were friendly, attentive, and made us feel very welcome throughout the evening. Service really makes the difference.

Will definitely be back again 👍
author: Sim Cik

review_text:
Pizza Hut never fails to impress. We’ve visited several Pizza Hut outlets over the years, and we’re always amazed by the consistency in their food quality. The Marina Square outlet was no exception.

We came in a group of 10 and ordered two 4-person Hut Savers sets, along with a few additional add-ons. Everything arrived promptly, and the service was efficient despite our larger group size. The food was fresh, well-prepared, and just as satisfying as we’ve come to expect.

Overall, it was another great dining experience, and we wouldn’t hesitate to return to this outlet again.
author: lamlkk

review_text: Love the outlet atmosphere. It's so quiet and peaceful. We had the spicy chicken pomodoro and the valentine's special heart shape Hawaiian pizza. It was delicious. Meena was very friendly with her services. Wouldnt mind to have a bite here again.
author: Saridah

review_text: One place that has all my heart perhaps because of nostalgia that's linked with the place is Pizza hut. I must say that rich flavour and stringy texture of cheese which I had about a decade back is all alive again. pizza hut never fails to amaze the customers. This time I tried their kickin chunky chicken pizza,  the soup of the day ,chicken fingers and hazelnut tarts popping out straight from the oven as part of meal and I must say that the food served the taste buds with such royalty. To place the order all you just need to do is  scan the barcode and place the order via their App which was pretty fast.
author: Sajjad Rasool

review_text:
Lovely place with good service and people. Not crowded even during peak hours, as far as my experience goes, anyway.

Already love the food, service is fantastic. All lovely people, and also took interest in my photography hobby.

Hope to see you all again soon one day!

(Sorry about the late review!)
author: ZWE WINT NAING (Valentine)

review_text:
Food was good and service was excellent. Hawaiian pizza was fresh and chicken wings were yummy.

Meera was very friendly and helpful. Thank you very much.

Will eat here again. Recommended.
author: Yung Huhn Soo

review_text:
I had a weekend dinner here with my family, during the Lunar New Year period with their celebratory menu on a Saturday. I was impressed!

The food was laid out in a section of the very spacious and well decorated restaurant. It was easily accessible. Although the variety was sort of limited, but it covered all kinds of possible Penang favourites so there wasn't any lack of choices. I personally didn't eat everything as it was more than enough for a good meal!

All the items that I tried were deliciously prepared and fresh! I couldn't find any fault with the style and quality. Sauces were not too spicy and there is a depth of flavour with nuances representative of the recipes used and skill of the chefs. Tasty and wonderfully cooked! Once the trays were almost empty, they would top it up again. So there is always more available. There are many small bites too!

If I were to describe every dish in detail, this review would be too long to read. Hence, rest assured that you will enjoy your meal here. The service was excellent too! Staff were quick in clearing used bowls and plates, and they were all very friendly with smiles on most of their faces. Even though the crowd level was quite high, the staff were all in high spirits and attended to their customers well!

Price wise, the buffet on a weekend may seem expensive but it is more than evident that the quality of the food and ingredients is the reason. A good and satisfying meal is assured and you will definitely leave after the meal with a happy belly!
author: Kelvin Seet

review_text:
First time trying Penang food at Penang Place restaurant. Overall, the food was good – highlights for me were the Asam Laksa, beef rendang, and lobak, which were all delicious.

The char kuey teow was decent, though still hard to match the authentic Penang taste. For desserts, the bubur hitam was tasty, but the cendol was quite ordinary.

We went for à la carte, and while the food was worth it, service was a little on the slow side. The restaurant was quite full with buffet diners, so it was a bit hard to get the staff’s attention.
author: C T

review_text:
Nice environment but difficult to find the place. Suntec City Atrium, near to Information Counter, 2nd level.

1st time tried the buffet lunch. Liked the chicken satay, beef rendang, Pisang goreng, bobo hitam, cuttlefish kangkong, fried popiah and chicken wings.

Kueh kueh , only 2 types per time, not nice. Crabs, sauce too sweet and starchy, average. Nasi Lemak chilli average but nice fragrant nasi.
Range of food not much.
Only drinks- lime drink and warm water. Surprised no coffee and tea offered, need to order.
Paid $40+ for senior.  Food are tasty.
author: Kancy Eng

review_text:
This was my 1st visit to Penang Place since they relocated to Suntec City. Unfortunately, it did not live up to expectations.

The Char Kway Teow, usually a must-try, was already "wiped-out" when we arrived around 12:30pm. When it was finally replenished, it was cooked plate by plate and simply poured into the buffet tray, rather than served fresh in a full batch. It did not taste as good as before and really needs to be eaten hot to be enjoyed. The Assam Laksa and Hokkien Mee soup were also disappointing.

At least, the Chicken Satay, Assam Prawns and Durian Pengat were good.

Perhaps it was a Sunday and the standard dropped? For the buffet price of $39.90++, it is still worth to try.
author: Lucky Mary

review_text:
An Exceptional Dining Experience at Penang Place!

From the moment we walked in, the warmth and hospitality at Penang Place made us feel completely at home. The food was outstanding — authentic Malaysian flavors, generous portions, and beautifully presented dishes that truly celebrate the cuisine.

A special mention for the satay — honestly, the best satay I’ve had in my life! Perfectly grilled, tender, and paired with a deliciously rich peanut sauce. Every bite was unforgettable.

And of course, a heartfelt thank you to Kevin, for his exceptional hospitality. His attention to detail, warm personality, and genuine care elevated the entire experience.

A restaurant that delivers not only incredible food but also sincere service — highly recommended! We’ll definitely be back soon.

— ★★★★★
author: Evon Sachdeva

review_text:
Having reviewed the standard menu items previously, I’m focusing more on the off menu and seasonal specials.

From the seasonal specials, we had the roasted conference pear with burrata cheese. I love the pear , which gives the sweetness to the prosciutto crisps and the burrata cheese gives the creamy taste which was not cloying. The hamachi and scallop ceviche was also on point with its citrusy and salty flavours.

We had the off menu order of mushroom soup and lobster bisque. Both were decent,  not overly rich, though the mushroom soup was on the saltier side.

The prime porterhouse steak and pork chop kept to their usual standards. It was the first time we tried the rotisserie chicken which was tender and flavourful. Another first was the lamb chops which was well marinated and easy to chew. Another off menu was the Shanghai lobster curry rice, which was presented nicely with the lobster shell and chopped meat drizzled with curry on rice.  Slightly on the sweeter side but something different from the standard menu.

We had the standard signature sides of peewee potatoes, creamed spinach, sautéed mushrooms, mash potatoes and my favourite was the roasted broccoli.

Of the 3 desserts of strawberry almond financier, chocolate soufflé, baked Kaya Alaska, the last with my favourite Kaya was to my liking.

Oh other than the signature ‘Call Me Daddy’ cocktail, we tried a variety of mocktails, mainly fruity floral and all looked and tasted good.
author: Ying Ying Chan

review_text:
We celebrated my birthday at CUT by Wolfgang Puck and it was truly an unforgettable experience from start to finish.

First, the service was exceptional, warm, attentive, and incredibly thoughtful.

The steak was absolutely fantastic, perfectly cooked with a beautiful crust on the outside and tender, juicy inside. Easily one of the best steaks I’ve had in Singapore. And I have to specifically mention the mashed potato,  hands down the best I’ve ever tasted. Silky, buttery, and impossibly smooth. It deserves its own spotlight.

We were also pleasantly surprised with complimentary sliders and sweets, which were such a lovely touch. The birthday dessert plate was beautifully presented and made the evening feel even more special.

The ambience is elegant yet comfortable — perfect for a celebration or a special night out.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for a top-tier steakhouse experience in Singapore. I’ll definitely be back. 💛
author: Kethmi Hettige

review_text:
Had an amazing dining experience at CUT by Wolfgang Puck. The service was impeccable from the moment we walked in, attentive without being intrusive and genuinely warm.

We were started off with an assortment of freshly baked breads, which was a great way to kick things off. This was followed by the oysters we ordered, incredibly fresh and briny and just perfect.

Then came the main act, the steak. It was unbelievably juicy and tender, cooked exactly how you’d hope a premium steak would be. While it was definitely too big for two people, that’s hardly a complaint, more of a warning to come hungry.

The candlelit atmosphere added a beautiful, intimate touch to the evening and made the whole night feel extra special.

Overall, exceptional food, top notch service, and a memorable ambience. Highly recommend for a special occasion or whenever you want to treat yourself.
author: Ethan Loo

review_text:
We had a birthday celebration here and boy the team made it an excellent one🥳
Food is great as many reviews had mentioned. I particularly like the crab cake with clean and delicate tasting. The many option of bread rolls are fun to start, the sides are simple food executed well. USDA porterhouse is good, but i wish it was not sinewy and less greasy with more crust. Flavour wise is good, meaty and lean on 1 side and fattier mouthfeel on the other. Wagyu beef sliders were on the house and they taste great too. All their food is unpretentious type that are executed well.
Our dinner is closed with the best basque cheesecake i’ve had🥰 it’s so smooth, not too sweet and raspberry coulis goes so well with it. Special shout out to Kim and Dan who made our dining experience that much better. You guys are awesome and your service made a big difference and reason to come back and recommend this place ❤️
author: Yuly Mirawati

review_text:
Great experience celebrating a birthday. The portions are BIG so be mindful of that when ordering. We ordered baby chicken with Ribeye steak and macaroni - all dishes were really well made but we could barely finished half. It might be also due to how delicious the fresh bread basket was, so good!

Yes it’s not inexpensive, but since we don’t drink alcohol much, I find that the food is of great value given the portion size, location and how great the service is. Really excellent and attentive service by the staff at CUT.

Everyone from the front of house, to the waiters, food runners and floor manager are very friendly and genuine with their service.

Also, they give you a free parking coupon every table for the mall, which that in itself is already worth $20 lol

Thank you for the great experience! We will be back
author: Amber

review_text:
Awesome food!
I went on a Monday for lunch and really enjoyed being able to sample a wide variety of dishes. The selection was excellent and everything was well prepared. There were plenty of choices and the overall quality was great.
Do call ahead to check for any discounts or promotions — they can make your dining experience even better!
author: Zhi Hui Tan

review_text:
It’s a Halal Restaurant. Reservation is required. The buffet starts at 6:30 pm, and due to the weekend and Christmas season, guests began queuing around 6:10 pm. By about 6:25 pm, the staff started welcoming guests into the restaurant in an orderly manner.

The food selection is wide and very well prepared. Everything I tried was delicious, with the laksa being the standout for me. The portion was generous and rich in flavour. As it’s a buffet, sharing the laksa is a good idea so you can fully enjoy the rest of the spread.

The staff are polite and hardworking. Although they seem relatively new and limited in number, they do their best to attend to guests’ needs.

The dining environment is calm, comfortable, and relaxing, making it a pleasant place to enjoy a meal. Overall, it was an enjoyable buffet experience, especially during the festive season.
author: Clo’s Laobu

review_text:
The restaurant is on level 4 of Parkroyal Collection hotel which was the previous Marina Mandarin hotel many years ago when in my youth.

The check in lobby & restaurant on level 4 is beautiful decorated with CNY festive atmosphere and many people dine here with a happy mood too.

We had the Lo Hei Yusheng ($108++) excluding the Halal buffet price. The place is 3/4 full seating
On a weekday evening.

Buffet serves cold seafood 🍤 🦪 🦞, sushi 🍣, Indian and asian cuisine, not forgetting dessert.
I like the cold lobster 🦞 and abalone but the tuna sashimi not up to my taste.

Laksa with your pick of seafood 🦞 🐟 cook to eat with tasty laksa curry mee is good. Their biryani’s with curry is good too and the mala fish with tender smoked duck meat 👍.

Cold water is freeflow and tea 🫖 coffee ☕️ is included. Juice, soft drinks and alcohol is chargeable.

Lastly end the meal with a great pastry with CNY sticky cake with peanut & coconut flakes topping and durian pengat with your choice of toppings like sweet corn, chendol, red beans and Alap seed.
author: Thomas Saw

review_text:
I called and made a reservation via one of their service staffs, Zhiyang and briefly mentioned that I was celebrating a friend's birthday.

When the day arrived, we got to the buffet and was overwhelmed by the variety of food they had. There was seafood on ice with Boston lobsters, whole abalones, crabs, prawns, crayfish, scallops, clams etc.

There was also a laksa station where one could pick the seafood we wanted and the chef would cook it on the spot. There were rock lobster, mud crabs, fish etc at this station. It was really good and popular, as testified by the long queue to it.

There was also a hot food section, which I loved the salmon, pizza and the hainanese chicken.

I'm not a big fan of jap and Indian food but there are counters for that too. Can't stop munching on the papadum though. Hahaa...

I couldn't get enough of the durian pengat and I even had it in the kueh pie ti shells and that was so good...!! Totally amazing.

The desserts were so pretty but I didn't have anymore stomach for it. Such a shame.

After such a huge feast, one of the staffs popped over to our table with a cake - a full cake, albeit a small one, wishing us a Happy Birthday!!  Omg... I didn't think that my brief mention of the Birthday, to the service staff, Zhiyang, was actually taken down as notes. And they came surprising us with the birthday cake!

Would highly recommend the restaurant not only for the variety and quality of buffet items, but also the service and ambience of the entire experience.
author: H S H

review_text:
There are lots of greenery, and I really like the natural environment. The service is very good and the food is decent. I dont like cold seafood, if got hot seafood will be better. I like the self-service water station, many hot drink choices available.
Overall, it was a good experience and I will visit again.
author: Emily Chen

review_text:
We had an unforgettable dining experience at your restaurant! The Turkish cuisine was AUTHENTIC and DELICIOUS - every dish was a flavor explosion! 🤩 The atmosphere was warm and inviting, making us feel right at home.

Please pass on our heartfelt thanks to Wan, our incredible server! 🤩 He went above and beyond to ensure we had a fantastic time, explaining dishes, making recommendations, and checking in on us constantly. His passion for the food and hospitality was evident, and we truly appreciated his dedication.

We'll be back for more soon 😊
author: Jan Denzel Golez

review_text: Sofra is an outstanding Turkish restaurant that offers both excellent food and a wonderful dining atmosphere. The dishes we ordered were cooked perfectly and packed with authentic flavor. Even my eldest son, who is a picky eater, thoroughly enjoyed the flavorful shish kebab and the kunaffe with ice cream. He even tried and enjoyed the lamb! The staff provided excellent service and showed genuine hospitality by quickly replacing his spilled peach ayran drink at no extra charge. With a family-friendly vibe and a beautiful view of the Singapore skyline, we will definitely be returning to Sofra soon.
author: JJ Arc

review_text:
Had a fantastic experience at Sofra.
We were a group of 15 people and ordered quite a bit to share.

The platters are standouts with the meat grilled perfectly. Balanced flavors with a nice charred taste.
In fact, everything we ordered were good. It was quite a surprise.

Damage is around $300. Which works out to around $20 per person from a very filling dinner.

Worth a try.
author: Jonathan Goh

review_text:
A Great Place to Have Turkish Food

This is a nice restaurant in Marina Square with a view. It is a fairly large restaurant even though the entrance looks small.

Dinner in the evening was a pleasant affair. There were numerous customers but not too many, so the ambience was maintained. The Turkish themed decor was good and put you in the mood for Turkish food.

Food was great - made from fresh ingredients as one would expect. Salsa tasted fresh and nice. The chick pea was great too. Beef and lamb kebabs were very good. The chicken was a little dry though. However, overall it was still excellent.

Service was fantastic. Everyone was very helpful and ready to respond.

Overall, I would highly recommend this lively restaurant if you’d like to have Turkish food.
author: Beary Beary

review_text:
Thanks to the crew for letting us in even though we did not make a reservation for two. Much appreciated.

We have been craving Turkish food for quite some time, so we went straight for the Bursa Delight Iskender Kebab and the authentic doner rice.

The meat is well marinated and perfectly cooked, while the rice is aromatic. Portions are generous with plenty of meat. Very satisfying, very yummy, and definitely a happy tummy moment.
author: Dwayne Yong

review_text: It is a shame that we can get a better serving and quality of the set meal. Have ordered the set of pork and seafood soup but the portion came was pathetic and the soup was super thin. Worst than our normal food court standard. And furthermore , the chefs all wear like sou chef which made us thought their cooking are of standard. Please do not eat here as we can get better korean food in other foodcourt elsewhere.
author: Kris Heng

review_text: This place had a very promising description on the website which prompted me to visit. Unfortunately the food was not up to par to the value that was charged. First of, the chirashi bowl was disproportionate compared to the value with the cuts of sashimi very underwhelming compared to the ones I have had in Singapore or elsewhere. While the rest of the meals were just not average. The only saving grace for the entire meal was the mushroom and clam soup which was flavorful and wholesome. I have to agree with some of the reviews that the service need to be improved drastically because you claim to be fine dining, customers do not need to prompt for the tea to be refilled. This was not a very impressive meal for my trip to Singapore.
author: Peter Gan

review_text: Way overpriced. Staff not attentive, more worried about getting the bill payment and closing up. No water offered. Took 15 minutes to actually be asked if we want a drink or to order. People next to us came much later received food first. We received our food not together but one disg every twenty minutes which is pathetic for Japanese as it's generally cold dishes and eaten within a few minutes. They also forgot one of the dishes and said out loud in front of us to the people next to us that they accidentally gave them our dish. So spent maybe 1 hour and 30 minutes here. Really bad service. I am from New Zealand and high end Japanese restaurants over here, are so much better. To end this restaurant is over priced, like way over priced! Never again will visit here.
author: Rhys Tau

review_text:
This restaurant was described in the Mandarin Bay Sands Hotel brochure as fine dining and so my wife decided to visit as we travel a lot and love Japanese food. We have eaten some excellent Japanese restaurants whilst travelling including Morimoto's in Napa, along with many around Australia, New Zealand, and other parts of Asia, most would blow this restaurant away in terms of quality, service and price. In fact after leaving Singapore we visited Thailand and ate Japanese (Sushi,Sashimi and other dishes) in the Indigo Pearl Resort and chef Jack (from California and not hint of Japanese in him) produced some of the best Japanese we have every eaten for half the price we paid at Hide Yamamoto in Singapore.

In short we were not only disappointed we were grossly under impressed as not only was it not fine dinning given that we were presented with bare wooden tables and basic surrounds but with chop sticks in paper that we had to tear apart!! I could live with that and the over the top pricing if the food was indeed fine dinning and were grossly disappointed again.

I will go as far as to say to people to just visit the food court as the Japanese food had there the following day was every bit as good and only 10% of the price. My comments would be too long if I were to put everything I thought into it. May I suggest that you will get better food, better service and pricing at a local Sushi Train.
author: Dale Gillham

review_text: Almost got turned away by the ratings here but really glad we followed our own intuition - food was amazing. Had their set menu and loved every dish - uni chawamusbi with truffle, wagyu beef, grilled mackerel... The price was definitely worth it for what we had. Recommend.
author: Nawei Chen

review_text:
Italian food is remarkably tolerant. It has survived colonial misadventures, airline cabins, and the concept of “truffle oil.” At Dolce Vita, it is asked to survive something more corrosive: a luxury hotel pool that has mistaken itself for a stage.

The food is the reason to come. And it largely justifies the decision. Bread arrives warm and worth eating. Olive oil behaves. Pasta is cooked by someone who understands restraint and timing. A braised beef dish on saffron-hued rice lands with quiet competence — rich, balanced, finished. Nothing is trying to impress you. Nothing needs rescuing. The kitchen appears to understand its role.

Unfortunately, the surrounding crowd does not.

Beside the tables unfolds an unrelenting performance of being seen. Diamond-studded bikinis flash aggressively in the sun. Mothers pose with perfectly miniaturised children — Versace swimwear scaled down for bodies still learning coordination — lifting, angling, arranging them like accessories. Leisure is not occurring. This is rehearsal. Documentation. Adults working very hard to appear effortless.

Phones rise constantly. Shots are retaken. Walking paths become runways. The pool is largely decorative; the water exists only as backdrop. No one is swimming. Everyone is presenting.

You eat pasta while surrounded by people who seem genuinely baffled that food might be the point. The effect is surreal, then faintly exhausting.

And yet — the staff.

The service is extraordinary, not because it sparkles, but because it endures. Calm, precise, and unfailingly professional, the staff move through this absurdity without commentary, visible irritation, or the eye-rolling such circumstances would normally invite. Plates arrive perfectly timed. Glasses are refilled. Requests are handled with grace. That they manage this without visible psychological injury feels less like hospitality and more like public service. Some form of civic recognition seems appropriate.

Dessert restores a brief sense of order. A vanilla panna cotta with a berry sauce of exacting balance — not sweet, not clever, simply correct — arrives and commands attention without asking for it. For a moment, something real takes precedence.

Dolce Vita is a good Italian restaurant trapped beside a deeply stupid performance. The food deserves linen, quiet, and people who understand why they are there. Instead, it competes with rhinestones, ring lights, and guests mistaking visibility for purpose.

Order with confidence.
Eat attentively.
Do not look toward the pool.
author: The Nihlistic Epicurean

review_text: We had amazing lunch in Dolce Vita. We went for a special lunch menu by the chef from Essenza. All the dishes were delicious, very flavourful and well presented. The truffle pasta with smoky mozzarella was an absolute winner. The service was very attentive, yet felt very natural.
author: Lee K

review_text:
I had dinner there with my friend.
Good location , very chilly space and not so clouded the day.
Food was very good and portion was just nice for 2 person to share.
But the tomahawk was really disappointed.
We requested Medium rare but came almost well done ….
Very dry and not even any apology from staff.
Btw every western restaurant always ask me doneness for beef but I haven’t eaten what I requested even 1 time in Singapore
author: Potato Head

review_text:
Have to give it to the waiters first: service was attentive and up to the standards set but the prices.

Atmosphere nice obviously on the roof top overseeing the Marina Bay. Maybe construction cranes make it less perfect, but as long as the construction site is not seen they sorta compliment the skyline.

Sadly, the food - the most important in a restaurant - was disappointing in my experience. Took the offered special (Christmas?) course menu. Starter risotto: scallop taste was overpowered by taste of milk in the sauce. Main: steak was great, but the fries that came with it were lukewarm.. Temperature is kinda key for fries imho. Creamed spinach was ok (hardly creamy despite the name, but i actually liked it like that). Felt hungry, so additionally ordered pastas: one was average tasting tomato lobster, and the vongole was just tasteless(!) and not ardente. Chocolate cake desert was very nice. Finally, the cheese plate tasted like they grabbed some stuff from FairPrice.
author: Anatoli Shakin

review_text:
One of the rare places that I would give 5 star rating.
Went there for lunch recently, it’s a bit of a maze to find the restaurant but it’s through a discreet part of Marina Square and then up the lift by the poolside.
I wish the hotel would have better signage on the ground level.

But we were greeted warmly with smiling faces at the restaurant despite being flustered that we were running late.
The lunch set menu was a good selection of items for people of different tastes and requirements.

Staff was also attentive to give us sharing plates and serving utensils without us asking. We thought that’s a very nice touch because usually mum & I like to share different selections but we always had to ask. We felt taken care of here.

Also, as it was too early for wine in the day, they served complimentary iced water which is refreshing since many such restaurants I’ve encountered only served bottled water which is unnecessary.

The food we had was all delectable. The burrata was creamy and portion good sized. Salad was fresh too. Enjoyed the carpaccio with yummy truffle bits and cheese savings. Chicken was crispy and cheesy. But the fried mash potato wasn’t our favorite. A bit hard and tasteless. Pasta was delicious though. Mum nearly finished it all! Pistachio ice cream was yummy. We haven’t had this flavor before and it’s nice.

The atmosphere here is nice, good view of the pool, relaxing environment with tasty food and friendly attentive staff. We really enjoyed it and will be back in future.
author: M

review_text:
Shahi Maharani was quite disappointing overall. The food lacked authentic flavor, and the tastes were not great, especially for a restaurant that positions itself as a premium Indian dining experience. The buffet lunch, in particular, was underwhelming with limited variety and mediocre quality.

Service was poor and inattentive, which made the experience even less enjoyable. We had to wait longer than expected for assistance, and the staff didn’t seem very engaged or welcoming.

Also, just to clarify—this is not an outlet of Fairmont, which may confuse some guests due to the location.

Overall, there are much better Indian dining options in Singapore offering better food and service for the price.
author: Ismail Faseeh

review_text: Im a big fan of indian cuisine and this is my new favorite restaurant. everything was delicious, great seasoning, great textures, it was pure joy to eat. Mr. Sanjay was very helpful and kind. Live music added a nice touch, and the place itself is beautiful. Can’t wait to be back and try more!
author: Mia Sabathy白彌兒

review_text: I had been craving Indian cuisine lately and decided to visit this place. The grilled lamb chop was a true stand-out, as were the okra and the fish tikka. The relaxing ambiance makes it a perfect spot for dining and engaging in conversation.
author: CP

review_text:
I have always had a fondness for North Indian cuisine. During my university years in the US, a small, unassuming North Indian restaurant in my town offered a weekly Sunday lunch buffet. Even on a student budget, it was affordable and a welcome treat – a taste of authentic Indian food in the American Midwest. My experience at Shahi Maharani North Indian Restaurant transported me back to my university days and that humble North Indian restaurant.

A friend had mentioned this place to me before, and I would always noticed a crowd outside this restaurant when I went for my Treatsure food at the restaurants nearby. But their à la carte prices are always on the steep side, a bit too much for a non-occasional lunch. Recently, Shahi Maharani North Indian Restaurant has been offering an SG60 1-for-1 buffet promotion to celebrate Singapore's National Day for $60++. We decided to give this place a try, and at the same time, celebrate my friend's birthday, which is just three days away.

When we arrived at 12 noon, there was already a small crowd inside. There was a group of office workers here for their lunch.

The dishes were nicely presented and kept warm. Every dish was carefully labelled in English, showing the cooking method and ingredients. My favourites were Mixed Vegetable Pakora, Methi Aloo Gobi, and the highlight of the lunch, the papadum. And I must say, this is simply the best papadum I have had in ages. The crackers, ever so thin, light as a feather, and crispy as can be, were deep-fried to absolute perfection. Not a hint of oiliness about them, nor that greasy smell you sometimes get. Definitely my gold standard from now on, without a doubt.

The dishes were all impeccably balanced in terms of flavour, avoiding excessive salt or grease. The meats were perfectly marinated, tender, juicy, and had excellent texture. The Saffron Rice was expertly cooked, exhibiting the ideal firmness and showcasing the high quality of the basmati rice.

The fruits and desserts were equally impressive. The papaya was perfectly ripe, neither too soft nor too hard, with just the right sweetness. The watermelon, however, was slightly disappointing; its texture was a bit too soft, though the sweetness was fine. The Kheer, a rice pudding, was a particular highlight, with a perfect balance of sweetness and spices.

The chai was another standout. Unsweetened, it was ideal for those watching their sugar intake, and the balance of tea and milk was excellent, the tea itself rich and free from any bitterness or astringency.

The only drawback was the naan bread, which was a little doughy and tough, suggesting the dough hadn't been properly proofed. A North Indian restaurant serving subpar naan bread is like a Chinese restaurant serving under-cooked white rice. Utterly disgraceful to the native cuisine, I must say.

The restaurant itself has a sophisticated and opulent atmosphere. Clean and pleasant, it lacked the sometimes overpowering smell of burning incense found in some Indian restaurants. It was also encouraging to see a diverse clientele, with many non-Indian patrons enjoying the food.

The service was excellent; the waiting staff were polite, attentive, and efficient. The speed with which they served the papadums and cleared our dishes was particularly impressive.

All in all, my friend and I thoroughly enjoyed our lunch buffet at Shahi Maharani North Indian Restaurant. Good food, good service, good ambience – it was a truly delightful experience, it was. What more could one ask for, really? Well... except perhaps an improvement on the naan bread – I would have given the restaurant a full 5 stars, no question. Otherwise, it is a culinary experience that I would happily recommend to anyone looking for authentic North Indian cuisine in a sophisticated setting.

𝟮𝟳/𝟬𝟭/𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟲 - I have revisited the restaurant many times and I am delighted to report that they have at last perfected their naan bread. The dough is well-proofed, exceptionally soft and fluffy. As such, I am thrilled to increase my rating to a full 5 stars.
author: Kopi O Kaya

review_text: I love Shahi Maharani! The new renovation looks amazing. It's much more elegant now. The ambiance feels so classy and relaxing, it's perfect for any occasion. I've been coming here since I was a kid and the food and service are still great. The decor is beautiful and the staff is super friendly. Highly recommend!
author: Muhammad Khairen

review_text: We visited this restaurant today and really enjoyed our experience. The restaurant was almost full, with many families and couples, but it was not noisy at all. All the food was delicious. We especially liked the fried chicken with flax seeds, the rice, and the noodles. I also ordered a soup with fish maw and mushrooms, as well as crispy pork belly and crispy fish skin with egg yolk. It’s a tasty restaurant with good service. I really liked it!
author: Ekaterina Nurtaeva

review_text: Had a wonderful dining experience at Cherry Garden Chinese Restaurant by Chef Fei. The food was beautifully presented and packed with refined flavours — every dish felt thoughtfully crafted. Service was attentive yet warm, making the whole meal feel special and unrushed. Perfect spot for both intimate dinners and celebrations. Highly recommended if you appreciate modern Chinese cuisine done elegantly.
author: Patricia Yeo

review_text:
The Signature Dish "Lolly Pop" prawns with mayonnaise sauce is outstanding and the presentation truly memorable. The dish comes with 6 prawns but 4 disappeared before I could take a photo!
Other incredible dishes we had were Golden crispy fish skin with salted egg yolk, Deep-fried five-spice silver cod, Marinated celtuce with pickled chill and Cantonese BBQ Roasted Duck.
Thank you Chef Fei for a wonderful dining experience.
author: Brad Dale

review_text: My mom and I had an incredible dining experience at this restaurant. The service was incredibly attentive and caring. Mom always requested hot fresh ginger tea, and the staff was accommodating by not making the water too hot or cold. The food was exquisitely prepared, with meticulous attention to detail in each dish. We left the evening feeling satisfied but not overly stuffed. Special mention to Jennie for her exceptional service throughout the evening. We left the night feeling warm and cozy!
author: David Li

review_text: Everything was awesome. The food, prompt services & ambience was excellent.  Special thanks goes to Paolo, Murphy & Sakura. I was so impressed with Paolo, when my hubby dropped his napkin on the floor, he quickly replaced it with a new one. My hubby did not realise he dropped his napkin. Everything was top notch & our rating is 10/10. Thanks.
author: Tanusha Tan

review_text: Always love Lei Garden for their happy courteous staff providing attentive service, their restaurant’s ambience and delicious Cantonese food. The sea prawns we had were very sweet and fresh. Sharksfin was delicious in its own way. Half a Peking duck portion was big! Highly Recommended for dinning here for dim sum, lunch and dinner. ٩(^‿^)۶٩(๑❛ᴗ❛๑)۶
author: Clara Poh

review_text:
I've been to Chijmes on many occasions but always walked past Lei Garden without really noticing them, what a mistake because it's a fantastic Chinese restraint.
We'd booked only a few days before and were lucky to get in, online it showed as full but by ringing we were able to secure a table. From arrival you are well looked after by helpful staff and made to feel at home. Being a non-Chinese speaker myself wasn't a problem and we were nicely helped through the wide menu selection and found some of our favorite dishes and some new ones too. If you are after some special dishes it's best to advise them when booking to ensure it can be prepared for your visit. Each dish was amazing and so well prepared, we ordered many dishes and still had food left at the end of the evening which was packed for us to take home and enjoy later. Really good restaurant.
author: Andrew P (Highlight Photography)

review_text:
One of the best Cantonese restaurant in sg, with many varieties of hk dish to choose from.

Bao Luo Wan You is nice, consist of abalone, fish maw, sea cucumber with braised abalone sauce in a single dish.

Their braised bird nest with crab meat soup and bird nest with almond cream are recommended too.

This is a one star Michelin restaurant that is worth repeated visits.
author: Alan

review_text: 9 of us had lunch here on 30 Jan. We started with Lou Hei, followed by mostly tim sum with half a roast duck, vegetables and fried noodles. The food is tasty and prices are reasonable. The staffs are also friendly and quick in service. Nice Chinese restaurant to visit if you’re in Chimjes.
author: Jon Ng

review_text:
An outstanding dining experience.

Had a wonderful evening at Lei Garden located at Chijmes, and it more than lived up to its reputation. The Peking duck was superb — perfectly crisp skin and beautifully balanced flavours — and the crispy pork was equally exceptional.

What truly elevates the experience, however, is the service: attentive, polished, and genuinely welcoming without ever feeling intrusive.

Ideal for a special occasion or celebratory night out. Highly recommended.
author: Barney

review_text:
Chicken is well marinated and flavourful, the Tom Yum and Kang kong from the 2 pax set had a good level of spice. Kang Kong had a good wok hey as well. Steamed Fish is good, pairs well with the sour soupy gravy.

Calamansi and milk tea is pretty decent. The 2 pax set fed three people easily, and it came with dessert of the day which is gula melaka sago with coconut milk and longan. Sweet and creamy, it was really indulgent!

The service is amazing! Like legit, they are so attentive and quick to clear empty dishes and answer any queries we had on the set dishes and the food. Especially thankful for James because his service is top tier!

Even the general service with all the other waiters was amazing too! They took note of how we had three people despite getting one of the 2 pax set, and gave us an extra set of utensils to accommodate all of us.

I also love that it’s not very noisy here unlike other restaurants, giving it a good ambience.
author: Alethea Voo

review_text:
We liked their friendly services & smile at Bali-Thai in SunTec+.
We had ordered Olive Rice Set, Petai Fried Rice Set & Thai Milk Tea for our dinner.
We liked the taste for both the rice set. It was delicious 😋 & fulfilling. They even served us warm water as complimentary, as most restaurants will charge it.
author: Terence Oon

review_text: Very good food, while has Vegan option menu. Love it so much. I can feel the food even before eating already very good aroma. Definitely my favorites
author: 熊哥哥

review_text: Awesome vegetarian food. They have a special vegetarian menu which also marks no onion,no garlic,no eggs. They also can prepare food as per you spice level. Soulful food.
author: rutuja mehta

review_text:
Thank you to James and Afifah for the great hospitality, they were very friendly and all smiles :)

I had 2 orders of the papaya salad and one each of the butter and cereal prawns, along side the mango sticky rice and a drink to-go.
Excellent packaging as there were no spills at all (I walked about 45 mins in the evening crowd) and sauces/dressing were kept separate without asking. James also ensured to check I received everything in the bag, and thoughtfully offered suggestions on reheating.

The papaya salad’s always a favorite of ours, and complimented the fried prawns well.
author: Solar

review_text:
We had a nice meal at Brotzeit at Raffles City Singapore.

We ordered the Schweinshaxn Rösti and the Bauern Bratwurst.

The pork knuckle on the rösti dish was nicely crispy, and the rösti itself was well done with a good crisp on the outside. The crispy kale unfortunately wasn’t very crispy, and overall the dish felt slightly on the dry side. Still enjoyable overall 4/5.

The Bauern Bratwurst was very good. The pork sausage was juicy and flavourful, and they were quite generous with the roasted potatoes which paired nicely with the sausage. 4/5.

Service was good, fast, attentive, and friendly throughout the meal.

Overall 4/5, a solid spot if you’re craving German food in the city.
author: JT

review_text:
We were fortunate to arrive early and get a shared table near the kitchen. The kitchen door was not closed and we could see the large bin and some of the kitchen activity, Dan and Jessica’s warm and attentive service made up our enjoyable dining experience.

Dan recommended dishes for us and even helped us with the promotion we wanted to use. Jessica was friendly and thoughtful. She helped to slice the fish we ordered, served us with a cheerful smile even when just passing by, and refilled our water the moment it was half-finished.

The food was good as well. The ribs were slightly sweet but to my liking though not for the rest of the group. Overall, it was a pleasant dining experience, made even better with nostalgic Christmas songs and oldies playing in the background instead of loud and noisy songs which make talking difficult
author: Bee Lee

review_text: Nice experience. We don’t have barbarism cuisine often, but what we had was nice. Bratwurst sausage, sour kraut, Rossi w crackling, cous cous. Everything was flavoured well, albeit on the verge of being overly salted. Will return again to try the knuckle.
author: michael lin

review_text:
Service is great and the staff gave our attention even on Xmas day. While we were only given 2 hours to eat, food is served rather fast and we had half an hour to spare when we left. Salad was refreshing, goulash is really good and comes in hearty portion. Rosti falls off easily I thought and bit disappointing. However, the pork knuckle really lived up to it's name and the skin is so crackling good! Well worth the calories. Roasted chicken is ok not that great and certain part like the wing and breast were dry, but the sausages were really juicy.
Beer is also good and cold enough.
author: Jack

review_text:
Tolles Essen und tolle deutsche Atmosphäre! The vibes were great and we brought our Asian friends here. Really great time and food.

Ploy and Tutu were super friendly and made our experience so worth a visit. I had an injury on my foot and they made sure that I get some ice to keep the wound cool.
author: Max Wallisser

review_text:
I would like to compliment the team at this crystal jade for their truly exceptional service. From the moment we arrived, the staff were warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. They offered thoughtful recommendations, checked in at the right moments, and ensured that every detail of our dining experience was taken care of.

Well done to Ms Wendy, Lein, madam Hua and Karen.

The service was fast, friendly, and highly professional. Our dishes were served promptly, and the team consistently maintained a high level of courtesy throughout the meal. Their sincere hospitality made the entire experience even more enjoyable.

Thank you for delivering such outstanding service and creating a memorable dining experience. I will definitely recommend this restaurant to others and look forward to returning soon.
author: Gary Foo

review_text: My wife and I were here today (14 DECEMBER 2025) for a dim sum brunch. It has been a long time since we have dined at a Crystal Jade outlet. We ordered the following here: a Crystal Har Kau, a Steamed Cheong Fun Prawn, a Steamed Prawn Pork Beancurd, 3 pieces of Steamed BBQ Pork Bun, and a Pan-fried Carrot Cake. Overall, the dim sum here was good, but not great - the dim sum "skins" could have been better in encapsulating their contents, but the chilli paste here was very good. Service here was good - friendly and courteous. The dining ambience here was good - the tables were set apart nicely and the air-conditioning here was very good. By the way, we also took away a BBQ Pork Pastry, but felt that it was a tad underwhelming.
author: edtayjb

review_text:
Came to this branch on a Sunday night for dinner with my family, and it was relatively disappointing.

First and foremost, I must say the food was above average, there were hits and misses but overall the food tasted good. Vinaigrette wontons were not great, scallion noodles were awesome, XLBs were ok, carrot cake was the BOMB, easily the best dish here. The other dishes were quite good as well.

Service: while the frontline servers were friendly and helpful, food service was poorly managed, firstly, some appetizers came, but I had to ask them for the rice I ordered only after we finished some of the food cause we realized it wasn’t coming.
Next, there was a huge gap in between some dishes and our meal was a little bit of a stop start stop start affair which was irritating. The wait in between dishes was also too long and I hope they rectify this.

Overall an ok experience but I’m sure they can do better given the tough competition around them with this cuisine.
author: Cedric Seet

review_text:
Ordered Steamed Fish with Minced Garlic and Black Bean, and Sautéed Broccoli with Minced and Fried Garlic for dinner. Both dishes were delicious. Fish was big, fresh and steaming hot when served. Broccoli was nice too.
Nice atmosphere and good service.
author: DP

review_text: Food was decent but none of the dishes were memorable nor impressive. Given the entrance of multiple Chinese chains over the past year, this restaurant needs to be more innovative / improve their dishes to remain competitive in the food scene.
author: Wen

review_text: I came here for a quick breakfast, expecting a mediocre meal. However, I was pleasantly surprised because o had ordered the breakfast with a crouffle(?) and some portobello mushrooms which was absolutely amazing! There was also a sweet, croissant like bread. It was sweet and perfectly tasty! Everything was delicious with the exception of the dark cherry matcha. It was oddly foamy and the taste wasn’t as matcha-y as i had expected. Other than that, the meal was pretty good! I would definitely come back again-but without matcha.
author: Rachel Tan Yufan (Chijtpps)

review_text: This is my repeat visit to the outlet at Raffles City because of the warm and welcome service by the staff Ms Nancy. Her friendliness and helpfulness are beyond the standard service. Tiong Bahru cafe has other outlets but this sone is the best. Not only Nancy but the short hair staff at the counter I believe must be the manager is also very helpful. She is pro-active and offers her service instead of even ask. Ms Nancy deserves a promotion as she successfully carries your brand to a good name. My last wish is...I hope you will be a Halal certified F&B so that I can bring all my Muslim friends, family and relatives to come and enjoy the great food and drinks tha you serve here...❤️
author: watie shariff

review_text: Good place to chill with friends. Suitable for maximum 4 persons per table. Almond croissant is still very tasty to go with coffee.
author: Belle H

review_text: Great Reuben sandwich at this place. Very unexpected, but I’m glad we stopped by for some quick breakfast. As an Australian we’re picky on our flat whites, but these guys make a great coffee. Lots of really good stuff to eat here.
author: Niklas Hammarstrom

review_text: The food was overall pretty good. The chocolate pastry was mostly plain, kinda not worth it being $7. It was 95% puff and 5% chocolate. Very stingy…. The almond pastry was pretty sweet and tasty. The staff here are nice. Definitely worth coming for teabreak.
author: Brendan

review_text: Thai restaurant in purvis street bugis. You order with a QR code, pay after you eat, and they take Paywave. The food's awesome! The basil chicken or beef rice isn't too spicy, and you can pick how spicy you want your tom yum soup. Service is good too. Definitely recommend it!
author: Hartono Harjono

review_text: Reviews here don't make sense. This is my favourite Thai restaurant in Singapore. The green curry is incredible and so addictive. The crispy fried fish sweet and sour is so light and crispy yet so flavourful. The price point is also very cheap for the great quality of the food. This place deserves more popularity.
author: Yasmine S

review_text:
Terrible experience!! We ordered vegetarian, but they served prawn beehoon. After informing them, they simply removed the prawns and claimed it was re-cooked. While eating, we still found prawn legs. My friend is a lifelong vegetarian and I’m highly allergic to prawns, yet the chef and waiter insisted it was fine.

It’s not only careless but morally wrong to serve meat to vegetarians and dismiss allergies even after highlighting it to them many times....
author: Sophie Ying

review_text: Standard thai food i guess - nothing too special. The mango sticky rice slapped, and the thai green curry was really good.
author: Aravind K. Saravana

review_text:
Excellent Thai food. Honestly loved everything.

For starters, the prawn cakes tasted great and sets a good tone for the meal. The pad thai is flavourful, not the bland ones you find from others.

Both mains are delicious! Out of everything, the yellow curry is my favourite, can't get enough of it. It pairs so well with rice, you just keep going in and scooping for more. The tom kha kai is also good.

Meal rounded up by a glass of thai milk tea. Service could be better though, didn't feel that classic warmth from a Thai restaurant. Still giving it full points since we enjoyed the food that much.
author: Ruth Go

review_text:
Came down for friend's birthday dinner. 1st visit to this buffet.
Given a round table all the way to the end of the restaurant. Felt a little neglected at the 1st half of our duration there as plates were not cleared that efficiently.

Asian Market Cafe has a good spread but pales in comparison to its neighbour, Clove.

1 long stretch buffet line where food ranges from cold seafood - salad - laksa -grilled clams&mussels - cooked food - satay - roast beef - grilled salmon - more cooked foods.
2 kiosks-like stalls where the drinks and desserts are respectively.

Food overall is quite ok good. Special mention for the durian mousse, teh tarik, grilled salmon and laksa.

Staff here are rather friendly especially the lady whom served the birthday boy a cake. She helped to light the candle, sing birthday song and also took photos for us. Incredible

Will return if there is another opportunity
author: Bryan Fang

review_text:
We celebrated our  New Year get-together there lunch was fully packed , and it was truly a memorable experience for my family.

A special thanks to Anarul for making the evening feel extra special. His service was warm, attentive, and genuinely caring. He made sure my family was comfortable and well looked after throughout the celebration.

The food selection was excellent fresh and beautifully presented and the crab was absolutely next level. It really made our celebration even better.

We truly enjoyed everything and will definitely be coming back again.
author: Tran Nguyen Anh Minh

review_text: It’s a nice hotel restaurant tucked in a corner of Raffles City. The buffet spread is magnificent, and one can expect to be spoilt by the spread of choices. Highlights include the laksa, which featured a thick and flavourful broth with generous amounts of ingredients. The cold platter stuff was fresh and tasty while the cooked stuff are a delish. Definitely worth the money and the experience.
author: XY Sim

review_text:
Was very crowded, think because of the 50% discount promotion going on.
But service was still attentive and friendly.
The food runs out quickly but staff replenishes it quickly as well.
The sashimi and scallops were very fresh.
The rojak station was good esp the crackers. The satay was plump and juicy.
Some of the fish dishes were flavourful, and I like the skin of the fish, very gelatinous.
Chilli crab was ok. Had fried manitou but the sauce flavour balance was not quite there, maybe too starchy also.
Desserts were average.
Durian pengat was also ok, fragrant but flavour not as strong as I expected.
author: Kelvin Goh

review_text: My 2nd visit in 2 weeks. Will be there for the 3rd time next week. Everything just felt so nice the moment we stepped in to the restaurant.  Cosy ambience,  excellent and friendly services, good variety of food and drinks totally value for money. Food replenished fast, too! The fish and satay were perfect for me, while the cold station for my sister. My nephew loved the salmon sashimi, and my husband enjoyed the main dishes. My niece had several servings of the chilli crab and it was finger-licking! Drinks were generous, too. Teh tarik was good! We are not really a dessert person but we enjoyed the dessert station especially the hazelnut cake and durian! And thanks for the nian gao for this festive!
author: Samantha CS

review_text: Had executive set lunch, lovely starters of angel hair pasta, squid with black ink. Mains of seared cod, wagyu beef done nicely. Pleasant, enjoyable meal, but overall felt tired and not very inspired compared to previous meals. The staff were polite, dutiful though coming across as cold. Some change in decor would help it feel less dark and foreboding.
author: Joy KC

review_text:
Came on a weekday for birthday celebration and was pleasantly surprised by the food quality. Easily one of the best meals I have had in Singapore (coming from a local). The food was so good that it beats some of the Michelin star restaurants I've tried.

Every dish was a hit, literally no misses.
We had the set lunch and everything was good but if we had to choose favorites, appetizer would be the seared atlantic squid (literal flavor bomb, never had squid seared this way before), dessert would be the apple tart. For mains, iberico pork jowl was so soft and flavorful. Lobster was perfectly cooked and paired well with the bearnaise sauce.  Even the complementary petite fours were so good! 🥹 (Photos provided may not serve the justice it deserves 😂)

Service was amazing as well and they even prepared a small birthday treat for us! Very sweet of the restaurant! Chef Gunther was walking around (with his local good morning towel) and asking for feedback, which made the whole experience much more genuine. We will definitely be back for another special occasion!
author: Rilla Teo

review_text:
Every dish was delicious. The prices are on the higher side, but the food quality is excellent. We ordered several dishes and the staff kindly divided them into smaller portions for each person, allowing us to try a variety. The service was outstanding — the staff gave great recommendations and were friendly and attentive throughout.

The staff generously treated us to complimentary desserts, including canale, chocolate and ice cream. Thank you very much
author: T&B

review_text:
Gunther's, while not the flashiest of French restaurants, is still low-key amazing. My last visit there was for lunch nearly 10 years ago, but memorable enough that I had to return.

This humble fine dining option does not disappoint. Chef Gunther's signature cold truffle angel hair pasta was an absolute delight, although I recommend visiting during truffle season to elevate the dish a level higher, although it's delicious as is. Their lunch promo is a steal for this level of dining, although we went for dinner and opted for the 4 course degustation menu, and paired it with a fantastic bottle of white which was reasonably priced.

A 4 course dinner at a restaurant like this can sometimes leave you feeling hungry afterwards, yet we left content, even a bit full. Our server, Kat, as well as the other servers, were incredibly attentive, friendly, and prompt. Each dish was cooked to perfection and plated elegantly, never over the top, always humble. For dessert my partner opted for the apple tart, while I chose the farm cheeses - both simply fantastic. Then Kat brought us the truffle chocolates, financiers, and crispy-edged buttery canele that were a delightful compliment from the kitchen.

Our evening at Gunther's was a memorable one, we'll be back. Merci beaucoup for the experience!
author: Travis H.

review_text:
friend bought 3pax lunch

@ Gunther

S$48 restaurant week menu

baguette was good 👍

smoked salmon with asparagus was good, salmon very lightly smoked, in-house

scallops on shell was big and plump, nicely done

pork shoulder quite tasty, texture not the best some tough bits. the shell pasta was good 👍

seems they ran out of prawns for YS, asked to replace with crab meat. pretty good dish

for dessert I selected cheese platter,  pretty standard

great lunch and wonderful dinner with friends

17.4.2025
author: chefquak
