Brought the family here for pizza night, service staff were friendly and service pace remain efficient despite a rather crowded Friday night. Thumbs up to Ira and her team 👍👍👍

We ordered 3 types of pizzas, the overload pizzas are worth going for with +$3 for extra meat ingredients! Crust is the soft n fluffy type, although we noticed their food taste a bit on the bland side. But that's really ok (better than overly salted)
Save room for their tiramisu, it's pretty good!
author: Berlinda Goh

restaurant_name: Pizza Express | The Star Vista (Buona Vista, Holland)
review_text:
Dropped by Pizza Express and tried their peperoni pizza and seafood aglio olio. The pizza hit a nice balance—flavourful sauce, not overly cheesy, and the meat was tasty without being greasy.

The aglio olio was a pleasant surprise: prawns were fresh, pasta had a good bite, and the spice gave it a satisfying kick. Would’ve been a solid meal all around, but the manager lady’s vibe was a bit off—service could’ve been warmer.
author: John

restaurant_name: Nando’s Star Vista | Flame-Grilled PERi-PERi Chicken
review_text: unique dining experience. food is quite unique taste and flavorful. nicely decorated restaurant withlot of comforable seats & good service. Ixlike the spaciousness and the outdoor feel.
author: Sam Goh SE

restaurant_name: Nando’s Star Vista | Flame-Grilled PERi-PERi Chicken
review_text:
The wingettes & drumettes look so sad tbh.
Not sure why the sides were not served together, but more than 10 minutes later after some prompting. Staff seemed super confused with our orders for some reason. I could tell Jason was trying his best to make sure we all got our food (thank you!), but generally it felt very disorganised. Also asked for a lime (calamansi) for my chicken but staff said it was only for the mild flavour, I was not entitled to a lime since I ordered hot. Okay…

Our group was disappointed because the quality of the food did not justify its price. $16 for some sad wings and 2 sides… when you really can get a whole chicken chop and 2 sides for a few bucks cheaper elsewhere. We all agreed we wouldn’t be back to Nando’s.
author: M

restaurant_name: Nando’s Star Vista | Flame-Grilled PERi-PERi Chicken
review_text: Chicken grilled to perfection.  Moist tender tasty.  Small serving had whole chicken for $40.90. compared to London Kings Cross GBP16.95 on its own. see photo of UK menu.  pricey, good enough for two men only on its own
author: Porter KHOR

restaurant_name: Nando’s Star Vista | Flame-Grilled PERi-PERi Chicken
review_text: Nice n fast serving even tho its lunch time n restaurant is full. Soup is serve hot but I cannot order yuzu drink in the apps. Only comes in jug. Ask the waiter, he ask to order at counter. Hmmm
author: Miss Zoob

restaurant_name: Nando’s Star Vista | Flame-Grilled PERi-PERi Chicken
review_text:
Very cozy ambiance with very friendly staff. Surprised with my birthday treats.

Thanks Esabel :) and Manager for lovely lunch.
author: Kapil Aswani

review_text: Always love the sourdoughs from 🇸🇬 Singapore!! Managed to grab x 2 sourdough here yeahhhh: Blue Pea Cranberry Sourdough & Whole Wheat Sourdough 😍😋 Can you see the description of the ingredients? That's OMG indeed! Gemini ♊️ told me both good 👍 yeahhh but have to consume it after your main meal, especially fibers & protein, then your insulin must be super steady because of the fermented foods!! Love ❤️ it !!
author: COCO nonosugar

review_text:
Nice place to rest my feet.
Nice place for a peaceful rest without anyone screaming.
Background music quite soft.
Didn't have young children screaming.
Nice ambience with peaceful decor in the cafe itself

Outside was quite hot at 33. But inside the cafe it was cooling.
Air con was strong you didn't feel like 33 which is the outside temperature. So I felt it will be a place I'll come back again.
Eggless tiramisu was great. I ate the whole slice of cake for myself.
Cafe latte was Abit too much iced but overall I still like this place.
author: Ivy Chan

review_text: You can never go wrong with Cedele. They introduced me to sourdough years ago, and I particularly like the Eight Treasure Sourdough ($9.90), which has a very nice chewy texture and isn't too tangy, making it great as a pairing bread for any meal. The Spring Onion Bagel ($?) is perfect for a light sandwich. Their cakes have never failed me. While I typically go for the cream varieties, during this recent visit, I tried the Cherry Pistachio Slice ($4.80) for the first time and loved the crumbly and buttery texture. I will definitely come back for this again.
author: Touristmouse

review_text:
Price is acceptable. The service is quite normal, nothing great but also not bad.
The eggless cake was smooth and rich. Coffee is normal mediocre, nothing wow.
One section of the cafe was blocked up and placed with their products.. not sure what but I don’t think it should be there.
author: Sibyl Tate

review_text: Richard is an amazing worker who came running to us as we needed feedback on what breads to select for our dinner. This man richard really made my day with his outstanding service he managed to convince me to buy the most expensive bread and I will surely come back for. Sincerest thanks to richard and whoever decided to hire him😁😁😁
author: YeeT Flash

review_text:
Dear Management,

If you would like to understand the reason behind my 1-star review or if you genuinely care about your company’s reputation, please provide me with your direct email address so I can share my experience in detail.

For your reference, we were served by Joy from your service crew. We ended up leaving without consuming the food and drinks we ordered — we simply paid and left.

Thank you.
author: Ben L

review_text: A special thanx to Doreen who was extremely welcoming guests into the restaurant. She was alert enough to notice empty cups to refill with water. Was a nice gesture for Cocoichi to provide ice/warm water for guests. The ultimate tasting experience is still having the curry with non sugared drink to enjoy the best taste of Cocoichi' s curry, still my most favorite among the various Japanese brands which extended their business here in Singapore. Will visit again this outlet again to visit Doreen cos shes really nice throughout. Do find her around this outlet. It's extremely rare to find staff had passion overlimits, as most wasnt such case. Keep it up! The curry experience today was made an even better one with Doreen's presence.
author: 雨、文。

review_text: Got the omelette rice katsu curry rice. Generous portions and flavour, definitely didn't cut back on the curry! Service was also impeccable with Annie and Lisa covering for our table, will highly recommend
author: Shankar T

review_text: Excellent curry! Great environment and wonderful staff makes dining at Coco Ichibanya a nice and pleasant experience! Thank you for your service at Star Vista outlet ☺️
author: S. Sofian

review_text:
Ordered pork katsu curry, additional rice and spice +4. Added eggplant and egg.
Curry was the best, and even with the added spice level, it kept the flavor of curry intact. This is a huge plus as sometimes added spice level destroy the curry taste.
Pork j
Katsu was tasty. Staff very friendly and helpful.
author: Shocho Shocho

review_text: Amidst the deep cost cutting measures in the F&B, Ippudo’s reliable quality and consistency is reassuring and comforting. We had a few disappointing ramen lately and coming back to Ippudo invigorated us. We had the lunch set that came with a side and a drink. Plus a couple of ala carte ramen. It was a good lunch.
author: M L

review_text:
Ordered their lunch set, that comes with a side and a drink. Only the hot green tea is refillable. We also ordered 2 sides items, cold cucumber and a beef.

The chicken Karage side that comes with the set meal taste below average, all else, is good.

Staff is friendly and explained to us the various options for the set meal, and even helped us to order.

Overall, still recommended.
author: Chris

review_text: This is a very straightforward ramen restaurant experience at Star Vista. Amidst the many dining options, it’s a reliably predictable choice: you order, get a bowl of ramen with a standard taste profile, eat, pay, and leave. It wasn't a mind-blowing meal, but it serves its purpose.
author: Flo Yeow

review_text: Tried the Tropical Cold Ramen, very firm and chewy noodles, very interesting as it tastes very different from the usual ramen I had. There are tiny bits of pineapples  and celery is interesting. The fresh coriander, mint leaves and crispy potato chips give it a refreshing and interesting texture. I would describe the dish as refreshing, cold, spicy, thick soup, crunchy and chewy noodles.....should give it a try.
author: Kase Zheng

review_text:
Comforting bowl of ramen - broth was thick and creamy, meat was tender and soft, noodles were well-cooked to preferred hardness.

Crispy mushroom w truffle mayo sides weren’t outstanding.
author: Nicole Quek

restaurant_name: Canton Paradise 樂天小香港 at The Star Vista
review_text:
The lotus leaf glutinous rice, the dumplings in chili oil and vinegar plus the deep fried crispy egg plants are so delicious!
Great service and lovely atmosphere.
author: Posh Pearl

restaurant_name: Canton Paradise 樂天小香港 at The Star Vista
review_text:
happy lunar new year!

are you a of dim sum ?

had cny Lo Hei here !

delicious  dimsum and attentive  fast service despite full house ..simply awesome !
author: Coco happyprincess

restaurant_name: Canton Paradise 樂天小香港 at The Star Vista
review_text:
July 2025
We were being usher to a little corner at the end of the far room. Good point is we enjoyed the privacy; bad point is waiters and waitresses were no where to be seen. We need to go out and call them. No bell to press for assistance.

We ordered set menu and added on a few other dishes. I didn't take photo of all food served. Taste was average, fat duck is really fat!
Very slow in serving the food and interval timing was quite bad that we almost finished our carbs before they served our last 2 dishes. We can't finished them as both dishes were too salty to eat with rice or noodles.

This is the 1st time i ate at Canton Paradise and encountered such issue. Usually their services was ok. Maybe we should not take that back-corner table. 😅
author: L Wong

restaurant_name: Canton Paradise 樂天小香港 at The Star Vista
review_text:
四季豆 they use the long beans not so nice.
Other dishes were good
Recommend the crispy duck and roast pork!
Horfun was decent too
author: Golden Rays c

restaurant_name: Canton Paradise 樂天小香港 at The Star Vista
review_text:
Ordered 3 dishes, two of which are new tasting dishes (steamed kampong chicken with cordyceps flowers in claypot; Stewed Thai style pork rib in claypot) and a 3rd dish is a fish from the menu which I often ordered.
The fish dish TODAY are very thin sliced pieces compared to thick pieces I used to get whenever I ordered.
The Stewed Thai style pork rib doesn't taste much different from the jing du pai gu in the menu which I also often ordered.
The steamed kampong chicken dish is disappointing! 1st, the chicken pieces are all pieces of bones with VERY LITTLE Meat!!! 2nd, the chicken pieces not hardly have meat to bite but the chicken is also hard - - NOT tender like kampong chicken at most restaurants!!! 3rd, the chicken pieces are deep-fried without marinated, then stir-fried with a special gravy. Therefore, the chicken meat has no taste. The taste is only in the outside of the chicken. 4th, don't understand why the name of the dish is steamed chicken  when the chicken is actually deep-fried plus stir-fry with the sauce to make the dish appetising. If the dish had been steamed, the meat will NOT be so tough!

The first photo is the bone after I tried very hard to bite off a little meat. Can everyone see the SIZE of a piece of chicken before being eaten and the SIZE of the bone left on the plate is almost the same? This shows how little meat goes into my stomach!
I believe the restaurant bought frozen drumsticks, chopped into pieces for each claypot, that why every piece is all bone. When I put the pieces together in the claypot, it seems that each claypot has only ONE drumstick chopped into 4 or 5 pieces!!! For that ONE drumstick, the dish is sold for $15.80++.
author: Joy BHX

review_text:
We ordered the “Hokkaido Pork Katsu Set” and the “Pork Fillet Katsu Gyoza (3 pcs) Set” from their Weekday Lunch Menu.

This must have been my fifth visit here, and I keep coming back because I’ve always enjoyed both their katsu and the service (despite some of the mixed reviews I’ve seen here).

Once again, the katsu did not disappoint. The pork was nicely breaded and fried to a crisp on the outside while remaining tender and juicy inside. The portion was satisfying, and the flavors were exactly what I had come to expect from previous visits.

We also enjoyed the accompanying side dishes - rice, soup, and cabbage salad. The cabbage salad remains free-flow, just as before, which is great if you enjoy having extra vegetables to balance out the richness of the fried pork.

However, I did notice that the rice and soup no longer seem to be free-flow. Previously, this was indicated on the menu, but I didn’t see it mentioned this time. I’m not sure if the policy has changed or if it’s simply no longer advertised, but it was something I picked up during this visit.

Overall, it was still a very enjoyable meal, and the consistent quality of the katsu is the main reason I keep returning.
author: P Lim

review_text:
Ordered the premium Pork loin, pork is juicy and tender. Curry is not spicy, rice is also nicely cooked. Asked for more curry and there is more curry.

Udon soup is salty. Udon is thin noodles.

Serve refillable veg and rice.

Pretty empty on the weekday dinner
author: Orange

review_text:
A nice restaurant serving good tonkatsu. Several toppings available on the tontaksu such as miso or mentaiko.

It can get pretty packed during peak hours at lunch. During lunchtime, various set meals are available as well.

Ordered the mentaiko tonkatsu and the breaded pork cutlet was served with a heaping load of mentaiko on top it. It will be popular with diners that love mentaiko.
author: Jing Jie Ng

review_text: Used not to like it but now a big fan. They serve thin udon which is now my family's favourite! Well fried ebi while soft in the inside and really delicious katsu. The katsu i feel is still better in ma maison @mandarin gallery but not far off - i heard the latter is not always consistent in other locations.
author: Drift King

review_text:
Went there for lunch on a Friday afternoon and it’s not crowded. Was served with a dirty table (obvious cup stained from don’t know how many diners before me. Refer to image attached). No serviettes were issued together with the utensils. You have to ask for it.

Ordered pork loin with pork filet set. The pork loin was pathetically small as compared to other jap restaurant pork loin. Other restaurants I had was palm size this serves finger size pork. Free flow of vege with sesame sauce. But again, you have to ask for refill due to serious understaff.

Service was bad. There’s only ONE staff that assign walk in customers to the seat, issue menu, clear dishes when the customers are done with their meal, clean table, collect payment. You have to ask the staff to refill your drink, give serviettes or refill vege.
There is another staff who serve dishes out to customers but realised she’s with ear pods on her ear and showing an unhappy face (maybe she had a bad day). Even when I asked for refill of vege, she just had eye contact with me and nod her head after I point the bowl of vege. No smile or no chats. Nothing.

IMO, the price is not worth the food and service. I will not go back again.
author: Saa Saa

review_text:
Repeat visit. Service was good and fast unlike what some recent reviews mentioned. This was 7 to 8pm on a Saturday and we didn't have to wait long for the food.

We did the signature buffet. The karubi and dragon karubi can be fatty which result in flash flames. The stars were the misuji (normal not the diamond cut) and the tongue which were very nice.
author: Calvin Chin

review_text: Food was very good, especially the signature ice-cream.  Service was excellent, with special mention to Harris.    He greeted us with a big smile and made the family feel very welcome in the restaurant. Customer service was prompt and he checked in constantly with us asking about the food quality.  Thank you Harris for the excellent service.
author: Caleb

review_text: Nice cuts of meat and tongue. We zeroed in on the beef only. The two dipping sauces (no photos) were really quite delicious. We garlic fried rice was good, too. The ambience wasn’t so pleasant for this price for food though. Really loud and the restaurant was half full because of safe distancing.
author: Nicole Yeong

review_text:
We went at 5pm, no reservation, no waiting time, peaceful environment. staff are very helpful and friendly. Price are consider high, the service crew will teach us how to “cook” when they serve every dishes.
The meat are super fresh. Good job
author: Chin Kang Teh

review_text: This restaurant offers a delightful dining experience, specializing in BBQ and yakiniku prepared in Japanese style. The powerful ventilation system ensures a comfortable environment despite the smoky grills. The quality of the meat is good, with tender cuts and excellent marbling. However, the service is lacking in attentiveness, which can be frustrating at times. Overall, it's a great spot for BBQ lovers seeking authentic Japanese flavors, but improvements in service would elevate the experience further.
author: GKN

review_text: Restaurant does not exist anymore!!!
author: Anil Malpani

review_text:
Tables were placed close together, resulting in lack of privacy for diners. I now know the exact travel plans of the diners seated beside my table.

Food took a long time to arrive and it did not taste good. You can have a look and compare the order to the photo in the menu. The sauce looked like an afterthought and the chef was a tad too liberal with the salt.

Service was slow and I would assume it’s due to the lunch crowd. What I don’t understand is how I did not get a QR for ordering when they seated me. It should be a part of their SOP, no?

The price is reasonable and I am sure the place is better during off peak hours. Nevertheless, I don’t recommend this place and won’t be back again.
author: Prisca Lai

review_text:
The restaurant has a pleasant ambiance and looks aesthetically nice. However, the tables are placed very close to one another—less than the length of a standard long ruler—which made the seating feel a little cramped and lacking privacy.

I ordered the sashimi salad. Unfortunately, the sashimi did not taste fresh especially tuna, the color turn dark which was quite disappointing. That said, the accompanying special salad sauce was flavorful and enjoyable.

I requested wasabi from one of the staff members. While she did bring it over, her facial expression seemed to suggest surprise—as if she was questioning why I would need wasabi with a salad, especially since the sauce was already provided. Perhaps it was just my perception, but I appreciate that she still fulfilled the request.
author: Jamie Tan

review_text:
Good Japanese Cuisine.
Ordered the Set Menu because of Mizu Shingen Mochi which is ok but not spectacular.
Have not tried the original one in Japan yet so not able to make any comparison.
author: Chee Wan Lim

review_text: It’s fine. Just didn’t like the rice is it’s too wet. A bit more and it’ll be like kueh
author: JX

review_text: A fantastic, classy restaurant perfect for any occasion, be it a family dinner or just a quick meal with friends. The quality of the food is top notch, with the meat cooked just right and the noodles easy to chew but not too soft at the same time. And the staff? So professional! Shout out to Elsie, Cerine and En Kee for their brilliant service. Overall, a restaurant I would definitely visit again in the near future.
author: Knockalicious Reviews

review_text: High ceiling, great music and cosy environment. If you looking for private time with your friends and family, this the place to go for! Personally i love their fish and chips. Cripsy batter with snapper meat to satisfy your stomach!
author: Jonathan Ong

review_text: Went to Bodacious bar & bistro for the second time. I am impressed with the consistent quality of the food, nice ambience and welcoming staff. The dessert of the day - a very nicely paired coconut ice cream with blue pea crème brûlée was the highlight of the night. It’s a great end of a hearty dinner. Thanks to the team for the great effort.
author: lanli w

review_text: We were at the cafe for our team lunch and we totally enjoyed the food and service provided by the staff. A rare gem in Biopolis :)
author: hello user

review_text: Environment was cosy while staff were welcoming and attentive. For the price, food quality and quantity was great. Draft beers at less than $8++ per pint. This place deserves higher ratings and patronage.
author: CK C

review_text:
Had a birthday celebrations here as it was also pet-friendly and can host bigger groups.

We like the parmesian wings, fries and cauliflower, and they serve Stella Artois draft beer here.

The Tiramisu and lava cakes were excellent as well. We enjoyed the warm and friendly service here too!

Parking is free after 7pm along the road with single white line.
author: Melvin Yo

review_text:
Here for a gathering dinner to mark another close of a year.
We came as a group of 29pax. Enjoy the promotion of 50% off with min. 4 pax, ala-carte dinner buffet.
We occupied 3 tables at the corner of the restaurant which was right next to the kitchen.

We experienced full on service from the staff as we were the earliest reservation. Kudos to them for paying much attention to us.

We tried almost everything on the menu as can be seen from the uploaded photos. Food quality is quite good as most of us agreed upon. Repeated orders were ice plant salad, spicy chicken bites(辣子鸡), Xiao Bai Chye with mushroom, fried winglets and the ice jelly dessert. The peking roast duck was aplenty, skin was super crispy, ate it with the egg wrap, cucumber slices and the given sauce.

Truly a great dining experience overall. Glad we chose to have our dinner here.
author: Bryan Fang

review_text: i should hav read the previous review by Phoebe on cny set. really a rip off for their cny take away set. so now  im very sure its their standard. menu had no pics. ordered 2 different sets of 2pax set. my cny dinner totally ruin by tis restaurant. louhei alzo never come with ANY sauces. not even pepper! endup i could not do my louhei w my family.  see below pic the food qty is ridiculous little. 1prawn 2pc rib🤦‍♀️🤬  i close to tell them on the spot i wan a complete refund n cancel but i know i need to rush off to hunt for another restaurant for food.😭 my cny dinner completely spoil by tis restaurant. i better tell my collegues nex time dun order cny sets from office downstairs peach garden.
author: Coolman Ken

review_text:
We held our company annual dinner here last Friday night, and it was a wonderful experience. The food portions were very generous and everything tasted great. The pricing was very reasonable, and the location was very convenient.

The service team was friendly, attentive, and very well organized. Our boss, colleagues, and guests were all very happy and satisfied with both the food and the service.

Special thanks to the person-in-charge, Randy — we call him our “Superman”! 💪 He was extremely helpful and kind, even helping us to move and rearrange tables at the last minute. He was very approachable, attentive, and always did his best to accommodate our requests.

We would also like to thank the supergirls, Joy, Poh Choo, and the rest of the team for their warm and friendly hospitality. Even though we arrived during their break time to prepare, they were still very helpful and never ignored us — instead, they went out of their way to assist us.

Truly appreciate the team’s dedication and excellent service. We will definitely come back again and highly recommend this place for company events and gatherings!
author: Jacklyn Yi

review_text:
Came here for the buffet promotion, celebrated my dad's birthday with the entire family. I totally love the warmth service shown by the entire crew, I didnt catch the auntie's name with the Graduate A Line Bob hair cut, special shoutout to her and million thanks for the fantastic service. If she isn't the team leader yet, I would appreciate this appointment to be given to her, table-touch skill of hers are great.

Food also came fresh and hot, my favorite will be the drunken prawn and grouper fish. Well done chef team, totally love the presentation as well.

Service 10/10
Food 10/10
Cleanliness 10/10

Definitely will come again.
author: JNWS

review_text:
4 of my classmates had dinner at Peach Garden at the Metropolis but the food did not turn out to be good.

It is al carte buffet we can order from the menu which has limited dishes available from 7.45pm to 9pm.

Waiter check with us whether we want tea but did not inform that it is not included in the buffet price we paid.   The total price we paid with tea is S$41 net each.   The Tea for 4 is S$20.

1) We were given complimentary Peking duck but the skin taste fine but the meat is tough  and chewy.

2) sweet and sour pork – the pork had thick fat, starchy and tasted too sweet without any sour effect.

3)	Sichuan chicken – it was just a plate of deep-fried and oil was not drain well.  The chicken pieces were tiny with some chili.

4)  Abalone Buddha soup – only one mini piece of abalone, and this order cannot be repeated.

5)   Deep-fried soon hock – it was salty.

6) Desserts are not good too, just plain sweet water not much effort put in. It is just like the above dishes.

Overall, the things acceptable are the 2 dishes of prawns and brinjal.   The standard of the food taste and quality is lower than some good coffee shop economic rice  stalls.

This is my first and last to Peach Garden.
author: Ngai Sarah

review_text: Beers were competitively priced at $10-12 nett/pint all night. Spacious seating both indoors and outdoors. This is not really an izakaya as I don’t remember the menu contained any grilled dishes. The quality of the dishes that I ordered were substandard. Will return for drinks but not food.
author: CK C

review_text:
Decent, affordable Japanese food. My go to lunch at that area for comfort Japanese food.
And there’s discount for some staff in the offices in that area!

-update-
Had the curry beef rice and it was actually quite good! Will be nicer if it’s hot.
author: Han Lee

review_text:
A friend of mine suggested this place and the food was actually pretty good. Not only was it yummy but quite generous portions too. The restaurant is actually quite spacious with big tables suitable for group gatherings. we ordered some ramen and the soup was pretty tasty. If you dont like bamboo shoot, make sure you ask them to not put in your ramen as the smell and taste was abit strong to our liking. As we arrived after
8pm, some dishes were already unavailable. To avoid
disappointment, make sure you head over early. I ordered the sake soda which was quite good to my surprise. Go ina group so that you can try more dishes!
author: Carolina Lee

review_text: Ordered 2 of their set lunches at around $16 each (about $20 after service charge and GST). The food was decent, with no standout hits or misses. The restaurant design is nice and spacious, and the cashier that day was the boss, Adam Chen.
author: LP Pua

review_text: Highly recommend the food and extremely pleased with the service :) Will be back.
author: Jane Wong

review_text: Standard franchise that you can probably find in many other places. That also ensures a certain quality control for the products they serve across the country. They have good dough fritters you tiao here, and we always get their butterfly bun as well. Great for that morning breakfast snack you need, to go with your morning soya bean milk or coffee.
author: Flo Yeow

review_text:
Delicious snack! Even though i picked the last carrot cake and is still warm! The uncle that served me was kind and super friendly. Cheers

Taste and service is always subjective.
author: Capture Asia Photography

review_text:
We will normally just go for their goreng pisang since it's value for money at $1.20 for such a huge piece.

The rest of the stuff,like youtiao, butterfly, are reasonable tasting and also priced at $1.20 market price.
author: Botak

review_text: Ordered you tiao, fried green beans and banana fritters. So crispy . Love all of them!
author: SK Ho

review_text: Good tasty snacks like it’s popular You Tiao and Butterfly. One of the better ones that you can find.
author: Donald Chen

restaurant_name: Bao Gong XO Fish Head Bee Hoon
review_text: Ranks as one of the worst food places I’ve gone to. The 三捞河粉 was bland and the bean sprouts were definitely NOT stem-only. The “伊面” was 伊面 in name only, and had zero flavour until the sliced chili was added. If you dine in, you get a constant supply of second-hand cigarette smoke. Never again, even if you paid me to.
author: Stan L

restaurant_name: Bao Gong XO Fish Head Bee Hoon
review_text: Wow still here after 6 years, adding in my review for my 30 Dec visit, not too bad experience, very patient staff, ordered about 6 dishes cost me 132, eat by 6 mouths, I think portion size is decent, fish soup is medium, they gave me extra bowl of soup, no coffee pork rib here so I was quite disappointed, not too salty and still made some impression in terms of taste, Remb to reserve a table if u have a big group coming, cheers
author: FROSTY

restaurant_name: Bao Gong XO Fish Head Bee Hoon
review_text:
There’s 3 XO Fish Head Bee Hoon at Ghim Moh/Buona Vista and I like this outlet the most.
Fish Head Bee Hoon: Soup was tasty, noodle texture nice and portions were ample.
三老河粉: Surprised to see they gave a lot of noodles and bean spouts for S size
We also ordered their staple good dishes like fried chicken wings, Kai lan.
author: Liau Yuan Wei

restaurant_name: Bao Gong XO Fish Head Bee Hoon
review_text: Came by for lunch before 12pm.ordered San Lao Hor Fun or sliced fish flat noodles with beans sprouts for $6. Based on memory, this used to be up there with one of the best. The noodles came out fine smooth with a little wok hei, but the sauce is on the bland side. Fish slices were not uniformed, some thicker so slice thinly. On some pieces, the fish is tough. Well they are pretty generous on the beans sprouts.
author: Ron Ng

restaurant_name: Bao Gong XO Fish Head Bee Hoon
review_text: Zhi char store been around for some time, at least 10 years eating here. Start from this location, go other place then return. Did not try their famous dish. Eat other dishes instead, tasted average. Price is zhi char price.
author: Marcus Goh

review_text:
Ordered takeaway and I’m very satisfied! The pizza was still hot and fresh when I got home. Staff were attentive and welcoming.
Definitely will come back again!
author: Hoang Oanh

review_text: Convenient and close to the office. Did a self-pick up order and when i arrive my order was ready and still pipping hot. The staff at the counter was very friendly and double check my order just in case anything was missed out as I had order a couple of pizzas order. Definitely will return for the prompt, friendly service and great pizza.
author: Izzy M

review_text: It's very convenient to have such outlet near your heartland, staff are friendly and you get to enjoy the aircon during the hot season providing the store not busy..
author: Fauzi Atan

review_text:
This is updated review after forced 5 star review by one staff one month back. I doubt reviews for this outlet is genuine as they ask for review when you try to redeem singtel voucher.

This is by far the worst Pizza Hut outlet I’ve visited. Every time I try to redeem my Singtel voucher, they come up with a different excuse. On Sunday, when I visited with my wife, the store manager told her the voucher was only valid on weekdays—which was untrue. When I returned today, the same manager, Hafiz, immediately claimed that the dough was “finished.” I knew this wasn’t true and confronted him, but he simply said I could go ahead and complain. I even checked online afterwards, and personal pizzas were still available. Extremely disappointing experience.

Issue happened around 7:10 PM on 27 aug incase any competent person is there in pizza hut wanting to improve there service
I will raise it to singtel too
author: Abhishek Prasad

review_text: Had a wonderful experience at Pizza Hut Ghim Moh! The food was hot, fresh, and delicious. We were served by a friendly young man who was polite, attentive, and cheerful, making our meal extra enjoyable. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
author: Zavior K

restaurant_name: The BOILER @ Buona Vista | Best Seafood Boil | Crabs & Lobsters |
review_text:
Girls were craving for seafood and we decided to have a go here. Make reservation for table as it was crowded on Sunday night.
We ordered the onion rings, crispy lotus root. Bombgiggity Seafood Bag for four pax which was very enjoyable. The truffles lobster mee pok was bouncy.
The Black Sesame Mochi Crunch was good to try
author: Sze Wee Tan

restaurant_name: The BOILER @ Buona Vista | Best Seafood Boil | Crabs & Lobsters |
review_text: Ordered for delivery - the duo set that comes with crab, mussels, clams, prawns, sausages, corn cob and buns. Spicy level I chose Medium (2). The flavor is really awesome, I like! Seafood is fresh and juicy, very enjoyable! Spiciness is acceptable, the aftertaste heat with flavourful cajun & butter. I just wish there are more corn and sausages, and, personally prefer potatoes to deep fried buns. The sparkling sake definitely complements the dish and it’s $28 for two bottles, well worth it! Will definitely patronize again!
author: A N

restaurant_name: The BOILER @ Buona Vista | Best Seafood Boil | Crabs & Lobsters |
review_text: Went here to celebrate a friend’s birthday 🥳 Great atmosphere and even better food! Amos served us and was very timely in his recommendations. He saw that our drinks were low and asked if we wanted top ups haha (to which we said yes pls). Enjoyed our experience here.
author: Jaz A

restaurant_name: The BOILER @ Buona Vista | Best Seafood Boil | Crabs & Lobsters |
review_text: Nice food and chill environment. Amos has been very helpful and prompt to serve us despite having quite a number of tables to go around. Kris is also very friendly to help us with our request. Highly recommend this place for food and services.
author: Michaela Tan

restaurant_name: The BOILER @ Buona Vista | Best Seafood Boil | Crabs & Lobsters |
review_text:
Food: Seafood Bag Combo Duo Plus, white wine, seasonal beer, fish and chips, calamari fries, lava cake
Atmosphere: Outdoor long table
Service: Amos

Every single thing was a hit. The food was fresh and absolutely delicious. The ambience was relaxing, and the background music set the perfect mood. The service provided by Amos went above and beyond anything one could ask for—truly outstanding.

It was a birthday celebration and nothing short of a wonderful memory. We will definitely be coming back again.

Thank you, Boiler. Thank you, Amos.
author: Saw Phone Myint Lay

review_text: Decided to eat for my lunch on Sunday. Came at 11am after my exercise class. Ordered less rice and indeed the rice was little. However I find their ingredients are v v salty. The second pic shows I’m unable to finish the food. In fact I ordered two teh O kosong to wash down my food. Cost for my meal $4
author: wen

review_text: Please avoid this Chang Cheng Mix Rice stall. I order fish fillet,very small portion and full of fried powder. What a shame.
author: William THC

review_text: Didn't know cai png can be so expensive nowadays. I ordered 1 veggie and 1 meat already cost me $5. Cannot imagine if I order 2 meat and 1 veggie is gonna cost me $8 to $10?
author: L.

review_text: There's a variety of dishes though it will be better with more greens. Slight increase in the prices but still reasonable as compared to others. There's usually a Q during lunchtime so have to go early.
author: CHING HSIA GOH

review_text: Cai Fan dishes are expensive, staff is unfriendly! Last week, picked 1 chicken meat + 1 plain vege + rice = $3.00. If you're a female, staff gives you less rice than normal portion! Prices change daily, it's up to the staff's mood! I aways pick 1 chicken meat + 1 plain vege and the prices are different each time. NOT recommended!
author: Moomoo TSC

restaurant_name: Ming Kitchen Live Seafood 名厨活海鲜 - Holland Drive
review_text: Ordered Black Pepper Crab and we asked to pick our own crab, the crab was cooked and served within 5min which was a little fast in my opinion as our vegetable dish comes next, followed by fried rice dish. Somehow the crab didn’t taste very fresh despite being killed, cooked and served in 5min, it is also missing a leg.
author: Kelviz

restaurant_name: Ming Kitchen Live Seafood 名厨活海鲜 - Holland Drive
review_text:
Tried 3 dishes on a busy weekday lunch time. They tasted quite good, and were served quite promptly. All 3 beef dishes came with tender beef and delicious sauce. See photos for the dishes and price tags. Some empty tables were reserved for this anchor tenant, so there’s no need to wait for an empty table, ideal for a big group of colleagues having lunch together. San Mee $4.50 was also quite good!
Update Jan2025 price inflation, see latest receipt. Food still v good
author: Blackraven

restaurant_name: Ming Kitchen Live Seafood 名厨活海鲜 - Holland Drive
review_text:
A Friday night, lots of people.
We ordered a curry fish head, the curry sauce was good and the toufu are really good 👍🏿 but the fish is a bit under cooked so taste fishy.
The soup is good, which is very suitable for a cool night.
The Malay delight is flavorful but too oily .
S
In all the restaurant is good but not good enough for me to come back for certain dish.
author: Tracy Zhang

restaurant_name: Ming Kitchen Live Seafood 名厨活海鲜 - Holland Drive
review_text: We came here to try their zi char food. It was delicious and flavourful. All the meats were really tender and marinated well with the sauce. Sambal kangkong was fresh and up to standard. Would definitely come back to try their seafood because look at those cute big crabs 🦀. Staff was quite rude, hopefully this can be improved!
author: Professional Tummy

restaurant_name: Ming Kitchen Live Seafood 名厨活海鲜 - Holland Drive
review_text:
Food is still good. Crab is good and now they charge GST separately and no longer inclusive and Crab is same price as other Zhi Char.
They have the regular zhi char Chinese dishes and mostly of standard

restaurant_name: Rong Kee Roasted Delights 榮記烧腊 - Holland

author: Cookie Monster

restaurant_name: Rong Kee Roasted Delights 榮記烧腊 - Holland

restaurant_name: Rong Kee Roasted Delights 榮記烧腊 - Holland
review_text: The roasted duck noodle is really good! Remember to ask for boneless meat!
author: Blackraven

restaurant_name: Rong Kee Roasted Delights 榮記烧腊 - Holland
review_text:
Chicken too dry and a lot of bones, they look like they are trying to scrap as much chicken as possible
Rice too salty
I do not recommend
author: John Robert

review_text:
This place is a hidden gem for craft beer (and cider) lovers from outside the area, which is a cluster of condo towers and some landed house estates. Seems to be a popular meeting place for the locals, particularly expats living nearby. The location is quite odd and rather hard to find (inside a condo complex), which warrants one of the criteria of a hidden gem.

The bar is super airy and almost entirely open air. It boasts humongous inventory of beers from all over the world, including a number of rare produces. Surprised to see Hitachino Nest Red Rice beer from Japan, which itself isn't easy to find in its own country (most Hitachino beers in large supermarkets/liquor stores in Japan tend to be Dai Dai or the IPA). No brainer to not to order this sweet treat ($14 in 330 ml bottle, which is perhaps 3 times more expensive than that in Japan), given how rare it really is in places like Singapore.

The meals are rather nice, the pork meat ball with fries was served warm and with flavorful wine sauce. The fries were rather mediocre but dipping it into the sauce improves it somewhat. Will come back for the pizza, especially if coming with friends.
author: lontongstroong

review_text: Really nice ambience in the evening. It’s an interesting dining place within a condo development, overlooking the pool, sports courts and distant scenery. Staffs are friendly. The food we ordered was average except fish & chips which is tasty and crunchy. Good for family in early evening, hope there’s more of such private developments with public access. Only thing is parking, there’s no designated lots for visitors in the premise so just park on the road outside the restaurant entrance.
author: KH Chong

review_text: The food is okay and the location is bit odd, being inside the Rigdewood condo. It is the range of their beers that are the main attraction - they claim to have about 100 different beers and ciders from countries all over the world. Go try it if you are a beer lover.
author: Debabrata Biswas

review_text: Fantastic place nested within mount sinai. Allows food from other restaurants. Ordered their Bak Kwa pizza which was fantastic. Pork meatballs was ok.
author: Terry Chua

review_text: Pizza is thin and crust is quite unique. Did a takeaway so didn’t get to experience the atmosphere. Felt the prices are quite expensive for Grab though. $20 for a pizza that’s prob only enough for 1 person. Like the fish & chips though, they use real cod.
author: Crystal Koh

review_text: Goodd
author: Lazarus Jiarto

review_text:
Had a company dinner at Blu Kouzina Dempsey and it was a great experience. The food was delicious, especially the grilled meats and dips. Everything tasted fresh and authentic.

The atmosphere at Dempsey is very nice and relaxing, perfect for group gatherings or company dinners. The staff were friendly and attentive throughout the evening.

Overall a wonderful dining experience. Would definitely come back again!
author: Angela Goh

review_text:
Started the meal with warm, soft pita and honestly, the hummus was a pleasant surprise. It had its own character, not the usual bland kind, and paired really well with the hummus. The grilled octopus was nicely done, crispy on the outside, tender inside. There was a slight sour kick from the vinegar, but it didn’t overpower the dish.
The lamb was really good. Juicy, fresh, and most importantly, no strong lamb smell or taste, which I appreciated. The fish soup was a standout for me — very unique and full of fresh seafood flavour, you can tell it wasn’t rushed. The chicken skewer was a bit tough, probably due to the cut used, but still enjoyable overall.
Dessert came last and it was rich, dense and nicely cheesy. Very satisfying way to end the meal. The place itself has a cozy, retro feel with high ceilings and vintage details that make it easy to just sit back and enjoy the time there. Definitely a spot I’d come back to.
author: akst ang

review_text: We chose blu kouzina to celebrate our wedding anniversary! Thanks to chandra and others who served us for making it such a memorable experience for us. But definitely huge kudos and credits goes to chandra.  From the time we arrived, we came forward to ask our preferences, recommended accordingly to our preferences and went out of his way with some specific recommendations too. Really appreciate the amazing service standards maintained by him and the team. Food was delicious and fresh. Felt really good , loved everything and definitely will come back ! ☺️ 5/5!
author: devan srigaran

review_text: We ordered octopus, lamb chop and salad. All dishes were very nice. Octopus and lamb were very soft and the salad was so refreshing. And the staffs were super nice and kind. We also had the dessert, was so nice! Recommend this place! One thing wanna mention is the place is a bit dark 😅
author: SS

review_text:
Had lunch here and the food was👌🏽

Highlights were the meatballs, dips platter with super soft & yummy pita bread, and the filet mignon - all hit the spot 😋

Downsides: Service could've been more attentive, and the indoor ambience feels a bit gloomy & underwhelming. More lighting and vibe would lift the experience.

Overall solid food, would revisit for the eats👍🏽
author: Nathiya Faith

review_text: One of our favorite meals in Singapore! We decided to go all out and order the king crab 2 ways, which was very expensive but worth it for the experience. I personally liked the pepper crab more than the Singaporean chili crab, and the pepper crab was probably the best crab I've ever had. Hokkien nee was also very good. Reservations highly recommended. Service was friendly and attentive. Prices are high but worth it for the quality. Would definitely come back!
author: Nancy

review_text: The staff who has served us provided excellent service. We are very happy with the prompt service and food are yummy. If the air conditioner has been cooler would be better as the weather was very hot yesterday
author: Ivy Lee

review_text: Fresh seafood and nice flavours. Attentive and helpful table staff Ms Fen Lin. Pleasant outdoor seating, sheltered and not hot in Feb. Easy to book by WhatsApp. Got the CNY set for 4 for $338++, forgot to take pic of the chilli crab with mantou and soup. Ala carte bamboo clam is always my favourite
author: Loo Yan Tong

review_text: I would like to commend Oscar Chen from the Jumbo East Coast Park branch for his outstanding service. He was very helpful in teaching us how to use our vouchers effectively, which made the whole experience pleasant and hassle-free. The food was delicious, and we truly enjoyed our visit. We will definitely return again.
author: Low Chi Fong

review_text:
Good food, nice environment, and great service! We chose the indoor seating. Not gonna lie—their chilli crab tastes really good, but it can get jelak easily, so it’s better to share among 4 people or more.

I loved their spinach—this is my favorite so far. We also had cereal prawns, and they tasted really good.

Overall, the food was spot on and perfect for seafood cravings. Definitely coming back again for more!
author: Michael Lee

review_text:
Had a wonderful company dinner at Long Beach, a renowned seafood restaurant in Singapore that is known to be the creator of the original black pepper crab dish. The restaurant is nestled amidst the lush greenery of Dempsey Hill, the restaurant serves the freshest seafood from the tanks to the tables. We ordered:

- Deep fried baby squid with honey sauce
- Crispy white bait fish with salt & pepper
- Steamed Scottish royal razor clam with minced garlic & vermicelli
- Live drunken prawns with herbal soup
- Chilli crab
- Black pepper crab
- Deep fried pomfret
- Fresh scallops with broccoli
- Irish roast duck
- ‘Ching Mun ‘ braised noodles with fresh clams
- Mango sago with coconut jelly

The restaurant really lives up to its name and did not disappoint. Everything was delicious! I would highly recommend the crispy white bait fish, royal clam, chilli crab and Irish roast duck. I love their drunken prawns as well, especially the herbal soup. But this is probably not for those who hate the taste of alcohol. I love it because of the strong taste of herbs and alcohol. So rich and nourishing.
author: elin chow

review_text: It was wonderful having dinner at an outdoor table, especially on a breezy February night. Atmosphere was lovely as the lights lit in the garden. We had Chili crab and razor clam and yes, it was wonderful as usual.
author: Minjeong Kim

review_text:
Thank you Pamela for liasing with me on arranging a big dinner with my clients! They enjoyed the food and the service of you and your staff :)
We ordered the CNY set menu for 10 pax which was just nice for everyone!
author: Liau Yuan Wei

review_text: Used to have good services in the past, even deshell crab for us during COVID period. This round the services is a bit disappointing, probably because they are busy? Need to request for chilli, and a few reminders before they helped us to top up the Chinese tea. Food-wise, general their seafood is good. The asparagus is nice, the broccoli seems to be cooked using same sauce but the taste is slightly not as flavourful. Roast Chicken skin is crispy.  No offer of gloves, apron, or scissors when we had the princess crab. Servers only offer to change plate for few of us, when we are almost done with the crab. Used to offer all to us without requesting.
author: Fernshares

review_text:
Fried food is ok. Disappointed on the crab meat, we open the crab and find the meat is not filling full. The quality is not worth for the price. Feedback to staff they mention deep sea crab is this standard. Another thing is eating half way find a hair in the vegetable. Usually I will not post to Google review directly but too disappointed on the reason giving on the crab so I didn’t report again.
Will not go again.
author: Weeli Kang

review_text: We enjoyed our lunch at Jumbo Dempseyon Sunday. Fortunately we were given a room which was indoor area as the weather was very hot.
author: Ivy Lee

review_text: Fantastic food… hawker fare here is much better than your hawker centre!! Extremely surprised!
author: Hulk

review_text:
Please visit Ah Di Durian at Dempsey.
Do not miss it. Book your durians in advance else you will likely make a wasted trip.
author: Jenn Chong

review_text: Menu clearly labels gluten-free items! Lifesaver for family members that have gluten allergy (now that the trend has passed for non-allergic people, few places have this label now). Thank you to Delle for hosting us so warmly!
author: S Susanto

review_text: Very atas and quaint neighbourhood with a lot of great dining options. Definitely not v accessible by public transport and you will need a car to get here despite its central location. Definitely a nice place to explore on weekends especially in the morning if one wants to walk and get some peace and quiet.
author: Keng Cheong Tan

review_text: Big and spacious restaurant with lovely Mexican food. Go for the quesadillas, they were so good till we wanted to order seconds. Main course was the steak on hot plate. The fried jalapeno was a lovely addition to the meal, great crunchy bites to whet your appetite. Portobello mushrooms were so juicy and the small jalapeno were very spicy, added kick to the meal. If you looking for great, spicy, siesta fun, this is the place to visit
author: Irving Goh

review_text:
Fantastic Place for great Mexican food.

Had the beef tlayuda and pork carnitas

At first thought it was overpriced, but when the portions came.. wow big enough for sharing. The wait staff also kindly informed us regarding this

Both the beef and pork was well seasoned. The pork was incredibly juicy and flavorful. All the salsas from the tomato to the guacamole was very tasty, well balanced and well done.

The acidity in both dishes was also well balance and not too spicy.

Excellent job from the chef. Wait staff was very attentive and polite as well.

The restaurant was also very nicely decorated with a great mexican vibe and background music.

Great place. Will be coming back. Three thumbs up.
author: Y-Dub Dub

review_text:
Lovely Dinner experience at this place. Scrumptious food and amazing MARGARITA'S, Specially the frozen slushy one. I recommend taking a prior booking at this place as it tends to get busy during the weekend and lunch/dinner times.

Paradise for Medical food lovers.
author: Aashish Razdan

review_text:
Great experience overall

Delicious food , nice ambience. Not too crowded. Waiter very observant and attentive -- helping to turn on the extra fans when the restaurant feels stuffy, and keep topping up the ice water for us.
Being first timer in this restaurant, a bit unfamiliar with the menu. Waiter gave good advice and suggestions

Enjoyed the meal thoroughly and left with happy stomach ! Decent portion of food and not overpriced with great cooking + fresh ingredients
Highly recommended !!
author: Elsie G

review_text: Age old tale of beautiful Mexican cuisine. Been dining here for yonks and the food has always been flavourful and spectacular. Never a bad experience here at Margs. Great service. Fast and friendly.
author: LAM CHUAN

review_text:
Located within walking distance from Holland Village and tucked away in a cozy neighbourhood, the restaurant offers a pleasant and relaxed ambience. The food portions are generous, and there are good vegetarian-friendly options available. The truffle fries are especially addictive and a must-try.

I would definitely recommend making a reservation before visiting, as the restaurant can get quite full at times. While the staff took a little longer to attend to our table and could have been more responsive, the overall experience was still enjoyable. Great value for the quality and portions offered.
author: Yaznasri Divili

review_text:
I’m 100% “true-red” carnivorous & kinda skeptical about vegetarian food but chose Original Sin as I was celebrating my friend’s birthday & he likes vegetarian food.

We ordered truffle fries, Moussaka & pasta burrata. Both dishes are lovely & we totally enjoyed it.  And not forgetting the lovely birthday cake that was brought to us.

Service crew are attentive, friendly & lovely. Definitely will be back to try others on the menu.
author: Jennifer Matilda Hoa

review_text: I had a wonderful time celebrating my wife's birthday here! 🎂 The food was absolutely delicious 🍔, and the staff were incredibly friendly and attentive. Highly recommend this spot! ✨
author: Dav P

review_text: This is a hidden gem in Holland Village area. We passed by this one during lunch time and decided to have a try. We thought this was a regular Italian restaurant, but it brought us happy surprise! The food are superb! The veggie bowl is the best I have ever had. The veggies are so fresh, and the tofu is fried perfectly. Funghi pizza is also excellent. We later realized this is a vegetarian restaurant, but they provide seafood pasta which is one of the best. Impossible burger is also done perfectly. All in all, this has changed my view on vegetarian food!
author: Teng Ren

review_text: Loved the food. Used to go there a lot many years ago and went back this week after ages. The food is still as good. The weekday set lunch is great value for money. The menu has expanded and it’s not just vegetarian food now. They have also expanded beyond Mediterranean food to include more Italian food and the tiramisu is awesome.
author: Anju Patwardhan

review_text:
I passed by this pizza shop and noticed their selection along with a 1-for-1 🍕 takeout deal. Even though I had already eaten, I couldn’t resist trying their Cinque formaggi and Prosciutto di parma e rucola. I was glad I did—they were delicious 😋, even after two hours and eaten cold. I can only imagine how much better they’d taste fresh out of the oven.
_________

📨 to the owner:

Hi, you’re welcome.

My rating reflects the overall experience, not just the food. The food itself was 3 stars for the area — decent quality. The service was 2 stars because it felt purely transactional; your staff only engaged after I stood there for a while and asked questions, the chef didn’t show a welcoming face, and if you are the owner I saw that day, you didn’t even greet me — you were focused on your accounting work instead. I didn’t feel the Italian grandmother’s warmth. The atmosphere was 1 star, as the space lacked the ambience for a true la nonna Italian experience.

To me, a higher rating comes when food, service, and atmosphere all feel above average — where warmth and genuine hospitality are part of the experience, not just the transaction. That said, I would still recommend your food.
author: Monda S.

review_text:
How this restaurant has a 4.2-star rating is baffling to me.

When I asked a waiter about the arrabbiata, he didn’t even know what that was… How are you a waiter in an Italian restaurant and not know one of the most basic pasta sauces?

That was the least problematic thing that happened during our visit.

The food is absolutely abhorrent. We ordered the lobster ravioli and their “signature” pizza. The ravioli’s tomato sauce tasted like pre-made NTUC sauce. The “lobster” tasted more like frozen prawn paste. The ravioli was definitely pre-packaged—it tasted worse than the pre-packaged ravioli I get from M&S. It literally tasted like a prawn dim sum dumpling you’d get from a random coffee shop.

Their “signature” pizza tasted like it had been pre-made and then just dumped in a microwave to heat before serving. Maybe if they had actually done that properly, it might’ve tasted better, because when we received it, the pizza was lukewarm. The base was also soggy and didn’t taste fresh at all. Possibly the worst pizza I’ve ever had in my life. Even Domino’s could serve you better. The asparagus was soggy too.

This meal absolutely ruined our Valentine’s Day, and I genuinely hope nobody ever patronizes this restaurant.

**EDIT/ UPDATE: They have also responded to this review by accusing me of ‘working for a competitor’… I wish I were, because I wasn’t compensated at all for the absolutely terrible food they served me. My goodness… they haven’t even taken any form of accountability and instead have resorted to making up lies. Also, really appreciate the compliment about my writing lol… Yes, reported to Google… and they will see from my review history that I indeed have not gone around rating Italian restaurants one or two stars! In fact, I have given many restaurants of varying cuisines 5 stars. And they mentioned they reviewed the CCTV footage? What’s there to review… us coming into your restaurant like normal people, dining and leaving? Extremely dishonest establishment
author: Charlotte

review_text: Decent food in a rustic and cosy atmosphere. Honestly, the unanimous favourite of the meal was the Cesare ($19 +$2 for chicken breast) - lettuce was fresh and crisp, and the dressing was so darn delicious! The others dishes we had was simply average: Calamari ($20), La Nonna ($27), and Fettuccine Pesto e Pollo ($26). Service was friendly, and when our Entertainer promo failed to go through they still gave us a 20% discount which was so nice of them!
author: Darren

review_text: Food taste great ! love it when the pasta is hot and freshly served! flavourful but not overwhelming. portion is just nice too. i love the ravioli isnt too thick so we were able to enjoy the flavour and texture!
author: Wendi Chan

review_text: An Italian restaurant in the row of shops at Holland village. The menu offers much from the Italian cuisine. But they are well known for the pasta.However, my friends and I thought that the pasta was pretty mid. Perhaps not savoury enough? It didn’t really stand out. Everything else was ok. The decor was on point and staff were great and attentive, always refilling our drinks ❤️I would say the food would suit the palates of the younger folks.
author: The Friendly Hamster

review_text:
A well known place on internet for their fish head curry and seeing that I always wanted to try here. Went here on sunday hence couldn’t get online booking and walked in, got seat within 5 mins.

Ordered their cauliflower 65 which was very good in flavours but too oily. The fish cutlet was perfectly cooked in egg and filled with rich flavours of fish and loved it.

The fish head curry was definitely a droll worthy dish and show stealer. The fish was fresh and the curry was richly packed with flavours, served pipping hot. The curry had brinjal and ladies finger which is usually love and was great. I paired it with plain white rice which you once and get unlimited with 2 veggies. Was worth all the money and was totally in love with it. The small packs can be shared by 2-3 persons easily.

Lastly got their rasam which was really good packed with umami flavours and must try at the end. Don’t forget to taste the rasam which helps in digestion too.

Worth coming here when near demsy area and i will definitely go back again for their taste and quality.
author: abijith munikannan

review_text: We have been to Samys Curry Restaurant for a lunch with our client. Its a very good restaurant for a casual lunch or dinner especially if you are a non vegetarian lovers. There is a lot of choice for non veg food. We had a good pomfret, Mysore mutton, crab masala apart from the biryani rice and chicken curry.  Everything tasted good. Particularly loved the mutton together with the biryani and chicken curry.  We also had a coconut water which was refreshing.  The atmosphere is very casual and I would not say this is a classy restaurant. Its good for a friends or colleagues lunch or dinner. Would go again for sure
author: Vishal Shirsat

review_text:
I have been dining at Samy’s Curry since I was a kid, so I admit I am biased—but I also believe this is the best Indian curry restaurant in Singapore. While everyone talks about their famous Fish Head Curry, the real star for my family has always been their Masala Chicken.

The Food:
Masala Chicken: In my opinion, this is the best version in SG—better than Karu’s, Muthu’s, or any other contender. The spice blend is complex and robust. Pro Tip: We always ask for an extra serving of the Masala gravy to flood our rice.

The Briyani Set: Served traditionally on a banana leaf with cabbage stew and curry potatoes. The vegetables and rice are free-flow (though the initial portion is so generous we rarely need a top-up!).

Appetizers: They serve complimentary Papadums that are consistently crispy and flavorful—the perfect start to the meal.

The Only Miss:
Masala Tea: If you like a spicy kick to your tea, you might be disappointed. It was a bit too mild for my taste; I prefer a much stronger spice profile.

Verdict:
We spent about $91 for 5 people, which is incredible value for a meal at Dempsey. If you want the authentic banana leaf experience, Samy’s is still the place to beat.
author: Wiz Yeo

review_text:
Samy’s Curry at Dempsey offers a classic and authentic banana leaf rice experience, making it perfect for groups who want to share a variety of flavorful dishes. The absolute highlight was the Mutton Mysore, which was super spicy and aromatic, though it had a slightly wetter consistency than I remembered. The Chicken 65 and Cauliflower were also excellent, served piping hot and crispy. You get a choice of white or biryani rice served on a banana leaf with dhal and vegetable curry, providing a hearty base for the rich sides.

Be prepared for a crowd during weekend lunch, as the place gets packed, but the lively atmosphere is part of the charm. While their fish curry is legendary, I opted for the other meat options and wasn't disappointed. It’s definitely better to go in a larger group so you can sample more items. Conveniently, there is free parking available right in front of the restaurant and also an air conditioned dining area at the back, which is a nice bonus for hot and humid days.
author: Ribeye

review_text: Definitely one of the best banana leaf south indian restaurant in Singapore. Was here with my team for year end lunch and must say, we truly enjoyed the good. Fish head curry, mysore mutton, masala chicken are highly recommended. Best part, rice (either white rice or biriyani rice) is free flow. Cauliflower65 goes well as a starter.
author: Rajkapoor K

review_text: We love to come here for lunch every Sunday.  Food is good, reasonably priced. A bit hard to get a seat. The Japanese food stall is worth a queue. Couple serving are very genuine,  cheerful and friendly.  The Saba sets, beef sets are good.
author: Elaine Quek

review_text:
good eating, all round.

hainanese joint dishes plentiful protein, with oink chubby bits and spare parts, at light damage.  too much of good thing to keep to yourself.
author: alwyn

review_text: Literally the cleanest and most orderly hawker I have been to. Well ventilated spacious and clean seating. Credit goes to the cleaner uncles aunties that work there. Well done.
author: Cu Cu Jo Lie

review_text: A nice smaller hawker where you can buy fresh fruit, vegetables etc. But it’s also an excellent hawker, not as big as many others but it has some great choices. Some of my favourites is the Mei Di Noodles and Liang Ji Wanton Noodle. I often order a fresh juice to end the meal with. It’s not so noisy here, and normally not a problem to find a seat.
author: Fab Foodie Swede Malin Nordblom

review_text: This is a place that has some good restaurants and bars. The vibes are different with other places in Singapore. It is not a tourist area, but more of locals and expatriates gathering place.
author: Irwan Suparman

review_text:
I decided to give this roast stall a try, but honestly, it was a disappointing experience. They state that they open at 11:00, yet they only started serving at 11:15, leaving a long queue of customers waiting. To make matters worse, while everyone was standing in line, a customer sitting at a nearby table , clearly someone they knew was allowed to place and collect his takeaway order before the stall even officially opened. This kind of double standard shows they prioritize regulars over everyone else, which doesn’t leave a good impression.

As for the food, it doesn’t live up to the hype. The roast duck is tender but lacks seasoning , it tastes more like plain meat than something well-marinated, even if the skin is somewhat crispy. The roast pork was underwhelming: not crispy, with certain parts tasting a little too porky and lacking in salt. The char siew is the only saving grace, with a nice char and sweetness, but it leans heavily on fatty cuts, which not everyone will enjoy.

Overall, I don’t think it’s worth queuing up and putting up with the stall’s attitude. There are plenty of other roast stalls around that serve equal or better quality food without making customers feel like second-class diners.
author: Ankori

review_text: This stall serves delicous roasted meat at hawker price. No wonder there was a queue at lunch time. Love their caramelised char siew, served in generous chunks, with just rhe right amount of fat. The roasted portion belly was delicious too. With crispy skin and lots of lean portion, the way I prefer. Their roasted duck can hold its ground too, when compared to other popular stalls. Having a platter of mix roated meat would be a great way to enjoy what this stall has to offer.
author: Freddy Kua

review_text: Queued before is opened and taste is as good as ever! Too bad no dumpling soup anymore. Love this place.
author: SG Food Legends

review_text:
Since the owners decided to reopen here, I haven’t been here. Standard is still good. I ordered the 3 in 1 - roast duck, roast pork and char siew rice. All three items are still good. Charcoal roasted is always better. Roasted duck and pork skins are crispy and I love the char siew not too sweet ❤️ Stall opens every Tuesdays to Saturdays from 11 am till sold out.

Second visit to try roasted duck drumstick and roasted pork. Yummy! Pity I forgot to ask for sauce on the duck. Would have made it better.
author: C K Leong (Ah Leong San)

review_text: The char siew is a must to try.. but do expect a wait about 20 mins but I think it’s worth the wait .. roast pork was normal.
author: Darren Tan

review_text:
We had a wonderful lunch experience at Chang Korean BBQ and left very impressed by both the food quality and service.

We ordered the Prime Rib Eye (Aus. 200g), marinated chicken, seafood kimchi pancake (customised to all prawns), ginseng chicken soup, steamed rice, Coke Zeros and a makguli. Every dish was well executed — the beef was flavourful and tender, the marinated chicken was juicy, and the kimchi pancake with prawns was satisfying with a nice balance of crispness and flavour. The ginseng chicken soup was comforting and hearty.

What truly stood out was the service. The waitress wearing spectacles was extremely patient, polite, and genuinely cheerful throughout. She cooked both the beef and chicken for us over charcoal and thoughtfully removed the charcoal once everything was done so we wouldn’t feel the heat — a very considerate touch that made the experience even more comfortable.

The total bill came to about $245 including GST for the both of us, and honestly it felt well worth it given the quality of food and attentive service. Parking was also incredibly convenient, literally right at the doorstep, which made the visit very hassle-free.

Overall, a very enjoyable experience and we would happily return.
author: Vincent Luo

review_text: One of the most authentic Korean BBQ restaurant hidden in the outskirts of busy Orchard road. Inaccessible without car. The Spanish Pork collar and spicy chicken are simply delicious, eaten by wrapping it with lettuce and Korean sauce. The Korean ginseng soup is thick and I like the ginseng taste that infused into the whole chicken. The staff provides good service by grilling the meat for us  at the other end of the restaurant.
author: Rachel

review_text:
I had a wonderful dining experience at Chang Korean Charcoal BBQ Restaurant. We ordered the cold bibim beef broth noodle and the spicy pork, and both dishes were outstanding. The cold noodles were refreshing and full of flavor, perfect for balancing out the richness of the spicy pork. But the highlight of the meal was definitely the spicy pork. It was absolutely heavenly – tender, juicy, and packed with just the right amount of spice that kept me wanting more with every bite.

Another thing I really loved was the portion size. The servings were huge, definitely worth the price, and great for sharing if you’re dining with family or friends. The banchan (side dishes) were also a treat. Each one was tasty on its own and complemented the main dishes perfectly, adding variety and balance to the meal.

On top of the delicious food, the restaurant had a cozy atmosphere that made the whole experience even better. Service was friendly and efficient, and everything came out fresh and hot.

Overall, this is a place I’ll definitely return to. I’m already looking forward to coming back to try more of their dishes, because if the spicy pork is any indication, everything here is going to be amazing.
author: Yvonne Chou

review_text: Went there for dinner on a Sunday night. Unfortunately the quality of meat was not great. Spent close to 100 per person and the meat was not tasty and did not taste like prime cuts. Service was average. Drinks were not refilled unless asked repeatedly and the banchan were in small quantities similarly hard to get a refill. Overall it was not a pleasant experience.
author: D Y

review_text: Quiet, but a bit on the pricey side, wish the beef (not shown) taste a bit better, hard to chew off. Pan cake is good though! Service staff are attentive 👍
author: SKY -

review_text: The vibe is back in Holland V! Nice new fresh look! The live band adds so much to this institution! Congratulations to Team Wala Wala on such a wonderful revamp! Kudos.
author: Desmond Lee

review_text:
This pub is a landmark at Holland Village. They announced their closure in 2025, but later announced that they will remain open.

It was rather quiet for a Wednesday night.

About 5 tables were occupied, each with 2-3 customers.

Most patrons were seated outside due to the cooler weather and to people-watch.

They have indoor and outdoor seating.

Live band performance will commence from 15 Jan 2026.
author: Winston Ho

review_text: Only few tables were occupied on Monday night. Nice place to chill & chitchat with friends. Wala Pizza & chicken wings are recommended! Happy hour from 4 - 9.
author: KarenL

review_text: The pizza was ok, but the spaghetti are the worst. It has no taste, you can only feel the creaminess and spiciness. The pasta itself is very dry inside, I don’t know how they make make it so bad🤣
author: Lim Davy

review_text: Came here one night with a friend, we wanted to come here as the place looked very lively. We wanted to sit inside as that’s where the live band is but sadly indoors were full :( , the staff told us if there’s a available table he’ll shift us so we were ok, moved inside probably after a pint and some starters, and I have the say the band was really great, it’s nice to have live music here in the neighbourhood, really beautiful and thank you in bringing something I didn’t know I would come to enjoy
author: Junichiro Maruyama

review_text:
The perfect spot for a festive feast at Dempsey!

Had a wonderful dinner at RedDot Brewhouse! The atmosphere at Dempsey is always great, but the food really stole the show this time.
We ordered a mix of their signatures and the Christmas specials. The Crispy Pork Knuckle was absolute perfection—crackling skin on the outside and tender meat inside, paired perfectly with the sauerkraut. We also got the Satay platter (pork and chicken) which had a great char, and the Grilled Squid was fresh and came with a delicious dipping sauce.
Since it’s the holiday season, we tried the Christmas Turkey, which was surprisingly moist and came with a rich creamy sauce. The presentation was super cute, especially the festive Santa cocktail with the sugared rim!
Great vibes, huge portions, and friendly service. Highly recommend coming here for a group gathering or holiday celebration. Will definitely be back!
author: Andy Chen

review_text:
Came for lunch after a walk at Botanic Gardens. Not that this place does not have AC at all but throughout the time we were there it was nice and breezy.
Service is good as all the staff were friendly and helpful. There are designated areas for pets if you do bring your dog with you.
We ordered the chicken and pork satay, guava salad, tapas, and slow roasted pork ribs. The food was generally good and enjoyable but felt the ribs were not soft enough.
I enjoyed the beer sampler. In fact I think all the beers were good.
author: Average Guy

review_text:
Nestled in the scenic surroundings of Dempsey, Red Dot Brewhouse gave me one of the most delightful dining experiences — and surprisingly, it was all about the vegetarian food! Their perfectly cooked pasta, freshly baked Margherita pizza, and the signature Red Dot salad bursting with freshness truly won us over. The Papdi Chaat and Gobi Manchurian were simply outstanding, and the mango lassi was the perfect finishing touch.

Red Dot isn’t just a destination for beer lovers — it’s also a place where vegetarians can indulge in thoughtfully prepared dishes served with genuine care and warmth. A special mention goes to Mr. Paul, whose hospitality made the experience even more memorable.
author: Vatsalya Gudimalla

review_text:
Great place for a meal with your pets.
Although al fresco, the large fans make it very cool and comfortable.
Satay, Pizza, and ham croquette are excellent.
Pasta very normal.
Shisamo better to be fried than baked, it felt under cook.
author: BC Quah

review_text:
Beautiful and comfortable place to chill, date or have a gathering. Very conducive and waitstaff are friendly and attentive. Child friendly too. I love the design and the overall outlook of the place plus they have ample carpark just beneath.

But… I big but… food is wasn’t tasty and didn’t meet expectations. Lacked depth in flavour and was below standard, for almost all dishes. The flavours and effort could be much improved.

If food isn’t a concern and ambience is important, this place might be suitable for you. But don’t expect anything from the chef
author: Silver Silver

review_text: Vibrant green iconic Subway branding and modern design. Fresh ingredients displayed beautifully, comfortable seating, bright lighting, and inspiring wall art. The 'Your masterpiece' motto perfectly reflects their customization focus. 😊✨✨
author: Local Guide .: : :::

review_text:
Cosy and nice ambience. I am a minimalist. Small, clean places are blessings to me❤️ And the lady that served me and family is very friendly and approchable. Wish i had glanced at her name tag as well coz i was so busy talking to her😅 She is also concerned as to why my son was not eating a meal. He was not feeling good at the time and ordered just snacks

Thank you so much, Ma'am for your generosity and wonderful service❤️
author: UmmuLynnMuhammad

review_text: This is a pleasant location for having lunch, less crowd and quick service
author: Alloywheel

review_text:
This outlet has been changing staff for the past years, only until recently it has been managed by an Indian female; Mona. Soon after other Indians have also joined onboard. They can be not receptive on the orders, so they will ask you to repeat your orders to reaffirm.

Toilet is accessible at the back, though they sometimes lock it and you have the ask the staff for key. Most of the orders here are Grab and FoodPanda orders than dine-in customers.

Overall it is still a suitable place for reading or some light laptop work if you intend to stay. There is one USB charging unit, and several wall outlets for charging. Do note that you smell some of their over-burnt breads, as they still cannot handle the machine properly with the correct timing (even though it’s a preset).
author: Qihui Looi

review_text: the person handling my food was rubbing his dirty hands on the clean side of the gloves, while grabbing on to stuff while wearing the gloves as well.... absolutely disgusting and defeats the purpose of wearing gloves
author: Har Joe

review_text: I was here this morning (1 JANUARY 2026) for a New Year's Day breakfast at this, in my opinion, most beautiful standalone MacDonald's in the whole of Singapore. I say this because it is nestled in a Japanese garden with a lovely pond thereat with much to see in the case of the latter at the pond's edge or in the waters of the pond. This morning I ordered a Breakfast Scrambled Egg Burger Meal Set with Corn and an Americano. The Burger was very good, in particular the fluffy scrambled eggs therein, and the Americano was of very good quality in terms of robustness and flavour. Service here was very good - friendly and courteous. The dining ambience as I have hinted earlier was very good - as I dined in air-conditioned comfort overlooking the beautiful Japanese garden and pond.
author: edtayjb

review_text:
Visited on a Tuesday morning, not that crowded.
Ample parking space.
Small garden giving a zen experience.
Clean interior and different seatings available for single to larger groups.
Staff are efficient and announce the order numbers clearly.
author: Grace

review_text:
Really full of seatings maybe was off peak but really nice n chill vibe definitely best zen chill McDonald's in SG!
Only thing there isn't any power outlet r USB as some other McDonald's there are.
Other then that all is good
author: diana Peh

review_text: Most Scenic McDonald's in Singapore!  There is a very beautiful and nice garden there...can enjoy the garden & have food 👌
author: AbuObaida Khan (Dr. Khan)

review_text:
Dropped by McDonald’s at Queensway (Ridout Tea Garden) for a late lunch, and I’ve got to say, this has to be one of the most scenic McDonald’s outlets in Singapore.
