Full padang dishes are ready when I arrive at about 8.20am. But I ordered the mee siam.

First look at the gravy made me wonder if it will be nice. It looks more like laksa gravy with consistency almost like mee rebus.

But looks can be deceiving. I has a delicious and balanced sweet and sour taste to it. I like!
author: Saherly Limat

review_text:
Just had a comforting feast at Rumah Sayang, Jem, and every bite felt like a warm hug! 💛

The nasi lemak is a perfect balance of fragrant coconut rice, crispy fried chicken, buttery omelette, crunchy peanuts, and spicy sambal—it’s hearty, flavorful, and utterly satisfying. The seafood fritters are golden, crispy, and deliciously simple, with just the right touch of chili to make them irresistible. And the mee siam with otah—wow! Tangy, slightly spicy, and perfectly balanced with tender noodles, fragrant sauce, and flavorful otah, it’s comforting, aromatic, and packed with flavor in every bite.

Every dish at Rumah Sayang shows care and attention, delivering Malay comfort food that warms your heart as much as your stomach. Highly recommend for anyone craving soulful, flavorful meals! 🍴✨
author: See WhatLah

review_text:
I've tried this store multiple times for lunch, sampling various dishes from chicken and mutton to beef rendang. Today, I ordered the beef rendang, while my colleague opted for the chicken rendang. The set came with two side dishes, including options like fried egg, vegetables, fried tofu, or Begedil.

*Customer Service*
The auntie who served us was friendly and communicative, making requests easy. With minimal fuss, I'd rate their customer service (4/5).

*Beef Rendang*
The beef rendang stood out with its unique, aromatic curry flavor – a true reflection of the chef's skill. The strong, thick curry sauce blended perfectly with the beef, earning a (4/5).

*Sides and Extras*

The cauliflower was cooked to perfection – crunchy and not overcooked (4/5). The fried egg was omelette-style with a sprinkle of onion leaves for added flavor (3.5/5).

*The Chilli Game-Changer*
Don't forget their special chilli adding-on if you can handle the heat! It really elevates the whole dish.

*Value for Money*
The total bill came up to $18.90 for 1 chicken rendang, 1 beef rendang, and 2 coffees. Definitely worth coming back for!

review_text:

author: Jack Tan

review_text:
Ordered mee rebus & kopi o kosong.
1. Mee rebus is a let down. I cannot taste the spices despite all the strong yellowish colors in presentation, supposingly due to the tumarine used. My experience tells me one thing: If spices need to be used, the winning secret is always to freshly prepare it, no powder strictly. Even the peanuts are tasteless. The strangest thing is no taste of potatos, lemongrass,it is purely just colors.

2. Coffee is way too dilute and again, lack aroma.

3. The ordering needs to be planned & re-organised, such as where to order, from which staff ( drink, food & mee different staff) . Bear in mind this is a restaurant/ eating house, people expect more than a hawker centre.  More importantly, they pay for restaurant price, so they derserved the service. People already return food tray in a restaurant, what more can the owner ask?

4. Is this a francise? The the service must also be made part of the francise if it is. A few staff are obviously lacking in training.

5. I suggest to have a door curtain over kitchen. Not all like to sit next to an open bin near kitchen.

6. When it comes to reviewing a restaurant, it is held as higher regard than a hawker. It is only fair that way.

review_text: Actually I want squid otah after work at 7.50 pm on 9/10/25 the male staff told me only left original, so I bought 2 cost 90 cents each. What anger me was the female cashier,   whom often at the counter I noticed, she collected $10 from me, I got my change back $7.20 she turned to the male staff and started chatting, she thought I did not know she never pass me my paid food item. author: Sarah Lee

review_text:
Rubbish place to order food!!!!!!
the rice give was so less, is literally not even a bowl of rice just a fraction of it.
Never going back to order
author: Brandon sim

review_text: This is the chicken cutlet set, which costs SGD 5.90. Ikan billis is packaged separately so that it remains crunchy and crispy. Otah is too spicy for my taste. Overall, it's pretty good.
author: BABY GERM

review_text: I was at the Jem location at 6.30pm only left 2 no spicy otah.  The spicy otah has sold out. But the stall only closed at 9pm why the stock was not replenished as 6.30pm is still early.
author: Elaine Lim

review_text: I am very unhappy with their service. My helper bought the normal fish otah but was charged double! They are the one who packed the item yet charged us something more expensive, so ridiculous!
author: JJ 1&1

restaurant_name: Brotzeit German Beer Bar and Restaurant @ WestGate
review_text: Came here on my birthday last month. We had some beer on barrel, the warsteiner premium lager. A sharing platter, fried button mushrooms and a rosti. For a 3 ppl group, the sharing platter was a little bit too big. It was indicated on the menu it is for 3-4 people to share. I guess we needed the 4th person.  Anyway, we didn't expect the portion to be super generous. Especially the pork knuckle, you have to eat it while it's hot, otherwise it would become dry on the inside once it cools down. The sausages were good, they were accomodating as well to switch out a few pork sausages for chicken as we had a friend that couldn't eat pork. The rosti was pretty standard, I would've eaten the whole lot if we managed to finish the platter. As mushrooms were a personal favourite of mine, I finished them all.
author: Qing

restaurant_name: Brotzeit German Beer Bar and Restaurant @ WestGate
review_text:
Was here on a weekday for an office group lunch.

- The outer dining area can be quite warm, despite being cooled by massive ceiling fans

+ There is a smaller aircon dining area, which is cooler.

Tip: watch out for the drinks promotions indicated on little signboards on the table.

- Water not free. $1 for free-flow "premium  sparkling, chilled, warm and ambient water" per pax.

We ordered the following for 5 adults:
+ Aerated Fried Pork Skin ($6++)
+ Platten Signature Brozteitplate - Crispy Pork knuckle, Honey-Glazed Pork Ribs， Fried Pork Schnitzels， Sausages, Potato salad, bacon sauerkraut ($138++)

Ribs - a little dry. Can be softer and more moist.
Pork Schnitzels - very thin
Sausages - too salty
author: Yong Hui, Ronny Tan

restaurant_name: Brotzeit German Beer Bar and Restaurant @ WestGate
review_text: Like Home! Thank you Adi n Daphne, for the superb leadership. Joan, Aliyah, Armenia for making me feel like talking to my siblings during dinner. I havent felt this homely and comfortable in any establishment for a while. This is amazing. Thank you!
author: Muhammad Noor (Jo3mano)

restaurant_name: Brotzeit German Beer Bar and Restaurant @ WestGate
review_text: Overall, the food was enjoyable and the crew were all attentive and very accomodating. The oysters stood out! However, the Bavarian Honey Ribs were a bit dry and felt skimpy on the meat which kept them from being truly great. The cocktails (we only tried Black Forest Kirsch and Kirsch Me) were, unfortunately, disappointing... I'll just skip cocktails on future visits. One small suggestion: the experience would have been even better with complimentary drinking water offered at the table. Value for money = 3.5/5.
author: Sean

restaurant_name: Brotzeit German Beer Bar and Restaurant @ WestGate
review_text: I had a fantastic experience here! The German food was absolutely delicious 🍖, and the selection of German beers was impressive. 🍺 The service was also excellent, making for a truly enjoyable visit. Highly recommend! 👍
author: Tony Karlsson

review_text:
The dishes were served pretty quickly, which is always a plus.
That said, the fried rice with prawns could be better. It was a little too wet for my liking. I usually order the chicken soup with noodles, but over the years, I feel that the soup has become more and more diluted, which is quite disappointing.
The prawn pancake is also not as crispy as before, which took away some enjoyment. On the bright side, the xiao long bao is still good and consistent, which is reassuring.
Overall, Din Tai Fung here is still reliable, but some of the dishes feel like they have lost a bit of their former standard.
author: Ming Shen Tham

review_text: We visited Din Tai Fung (鼎泰丰) at JEM on the 3rd day of CNY for dinner. The atmosphere was lively and welcoming, and we liked the open-kitchen concept where we could watch the chefs meticulously hand-folding dumplings. The service from the staff was also commendable. Overall, it was a positive dining experience.
author: Sheringham Zhou

review_text: Very sloppy way of serving food. They serve one dish at a time, bit by bit, they likely cook in batches so if you are not part of the batch, your food will come super slow. I waited 30 mins for my fried rice and to be honest, it didn’t taste all that nice either. 15 dollars for a plate of fried rice with meat. The waitress was swarmed by the crowd despite the use of automation. Such a premium place and food serving cannot be done on time.
author: FROSTY

review_text: Impressed with this outlet, the service by the staffs esp a male server in black was immaculate, he was attentive and hospitable! Food was delicious too.
author: Yen L.

review_text:
Long queue during weekends(not sure why the hype), came with family, ate and didn't find it worth the queue. It was during lunch hour, although there were no queue it was half filled.
Our main course came before our appetizer. There weren't many staff so it was difficult to catch the eye of the wait staff. Definitely understaff.
author: Jade Low

review_text: Sunday noon time 8 Mar. Under staffed. One female staff does drinks and $ collection. Other male staff does the cooking and washing. Took a good 10min to get the toast all bcos the male staff was casually washing...I really mean casually. There is no sense of getting food order out quick enough. Hey it's lunch hour. ...leave the washing to later lah. Perhaps management should really think about just having 2 staff...even the return tray area is not cleared.
author: KJ P

review_text:
Yakun is chain/ franchised outlet. Menu wise, the quality is pretty consistent. Nothing much to say, either like the taste or hate it.

However, I notice services vary a lot from very rude to polite staffs.

The notorious one I encountered are Westmall & Jem. The polite one at Raffles Place, Lot 1 & Taka basement,so far.

Kopi uncles & aunties especially tends to be easily  irritable, like very self entitled seniors.
Jem is one for example. They do take feedback, and answer you this is it, bopian.

Atmosphere wise, Yakun's positioning is a " stall" ,  Toastbox is a ' shop'.  Therefore Yakun is stuffy, when located next to a stall doing frying, such as at Jem/Lot 1 , and many more. Another problem is way too crampy for comfort. Bumping into next table is possible. Or, have to excuse your way through. It's like taking flight, u have the window seat

Upkeeping has a lot of room for improvement. Dirty tables & floors are not attended.

Are the staffs welfare poor? What cause the sub par services? Can ventilation be improved? Maybe that explained staffs frustration too, which in turns, vented on others.

Bopian can mean take it or leave it, you can say it to life. To your customer.....on 2nd tot, no one say cannot.

The test of good service is when welfare is bad , and ventilation is poor, unfortunately.
author: Jeff Wang

review_text:
Ya Kun Kaya Toast (Jurong Gateway): A Mixed Bag (3.5/5 Stars)

Rating Breakdown:

• Kaya Toast: 5/5 (Still a classic, perfectly toasted with the right amount of butter and kaya)

• Coffee and Tea: 3/5 (Not as flavorful and not as piping hot as other outlets)

Overall: 3.5/5

Donkey and I are huge fans of Ya Kun Kaya Toast! We're not sure what it is about their coffee and tea, but it's always so flavorful.  Whenever we're craving a good cup of coffee or tea, Ya Kun is our go-to choice, especially if there's one nearby.

We were in the Jurong Gateway area and decided to visit this outlet for a coffee and some kaya and butter bread toast. However, we noticed that the coffee at this outlet was a bit different from the other outlets we've tried. It wasn't as flavorful, and it wasn't as piping hot as we're used to. We also found the tea to be less flavorful than usual.

Their kaya toast is still a classic Singaporean treat. It's always perfectly toasted, with just the right amount of butter and kaya.  We love the combination of the sweet kaya and the salty butter.

author: Doraemon

review_text: Lousy food quality at this store. All three pieces of my toast were sliced sloppily (as pictured), with half of the bread gone. For the price, I expected something at least minimally consistent. The ventilation is terrible too.
author: Sarah T.

review_text:
I forgot how tasty Poulet chicken is!

A random choice of Poulet, cos the Hakka restaurant we wanted to try had a crazy long queue, made me revisit an almost forgotten restaurant.

We ordered the whole chicken that came with the most delicious creamy mushroom sauce and two side dishes. The duck and mushroom croquettes were very good too!

Another thing worth mentioning is the warm service from the crew. They were so accommodating and even gave our friend a complimentary dessert with a birthday song! Thank you so much! 🥰

#tiramisoooo #tramisoooojiaks #jiakjiakjiak #poulet #westgte
author: Tiramisooo Tiramisooo

review_text: We visited on October 15, 2025, for a belated celebration dinner. We ordered the roast chicken with mushroom sauce, truffle mushroom risotto, Salad de Paris, and seafood cassoulet with toasted baguette and Garlic Butter Clam Little Toast. The promotion offered excellent value. It was my first time trying risotto, and I was pleasantly surprised by how much I enjoyed it. The seafood cassoulet, however, could have used more sauce. We ended up skipping dessert, mistakenly interpreting the waiter's efficient table clearing as a signal to leave.
author: Jessie Chua

review_text:
Came here for dinner and I’d say Poulet offers really good value for money, especially with their set dinner. The variety is nice, and portion sizes are fair for the price.

The Brussels sprouts were a highlight as it was charred just right and very flavorful. The mushroom soup, on the other hand, tasted quite similar to canned soup, which was a little underwhelming. The salad was fine, nothing too special.

For mains, the creamy pasta with beef cheek stood out. The sauce had a nice creamy texture with a spicy kick, which kept it from feeling too heavy. The fish dish came with a lemon sauce that worked well to balance out any fishiness, and the chicken dish was decent too.

Desserts were a mixed bag. The bubble tea pudding was disappointing as the pearls weren’t chewy and the taste didn’t really remind me of bubble tea. The mango pudding, though, was much better and enjoyable.

Overall, Poulet is a value-for-money spot with some hits and misses, but worth coming back for a casual dinner.
author: Ming Shen Tham

review_text: Had the 3-course meal and was pleasantly surprised by how delicious most dishes tasted! The standout was definitely the black pepper cream sauce chicken. The meat was tender, and the sauce was rich and flavourful. The spicy chicken sausage and clam toasts were incredibly tasty, and the truffle fries were decent. For dessert, the bubble tea pudding was a little too sweet for my liking. The mango pudding tasted better.
author: Rlyejayn

review_text:
Normal taste for almost dishes we ordered. And food came out so fast that we wondered if it was pre-made.
The roasted chicken disappointed us as the breast was woody n tough without other taste. I can’t believe this is the signature dish. Pasta was a bit tough also. Only the strawberry toast surprised us.
Btw we gotta constantly shoo away a fly, a bit of workout during this meal.
author: Notos

review_text:
A dependable spot for great Japanese yakitori and donburi at JEM. The food is consistently satisfying — well-grilled skewers with good char, flavourful sauces, and comforting rice bowls made with quality ingredients. Simple, no-nonsense Japanese food done right

The seating area is small and straightforward, more functional than fancy, but it works well for a quick meal or takeaway. One small suggestion is that service staff could speak a little louder, as the background noise from the mall and kitchen can make it hard to hear at times
author: Loki

review_text:
Tori Q at JEM always seems to have a long queue, but thankfully it moves quickly, so you won't be waiting too long to get your food.

It's a convenient grab-and-go meal—you pick your skewers, they place them over a bed of rice, and you're good to go. The skewers taste decent, with a decent grilled flavor that hits the spot when you're craving something simple and satisfying.

That said, the rice feels a little pricey at around $2, considering it's mostly rice topped with seaweed and a few pickles. Still, if you're looking for a quick and fuss-free meal, Tori Q is a pretty solid option.
author: Ming Shen Tham

review_text: I enjoyed the grilled skewers at TORI-Q, Jem, juicy, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. A tasty spot for quick Japanese-style bites.
author: Peter Tay

review_text: The rice is delicious...no sauce for the grilles if you do not like it to be salty!
author: H Lai (The Sun Always Rises)

review_text: always always amazing food. enjoy it every single time without fail it's amazing. a good place for takeaway or a quick snack. love their rice combo. staff are so friendly and gives a good portion of extra sauce when requested. limited seating tho. dining in at this outlet not recommended for more than 4 Pax.
author: a.nth3a

review_text:
PROSPERITY FEAST ($108, 750g), great for two to three pax. Featuring 8️⃣ types of premium meat for grilling, including their signature Korean Galmaegisal!

🐖 Signature US Pork Skirt Meat (Galmaegisal)
🐖 Premium Pork Jowl (Hangjeongsal)
🐖 Original Pork Belly (Samgyeobsal)
🐖 US Thick-Cut Pork Collar (Yangnyeom Moksal)
🐄 Nuruk Black Angus Beef Outside Skirt (Nuruk So Anchangsal)
🐄 Prime Beef Oyster Blade (Gwangyang Bulgogi)
🐓 Garlic Chicken Thigh (Garlic Dakgalbi)
🐓 Spicy Chicken Thigh (Spicy Dakgalbi)

My favourite cuts for this meal were the beef, pork belly and garlic chicken. We also got two fruit sodas, a pancake and jjigae to help cut down on the meatiness.

Since it was the weekend, it was packed and dining time was limited to 1.5 hour. This was also the first time we tried grilling ourselves, usually we would have a grill master. It was fun and easier to pace ourselves.
author: Jennifer

review_text: The beef was juicy and tender, and the marination was tasty, but the cuts were inconsistent in size and shape. Looked like it was prepared by an inexperienced chef. The sides were also very tasty. The cabbage was well washed and very fresh. Very impressed with how they washed and prepared it. Definitely better than an ordinary bbq restaurant in Seoul. Service was so so only. They need a lot of training and improvements to make customers feel welcome. The background music was neither relaxing for customers to enjoy a meal nor rhythmically engaging for customers to feel excited. In general, the background music gave a feeling of unmatched noise for a restaurant. I think they should play better music.
author: Flying Molen

review_text: Amazing experience at SEORAE JIB! The collaboration with Chef Yoon Nam-No from Culinary Class Wars was a game-changer. The dishes were expertly crafted, and the service was top-notch. The hay-smoked meats were tender and flavorful, and the Makkoli sorbet was a refreshing twist. Highly recommend the Pork & Beef  set
author: Monkey Skye

review_text: Today came  here after 9 months ago. The meat quality  was still good . Just that the pork belly was slightly lesser than 9 months ago when came upon checking past photos . Staff Darryl was helpful in the BBQ process.  He is patient and proactive. His BBQ skill is good and tasty for the assisted grilled  meat.
author: S M

review_text:
One of my worst meals ever for the high price tag ($25/pax). Ordered a bowl with black angus beef oyster blade and I'm certain that they gave some cheap slices of beef instead - hard and overcooked (you can see my pictures).

The vegetables side dishes and radish kimchi was bitter as well, probably leftovers for a long time.

Also asked for ice water, server nodded and we never got them.

I would stay far away from this place, or this branch in particular, unless you wanna waste your money like me..
author: Gerald

restaurant_name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh JEM
review_text:
For some reason, I actually prefer their cheaper bak kut teh option. Even though the pork ribs have less meat, I find it tastier, but that is just my personal preference.
The soup is still very good, and a big plus point is that the refills are not diluted at all. I really enjoy it because it is very peppery, which is exactly what I look for in bak kut teh.
The sliced pork soup is alright. The pork is super soft, though I personally do not enjoy it as much because it is a bit too soft for me. Again, just personal taste.
The other side dishes are pretty normal. The sesame chicken was slightly disappointing as the sauce was too watery. I think it would be better if the sauce were thicker, although flavour wise it is still okay.
Overall, it is still a solid place for peppery bak kut teh, especially if you enjoy strong soup with unlimited refills.
author: Ming Shen Tham

restaurant_name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh JEM
review_text:
Had their lunch set priced at $13.90++, which was a filling and comforting meal overall.

What I appreciated was the service. I was in a cast and on a wheelchair, and despite it being close to peak hour lunchtime, the staff kindly arranged a bench seat that was more spacious and accommodating for my leg. That small gesture made a big difference.

That said, perhaps because we came early, the soup didn’t quite pack the peppery punch I remembered from previous visits. It was still enjoyable, just a little milder than expected.
author: Yun Yi Thiam

restaurant_name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh JEM
review_text: Quite disappointed with the Bak Kut Teh I had at Jem, the pork rib was quite overly “done” and extremely tough and chewy and I can only imagine the cooking time is too short or the chef was too rush to serve the dish. The taste was totally deviated from the one I had at Chinatown and I felt extremely thirsty after the meal. I believe the management needs to align the procedure and ensure consistency in the quality of the pork rib, and more importantly, maintain the appropriate soup base, regardless of the branches across this island. For the time being, I doubt I will hold back my visit to Song Fa Bak Kut Teh JEM.
author: Reiko H

restaurant_name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh JEM
review_text: Tasty Bak Kut Teh and mild soup. The food are fast in servive and many choices to eat with. I love the fried dough when dipping in the soup.
author: Pracha Pong

restaurant_name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh JEM
review_text:
I had a wonderful dining experience at Song Fa Bak Kut Teh. The Bak Kut Teh was absolutely delicious, with a rich, peppery broth that was both aromatic and comforting. The pork ribs were very tender, juicy, and fell off the bone easily, showing the excellent quality and careful preparation.
The side dishes like braised tofu and salted vegetables complemented the soup perfectly. I especially loved dipping the meat into the dark soy sauce with chili, it enhanced the flavor even more. The you tiao was also crispy and perfect for soaking up the flavorful broth.
The restaurant was clean, well-organized, and the service was fast and efficient even during busy hours. The staff were friendly and attentive, making the whole experience pleasant.
Overall, Song Fa Bak Kut Teh truly delivers authentic, high-quality Bak Kut Teh. A must-visit place in Singapore for anyone who loves traditional and comforting food. Highly recommended.
author: My Cherrie Amourre

review_text:
We had a wonderful dinner on 28 October to celebrate my husband’s birthday. He loves Jack’s Place’s baked potato!

We ordered the Jack’s Special Steak and the Bacon wrapped Fillet Mignon with Truffle Butter (which can be salted a bit more due to the thickness of the steak) but still delicious. The service was excellent from start to finish. We were served by Hanafiah, the Assistant Manager, who was friendly and attentive. He recommended the Lobster & Crab Stuffed Mushroom, which turned out to be an excellent choice!

A big thank you as well to his team — Nantha, Jamilah, and Susan who were all warm, attentive, and professional throughout the evening. They truly made our dining experience special.

We’ll definitely be back again!
author: Lili Ang

review_text: The old school restaurants probably visited more by seniors coz that is exactlly what I see. The interior deco, ambience reminds myself of my younger days. Jack's Place have really been around for decades & I'm glad it still exist today. Serves great food & this has not changed over the years. Always love their set meals that is well budgeted to meet today's expensive Singapore. Am here for a Valentine's celebration with my wife. Thanks you, I had a great time.
author: viking T

review_text: The otak fish was not fully cooked thus I asked for it to be recooked.Waiter was very kind to replace a new set.Very succulent and love the taste.lamb chop was over cooked n tough to cut through. Soup was great.The lunch set come with free tea and the dessert was a small brownie.Really worth the money.
author: teck huay lim

review_text:
I was here today with my wife for lunch. We were primarily here, because I was able to redeem a complimentary Great Eastern Life lunch voucher, and my wife was craving for some Fish and Chips. So, I ordered with my lunch voucher, a 150g NZ Striploin Steak (medium rare), and it came with gravy, split potato jacket with sour cream, faux bacon bits and spring onions, and a side of veggies - and it was nostalgically very good; "nostalgically" because it was done the old-school Singapore way, which I will elaborate later. And my lunch voucher also afforded me a tea with (and again, this is old-school) evaporated milk on the side, and a lovely scoop of vanilla gelato, and ..  plus, by mistake by staff, a slice of garlic bread that is actually meant for another type of lunch set; but never mind, I appreciated the gesture. As for my wife, she ordered (as I hinted earlier) a New England Fish & Chips, which she enjoyed very much. Service here was very very good - very polite, very friendly, very helpful and very attentive. The dining ambience here was also very very good - we were assigned a booth overseeing the spacious and well-ventilated dining area before us.

Back to what I meant by "nostalgically" - before Singapore became a "hub" for Western restaurants and fine dining, Jack's Place led the way for then, affordable Western cuisine dining. And I am happy that it is still very popular locals for that very same reason and for those who have not lost touch with, or are, or are still looking for that old-school Western cuisine done in the Singapore style.
author: edtayjb

review_text:
Tried their pre-Christmas lunch. Turkey is a bit dry. Barramundi and dory fish fillet are good. Pumpkin soup, cupcake are nice.

Staff service are extremely friendly and attentive, a slight wait when restaurant is full and at its peak lunch hour which is understandable.
author: P. C.

review_text: We had the mutton briyani, butter chicken and naan bucket. We thought the sizes looked small but they were very filling. Price bit on the high side but would come for celebrations / special occasions. Many thanks for a nice meal.
author: Jufri Annuar

review_text: Anjappar was great! Food was hot and tasty and orders were served in 10mins or less. Staff was very friendly and dining atmosphere was awesome. Well done!
author: IY Eo

review_text: Relaxing atmosphere and good food with quite large servings. So not to over order!
author: Masaki Wong

review_text: Authentic chettinaad cuisine. Delicious curry with variety of options.
author: Fairuz Aarif

review_text:
I recently dined at this Indian restaurant and was disappointed with the Mutton Biryani. The portion of mutton was extremely small—just two tiny, bony pieces—which did not justify the $16 price tag. The pricing felt excessive, especially given the lack of substantial meat in the dish.

When I asked the waiter if this was really the standard portion of mutton, he simply said "yes" and walked away without any further explanation or concern. This lack of customer service added to the overall disappointment.

On a positive note, the ambience was decent, offering an authentic Indian restaurant feel. However, the portion sizes and service definitely need improvement to match the cost and provide better value for customers.
author: Hafiz Halim

restaurant_name: Miam Miam French Japanese Cafe Kitchen (Westgate)- All day Dining
review_text: Service is top notch the moment I stood at the entrance. Was acknowledged with a smile and gesture even when the staff is still serving another customer. Was seated almost immediately. Food ordered and served fast ...taste is awesome from starters, mains n desserts. Staff were all friendly,  helpful and observant throughout the dining period. Truffle oil onsen egg mushroom soup and squid with squid ink pasta is a must try. The dessert we ordered caramelised banana pancake is really a great ending to our meal. We savor every bit of it. Kudos to the chef/chefs in charge. Highly recommended and will definitely visit again.
author: Rowena Chen

restaurant_name: Miam Miam French Japanese Cafe Kitchen (Westgate)- All day Dining
review_text:
I had a lovely meal here! The squid ink rice was very nice, rich in flavor and perfectly cooked. The egg on top was especially good, buttery and full of flavor. I also tried the banana pancake, which was soft and not too sweet, just the right balance for a comforting dessert.

The drinks were decent, the iced coffee wasn’t very aromatic, but the hot coffee was okay.

Service was excellent,  fast, efficient, and thoughtful. I really appreciated that they provided small plates without having to ask. Overall, a pleasant dining experience with great food and attentive service. Would come back again!
author: Reina K

restaurant_name: Miam Miam French Japanese Cafe Kitchen (Westgate)- All day Dining
review_text: It's truly amazing and impressive. Every waitress's staff member was exceptional, courteous, and always had a warm smile on their face. The manager exhibited a high level of politeness and friendliness. I am thankful for the fact that I accidentally poured the water as I stood up. The manager and staff were extremely kind and continually told me it was all okay; it was just water. Their delicious food should not be forgotten.  I strongly recommend this to anyone
author: HG G

restaurant_name: Miam Miam French Japanese Cafe Kitchen (Westgate)- All day Dining
review_text:
We’ve visited this restaurant a couple of times now, and it never disappoints. As always, the service was excellent: the staff were polite, attentive, and hardworking, clearing empty plates promptly and making us feel well taken care of.

We ordered two set lunches along with a seasonal appetizer, and everything was delicious. The food was tasty and the portions were just right. A thoroughly enjoyable meal, so we’ll definitely be back again! 😊
author: Michelle Tan

restaurant_name: Miam Miam French Japanese Cafe Kitchen (Westgate)- All day Dining
review_text: This is our first visit to the restaurant. We came to celebrate my daughter's birthday. The food is flavourful and we love the attentive service from the restaurant's manager. She paid attention to what we said and gave my daughter a creme brule to commemorate her birthday. My girl enjoyed her pancakes and complimentary dessert. Thank you for making today memorable for us. We will definitely come back again.
author: Jesslyn Juan

review_text: Food is above average! I would even dare to say it's great. We came in hot and sweaty and the lady behind the counter helped us find the table with the best ventilation and pointed the fan at us
author: Potatisen Potatisen

review_text: Good food with free flow barley tea at affordable prices. The yakitori skewers were surprisingly good. Corn is sweet and scallion was fragrant!
author: Emily Ho

review_text: Really delicious japanese grills. The mushrooms and pork all perfectly cooked. But the wait time is 45mins to 1 hour for the food prep coz i think they are very short staffed
author: Mei Yi Yeap

review_text:
Absolutely divine food and amazing service! There was only one staff yet service speed was well within reasonable range and everything was grilled to perfection!

Most importantly what fuelled me to (finally) leave a review was the exceptional service quality of that one staff. I am in awe.
author: Joanna K

review_text:
Grilled items are either overdone (and attempted to hide) or underdone.
Staff dropped a Yakitori skew on the table and just put it back onto the plate😵‍💫
author: Chee Wan Lim

restaurant_name: Paradise Dynasty 樂天皇朝 at Westgate
review_text:
Finally decided to try the xiao long bao here after walking past it multiple times when we go to NTF hospital.

We ordered an assortment of xiao long bao, the original xiao long bao and the meat buns.

Overall, food was great. The xiao long bao skin was thin and delicate. Dumplings were full of flavours. Personally, I still prefer the original xiao long bao compared to the fancy ones.

Service was excellent and staff were very attentive.

Would love to come back to try other items in the menu.
author: Corinne Yong

restaurant_name: Paradise Dynasty 樂天皇朝 at Westgate
review_text: A good variety of Chinese dishes on the menu, with some unique options you don’t usually see elsewhere. Service was prompt and pleasant. We ordered a few dishes to share. Most were delicious and well-suited for those who enjoy bold, flavourful tastes.
author: S S

restaurant_name: Paradise Dynasty 樂天皇朝 at Westgate
review_text:
Overall, the food quality was of top notch quality and taste.

Areas of improvement:-
- service staff attentiveness and difficult to get assistance.
- lack of trained staff.
- diners left 15 minutes to 30 minutes, tables still not cleared for next diners.
- Paradise mobile app down at the moment of payment
author: Kevin Tan

restaurant_name: Paradise Dynasty 樂天皇朝 at Westgate
review_text:
27-Jan-2026 (Tue)
No queue during lunch time. Honestly, all the dishes tasted kinda bland to me except for the Prawn Pork Chilli Vinegar. I don't find it value for $$$.
author: SG Ong

restaurant_name: Paradise Dynasty 樂天皇朝 at Westgate
review_text:
Thought it was just a normal Chinese noodle since my girl wanted it. Didn’t expect it to taste like ramen, but it was tasty.

The service was okay but could’ve been better. We waited in line for a bit even though the outside tables were clean and empty. We only managed to get in after letting staff know that we are okay to sit outside.
author: Charliee Ng

review_text:
Came here for dinner. Service was excellent, with friendly staff and clean tables. Atmosphere is pretty chill despite the queues outside.

Food is served at a reasonable pace. Food's delectable, with the piping hot soup a testament to the freshness of it's food, as it is cooked on the spot. Their chilli condiment is superb, complimenting most of its dishes perfectly.

Overall, it's a fantastic experience dining here. Recommend you to come down and try it!
author: Everhart

review_text:
Great food at an affordable price with a really comfortable ambience. The dishes were flavorful and well-prepared, and the portions were just right.

Service was efficient and the place felt clean and welcoming. Definitely a great spot for a satisfying meal without breaking the bank. Would happily come back again!

#Lucky CNY Cake was a standout  🟰crispy on the outside and chewy on the inside, so satisfying!
#The spicy dumpling noodles were also delicious, with a nice kick of heat and well-seasoned dumplings.
author: Ashley Dior

review_text: My wife and I were here today (15 February 2026) for an early lunch. While we have dined at the Tim Ho Wan outlet at Plaza Singapura on many occasions, it was our first time dining here at this Tim Ho Wan outlet at Westgate. We ordered here today our "usuals" whenever we are at Tim Ho Wan: Shrimp Dumplings (3pcs), Signature Baked BBQ Pork Bun (3pcs), Pan-fried Radish Cake (3pcs), Shrimp Rice Rolls (3pcs), $5.80++ Fried Taro Dumplings with Chicken, and Supreme Pu-erh Tea (Hot). In our opinion, the dim sum at this Westgate outlet seemed better than the one at Plaza Singapura in terms of taste and texture. As for the service here, we must commend the Tim Ho Wan staff here who were polite and attentive, despite today being a Sunday and being the eve of Chinese New Year's Eve. As for the dining ambience here, it was nice enough with the tables spaciously separated and in air-conditioned comfort.
author: edtayjb

review_text:
Food quality was okay, but the taste wasn’t as good as it used to be. During weekday brunch hours around 11am, the place was already quite packed. Manpower seemed sufficient, but at times our table requests were overlooked, and the food took quite a long time to be served. Our last dish, the carrot cake, arrived almost when we had finished everything else.

The seasonal item, crème brûlée, had an over-torched sugar layer that was burnt and very bitter, which spoiled the whole dish. The wonton skin was very thick at the bottom and had a strong alkaline taste.

For the same price, I can find better and more authentic dim sum elsewhere. That said, Tim Ho Wan’s dining environment is better, with a lower chance of being turned away and shorter queue times during peak hours.
author: Lyla (ZL)

review_text:
Had the chance to visit the new Westgate space, and there’s even a new menu. We got to try the mushrooms, foie gras, and truffles in the dumplings to mango-cheese crab rolls that crunch then melt.

It was so good, not sure if the menu is still available, but if it is .. you should give it a try! 👍🏻

IG - @adblehs / @at.foodcrawls ✨
author: Amanda Tay

review_text: All time favourite place to chill.. absolutely love their blooming onion and beer butt chicken. Been coming here since +10 years ago and the standard hasnt changed. Do note that the beer butt chicken has to be pre ordered. Waiting time is about 75 mins
author: Iris Lim

review_text: Great food and great service! Came in as I remembered they had great carbonara since I last had it a few years ago. I was so pleasantly surprised it’s still so delicious! Creamy and delicious, but not jelak. Steak was super tender and flavourful; I have never had such a good steak in any pub/bistro before. Ribs were great too. Lamb shank was so tender as well it literally fell off the bone. And my god the service was so good! I came in with my 2 kids, 1 of whom is a baby. The service staff was so kind to check if our handheld baby carrier was safe on the chair and wouldn’t fall off, and kept checking in to see if the baby was alright. No doubt will be back here again soon!
author: Nigel Loo

review_text:
Went to this Western bar at Tradehub 21 on a weekday evening and had a great time! Made a reservation easily and was happy to know that it’s pet-friendly — brought my dog along and sat at the outdoor open seating area. They had several air coolers around so it was quite comfortable even outdoors.

The food was surprisingly good! I had the pork chop, which came with a choice of two sides — very satisfying. Tried the "Suicide Wings" too — super spicy, just like the name suggests! The satay was served in a really unique way — they poured alcohol over it and lit it on fire. Quite an impressive presentation!

The vibe was chill, and the waitress who served us was friendly and attentive. Only downside was that the salad was sold out, but overall, it was still a solid experience. Plenty of parking lots available too. I think they recently relocated here, so it's nice to see them settling in well. Will definitely come back again!
author: Pauline Wee

review_text:
This place obviously prides itself on their alcoholic drinks, given how much of their drink are alcohol-based.

Ordered a breaded fish set meal, which comes with 2 sides and a drink. Food was a little underwhelming.

Service was good. Ambience was also nice and not too noisy.
author: Joshua Tong

review_text:
Definitely one of my most favourite go-to places especially for great food, especially their steaks and meats, despite the seemingly pretty “out-of-the-way” locations.

They used to be a spot just about a 5min walk away, and my heart almost sunk when we arrived at the old location and thought they had closed for good without knowing where they might have went!

Thankfully there was somewhat of a “paper-notice” hung around the old place to redirect us to the bigger, newer, and air-conditioned location just 5-mins in another direction.

The newer place definitely had more spaces, have air-conditioning now, and more well lit than the previous place which was just dark and gloomy.

Thankfully there food is just as amazing and awesome as it used to be and I had my most favourite steak there coupled with some extra meats. Their chicken wings and especially satays are just amazing as well!

Would totally come back again in the near future!

PS. If you were at the old place, there was no service charge or GST last I remembered, but now they have both, so the final tally might be a little pricier. But.. I would still come back to enjoy a good meal here!
author: Robert Chai

review_text:
Date: 04 Jan 2026
Great location.
Free space to taste delicious burgers.
Not too spicy, but the taste wasn't bad.

French fries were really nice, and so were the soft drinks.

Cheers!
author: Arul Honest Raj

review_text:
DLite chicken sandwich was great with juicy fresh chicken, unluckily the chicken tenders were a bit dry so we really had to use a lot of sauce, the cheese fries were nice (not as good as shake shack cheese fries) and I really enjoyed the biscuit with jam (scone with jam) - I normally would expect jam and cream but it was a very buttery biscuit so it worked well!

Tables were pretty clean considering it was busy, and it was quick to get our food and a table to sit and eat at
author: Tia C

review_text:
Why I give 2 stars:

1)The Chicken sandwich is large.
But lacks taste. Bad choice of Thousand island dressing.
Meat is not marinated.
There is no signature taste.
I'm thinking of MC Donald's double MC spicy when eating this.

2) Medium drinks sold as "Large"
3) Medium coleslaw sold as "Large"

It's a Rip off.

Only thing good is the cheese fries.
author: Khitan

review_text: I had their new Umami Seaweed chicken burger but I can't really taste the seaweed. Maybe they should put more seaweed but the chicken is juicy and hot and the coleslaw is nice.
author: NiceKopi

review_text: The best fried chicken in Singapore, new outlet, all new and it’s very clean! The staff are super friendly even they’re very busy and in peak hour. Good training to staff! Quality fried chicken! Best!
author: Chin Kang Teh

review_text: One of my fav place in IMM. Food is tasty with decent portion and reasonable priced. Shrimp paste chicken was crunchy and juicy while the baked salmon rice was tasty and savoury. The milk tea was also very smooth and creamy with the right balance of sweetness. There is also a complimentary soup per main dish ordered which was great. However, payment can only be done in cash or paynow and there's no menu for us to visualise the dishes.
author: ZZ

review_text:
Went this place few months back, was flipping thru my camera album and realised I haven write about this place!

Okay, was spoilt for choice of which place to take our dinner that day. Since we haven't visit this place before, we came to try it out.

Ordered for the salted egg meat patty rice, it's so good! Really like it. The meat patty was thick with just the right amount of rice. You know it when some place give you twice the amount of rice with a thin and sad looking piece of patty. It's really a pleasant surprise. They also provided a bowl of complementary soup with the rice. Partner had the dumpling noodle soup, tried abit of the noodles and took a bite of the dumpling, nice. Thou this place looks abit boring, but they does make nice food. The pork chop bun is good, patty is crispy so does the bun! The best among all the items we have ordered. On the side note, the Yuanyang drink was not bad.

Might be back for other items if around this area.
author: Ginger

review_text: A very nice place to get a quick lunch. You ordered on a piece of paper, bring to the counter and boom...food comes. Price is very reasonable for the place. Seats are spacious and well spread out. Staff are nice and polite too. Food tasted good, had the dumpling noodles soup and tasted just the way it should be..noodles are springy, and had like 4 large prawn dumplings. They have corner booth seat, nice and quite for 1 to 2 persons dining in.
author: JA A

review_text: Haven’t tried this place for a very very time. The fact that they are still in business means something. The seafood black pepper horfun, wanton mee and portugese curry chicken baked rice were yummy.  The wanton noodles were tat too salty and the cheechong fun was disappointing. Other than that, the yuan yang was fantastic. Brought me back to HK. Approved.
author: WDG Dingguo

review_text: Wan Chai Hong Kong Tea Room offers a comforting, casual Hong Kong–style dining experience. The fresh shrimp dumpling noodles stood out — the prawns were plump and fresh, the dumplings nicely wrapped, and the noodles paired well with the light, savoury broth. It’s definitely a dish worth trying if you’re here
author: Loki

review_text:
Had a mixed experience at Subway in IMM Mall, Singapore. While the food quality was good, the service left much to be desired. The person preparing the sandwiches seemed in a rush, pressuring us to place our order quickly even though there was no one behind us in the queue.

They rushed us, making it hard to pick the toppings we wanted for our sandwiches.
author: Shash

review_text:
Very bad experience at Subway.
We had ordered and were eating Subway food, while also feeding our one-year-old baby a few chips (his snack). The staff came and very rudely said outside food isn’t allowed. Even after explaining it was for the baby, they continued to behave arrogantly instead of politely handling the situation. On top of that, the staff said only three sauces were allowed but added them in very small quantity, the food quality was poor, and the soft drinks were served at room temperature. Overall, a terrible experience — rude staff, bad food, and no basic courtesy.
author: shivam arora

review_text: Visited this chain after a long while. Was searching a good deal when then $5.90 value meal combo struck my eye. This comes with a drink and cookie of your choice, as well as 4 6-inch 'subs' that you can choose from. Got the Chicken Shroom Poloni meal. Well-staffed for a Saturday lunch period; each station had 1. Staff were polite. The product was good, especially if coupled with mustard and mayonnaise sauces. The wholegrain bread was crunchy and worthwhile in itself. The 'sub' wasn't soggy at all and it was clear that fresh ingredients had been used. A White Macacdemia Cookie was taken as the extra. Good cookie. Soft, simple and subtle. Cup given for drinks was of good volume. Very nice interior with pictures of various ingredients that Subway offers. Good warm lighting with ample seating. Located near McDonald's.
author: Ivan Varghese

review_text:
Visit date: 24/10/2024 (Aprox. 1700hrs)

One of the greatest Subway outlets in SG!

The lady who prepared my flatbread was friendly and efficient. Bread was soft and fluffy with fresh ingredients. Ham toasties was warm and fantastic. Mac and cheese was simple yet delicious.

The lady who served at the cashier counter was very customer-oriented, kind and polite.

Great team!
author: Anna K

review_text: Had been having subway for many years and i believe it is also a global renowned brand. Giving 5 stars for the Subway leader (the lady dressed in black) customer service (sorry i didnt catch your name). I was dining in with my family so we order afew sandwiches but only opt for 1 set. She took over the cashier and give advice on how to optimise my meal. Paying a cheaper price for more! Thumbs up. Going the extra mile!
author: jianhao lee

review_text:
Seoul Garden Hotpot is a solid option for Korean comfort food in a casual mall setting. The dolsot bibimbap is well done, served hot with good texture and flavour, and the free-flow kimchi and namul are a nice touch that really complements the meal

One area that could be improved is the counter service. During my visit, an elderly couple spent about five minutes at the counter doing a ball-type lucky draw, which slowed things down for others waiting to pay
author: Loki

review_text:
Wasn't impressed by the environment as it looks rather 'empty' but the food were fantastic. The taste fits our tastebuds and I couldnt help but order a 2nd round of tteokbokki (with a full tummy).
We love the waffle ice cream dessert as well! Waffle was crunchy and nice.
Both Shahrima and Connie are very helpful and friendly - good service in helping us top up the kimchi soup that was too thick with hot water
We will be back to try more of the dishes and dessert
author: Patricia Ker

review_text:
One of the best Seoul Garden Hotpot. They have different varieties of drinks and dessert. Exclusively at IMM branch only.

Their garlic fried chicken wings is one of the best so far. Their spicy squid is on the dot - not overcooked.

Only branch with self serve kimchi, lotus root and radish salad.
author: T0m2y Ch00

review_text: Our experience was exceptional. The staff fostered a welcoming and friendly atmosphere from the moment of our arrival. Additionally, we were provided with a discount on the croissant dessert.
author: Efa Soleha

review_text:
Love the premium tier. But regular is fine too cos there’s really a wide variety.

Love the ambience here. Toilet is nearby too in case you need to visit halfway
author: Rice Noodles

review_text:
The warm service, affordability, and pleasant ambiance more than made up for the rather average food. The food was somewhat fresh, though lacking in flavor.

The atmosphere was comfortable, with great ventilation and none of the typical fishiness found at typical express sushi chains.

Kudos to Pham who patiently packed my bulk purchase of sushi express tea. Appreciate the careful packing and general positive vibes.

Overall, a pleasant experience!
author: MH Tham

review_text:
Walk in on a weekend evening and waiting time is about 10 minutes.

White plate is $1.50++, black plate is $2++ and colour plate is $3++.

The food quality is good and freeflow of wasabi and green tea.
author: Robert Robert

review_text: A great sushi place selling affordable sushi options on conveyor belt and also provides a la carte orders through the menu at the same price in case you don't find it on the belt. Especially love the salmon soup!
author: Aven T.

review_text:
Service nothing to fault, atmosphere okay, looks decent, clean, ventilated and seems like just renovated?

But serving 10x in a row of fried chicken drumlets on the conveyor belt is a major turn off experience for people looking to eat sushi but being served constantly with A LOT of chicken drumlets on the belt. Am I in a chicken fast food outlet or conveyor belt sushi restaurant?

On top of that, ginger on the belt was not refilled at all for the whole time we were there.

We went on a Tuesday around 7pm dinner time, thought to revisit a young time favourite spot. Not sure if it’s bcos they didn’t raised their prices for years, and w inflation, their choice of food is very limited and pathetic now.

Stayed for 45 mins and needless to say. Left the shop hungry and sad.
author: Christina Tan

review_text:
Went to Sushi Express at IMM for dinner, the queue was long but the staff will try their best to slot you in.

Sushi choice is quite limited as compared to other sushi shops. But relatively affordable range.

Overall it's a good place for sushi if you are craving it.
author: Billy Lim

review_text:
Ya Kun Kaya Toast is a reliable spot for a quick local breakfast. The highlight for me is definitely the crispy toast — it has a nice crunch and feels lighter compared to the nearby Toast Box, which makes it quite distinctive. The soft-boiled eggs come ready to eat, smooth and nicely done, so you can just dig in without much fuss

The classic kopi/tea pairs well with the set, though the drink portion is on the smaller side, which is the only slight downside
author: Loki

review_text: Our favorite outlet due to the location, space & most importantly the staff who provide a positive dining experience to start our day. Drinks are consistently meeting standard & we appreciate the value-added service for regular customers. 👍👍👍
author: Boon Ying Choo

review_text: still my favorite place for kaya toast set. the coffee has the right aroma and the half boiled eggs are cooked to the right texture. the toast us yummy and not too sweet. the outlet after the mall upgrading has a more atas touch and more cozy as well. loved it here.
author: Sam Goh SE

review_text: While the food is just as good as at other Ya Kun branches, the seating here is very very cramped. You can't help but touch elbows with your neighbors and also hear their conversations.
author: Giri K

review_text: We ordered Kaya Toast with butter, French Toast, Peanut Toast, and the Tuna Mayo Toastwich. Everything was good for sharing, and it was nice to try a bit of each. It turned out to be quite a heavy meal.
author: Jin Arq

review_text:
Order no - 0681bca0-e17e-11f0-a46a-8ff41bdc83e4

Ordered Romano Margherita but we were delivered Beef Pepperoni Pizza. We like to get half of the money paid to be returned. Kindly dont send the voucher. Jurong East outlet keeps making this mistake again and again. They should be all fired. They dont even pick up phone. Called 20 times.

Domino's Pizza Singapore Domino's Pizza
author: Ankush Ved

review_text:
The outlet was along my way home so dropped by. The staff told me to order online to pickups. There wasn't any walkin order or dine-in. Would be nice if they had. There's empty space outside for tables & Chairs.
Saw two staffs. Got the order in abt 15mins. The website shows the live status of the pizza I ordered. The pizza looked more like thin crust pizza than new york crust pizza. Should have sticked to the regular crust. Taste was so-so.
author: Mohamed Haniffa

review_text:
Do not order from this outlet at all!!
Was informed that delivery rider was out for delivery at 6.15pm but food only arrived at 7.45pm and was completely cold. Obviously rider went to do some personal errands because no way the food coild have went cold from shop to my house. No accountability at all. Avoid this outlet
author: benjamin ho

review_text:
If Pizza dough finished, You should advice customers of it .
The pizza I collected is not even half of the actual pizza thickness.
Dough finished than should add some other food  to balance the order not make the pizza thin like biscuit.
Went there 2nd time to ask but the Staff also say " dough finished that's why we give you this " ..?
author: Eagle Black

review_text: I ordered online 22 XL + 2 L pizzas for delivery. That's a huge delivery for the size of the place so did it 2 days in advance. The order was perfect. It arrived on time, the pizzas were all fresh and hot, great presentation. Thank you!
author: Hellen T

review_text:
The restaurant manager cannot manage this group of noisy customers. The sound level of giggling is  so deafening that almost every customer that is sitting near them are affected and looking at them!! A couple of the customers quickly left the premises as I believed it’s no noisy!!!
No action was taken to handle such situation

Dated 7th Jan 26 between time from 1930 to 1950. When we left, this group of customer is still there.
author: Lyn Ho

review_text:
Gave wrong items most of the time. Lost count the number of wrong items given at this outlet. This time ordered tom yum prawn.. gave tom yum chicken.

Order numbers on the screen gone and served. Yet orders not ready and have to wait. Just cheating the kpi system
author: F C

review_text:
Firstly my fault for ordering wrong nuggets i wanted the original nuggets but press wrongly. so i asked the staff nicely whether can change to the original nuggets she say okay with some attitude.

When i checked my rest of the order, i nvr received my curry sauce so i asked the same staff( Hui min idk dont rmbr) nicely whether i can get my curry sauce she say my meal is not include curry sauce… then i said even its a meal that included the sauce that orderes
author: Nurul Rahman

review_text:
Onsite orders are missed out. And they dont seem to be surprised. Maybe MCD should start checking their ordering system. Perhaps orders automatically disappear after certain time frame and apparently the internal order paper can be lost too in the process.

Possibly due to surge of online orders
Waited about 10-15min only to find out my order was lost or not processed at all. Quite a few people ordered after me got their orders, but mine was still not ready.
Checked with counter and they didn't tell me about my missed order and just turned around to ask kitchen to prepare my missed order after he found out that my order was not on the waiting table nor on the front desk.

I do appreciate his effort to take up the responsibility to ensure all things are packed for my order. But it may be better to keep customer informed of the situation. Waited another 5-10mins or so to get my order packed.

As I am unaware of whether the order was packed somewhere and they are just looking for it or they are preparing it fresh from start, I was left there standing 😂 and I dont have the receipt anymore at the time since I gave it to the guy at the counter.

Quite sure there is SOP for this situation.. but maybe they panicked and just do what ever came into their mind 😬
author: ocean x

review_text: Enough parking during breakfast hour! Near high! Good place
author: xavier32lau

review_text:
Place is a gem, lightly polished and reminiscing the gd ol times of a pub. The aura and scent of rustic vibe. It's our go to pub for a quick bar bites, samosa are great! The tiger beer is somewhat always so nice, cold and fresh..
And my partner always has their white wine thts served super chilled. See ya arnd again!
author: Rahman Saat

review_text:
Good bar food and quality indian food at good prices. They carry mainly Whisky and beer and are price super competitively.

Staffs are the best! Is my fav hang out on my way home..
author: Lim SS

review_text: Been here twice. Love the chicken wings. Had a cidar for 8 bucks. No GST no service charge. Very unassuming place and down to earth. You won't be judged even if you wear slippers and shorts.
author: Stella H.

review_text:
Out of the way, but a great place to chill and have an early night. The crowd differs occasionally but mostly are regulars.

Loves the bar snacks as well. Very old school snacks.
author: SK K

review_text:
Great & chill family pub settings.
Both staffs & customers are all friendly & Great.

Nice place for pool players too with a 8 feet pool table & many good players.
author: Steven Max Quek

review_text: Delicious Hokkien noodles, reasonably priced, and the waiters, Ah Long and Jiaxin, are very friendly.
author: Lawrence Tan

review_text: Excellent service, cheap and delicious food. Thanks, will come back.
author: diyana

restaurant_name: 37 Teban Gardens Fishball Noodle 德曼花园纯正鱼丸面
review_text: This newcomers is much better than hawker centre fishball Noddle.
author: SOO SENG

review_text: Stall run by friendly owner. The noodle was served fast. Stall open early and inside Teban Gardens hawker. Taste ok, serving size was big.
author: Hao Tan

review_text: Ate the fishball noodles that costs $3.50. Very average…noodles too much and clumpy, fishballs not very bouncy and the sauce was so so. Auntie serving was very friendly.
author: Darryl C

review_text: Signature noodles - a lot of noodles, value for money, self service for spring onions and lettuce.
author: QQ

restaurant_name: Ri Sheng Seafood 日升海鲜小厨
review_text:
Ri Sheng delivers really good steam fish! Bonus is they will clean and gut ur fish from our fishing trip!

Sambal sotong rocks! Sambal is way better than many bbq sting rays stalls.

What a local gem of zhi zhar!
We will be back!
author: Tze Kiat Lee

restaurant_name: Ri Sheng Seafood 日升海鲜小厨
review_text: Been frequent this stall for years. Most unique dish is their Hokkien Fried Prawn Mee 福建炒虾面, no other stall has such flavour and it tastes delicious especially with their sambal source. Other zi char dishes are really nice too. It’s not easy to find the original style of crispy beehoon 香底米粉 nowadays. We often order their Prawn Paste Chicken 虾酱鸡, but with the recent craze of salted egg dishes, their Salted Egg Chicken 咸蛋鸡 is also much better and not as deep fried as other stalls. Call them to preorder if you want to take away or reserve a table!
author: KH Chong

restaurant_name: Ri Sheng Seafood 日升海鲜小厨
review_text:
Tucked into a corner inside a popular food court, it is easy to miss them. Which I did for over three years since I moved into the neighborhood.

Yesterday, we finally gave them a tryout and realized what we've been missing. That is, honest to goodness Chinese Zi-char.

Their menu is impressive, ranging from a simple $6 rice set (sweet and sour fish is good) to fish head soup for family of four.

We will certainly be back to sample the rest of their menu.  And we just need to walk there (7 minutes) without the need to drive to Pandan Gardens.
author: CCS

restaurant_name: Ri Sheng Seafood 日升海鲜小厨
review_text:
Very nice Fish Head Steamboat and the Prawn Paste Chicken is exceptionally nice. The lady auntie is also very friendly and helpful. She even told us we can top up the soup if we finish.

It is a Zhi Char store located at the end of 1 of the coffeeshop. These 2 dishes is a must try.
author: David Wong

restaurant_name: Ri Sheng Seafood 日升海鲜小厨
review_text: Have frequented this shop for a few years already. The stall owners (an aunty and an uncle) were very friendly, my boys would always pester me to visit their favourite aunty to eat their favourite food. One of my favourite dishes is this curry mixed meat pot. Quite a large portion for the price paid too.
author: Wendy Tay

review_text: Visited on 30 Mar 2023 for lunch with colleagues and ordered the nasi padang during Ramadan. But it was good taste with the curry soaking the rice to give it extra aroma 😂
author: Eric Wong

review_text:
Step into this place and you've just time travelled to Jurong Singapore in the 1960s. Or maybe worse.

The sights and sounds (songs blaring) and food stalls unreal and unexpected- even in Teban.  Yet there seems to be place for them in industrial survival eating. Hordes of foreign workers descended for a hearty meal over hearty laughter.

Okay for them. I will hop over to next door.

My friend reminded me that this is Jurong industrial estate after all. Yes,  sorry, I forgot
author: CCS

review_text: Best nasi padang around the area! The taste is authentic just like home cooked food. I got ayam belado(a type of chilli chicken), 2 veg, and bagedil only for $7! Value for money. The guy staff serving even. asked if I want gravy after adding belado sauce. This is rare cause most shops might not do this. Come by if you in the area and try
author: Farhan Albasri

review_text: one of the best nasi padang food out there and price is affordable, portion is alot. give it a try guys. they also sell mee mee like mee soto mee siam
author: Nurul Ariyanty

review_text: Ordered in english. 1 chicken 1 vege for $7.50. Daylight robbery with the mosque just next door!!! Dont patronize a stall with no integrity. Refer to pricing in photo.
author: Googlereviewer

review_text: Highly recommended for their Malay Cuisine,Nasi Campur and morning breakfast like lontong & mee soto etc.. quality and good food. The food are quality and taste good.keep up
author: Nas Shah

review_text: Highly recommended for their Malay Cuisine,Nasi Ambeng... quality and good food. The food are quality and tastefully powerr

review_text:
Poh Poh Roasted Chicken Rice sits quietly in the far reaches of Teban Gardens Food Centre, a place few would visit unless they live or work nearby. Yet this unassuming stall rewards anyone who makes the trip. Although Google Maps lists its hours as 7.30am to 8.30pm, the owners were still preparing when I first arrived and mentioned they would be ready at 10am. I returned later in the afternoon at 4pm, when only a small handful of stalls were open, and Poh Poh was among the few serving at that hour.

The steamed chicken had already sold out for the day, a good sign of its popularity, so I ordered the roasted chicken rice. Portions come in two sizes at $4 and $5, with an optional egg for an additional dollar. The owners were warm and generous, even encouraging me to come back for more rice if I was still hungry. A simple bowl of soup accompanied the dish.

The serving was hearty and satisfying. The roasted chicken was tender with a pleasant smokiness, the rice fragrant and well-seasoned, and the overall plate comforting in its simplicity. If anything could be improved, it would be the soup, which felt more functional than distinctive. Still, the meal was enjoyable and filling, and Poh Poh stands out as one of the better chicken rice options in the Teban Gardens area.

I look forward to returning to try the crispy pork next tim
author: Keith

review_text:
JH Fishball Noodles is a beloved hawker stall in Singapore’s Teban Gardens Wet Market & Food Centre, known for serving classic, no-frills fishball noodles at wallet-friendly prices. Operating since the 1980s, it has become a go-to breakfast spot for locals seeking traditional comfort food.

I had the Fishball Noodles (dry) for $2.50 — a small portion as expected at that price, but just right for breakfast. The noodles were springy, the fishballs fresh and bouncy, and the seasoning was well balanced. Just note that it closes by 2pm, so come early. I’d rate it a 4 out of 5 — simple, satisfying, and a dependable start to the day.

review_text:
Been a long time since I’ve come here but sadly the Chye poh kway teow tastes really different to when I last had it in 2023. It is too crispy and burnt for my liking and you can’t taste the Chye poh anymore. The waiting time for this dish has also increased to about 1 hour.

Given the waiting time my guess is since this is so popular now, they probably make this using an automated machine? It looks ironically too consistent and it lack character. The machine probably makes one at a time and during service if there are multiple orders, this would only mean a longer waiting time.

The same thing happened to Chui Huay Lim’s famous oyster omelette. It was good to begin with but they confessed that they now run it on a machine with longer waiting time. Not sure if Chin Huat is doing the same.

Please bring back the old recipe 🙏🏻

Edit:
Thank you Chin Huat for your reply. The rest of the food is still amazing and I will gladly come back. Appreciate what your team does but just thought of sharing what my tastebuds were used to back then as I remember ordering a lot of this during Covid!
author: Tan Chung Hong

review_text:
Every dish is impressive. We tried the golden sauce (pumpkin) sri lankan crab, salted egg eggplants and cereal prawns.  The restaurant is honest and lets you choose the seafood with transparent prices and gave good advice. The staff is extremely friendly and a lot of people come to the restaurant for birthday celebrations.

You cannot miss the dessert. Both durian and coconut pudding are so fragrant, smooth and creamy. It is better to make reservations or even call the restaurant to reserve the crabs.
author: Kenneth Kan

review_text:
Had a wonderful experience here!

The staff were very friendly, attentive, and made us feel right at home. The seafood was amazingly fresh, cooked to perfection, and full of flavor. You can really taste the quality in every dish. The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, making it a great place to enjoy a nice meal with family or friends.

beef burger with sweet potato fries

Food itself is ok, ordered medium well and got that.  but the portion sizes are small and getting smaller. check photo for fries portion size
author: Technological Alexander

review_text:
Disappointing Experience at Common Girl
I had high expectations for Common Girl, especially since it’s under the Colin’s brand, but my recent visit was very disappointing. I ordered the grilled chicken set and added an egg, but my egg was missing from the order. Even worse, the popcorn potatoes, beans, and chicken were all badly burnt. The chicken itself was dry and served cold—it honestly felt like I was eating charcoal.
Despite it being a busy Saturday night, I still expected a certain level of quality, especially considering the long wait time. Unfortunately, the food and experience fell far below what I would expect from a brand like this. Truly unacceptable.
author: Tze Wei

review_text:
On 21/9 @ 8:23pm after my appointment purposely google to the nearest COLLIN's for dinner. Ordered a Mixed Grill & a medium Ribeye Steak, all stated clearly in the receipt to eat in, at the same time ordered 2 set of Double Chicken chop set to take away. When the food came the Ribeye was charred and hard, but bcos after a hard day work too tired to bring for exchange  we decided just go with it later just give a feedback. When we finish our dinner went to collect my takeaway, we just gave a friendly feedback said the steak was overcooked and hard, they said we ordered the wrong part, but we showed them it was a ribeye, then they said next time pls bring back to exchange. While waiting for the food i reminded the cashier my 2 takeaway both set are double portion of chicken she said she is aware but i told her she forgot to charge for one set, so i paid her additional $5/-.  Few moments later our food was ready, when we collected the food they said the spagehetti are under the chicken. So we did not suspect anything took the bag and left, when we reach home reaslized the 2 chicken set does not have any spaghetti, both are for my 2 hungry son, can you imagine how disappointed i felt.
I paid $20.90 for ribeye came out dry and hard
i paid $9.50 chicken chop + $5 double up chicken X 2 Sets total paid $29/-  end up they did not give me my spaghetti. I felt so short change. Staff do not accept feedback when we do so they not  apologetic but yet purposely short change my food. Do you think they accidently missed out? If yes, why would they tell me the spaghetti is under the chicken. I am very upset and disappointed.
I really hope the management could do something about this.
author: Dorene Lim

review_text:
Happened to be around this area and decided to just dine at the coffee shop. It was crowded but I still managed to find a seat. Ordered the ba chor mee ($4.50) and requested for extra chili. Uncle was friendly and jovial, which made me feel welcoming.

The noodles were fantastic, cooked just right, springy and not overdone. The chili gave it a strong kick, exactly how I like it. For $4.50, the portion was fair and came with a decent amount of ingredients (minced pork, mushrooms to meatballs). It’s a satisfying bowl at a very reasonable price.

Simple, hearty and well worth it if you’re in the area.
author: June Ang

review_text: Came on a Saturday evening. Auntie manning the stall had an appalling attitude. Saw us ready to order and made eye contact but couldn’t be bothered to put down her phone. Does not acknowledge when you give your order, can’t be bothered to ask for the type of noodle or chilli until she is already cooking then blames us for not saying. A very forgettable employee of this franchise.

If you’re feeling up to it, pay a little more for the Soft Ribs Noodle. The ribs are well marinated, packs full with flavours and it’s undoubtedly soft as well. It’s definitely a stall above average and prices aren’t skyrocketed, would definitely visit again. And it’s available 24/7, why not right?

For the first time I decided to sit down for breakfast n ordered laksa from a young man at exactly 0935 hrs, 23/4/23, Sunday.

The dried mee pok tasted subpar standard (not nice) n the laksa has no laksa leaves!!!!

Disappointing.
