The last pic is other branch no extra charge.  Same price. This is obvious different
author: Eunjung Lee

review_text: ''Subway staff' like to trouble customers during my order. It was almost done, I said can I order the same as the first order , Sir you have to queue back in order to have one more, I glanced at it and  the queue was long .
author: JEFFERIZZ

review_text:
A classic simple meal.
First time trying the bulgogi chicken, preferred it to the teriyaki one as it doesn’t have as much sauce overflowing on the sandwich. Staff were efficient, delicious and easy meal.
author: Charlyn

review_text:
I wanted to purchase a Subway Breakfast Set with an add-on of a roasted chicken patty. The staff refused, blaming the POS system.

​The "workaround" she proposed was absurd: she insisted I buy the Roasted Chicken bread, then top up for the ham, egg, hashbrown, and coffee (entire breakfast) separately.

​It is baffling that a staff member would block a standard order and suggest a convoluted, backward transaction instead. When challenged, she became defensive rather than helpful, asking for the receipt where I did that order.

​I have attached a receipt from another Subway location where this transaction was processed correctly.

Management, please train your team on how to process simple protein add-ons. You are making it essentially impossible for customers to give you money.
author: A C

review_text: Easily the worst Subway I have ever been to. Told them the quality of beef was subpar, portion was 5pcs of beef full of fats. the staff was unwilling to provide me a solution. Her solution was for me to order another one because i “paid already”. She mention their supplier gave them this quality of beef so next time I should “think first before ordering.” 😂. Please do not patronise this outlet and to the one who franchise this particular outlet, please train your staff proper customer service and service recovery! Horrible!
author: John Ortega

review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at this Subway outlet.

I ordered a sandwich with only lettuce, tomato, and onions, and politely asked the staff if I could have a bit more lettuce and onions. She told me it was “over standard” and refused to add more unless I paid extra.

When I asked again, she reluctantly added just a few strands of vegetables, which felt very dismissive and insincere. The final sandwich had barely any vegetables, even though I didn’t ask for anything excessive — just a reasonable amount to fill the bread.

I’ve never had this issue at other Subway outlets in Singapore, and I’ve always believed Subway allows small customisations like this. This experience made me feel unwelcome and uncomfortable.

Really hope Subway will look into this, because it doesn’t reflect the brand experience I expect.
author: Ivy Xuewen

review_text: I like visiting this Subway outlet as the staff are always friendly. They are also generous with their vegetable portions, which is great to see. The bread is consistently toasted to perfection, with a satisfying crunch in every bite. The wrap is equally delicious. I always leave feeling satisfied.
author: Jas

review_text: I ordered a Meatball Supreme, and your staff asked which vegetables and sauce I wanted to add. After I made my selections, I was told that my order does not come with vegetables and sauce. This was confusing and very frustrating. If the item does not include vegetables and sauce, the staff should not be asking customers to choose them. This was a very bad experience. Please look into this issue and ensure that all staff at your outlet are properly retrained
author: Chang KC

review_text: Haven’t been here in years. Came here with a friend who had cravings. Ordered the soup with premium loin ribs ($12.80), salted vegs ($3.30) and a braised soft pork ribs ($9.90). The soup was kinda salty. I don’t rmb it being that salty or maybe i forgotten how it taste like already. Peppery taste also pretty strong. I think the flavors of the soup is more intense than Song Fa for sure. The loin ribs was also abit disappointing. For $12.80 i expect more meat from the ribs but the meat was so thin. The braised pork ribs was surprisingly good though. Meat was tender and every piece is chunky enough to give a good bite. I will come back for the braised pork ribs but not so much for the soup actually.
author: Ray Tan

review_text:
Review of Founder Bak Kut Teh

This is truly a celebrity-beloved Bak Kut Teh restaurant — the walls lined with countless photos of famous visitors say it all. Some of my favourite celebrities have dined here, and it’s impressive to see the immense support Founder Bak Kut Teh has received over the generations.

I’ve visited many times, and the restaurant has consistently maintained that signature taste passed down from the first generation. We initially wanted to order the premium pork loin and short ribs, but they were sold out. Instead, we had the Founder Bak Kut Teh, which was wonderfully flavorful — and best of all, the soup is refillable.

We ordered two bowls of vermicelli, which paired perfectly with the Bak Kut Teh and other side dishes such as salted vegetables and fried fritters. The crispy prawn roll was generously filled with meat, fried to perfection, and had a delightfully crunchy texture. We also added braised eggs and lettuce with oyster sauce to round out the meal.
author: WanderWithWit

review_text:
Play the spot the mandopop, cantopop, Tw, HK, Mediacorp celebrities in the photos there.
Colleague highly recommended the place. With good reasons - they cooked their braised peanuts in house, not using the canned ones, the youtiao (fried fritter dough) very nice too, also said to be made in house...
Broth is the strong peppery type, with good flavours of meat and bones. We ordered the "signature" bak kut teh $9.90, 1 long piece of ribs and 2 short ones, I actually preferred the texture of the short ribs as the meat is softer.
Prawn rolls made in house $8.90, pretty good - have chunks of water chestnut inside.
Yuanyan (mixed intestines) handled well too.
Lettuce with oyster sauce also had fried crispy lard, quite nice, portion is good for $6.80.
Would recommend this place, for peppery bkt.  No wonder the stars like it.
Seems to have parking onside too, don't know the charges...
author: Cat T

review_text:
I have not been here for a number of years. The quality of BKT is still pretty good. The soup is very good, however the pork ribs is a little dry but still nice.

For BKT lover, you should give it a try.
author: Steven Teo

review_text:
Big portion, Still the best Bak Kut Teh I eat since young. It has been 2 decade I never come back here.
Nice to see the friendly cheerful founder uncle here too. 😊
author: Tan JT

review_text:
Went down to the shop, bought 2 baked(rice/lasagna) sets and 2 Pizza around 12am. I was told that the waiting time would be 20mins and so i went to the nearby coffee shop (Fayidha) to have a cup of tea and wait.

After collecting the food and bringing it home. I realised that all the food that i paid for, was cold. The pizza was cold, the onion rings were cold and the baked sets were mushy and uncooked.

Really disappointed in the service of the food preparation. Especially more so when i went personally down to buy the food.
author: S S

review_text: Came to their Kim Keat outlet to get their  2 for 1 deal, a Hawaiian Pizza and Margherita Pizza. Short waiting time and freshly baked pizzas made a great tea break snack for 4 pax. Value for money.
author: SC Tan

review_text: Can someone explain to me what the hell was wrong with the pizza?! I’ve never seen any pizza could be such damaged! This is an extremely terrible worst experience , I couldn’t believe it came from Canadian Pizza! You totally ruined my appetite and meal! Grab Food booking ID A-8DLKE3QWWO72AV, order placed at 23:17 on 25 Sep 2025! I need an explanation, apology and compensation for this!
author: Jason Dempsey

review_text:
Bought 2 pizza to my beloved son.
Beef pepperoni and Super cheese.
Taste is fantastic and my beloved son love it.
I when to the shop at Kim Keat road and Mr. Irfan assist me well. Thank you to Mr. Irfan for his excellent customer service.
author: Paul Lim

review_text: Ongoing promo of buy one get one free. We bought 2 of the XL pizzas to take away. The sizes of the different pizza boxes were displayed on the wall. Was told that waiting time will be 15 minutes. So we sat at the 2 high stools provided in the store. Air con was not cold, but it was not warm either. We waited for about 18 minutes before we got our food.
author: J C

review_text:
Several good eateries, bustling at the weekend. Convenient location across the road from the dragon playground. We enjoyed the family fun day.
Quite nice nursing room.
author: Jean Seah

review_text: Very big and spacious safra with many facilities. 1 Olympic sized pool with 2 baby pools. On a weekday, the pool is relatively empty as there are not many jobless people swimming on a weekday afternoon. They have MacDonalds and Yakun as well. We went to play the darts which is located inside the KTV room on lvl 2. There is a billiard room beside it and a bowling room on top.
author: Truth Fairy

review_text:
I would like to share some feedback about my recent visit to the billiard room. When we first entered, the staff who attended to us very unfriendly and treated badly to us.
He didn't inform and tell us to write down the name on the particular waiting list. I asked also but he didnt answer. So we just wrote down the book which also show the same as waiting list. We wasted one hour to find out that we wrote on the different book of waiting list. Very poor service.
author: Johnny TK

review_text:
One of my favorite hide outs on the weekends - whether it’s to have a meal with the family, find a quiet space to read, catch up with a group of friends or have some workout done. It offers most facilities and services where you will typically find in other country clubs, maybe less the golf courses at a much lower membership rate.

Karaoke, cafes, Chinese restaurants, drive-thru Macdonald’s and business function rooms are some of the key highlights. Very conveniently located too via Toa Payoh MRT and a couple of bus stops away.
author: Xin Hao

review_text: SAFRA Toa Payoh offers a diverse selection of dining options, catering to the varied tastes of its visitors. From restaurants to fast food outlets, and even a stall at the bowling area that serves food, drinks, and beers, there is something for everyone. The convenience of having these options available within the club adds to the overall experience, allowing members to enjoy a meal or a snack while engaging in recreational activities. Whether you're looking for a quick bite between games or a sit-down meal after a workout, SAFRA Toa Payoh has you covered with its range of dining choices.
author: oXRYSTALo Ong

review_text:
The best SaladStop! outlet in Singapore. The salads are beautifully plated and thoughtfully presented. There’s ample seating, the space is always clean, and the crew are consistently friendly, efficient, and welcoming. It’s a real pleasure to see the team work together with such great camaraderie. Plus, they remember my husband and my orders to the T, and the crew is so cheery! What a joy to eat healthy and be around such a great folks. Keep it up!

PS: thanks for providing metal utensils. Its makes such a difference to eat out of a proper ceramic bowl and metal utensils. I know some salad stops jusy do takeaways even though you ordered to dine in.
author: X Lou

review_text:
I was probably the first customer at the shop at 10+am to pack my lunch after my medical checkup. The setup was all ready and the staff attend to me promptly. Too bad there's the end of my pleasant experience.

First, they told me avocado is protein...??? Then when I was paying the screen that is supposed to show customer what they were paying for is off. Upon query, they say if I want, they can switch it on. What do u mean I want??? Isn't that the purpose?

Then after paying, when I ask about the bag for takeaway then they inform me there's a 40 cents charge for a bag.... why didn't you ask me before I pay? Do expect me to take a bowl and walk back to wherever. Even so, u should have inform!!!???? Anyway, conclusion? Let's go Poke Theory.
author: Ann Ng

review_text: Had a great experience at SaladStop! The staff, Nant, was friendly, attentive, and efficient in taking my order. Really appreciated the excellent service—it made the meal even more enjoyable!
author: CH Cheng

review_text: The physical store itself is showing its age (some wobbly tables and chairs, the leather on the bench we sat at was peeling, one of the lights was flickering on and off). But the food is great, and the staff is very friendly and attentive. Their seasonal menu items are always delicious. My only real gripe is that I live too far away to visit more frequently 🤣
author: Desmond Tribdino

review_text:
Used to eat this few years back and reminds me of the days where I couldn't grab a decent lunch and had to do quick takeaways at Salad Stop. They have closed down quite a lot of branches so it wasn't easy to come by, and took the opportunity to try again when I saw it at Novena Square.
Gone are the days when you still can pick free toppings. I actually asked for it and they told me there are no free toppings anymore, and gone were the days where I could spend less than $12 but now it costs more than $20!
Some of the items in the menu have also gone and replaced with new ones, so I decided to try Jeju Bap rather than the usual Jai Ho.
Pretty nice and friendly staff had a short chat with them. Food was of quite generous portion still was very filling after finishing the wrap. Taste of the pumpkin soup hasn't really changed over the years, but still preferred the days where we used ground black pepper instead of the powdered one.
Expensive but still pretty decent and a healthy option to choose.
author: Matthew Lee

restaurant_name: NG AH SIO Bak Kut Teh (Rangoon Road)
review_text: Pretty decent bak kut teh soup. However i do not really fancy the pork trotters as i feel its not the soft braised version. The youtiao is not freshly fried as well. The main bkt soup and its white rice has excellent standard though.
author: Louis (ahluu)

restaurant_name: NG AH SIO Bak Kut Teh (Rangoon Road)
review_text:
Got introduced to this place by a close friend and it was pretty packed when we headed down on a rainy evening for dinner.

The place is well lit, clean and fully air-conditioned, with a very traditional feel to the tables and seats there. Seemingly a store that is under the JUMBO umbrella of brands.

The soup base is dark and very tasteful. Loved that soup refills are free-flow and overall we got easily filled up. Really a good bak ku teh option and would definitely come down again if I am around the area!
author: Robert Chai

restaurant_name: NG AH SIO Bak Kut Teh (Rangoon Road)
review_text:
It’s a classic and comforting bowl of peppery bak kut teh done right. The soup was rich, garlicky, and full of flavour, with just the right level of peppery kick that warms you up instantly and then making you perspire continuously after…. The pork ribs were tender and well-cooked, it does fall off the bone rather easily.

The side dishes like braised meat and pig skin were also not bad. Service was efficient, and food was served rather fast. We came T around 2:30pm.

While prices are slightly on the higher side, I still had a satisfying bak kut teh meal.
author: Yun Yi Thiam

restaurant_name: NG AH SIO Bak Kut Teh (Rangoon Road)
review_text:
While I usually prefer herbal one, this peppery one is super nice and flavorful. Very nice on rainy day

The soup is really wow. Very peppery spicy that better to pair with cold drink even on raining day. But it’s very delicious and note to drink when hot

The prime rib also very tender and big. It’s abit pricey at $12.80 being the most expensive cut but it’s quite filling even with 2 pieces only

The braised taukee is not too bad but nothing to miss

The service crew is very nice and friendly. Giving big portions of chilli and chairs for your bags

Highly recommend
author: M P

restaurant_name: NG AH SIO Bak Kut Teh (Rangoon Road)
review_text:
Little India is strewn with quite a few bak kut teh joints even one from Klang. This place started way back in the 70s offering peppery bak kut teh with portions cooked till meat is tender and tendons are soft. I'm told that they start preparing 3am and open for breakfast early am.

Different folks different strokes - culinary curiosity for those used to herby Hokkien flavors, comfort food for those who usually stay away from peppery stuff except during rainy weather whilst to those who had a heavy weekend hangover, t'is the perfect remedy so I'm told. Take your pick.
author: David Fu

review_text: Prominent unit hard to miss located at main atrium of the mall. Adequate seating area.  Counter right in front of shop. Easy buy and find seating. Food quality consistent.
author: EveC

review_text: Staff not friendly, but order was accurate and food was up to good standard and fresh.
author: michael lin

review_text: Despite the recent renovation, this outlet was a huge disappointment. Orders were severely backlogged, over 10 pending, with delays of 20+ minutes. I ordered the new limited-edition Chilli Crab Burger and was shocked to find a piece of plastic in it. The chicken itself was tough, chewy, and inedible, and the sauce was sloppily applied to just one side of the bun. The burger felt hastily thrown together with no care. Overall, very poor quality and service. I do not recommend visiting this KFC outlet.
author: Ameya Marathe

review_text:
On 9th Nov 1015am Sun
I ordered my meal via Pick up. When I reach there I saw my meal already on the table but not packed.. so I waited . But this look grumpy staff an old uncle seem ignored my order n keep packing others order behind mine. when I try to ask nicely he ignored me x 2 times. Since my 3 items already done why dont just pack? and the pick up time was already over. once he packed my food. .. he still wanted to bring to another area for pick up ordered.. so I have to raise my voice to ask if that my number... if at the 1st place he acknowledged me !
As a front line staff ... manners are very important. For his speed I think he more suitable to work on simple task, cleaning table...  etc  but not front line which need to communicate w customers with smile. thank u!
author: miffy

review_text:
Chicken had served cold.
I know here is fast food but better change something
author: Potato Head

review_text:
Came for the complementary breakfast buffet and welcome drink at lunchtime.
Breakfast buffet: Good selections of beverages. Limited choices of Western style, Chinese, Indian, and Japanese food. Crispy Hash brown. Fresh fruits (I like papaya). Not bad for simple breakfast.
Welcome drinks: different from the beverages station of breakfast buffet. For takeaways or dine in.
Very busy at the breakfast buffet. So quiet during lunchtime in spite of lunch special promotion.
Service: efficient, prompt. Smiles. Friendly and polite staff. Refill food and clean up very fast. So far, the best service among IBIS hotel's restaurants (compare with Singapore, Japan, and Australia). --- 8/10
Venue: typical decor. Slightly packed. Clean and tidy. Ourdoors dining is available. TV new during breakfast.
author: Sze Mei NG

review_text: Decent lunch, ordered creamy seafood pasta, Hawaiian pizza, burger, Cajun chicken. All dishes were ok. Special mention to Ira and Nicholas who were friendly and attentive. Hope they will always enjoy their work :)
author: J C

review_text: Casual restaurant serving great food. Loved the service from the ladies.
author: Wei Peng Chionh

review_text: The lunch special was decent. The dish I had was Pork ribs & wedges.Went there after lunch hour and the food was to my liking. Overall, very good indeed.
author: DL

review_text: excellent service provided by the staff when I booked the whole restaurant for birthday party. food was also great
author: Sharleen Ng

review_text:
Had lunch with colleague and chanced upon this restaurant, did the sharing lunch set and immediately realised it was quite a bit of food!

Ordered the claypot tofu, sambal kangkong and sweet and sour pork, along with olive rice (steamed!)

The highlight was the sweet and sour pork and velvety claypot rice. I have had better olive rice somewhere else, was pricey at 5 bucks although had to admit that portion was huge.

Highly recommend for lunch! It was quieter at around 11.30, until about 12+ there were only about 4 groups of people for the whole restaurant on a weekday.
author: Natasha Tjahjadi

review_text:
Not a great experience at this outlet. We waited 10–15 minutes just to get someone’s attention to order, and then had to wait another 20–25 minutes for the food to arrive.

The food itself was also disappointing. The soup tasted very diluted and bland, and the sambal potato leaves were full of water and not tasty at all. This was definitely worse than what I’ve had at other branches.

Hope the management can look into improving both service and food quality.
author: Jun Wei

review_text:
I visited yesterday during lunch and had a wonderful experience. The food was delicious, well-prepared, and beautifully presented.

What truly stood out was the service. The staff were attentive and welcoming, which made the whole dining experience even more enjoyable. I’d especially like to commend the staff, Zoe, for being incredibly warm, professional, and attentive. She went the extra mile to ensure everything was perfect for us.

Overall, it was an amazing experience and I’ll definitely be back again. Highly recommended!
author: Jordan

review_text:
I had a really pleasant dining experience at Soup Restaurant - United Square. The atmosphere was warm and cosy, perfect for a relaxed meal. The food was absolutely yummilicious, especially the Samsui chicken, homemade tofu, tofu prawn, and sweet potato leaves — everything was flavourful and satisfying. That day, we also bought the ginger sauce which had a buy-one-get-one-free deal, making it even better.

Special thanks to the manager, Zoe, who had such a welcoming smile and a great attitude. She made my friends and me feel truly comfortable and ensured we had such a wonderful experience. We’ll definitely be back again! 👍👍
author: jing wen

review_text:
I love Soup Restaurant; I have not visited this branch in years. We stepped in around 7.00pm on Saturday 14 Feb, and there were many tables available. It was just the two of us. However, the staff ignored us. First, we waited at the entrance but no one served us. Then we moved into the restaurant to try and get the attention of the staff.

One lady seemed to address us, and we followed her, but it turned out that she was going to speak with one of the managers in a black jacket, and she was not serving us. She ignored us as she doubled back past us. The manager she spoke to saw us as well, but walked past us. Moments later, another manager in a black jacket did the same.

We were lost -- invisible customers at dinnertime, trying to get some attention and get a seat. Instead, we left and discovered how pleasant Yayoi is. Attentive service and politeness, the same standards we receive at Soup Restaurant branches elsewhere.

Thank you, Soup Restaurant United Square! Without you, we would never have discovered Yayoi. And the next time we wish to have Soup Restaurant, we will go to another branch instead.
author: Huaqi Ma

restaurant_name: Wee Nam Kee Hainanese Chicken Rice Restaurant
review_text:
Went for Sunday lunch at 11:30am — no queue then, but by the time we left around 12:30pm, a line had formed outside (tip: go early!). Oddly, there were still empty tables inside while people queued outside.
Food was served pretty fast, but the service felt rushed and noisy. The waitstaff weren’t exactly throwing dishes, but the way food was placed on the table could definitely have been more gentle. The table we were seated at had been wiped, but the tablecloth left behind a very strong smell — we ended up cleaning it ourselves with wet wipes and sanitizer before it felt okay to eat. Atmosphere and service could really be improved.
That said, the food itself was good. We had ½ white and ½ roasted chicken, dumpling soup, and kangkong. The rice was fragrant and tasty, and the dumplings were nice with a good mix of mushroom, prawn, and pork. It would have been better if the soup had more vegetables instead of just two lonely leaves. While the flavors delivered, the overall price felt a little high considering the service and dining experience.

They also have big tables that can seat 10-12pax, which makes it a good spot for family gatherings or to bring overseas guest to try yummy chicken rice

Will we come back again? Yes.
author: Yahui Lin

restaurant_name: Wee Nam Kee Hainanese Chicken Rice Restaurant
review_text:
Pretty good chicken rice. We ordered the set that came with either dumpling soup or stirred fried vegetable (see pictures) and a small cold drink of your choice.

Will be back if in the area which is United Square Mall on the ground floor facing Thompson Road.

2025 December
author: John Tango

restaurant_name: Wee Nam Kee Hainanese Chicken Rice Restaurant
review_text: Food is quite decent but just a bit overpriced, guess we have no choice but to pay more for aircon, gst and service charge... Anyway, there are just too many good chicken rice stalls in SG for it to be rated anything above 3 stars.
author: Jason Soh

restaurant_name: Wee Nam Kee Hainanese Chicken Rice Restaurant
review_text:
Came here for a simple family dinner after hearing about the chicken rice and it did not disappoint. The chicken rice here is fluffy, fragrant and flavourful- good enough to eat on its own.

Both the steamed and roasted chicken were juicy and tender. Curry fish head was creamy, tasty and not too spicy. Sizzling tofu was okay- can do with and without. Eggplant was nice.

Portion of food here is big and price is reasonable. Food gets served rather quickly.
author: Sarah Lee

restaurant_name: Wee Nam Kee Hainanese Chicken Rice Restaurant
review_text:
First time trying this place because I saw the long queue and a full house inside. Unfortunately, it turned out to be one of the worst dining decisions I’ve made.

Honestly, I wouldn’t even pay $6 for this meal.
•	Dumplings were extremely bland.. frozen dumplings from NTUC would taste better.
•	Chilli and ginger paste were both tasteless.
•	The chicken had a strange sandy texture and taste.
•	Char siew and siew yoke were very average at best.
•	The rice was the biggest disappointment, completely lacking aroma and flavour.

Overall, very underwhelming. Even plain white rice with fried eggs (with soy sauce) at home would have been more satisfying.
author: rachel

review_text: Came here in a big group of 7 for weekday lunch! We had 2 chicken hotpots, 1 fish and 1 pork organ soup. I like the pork organ soup a lot, but the fish soup I find it’s very bitter. The chicken was tasty and meat not dry. Portions are big so very good for sharing! Best to make reservations for large parties
author: Liau Yuan Wei

review_text: We ordered only 2 dishes- the original chicken pot and fish. Both were excellent. We liked both dishes so much that we ordered more rice for each of us. The chicken sauce was tasty and thick. Flavour was intense so for those who prefer something lighter, you can request for the staff to add the soup broth. When we added the broth later on, the taste was not as good. The stall was relatively generous with the fish slices. Slices were quite a few considered we had ordered a small portion. Fish was firm and thick. As with chicken pots, the cost increases with the additional ingredients in the fridge so just to keep in mind before you over order. The stall is just outside Fairprice supermarket. We were seated at the side next to the aisle, opposite other food stalls. There will be quite a lot of human traffic walking past.
author: Christine Ho

review_text: Very nice Chicken & pig stomach soup. Soup can be refilled! 😁😁 Using Eatigo for 40% discount on soup. Next to NTUC Fair price.
author: Tony Liow

review_text:
Wait staff suggested we order set meal for 2 which include 2 regular pots + 2 rice + 2 drinks. We chose chicken n beef. Hotpot is spicy 🥵🔥👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼 Restaurant shd serve iced water foc. We took 2 extra plates fr fridge.

Note d curb. I almost fell when walking to cashier then wait staff reminded me there's a curb. Wait staff like to hurdle n chit chat (or gossip) but they forgot they r in full view of staff. We had to put on our earpods to eat in peace.

Actually I don't know why I m paying service charge when I refilled soup into d pot myself, took d dishes fr fridge myself n walked to cashier myself. I even had to tolerate their gossip coz I was seated at d entrance, also d seat closest to d cashier.
author: Sandra

review_text: Nice hot pot, friendly staff and food was excellent. Maybe the side dishes was priced abit high. Overall recommended.
author: Chiun How Teng

review_text:
Had lunch. Had the chicken briyani with masala chicken and coin prata.

Not sure what is lost in translation … they had coin prata with mutton signage right at counter, we pointed and requested for it .

What was delivered to table is just 6 coin prata but no mutton.

Did not help the service and attitude of staff is not great.

Coin prata is crispy and nice but pity … will probably not be returning .
author: Whiskey Tea

review_text: Must visit place for South Indian food lovers. Great nutrional tasty food. The taste is extremely honestly and made with very less oil and mild spice. Very affordable as well. Portion sizes are perfect with a huge variety of vegetables. Chapatis were extremely soft. Will visit again!
author: Shilpa M V

review_text: Very good prata, though it's pricy at 2+ for plain and upwards 3-4 for rest. Chicken boneless masala is good as well, recommended. It's tender and flavourful too! Got the 11++ set: 2 prata/rice and a main dish.
author: theresa lim

review_text:
Got the chicken murtabak and tissue prata.

The chicken in the murtabak was so flavourful I honestly could've enjoyed it by itself but paired with the curry it was like a flavour explosion in my mouth. Love the doughiness of it and honestly would come back just to eat it again.

The tissue prata was nice and crispy and I had it with the chocolate sauce. It was good as a snack but maybe not for those looking for a full meal.

The service at the novena branch was good and the teh tarik tasted very authentic.
author: Maisarah Hamdan

review_text: This is a good Indian food place to try. I have been one in star vista, food is great. I like the service quality & cleanly environment.
author: Sateesh Mulpuri

review_text: A beer bar offering a very wide range of beers on tap, spanning the globe. While range is excellent, price is a bit on the high side. Server was extremely friendly and gave free tasting portions before customer decides on the final selection to enjoy. Takeaway receives 10% discount.
author: Kevin Ang

review_text: I find the fish and chips quality unfortunately, did not meet my expectations for the price I paid. The fish portion was small and tasted mostly like just cooking oil. The fries were soggy and lacked flavor, while the pasta was decent but not outstanding. To add to the disappointment, the craft beer prices were also high. In total, we spent $80 on the meal, and to make matters worse, we were the only customers on a Saturday night, which was surprising. Overall, the experience was underwhelming considering the cost and lack of ambiance.
author: Benny T.

review_text: Craft beers galore!! Great variety of choices to suit your taste buds! The prices are a bit on the higher side (I would give them another star if prices are 20% lower). Did not get the chance to try their pizza though.. the garlic fries is heavenly!! And they go well with craft beer!
author: Tan Long Hwee

review_text:
Went on a weekend dinner, not many people. The mushroom pizza was not too bad, it would be enough for two pax.

The pork ribs were good. Like the salad side as well which helps to balance the jelatness.

They have a range of alcohol to choose from on the chalkboard (not on their menu).
author: Bandit

review_text: This place is very cosy, and offers a pretty wide selection of beers on tap. Food wise, they will not disappoint you with their finger and bar food. It's delicious. Just that it may be a tad too salty for some individuals. This place also has screens that shows soccer matches, and friendly staffs that'll assist you on the type of beers that you may be more accustomed to. Easy to have a conversation with your friends as the music here isn't too loud.
author: lance kwok en Cheng

review_text:
Check out my other reviews at @pandareviewsfood

7 Tavern: 8.1/10

I finished work at 9 pm. As one expects, there really isn't much good food open at such a late timing. I opened Google Maps as a Hail Mary and found this place just right beside me.

I love you, Google Maps, for finding me this gem.

Moonlight Kuey Teow ($12): 8.3/10
I didn't expect much from pub food, but I was shocked at how good this was.
It was simple, done well.
The lard is fantastic, perfectly crispy and rich in flavour. This, along with the strong wok hey made this such a luxurious meal to eat.
The chilli isn't anything novel either, just heat with a bit of acidity. However, this was just what was needed to make the wok hey pop even more. With a pint of Guinness, this is the perfect late-night meal to have.

I understand that some people might not enjoy this place due to the rowdy atmosphere. Nevertheless, if you are just looking for a decently priced meal in Novena, this is perfect for you.
author: Jay Hoo

review_text:
A Hidden Gem for Local Bites and Cold Beers

Tucked away from the tourist bustle, this small bar-restaurant delivers a truly local experience. The atmosphere is laid-back, with just enough buzz to feel alive without being overwhelming. Their menu champions local flavors—each dish feels like a home-cooked classic, elevated with care. Standouts include the signature HKM, bursting with spice and soul.

Service is prompt, friendly, and genuine—staff treat you like a regular even on your first visit. The beer? Ice-cold and affordable, the perfect pairing for a hot evening and spicy plate.

Come for the food, stay for the vibe. A perfect spot to unwind and soak in the local flavor.

review_text: Loved the char kway teow.. food was overall great. Service is prompt and friendly.. good band on Thurs and Fridays...but if you also want to relax with good vocals, I'd recommend the weekdays too...

author: Gavin Ang

review_text:

author: Kieran Kumaraguru

review_text:
One of the best tasting Thai food I had in Singapore for quite a while. They reminded me of the quality of food the now defunct Lemongrass chain of Thai restaurants had when they first started. I love their crispy and plump prawn cakes served with plum sauce. The yellow curry prawns were fresh and large, with a really authentic yellow curry gravy that I relish. The hor mok(seafood otah) was one of the best I had. The khanom tako and the green Thai milk tea were both delicious.

The taste of their food is authentic with a great depth of flavour. Prices are higher than casual Thai eateries like Sanook Kitchen and Nakhon Thai but you can taste the difference in the quality of their ingredients. I have visited a few times over the years but have only reviewed this place recently.
author: Julius Tan

review_text:

author: Darrell Tan

review_text:
SO PHO……. So Good and here’s my review for the Novena Square @ Velocity

Restaurant : Very nice decorations / renovation works. It’s brightly lit 🌟 using lanterns 🏮 and has a wall of Vietnamese 🇻🇳collectables as decorations 🫖🗳️🏺and penciled on the floor are retro tiles. 🎋💮 Clean restaurant with a mixture of wooden 🪵 bench and metal chairs 💺 for seats.

Staff : Very Polite, friendly and approachable 💁‍♂️💁🏼‍♀️. Only crux is they are also using the self-scan QR code to place an order 🧾. I have previously mentioned that I don’t think this provides the best service considering they charge 10% service charge. Nevertheless, this is all made possible today with technology 📲. However, I’m just saying with the order taking, you will most likely be able to upsell me all the way to the desserts 🤷‍♂️.

Food : Wow 🤩….. What got me was the size of the portion that was served. 🤯 It’s huge! So for those who want to get your money’s 💰 worth, this is it! Lol 🤣 Quality? I’m unfortunately going to say it is not the meal that will make you cry-sort-of-reaction. But is it good? Yes, it is well cooked, ingredients 🐮🐓🥬🦐 are fresh, portions are huge 🍱. I think what it lacks is the Wok Hei…. the umami from the gravy 🥘. I think this feeling of wanting it can only be found in Vietnam 🇻🇳or places that use Charcoal 🔥🔥🔥 for cooking. You are not getting that here but it’s still pretty satisfying. So…. It’s great but it’s not gonna make you cry 😭 sort of feeling.

The Fried Vermicelli 🍜, Beef Pho, Chicken Chop Pho and Mix Appetizers are all very nice, no complaints whatsoever. I will advise those getting the Vietnam 🇻🇳 Coffee ☕️ to have it served later⌛️. By the time it finished dripping and when I was done with my meal, it was already cold. So lesson learned.

Overall, a good meal. What it lacks in Wok Hey, it made up on it from service the portion and price. 👍👍👍

restaurant_name: Coffee Hive (Square 2) | Wide Range of Local Delights | Traditional Local Coffee | No Pork No Lard
review_text:
This is a Nanyang-style breakfast shop, similar in style to Toast Box and Ya Kun Kaya Toast, but more customer-friendly than the Killiney Kopitiam listed on the "must-try" list.

They offer affordable set meal options, and the staff thoughtfully charge customers based on the set meal price instead of sneakily charging à la carte prices for first-time visitors like some opportunistic merchants do.

Tourists can try the kaya butter toast, a signature local flavor—though be aware that this combination is quite sweet. The soft-boiled eggs can be seasoned with soy sauce or white pepper, depending on personal preference.

However, there are no condiment bottles on the tables outside, so customers must serve themselves entirely. Orders are placed at the front counter, and food is picked up at the self-service collection area in the back, where there is also a relatively spacious dining area. Since all food collection is self-service, first-time visitors may need some time to get used to the process.

The young female staff here are generally polite and helpful, especially to first-time visitors—much better than the rude, ill-mannered, and uncultured elderly staff at the Tai Cheong Bakery next door. The overall pricing is affordable, making it a good choice for solo dining. First-time visitors can start with the classic toast + soft-boiled eggs + hot/cold drink combo to get a taste of Nanyang-style breakfast.

author: Jeremy Lim

restaurant_name: Ji De Chi Dessert @ Square 2 Novena
review_text:
Ji De Chi Dessert isn't just a dessert shop; it's a nostalgic portal to sweet, comforting bliss. From the moment you step in, the aroma of simmering ginger and coconut milk wraps you in a warm embrace. Forget fleeting dessert trends, this place is a testament to timeless Hong Kong classics, executed with unwavering precision.
Their signature black sesame paste? A velvety, nutty revelation, rich and intensely satisfying. The ginger sweet soup, with its perfectly chewy tang yuan, delivers a soothing heat that lingers beautifully. And the mango sago? Forget those watery imitations; Ji De Chi's version is a symphony of ripe, succulent mango chunks and creamy sago, a tropical dream in a bowl.
What elevates this place beyond the ordinary is the palpable dedication to quality. Every ingredient tastes meticulously sourced, every bowl crafted with care. The service is genuinely warm, adding to the homely atmosphere. It's a rare gem that manages to be both authentic and consistently exceptional. If you crave desserts that nourish the soul as much as the palate, Ji De Chi is an absolute must-visit. You’ll leave with a sweet smile and a longing to return.
author: Maximilian Jackson

restaurant_name: Tonkotsu Kazan VOLCANO Ramen @ Novena Square 2 豚骨火山ラーメン @ ノベナスクエア2店
review_text:
Ordered a Shio Ramen and Ponzu Vinegar Karaage at Tonkotsu Kazan Ramen in Novena Square 2 🍜🔥

The meal even came with free hard-boiled eggs, which made it extra satisfying.

The Shio Ramen had a light-looking but deeply flavourful broth — clean, savoury, and nicely porky. Every slurp felt comforting and well-balanced.

The Ponzu Vinegar Karaage was a hit with my SO. The crispy chicken paired beautifully with the tangy ponzu sauce, cutting through the richness and making it very addictive.

They also provide raw peeled garlic soaked in vinegar on the side — bold and punchy. I personally loved adding them in for that extra kick.

Definitely coming back again for more goodness 🔥

author: Prof Chloe

restaurant_name: Tonkotsu Kazan VOLCANO Ramen @ Novena Square 2 豚骨火山ラーメン @ ノベナスクエア2店
review_text:
Tried Tonkotsu Kazan Ramen at Novena, a well-known Japanese ramen spot famous for its “volcano-style” serving. The shop itself is quite small, with limited seating, and I was seated at the bar table. It does feel a bit cramped, especially during peak hours, but still keeps the classic ramen shop atmosphere.
I ordered the Shoyu Ramen. The broth was thick, rich, and tasty, with a deep umami flavour that was satisfying without being overly salty. The volcano-style pot helps keep the ramen hot until the very last sip, which is a nice experience overall.
I also took the set with gyoza and green tea, priced at around $20. The gyoza was decent but fairly standard, while the green tea was nothing special. The set was okay in terms of value.
Overall, it’s a great ramen place if you’re craving a rich and flavourful bowl, especially if you enjoy thicker broths.
Rating: 4/5 🍜
author: Ewe Keat Huan

restaurant_name: Tonkotsu Kazan VOLCANO Ramen @ Novena Square 2 豚骨火山ラーメン @ ノベナスクエア2店
review_text:
If I can rate zero star, I’ll strongly put ZERO.
This was my first visit, and unfortunately it left a very negative impression.

The restaurant was not busy, and staff members were sitting and resting in the dining area.

I ordered salt ramen with rice.

When the ramen was served, an hourglass was placed on the table and I was instructed not to touch the lid until a staff member returned. However, even after the sand had completely run out and additional time passed, no staff member came.

More importantly, the rice that was part of my order was never served.

At the counter, when I politely explained this while paying, a staff member named Melissa responded by raising her voice in front of other customers. She stated that some customers do not need rice and that I should have informed the staff if I wanted it.

This explanation makes no sense.
The order clearly included both ramen and rice, and it should not be the customer’s responsibility to remind staff to serve items that were already ordered.

When I requested an adjustment for the rice that was never provided, the request was flatly refused, again in a raised and confrontational manner.

Charging customers for items that are not served raises serious concerns about service standards and basic business practices.

Because of this experience — particularly the unprofessional attitude of the staff member involved — I will not be returning. I hope management takes this feedback seriously, as this situation could easily happen to other customers as well.

review_text: Quite a small outlet at the basement of United Square with limited seating, so arrow hard to get seats except during off peak hours. Kopi was OK, as was service and ambience.
author: Sihan Goi

review_text:
This morning was completely spoiled by the aunty who kept scolding and yelling. The customer behind us mistakenly collected our food, leaving his own order unclaimed at the counter. When we checked with the staff, they told us to wait until our number was called. Then the rude aunty came out and shouted, “Don’t just look at your phone! Watch the queue number and collect your food!” — which was really frustrating to hear all the yelling in the early morning. She also yelled at customer returning tray at the food counter. A lot of unnecessary yelling throughout the dining experience.

We approached the staff again, and thankfully another cashier lady kindly attended to us. She confirmed that the other customer had indeed taken our food by mistake. Yet that customer also another next level one - he acted as if nothing had happened throughout the whole conversation when he just sat next to us. Honestly, we weren’t asking for compensation from him, but at the very least, some courtesy would have been appreciated.
author: Juney B

restaurant_name: The Marmalade Pantry - Cafe Bistro @ Novena
review_text:
I had an awesome dining experience at The Marmalade Pantry in Novena. The moment I stepped in, the atmosphere felt classy and refined — it really gives the vibe of a hotel-style breakfast restaurant, with a calm, elegant setting that’s perfect for a relaxed meal.

I ordered the burger meal, and it was excellent. The patty was juicy, the flavours were well-balanced, and the portion size was satisfying.
Burger: ⭐ 4.5/5

I also had a mocha, which came with beautiful latte art. The drink was smooth, rich, and not overly sweet — exactly how a good mocha should be.
Mocha: ⭐ 4.3/5

Before leaving, I grabbed a carrot cake for takeaway. It turned out to be a great choice — moist, flavourful, and topped with creamy frosting that wasn’t too heavy.
Carrot Cake: ⭐ 4.4/5

Overall, The Marmalade Pantry delivered a top-notch experience with great food, elegant ambience, and attention to detail. It's a spot I’d definitely return to for both dine-in and takeaway treats.
author: Ewe Keat Huan

restaurant_name: The Marmalade Pantry - Cafe Bistro @ Novena
review_text:
Exceptional Dining Experience at The Marmalade Pantry (Novena)
From the moment we walked in, the service at The Marmalade Pantry was nothing short of outstanding. The staff were warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming – a rare find these days. They anticipated our needs without being intrusive and made the entire experience feel personalized and seamless.
The food? Absolutely divine. Every dish was beautifully presented and bursting with flavor. Whether you're here for brunch, lunch, or dinner, the menu offers something for everyone – and everything we tried exceeded expectations. The portions were generous, and the ingredients tasted fresh and high quality.
The ambience is cozy yet chic, making it perfect for a catch-up with friends or a quiet date. Overall, an amazing spot in the heart of Novena. Highly recommend and will definitely be coming back!

Staff were very accommodating especially Nigel and Vivian. What a great food experience
author: Lao Daet

restaurant_name: The Marmalade Pantry - Cafe Bistro @ Novena
review_text:
I booked for lunch at 12.30pm (Thursday) for my birthday celebration. Unfortunately they were shorthanded, and we had to wait close to 10min before being seated.

Food was not as fantastic as heard off... we took the set meal which comes with a fixed appetiser and drink (juice of the day, black coffee or tea). Juice was orange juice and seem diluted and bitter.. The soup for appetiser was ok... Pork chop was a bit hard, chicken chop was not as tender as hoped for, salmon was fine but the Wassabi based sauce gave it a raw taste... Abit sad...

We ordered 2 cakes which looked wonderful in the showcase. But for both, the sponge layer was dry. The chocolate cake was saved by the ganache which moisten the sponge. The other cherry cake was jusy dry. It was really sad to have such quality as my birthday cake :( and they don't come cheap...

The best was the truffle fries actually... That was the highlight and life saver that didn't get the ratings more down...

Also if you have the triple plus membership, theres 25% off for bday mth. Sadly it didn't apply to set meals which i didn't see it in the t&c.. so oh wells..

Overall, i think there are heartland cafes that offer better quality food and at lower prices...
author: Debbie Soo

restaurant_name: The Marmalade Pantry - Cafe Bistro @ Novena
review_text: Service is good and the atmosphere is nice and peaceful. However, the quality of the cakes could be better. The carrot cake didn't have enough ingredients like nuts and raisins and was generally too smooth, while the Cherry cake just tasted average. Cake slice sizes were generous though.
author: Kitty Cat

restaurant_name: The Marmalade Pantry - Cafe Bistro @ Novena
review_text: Set lunch eg spring chicken is good. Pork chop is a bit too hard and dry for my liking. Truffle fries are really nice. Overall very attentive service crew!
author: Daph Ch

review_text: Very good selections of craft beer. It is always great to have a good IPA in a frozen pint glass.
author: Kaz Hamaj

review_text: Chilled IPA good to pair with all hawker dishes. Can request for chill mug every 30min.
author: H Ngim

review_text:
Didn't know there is such a shop in Newton circus! The owner (just guessing he is the owner) really puts a lot of effort to pull the beer, to balance the beer and foam. First time I tabao draught beer, covid phase 2 :s I ordered the IPA, happy with it. Went back a 3rd time but the shop was not opened :( will definitely buy again if the shop is open!
During my second visit, I asked if they sell sampler, unfortunately no
author: wei K

review_text:

They serve glasses very cold, which Japanese prefers.

review_text:
[2023-04-01, $13/pint]

had the wheat beer and was honestly not a fan. not as malty as I'd like and was more sour than most, had a banana note as advertised which was interesting.
author: Dave

review_text:
I love traditional kuehs

Second time that I find it surprisingly salty.. for $3.90 for 3 it's ok but the taste is off..

Hopefully more QC be done to bring back the old taste
author: Ryan Seah

review_text: 24 hours open shop on Balestier rd. They has some kind of rice dumplings. Also make it warm by micro wave they can do. My signature is pepper chicken rice dumpling. I have never seen such very Very good spicy rice dumpling, I’m loving it.
author: S K

review_text:
Bought 2 rice dumplings at an evening, served by a Chinese man. He was picking his teeth in front a pile of dried shrimps, back facing the counter. Stood there for a moment then he came to take order.

Re-heated the red bean dumpling home and found a dark figure in the translucent rice, little then I found out it’s a corpse of an insect encased in the rice!

Can’t imagine if someone just popped it in their mouth if it is not so obvious in a savoury dumpling.
author: HL Tan

review_text: We have been patronizing their dumplings for many years and they are still very tasty and have introduced many varieties with generous fillings. Rice and ingredients taste just right and will continue to buy from them. Boss and wife are very pleasant and nice people too.
author: Elaine Tan

review_text:
One of the best dumpling around.
I have been their customer for almost twenty years.
They are very generous with the ingredients in their dumplings.
The texture of the rice is always well cooked.
Very good value for money.
author: Eric Foo

restaurant_name: Whampoa Keng Fish Head Steamboat @ Balestier
review_text: Have a dinner in this restaurant with friends and family. Didn't expect so kuch people waiting when we arrived at 8pm. Although we have a booking at 8pm, table is not ready yet. Have a short wait only. The food taste great. Especially the salted fish pork belly. The fish head pot taste great too. By far was a very satisfying dinner.
author: Jason Cheong

restaurant_name: Whampoa Keng Fish Head Steamboat @ Balestier
review_text:
Visited Whampoa Kheng for their famous fish steamboat (鱼头炉) and overall it was a solid dining experience.

The Fish Steamboat (charcoal) is definitely the highlight—the broth is incredibly tasty, flavorful, and has that deep, traditional soul to it. The fish was very fresh, and I love that they provide a soup refill service so you can enjoy the broth all the way to the end.

We also ordered a variety of side dishes:
• Har Cheong Gai (虾酱鸡) - Crispy and fragrant.
• Prawn Rolls (虾枣), Hot Plate Tofu (铁板豆腐), and Foo Young Egg (芙蓉蛋).
• Mango Fried Prawns (芒果炸虾) and Fermented Pork (南乳炸肉).
• Sambal Kang Kong (Sambal 空心菜).

Everything was delicious and met expectations — definitely no "踩雷" (disappointments) with the food!

Service is where it gets a bit tricky. We noticed the lady boss (or perhaps a senior staff member) had an attitude that wasn't very impressive while taking our orders. It’s a bit ironic—you see it in many old-school restaurants where the bosses can be quite unfriendly even though you're there to support their business!

On the bright side, the junior male staff were excellent. They were very attentive, polite, and provided great service throughout the night. It's really the younger team members who are keeping the hospitality standards up.

Go for the food and the amazing soup. Just be prepared for some "old-school" boss attitude, but the junior staff will take good care of you!
author: OB1

restaurant_name: Whampoa Keng Fish Head Steamboat @ Balestier
review_text:
Whampoa Keng Fish Head Steamboat was packed when we arrived but we found seats fast and the food was so comforting. The truffle roll was crisp and addictive. The red grouper steamboat had fresh fish, yam and greens in a rich broth with a gentle touch of Chinese wine and we loved dipping the fish in chili. The prawn paste wings were hot and juicy and the prawn rolls were crunchy with tasty filling. The mee sua soaked up the broth beautifully and the lemon tea was refreshing. A hearty meal that warmed us right up.

📸 Follow @ayaalan.foodie for more foodie reviews!
author: Ayaalan.foodie

restaurant_name: Whampoa Keng Fish Head Steamboat @ Balestier
review_text:
Whampoa Keng fish steamboat is a true Singapore comfort food. Their signature dish is a live charcoal cooked broth flavoured with three ingredients:fried flat fish, pork rib, sour plum; and in the broth: yam, cabbage, and fresh fish slices of your choice: pomfret, mackerel, or red trout.  This is a must try dish… 10/10

We also complemented our meal with salted egg fried chicken and stird fried snow pea leaves with garlic… delicious. Comfort food- this is it.
author: M4l2K T4N

restaurant_name: Whampoa Keng Fish Head Steamboat @ Balestier
review_text:
As we celebrated Diwali with relatives visiting from Taiwan, we had to let them try our local favourite — the fish head dish. Being regular customers, the owner was kind enough to reserve a nice table for us on a busy Saturday night.

That said, the service was excellent, and the young boss lady was absolutely stylo-milo (😁) — but of course, we were really there for the food. The dishes were fantastic, and we were all very happy with both the quality and the reasonable prices. All the service staff were friendly and efficient, attending to our needs promptly.

We’ll definitely return soon and bring more family members and friends to enjoy everything this restaurant has to offer.
author: p hungmoe2

review_text:
10, 23 & 29 December 2025 - yes I lunched here 3 times in same month with 3 different lunch partner 🤪 Love the peaceful and tranquil surrounding this restaurant is in. It’s truly unbelievable this place of calm exists in the heart of Novena/TTSH area.

Three times we had the same items to share:
- dory & chips $11.83
- salmon poke bowl $15.50

❤️ No reservations made but we got tables immediately
❤️ NO service charge, only GST 9%, so just  order and pay at counter
❤️ Food is served within minutes - piping hot & freshly prepared
❤️ Servings are generous, yummy, and filling. Fish batter is crisp, fries seasoned but not salty and the greens are fresh
❤️ FOC plain water from a bottle at the table and we had to collect glasses from a counter
❤️ tall glass windows, brown wooden tables add to a cosy vibe
❤️ Atmosphere can get a bit noisy when filled with diners. But not rowdy or intrusively annoying
❤️ Service crew are young and polite

👎 the bald headed manager is known for being brusque and I finally came face to face with him when I personally ordered & paid during my third visit! He went through his tasks efficiently but it was his tone, attitude and mannerisms that turned me off.

I had enjoyed lunching here repeatedly but my last visit had a tone of negativity, so I will likely stay away from this place for a while.
author: Karen Teng

review_text:
Updated.

We came here to have a family dinner and the restaurant was quite empty tonight.

we enjoy coming here because it is spacious and family friendly. the food is delicious. my favourites are the crostini and the pizzas. the tiramisu is absolutely divine. my son loves it too, it is in a convenient location with ample parking, and they even have toys and boardgames !
