review_text:
I bought dim sum 芋角from Jurong West st.51 yesterday. The food tasted weird, like burnt or cooking oil's dirty. I informed the stall assistant, an auntie about 50-60 years old. She said to me unhappily her manager always come to stall and check on the food, "Where got problem".
I'm very disappointed with her service. I used to visit this stall often..,

This stall assistant has an attitude problem.
author: Jasper Jane

review_text:
PRC cashier was very rude when i was ordering and she replied in an annoyed manner, "what you want".

had a verbal quarrel with her in front of the stall....
author: Ghost

review_text: Everytime no sambal chilli....how to eat with chilli sauce? Kimly your sambal chilli is a PLUS point pls note that. Aunty was very rude...don't know how talk to people nicely.  🙄
author: Angela Jeremiah

restaurant_name: Hong Man Tian Traditional Charcoal Roast
review_text: Neighbourhood roasted meat stall, reasonable price and portion. Coffeeshop setting, relative clean and tidy. Some tables are for smokers, steer clear unless like free smoke or if you are smoking.
author: Marcus Goh

restaurant_name: Hong Man Tian Traditional Charcoal Roast
review_text:
Char Siew + Roast pork noodles and Roast pork + Roast duck noodles $10.50

Roast chicken + add meat rice $4.50

Price is decent. Noodles doneness not too soggy. Soup was not served hot and salty. (Or MSG)

Requested to debone for roast duck, but there’s still bone in it.

Roast pork and roast duck not a bad choice. But thinly slice.

Personally, I’m not a fan of char siew.

Chilli are not spicy at all
author: BABY GERM

restaurant_name: Hong Man Tian Traditional Charcoal Roast
review_text: In the afternoon, I went to this stall and ordered a plate of barbecued pork rice. When it was served, the assistant also brought a bowl of soup.  Seeing that the assistant's fingers were put into the soup, i'm quickly wanted to take the soup.  Unexpectedly, the stall assistant yelled at me not to interfere while he put the soup on the serving plate.  I explained to him that it was because I saw his finger put into the soup.  But he argued that it was because I touched the bowl of soup.  I felt that this soup was already unhygienic, so I refused the bowl of soup that felt unhygienic.  I hope the person in charge of the stall owner can pay attention to the hygiene and attitude of the employees in handling food.
author: Eng Hooi

restaurant_name: Hong Man Tian Traditional Charcoal Roast
review_text: Ok Price for $5. Roast meat was average. Sause was too sweet for me. Chilli tasted strange. Eat to make you full not for enjoying. 505 market was closed thus tried here
author: Thaddeus Zheng

restaurant_name: Hong Man Tian Traditional Charcoal Roast
review_text: The 红满天 hong man tian roasted meat stall service guy super rude to a singaporean uncle by throwing his food into the dustbin when he feedback his order is no sauce. Food also anyhow cut. Too bad they preparing my food already if not i just walk away.
author: Pan Wen Jing

review_text:
Review @jfoodiediary

Super nice spot in west! red Tom yum soup was sooo good, slightly sour yet spicy and rich in flavour.

Basil pork chicken is rly yummmyyy, good portion of meat & v crunchy beans. Enjoyable meal.

2 pax; order basil pork w egg n rice, red tomyum seafood soup, pad Thai pork. Total $33
author: Lim JMS

review_text:
Some hits and misses:
- Pandan leaf chicken is really bad. Can't taste the marination and has meaty taste that suggest it wasn't fresh? Meat is tough too...how can this signature thai cuisine goes wrong
- Thai Kang Kong is nice and crunchy. Love the garlic
- Pad Thai is nice
- Red curry is pretty comforting
- Papaya salad a bit salty
- Fish cake is v nice
Can give it a try and the food is pretty okay. Maybe the chef is on day off today :/
author: Stevez Chua

review_text:
Ordering system is via QR code which was convenient.

Seafood tomyum was well balanced with tangy and sweetness. It came with a few tentacles, squid slices and 3 prawns. Hit the right spot. 5*

Pork basil rice was looked deceptive. The meat was marinated well and the sauce was addictive. Sunny side egg added to the overall texture. 5*

Honeyed chicken was advertised. Sweet though on a slightly cloying side. 3.5*

Garlic pork tasted like honeyed version with a sprinkle of garlic crisps. It was also too lean and tought for my liking. 3*

Unfortunately the last 2 dishes had an "old / overused oil" taste which marred its experience.

Kitchen is fast and less than 10 mins wait and service was friendly.
author: MNG

review_text: This is my first time eating at this restaurant and the food was honestly amazing. The Tom yum had really good flavor, so did the basil chicken. The pad Thai was a bit sweet but overall quite good. However, I would highly recommend that the staff make the portions of the candied tapioca dessert a bit smaller. But the tapioca was also quite sweet and yummy. Definitely coming here again.
author: Misha S.

review_text:
5 stars for Green curry chicken! Love that the chicken didn't taste like it was frozen chicken (most of the other green curry chicken we've had in recent years did taste like frozen chicken)

Claypot prawn vermicelli $21.90 was so so even though it was on the signature dishes list. Prawn seemed not so fresh.
author: Fenella Teng

review_text: Like this place. Secluded with lots of parking space. A little small for a neighbourhood coffee shop. Food is good but miss the great grade for my liking.
author: rahim non

review_text:
Nasi Goreng Butter Chicken.
4 pieces chicken which is not karaage chicken but its chicken breast with bone, its not fried and its salty. This is my first time eating butter chicken without frying the chicken. Can’t even make a proper butter chicken. And its not worth the price. Its $9.50!!!! Will not come back or recommend anyone
author: Myra’s Story (MissVee)

review_text: I've tried the asam pedas before and its good, tried the prata tsunami for breakfast and it makes me full till lunch
author: mohamad azman saleh

review_text: They’ve improved a lot over the year - food option wise & interior. Now they are more focused towards Malay style zhi char from 12pm. I always get their Nasi Pattaya(no chilli sauce) or their Ikan Bakar set. Worth my money, worth my time.
author: ikneadyou Sports Massage

review_text:
Run into this prata shop during a random weekend morning orienteering. Came right after the shop was opened, thus very little crowd other than a few locals. Thus lots of seating throughout, most of which are at the airy side of the shop.

The sarang burung (bird's nest) roti paratha turns out to be the specialty item here, so that what I ordered. It came with a dollop of sweet sambal, mutton curry (too bad it's just all the fat), and fish curry. Top them up with a cup of teh tarik. The paratha was freshly made, flaky yet fluffy, but I wish they gave the option to not to have the eggs entirely raw, perhaps by 'nestling' them on the paratha earlier when it was on the flat pan would do. The teh tarik was pretty nice and rather well-balanced (albeit a bit too sweet for me, but it's more on personal preference).
author: lontongstroong

review_text:
Disappointing Experience with Takeaway Order

I recently ordered a half chicken with rice from this place, and while the order was ready surprisingly quickly (within a minute of placing it), I was really disappointed when I got home. The rice was slimy and clearly spoiled, which made the meal unappetizing. It was a letdown, especially considering how fast the order was prepared. I really hope they can pay more attention to food quality in the future.
author: Chris Tangalin

review_text: Rabz ehh. This time round buy lucky set wth why the fries so pathetic siaa. Damn less. The chicken also getting smaller. Might as well i get half spring…
author: xiiao honghong

review_text: One of my go to places for food, but would reckon that the service levels have kind of declined quite a bit compared to before. Great for a quick bite and nice fried chicken though!
author: Jesslyn

review_text:
This is the thinnest slice of fish I've ever eaten...... how did they know I was on a diet.
Not only was the fish thin, it was tasteless to boot. The only thing that's good on my plate is the toasted bun. That's done to absolute perfection.
author: Benny Toh Hian Leon

review_text:
This is what they served me after the staff forgot my order(payment already made).
They just threw some fries into the fryer for about a minute and then gave it to me. No apologies and not even a hint of guilt.
The fries are softer than mash potatoes.
Pls ignore the 1 star rating. I'm actually giving them 0 stars.
author: Keith Teo

restaurant_name: 胡须佬建造咖喱面 Hu Xu Lao JianZao Curry Noodle
review_text:
Found this place from TikTok & it did not disappoint!! Love that the owner genuinely wants to bring in his family tradition meal to SG.

The $6.80 curry noodles were super fragrant and flavourful, with generous ingredients like char siew, roasted pork, veggies, and fish maw. Added the Ipoh-imported kway teow (+$0.20), it’s silky smooth and totally worth it!! Additional chilli was added on top of the soup if you want more spice.
Will definitely be back! 💯
author: Sherry L

restaurant_name: 胡须佬建造咖喱面 Hu Xu Lao JianZao Curry Noodle
review_text:
​7.5/10 | Can Eat but...
​The Signature Curry Noodle (S$6.80) is a must-try. While it’s slightly pricier than typical options, the dish's excellent curry and generous, high-quality ingredients completely justify the cost. Worth every penny. Keep up the quality please 👍

(13 Nov) This time tried the S$8.80 with cockles. Ingredients are fresh but the curry gravy seems abit loose and lighter on taste.
author: Ken Tay

restaurant_name: 胡须佬建造咖喱面 Hu Xu Lao JianZao Curry Noodle
review_text: Authentic Ipoh style Curry Mee. I saw a lot of people eating so I got curious to get their Signature Curry Mee. I was pleasantly surprised how good it was. The Curry was light, not overly lemak. A very nice touch with the lime juice, balance all the flavours together. The ingredients were very well executed. The char siew, sio bak, pig skin, tau pok, cockles.. I am not expecting it all to be that well cooked. I was puzzled why the 2.4 rating? How is this 2.4? Doesn't do them justice which prompted me to make this effort to post my honest review how I felt their food deserve. Good job. Can't wait to return.
author: Eric Lim

restaurant_name: 胡须佬建造咖喱面 Hu Xu Lao JianZao Curry Noodle
review_text: Nothing overly special about the curry noodle. ordered the $8.80 HuXuLao curry noodle and the broth didn't meet expectations. It didn't have the savory, aromatic punch. It's not terrible, but it's not the satisfying, robust curry experience I was hoping for.
author: Hua Kia Peng

restaurant_name: 胡须佬建造咖喱面 Hu Xu Lao JianZao Curry Noodle
review_text:
I’m a big fan of curry noodle, especially Ipoh curry noodle! I just back from Hanoi and heard that my house opposite opened a new curry noodles, immediately I got my helper to buy for me. When I saw it, I think I will not satisfied with this curry 🍜!

Firstly, I asked for more gravy, in the end …. (Look at the photo yourself)
Secondly, the taste is like water blend with curry powder, none of Ipoh curry noodles taste.
Third, I asked for chilli paste, because I love spicy, unfortunately I think this stall not even provides the home cooked chilli paste for “Ipoh Curry Noodle”! This is shameful, and fully disappointed for first try!

Overall, I wouldn’t recommend at all this stall, heard that their business is very good and always long queue, I think the owner also same like most of entrepreneurs, sacrifices the quality when the $ is in front of him.
author: Walden Ting

review_text: Worse plate of wanton noodles and duck rice i've ever had. The wanton frozen taste too strong and the duck meat was so dry and tough with lots of bone, no dang dui at all.
author: Emily Ho

review_text: The dang gui duck is damn juicy and sauce is so smooth! Added roast pork, it was the best decision ever. I describe it “ Super ASMR Crispy “. The duck and roasted pork is a must try if you are around the area! Definitely a hidden gem in the west! Highly recommended!
author: Wei Sheng Wee

review_text: Order around 1.30pm, given yesterday left over dried roasted pork. Seriously a no to me. Beside this their char siew was great.
author: Chua Ray

review_text: Love all the roast meats here. Meaty and juicy. Little pricey compared to other stalls but service and food is top.
author: Alana T

review_text: Staff very friendly. One of the best roasted pork and char siew in singapore.
author: Douglas

restaurant_name: Trichy KR North & South Indian Food
review_text: Ordered prata with curry and was pleasantly surprised. The chicken curry was flavorful, the chicken was very tender, and everything tasted clean and nicely done. Overall a really satisfying meal — hope they keep this standard up! Would definitely come back again whenever I’m in Jurong.
author: Katherine Lau

restaurant_name: Trichy KR North & South Indian Food
review_text:
Came here for lunch. 1st time here. Wanted to try something light. Ordered the mee goreng.
At 1st glance, mee goreng was on the lighter tone. Had runny fried egg with cut cucumbers at the side. Portion was big. Slightly spicy. Not the typical mee goreng you get at hawker stalls.
@$5, Guess it's a vegetarian mee goreng + egg. Not so flavourful.
author: Mohamed Haniffa

restaurant_name: Trichy KR North & South Indian Food
review_text:
Awesome typical  indian food at an unbelievable price.
Veg set meal s so good with a lot of side dishes.
Must try 🥰
author: prabahar annalingam

restaurant_name: Trichy KR North & South Indian Food
review_text: Eggs not peeled properly, mutton is tough, curry is salty. I am not sure about the other items sold here, but you should at least avoid the mutton biryani.
author: Jason Soh

restaurant_name: Trichy KR North & South Indian Food
review_text: I had tasted their plain prata once.  The curry lacks punch and not thick.  Prata is not very crispy.
author: ZenD

review_text:
Love the curry so much, so appetising! After the curry was served we ordered more rice! 🤣

Everything was good, we had such a great time gathering over yummy vegetarian dishes.

The menu has a great variety of yummy dishes, including western food too. Would love to come back and try the other dishes!
author: Vern Koo

review_text: This place serves some of the best vegetarian food I’ve had. The flavors are unbelievably good—so much so that even compared to the “real stuff,” it holds its own. Truly worth a visit and definitely worth trying out, whether you’re vegetarian or not.
author: Sammy Soong

review_text:
This is one of the best and most reasonably priced vegetarian restaurants. The dishes don’t have that typical flour or doughy flavor, which is a big plus.

I’m grateful for such delicious vegetarian options being available, as they provide more variety and encourage people to consider meatless choices.
author: Bear Gwee

review_text:
Food here is just sweet, salty,  oily and starchy.
Sorry, didn't make the cut for me.
author: Shark Sharkey

review_text:
Another decent place for vegetarian food. Silent and bright place. All the food was tasty, hot passion fruit drink seal the best on the day for me.
The food was delicious, which made me missed taking the photos earlier, but at least plates still have some when these being taken 🙃
author: Aditi Khare

review_text: Not sure why, but this outlet only had one chicken option today. Went ahead and ordered it, it was the most horrible taste and texture, I went to double check if this was teriyaki chicken and they agreed. Even the chicken sausage tasted spoilt. We didn’t eat any of the meat in the end. They also took almost 30min to process our mookata order for 2 people, and there was only one other table there. Truly do enjoy dining at other outlets, but the experience with the chicken itself has ensured I will not be returning, please be careful.
author: Thivya

review_text:
Extremely rude Chinese male staff for an expensive hawker meal

Visited the store for dine-in. Simply because I paid using GrabPay and he wasn't competent in using the system, he used curse words and even tried to grab my phone to take picture of the receipt on my phone screen without asking for permission (I was literally holding it in front of him for him to take the picture already). I'm paying $12 for a Tomyum Mamee on a hawker place, but the service was so terrible. Didn't even call out my number when the food is ready, until I approached the counter when my food was already lying there for more than 5mins

3 small end pieces of crackling pork inside with a single large scallop, 4 shrimps and some mushrooms with an egg...
author: Audrey Lim

review_text:
This is the first time we visit this outlet, we are really disappointed.

Chilli - i request to have the chilli to contain in the small bowl , the uncle say use the plastic saucer will do , i say i want small bowl, he side stare me sia .. walao dont gey gao chilli la i is got eat the chilli one , not take and look de .. 😒

Secondly , clearly the outlet is understaff , when we reach , there were only 1-2 table having mookata , so i reckon the other staff is busy for online orders , our mookata took close to 25 mins and the item came in separate order manner . Uncle is impatience , but maybe he is like that one la but … u cannot shout back or pek cek back at customer one ma unless the customer make u pek cek first.. but you all the way pek cek one leh .. order never come i also dont dare ask .. our fire no more liao u ask us wait .. den we wait more than 5 mins , u ask us wait again .. peng kang food can wait de meh .. sigh ..

Lastly, you have 2 -3 staffs handle multiple companies order meh? One cook porridge, one cook thai food, one handle mookata..

Siam Square management , please provide more staff for this outlet , i believe happy staff will make customer makan session enjoyable also.
author: Villies Ang

review_text:
I was at Siam Square Mookata Jurong West outlet at around 6.36pm today. After waiting for 20 minutes with no dishes served, I went to check with the person in charge. I understand it was peak hour, but when I asked how much longer we needed to wait, he replied to me in Chinese: “你要吃就吃，不要吃就走.”

Is this really how your staff are trained to speak to customers? This attitude is completely unacceptable. Siam Square Mookata has always been one of my favourite places, but after this experience, I’m very disappointed and I don’t think I will be supporting anymore.
author: loa weeling

review_text: Spent $8 on the Krapow Minced Pork, but the portion of meat was disappointingly small and overly salty. The egg was overcooked, which added to the poor experience. I would not recommend this dish.
author: Zach

restaurant_name: Hong Ji Porridge 洪記粥品
review_text:
Ordered mixed pork porridge, cost $4.

Taste is ok with generous ingredients, so deserved the 5 stars!
author: xylon Siah

restaurant_name: Hong Ji Porridge 洪記粥品
review_text: Long queue, everyone waiting patiently. This shows how good the porridge is. Tasty and soft, warm porridge. Pricing has increased slightly but still reasonable. Come try and support!
author: Cheow Mong Chan

restaurant_name: Hong Ji Porridge 洪記粥品
review_text: One of the better porridge stall in region with long queue expected for breakfast. Price is average for hawker fare. Ingredients added to Cantonese style porridge makes the waiting much easier as not only good portion but also good overall taste.
author: Marcus Goh

restaurant_name: Hong Ji Porridge 洪記粥品
review_text: Awesome on a rainy day
author: Ronn Chan

restaurant_name: Hong Ji Porridge 洪記粥品
review_text: Tried the new stall in Clementi at the recommendation of my wife. Indeed it was good. Porridge is very smooth and tasty. Only $2.50 for pork porridge plus 0.50 more for egg.
author: Danny Han

review_text: Great spot for brunch. Barokah noodles is a g good spot to find many Malay dishes to choose from! I was craving for the Mee Batawi and the visit didn’t disappoint. Meat is super tender and the soup is super good.. add in some sambal kicap to your bowl and wow! a favour burst on your mouth. Will come again to try their other menu items / other stalls too.
author: khrhms

review_text:
I would recommend the food at Air Pasang Seafood. This is our second time coming here. They boasted that their Mee Goreng is the most sought-after and we have to agree. It's full of flavor with a generous portion.

We came back this time for the Beef Hor Fun with gravy and white Bee Hoon Lala, both of which were absolutely satisfying. We really enjoyed the food because it was cooked well with full of flavors.

Definitely will come back for others and hopefully they will maintain their quality.
👍👍
author: Rudy Sayas

review_text:
Despite the place being quite crowded (12.00 noon), we managed to find an empty table for the two of us.

We ordered a simple lunch: an omelette and fried broccoli with mushrooms in oyster sauce.

The presentation was very appealing — both dishes were served in bamboo-like plates, adding a nice touch to the dining experience. The broccoli was perfectly blanched, not overcooked, and still had a nice crunch. The mushrooms were flavorful and complemented the dish well.

Overall, a pleasant and satisfying meal!
author: Ratinah Rawi

review_text:
Had seafood dinner here and felt unwell almost immediately after eating. I vomited when I reached home, which was about 10 minutes after the meal, and my wife experienced strong stomach nausea. We ordered rice with sambal stingray, kangkong belacan, tomyum soup, and onion egg.

The symptoms came on very quickly, which was worrying. The food may have been too spicy or not fresh. I hope the restaurant can look into food quality and preparation, especially seafood.

Sharing this for awareness and improvement.
author: Syafiq Asyraf

review_text:
Short walking distance from Bukit Gombak mrt.
Different food stalls selling different kind of foods.
They’re still open during this fasting month. Take away food in containers are conveniently available for breaking fast.
author: Irny N

review_text:
ordered rose wine but got delivered the normal one instead, told the service crew and they changed it for me. however, after delivering the correct beverage, i spotted a stain on my wine glass. 🤢kinda ruined my appetite as im particular about cleanliness.
its so obvious, how could it have been missed?

i did requested a new glass and the service crew changed it for me.

other food were okay and service crew cleared done plates diligently.
author: Ciel Min

review_text:
Average food, feels very microwave.
Portion is quite little so even though per dish is cheap, still spend more than $10 per pax
The chocolate lava cake from 7 eleven is better.
author: JX

review_text: I had dinner at somewhere else (not Saizeriya) today and was really disappointed with their Hawaiian pizza. The ham was lackluster, the tomato sauce was watered down, and the cheese was overly stretchy - it was a choking hazard for my kid! Even the mushroom soup was too salty. I could've gotten a better meal at Saizeriya for half the price. Thanks, Saizeriya, for showing me that pricier doesn't always mean better. You've earned my loyalty!
author: SC Ang

review_text:
Witness a Customer with his little kid son pouring unknown drinking water at the Ice cube compartment.

Notify the one of the Ground male staff immediately. Follow by ground manager…

She took swift action to change all the Ice cubes and ensure Top hygiene is taken into action for all others customers. This prevents contamination to other consumers.
author: ZhongMing Thong

review_text:
Decided to drop by here for lunch. I was seated immediately, since it is about an hour into the afternoon.

Food was served relatively fast, with the usual decent quality given its price. The dessert (Tiramisu) was still something that I enjoyed thoroughly throughout the entire course of the meal.

The atmosphere was relatively peaceful, with soft ambient music and some art hanging around the walls. Would recommend coming over here with your friends and families!
author: Everhart

review_text: Didn't know what to get for dinner, stopped by a nearby coffee shop to grab a simple cheap meal after work, I saw their Fishball Minced meat noodle at the price of $5.80, ordered and told them I specifically didn't want mushrooms, ordered takeaway. Total price at the end costed around $7.70?! You are telling me takeaway cost nearly $2? I didn't even add any extra toppings or noodles. Even when I requested no mushrooms, the auntie still gave me. Got home and decided to just eat the noodles as I was sick as well, turns out the noodles were undercooked, pig liver still chewy like rubber as if it was still raw, fishballs were OK, meatball average, minced meat were hard to notice but were mid, I got vinegar no chili but tasted no hint of vinegar, overall meal was 3/10. Would I return? Probably not, $7.70 for a bowl that was advertised $5.80 (not excluding takeaway) is crazy. Despite the price, the taste and texture of the overall meal was depressing.
author: Arash Jirut

review_text: It's been quite sometime since i last visited this stall. Used to have a very grumpy and grouchy lady managing the stall, now is another lady sound like a Vietnamese. She is also as grumpy. Reading from the past reviews, seems like all persons working in this stall are rude. Noodles and soup are nice though. Probably won't visit again if there are other choices
author: HãpPŸ

review_text:
I tried the signature noodles for $5.80.

The noodles came with this watery sauce that gave it a bit of sweetness. It can be quite oily though so I like to water it down a bit with the soup.

The soup had a bunch of different pork cuts in there, some liver, meat slices, meatballs. Overall it’s pretty good, the noodles are cooked well, flavours are alright, not too salty. Though some of the liver given was a bit chewy and tougher while others had a nice bite to it, so there’s a bit of inconsistency. The soup also had a nice eggy flavour as well.

Food came fast and pretty affordable.
author: Han Yu Tan

review_text:
A very average bowl of mee pok, nothing to shout about. I had the signature selection. Mee pok was ok, ingredients in the soup are over cooked. Liver is rubbery and egg is not runny.

I wanted mee pok with chilli but without vinegar. It comes without both.

I don't believe they are not passionate about cooking.... just a job.
author: Rick

review_text:
Just something to eat to fill my stomach.

Honestly it's one of the worst noodles I've had and the dumplings wasn't nice.

Staff was friendly but the food just wasn't worth the calories or the price.

I won't be coming back for sure.
author: Alvin Chan

restaurant_name: Dajie Makan Place @ Bukit Batok | Halal Chicken Rice, Mala Hotpot & Yong Tau Foo
review_text:
Been here countless times over the years, my comfort food for non spicy halal meal. I do understand inflation n high overhead in f&b r real n scary but yday encounter really shocked me.
1 canned button mushroom, baby corn, quail egg, tomato, prep tied veggies cost ($0.90/pcs) ain’t it too steep to count as NDF pricing?
Thanks to the receipt 1st take too, usually don’t have, I will try avoid taking those items the next time I visited.
FYI, I did asked for recount of the items cos it is the highest amount I ever paid, usually always around $12/14++, he admitted overcharge of $0.80 n refunded me, last visit was less than 2 weeks ago
author: Hana

restaurant_name: Dajie Makan Place @ Bukit Batok | Halal Chicken Rice, Mala Hotpot & Yong Tau Foo
review_text: Came here for a late lunch and had the roasted chicken rice—it was amazing! The chilli sauce was delicious too. A great spot for a simple, satisfying meal.
author: Andrew Ang

restaurant_name: Dajie Makan Place @ Bukit Batok | Halal Chicken Rice, Mala Hotpot & Yong Tau Foo
review_text:
This place is a monthly visit requirement even pre pandemic 😊

Enjoyed the chicken rice (good portions), the Yong Tau Foo was good (more variety would be nice) and price was reasonable for sure.

Biggest issue with me since day 1 I visited here was the tiny tiny tables. 2 person to a tiny table is just super crowded and uncomfortable. 2 tables seating 2 people (as per the required regulations) would not breach the space and distance requirements. So hopefully they can look into this.

The food can be nice, the staff can be wonderful but when the set up is uncomfortable, the whole experienced is compromised. Again, hope they will look into this.

Food : 4 / 5
Staff : 4 / 5
Ambience: 2 / 5
author: Alex Pfieffer

restaurant_name: Dajie Makan Place @ Bukit Batok | Halal Chicken Rice, Mala Hotpot & Yong Tau Foo
review_text:
Situated across the road from Bukit Gombak station, Dajie has been around for years.

I was really impressed by their mala chicken rice in the past (which is now no longer available).

Nevertheless, their chicken rice, be it roasted or white is of great taste! Don't be fooled by the facade as their menu is very extensive. Many diners opt for the chicken rice set with YTF. If not, the chicken rice sets are good options!

The last time I was here, I spied additional items like fried rice and sliced fish dishes on a handwritten whiteboard.

The place gets crowded during mealtimes. If not, they are busy preparing for food delivery orders.
author: Alvin Li

restaurant_name: Dajie Makan Place @ Bukit Batok | Halal Chicken Rice, Mala Hotpot & Yong Tau Foo
review_text: On 4th November, I went to eat mala. I clearly told the cashier mala soup however when my food was given i received clear soup base. The next day, i ordered again mala soup. guess what? the mala soup was barely there…. and they gave me a side of clear base soup. i would like an explanation and compensation on this if possible. thank you. i paid 12.30$ just for the soup to be nonexistent.
author: Nurin Insyirah

review_text:
New Pizza Hut  look and more brighter now
sour dough crust is awesome taste
Now with more choices of menu to choose from
author: Jeganath Selvam

review_text:

author: Samantha Ong

review_text:
Three to four mornings a week, I walk into Subway Gombak not just for breakfast—also for the warmth of The morning team here. They serve and make every sandwich to the preferences of customers.
But lately, the air-conditioning managed by SMRT has been down for over two weeks.
Instead of cool comfort, we get a noisy blower, a fan gasping for breath, and wide-open doors inviting in the tropical blaze.
Singapore’s heat is no joke. It’s time SMRT stepped up and Fix the aircon!
Let the staffs of Subway work in comfort, and the customers to enjoy their meals without melting.
author: Jiakelin Lin

review_text: Ordered my food via grab self pick up. When reached my order was not ready yet although in app says ready. But i expect such delay beforehand because i ordered during peak lunch period. But the staff on site was very efficient to prepare my order although i've arrived at the restaurant. There was this tall lady who was quick to prepare my order quickly to cater to my grab self pick up order which was supposed to be done already. There was also another lady, i think she's the manager there, who apologise and explain why my order was not prepared yet. Which i totally understand due to the peak period. The only issue i had was there was no aircon. When i asked the staff there, they said the aircon compressor is spoiled pending repair by smrt staff. To smrt, please address this issue as i was started to sweat waiting for my order to be prepared, if i am sweating, the staff must be suffering to. Received my food within 10 mins after i reached the restaurant. And i was on my way home.
author: Fadli Matswan

review_text: Went down with my daughter to this outlet for takeaway for lunch. Saw that they had the new meatball marinara sub. Was hesitant at first. Asked the kind lady at the regarding the sandwich. She was patient enough to explain to me which condiments goes best with the meatball marinara . After much consideration, I decided to give it a try and I was not disappointed. Kudos to the staff for entertaining my queries. Another lady on duty prepared daughter orders of egg mayo, apologises for my daughter being a bit picky and fickle minded in choosing the condiments. But the other lady was also patient enough to entertain my daughter's antic.😅 Overall a good place to buy takeaway.
author: Noralina Ali

review_text:
I visited Subway Bukit Gombak MRT at approximately 1:50 p.m. on a Friday. There was no queue, yet the young male staff (name beginning with “J”) completely ignored my presence while working on a delivery order. I waited close to 10 minutes without any acknowledgment, even though he had clearly seen me standing at the counter.

When he finally addressed me, he raised his voice and shouted “HELLO ORDER?” in a rude and uncalled-for manner. This tone continued throughout the interaction — it was not the demeanor of someone under pressure, but rather a consistent display of poor attitude and lack of respect toward customers.

What was even more concerning was the severe lapse in hygiene practices. The staff member used the same gloved hands (which were handling vegetables and meat) to adjust his spectacles, cross-contaminating the gloves in the process. The air-conditioning appeared to be down, and he was visibly perspiring while preparing food, which made the entire experience extremely uncomfortable and unhygienic.

A senior-looking Filipino staff member eventually appeared but took several minutes to offer any assistance and failed to address or correct the junior staff’s unprofessional conduct.

This outlet demonstrated a serious breach of service and hygiene standards. I strongly urge Subway’s management to review this outlet’s staffing, training, and hygiene protocols immediately before such negligence compromises customer safety further.
author: cy

review_text:
i only patronise this branch because of convenience (located at MRT station). i wanted to order my usual sandwich, chicken shroom poloni with garlic bread, which is on the overhead menu.

staff A said there is no more of that and that they have something else. i couldnt make out what she was saying and she didnt point to it. as queue moved forward, i pointed to ask about an ingredient i didnt recognise at first glance so i asked and she "repeated".  i said ill get that, cos why not try right? then she put my bun back and told me to choose either italian or multigrain.. i was confused why she put my bun back and asked if i can choose my bun. she didnt reply me but a male staff (Staff B) said i can only choose between the 2. ok, fine.. then after toasting, he told me i can only choose amongst the 5 veggie he pointed out. i asked if i can order other veggies and he said i can add on..i was super confused  because I have added on guacamole before but never "added on" pickles or jalepeno.. he said rudely that its posted outside and i turned back a few times and i didnt see anything on the glass.. he saw i was confused and repeated himself. it sounded like i shouldve seen it and too bad if i didnt.. but i wasnt pleased that i wasnt informed upfront at the beginning. i can tell he wasnt too happy helping me with my sandwich. he said just today i can order them, like a concession.... ok, thats a relief to hear because i wouldnt want the sandwich if i cant have both the bun and veggies i wanted -i mean, i thought that was the concept of subway?? when making payment, i asked the female cashier (Staff C) about what Staff B said, cos walking from the MRT gantry, i didnt see anything then she said its on the wall at the other side of Subway and pointed to the location of the poster. then she told me that whatever they said was the recommendation and that i still choose the ingredients i wanted. i am still very confused because i received different information from both Staff A and Staff B. i said i didnt see the poster as I came from the MRT gantry and she tried to explain a little. i feel she was the only one who talked to me nicely.

(see photo from the gantry direction) customers sitting ANYWHERE IN the store would not be able to see the said posters because they are posted PAST the inside wall on the outside.. maybe the posters can be placed where customers will definitely not miss it (eg near the door)? just a suggestion. and please note, there is only 1 door for this branch and most commuters dont walk by the said wall. yes i didnt notice the posters, thats kinda on me. but the location of the posters really isnt ideal.  i would appreciate it if the staff can explain nicely - of course they are familiar with the terms and conditions and posters but dont assume every customer is aware..no need to be sarcastic and rude about it.  i wanted to have a nice meal but this experience was very unpleasant.
author: Wendi Chan

review_text:
Decent Mookata! The broth wasn’t too flavourful, but the meat and vegetables were fresh. Each serving of meat / vegetables is quite big (we way over ordered).
The cheese tofu was really good. And the fish dumplings. And shrimp paste.
author: Cass

review_text: Fresh & well marinated chick thigh, pork collar & belly. Never goes wrong together with the homemade chilli & suki sauce. Superb appetizing pairing with rice & mamak mee. Most of all, reasonably priced.
author: Sim Benny

review_text: I recommend the garlic marinated meats over the black pepper ones as I felt they tasted way better. Worth the money, meat was good quality and marinated well. Chilli was good as well. The tom yum soup was lacking though so I'd probably order the plain soup if i came again. Overall would reco!
author: Tania Koh

review_text:
First time having mookata in my life. I have been reading about this mookata for a long time but never have the chance. Today I finally decided to give my "first time" to JJM after reading rave reviews over here. It definitely didn't disappoint! We ordered the 4 pax platter and it cost at $42, what an economically pricing! The platter comes with a lot of meat and other side dishes including veggies. The pork belly is really something not to be missed. When you put it on top of the pengkang, OMG, the little chaotar smell plus the marinated taste is just godly. The soup base is also very good, mixing with noodles, a perfect match from the sky my friend!

Service is also very good. The uncle will always walk by and even help you top up soup or check the gas. Coupled with the kopitiam setting, it's just plain perfection. Also not to be missed, the self service sauce in front of the stall. My personal favorite is the Thai chili sauce, not too sour, not too spicy. Just nice.

Highly recommended, don't miss this. The business is really good by the way. At least 90% of the kopitiam customers are eating this mookata. So this is a testament of their quality and value.
author: Ken Peh

review_text:

author: Amzar Hamzah

review_text:
I had a truly wonderful experience at KFC Keat Hong, and it definitely deserves a 5-star review! From the moment I walked in, the staff were warm, friendly, and attentive, which immediately set a positive tone. They were patient while taking orders and handled everything efficiently, even when the outlet was busy.

The food was excellent — served hot, fresh, and perfectly prepared. The chicken was crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside, just the way it should be, and the sides were fresh and well-portioned. It’s clear that the team takes pride in maintaining quality and consistency.

The restaurant itself was clean, organized, and comfortable, making it a pleasant place to dine in. Orders were prepared quickly without compromising on quality, which is always appreciated. Overall, the combination of great service, delicious food, and a welcoming environment made this visit especially enjoyable.

KFC Keat Hong has definitely set a high standard, and I’ll be more than happy to return again. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a satisfying and reliable KFC experience! 🍗✨
author: Alex Hafizi

review_text: Had a great experience at KFC Keat Hong! The outlet was clean and well-maintained, and the staff were friendly and efficient even during busy hours. The food was served hot and fresh — crispy chicken, juicy inside, and the sides were just as good. Orders were prepared quickly and accurately, which made the visit smooth and enjoyable. Overall, a reliable and satisfying KFC experience. Will definitely come back again! 🍗😊
author: Nur Syakirah

review_text:
26/11 @ 9.20pm

Please ensure that orders are checked thoroughly before handing them to customers. This is not the first time items have been missing from my order. I have overlooked it on several occasions, but today’s experience was unacceptable.

When I returned to inform the staff member that my cheese fries were missing, she did not apologise. Instead, when I reminded her to check orders before giving them to customers next time, she told me that *I* should be the one checking the items.

This response is completely unprofessional and unacceptable. The order comes from your kitchen, prepared and handed over by your staff. It is your responsibility and not the customer’s. And to ensure the order is complete before passing it over. The audacity to shift the responsibility onto the customer shows a serious lack of accountability and basic customer service standards.

Yes, customers can double-check their orders, but the primary responsibility lies with the staff. This level of carelessness and attitude is disappointing and needs to be addressed.
author: Kellyn Aguileraa

review_text: I have ordered my food items here via contactless delivery and dine in, everything was smooth as always. No hiccups and always on time. Staff was very friendly and meet my expectations. Nice and convenient to have pizza hut around our neighbourhood area!
author: Aslina Abdul

review_text:
I had a really great experience at Pizza Hut in Keat Hong! The outlet is clean and well-kept, making it a comfortable place to grab a bite or pick up an order. Their pizzas are consistently tasty — with generous toppings and a nicely baked crust that hits the spot every time. The staff here are friendly and attentive, always ready to help with menu questions and promotions, which made our visit pleasant and stress-free.

Whether you’re ordering for takeaway, delivery, or collection, I’ve always found their service reliable and reasonably prompt, and the food arrives hot and fresh. With a good variety of classic and seasonal flavours as well as some great value bundles, it’s a solid choice for a casual meal with friends or family. Highly recommend if you’re around the Keat Hong! 🍕😋

review_text:
Genuinely, the service was extremely bad. There were about five people inside the kitchen, yet the service was unbelievably slow. The counter/cashier staff named NANA had the absolute worst attitude. She rolled her eyes at everyone who walked past, queued, or simply needed help. The restaurant wasn’t even busy, this was close to 10pm and there were barely any customers.
When I started queuing, I could already hear people complaining about how slow the service was, and some of them just left. I was third in line after that, I stood there for exactly 25 minutes, only to move to second. By the time I left, there were at least six people behind me. How does it take 25 minutes just to move up one spot?
When a customer politely asked for help to check their order, she ignored him and then proceeded to scream out past order numbers instead. (He asked really politely before she started yelling out the numbers)
Not only was she rude, but she also worked painfully slowly, as if moving any faster would be a problem. She strolled around, and WHY does it take more than 10 seconds to take the chicken out on put it in the box??
I’ve worked in F&B before, so I understand that it can get overwhelming. But this restaurant was almost empty. Nobody is forcing her to work in F&B. there are many other job options, such as retail. If you choose to work in a fast food resturant, at least make some effort to keep the service fast.
Customers don’t expect her to smile all day or give superb service. But basic respect should not be too much to ask
author: Misaki Eh

How can the tenders be gone in 2 bites. Look at my photo size. It’s only a bit larger than the sauce box. That’s nugget size already.

Twice recently I bought from this KFC and twice disappointed. Not going to buy from this joint again.

author: Kelyn Ngui

restaurant_name: Defu Minced Meat Noodle & Fishball Noodle (德福)
review_text:
My good friend introduced me to this stall as I had just moved to the neighbourhood. I was totally mesmerised by the lady boss because of her friendliness!

Price: She had kept her food prices low for many years, and increased to $3.50 for the fishball noodle probably not long ago. It still seems like a fair price for a super budget person like me.

Taste: I love her mee kia and had tried mee pok (my girlfriend's order) that satisfied my stomach well.

Generosity: She went for holidays not long ago and bought snacks for her customers! Although we were new to her stall, she gave us some as well! Most importantly, she gave a very generous portion of food and extra ingredients.

Food hygiene: A week ago, a not-very-pleasant man behind the queue somehow moved our bowl of noodle while she was still preparing another bowl, she quickly stopped the man, and they had a dispute. She was super concern with the hygiene level of her food, at the expense of offending an unsound man. I think she's also very righteous.

Due to her working alone, I hope people can be more patient with her. She's really fast in preparing the food and she can take multiple orders at the same time - a rare food seller I have met.
author: Skai Chan

restaurant_name: Defu Minced Meat Noodle & Fishball Noodle (德福)
review_text:
Ordered the Century & Salted Egg Spinach Soup $3.50 with additional Noodle $1.

Not bad, soup is quite flavourful and they are generous with the portion. The lady owner is friendly and will give you more spinach if you ask nicely. Noodle is quite okay as well. Overall good! And cheap!

Would recommend to try if you stay around the neighborhood!
author: Melvin J.

restaurant_name: Defu Minced Meat Noodle & Fishball Noodle (德福)
review_text: I’m surprised by some of the negative reviews about the stall auntie. I’ve been a regular customer, and every time she’s been kind and welcoming to both me and my child since day one. She even offered my little one some snacks and free fishball. It’s possible she’s had an off day or been overwhelmed managing the stall on her own, but in my experience, she’s always been pleasant. Let’s all remember to live and let live!
author: JY

review_text: Tried Wingstop at Le Quest and enjoyed the experience. The wings were freshly prepared, flavourful, and served hot. There’s a good variety of flavours to choose from, and the portions are satisfying. Convenient location for nearby residents and a nice spot for a casual meal or takeaway.
author: Benedict Correya

review_text: When home then realise shortage of 1 fries and gave me the wrong drinks....
author: Janelle Lim

review_text:
Tried this place for the first time and honestly loved it! The chicken was good, flavourful and felt very freshly made.
Also shoutout to Sheena who took my order and prepared the food — she was really nice and friendly, and you can tell she puts effort into what she does.
Overall I've had a satisfying experience. Will definitely come back again and recommend to friends!!!
author: Bìnhh Ann

review_text: never thought i would be giving wingstop a 5 star review but here i am. the le quest outlet surpassed my expectations greatly! the wait for the food was decent despite the huge number of takeaway orders before us. and best of all, the food was.. HOT !! wingstop has never tasted this good.
author: matchagirl

review_text:
This was the FIRST time that i ordered from WINGSTOP and may be the LAST.

Unfortunately, when i took home (there were quite a crowd and lack of space in stall hence i avoided the check. Another feeling is that i trusted them since is new hence order will be “CLEAN”) it did not come with Fries Cmb (R) shown on the receipt. The wait was 20 mins for my order btw, but yes i could wait but really disappointing with the shortchanged.

I do not know how to feedback as there are no contact number on receipt for this specific store!

I submitted in facebook and for 3 days, there were no genuine replies.

It have shortchanged me for the first day.

I would return to the store when i passed by with enough time and let’s see whats the service recovery will be like.

Very disappointing and disrupting.
author: Papa Toh

review_text: Had nasi lemak here with chicken thigh and chicken cutlet. Both were tasty and well-prepared — the chicken was crispy on the outside and juicy inside. The sambal complemented the rice nicely without being overpowering. A satisfying and affordable nasi lemak option in Bukit Batok.
author: Benedict Correya

review_text: Tried Ho Yeah Nasi Lemak and really enjoyed the food — flavours were spot on and very satisfying. Special kudos to the staff/boss for their flexibility and patience in handling my order, which made the whole experience even better. Great service paired with good food. Will definitely recommend to others.
author: CP K

review_text:
One of THE BEST Nasi Lemak in Singapore. I have been trying to find good ones in Singapore, that has the same oommph back home, and this stall surprised me.

Try it to believe it. 4 branches along the Red NSL.
author: Shimon

review_text: Their nasi lemak is amazing! The rice is fragrant, chili is unique and portions are big for $5. Will definitely come back for more!
author: Chloe Wong

review_text: The food is absolutely delicious and The eggs was lava type. This is so much better than crave. Keep it up
author: HG G

review_text:
I had the chicken chop recently and honestly, it was so good I’m still thinking about it. The chicken was grilled to perfection—crispy on the outside, juicy and tender on the inside. You could really taste the seasoning, not too salty, just the right balance of savory and slightly smoky. The sauce it came with (I think it was black pepper?) was rich and flavorful without overpowering the meat.

The portion was generous too, and the sides—especially the coleslaw—complemented the dish perfectly. It’s one of those meals that just makes you feel satisfied and happy after.

Overall, it’s definitely one of the better chicken chops I’ve had in a while. If you’re craving something hearty and delicious, this one’s a must-try!
author: Celvor

review_text: No issue with service or wait time. There are only 2 people working and grilling food takes time. Taste wise ok but not exceptional. Packaging wise, not sure why they choose to use small packaging which forces them to break the fish up for takeaway orders. Not a deal breaker though.
author: P Loh

review_text: Found this store on Food panda and I ordered online for my family gathering. We liked the food. Decent portion and not overly cooked until “dry” compared to other online western food places I have tried. Highly recommend 👍
author: Hà Nguyễn In Singapore

review_text:
Now, we know why waiting time is so long even though there's only 1 Food Order.

Cos that slim lady with glasses was sitting behind the counter having her meal. And when being asked, she said 2 minutes with that unhappy expression.

Sohai~
author: Meow The Cat

review_text: ordered fish and chips and the fish was smelly and not fresh at all. it was mostly just the batter too. and the potato salad was terrible too. as someone who doesnt like wasting food i just couldnt bring myself to finish this. WORST WESTERN FOOD EVER!!
author: Arjun

restaurant_name: Ding Jian Hong Kong Style Charcoal Roasted 鼎尖港式炭燒燒臘
review_text:
5 dollar.
Char siew and roast pork rice with MSG soup.
Rice on the hard side.
Food is alright for not picky eater otherwise rather you waste your calories on other stall.
author: Jefferson Lee

restaurant_name: Ding Jian Hong Kong Style Charcoal Roasted 鼎尖港式炭燒燒臘
review_text:
Food here is now mediocre at best, a huge downgrade from what it used to be. Once the original partner left (I believe the same person behind Four Heavenly Kings Roasted Duck), the quality took a nosedive.

The service is horrible. Zero effort, zero courtesy, and the attitude is as if customers are an annoyance. Some of the Malaysian staff behave like we owe them something. Extremely disappointing and nowhere near the standard this stall used to have.
author: Terry

restaurant_name: Ding Jian Hong Kong Style Charcoal Roasted 鼎尖港式炭燒燒臘
review_text:
Hidden gem in the neighbourhood!
Chanced upon this coffee shop diagonally opposite Le Quest. Saw that the roasted meat stall has a queue so i ordered from roasted dang gui duck (their signature) and roasted pork. Hubby ordered char siew rice. They were all tasty, especially the duck. Meat tender and moist with the sauce, pork skin crispy and crunchy. Rice is fragrant

Went back there again yesterday evening to try the roasted chicken, not disappointed as well. Value for money (2 meats combo cost less than $5, probably slightly more for combo with duck which is understandable), they are not stingy with the portion. Highly recommended!
author: Seow HT

restaurant_name: Ding Jian Hong Kong Style Charcoal Roasted 鼎尖港式炭燒燒臘
review_text: I had chicken rice at this stall in a coffee shop and honestly, it isn’t that particularly different from any other place. The soup was definitely steaming hot which is great at least. The chicken rice itself isn’t notable in that it’s just your basic chicken rice dish. I do like how cheap the prices are since it was only $4 for the dish, helps that the environment is also clean and tidy. Overall, good chicken rice but not much to note.
author: Ivan Ang

restaurant_name: Ding Jian Hong Kong Style Charcoal Roasted 鼎尖港式炭燒燒臘
review_text:
The char siu is very good for the price and outshines the roast pork. Lovely caramelized dark bits give the bitter sweet smokey  contrast to the flavorful tender char siu either melt in the mouth fat.
Good value for money. 👍
The coffeeshop is a little messy and could be cleaner.
author: Leonard Lim

restaurant_name: 福星海鲜 FU Xing Seafood
review_text:
Not sure why the review was so bad but since am in the area and wanted to try something new so just take a leap of faith for it.

Came around 9.30pm and wanted something light. Friendly old uncle intro fish soup noodle and I also ordered another Bee Hoon (香底米粉).

Didn't expect much and the food came surprisingly tasty.
I love the fish soup and the bee hoon gravy.
The price is more economical compared to other zhi char stores.

Will come earlier next time to try other dishes...
author: MsJiakPuiPui

restaurant_name: 福星海鲜 FU Xing Seafood
review_text:
Looking at the last few reviews from 7 months before which were mostly negative and seeing the steady flow of people ordering from the stall, thought will give it a try.

Ordered assam fish head and fried egg with chives. Assam fish head which costs $25 is ok, with nothing exceptional or bad. What irks me is the fried egg with chives. At $8, I would have expected something more substantial than what you can see from the photo. My kids feel that it’s only worth $3 but I think $5 is probably reasonable. Definitely not $8. While it tastes ok, this has marred the experience and one try is more than enough for us.
author: P Loh

restaurant_name: 福星海鲜 FU Xing Seafood
review_text: Yesterday decided gave it a try by packed for whole family dinner here. The uncle is very nice and patience by intro the food. Price is quite cheap compared same food category. Although the food taste is not fantastic, but personally I felt is ok for me (not heavy taste). Recommended to give it a try as the business seems bad after the new hawker centre opened.
author: Jimmy Tan

restaurant_name: 福星海鲜 FU Xing Seafood
review_text: Fresh and tasty seafood with generous portions at reasonable prices. Friendly staff and a good variety of dishes — a nice spot for zi char and seafood lovers.
author: Benedict Correya

restaurant_name: 福星海鲜 FU Xing Seafood
review_text: Had such a good lunch. Nothing beats a freshly cooked meal. Thank you!
author: Edwina Bensal

review_text: I don’t usually give review, but this time round just too irritated. The entire restaurant full of flies, every time I come always see flies, and the staff not doing anything. People are complaining and their replied were the flies are from Koufu. Can’t imagine the flies in the kitchen, and keep touching your food. Busy chasing flies away during the whole meal, won’t be surprise having stomach ache. Feels like coming to an air con kampong.
author: Bendon Tan

review_text: Ambience cosy, staffs service very courtesy, friendly, pleasant, attentive and helpful especially Zoe. The food is good, pricing reasonable and set meals come with free flow of hot and cold drinks. Give it a thump up.
author: Ricky Seah

review_text:
Value for money: very dependent,  5.9 for risotto, 7.5 for very disappointing cheesy chicken
Quality:  Cheesy chicken was very underwhelming. No flavor and the brown sauce given was a sad puddle. Corn tasted bland and they gave like 5 potato wedges in total

Gelato was bit too sweet, risotto but too salty but overall was quite good
Gelato I think but ice cream from macs right next door better hehe
author: IAm Human

review_text:
Service and atmosphere is good and food is decent for the price

But I am greatly concerned with the hygiene. Saw some kids take the ice cubes with their bare hands for the drinks without washing them first.

Now I don’t want to drink my drink cos of the contaminated ice. I won’t ever be taking the ice any more and I highly recommend others to do the same.
author: AhDada Desu

review_text: Kind of disappointed for the first visit with so many flies around my table. I can actually see around 4 of them flying around my table. Is so annoying. The restaurant management really has to do something on this. Is really not hygienic and feels disgusting with insect around. Have feedback this to SFA.
author: Adrian Lau Kok Shong

review_text:
The food was extremely disappointing. The fries tasted like they had been refried multiple times — hard, dry, and almost impossible to bite through. What made it worse was the service. The staff were very perfunctory and didn’t even bother to coat the fries with the seasoning properly. There was barely any flavour at all.

I ordered seaweed fries, but instead they randomly sprinkled chili powder on it. How does that even make sense?

Charging $13.50 for something like this — do you honestly think that’s reasonable?
The ratings for this place are definitely not real.👎☹️
author: jiamin li

review_text:
Easy to order online and pick up at designated time. The collection was a bit later than the stated time but it’s ok can pop into NTUC while waiting.
This is a new outlet so it’s quite clean and well designed for collection.
Can see the staff working busily to fulfill orders in their large open kitchen. Can be ensured the food is prepared fresh.
This outlet is only for takeaway and collection. Quite convenient for nearby residents.
Staff is friendly enough even though they were busy during peak hour meal time. Don’t mind going back to takeaway again.
Chicken is juicy, sauce is nice but the spicy can be quite hot as compared to soy flavor. Curious about the chili lime mayo next time can try. The crust is still very crispy even though 30 min after purchase.

I ordered another time using a Qoo10 coupon and redemption at this outlet was fast and easy. The staff was also flexible and obliging to request which is very kind. The food was good. Spicy drumlet is a bit hot for me but I like the kick as soy is nice but a bit monotonous taste so it’s great they allow mixed flavor. The food is still crispy after tabao home, that’s really amazing as soggy fried chicken is the worst.
author: M

review_text: Bought 6 wings combo soy sauce. Soy sauce very dry n tasteless. We pay $11 . Not $1 meal. Pls tell your staffs do work up to standard. I see like student younger faces that spread the sauce on the chicken. Disappointed.
author: Junaidie Leman

review_text: a lot of fake reviews about good service in this outlet. got very bad service from this staff called suriya, showing attitude and being very impatient when ordering. food is cold, fries not crispy at all, seems like its been left there for quite awhile, sauce for chicken and maki was so little, barely any sauce on them. bad experience
author: haha myeon

review_text: chicken is no longer juicy like last time. now is small and dry and not nice
author: stella

review_text:
This is based on Grab delivery review.
Ordered 4 pizza. Photos and actual is not same. Look at the size of the shrimp (not prawn). I think dough is fresh, but ingredients quite limited and pizza taste dry. Look at the cheese packets. Oily lump of mess when it reach, not edible at all.
author: Cheow Mong Chan

review_text: Ordered from food delivery for Hawaiian pizza and teriyaki chicken pizza. Decent as comfy food though no wow factor. Could not comment on the service but delivery is on time, not sure how is the atmosphere at store. So 4 star each for service and 3 star for atmosphere.
author: Khoo CY

review_text: Ordered take away Hawaiian pizza. Surprised that it’s really good. The pizza is beautifully baked with generous ingredients.
author: Jowe Chu

review_text: The staff is friendly and polite, good customer service. My first time trying their pizza and I love it. I will visit again for the food.
author: Karen Bernadette

review_text:
This was my first time trying pizza from this brand. I ordered a cheese pizza, which, based on the menu photo, is supposed to have spinach on top. However, the pizza I received did not include any spinach. When I asked the staff about this, the initial response was dismissive, with one staff member simply saying, 'That's just how it is.' I received the same answer when asked again. Upon asking a senior staff member, I was informed that the spinach they received that day was spoiled, so it could not be used.

While I understand the situation with the spinach, it would have been courteous and professional to inform me beforehand, allowing me to choose an alternative topping or even a different item. The lack of communication and the indifferent attitude of some staff members left me feeling disappointed and undervalued as a customer. Clearer communication and better customer service would greatly enhance the experience.
author: wai siong cheah

review_text: Enjoyed my last McDonald’s meal of 2025. The restaurant is clean and comfortable, allowing me to relax here in comfort for long periods of time. It is also usually not too crowded, which is the main reason why I love coming here. Looking forward to more visits in 2026 and beyond!
author: Bryan Lim

review_text: Always something missing from the orders so please check. Ordered big breakfast and they missed out the hot cakes. Happen too many times that we started guessing what can go missing.
author: Zhe Liang Goh

review_text: I saw my food ready but staff just placed on table and never call for my number. And the small size fries as seen in the photo is not even fully filled. Very disappointing.
author: lisa cheong

review_text: asked for table no., cashier mentioned "sorry i already press in the order couldn't do that for you." it's not busy at all, there were no orders, i don't understand why just a marking of a table no. on the receipt or their order paper a problem, stand there for 10 mins for the food, thought they will call out for no. when food r ready, so i went back to my seat. however, i waited for another 5 mins, i didn't hear any no. called, i went to check my food was there waiting lonely. and my coke float isn't coke float anymore. HORRIBLE SERVICE. can't believe mcd is like that already.
author: Eilean Lee

review_text:
Review for McDonald’s @ Le Quest

Very disappointed with the service at this outlet. For a fast food restaurant, the service is consistently slow and inefficient, even when there’s a big crowd waiting. Staff don’t seem to have a sense of urgency, and this isn’t a one-time issue — it’s been the same across multiple visits.

Even when ordering from home, about 6 out of 10 times, there are issues with our orders — missing items, wrong items, or cold food. It’s frustrating, especially when we’re paying for convenience and reliability.

McDonald’s is known for its consistency, but this outlet really falls short. Is this the kind of standard we should expect?

Ordered food at 9.22am
Still no sign of the food at 9.50am
author: Charmaine Wong

review_text: First time ordererd from this shop and will be last too. We was very disappointed with the food which was blend and tasteless! It never live up to it's expectation! The mee goreng was dry and blend and the worse was Mee steak kuah.. ! We have no other alternative and have to disposed it as it was really a junk! My $15.00 was gone to waste! And I requested for cucumber but was not given at all! Please looked at the mutton steak kuah as it was totally entirely diffrent from the picture they displayed in their advertisement. If they had posted their original food photo I would not have ordered the food from this shop. I regretted about it. And it is now fasting month and due to the junk [ Mee steak kuah ] food which was given to us my kids starved. Truly and totally disappointed!
author: Abdul Abdul

review_text: Around tengah to cck to Bukit batok this one have the best rojak. Definitely worth the come back. Will bring whole family to this kopitiam
author: king sufi

review_text:
The briyani rice was almost perfect..

The Mutton, ar char (salad) and sauces are superb...

The Mutton was in a big chunk, then she/he use the scissor to cut into small sizes.. its very tender and boneless..

The sauces very rich with Mutton flavour. I love it. The spices and masala just nicee not too heavy..

The chicken taste ok ok..

The briyani rice was not the best in my dictionary..

The roti prata is good.. the key is the Mutton sauce.. yumyum $2.20sgd (2pcs)

$7.50sgd for Mutton briyani.. satisfaction above average..

$7 SGD chicken briyani..

$6SGD Mutton + white rice.. Mutton GOOD
author: Darren Cheong

review_text: Happen to change upon this stall when i came to dinein at another stall. Bought nasi goreng ikan billis to try out. Takeaway. Taste was okok. Staffs were friendly.
author: Mohamed Haniffa

review_text: A classic combination that brings together the fragrant richness of briyani with the fiery kick of ayam sambal. This dish is a powerhouse of flavors. The meal is made even better by the warm and friendly service. The staff is attentive, always ready with recommendations and a smile, making the dining experience feel welcoming and personal. Whether it's ensuring the sambal is just the right level of spicy or offering extra sides, their hospitality adds to the enjoyment.
author: Ainnie Tey

review_text:
Good fresh banh mi. 🥖 All options are flavorful and light! Grilled Lemongrass Chicken Banh Mi and Grilled Lemongrass Chicken Vermicelli are pretty good and meaty, and the least processed—we like these best. Grilled Pork Sausage is also nice, and so is the Special Traditional Vietnam Bánh Mì (Pate Chả lụa). The baguettes are nicely crispy and chewy with a crunchy shell, apparently baked on-site. I buy extra baguettes often.

🧇 Waffle is perfectly on point for peanut butter: a not-too-sweet waffle with a sticky salty-sweet peanut butter (that you can buy among all the minimart items).

Wait time varies.
author: Angel

review_text:
A very nice Vietnamese food stall housed under West Plains HDB. Their Banh mi is not bad, worth a try, coffee is good too.

There is a small table for dine in for about 4 pax and there is also a fan to make airflow better!

The shop also sells waffles, will have to try it out next time!
author: Cheng Han Chua

review_text: My 2nd visit today and I noticed they have updated their menu with some new additions and price changes. I had the Neum Nuong Bahn Mi which was a newly added item. This is really delicious…contrasting textures and aromatic flavours all rolled into one. I would have preferred if there’s more vegetables added especially the pickled carrots. I also noticed the pate was not added to this. I always felt the pate is the critical ingredient that adds flavor depth to any bahn mi. I also ordered the fresh spring rolls which was freshly made-to-order and was delicious as well. However, I was a little surprised that it was served with Nuoc Cham instead of the usual Peanut Dipping Sauce (the one with Hoisin Sauce added). Overall, the food taste fresh and delicious as always.
author: Shazz

review_text:
Very clean shop. Food is definitely highly recommended. Tasty, crisp for the bahn mi. Prawn roll is good 👍. Love the salad too. The grilled pork sausage is damn good.
Try it and you probably would love their food too. The condiments is not too spicy too.
author: Henry Chua

review_text: Tried the grilled pork sausage vermicelli and it was nice! Just like i was on a holiday in vietnam 😁Wanted the banh mi too but it was sold out 😅
author: Bronze Foo

review_text: New stall. Food is slightly higher priced but the portion is bigger, so it makes up for it. Tasty and slightly on the salty side so maybe you can try asking for less salt. You can use CDC here. One negative point is they don't have buzzer, so you need to sit nearby and listen out for the bell.
author: Tristan L

review_text: yum! 🙃
author: Alex Lim

review_text: I love this Subway outlet that is just ten minutes' walk from where I live. I was here today to take away my usual Tuna Wrap and I received very good service from Li Peng behind the counter - she was friendly and polite. As for the dining ambience here, it is usually quiet when I am there and because I live nearby, I rarely get to enjoy its air-conditioned comfort. As for my Tuna Wrap, it is very good as always.
author: edtayjb

review_text: I visited this location with my daughter to try their famous overloaded nachos, and we had an excellent experience! We were warmly greeted by a friendly young lady (dark skin) who prepared our food quickly and efficiently. The atmosphere was great, with air conditioning that was just right—not too chilly. Overall, I highly recommend this branch for its welcoming service and delicious food. 👍🏼
author: Rachel Lee P.S

review_text:
Absolutely Disappointing Experience – Never Returning! If I could leave a -1 star, I would.

Visited this outlet around 11am on Friday, May 16, and it was hands down the worst experience I’ve ever had at a Subway.

Firstly, the service was appalling – particularly from the staff member SHERLY, who was extremely surly, curt, dismissive, and completely lacking in basic courtesy. For a brand such as Subway, I expected at least standard service and quality.

Instead, I got:

No cheese offered – unlike every other Subway where staff proactively ask if you’d like cheese.

Shockingly scant chicken – when I questioned the small portion, she snapped that it was "500gm" without weighing, and the serving spoon used was only half-filled.

Only 3 vegetables allowed – cucumber, tomato, lettuce (even though other outlets let you choose freely, I've always had "all the veggies" and never been rejected till now).

Only one dressing – again, unlike other outlets where I could combine sauces like mustard, black pepper, and onion sauce.

The sandwich wasn’t even cut properly or wrapped individually – I had to tear it apart by hand to eat the 6-inch halves.

Not only was the sandwich incomplete and poorly assembled, but the attitude of the staff made the experience even worse. For the same price, I could have gotten a far better sandwich with proper service at Hillion Subway or Bt Timah Shopping Centre Subway, where they don’t restrict veggies or sauce choices, and actually treat customers respectfully.

There’s a reason this outlet is always empty – subpar food and rude service. Never again.
author: Michelle Kam

review_text: This outlet has extremely bad customer service, one of the workers gave us attitude when taking our order which made the process extremely uncomfortable and aggravating. Having good customer service is a basic requirement of the F&B industry, and this outlet falls short in that aspect. Do not come here if you expect to be treated the bare minimum.
author: Rachael

review_text:
I had an unpleasant experience with an OLD CHINESE AUNTIE during my recent visit. While her colleagues were polite and helpful, she continuously made loud and unnecessary remarks about me from the moment I placed my order until I finished my meal. Her behavior was very rude and unprofessional.

I chose not to respond or confront her out of respect, as I understand that working long hours in F&B can be challenging—I have been in the industry myself. However, her constant mumbling and negative attitude were noticeable even to her colleagues, who seemed uncomfortable as well.

I live nearby and visit Subway Rail Mall regularly, but this incident left me very disappointed with the standards of service. I strongly suggest addressing this issue directly with her in a one-on-one discussion. Her attitude and service need improvement, and I hope she will not continue serving at the frontline until this is resolved.

I will continue patronising Subway Rail Mall, but I truly hope such an unpleasant experience does not happen again.
author: Ned

review_text: I have a been "follower" of Karu's Indian Banana Leaf Restaurant for many years - when it was in its current location along Upper Bukit Timah Road, to when it shifted "briefly" to Dunearn Road, and to when it returned to its current location again along Upper Bukit Timah Road. To me, Karu's is not just an Indian Banana Leaf restaurant (which it does very very well), but also a North Indian restaurant as well as one serving South Indian vegetarian staples such as thosai, idli and uttappam - the latter offered here from 3pm to 10pm as "Tiffin." And my wife and I were here yesterday for that and one thing more for dinner. We ordered a Rava Thosai, an Onion Uttappam, and a Chicken (leg) Masala. We always find the Thosai and the Uttappam here to be very good and generously portioned, and the Chicken Masala here to be very good too. Service here is good - prompt and friendly. The dining ambience here is nice and in air-conditioned comfort.
author: edtayjb

review_text:
Ready for an authentic Indian meal ? Come to Karu’s restaurant! Dishes and drinks were served promptly and were also delicious! The atmosphere was buzzing and it was a great experience eating a meal on a banana leaf !
We ordered crispy chicken, lamb rendang, curry  sotong and fish head curry. Food was delicious, however for fish head curry- the fish was a little fishy (perhaps not so fresh?).
Would 10/10 recommend to you to visit :))
My favourite is the teh tarik Wah not too sweet and yet so tasty I had to order twice !!
author: The Friendly Hamster

review_text:
After hearing numerous positive reviews, I decided to try this Indian restaurant for the first time during lunch. The place was quite busy, but we managed to find a table for our group of nine.

We each ordered a variety of dishes, including chicken biryani, mutton biryani, garlic naan, mutton mysore, butter chicken, and paneer curry. The food was good, with a wide range of options to choose from. However, I have had better Indian food elsewhere, which left me slightly underwhelmed.

That said, if you’re in the area, this restaurant is definitely one of the better choices for Indian cuisine.

Parking is available but limited, so it’s best to come via public transport.  The bus stop is just a stone's throw away, making it convenient for those traveling by bus.

Overall, it was a satisfying experience, and I would recommend giving it a try!
author: CS* Chia

review_text:
Always see long queue and food bloggers introduce this restaurant. 1st time here and today queue was short! Mutton biryani rice was fragrance! Chicken masala was tender too not too dry. Side dishes, rice and papadam can be replenished. Can asked for chicken or fish curry on rice.
There's 9% GST and service charge for this restaurant.
author: Hayzel Tham

review_text:
Tucked in an unassuming location, near Cashew MRT, Karu’s Indian Banana Leaf Restaurant provides a nice selection of Banana Leave Meals. It was crowded during peak lunch time.

The free flow top ups of vegetables and curries made the entire meal fulfilling and value for money.

I had the mutton meal with generous portion of mysore mutton. Try it and you will love it. I will return to try their more exotic meat meals like kudal (intestines) meals and liver briyani the next time around.

Finished the meal with my usual Bru Coffee (less sugar). It was ok. Would have liked it a bit more stronger.

Overall worth the long trip I had to do to get to this restaurant.
author: Yogeswaran Gopala Krishnan

restaurant_name: The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf - The Rail Mall Fuyong Estate
review_text:
Great Value Promo at Coffee Bean!

I tried Coffee Bean's promotional SG60 Kaya Cake and sampled their cheesecake.

The Kaya Cake is excellent value for money—you get a very generous slice for the price. The taste is quite nice and authentic. My only suggestion would be to reduce the sweetness level a little; it would be perfect then!

As for the Cheesecake, the sample was promising and tasted good at first. However, I found it disappointing on given 2 types of cheese cake.

Overall, the Kaya Cake promo is a great deal and definitely worth trying if you have a sweet tooth!
author: Zann Loo

restaurant_name: The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf - The Rail Mall Fuyong Estate
review_text: Love the site and layout. The Lychee cake is so pretty...except that it is made mainly of mousse, with very thin actual cake layers.
author: G

restaurant_name: The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf - The Rail Mall Fuyong Estate
review_text: This is one of the nicer Coffee Bean outlets around. Location is excellent right next to the car park
author: Eric Lee

restaurant_name: The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf - The Rail Mall Fuyong Estate
review_text: Whilst I live quite near to this TCBTL outlet at The Rail Mall, I have to say, it's not one of my favoured TCBTL outlet - because it's a relatively small outlet (ergo "cramp-ish") "made worse" by the high footfall into it - say, versus the outlet at Dairy Farm Mall. That said, the service here was friendly and helpful. Anyway, my wife and I were here today to try it's latest 2 breakfast sets for $11.90 - and I have had its other versions of this offering in the past. The current one is an "SG60" version comprising "Kaya Butter Toast, Coddled (actually, I believe, microwaved) Eggs, Mini Pandan Muffin, Seasonal Salad with an Americano." On the whole - FOR ME THAT IS - I found it a tad sweet with a lower than previous or usual savoury quotient that come with such a set. The egg was kinda chewy at its edges and the Kaya Butter Toast was e tad soggy at the bottom - otherwise, the Pandan Muffin and the Americano were pretty good. That said, I do appreciate that "taste is subjective" so others might like the whole thing. Will I be back at this outlet? Yes, but not as often as I would like.
author: edtayjb
