author: Mealsphotos

review_text: Came here for lunch on a Sunday with family, ordered a variety of rice, kuay, and porridge dishes. Total came up to $34. Food was decent, not bad. Located on L1 of Thomson Plaza next to Yakun.
author: Sihan Goi

review_text: I recently dined at a charming eatery with a clean and bright atmosphere. My companion and I ordered their set for two, and we were thoroughly impressed. The kway chap was delicious, and the portion size was satisfying. Despite being self-service, the ladies behind the counter efficiently prepared our food. I'm already looking forward to returning for their delightful kway chap experience.
author: Helpful Tany

review_text: Had their set B at $7.50, quite good value for money. It had braised duck, an egg, tau kua, peanuts and bean sprouts, served with a bowl of silky kway teow in a slightly herbal soup. Made for a full meal for sure. Braised duck was tender, cut into very thin slices, so don’t expect chunky slices as per their pictures. 3 types of chillies available, the garlic lime chilli is the best. Nice little private sitting area in this branch.
author: S Law

review_text:
Every Morning i bought KoKa Main is $5.30
For less Noddle, More vegetables and No Meat , More Liver . Today Charge me $1.20 more . Never informed me to pay extra charges. Terrible experience. Staff also not patient. Noddles not cook enough.
author: Zaw

review_text:
I bought Amy Yip Pau and 2 siew Mai today, 12/7/2024 at 12.44pm. To my horror, I found a broken rubber band in the pau and the meats around it was all bitter. I threw the pau immediately.

This is my first experience with this brand. I’m not sure if I dare to try it ever again.
author: Xavier Kang

review_text: The stall worker is very unhygienic. She handled money and then kneaded dough with the same hand. Very disgusting!!!
author: Kikkilala

review_text:
Staff very rude and shows a total lack of respect.

I was at the Thomson Plaza store on 31st October 2024 around 12.30pm. Only a young Chinese male staff with eyebrow embroidery was at the store.

He was talking on his mobile phone, while a female customer was waiting for him to make the noodles.

Another female customer and myself were queueing at the cashier.

After a while the female customer queued at the cashier step aside.

The staff asked me very rudely am I  "不爽" not happy with him. I was totally shocked with such remarks. As if he wants to create a fight.

I just said I never "不爽" not happy with him. All I want to order is just a Char Siew bun.

I paid and left the store hurriedly, so afraid.

Kindly look into this matter seriously.
author: Kathleen Tong

review_text: Bought twice , twice gave me terrible food poisoning i will put this to rest if theres no answer from your management
author: Jason Yap

review_text: Two of the staff are friendly and helpful. My family and I enjoyed our meal there and we will be back for the good food and customer service.
author: Angelica Chand

review_text:
Wanted something relatively light & healthy before my dinner, and decided to order the Chicken Avo Caesar Salad upon the staff’s recommendation.

Staff was friendly and accommodated my request for just a bit of Caesar Salad sauce, and a bit of the sweet onion sauce.
author: Van Chan

review_text: Am a regular patron at this outlet and would like to compliment both the food and service. The sandwiches and cookies are consistently of high quality, and the young staff members always attend to our queries with attentiveness and care. Their professionalism and hospitality make each visit a pleasant experience.
author: bu one

review_text: Not sure since when subway can't customize stuff anymore? Ordered the meatball marinara. Can't even customize the bread or choose vegetables. Was told it's standardized and I can't choose the ingredients. On another occasion, I ordered some nachos and was told the same thing.
author: Y W

review_text: My 1st time eating at this outlet. The staff serving me at lunch time (12+) are  nice and friendly. As there was no queue, they took time to chat with me also :) happy staff, happy customer 👍
author: Pat

restaurant_name: Nan Yang Dao 南洋岛 @ Thomson Plaza
review_text:
Arrived at the restuarant after 6.30pm plus on a Friday. There was no queue and we could see a couple of empty tables. We were given a 2 seater only table. As there were other available empty tables, we requested for a seating at the banquette seat type (the only closest available bigger table type we could see which could accomadate a party of 4) but the staff at the restuarant rejected. So nevermind, we thought ok, maybe they were thinking it is dinner time and so expecting bigger group parties but lo and behold within 5 minutes later, there was a party of 2 and they were assigned to that table even though there were still other empty 2 seater tables available. And the best part is that that party of 2 had only ordered 2 dishes while we that had ordered 4 dishes had to squeeze all our dishes onto the limited spacing single table. I later also noticed another party of 2 was also assigned seating at the 4 seater banquette seat table even though there were still other empty 2 seater tables; and they too had also ordered only 2 dishes. I am not sure why the double standards but it was infuriating because we knew having been at this particular outlet before that the tables are small and so if you wanted to order more dishes, the table is really small and so thats why we requested for the bigger table space when we saw the availability.

Anyway back to the food:

KL Hokkien Mee: the pork lard felt stale and instead of being crispy it was more towards chewy; this is the first time that I am having chewy pork lard especially at a dine-in setting. The KL hokkien mee also had this salty aftertaste that I did not appreciate and I felt jelak already after eating just only one-third of my way into the plate. Will not order again.

Seafood Fried Beehoon:
This tastes exactly like Singapore Fried Noodles from the Tze Cha stall somehow. Salty but still edible.

Lobak:
Not hot upon serving. Just ok ok but will not order again.

Signature Fried Chicken:
The chicken meat inside the batter is ok but the batter is the one that is tough; it is a mixture of chewy-and-crispy but not the crackling crispy type of usual fried chicken. Another way I can put it is that the batter feels like from those fried chicken that you can get from the Mamak stall and they did not refry it and so it is not exactly hot and crispy. And the whole coriander seeds that is incorporated into the batter makes it feel like there are little hard rock pieces when you chew. This dish was also not hot upon serving. Will not order again.

Overall, it was not a good experience at this outlet; at least provide bigger tables for the single tables if the outlet wishes to practice double standards…unless maybe it is also because they do not wish for patrons to order more dishes.

Addendum: I had only read the reviews of other patrons after posting my own; and if I had read the reviews prior, maybe would not have patronised this outlet for the second time. It was a while back since I first dined in at this outlet and even back then it was not a particularly good experience due to lack of table space (but back then when I patronised, the outlet was packed) and how the food tasted (did not order the same dishes as previously for obvious reasons).
author: J C

restaurant_name: Nan Yang Dao 南洋岛 @ Thomson Plaza
review_text: Curry mee was lemak and came with good amount of condiments. Seafood beehoon was seafoody and good portion. Omelette rice has rather dry omelette, fried pork is quite dry too. Chendol is a big disappointment, very mild coconut milk taste and gula melaka taste. Staff were very friendly and good service.
author: RJ Ang El

restaurant_name: Nan Yang Dao 南洋岛 @ Thomson Plaza
review_text:
The chili pan mian is good. Just wish that chili is spicy. Cause it has no spice at all now.

The kolo mee and coffee need improvement.

The lemon chicken rice is really food court standard. Nothing to shout about.
author: SG Food Legends

restaurant_name: Nan Yang Dao 南洋岛 @ Thomson Plaza
review_text: This store service attitude very sucks. No customer waiting at the queue to go into the store, we were queuing and all the staffs were just crowding there for their discussion. When we were seated, we realised nobody bother to bring the menu to us. When I approached them I asked whether can we dine in. 1 of the guy answered yes, definitely. When we was about to order thru the QR code, 1 of the aunty (2nd photo) placed the utensils container on our table with a loud bang. We decided not to eat there and we walked out. I even told the guy: since wanted to work in f&b service line, do not show attitude. We wanted to eat there and not suffered from their attitude. And I believed one of the staff is a supervisor (first photo) as she did not wear any hair net.
author: Sharon Koh

restaurant_name: Nan Yang Dao 南洋岛 @ Thomson Plaza
review_text: I had an amazing experience at this restaurant! From the moment I walked in, the staff were warm, attentive, and welcoming. The atmosphere struck the perfect balance between cozy and stylish, making it a great place for both casual meals and special occasions. Was served by Yuki and xinyi thanks you :)
author: Daniel Goh

review_text: My favourite (foodcourt) leicha stall, considering the variety of options, price point and portion size. The tea paste is not the thickest or most fragrant around, but it’s pretty decent. What I like is the fresh and generous mix of vegetables, beancurd and chickpeas (if you opt for this option). Overall it tastes flavorful and filling yet not too oily or salty. And great service everytime I come. I am a long-time regular customer :)
author: Si Lei Agnes Goh

review_text:
Thunder Rice is such a rare find these days, so I was delighted to chance upon this stall and couldn’t resist getting a takeaway for dinner.

The tea-based sauce was wonderfully fragrant and added great depth to the dish, though the portion given was far too little to fully enjoy it—perhaps just a downside of takeaway. Still, the overall flavours came together beautifully, making it a comforting and satisfying meal.
author: John Kaiser

review_text:
The chickpea thunder tea tasted interesting. The peas themselves didn’t really have much flavour but everything tasted good when mixed.
The tea was also on point, although it was grainier than it could’ve been.
author: megan

review_text:
Ordered chicken pea thunder tea for $7.90. While it is on the steeper side there is no other place i encounter that offers chicken pea in place of rice which is something i preferred to rice.

At first the cha doesn't taste as good as some better ones but with the topping dipped in it totally elevated the taste. The same goes for topping average by itself but way better with herbaceous taste of the cha.

The harmony of how each of the pairs complimented each other is what makes this great. Chili is sour but i think is not necessary.
author: Super Fragrance

review_text:
Love it! Not easy to find this these days.

Ordered delivery for 2 Thunder Tea rice (1 brown rice and another brown rice vermicelli) and one piece of Hakka tofu.

It was nicely packed with a separator for the "tea paste". For takeaways, u just need to pour hot water into the tea paste to make the soup.

I love how each item goes well together. Ingredients were lightly seasoned but when mixed together it's a punch of natural flavors and textures. Full of natural goodness!

Order brown rice if u are looking for more filling portions.

Will return for the Chickpea versions. How bout opening another outlet in the east? :)
author: Sufen Lee

review_text:
🟨 Rocky Master ( cafe)
301 Upper Thomson Rd,
# 01-38/39, Thomson Plaza,
Singapore 574408

🟨 Visited this Rocky Master cafe for the first time and am very impressed with its wide range & depth of food offerings.

🟨 Nestled at the outer wing of Thomson Plaza Mall on the ground floor ( ➡️ facing the main road), this cafe sits at a prominent strategic location next to the main entrance.

🟨  Food range = They offer pastas, burgers, soups and western style cakes & pastries. 🟨 They have 3 types of rice dishes  = ⚫️Teriyaki Chicken +⚫️ Salmon Rice + ⚫️ Beef Rendang Rice.

🟦 Food = I ordered
*********************
🟦 Lemon Meringue Tart at SGD8.20 ( takeaway)

🟦 Chicken Ham Sandwich at SGD3.80 ( ➡️ with Mayo, Egg & Green Coral Lettuce)  as Takeaway.

🟦 Iced Cafe Latte at SGD7.50 ( dine in)
___________________________________________

🟧 I had the Iced Cafe Latte customised to a single espresso shot with more milk added. The result was a creamy & well crafted cafe latte with a nutty, velvety & rich profile.

🟧 The Lemon Meringue Tart had a piquant & tangy custard filling which I love. I am into Lemon Tarts at the moment.

🟧 The Chicken Ham sandwich was tasty. It had a Japanese style semi-set egg slice with a creamy custard-like yolk centre, very delicious!
_____________________________________________

🟩 Service & ambience
*************************
🟩 I was served by the cashier staff at the counter, a lovely Malay lady called AZ -- those are the initials of her name.

🟩  Ms AZ was cheerful, affable, empathetic and kind. Thanks to her genuine omotenashi spirit of hospitality, I would go back to this cafe again to try the Beef Rendang Rice.
____________________________________________
🟩 Decor of Cafe = The decor palette hues are a soothing mix of white, black, grey, cream and brown ➖️  which offers a peaceful & calming ambience to the whole set up.

🟩 This is a cafe which I will patronise again -- thanks to awesome service staff like Ms AZ. 🟩 In today's competitive and brutal F&B scene, the service component in a cafe is of high importance.

🔹️ Oct 12th 2025 Sunday at around 8 pm.
author: Florence Leow

review_text: So far the most friendly staff I ever met. Very good service, made you feel like home. Good food, decent place. Very pleasant coffee experience! 👍😎
author: Luxury Bear

review_text: I had a quick tea break at Rocky Master at Thomson Plaza and was greeted by Milla. She provided excellent service and is friendly and professional. Milla gave great recommendations on cake selection and I tried the honey chamomile which was light and delicious. Thank you Milla for your excellent service and I truly enjoyed my tea time at Rocky Master Thomson Plaza.
author: Stephanie Teh Suan

review_text: very warm and homey vibes, I often come here for lunch and to study and the staff are always so welcoming and sweet :) the student deal is also really worth it especially for the price and portion of food. Their signature brew is really really strong and keeps me awake as I study ahaha… have grown to love this place a lot and will definitely be a regular here
author: M L

review_text: The food was immaculate, way above its price range. The team running it was well trained, well spoken, top notch goes above and beyond in their services. The space and atmospheres very calm and peaceful, huge credit to the one who runs the music playlist. Can’t believe why I’ve only discovered this cafe only now, I guess that’s how the term hidden gem came to be. Thank you ever so much Azlina & Marlini for giving us a very warm and inviting experience dinning at your cafe. God bless 🤍
author: FFYE DDANNIEL

review_text: We tried the bunsik wang pan tonight. It’s good and the portion is quite generous, enough for 3 people. The galbi-tang is always good in this place. Service was quick and friendly. The barley tea is refillable. Overall, it’s a good Korean joint.
author: Anthony K

review_text:
Together with some friends we went there for lunch recently. Each of us ordered what we wanted including two of us sharing the grilled items.
Atmosphere wise is moderate and food is pretty good. They are generous with their refillable banchan. The vegetables (refillable too) used for wrappings are crisp and fresh. The drinks we ordered are pretty good too.
Overall, we have had a great time eating, fellowship and laughing.
author: Sally Tay

review_text:
Went for the lunch special and it was very good.
6 dishes available to choose from and all for 10 bucks. I ordered ja Jang Mian and it hit the spot. Side dishes are nice and refillable.

Service was good and place was clean.

Highly recommend the lunch specials.
Other A La Cart menu I can’t say but looks expensive… 😁
author: Harry Mason

review_text:
I've eaten at Thomson Plaza many times, but this was the first time I've been here thanks to my colleague's recommendation and the lunch set is a really wonderful deal.

There are quite a few choices (most of which are $9.9++) and I had the sundubu jjigae (tofu stew) with seafood (for an additional $2++) and it was tasty with good portion. The side dishes were also decent and the outstanding one for us was the bean curd because I've eaten at many Korean restaurants but I can't remember the last time that bean curd was served.
author: Luke Lau

review_text: Super great value for lunch 9.90$ lunches which are delicious, authentic and of large portions. Wonderful selection of banchan most of them homemade. Must visit for a home cook Korean feel
author: M4l2K T4N

review_text:
Would recommended you not come here and go to other outlets. For one I’m never coming to this outlet again.

Service staff is not the most pleasant and this outlet I’d say has a lack of customer service. You have to refill the drinks on your own at the front desk. I only sang for an hour (alone) and didn’t want to spend my karaoke time going all the way out in front to refill, when I refilled (for the first time and it’s water…) on my way out the young lady said can’t refill because the session ended. Shouldn’t pay service charge in this case imo. Anyway odd. This outlet is also old and system showing signs of age. Not the best atmosphere. I feel like I was walking through a carton or makeshift industrial space. Sound system is shabby and lacks base and clarity.

Went to the Pasir Ris Mall outlet the day before, much better customer service - warm and friendly!
author: Nate

review_text:
Had an amazing time here! The place itself is great, but what really stood out was the service. JoJo and Xiao Yin were both wonderful, and JoJo especially was absolutely amazing — so hospitable, warm, and genuinely friendly. She made us feel welcome from the moment I arrived and honestly is the main reason I’ve decided this will be my regular hangout spot from now on.
Highly recommend this place, especially if you appreciate great service and good vibes!
author: Ning Ng

review_text:
Just had a family dinner here. When the food arrived, we were impressed by the food presentation.
However half way through the meal, all of us felt so cloying.
The quality of the food was good but the taste was simply too rich. Need some balancing.
Overall, it's above average meal.
author: Marie

review_text: Pretty fun karaoke place! Singing outdoors start at 830pm so it doesn’t disturb the other shops outside and the patrons having dinner. Food is affordable, chicken wings for 9.9++ and stingray rice set for 12.9++. Fun place to hang out with friends
author: Crystal

review_text: Came across this lovely bistro bar located at Thomson Plaza basement. The food was amazing! We enjoyed the selection from finger food to their main courses. Favourite dish was the curry chicken. Wine selection was also very extensive so we had no issue getting different wines to go with our meal. The ambience is lively and we received very friendly service from all the staff. There is also private rooms available for booking. Highly recommended to try out this new place!
author: ting rocks

review_text:
A healthy vegan food place! No msg and refined sugar. Pleasantly surprised with what we had that day!

Rainbow soba - a simple dish, not too bad

Pesto pasta - Highly recommend, it was aromatic and flavorful. We’ve tried pesto at other vegetarian places before but this fared much better!

Fried mushrooms - Yummy!

Maki rolls - We found this to be more average in terms of taste and value.

Beetroot hummus - A healthier version, slightly dry for our liking.

Mala stir fry (add potatoes) - Yummy! Always enjoyed vegetables in my mala, this one was good. Still had spices but milder and much less oil and salt compared to other mala places.

Overall, worth a try!! Their food definitely tastes healthier but some of their dishes are still rly good and flavorful!
author: Rennie Lee

review_text: Was very early to beat the crowd as it was 15th. Uncle usher me to sit despite it was not open. Service js good. Food is not bad. The mala was not too spicy (u can select your spice level). The fried mushroom was good. The chrysanthemum goji was healthy - no sugar added.
author: LL C.

review_text:
Friendly staff, good vibes and food that’s healthy yet packed with flavour.

We tried the Mapo Tofu, Tomyam Soup, Cold Dish (King Oyster Mushroom), Truffle Rice and Sweet & Sour Lion’s Mane Mushroom — all so satisfying without feeling heavy.😋

Love that their food are made with natural ingredients, olive oil, and Pansalt (a low-sodium salt). No MSG, just wholesome flavours!
author: Josephine

review_text: Nice vegetarian food. Tasted clean and healthy, and still have decent flavours. Female staff has good service and attitude.
author: Bosch Xie

review_text: Delicious food, very healthy, with great flavor. Definitely worth trying again next time. The service was also excellent!
author: shixin huo

restaurant_name: San Ren Xing 三人行 - Thomson Plaza
review_text: A decently good place for CNY meal and I love the Peng chai which comprises of all the goodies and cabbages. The steamed fish was fresh and the noodles soup was perfect. Hope to be back for more soon.
author: Blue Angel

restaurant_name: San Ren Xing 三人行 - Thomson Plaza
review_text: Awesome dining experience at San Ren Xing!Repeated visits to this restaurant and they never failed to disappoint! Not only were the dishes delicious, the service was impeccable! Thank you! We look forward to visit again soon! ☺️ 🙏
author: Spidey

restaurant_name: San Ren Xing 三人行 - Thomson Plaza
review_text: Celebrated my mum's birthday there and it is a good place to have a family dinner or gathering. Ordered some dishes and I love their mapo tofu and cabbage. Their portion is just nice for a family of 9 and their staff was quite attentive.
author: Ting Ting love

restaurant_name: San Ren Xing 三人行 - Thomson Plaza
review_text: Great bowl of NanPing noodle soup Thick umami soup with clams and prawns. All the dishes Asparagus with preserved meat, salted egg chicken tender and tasty, cordyceps chicken soup so tasty. Will visit again for more dishes. The Louhei atmosphere very happening during Cny festive period👍🏻
author: Ju J

restaurant_name: San Ren Xing 三人行 - Thomson Plaza
review_text:
Best lunch deal especially if you love Heng Hwa style 卤面！

The lunch deal comes with a drink, a side of vegetables and protein like chicken drum stick or pork ribs. Plus a very filling portion of noodles.

Noodles was yummy!!!! Darn good.

For $13.90 ++ this was satisfying!!!!
author: Samuel Lam

review_text:
Ordered bear spiced crispy chicken, changed fries to mash potato. For $21.46, with GRAB 30% off it cost $15.02.

Chicken: great
Mash potato: excellent
Salad: average
Amount for money: poor

Chicken was well spiced which gives it somewhat of a unique taste. Thai-ish chili provided also gave it an acidic dimension if you so desire. You can also dip it on the mash potato which i find myself doing it rather frequently. Chicken was also tender and juicy.

Mash potato was very buttery which gave it a savoury note. Smoothness wise it was good but i have tasted better so that is a room for improvement.

Salad is well uncooked and maybe also undressed? Not much to say besides typical.

Amount wise even with the discount it was not alot. Filling wise reasonable but this part is amount not value for money. Even value for money wise i would say it is just okay. And depend on which dish you order. I had a bite of the cajun chicken that she ordered, it was very average. Definitely something you can get for less than 10.
author: Super Fragrance

review_text: Rocked up on Christmas Eve and managed to find nice and quiet seating for 11.  Food was overall good but what really stood out was the service.  Friendly staff were more than accommodating to us and our kids. I would go back just for the good service frankly!
author: Vicki Loh

review_text:
Made a reservation for 18 pax with Grumpy Bear Cafe and I was not disappointed! Called in and spoke to Janice and Chih Yong on 2 separate occasions and they were both very friendly and helpful in making the booking process smooth and easy.

On the day of, I enquired through WhatsApp about promos and they were very clear about what to expect.

Came the dinner, pleasantly surprised they placed us at the corner inside, which had very cosy vibes with the fairy lights. Aaron was there managing my group and he was patient and friendly in getting the orders, helping to manage the flow of food service. Although their kitchen was small, they churned out the orders at a pretty decent pace! Plus the food was pretty great! My colleagues and I had a fun time chatting and unwinding. Would recommend this place again: comforting food, cosy vibes and friendly hardworking staff. Didn't take pictures of the food but took picture of the empty plates 🤣 A truly great find for a team dinner with colleagues who want a chill venue to chat!

This place will definitely be on my list for organising future events for 15-20, I think even 30 pax!! Thanks Aaron and the team working there on 29 Sep Monday!!! 🎉
author: Char

review_text: Had such a wonderful and lovely V-day celebration. Food was pretty good and the service was great. Staff was attentive, decoration was beautiful and the music selection was intentional for V-day! Kudos to the staff who made our V-day such a special one.
author: Dom & Choo

review_text: There was a funky smell at the back of the indoor space of the cafe (probably coming from the next door restaurants) so moved to the outside space of the cafe overlooking the lower levels. Food is pricey for standard food court chicken chop type of dishes. The service staff were courteous and professional.
author: Winter Shu

review_text: Value for money set lunch which came with coffee/tea. Brightly lit dining area good to chill out with friends. Food is decent. My meal would have been perfect if they did not mess up my drinks order. Had order kopi-o thin with sugar but it came kosong. When I went back to ask for more sugar, the lady gave me a miserable 1/3 of a teaspoon and when I said it wasn't enough, she gave another 1/3 teaspoon more. At this point, decided it was pointless. Liked the ayam merah
author: Princess Mania

review_text: Tried the ayam merah and curry chicken. Food was tasty and portions were good. The tall auntie serving was very helpful in recommending dishes and accommodating our large group.
author: Andrew Baey

review_text: Came here for lunch and tried the lontong and nasi Lemak. Both were delicious. The chicken wing was crispy and savory. Blue nasi Lemak rice used long grain. The set is quite worth it since it came with a drink as well. Surprisingly good and the restaurant is quite busy with regular crowd.
author: Keith Lim

review_text: Came here with my friends for an early dinner. Ordered Curry Chicken Baked Rice, Nasi Lemak Rendang, Mee Siam Goreng. Portions are relatively smaller, would have loved a larger portion. Most of us got the $8.80 All Day Breakfast set.
author: Muhammad Fauzan

review_text:
For
a budget cafe it is fine.  However I am bothered by the business integrity - the product differs from the photograph.  I had ordered the nasilemak - the nuts and ikan bilis came in a tiny sauce plate, whereas in the photo it looked like a huge splash of nuts and ikan bilis.

Four stars each for quality, service and atmosphere.  But two stars for not delivering what was promised (and making the disceepancy so painfully obvious).  Because good businesses must always be honest.
author: chen wee aw

review_text:
Decided to give this restaurant a shot and it ended up being a wonderful experience. Service staff were really friendly and helpful - I appreciated how they were all smiley and happy. Food comes in a big portion and guarantees a balanced meal given the side of greens. Loved the sambal quail eggs that came with the signature ayam penyet, along with the tofu and tempeh - bonus that we could specify we wanted chicken breast.

Foodrecco4u overall rating: 🙆🏻‍♀️ WILL B BACK
author: food recco 4 u

review_text:
Chanced upon Bistro Box and tried their promotional items - Mee Siam Goreng or Blue Pea Nasi Lemak for $8.80, which comes with a cup of coffee or tea.
The Nasi Lemak that I had was good, the rice has enough taste but not overpowering and it goes well with the sweet sambal. The Mee Siam Goreng has a lightly sour taste as what we usually get from Mee Siam.
Not to mention that the Teh C I had was good too, just the right balance of tea with evaporated milk.
Overall it is a good spot for a no frills meal and I will definitely be back to try their Ayam Penyet and Ayam Panggang!
author: Ben Lau

review_text:
As expected from sushiro, food is of top quality at a affordable price, on top of having a wide variety of selections through different seasons.
Highlights from this branch are how quickly the food gets delivered to your table even when it's full of patrons and the staffs were so friendly and courteous as well.
Place is also kept very clean and neat ⭐
author: Jake Yau

review_text: After eating so many rounds of this sushi eatery. Finally got to exchange for the sushi figurine. Tot the staff given me an used one. Actually it was a sample for me to choose first. Then gave me a new pack. Also first time trying out at this outlet. Tot the awaiting time taken quite some time. The turnover was quite fast & staff were friendly & helpful 😋
author: suzen

review_text: Its popular but i guess not for sole diners. I maybe biases but compare to another popular belt sushi place, i have to walk really far for refill, dont understand at their price point why cant they at least offer a hot tape for each table. They have some orignal offerings but just dont feel a wow point.
author: Wu Chunhui

review_text:
Had early dinner here. Pressed for a ticket at the entrance for your table and you could start order using the tablet on the table. You would need the ticket to make payment as well.
Regarding the food, salmons are better than tuna. Texture wise very normal nothing outstanding. The rice got separated with the meat easily and broke into half easily as they were a little dry. Food were served via the rail track linked to your table. The staff would serve you the tea when you ordered.
Total damage $70+ for two including the service and GST.
author: Henry Heng

review_text: It was a good experience at Sushiro. The food was good and satisfying. Some dishes didn’t look like the pictures but still good.
author: Pez

review_text: Forgot to take a pic before i started eating hence the funny shot but hands down one of the nicest pizzas I've eaten. I have never been a fan of pizzas because growing up I've always had the hard and tasteless crusts from P-H. The sourdough crust was so yummy! This will definitely be my Go-to pizza from NOW on 🤣👍🏻
author: DeeSee

review_text: Takeaway pizza. The 2 pizza set is quite worth it. Tried the truffle pizza which tastes good and the crust is think and charred nicely. Only 2 person manning this store.
author: Keith Lim

review_text: A takeaway only kiosk at L1 of Thomson Plaza near the travelator up from the carpark. Been wanting to try this as it is quite cheap (~$10 for a pizza) and it's sourdough crust. I ordered it and ate it about half an hour later, and it tastes decent. However, by then it was already only lukewarm and the crust has hardened. I suspect it would've tasted better if they had it in a warmer like Little Caesar (which closed down). Giving 4 stars instead of 5 because of this.
author: Sihan Goi

review_text:
Happy that it was open on CNY, but pizza was just ok, nothing bad about it but nothing memorable on flavouring despite the amazing names it has.
On service, I get it's a takeaway joint, but you can be helpful, at least acknowledge the customer there. Pizza was ready at the said time and was packed well and hot as needed, so rating ok.
author: Sujish Alexander

review_text: Tried now pizza twice - once takeaway, once delivery. Here's the reason for 4 stars: for the price, the pizza is definitely worth it for the price. (tip: after reheating, drizzle some extra virgin olive oil on top for more flavour). However, their mozzarella sticks were not good. These are frozen goods. They clearly do not deep fry them, maybe oven or air fried. While that may sound healthier, these sticks clearly NEED oil to be crisp. At least spray oil before baking or airfrying!! They were soggy and not crunchy, and even re-heating couldn't save them.
author: Yvonne Lee

review_text:
Love the complimentary miso soup and salad. I had the salmon don which was very lovely. Thick chunky pieces of salmon topped with high quality ikura.

Aki bowl has a mix of chopped fish and hotate, topped with ikura. I personally prefer the salmon.

We ordered the promotional $1 desserts as well (promo is over now)— creme brûlée, tofu cheesecake. Sesame ice cream. The creme brûlée was the best of the three!

Service is good and friendly.

Total damage SGD 73 for 2 pax.
author: M L

review_text: Food here is soliddd. Great quality at a great price point. Not surprised that the place is packed on a weekday night. The chirashi don is massive and so worth. Loved the tsukune as well. Beef tataki was rly light although I can’t say I really enjoy the yuzu beef combi but the beef slices were so tender. Oden was super good too!!! Not sure if they provide soup refills tho
author: Sarah Constance

review_text: This place is popular and hence best to come early. We were there around 6.30 pm and managed to be seated. Those coming later had to queue. The torusen salmon don was good with thick cuts of salmon. The salmon sushi platter was also good with different varieties. Service was efficient though not particularly friendly. Can improve on that front.
author: Lionel Tan

review_text:
Came here for dinner, managed to get a seat within 10 minutes. Was served complimentary side salad and miso soup immediately when sitting down, the vegetables in the salad were fresh save for one piece that felt like it was going bad already. Soup was pretty alright, with mushrooms, seaweed and tofu inside.

I ordered the salmon ikura don, added egg yolk and ikura - total cost was $29.32. Salmon was thick cubed and was a good amount for the rice given. As I'm an ikura lover of course i wish there was more ikura in the addon given to me.

My friend ordered the Kaisen salad for $9.90, and was served a generous portion of different fish slices and salad. We enjoyed it though the tuna could have been fresher.

Was pleased that the agedashi tofu portion came in nice big cubes, larger than expected for your usual japanese restaurant agedashi tofu.

The food I'm rating it a 4 star, however for the service i am rating it a 3 star. Don't get me wrong, the service was very fast, and they cleared our empty dishes very fast too. The problem is that it was too fast, we felt rushed to go off after finishing our food as the servers were hovering over us waiting to clear our table once we finished everything; since we were seated near the entrance customers queueing were also eyeing our tables, which is fine if its a food court setting, but this is a restaurant and we felt the meal was nice but we felt chased off -  Would appreciate if the restaurant could state a eating time limit so we can be aware of how long we stay.

Hope management can take this into consideration.
author: Tiffany Boogaloo

review_text:
Food was delicious, and the complimentary miso soup and salad were a nice touch!

A satisfied customer — I’ll definitely be back. Especially loved the salmon belly sashimi and the unagi rice bowl.

Long queue into car park, we were lucky to find one right way.
author: Vee 祐宁 L

review_text: Great choice for lunch, orders arrived very quickly. We ordered their lunch sets and the basil minced chicken rice set was really good. The sambal kangkong was so-so as the sambal was not the best I've had. Portion is big, great if you're hungry.
author: Amy Leong

review_text: Was pleasantly surprised to know Sanook Kitchen is open for CNY day one as we were starving and looking for a place to eat. We got the $43.80++ 2 pax set with the steamed sea bass on Auntie Carol’s recommendation which was absolutely amazing and decadent and she was so helpful and sweet to walk us thorough the menu. The hospitality and service was very efficient and top-notch, really enjoyed our lunch here and will be back for sure because we live nearby.
author: Supriya Giri

review_text: This is my family star choice whenever we crave for Thai food. We will order the steam fish set for 2 (I think 3 pax is still good for the serving) at $43.80. A fairly large fresh seabass fish absolutely delicious with tangy and garlic sauce. Stir fry Thai Kai lan and chicken dish. We are treated to pop corn while we wait for our food to come which is promptly served. Recommend to try!
author: Another Big Bite

review_text: A good Thai restaurant in Thomson Plaza. The service was quick and friendly. We liked their steamed sea bass, deep-fried chicken, stir-fried kai lan and the pad Thai. All were equally good. The sauce from the steamed sea bass was particularly tasty. The green curry was just OK. A bit too creamy. For desserts, we ordered the chendol and red ruby. Both were nice and refreshing. For drinks, we tried the iced lemon tea, iced lime juice and iced lemongrass. Only the lemon tea was nice. The rest seems to be diluted from concentrate. Will come back again to try their other dishes.
author: Anthony K

review_text: Nice meal for a small gathering. Food was good.
author: Martin Adenin

restaurant_name: Odeon Beef Noodles @ Koufu Thomson Plaza
review_text:
Went there to have my lunch and decided to buy a takeaway pork chop fried rice for my wife. Whilst I have eaten the beef noodles which is pretty decent, I was totally dismayed with the portion/size of the pork chop when I got home. The stall used to have a very nice lady preparing the beef noodles and a dark skin man doing the fried rice, alas, the crew has since changed. Though the new crew is friendly, they are not good at preparing your food. The lady preparing the beef noodles once totally messed up my orders (bought 2 packets of noodles...one without bean sprout and spring onions, one with...not too complicated i would imagined bc ive ordered the same with the previous lady crew without any problem.🤷‍♂️ I've also bought pork chop fried rice from numerous other stalls selling the item, and NEVER have I seen such a small shrunken piece of pork chop. It so happened that my son wanted pork chop fried rice from King of Fried Rice ( which i also bought the same day), was i able to take a photo to show the difference in my review here. Also, the fried rice from the Thomson Plaza Odeon Beef Noodles stall...totally no wok hey. They should bring back the dark skin gentleman. He was good. Also for the owner to review the size of their pork chop🤔...Thomson Plaza Pork chop fried rice with the puny pork chop cost $8.70 vs King of Fried Rice's $7.50. You be the judge.  Have a nice day. Bon Appetit 🥂
ps : the photo on the left is King of Fried Rice...the right photo is Odeon Beef Noodles' (yes odeon beef noodles sell fried rice...they have an extensive fried rice menu...but i won't be back. Sorry)😮‍💨
author: kevin Luke

restaurant_name: Odeon Beef Noodles @ Koufu Thomson Plaza
review_text:
🔵 Odeon Beef Noodles
@➡️ Koufu Food Court  #01-106
🟧 Thomson Plaza
301 Upper Thomson Road
Singapore 574408

🟢 This popular Odeon Beef Noodles stall is located on the 1st level of Thomson Plaza ( it’s a kiosk inside Koufu Food Court).

🔵 Visited Odeon Beef Noodles to do takeaways of 2 items:
___________________________________
🔵 Beef Ball Soup × 1 tub
🔵 Dry Beef Noodles (with only beef balls)

🔵 The Dry Beef Noodles uses Chor Bee Hoon (a thick and coarse white type of vermicelli).

Food description
******************
🟨 The thick rice noodles were drenched in a rich, dark, and flavourful beef gravy, served with a side of robust beef soup with beef balls, and a spicy & tangy chilli sauce containing fermented shrimp paste.

🟨 Overall, the taste of the noodles and beef balls were deeply satisfying. ● The flavour brought back nostalgic memories of the beef noodles I had as a child in the 1970s near the old and now-defunct Odeon Cinema.

🟣 Highly recommended. Service-wise, the lady in charge of the stall was pleasant and efficient.

🟣 The food court setting at Koufu is air-conditioned and comfortably spaced — typical of a suburban mall environment. ●The Odeon Beef Noodles kiosk stands out for its old-school charm and authentic taste that’s rare to find today.

🔷️ Overall Impression:
________________________
This is a satisfying and nostalgic bowl of traditional beef noodles that truly lives up to its heritage name. I will be back again.

🟩 Oct 4th, 2025 Sat evening.
author: Florence Leow

restaurant_name: Odeon Beef Noodles @ Koufu Thomson Plaza
review_text:
Yummy beef noodles.

I especially like the beef tendon noodles. It's a bit pricey but tasty. The beef tendons almost melt in your mouth but still has bite. I like the dry version of the noodles that comes with dark gravy, but the soup version is good too.

Also, if you pay for additional noodles, the lady gives quite a significant portion.
author: Dawn Lim

restaurant_name: Odeon Beef Noodles @ Koufu Thomson Plaza
review_text: Ordered simple beef noodles & soup was hot but very light unlike usual beef broth. However it looked like thinly sliced pork rather than beef, as the meat is not the usual dark/ reddish color but a blanched pork kind of color. It also didn't have a beef taste so I don't know what to make of it. Only remembered to take photo towards the end but can still see the meat color. A pity. Staff service not spectacular but decent. There was only 1 lady there at the stall.
author: Pearline Foo

restaurant_name: Odeon Beef Noodles @ Koufu Thomson Plaza
review_text:
Solid bowl of beef noodles, profile tends towards sweet and clear (pho like) but not as beefy. So if you're looking for a comforting bowl on a cold day, this definitely hits the spot.

I've tried the sliced beef (牛肉片) and braised beef (牛腩), both are decent. It's not actually brisket like what is served in Hong Kong, but the stronger flavours pairs well with the hor fun (河粉). Traditionalists might prefer thick bee hoon, but given this is sweeter I would recommend the hor fun to make it more pho like.

The sauerkraut (酸菜) and bean sprouts give it a nice crunch, you might even want to bring your own basil and mint to recreate pho on a budget 👍🏻
author: mj xu

author: KS Ang

review_text: The staff were nice and the sub was ok. However for an extra $4.5, you give reasonable amount of waffle fries la and what? 4 pathetic pieces and some are not even cooked through. Totally felt like a ripped off, won’t ever get the waffle fries set again.
author: Xander CY

This Sunday I discovered their tiny baby small harsh brown 😂 didn't realise it is so small. But it's a good savoury option for me since I'm currently conscious about high carbs level. Looking forward for more new healthy recipes from Subway 😊👍

author: rachit tushir

review_text:
Tried Popeyes’ Mala 88 Series and honestly, it’s a good and very tasty lineup — more savory than spicy, easy to enjoy.

I had the Mala 88 Chicken, Mala 88 Chicken Sandwich, Mala 88 Loaded Fries, Mala 88 Spaghetti, and the Strawberry Fizzy Pop. Everything was well-seasoned, fragrant, and satisfying without being overpowering. The mala flavour came through nicely and paired well with the crispy chicken and sides.

Overall, a solid series that’s comforting, flavourful, and worth trying if you enjoy mala without too much heat.
author: Victoria Ho

review_text: Pleasant experience first time eating Poppy Sausage & Egg Muffin Meal. Consisting of a sizable sausage patty, fried egg & a complete cheese slice between a toasty muffin, crisped hash brown and Tropicana orange juice. I like the sausage meat patty taste that is slight salty. Like that the dining area is clean.

Thank you!

review_text:
Stopped by Bee Chiang Hiang at 702 Ang Mo Kio Ave 8 and spotted a great promo — buy 2 boxes of Golden Floss Rolls or Crispy Chicken Rolls for the price of one! Naturally, we had to try both. 😋✨

Golden Floss Rolls – A crunchy, irresistible snack filled with savoury pork floss that you just can’t put down. Perfect for a nibble anytime!

This year, they’ve added cute horse illustrations on the packaging to celebrate the Zodiac of the Horse 🐴 — a fun touch to make these tasty treats even more gift-worthy.

author: Angus L

review_text:
Ordered their signature bcm for $5.80

Noodle: average
Soup: average
Liver: great
Fishball: average
Dumpling: good
Egg: average
Mince meat: average
Amount for money: decent

Nothing that i dislike about this but too much average part that is close to being poor. Noodle was over cooked so no bite and seasoning wasn't intense, it was only until the end that i tasted that funk.

Soup wise was a bit peppery intense which is kind of monotonous but pairing it up with noodle helps the taste of both tremendously.

Ingredient wise are mostly average, egg could be less over cooked. But the liver and meatball are actually great.

Amount of food wise it was decent for this price point. Variety of ingredients was actually very good.

Lastly, remember to take out the pork liver out of the soup asap else it will be over cooked easily. Overall, i like the ding ji noodles served here more than the other one nearby.

author: MightyFoodie

review_text:
Added more food photos from my second dinner at Mellben, three months apart. The food remains consistently top-notch.

I only recently discovered this restaurant and now I understand why it’s so popular. Every dish I ordered was absolutely worthy of a 5-star rating. The service was fast and efficient, making the experience even better.

I had the stir fried kailan with garlic, creamy butter prawns, salted pork ribs, and black pepper crab. The crab was impressively large and packed with meat. I usually brace myself for black pepper crab to be overwhelmingly spicy, but this one was perfectly balanced. It was just the right amount of heat to bring out the flavors without overpowering the dish.

loved the chilli crab’s gravy! very flavourful, but the dish is definitely pricey.

they’re prompt in refilling our hot tea beverages when asked for - quite a responsive service !

author: John

review_text:
We’ve been dining at Takagi for years but ordering takeout recently. Dining in today after their recent renovation was great! The new decor brings brighter and more energetic vibes 😊

​Shoutout to Dan, who helpfully let us know about their 10th Anniversary promotion, and we even got a free pudding with our first stamp. It’s great to see a local ramen shop reaching such a big milestone 💪
author: JY Tan

review_text:
I’ve tried quite a few ramen places around Singapore, but this one really stands out. From the moment I stepped in, the staff were super friendly and welcoming — they greeted me with genuine smiles and even helped me pick a dish based on what I usually like. The service here is honestly next level — fast, attentive, and done with that warm Singaporean hospitality you don’t always get elsewhere.

I went for their Unagi Donburi, and it was savoury with the Unagi being easy to chew into pieces. You can tell it’s been cooked with patience and care. The noodles were firm and springy, cooked just right, and the chashu pork practically melted in my mouth. I also tried their miso ramen on another visit, and it had a nice kick that wasn’t overpowering.

What really impressed me was how the staff, Dan, paid attention to the little things, being welcoming and always checking if everything was okay. All the staff really make you feel like a valued customer, not just another diner.

The atmosphere is cozy but lively, perfect for catching up with friends or grabbing a comforting bowl after work. Prices are reasonable too, especially considering the quality.

All in all, this place hits the sweet spot — great ramen, great service, and great vibes. Easily one of the best ramen experiences I’ve had in Singapore, and I’ll definitely be coming back soon!
author: Peter

review_text:
I love how supportive and how friendly the staff are! Especially we met the staff called Dan! He so cheerful, showing us our sits, making sure we are comfortable, he observed that we have bags and shifted us to a bigger table where we can put our things down and eat comfortably!

We were also celebrating B'day too! Dan came to celebrate with us and gave a pudding as a gift so sweet of him! 10/10 service hahaha thank you so much for the wonderful service 🥰💯

review_text:
Big portions of Chashu Yuzu Hiyashi Chuka, Wakame Yuzu Hiyashi Chuka. Can just mix the noodles with toppings and put wasabi and sauce or dip it as you like, cold ramen is shiok in this weather! Love the generous seaweed and the perfect ramen gooey eggs!

The icy drinks, Lemon Mint Ice Blizzard and Strawberry Snowshake will appeal to dessert lovers, on the sweeter side, but big cup as usual!
author: Cherrlyn Lim

review_text: Order Yusheng set for S$198.88 the Yisheng set was so big and so cute the veggie cutting was good and after mixed with all ingredients taste good and crispy and you can buy extra salmon to add on and sushi platter was big and nice to share for 4-9 pax good for CNY celebration
author: songchai (Food Leveling)

review_text:
The proportion of meat:vegetables to rice is super measly. So much for My Healthy Plate, already asked for less rice but it came with less meat instead. The meat covering the bowls of Lamb and Beef Sukiyaki Donburi was less than 5mm thick! To think this would cost $9.90. Just close shop, I head up to Sukiya better.

They had some good deals like the $4.90 anniversary Teriyaki Chicken bento and the $5.90 Curry Chicken. But pls pay attention to your regular priced menu too coz these are the items with higher profit margin that will sustain your business in the longer term. Pricing strategy just doesn't make sense.

Your staff are overworked churning out the high volume of promo items, wait time is at least 20 mins and you serve regular paying customers like feeding scraps to your dogs.
author: Florence Lee

review_text: Bought their teriyaki chicken bento at shopee flash sale.. There is a cabbage salad, green seaweed and potato salad w teriyaki chicken and rice. After eating everything, i feel quite full. Overall value for money
author: R Tan

review_text: Forgot to write this review. This was some time back in March. Enjoy the sushi here! Nice place for a simple meal. 😋 Easy to find seat most of the time.
author: Kai Ting

review_text:
It was a nostaglic that started to eat their sushi when they newly opening at Tiong Bahru Plaza. The very first bento to order was beef set. That time still remember didn't like their long green seaweed slices. Luckily this outlet didn't serve it. Or they had ceased it to offer.

Been to other outlets at Nex & Woodleigh mall including AMK hub before the renovation 😋
author: suzen

review_text: the worst 3-in-1 Nian Gao I’ve ever had. The amount of sweet potato and yam completely overpowered the Nian Gao, which was barely noticeable. The combination was overwhelming and unbalanced — it didn’t taste like a proper 3-in-1 Nian Gao at all. The flavour was so off-putting it made me feel nauseous. Definitely not something I’ll ever buy again.
author: Jamie Tan

review_text: The lady staff is very rude, I went in the morning to purchase, I ask her what time she open store, she did not answer but ask me what I want. So I thought she is taking my order, when I order, she suddenly said in a loud and rude tone “only one person,  how to prepare for me.” Excuse me, if u at not ready can just let me know, don’t have to speak this way, no customer service at all.
author: Caron Tang

review_text: Had an awesome experience at Yummi Bites AMK Hub for some takeaway banana fritters! The auntie manning the shop was so accommodating and jolly. Couldn't wait to reach home so as soon as I grabbed the items, I tried them right away. Absolutely nice and would surely come back again :)
author: Ed Robinson Lacson Reyes

review_text: Tried their goreng pisang to find it ordinary. Banana used is not very sweet, not ripe enough, and texture is kind of 'sandy'. Crust is crispy and overall, I don't enjoy it. Not sure about other items.
author: Clifford Yeo

review_text: Bought tapioca kueh and goreng pisang, both nice! :D
author: jiahui lim

review_text:
Bought from Hougang Mall outlet. Dumpling is not bad.

But service staff is terrible. Threw the dumplings around and handled it roughly. Was extremely rude to an old lady who was just asking questions.

Tell your grandparents to be careful of this lady.
author: Linus

review_text: Was not expecting to find such a refined rice dumpling at a kiosk. Tried the Cantonese rice dumpling —really excellent balance of flavours and rice cooked just right. Generous with the mung beans, salted egg and pork.
author: LW He

review_text:
22 June 2023
I bought 3 hokkien with salted egg dumplings and 3 sweet bean dumplings for my family.

All of the dumplings were improved versions respectively.
Fresh ingredients that retained the traditional styles, lean pork and lessened msg. The sweet bean contained lesser sugar than before.

The display of rice and ingredients remained highest quality and sustained quantity which was good value for money.

Flavours and tastes as old. New improved versions produced healthier choices.

The selections of quality rice. The firm and sturdy wrapped of dumplings keep everything intact when unwrapped for dinning.

The customer service had been prompted and great.

We were touched and thankful for the kind thoughts in new improved versions. We will buy again from your AMK Hub outlet.
author: Julie Goh

review_text: Bought a nonya rice dumpling on a whim when I was at AMK hub and just had it for breakfast. It was delish!! A little on the pricey side ($4) but so good. Note they only accept cash - I didn't have enough cash or I would've gotten the traditional hokkien style dumpling too. Will definitely buy more when I'm in the area.
author: Lydia K

review_text:
Dumplings involved a lot of work. My grandma makes them. From individual seasoning & prep, cooking each dish, to putting them together to form each dumpling and finally boiling them in salt water. Trust me.. the money we paid for each ba zhang is worth it.

Daun Pandan rice dumplings are very reasonably priced!

Love their Kee dumplings, white Nonya dumpling and black dumpling with salty egg yolk, braised mushroom & water chestnut. My Favourites!

Friendly Aunties serving us. Always a joy to see them :)) Will visit soon for sure!
author: CHLOE LOW

review_text: renovated fish & co came with a good upgrade! The food is actually quite good! Soup was nice, squid was super tender and fish and chips were good as usual. I didn’t like the fried swordfish as much as it was FRIED TO HELL HAHAHH
author: The Eating Shrimp

review_text: Great food, the Halibut Fish and Chips was delicious, and the soup of the day was also tasty. Service was only a little slow, but understandable since there were a lot of people. My meal came to a total of about $40, but there are cheaper options, so no need to worry much about prices.
author: TayTay Mockingjay

review_text: This is ultimate surprising, but I have always walked past this restaurant, but never tried it. He said he took me there when I was very young, but I forgot. Anyways, I actually really like the Peri Peri chicken! And we got a free calamari because it is daddy’s birthday month!
author: Eric Lee

review_text:
Ordered the Combo for 2paxs - Grill peri-peri chicken & lemon butter white fish coupled with sides of prawns, paella rice, fries & seasonal veg. The mains tasted good, prawns were delicious.
Overall a good meal in a nice quiet ambience.
author: Carny Wong

review_text:
I seldom go fish and co. Experience really no good. I don't even want to give a star for them, but because if you don't put a star, you cannot give your review here.

Firstly, at 2pm 4 dec AMK branch, there wasn't any crowd. My son and I walked into the restaurant. The only Chinese waitress that was on duty at this hour gave us a seat at the middle which is facing the entrance. I requested for a window seat which she acceded with my request reluctantly. Secondly, when I ordered only a meal, she said to me sarcastically: "that's all? No sharing of meal."

I won't be here ever again and the food is not really fantastic. There is plenty of seats at this hour and why she chose to give us a seat in the middle that people walk in and out. No sharing of food? What kind of policy is that? What if we are small eater? What if my son cannot finish the food? Does it means that they rather feed the rubbish bin than human?  How to promote a green Singapore with this kind of food wasting attitude? I just cannot understand the rational of this policy. I buy the food, IS MY RIGHT TO EAT AS I WISH!!!!!!!!

I enclosed the photo of the rude Chinese crew which is clad in blue that I mentioned as she didn’t wear a name tag.
author: AF Chang

review_text: Tasted like soon kueh, looked like har gao, priced like bbt. My only gripe is the size vs price ratio. The ingredient costs isn’t expensive (turnip, dried shrimp etc) but you’re paying for the workmanship. They accept cdc if that makes things better? They don’t provide chili/dark sauce as their recommendation is that it tastes better without them. Tbh I beg to differ bc I love chili.
author: Fion Lee

review_text:
Wonderfully made with thin skin, a yummy filling and perfectly steamed. I recommend the original one! I beg to differ with the other reviewers: a true soon kueh does not need sauces, it should stand on its own. While the kueh is not cheap, it reflects that each kueh is handmade and done well with generous fillings.

I highly recommend this place!
author: Andrea Lim

review_text: One Kueh at a Time is finally back after 2 years and they’re currently at Ang Mo Kio! You don’t get your usual dark sauce & chilli with their soon kueh as they believe that their versions are flavourful enough without additional flavours 😌😇 Handmade soon kueh here has chewy skin with fresh ingredients within! I like their original and ku chai best~
author: Melmeleats

review_text: Went at lunch on 29 Oct 2025. Not worth the price. The Soon Kueh taste was alright. The chive dumpling (koo chye kueh) was rather "meh". Chives were over-cooked and mushy. Prefer "93 Soon Kueh" (outlets around the island; one at Cheng San Market and Bendeemer Market). We were also not given any chili or sweet sauce packets. Thought that would be an automatic given.
author: Sarah Lee

review_text:
They had run out by 445 pm when we arrived but did have frozen classic ones.

Do note these do not come with any black sauce or chilli.  There are some interesting flavours like beetroot.
author: steven lim

review_text: Satay Bee Hoon isn't a common hawker staple like chicken rice, and I personally feel that its quality is defined entirely by the sauce. This stall passes the test with a flavorful, well-balanced sauce rich in peanut taste without being overbearing. The accompanying ingredients (pork, cuttlefish, kang kong) are standard fare. Though conveniently located in the center of AMK, this hawker can get warm and stuffy. Do patronise this stall to satisfy your Satay Bee Hoon craving.
author: Damien Wong

review_text:
The ingredients are all blanched quite nicely, the sauce is balanced. A little sweet and savoury. The peanut flavour could be more pronounced and the sauce given could be more.
Overall, good benchmark of satay beehoon.
author: Kai Xuan Goh

review_text: There’s a “FBI好吃” sign which maybe outdated. Besides the small serving. It’s too sweet and hard to enjoy esp if you had the one at East Coast Beach before. The service was strangely rude and he insisted on adding cockles even though I told him no cockles. No queue during peak hour lunch.
author: Dom Wee

review_text:
I had the medium size $5.50 portion.

Quite full of seafood like cockles, cuttlefish, pork slices, kangkong.
The bee hoon also soaked up the satay gray well so each mouthful you can taste the nutty gravy. Nice!

Friendly auntie taking orders and serving the dish with a smile, will come eat here again :)
author: Hoong Wai Wong

review_text:
Order M size - $5.50
Ingredients reasonable but bee hoon look like kid meal portion.

Horrible amount of bee hoon. Cannot imagine for small $4.50.

M - Only 1 prawn !!!!!!

Ask the service lady confirmed is medium size.
author: Zpop88G

review_text: Ordered 2 large Hawaiian and cheese pizzas for pick up around 3.30pm. Store was empty without any orders and these champions can still get my order wrong. Gave me some weird pizza with onions and mushrooms instead of Hawaiian. I did not like the pizza as I hate onions and mushrooms. What if some one was allergic to something? Contacted them and all they offered was a free regular (I ordered large mind you) pizza to claim within 30 days. Might as well don’t give, insincere and ridiculous!
author: Andy Quek

review_text: Please hired a professional pizza maker. Ordered large but doesn’t look large. Both pizza dry. Cheese stick out of shapes?  And no seasons of cheese on top of it?
author: Sri Nur Qurain

review_text:
I think basically every time I've ordered something has been wrong

Once they took 3 hours to deliver
Once they got the pizzas wrong
Next time it took 90 mins
Then they forgot one of the sides
This time it's been 90 mins already as of writing this. The standard is just godawful

I mean like pizza is literally fast food and I live a 5 minute drive away, idk man. Watch as they reply to this review with "please contact us via our website" and proceed to give a voucher for a free pizza (which still requires a min spend lmao)

Update: it arrived absolutely cold, and they messed up the order
author: Reynard Yeo

review_text:
6th of April 2025
-------------------
They gave me some free pizza due to my last complain.

So why not order some more from them..

Lighting really strike twice.

Ordered
2 large pizza
Hand tossed crust

1 large pizza
New York crust

Regular pizza
Hand tossed

In the end they delivered
3 large new York crust instead and i give them a round of applause that they managed to get the regular correct.

Pizza was cold as usual, suggest buying from ntuc and making it yourself... at least it's hot.

Delivery gave me the thin crust
