review_text:
Went here for lunch on a weekend. Surprisingly no crowd at all. Normally if there's no crowd at a restaurant, it could be possibly either too expensive or maybe taste issue.

Despite few bad reviews,I decided to give it a try and judge for myself. Different people have different taste bud and opinion right.

Well I will break it down to two points, that is the taste wise and service.

We ordered quite a few dishes though its only two pax. First its the:

TASTE:
1) Green Curry Chicken
Taste Verdict: 6/10
Taste a bit bland, chicken portion not much and lack of spices

2) Tom Yam Chicken Soup
Taste Verdict: 5/10
Ordered the red tom yam, a bit watery and too full of mushroom instead of chicken. Pathetic portion too just like the Green Curry Chicken.

3) Spicy Papaya Salad
Taste Verdict: 8/10
Its not easy to get papaya salad, so we decided to gave it a try. To our surprise, the taste is nice and acceptable to our taste bud. The only downside is that the portion is little which does not match the price.

4) Stir Fried Kangkung
Taste Verdict: 8/10
We reqeusted without Belacan or even Oyster Sauce due to some reason. So just normal stie fry but it lacks the amount of garlic. But overall the kangkung is nice as it does not overcook.

5) Deep Fried Chicken Wing
Taste Verdict: 8/10
Well its just a normal fried chicken wing, nothing fancy. Overall the frying method is acceptable as the chicken wing does not have the taste of undercook or overcook.

SERVICE:
As for the service wise all is quite good especially the cashier, whom said thank you to us after payment. The only thing that I would advise, hope the staff could ve more attentive to those customers seated at the last end corner near the mall entrance side because we have to keep on a look out when wanting to call out the staff to take away the balance unfinish food.

Overall to dine again, I might consider. Else I think there are better Thai food available elsewhere.

review_text: Fantastic BBQ and Steamboat. My friends and I had an amazing dining experience at this BBQ and Steamboat restaurant! The concept of combining BBQ and steamboat in one place was genius. The food was incredibly fresh, and the variety of ingredients for both BBQ and steamboat were impressive. The cozy atmosphere and attentive service made our evening even more enjoyable. It's a five-star recommendation from me!
author: Aaron Tee

review_text: delicious
author: Lily Harith

review_text:
I read so many bad reviews, I dont know what is the fuss about.

We had the cakes, and it was decent. We enjoyed the flavour. Good presentation, friendly staff and honestly good pricing.

I think you get what you pay for especially in this area of Sunway. Overall not bad, can't be worst then their opposite restaurant. Horrible Thai food.
author: Suzannah Ibrahim

review_text: Peaceful breakfast here with nice ambience. Lots of improvement especially on the drinks (hot chocolate & strawberry matcha  👍 Keep it up
author: Mahadir Mohamed Salleh

review_text: I’d like to share my experience from my recent visit. The nasi lemak served to us had burnt anchovies and peanuts, and the fried chicken was extremely tough and tasteless. We also ordered drinks (ice lemon tea and hazelnut tea), but both were bland and disappointing. Overall, the quality of the food really spoiled our dining experience. I hope the restaurant can look into this and improve the food preparation and taste.the chef need to go for training to polish up they're skill. As I'm a chef too I know how the standard  is thank you
author: Syed Abdullah

review_text: The food sucks big time. The nasi was not fully cooked so I felt like I was eating plastic pellets. The strawberry lavender tea was awful like drinking iced diluted jam. The milk I requested was BY THE SIDE so even without adding it it tasted awful. I did not bother to add the milk in at all even though I was provided with some condensed milk by the side so the ORIGINAL TASTE of the drink WITHOUT addition or MODIFICATION WAS ALREADY AWFUL. SO I DID NOT TAMPER WITH THE DRINK AS ACCUSED BY THE OWNER. NOW I am FULLY disgusted. At first I thought the staff was lovely but nah I realized they dont really care about customer service, any other cafe I go to when I barely touched my food the staff would check and see what's wrong but these ones just want to shift the blame to the customer immediately. The chicken still had blood on it, maybe during frozen they just immediately deep fry without defrosting so the insides are still not cooked. The sambal was awful as well. So much sambal I’ve had in Johor they’re so awesome you actually look forward to the sambal but this one is so salty and tasteless. Based on the response from the owner, I believe soon this review section will be flooded by plenty of paid reviews giving it fake 5 stars to drown out my honest review, I only wrote what I tasted, and they cant accept any feedback for improvement. Too bad.
author: Belle Lee

review_text:
Special thanks for the wonderful service and the staff who helped retrieve my camera which I accidentally left between the dishes. The food is great and 1Malaysia lychee drink is my favorite.

I see they cater to both large groups, birthday parties and solo diners equally attentively, which is a very high standard of customer service.
author: Sana Lakshmi

review_text: I like burger king yea the food is really good,im not sure about the service but hey im chill with it they must just be tired or something not my buisness to worry, great place to go when youre hungry and uhh also good for doing your work I guess if u dont mind abut of grease haha
author: Yu Hao Ong

review_text:
Burger King at Sunway Big Box is a convenient stop for a quick and satisfying meal. The restaurant is spacious, clean, and air-conditioned, making it comfortable for both dine-in and takeaways. Staff are friendly and efficient, ensuring orders are served promptly even during peak hours.

The menu has all the classic BK favourites, from flame-grilled Whoppers to crispy fries, and everything is freshly prepared. Its location within Big Box makes it easy to reach after shopping or while on the go, and there’s plenty of seating for families, groups, or solo diners. A reliable choice for fast food in the area.

#BurgerKing #SunwayBigBox #FastFoodMalaysia #BurgerLovers #JBFoodie #FamilyDining #QuickBites
author: Brian Wong

review_text:
Extremely slow service at this restaurant.
Only 1 counter was open and there was no self service kiosk.
Waited easily 8 mins to get served despite there being no customers around.

Workers were handling the food without proper gloves.
author: Justin Tan

review_text: I must compliment their staff,sometimes she alone taking order and preparing the food, all serve quite fast. All food prepared well and delicious.
author: fiq sofy

review_text: The RM9.90 set is a great deal but the taste of the burger was real bad, another à la cart burger even worst!
author: Venn Soh

restaurant_name: The Chicken Rice Shop Sunway Big Box Retail Park
review_text:
I would like to share some feedback regarding my recent visit to Chicken Rice Shop outlet in Sunway Big Box. My wife placed her order and waited for approximately 20 minutes before receiving her food. During this time, my wife noticed that other customers who ordered later than she did were served earlier.

We completely understand that delays can happen in a busy restaurant. However, what made the experience difficult was the lack of communication. My wife tried to get the attention of a waitress to ask about her order, but unfortunately she did not receive any response or explanation. A simple update or reassurance would have made the wait much easier.  She felt completely ignored.

I would also like to note that my wife has a gastrointestinal condition that makes it important for her to eat on time. Delays without communication can cause her discomfort and health concerns, which is why this matter is particularly important to us.
We value CRS and enjoy their food, which is why we are sharing this feedback. We hope this can be taken as an opportunity to improve staff attentiveness and communication with customers, so that everyone feels acknowledged and respected even during busy times.

--Scott
author: Scott

restaurant_name: The Chicken Rice Shop Sunway Big Box Retail Park
review_text:
A huge improvement is required.

Service - service and staffs were slow and inattentive.

Food - Roast Chicken was still okay, but the steam chicken was a not good at all. Rice was a little hard as well. Bean sprout was so so. Feels like the cook/chef is not in the mood to prepare the food.

Atmosphere - there are flies in the restaurant in A MALL. something must be wrong somewhere. You need to find its source.

Strategically located to do well but unfortunately mismanagement is destroying it.
author: James Tan

restaurant_name: The Chicken Rice Shop Sunway Big Box Retail Park
review_text:
Food is good but too many houseflies. Please maintain basic hygiene and pest control. One random
Photo has 6 flies in the picture. The whole eating session was chasing flies away.
author: Benjamin Alexander Chua

restaurant_name: The Chicken Rice Shop Sunway Big Box Retail Park
review_text: I recently had an early lunch at this restaurant, and I must say, the food was exceptional! Generous portions perfect for sharing, and the freshness of the vegetables added a delightful touch. However, the billing service needs improvement; fortunately, I double-checked our bill before leaving, as it was incorrect. Despite this hiccup, the overall experience was positive, and I look forward to returning for the delicious cuisine.
author: Nadzirah Mustafa

restaurant_name: The Chicken Rice Shop Sunway Big Box Retail Park
review_text:
The food is ok but not consistent in portion so sometime u came the portion is big..sometime u come the portion is small.

Hygiene is out of the window. Too many flies n it is disgusting n disturbing. What amazed me is the other restaurant like Absolute Thai faced no fly problem at all.

I wonder if TCRS management will take action on this cz many review said the same n no action has been taken.
author: zhuhainie zull kafli

restaurant_name: Ayam Penyet Best @ Sunway Big Box
review_text: Taste is average and sambal is average. Don't expect the taste like Indonesia ayam penyet. The toufu doesn't taste like what i usually eat, so weird. Hope will improve in the future.
author: May PML

restaurant_name: Ayam Penyet Best @ Sunway Big Box
review_text:
The restaurant offers a variety of menu choices. I had the lele penyet while my friends tried the ayam penyet and ayam gepuk. One thing I didn’t quite get was why the penyet set didn’t come with rice?? We had to add RM2.50 for each rice 😭 Most places usually include rice with their penyet dishes.

The taste was okay for me, but their sambal penyet was quite good! The portion size was just nice, not too big or too small.
author: Liy

restaurant_name: Ayam Penyet Best @ Sunway Big Box
review_text: Me and my friends had a great time here although the food is average, I am still quite satisfied with it and I actually like the sambal. The staff are friendly and helpful. Definitely gonna come again to try other dishes.
author: jojojojojo ja

restaurant_name: Ayam Penyet Best @ Sunway Big Box
review_text: A bit pricey cause for RM 14.50 ayam penyet set is not included with the rice . The sambal is okay but so little. Like the put on top of the cabbage so it's not that much.. maybe around 1 tbsp like that.
author: Adlia Husna

restaurant_name: Ayam Penyet Best @ Sunway Big Box
review_text: Ayam Penyet Best offer a Indonesian style fried chicken. This restaurant has a casual setting with fast service suitable for lunch or dinner. The main menu is Ayam Penyet comes with fried chicken, rice, sambal and tofu. However, the portion size is smaller and need to add extra rice or sides.Prices are reasonable and the environment is clean and everything is okay.
author: Ijan Mn

restaurant_name: Kenny Rogers ROASTERS Sunway Big Box Village
review_text:
Hi Kenny Rogers Sunway big box. Is your workers getting worst salary or I'm eating their salary? They severed me the chicken rice on my table like I'm eating thiers salary. Soup too much salty, chicken too thick, doesn't taste like Kenney Rogers taste. The food not even warm but very chill. I have ate Kenny Rogers at many places, even done my sister's birthday party in Klang Kenny Rogers, but not this worst.

Even there no many menu choice I decided to have dinner in Kenny Rogers. Easily the worst dinner choice I’ve made in a while.
Even they not provide the cutlery until I go and ask for it. We paying plenty tax for the good service. Hope for a better changes soon.
author: Monisha Rajadurai

restaurant_name: Kenny Rogers ROASTERS Sunway Big Box Village
review_text:
Should have trusted the reviews.

Not sure if this is consistent with all Kenny Rogers, or is it just this outlet.

Chicken portion small, sides too.

Their famed muffin shrunk and tasted strange now.

restaurant_name: Kenny Rogers ROASTERS Sunway Big Box Village

restaurant_name: Kenny Rogers ROASTERS Sunway Big Box Village
review_text:
I decided to go with the grilled chicken, but it turned out to be a big mistake. Although the restaurant was quiet, we still gave it a try. I ordered the original 1/4 chicken with two sides and a muffin.

Unfortunately, the muffin was dry on the outside and soggy on the inside, definitely underbaked. The chicken was cold and so dry it was difficult to even cut through. The potato salad was the only redeeming item, simple but decent, just potatoes with mayo and some herbs. The mac and cheese was a disappointment too. The pasta was hard, and the cheese sauce was thin and watery.

Easily the worst dinner choice I’ve made in a while.
author: TTT

restaurant_name: Kenny Rogers ROASTERS Sunway Big Box Village
review_text: Menu itself limited, a lot of food sold out. Preparation time, if u can wait, then will be no issue. The food itself is quite normal, nothing fancy.

Service crews are very attentive and friendly. Located just beside Caltex Petrol Station next to Sunway Big Box.

review_text: Nice cafe with a nice quaint environment, perched on a small "hillock". Coffee is nice and so is the tuna bread. The tuna sandwich is actually more than shown... By the time I took the photos, I have eaten half of it... ☺️

review_text: Finally we found a place for pet friendly Cafe.Overall food is nice and price is cheap.The important thing is the environment is very good and suitable for our pets 🐱🐶 and kids.

author: Hiew Lee Hui

review_text: A great tranquil place to chill after work. Friendly staff who welcomed people with a big smile. The food was okay but still would come here again.

review_text: Food taste is nothing to shout about. The satay which is accompanying seller is much tastier than the main cafe. But environment surrounding quite nice. Got lots of edible plants surrounding the cafe

review_text:
Friendly customer service.

Near Legoland.

Tasty food. I love the Sambal Paru.

Breakfast in the garden, enjoyed the nature view.

Reasonable price!
author: Raja Adrena R Aris

review_text: First time trying out this place. Happy to find a warung that serves nice delicious local food as food choices are quite limited at Puteri Harbour area. If you're coming for breakfast do come early as some food already ran out when we arrive at 10+am. It's aesthetically pleasing too as warung is located amidst the greenery in the park. Highly recommended and we will definitely return!
author: Sofina M Y

review_text:
A great experience, love the green surroundings. A simple self service menu written on the chalkboard. For those who want nasi lemak, you just move around the counter and choose from the trays. Or place your order to the staff, in my case i ordered the lontong kuah. The staff informed me that there was no eggs, that's fine with me. Then it's off to the drinks counter which is also the cashier. They also sell kuih, currypuff etc.

The lontong kuah was pretty diluted but the taste was good. Ingredients were generous. I was lucky not too encounter any flies, read so many reviews about flies but was happy not to see them.

Overall a nice simple place for breakfast as part of my morning walk routine. Will be back to try other dishes.
author: Esther Molina

review_text: Great spot for breakfast with plenty of food choices. Best to come early since it’s in an office area. Food is tasty, prices are reasonable and the garden view with a live band makes it even nicer. Just a bit hot at times.
author: Hasymah

review_text:
I had a wonderful dining experience here! The food was absolutely delicious — every dish was fresh, flavorful and beautifully presented. You can really taste the quality of the ingredients and the care put into preparation.

The service was just as impressive. The staff were warm, attentive and made us feel genuinely welcome from the moment we walked in. They were quick to respond without being intrusive, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable.

Overall, great food, great service and a lovely atmosphere. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a satisfying meal! 🍽️✨
author: Hema Rama

review_text:
The food portion is big. The vegetarian food options were very yummy. The combo briyani had a generous amount of chicken, lamb and prawn. Everything was good.
Good service from our waiter Surrender. He was very patient explaining menu to us and suggesting food as well.
author: Sweetha Anand

review_text:
I recently dined at Olive Bar in Puteri Harbour, and I have to say, it was an amazing experience. I ordered the chicken briyani, and it was absolutely immaculate. The rice was perfectly cooked—fluffy, fragrant, and full of rich spices. The chicken was tender, juicy, and packed with flavour in every bite.
The portion size was generous, and everything tasted fresh and well-prepared. The ambience was also great, with a relaxing atmosphere that made the dining experience even better.
Definitely a place I’d recommend if you’re around Puteri Harbour and craving a solid, flavourful briyani. I’ll definitely be coming back!
author: Agilesh Ahnand

review_text: Abdul Karim did a great job serving food today. He was polite, attentive, and served everything on time. The service was smooth and professional, and he made sure everyone was comfortable. Well done 👍
author: Yuvanesh Saravanan (Yuva)

review_text: We had Chicken briyani … one of the best briyani i ever tried. Pepper chicken really awesome and the portion was big enough .
author: Janani Jemimah

review_text: My first visit to Heritage Whisky. What a service from Shan! Just came for beer, ended up with a great bottle of whisky. Thank you Shan for the recommendation. Have I mentioned the view by the sea is breathtaking and enjoyed the evening breeze.
author: ELNIE S. MASHARI

review_text:
Loved their customer service and how attentive they were. Prem even got the staffs to come in earlier as we wanted to come over at 3pm(their opening time).

The first image captures a generous platter that brings together a harmonious mix of land and sea delights. The succulent grilled lamb and chicken appear perfectly charred, offering a robust smoky flavor that contrasts beautifully with the freshness of the accompanying salad. The seafood elements—juicy prawns and cuttlefish—are likely to add a briny sweetness, balancing the rich meats. The fries and sauce on the side complete the dish, providing both texture and a flavorful dip to elevate each bite.

The second image highlights a fresh Japanese oyster, which is evidently a standout feature of the meal. This oyster is a masterpiece on its own, nestled in its shell. The touch of whiskey adds an unexpected layer of depth, infusing the oyster with a subtle warmth and complexity that complements its natural brininess. The whiskey enhances the oyster’s sweetness while adding a sophisticated kick, making it an indulgence that seafood lovers would truly appreciate. This combination of fresh ingredients and innovative flavoring techniques reflects a high level of culinary expertise and attention to detail.
author: Rube A

review_text:
Staffs are super friendly.

The steak is indeed very thick, but this has probably made the Center of it not well cooked.

Orange juice was told ‘Fresh’ but I really doubt so. It tasted exactly like the one I’m buying regularly (not from concentrate, no added sugar)
author: Jun Han

review_text:
Location and atmosphere here is a win. Sit at the open and enjoy the sea breeze blowing across the straights of Johor. You may also glance the boats or little ferries cruising in and out of the canal close to this property.
A vast Whiskey collections here are worth a try.
author: Sivapragash Periannan

review_text: This place seems to have a lot of potential. It is very attractive, at a beautiful location over the water, but there were many shortcomings unfortunately. Firstly, I tried to call them multiple times during their advertised opening hours for enquiries. Not a single time did anyone pick up. The call was either forwarded or no answer. They have a very impressive list of whiskies from all over the world... or claim to. But they were "out of stock" for at least 10 different types of whiskies that we tried to order that night. The wait staff also don't seem to know anything about the drinks and kept having to ask us to wait while they went back and forth, in and out asking the bartender everything. It was just so frustrating. And the staff kept recommending us the really, really expensive options as alternatives - you gotta be kidding me. The food was pretty ok and arrived in decent time. But also we were the only table the entire night, not sure how they may fare if they were busier. Some of the staff seemed to struggle with English too. The reason I am still giving 3 stars is because the location is so good, and it is a very lovely place to relax in the evenings by the water. So will I come back again? Probably yes. But I sincerely hope improvements can be made.
author: Kimberley Howarth

review_text:
What's great?
Food is yummy. Beef short ribs (ordered twice!), butter chicken pizza (lots of cheese), even simple vege pasta is nice!
Live band is great, singer and guitarist! Can play pool game, well maintained table and cue.

What's to improve?
Nothing yet

Visit again?
Yes!
author: K M

review_text: Beautiful ambience with lake view. Reasonable price and delicious food.
author: Vig Nesh

review_text: Best service, environment and tasty food. People who enjoy live band and chill with dinner I highly recommended this restaurant. ✨🌹 Thank you Mr Shohag for recommending all the dishes. ☺️
author: Jh Hui

review_text: I like the atmosphere. The live band is one of the added point. Lamb curry pizza is quite special and tasty. Foods all are nice. The only thing to be improve is variety of beer like Guinness Stout. Customer service is good, they can help to order kid’s meal from next bar. Definitely will go again.
author: Franny GOH

review_text: Tried the chicken tacos here, and they were absolutely delicious! 🌮🔥The place has a great environment, especially at night—perfect for chilling and enjoying good food. The chef was super friendly, making the experience even better. Highly recommended! 👍 The customer service was excellent, very welcoming and attentive. Will definitely come back again! 😍👏
author: keerthana raveendran

review_text:
Had a great teppanyaki experience here. The beef was super delicious and juicy, cooked perfectly. The seafood was fresh and generous in size, especially the prawns and scallops.

The assorted mushrooms were a highlight—definitely something mushroom lovers will enjoy it. The garlic fried rice was normal, nothing too special but still fine.

The chef was friendly. The Pricing is reasonable for the quality and portion sizes.

We requested counter bar seats, our clothes smelled quite strongly from the cooking after the meal, so you might want to keep tat in mind.
author: Juan

review_text: Absolutely delicious! Kyoo has never disappointed me. The food is consistently fresh, flavourful, and beautifully prepared. I’ve been a loyal customer for a long time and keep coming back because the quality and taste are always top notch. Highly recommended for Japanese food lovers!
author: Syatirah Rusli

review_text:
Memorable dinning experience for my son as he celebrate his birthday in here

we choose to sit right front of the grill station, the chef is very attentive and acknowledged his birthday with some firery cooking show , thumbs up. You make my boy a very happy boy that night.

Food 5/5
Food wise are 5 star and the beef is perfect in cook. Not to mention hiw the chef handled the salmon and the skin are crispy.

Staff 5/5
We thank them for their attentive to kids too and prepared the birthday son according too.

Environment 4/5
Ambient are good with excellent kitchen hood and ventilation wont get too smokey when the food are cook ar open public.But do expect some oily face after the meal if you choose sit eight front of the cooking grill station.

Overall this restaurant are hidden gem in puteri harbor. Weekdays may have more quite but also privacy for someone wish to dine with peace.
author: Patrick

review_text: Everything was amazing! the place has a calm, authentic Japanese vibe and the food was top notchh. i ordered the mixed beef grill, salmon belly, tofu steak, mixed seafood, and garlic fried rice. every dish was packed with flavor and cooked perfectlyy. The salmon was super fresh and the mixed grill beef just melted in my mouth. staff were friendly and really attentive, which made the whole experience even better. Prices are reasonable, totally worth it for the quality and atmosphere. Definitely one of the best Japanese spots around!
author: yasir ayman

review_text:
Went there for a dinner over the weekend. The place is cosy and nice with limited eateries around the area. Food was pretty fast even though there was a crowd in the restaurant.

Garlic fried rice is nice. I can eat that without any dish. The vegetables tasted a bit salty for our liking but the rest are good. Would be back again but next time maybe order a bit lesser because portion is slightly bigger than usual. Eat until very full.
author: Schnitzer Ang

review_text:
"Sometimes you want to go, Where everybody knows your name, and they're always glad you came... You wanna be where everybody knows Your name".

This place feels like Cheers, but with more food and activities 😄 - most patrons are regulars and we understood why after our evening here.

We were doing a staycay in the area and was looking for somewhere to celebrate the man's birthday. He ultimately chose this place cause he really wanted a drink with his meal and the vibes felt right!

We ended up staying for hours.. food was fab, staff was awesome and the drinks menu was sufficient to keep us happy.. give the man ice cold craft beers and he is happy. We didn't have a cake but they sorted that out for us, with a birthday song and everything 😁.

It's one of those places where you just feel welcomed - if you feel low, you will probably walk away feeling good, if you wanna chat, someone would probably chat with you, and it is kudos to the team behind the place.. big thanks to Chris, Abby, Niel and Suga (I hope I got everyone's names right!) for a happy night.

It was a really nice touch to see them in tshirts with the faces of their regulars incorporated in the illustrations 😊.
We'll be back for quiz night 😉
author: PH Ong

review_text:
“Best burgers I’ve ever had” words of a teenager boy who’s usual vocabulary is “good” and “ok”.
The staff and other customers make it feel like coming back home, atmosphere is amazingly friendly and you get to meet lots of people you can have nice conversations with!
author: Sergelen Ika Sukh

review_text: Visited with my husband yesterday evening and had the most authentic fish and chips since I was at university in the UK! Not just foriegners lots of locals enjoying the Vibe too, will be coming back any time I’m awal from KL
author: Sugashini 13

review_text: Had a chicken kyiv here, haven't had one since I last went to the UK and let me tell you, it was divine! I urge more locals to try this authentic British food
author: Neil Navin

review_text:
(Edit): I came with my husband and a friend to try the new "Britz 2.0". I ordered a French Dip burger, and he ordered a Black and Blue burger with parmesan fries. Unfortunately I could not get a hold of the menu afterwards to double check the ingredients but the French Dip was really not what it's supposed to be... with a pricetag of RM69, I think it is really not worth it. It was served in a hotdog bun, there was not much cheese and beef filling inside, but a lot of jalapeno pickles and mustard. The flavour balance was completely off. Also it's supposed to come with bone marrow gravy, which our waitress forgot at first. But later when she brought it, it was not bone marrow gravy, but some instant premixed gravy. There were still globs of undissolved powder in it. So this is very dissappointing indeed. Husband's burger was fine, but for some reason the fries had a bright green food colouring on it. Waitress insisted it was garlic, and told us that the garlic turns green when it is left out too long. So she had essentially admitted to serving us garlic that is not fresh...? Oh our friend's burger was also late and she told us because the kitchen burned it and had to make another one. Gosh. Only reason why I am not marking this a one-star review is because the staff here are all very friendly and nice, and genuinely pleasant. The place is a nice place to hang out. I really hope the kitchen can get their act together, and improve on the food quality.
----------

Came here for dinner. It is a very  pleasant place to dine outside. The staff were very charming and friendly. They were out of stock for some items as they mentioned they were in the process of a management change. I ordered the pork schnitzel with mushroom sauce. The pork ribs that my friend ordered was absolutely enormous. Everything is fine, just the pork schnitzel was actually very dry, and they only provided a small amount of sauce.
author: Kimberley Howarth

review_text: Had a great experience at Smokd, Puteri Harbour. The staff member, Sayed, was incredibly helpful and went above and beyond to assist us. Even though there weren’t many vegetarian options, he kindly accommodated our request, which we truly appreciated. While the location is not the accessible, the food was absolutely tasty and delicious. Definitely worth the visit!
author: Nur Iman

review_text: Smokd never failed us. The lamb rack was tender, flavourful, and cooked perfectly, making it very satisfying. The Caesar salad was fresh and well-balanced, complementing the dish well. The restaurant also had a pleasant ambiance, with friendly and fast service that made the dining experience even more enjoyable. Tks for yet another awesome experience.
author: Md Hairi Md

review_text: Kick ass bbq meats. Had the beef ribs which were incredibly tender and delicious. We demolished the tacos (chicken and beef brisket) which were tasty and well seasoned. Ordered their trio of sides comprised of the coleslaw, mashed potatoes and potato bun - the bun was the only let down of the entire meal. Service was prompt and friendly. The restaurant is situated right in front of the cove; I’d imagine the view in the daytime would be quite something (we went at night).

review_text:
Hard Rock Cafe Puteri Harbour is an absolute must-visit destination that perfectly captures the essence of rock ‘n’ roll while offering a delightful dining experience. As soon as you step inside, you’re greeted by a vibrant and energetic atmosphere, adorned with iconic memorabilia that pays homage to legendary musicians. The ambiance is electric, making it a perfect spot for music lovers and food enthusiasts alike.

The menu boasts a tantalizing variety of dishes, and the burgers are truly a standout. The juicy patties are cooked to perfection and served with a delectable array of toppings that elevate the flavor profile. I also enjoyed their signature cocktails, which are as creative as they are refreshing.

The service was exceptional; the staff was friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable about the menu, enhancing our overall experience. Whether you’re looking to grab a quick bite or enjoy a leisurely meal, Hard Rock Cafe Puteri Harbour caters to all.

In addition to the great food, the live music adds a unique charm, making it a fantastic spot to unwind. Overall, Hard Rock Cafe Puteri Harbour is a vibrant hub that offers a memorable dining experience, and I highly recommend dropping by if you’re in the area!

review_text:
Nizar Saberi Makes the Difference
A True Hospitality Gem at Fraser Hotel

I initially visited teh Swatches Restaurant at Fraser Hotel out of curiosity, not expecting much more than the standard experience of a 5-star hotel eatery. But that first visit, about two months ago, changed everything, and the reason is crystal clear: Nizar Saberi.

From the moment we met, it was evident that Nizar is no ordinary manager. His presence radiates professionalism, calm confidence, and sincere warmth. He isn’t just good at his job, he elevates the entire space around him. Nizar has that rare ability to transform what might otherwise be a bland or predictable setting into a place that feels alive, welcoming, and genuinely cared for.

Thanks to him, I’ve returned multiple times since that first visit, for regular meals and for buffets, because I know the experience will be consistently positive. His attention to detail, unwavering kindness, and ability to make guests feel seen and appreciated is simply unmatched.

Nizar brings the essence of true hospitality, he listens, he anticipates, and he ensures everything runs smoothly while making it all feel natural and effortless. His leadership clearly inspires the entire team and sets a tone of excellence that doesn’t go unnoticed.

If you're dining at Swatches, you’re in good hands. And if Nizar is on duty (he always is...), you’ll immediately feel the difference. He’s the reason I now associate Fraser Place with more than just comfort, it’s become a place I genuinely enjoy returning to.

Bravo and thank you, Nizar. You are the heartbeat of this place!

restaurant_name: The Naughty Chef I Best Coffee, Pizzas & Pastas in Johor
review_text:
\\A Singaporean Girl Review 🇸🇬

A hidden gem 💎 in Puteri Harbour

We visited The Naughty Chef recently and left genuinely satisfied, not just because of the food, but because the whole experience felt thoughtfully put together without trying too hard.

Let’s start with the pizza, because that’s clearly one of their strong suits. The dough immediately stood out — well-aerated, lightly charred, and chewy in the way good pizza should be. It had structure but didn’t feel heavy, which is something not every place gets right. You can tell the dough is given time and respect. Topping-wise, the balance was spot on. The prosciutto wasn’t overwhelming, the arugula added freshness, and the cheese didn’t drown everything else out. Every bite tasted intentional rather than excessive, which I really appreciated with the generous curs of prosciutto.

What I liked most about the pizza was that it didn’t rely on gimmicks. No unnecessary drizzle, no over-stacking of ingredients. Just solid execution. It’s the kind of pizza you finish and think, “Yes, this is exactly what I wanted,” rather than feeling overly stuffed or distracted by too many flavours competing at once.

The drinks were another pleasant surprise. We ordered their iced Homemade Lemon Tea, and they were refreshing without being overly sweet. That’s a small thing, but it matters. The balance between flavour and drinkability was well thought out, and they paired nicely with the food instead of overpowering it.

The space itself is casual and unpretentious in Fresh Supermart. It’s not trying to be overly polished, but it’s clean, comfortable, and functional. You can tell the focus is on the food rather than creating an “Instagram-first” environment, which I personally prefer. Service was friendly and efficient — not intrusive, but attentive enough that we never felt forgotten.

What makes The Naughty Chef worth returning to, in my opinion, is location. Being in a mart, you can get any wine you like to pair with their starters, or even nuts to enjoy (without corkage hehe). The portions were satisfying without being wasteful. It’s the kind of place you could come back to with different people — friends, family, even for a casual date — and know it would work.

This isn’t a place chasing trends. It feels grounded, like it knows what it wants to do and does it well. In a food scene where many places try to do too much, that’s refreshing.

Overall, The Naughty Chef delivers honest, well-executed food in a relaxed setting. If you’re looking for good pizza, comforting flavours, and a place that feels easy to enjoy without overthinking it, this is definitely worth checking out. I’d happily come back with friends!! ❤️

Also looking forward to their desserts menu coming soon!
author: Michelle Tan

author: Vaansi M

review_text: This is a new Korean-Chinese restaurant in the Almas shopping district. It stands out from the many Chinese restaurants in Johor Bahru by offering clean, delicious Korean-style cuisine. I've visited with friends about four times. We've tried a variety of dishes and meals, including creamy shrimp with large shrimp, yangjangpi (spicy beef skin), yuringi (spicy beef brisket), jjamjjamyeon (half-and-half jajangmyeon and jjambbong), and even the cilantro-loving cucumber salad, which I absolutely loved. The clean interior and hygienic Korean-Chinese cuisine were a delight to the palate. I'd love to visit again to try other dishes.
author: Chloe Kim

review_text:
I visited for a late lunch with my family. Perhaps because it recently opened, the interior was clean and the staff greeted us warmly. The tables were well-organized, and once we were seated, tea was served. It had the aroma and flavor of a high-end Chinese restaurant. We ordered the kids' favorites, jajangmyeon (noodles with black bean sauce), jjambbong (spicy seafood noodle soup), and the national dish, tangsuyuk (sweet and sour pork). I was curious about the cucumber salad, so I tried it. The jajang was just right—not too sweet or bland—and the seafood in the jjambbong was fresh. The cucumber salad was as refreshing as I expected, but if you like spicy food, try the chili padi included in the dish. The tangsuyuk was fried just right and crispy. On the way out, my kids said they wanted to visit again. I wish you a long and prosperous future! 🙏

We visited for a late lunch with our family. Since it recently opened, the interior was clean and neat, and the staff greeted us warmly. The table was well-prepared, and once we were seated, they served us tea that had the aroma and taste you'd expect from a high-end Chinese restaurant.

We ordered jajangmyeon and jjamppong, which the kids love, along with the classic sweet and sour pork, and we also tried the cucumber salad out of curiosity. The jajangmyeon was well balanced — not too sweet and not bland — and the seafood in the jjamppong was very fresh. The cucumber salad had the refreshing flavor we expected, and if you enjoy spicy food, I recommend eating it together with the chili padi included in the dish. The sweet and sour pork was nicely fried and crispy.

On our way out, the kids said they want to come back again. Wishing you continued success and prosperity 🙏

Thank you to the chef for such a memorable experience. I highly recommend this place.

review_text: Enjoyed this Japanese restaurant. The quality of the ingredients stood out, especially the sashimi which was fresh and clean-tasting. A solid choice for Japanese food lovers!
author: Jacelyn Fong

Id come back again given the opportunity 😆.
