author: Bhushan Shet

review_text:
This food court is located inside Singapore’s Night Safari, making it a convenient dining spot for visitors who feel hungry after the night tour. That said, the prices here are definitely higher than outside.

For example, while 10 sticks of chicken satay typically cost around $7.80 at regular food courts, here you’ll pay $9.80 for just 6 sticks. A bowl of duck noodles that would usually go for $4–6 outside is priced at $16.80 here — though to be fair, the portion of duck might be slightly more generous.

Most visitors to the Night Safari likely began their day early, having first explored the Bird Paradise, the main Singapore Zoo, and the Giant Panda Forest before ending up here. After a full day of walking, it’s understandable to crave a hot, comforting dinner — especially since any packed food would probably be cold by now.

Fortunately, the food served here is still authentic local cuisine. Although the prices are steep, the quality hasn’t been compromised. Plus, you get a chance to sit down and rest. After your meal, you can return to the Night Safari and take another ride on the tram.

Given how late it gets by this point in the day, it’s likely that restaurants in the city would already be closed. After all, this is a tourist attraction — so a lower value-for-money ratio is pretty much expected.
author: LongEr

review_text:
Attended the Lunch in the Wild program hosted by Audrey. She was warm and welcoming and helped us take many photos. The environment was nice and it was great to be seated right beside where the birds perched, especially during feeding time!

Food could be improved. We were looking forward to the laksa, but it was sweet rather than salty or spicy. It’s probably more catered to foreign tastebuds 😅 The sambal was also sweet and had no spice to it. The duck could also be improved, as it had a strong duck flavour to it.

We were very, very full from the meal! Even before our mains hit the table, we were already filled up. There were lots of enjoyable theatrics too.

It was a good experience if you’re willing to splurge. Would recommend the experience.

review_text: Amazing promotion package for lunch in the wild! Unbelievable value. Wonderful experience with birds. Food is really decent, and you have to try their coffee! review_text: We joined the Lunch in the Wild. Started with an experience with birds. We had the chance to feed some birds and hug juvenile flamingoes. Four course lunch was awesome. Our host Kumar and Audrey were very friendly and their service was excellent. On the whole a very nice experience with very nice view of birds during lunch.
author: ACLS

review_text:
We had the most interesting experience for the “lunch in the wild “and the staffs’ service is impeccable! Thank you very much Kumar for the reminder in advance  so that we don’t miss the upclose experience with the parrots. Definitely the best birthday experience for us in a long while! Just look at the food. Its awesome! So filling and it tastes so good! Most tender lambshank ever. Salad sauce was interesting too.

Thank you to all the staff at bird paradise and Crimson restaurant!!

review_text:
We came here as part of the Lunch in the Wild package. Had an absolutely lovely time!

Special thank you to Amirul for the impeccable and memorable service!

We were seated at a reserved section and enjoyed spectacular views of the macaws perched just outside our glass window.

Food was decent. Lamb shank was great value for money. Laksa is NOT recommended (gravy too sweet, vermicelli overcooked and too soft).

I loved the salad dressing that came with the smoked duck salad - surprising fruity "syrup" mixed with very elegant balsamic vinegar. I later found out that it was lychee syrup(?). Nicely mixed. Smoked duck selected was also good - not the typical overly smoky type.
author: Priscilla Phileon Chua

review_text:
We had lunch at the Penguin Cove Restaurant and the whole experience was amazing!

We ordered:

Everything was really tasty — but I have to highlight the Chocolate Crunch Cake… SO amazing! 🤩
The atmosphere is fantastic, enjoying our meal while watching the adorable penguins swim around 🐧💕
A super fun and delicious dining experience — we loved it and will definitely come back again!
author: Jiaxin Wan

review_text: Had lunch here on a school holiday weekend. It was easy to get seats. Although the prices are higher due to the attraction location, we got lucky with some penguins swim-bys. The lamian and herbal mee sua were average, but the amazing atmosphere and friendly service more than compensated. It's an experience, not just a meal!
author: The Daily Drive Log

review_text: Amazing atmosphere. Food is Disney tier, surprisingly. Absolutely get one of the Arlo sets, it's a steal at the price with dessert and potato salad. And when the penguin swim, it's amazing.

review_text:
Came to bird paradise cos of a company family day. If it wasn't for the meal voucher that was given to participants, I wouldn't have stepped into the restaurant.
A few points for improvement:
1. Inefficient queue system - 1 queue for the food and 1 for the table. And they refuse to take your food order if you don't have a table. But the system is like IKEA where you collect your food when they buzz you.
2. Ridiculously overpriced kid's meal. We ordered the "mini cheese burger" expecting it to have at least some cheese and like a small beef patty. But it was just a small nugget wedged between some leaves and the world's smallest burger buns. Pls see photos attached.

I seriously think even IKEA can do a better job than the kitchen here. Pretty sad if you ask me.
The restaurant could have elevated itself by taking more pride in the food since thee was some effort in the presentation.
author: Liyan Lim

review_text:
A very interesting dining concept — eating while watching penguins swimming right beside you.
We celebrated a birthday today and the team made it extra special with a surprise song and a complimentary cake.
Staff member Firdaus was especially thoughtful and professional. He even checked on our food preferences to ensure there were no allergies. Really made our day.
author: Moo Shan

review_text:
I had an amazing dining experience at Copper Chimney Mandai in Singapore. The food was absolutely delicious, with rich and authentic Indian flavors that truly reminded me of home. There are multiple vegetarian options available, which makes this place a great choice for Indian tourists and vegetarian travelers who sometimes struggle to find good food options.
The service was quick and well-managed, and the staff was very polite, friendly, and attentive. They guided us properly through the menu and ensured everything was served fresh and on time. The overall dining atmosphere was clean and comfortable.
Another highlight is their excellent packaging service. You can easily get food packed and take it back to your hotel, which is very convenient since vegetarian food options are limited in many areas. Really appreciate the staff for their hospitality, professionalism, and quality service. Highly recommended for authentic Indian food lovers.
Portion sizes were satisfying and reasonably priced for the quality offered. The presentation of dishes was appealing and the aroma itself made the experience more enjoyable. Location is convenient for visitors exploring nearby attractions, making it a perfect stop for a relaxed meal. Overall, the consistency in taste, cleanliness, and courteous behavior of the team makes it truly special.
author: Officially Tintin

review_text: Fantastic food and service. Some of the best pani puri and daal I’ve ever had. Staff were so sweet as well. Will come back again.
author: Amy F

review_text: Our first visit. Love their food and nice, quiet environmemt. Price is reasonable. A place to frequent.
author: Terrick W.

review_text:
I recently visited Copper Chimney Express, Mandai (Bird Paradise) and it was such a relief! After struggling for the last 3–4 days to find good vegetarian food in Singapore, this place truly felt like a blessing. They have really good vegetarian options, and the taste was absolutely delicious—authentic, flavorful, and very satisfying.

If you’re a vegetarian visiting Singapore and craving proper Indian food, I would definitely recommend this place whenever you go to Mandai. Great taste and a comforting experience overall! 🌿✨
author: Rimjhim Gupta

review_text:
Food is towards the milder side, which is good in a way as it caters to people who are more sensitive. Spices wise and good and can feel that they are not your normal roadside cuisine.

I did not enjoy the naan, but did enjoy the others (palak paneer, butter chicken, and briyani). The briyani is a must order. The yogurt was not the usual sour and was slightly on the milder side, which to me is a good point. Even my kids enjoyed the yogurt.

Service wise was okay also. Staff were pretty friendly. Gave 4 stars instead of 5 as there was no introduction on the food / their specialties. There was also no ordering service, instead they used a qr code ordering system. For the service charge, I did expect at least some form of additional value add.

Water wise they charged 2 dollars for a jug, which I feel was okay, but would be better if they didn't charge for tap water.

review_text: A great classic fast food restaurant providing affordable food options in Mandai wildlife reserve where the other options tend to be pricier. Lots of seating available. The key highlight is no doubt the root beer float served in frosted glass. The fried chicken is served hot and crispy and worth the wait. The curly fries 🍟 and hot dog come across as quite ordinary.
author: Keng Cheong Tan

review_text: Frequent diner at A&W Mandai Wildlife West since it's opening. I love dining in nature and the atmosphere here is very nice and peaceful. Food is always delicious, piping hot burgers and crispy fries. Ice cold root beer float. The staffs here are very well trained and polite. When you are dining in the restaurant, you will get to see the beautiful surroundings. Beautiful place!
author: Desmond Lim

review_text:
Just randomly pop in as I stayed nearby. A great place to have dinner here if you prefer out of neighborhood and into nature dining.

I’ve been attended by Jun Yao (Part Time Staff), thou he was just a P/T but his service definitely exceeded expectations!

Jun Yao:
Helpfulness: 10/10
Service: 10/10
Politeness: 10/10
Hardworking: 10/10
Multi-Tasking Skills: 10/10

Nurdini (Service Crew)
Service: 10/10
Politeness: 10/10
Hardworking: 10/10
Multi-Tasking Skills: 10/10

Overall:
Thou this evening were packed with families as it’s a Sept school holiday.
Their standard didn’t fall short despite they were very short-handed at the front counter, kitchen & at dining floor. Chicken were great of standard size and served hot! Root beer float were awesome too. Curly fries were hot and crispy too.

Jun Yao & Nurdini did very well in such a short-handed situation. Applauded them for your great service 🙌🙌. Hope you both rest well tonight then🥰🥰
author: Serence Playford

review_text: Spacious seating for big groups. All your classic favourites available, root beer and coney dog. Digital order and halal
author: Jon Wan

review_text: The employees are dreaming, busy staring at his phone and chit chat among themselves. Beeper not working. Customers are ignored. When I asked for close to half an hour and asked if my order is captured, I saw my order was ready in the shelves, but the staff never informed, called, nor the bepper beep to inform me that the food had been ready.
author: Mely Goenadi

review_text: Had lunch  after visiting the Rainforest Wild and Bird Paradise. It was a calm and quiet place to take a break after walking around the attractions. The place was clean and peaceful not many people even during lunch time. I had the vegetarian hor fun and a cup of kopi-si. The food was simple with a fair portion. It’s a self-service setup where you place and collect your own order. A nice spot to rest, catch up with friends or even get some work done. However there no discount for Wildlife members.
author: Anson Chew

review_text:
Weekday morning is empty. No crowd. Peaceful.

Abit disappointed as it is only morning but they say only left 1 croissant. Makes me wonder if the croissant is from the day before..... but taste is ok, but filling is quite little.

Butter kaya toast filling is also very little. Very thin.

Overall, its a good place to sit and relax in morning.
author: Lina Lim

review_text:
Had a lovely breakfast with family before heading to Bird Paradise today. The food was delicious, although we did have to wait a bit longer than expected for our dishes to arrive, especially the Seafood Baked Rice.

Despite the wait, the overall experience was great and the food was well worth it!
author: Low Bao Heng

review_text: Awesome food and service! The seafood horfun had great wok hei. The food is fresh and delicious. The environment was also tranquil and calming. What sets it apart is the service! Aunty was so sweet: my honey lemon was almost finished and she came over to ask if I needed to top up hot water. She also did that for other ladies for hot tea. Such amazing service for a Han’s! Good job!
author: Lee C

review_text:
Very nice food! Local flavours at restaurant standard.

Queue to order and pay at cashier. Collect drinks first and wait for receipt number to be flashed on screen to collect food. Two auntie staff were very helpful and fast.

Place was clean and nice, with an enchanting view of a beautiful stream garden. Aircon could be a bit stronger during lunch peak.
author: Lenon Tan

restaurant_name: Birds of Paradise Gelato Boutique - Mandai Wildlife WEST
review_text: I am glad my favourite gelato hang out opened at Mandai. It is so convenient to go and after a visit to the zoo my family and I can enjoy a scoop or two gelatos. Gelato with waffle cone is the best. This was also my first time trying their waffle. It was so delicious because the waffle was soft with generous amount of gelato. It looked pretty too.
author: Norain Noordin

restaurant_name: Birds of Paradise Gelato Boutique - Mandai Wildlife WEST
review_text:
Had such a lovely treat at Birds of Paradise in Mandai Wildlife Reserve! 🌿✨ The gelato was super smooth and not overly sweet — perfect after a long walk around the park. The botanical flavours are unique and refreshing, especially in Singapore’s hot weather.

The waffle cone was crispy and fragrant, pairing so well with the gelato. Service was friendly and efficient even though it was quite crowded. Definitely a nice cooling stop for both kids and adults.
author: Lance

restaurant_name: Birds of Paradise Gelato Boutique - Mandai Wildlife WEST
review_text:
Staff don't seem very friendly.
Ice cream flavours are ok.
We ordered Lychee Raspberry, Strawberry Basil, Pandan Coconut Caramel, Dark Chocolate Sorbet.
The latter two are stronger flavours, the former two are lighter and more refreshing.
Unfortunately there is no complimentary water in this shop unlike other ice cream shops.
The decor is quite fun with a van vehicle outside and inside, which is the shopfront.
The tables at the side are curvey making it look quite unique and fun and vibrant.
author: Kelvin Goh

restaurant_name: Birds of Paradise Gelato Boutique - Mandai Wildlife WEST
review_text: Waffles were amazingly crispy, gelato as nice as all other outlets, service was really prompt (Auntie Ah Zhen was really helpful and smiley, thank you!). Ambiance for this outlet is great with nice seats, will definitely be back for more ice cream and affogato
author: chewy kwok

restaurant_name: Birds of Paradise Gelato Boutique - Mandai Wildlife WEST
review_text: I love to eat at here. The place is cozy and quite comfortable. The service is also good. They got various choices and a lot of unique flavour. From what I know, they used botanical ingredients for the gelato. Hope to come again and try another their top seller flavour 😊
author: Nur Hanini

review_text: Visited this Collin’s outlet twice and really enjoyed their Mandai Exclusive Menu. The charred Brussels sprouts with mashed potato were tasty and comforting. Portions are just nice and the price feels reasonable. Service was decent both times. Will definitely be back to try more dishes on the menu. The chill environment makes it a nice spot for a relaxed meal away from the crowd.
author: iamjess

review_text:
Had a quick lunch here in between visiting Bird Paradise and Mandai Rainforest.

I got the seafood aglio olio which was decently tasty! Oh we also got string fries which were nice too!
author: Liau Yuan Wei

review_text:
Very Disappointed with this Collin’s Branch – Poor Service & Food Quality

Visited this outlet with high expectations, especially given its location in a popular tourist area. Unfortunately, the experience was extremely disappointing.

The customer service was appalling. Staff were unfriendly, impatient, and clearly not service-oriented. One male server with a tattoo on his left hand was particularly rude, responding in an unprofessional tone and showing no effort to be welcoming. Most of the team lacked basic hospitality standards — no smiles, no eye contact, and an overall unwillingness to assist.

The food quality was also below standard. We were served burnt meat (see attached photo), which was unacceptable.

Despite the restaurant being nearly empty around 3:30pm (off-peak hour), we (3pax) were forced to sit in a tight corner with a baby chair squeezed to the side.  According to the server, the table that we pointed pointed to him is for table of 6 in a very unfriendly tone, Meanwhile, staff were on break at the bar counter, watching videos on their phones with the volume turned up, further diminishing the dining atmosphere.

For a brand like Collin’s, especially in a tourist-frequented area, this is unacceptable. I sincerely hope the management looks into this and takes appropriate action to improve both service standards and food quality.
author: Kelly Yu

review_text: Nice food with cozy ambience. Located in the Mandai Wildlife West where the Bird Paradise is located. Food was served pretty fast with good enough portion. Tried the Seafood Medley which is a sharing item and was really tasty. The Jap Sashimi Oyster was really good too. Overall a wonderful experience.
author: Fred C.

review_text:
Came to only eat salad while waiting for my aunt to do her “QingMing” visit.  This was the nearest restaurant I found. Ambience is nice and quiet, on Sunday morning.

Tips for the restaurant, to have kids meal for free when purchase 2 main course, like this more parents will dine in. Give drawings to kids, use cute cutlery.  It’s a waste that a Sunday when so many parents bringing kids to Bird park yet this restaurant isn’t doing as good as its neighbor beside.

Giving out cute balloons to all kids can also bring positive attention to parents.

Hope this restaurant can stay long here. See my photos for more detailed information. If you looking for job, I have post it here too.

Do give a thumbs up if my message benefits you.  I don’t earn anything here, it’s purely for my own and friends to read up. Cheers!
author: Joanne PeaceMind

review_text: Came here for dinner date and it was honestly a very good choice! Food was good esp the pulled pork taco and peri peri chicken. Garden mushrooms were delicious too.we ordered the meat platter, quite a lot for Two. We were so full then. The service was impeccable. Great thanks to the staffs and the manager on duty as well who was so accommodating. Thank you!!   Atmosphere was good. So 5 stars! Would recommend this place :) it’s good and affordable.
author: yvonne chua

review_text:
Overall service and ambience were good. Dining inside a cave made the experience quite special.

The spring chicken was tender and paired nicely with the chili. The mushroom soup was yummy, while the mushroom pasta was just okay , the noodles tasted a bit like pan mee.

The kids loved the kids’ meal. The oolong cheesecake was quite special as well.
author: C T

review_text:
Went there for valentine's dinner. Most of the food were nice and flavourful except for the toothfish. It was great but was overwhelmed with green peas which was not to my personal liking.

There was also a live duet in the background that added an extra vibe in the evening.

Service was great. Staff were very responsive and attentive to our needs. The atmosphere and ambience was very unique and nice. They even organised a photo taking with instant printout and a stalk of rose for every table which made the night special.
author: ZZ

review_text: Celebrated our 30th Wedding Anniversary here. Hunters Plate was delightful with tender beef. Chicken was nicely cooked with aromatic spices. Ribs were succulent. Servers were tip top and even presented us with a complementary tiramisu cake.
author: Peter Rock Steady Crew

review_text: Brought my fiancé to celebrate his birthday here. Love the quiet and comfortable ambience. The food was really really good! The staff here are all really nice too! Food is served fast. They even prepared a little cake with LED light as a surprise! Thank you, i'll definitely come back.
author: Ashling Magdelyn

review_text: Amazing food by Vishnu. Chicken rice and the pad Thai were great, especially the fried chicken. Presentation was great too. Got to sit and eat beside the python habitat as well, very unique experience! You can also order with your phone through the app which was very convenient!
author: Nicholas Lim

review_text:
A breather in the park! Dont worry to get hungry in the park, there are food stops.
Delicious food, nice ambience, clean space, good service in the middle of the forest! We ordered green curry chicken n nasi lemak.
author: Maricar Puyo

review_text: Find very cozy as this place have lots of tables and Chairs so no need to wait for so long.After a long walk and feel hungry,we decided to order something.Food worth the price.quantity will satisfied you and make you full Already. Need to order to Counter and give us buzzer to collect on every stall. Thanks to Geraldine for assisting us also as we feel lost where to pick up our food and drinks.Also this place is air conditioned so you can feel cooling while enjoying the food.
author: Edna Banesio

review_text: Idris was very friendly and cheerful. He checked on our food and created a really enjoyable atmosphere during breakfast. The food was honestly one of the best breakfasts I’ve ever had at Singapore Zoo.
author: Aidil Azhar

review_text: Good place to cool off at midday at the Rainforest Wildlife Asia. Air con is good. U can see Python as well as a black bird ( don't know the name) in the comfort of aircon. There is also a playground so that the child can play and parent can rest.
author: Fion sgp

review_text:
We came on Friday around 6pm and it was very crowded. We kinda wait for 30minutes for a table for 6. We ordered for 2 portions of salad, 1 portion of chicken tender, 3 portions of pasta, and 2 different pizzas.
After we wait for about 10min, our salad came but only 1 portion of it. So we kinda ask the server to reconfirm our order list and turned out the waiter got our order wrong. She just input 1 portion of each menu we ordered so we need to re-order we a different server.
In the end we got all our foods correctly but it did make the waiting time longer. Though we enjoyed all the food, and the portions very good too, maybe they can improve the service so that there wont be any mistake in the future.
Summary, the foods excellent, a little bit pricey but because the portion is kinda big so it’s still a good value for money.
author: alexandra meidiana

review_text:
My wife made a reservation for our wedding anniversary lunch today for the two of us.
The place was very cozy.
Music,  slightly a bit loud as I can't really hear what my wife was saying at times... haha..
Food was fast but fresh and tasty. As usual,  Bee Sting didn't let us down.
House bread and the cultured butter is tasty too.

After the main, we actually thought of ordering dessert though we didn't finished our main.
To our surprise, the staffs there told us they are serving waffle with ice cream as a complimentary to celebrate our Anniversary.  That's very sweet of them.

Overall,  it was a very memorable and great experience at this restaurant. We throughly enjoy the food, ambience and the service attitude of the staffs.

Thank you guys for making our day a memorable one with you guys!!! 🫰
author: Jeff Sim

review_text: We had a great experience at Roberta’s today. Ordered pizzas which were delivered pretty quickly. For us, the workers’ friendliness made everything better. We sat by the kitchen and were able to talk to chef Jalil (not sure if I spell the name) and watched him multitask with ease. As we were curious about what he was cooking it was like our own cooking show. Bee sting pizza and normcrg pizza were delicious. But waffle was amazing. Ground staff was also really nice. So we recommend this place
author: Asli Card

review_text: Selected Roberta's Pizza for celebrating my girl's birthday dinner and it was the absolute right choice. They allowed me to put my balloons at the restaurant, and cake in their fridge in advance since we will be visiting the zoo prior to dinner. The ambience was very relaxing (aircon was abit too cold tho), but food came promptly, the food was very good and yummy, and most importantly, the service was excellent - Thanks to Jamie and Yong - they were very attentive and responsive to our orders and prompt to meet any needs (as we had 4 kids with us) - E.g. adjourning to outdoor tables cut cake due, happy to help us take photos, cleared tables promptly. Later on, even after dinner, they allowed us to keep our left over cake with them since we were headed for Night Safari...they also gave the kids sweets/treats.. So many positive things to say! It was an awesome experience and we will definitely go back again!
author: Melissa Cheok

review_text:
A solid pizza establishment serving Brooklyn-style pizza, which is my preferred pizza with a toasty crust and sufficient structural integrity to hold up one-handed.

We tried their signature Famous Original and Bee Sting, both with generous melty cheese and toppings. The Bee Sting in particular had a nice contrast of flavours between the savoury salami and mild sweetness from the honey. The roasted chicken wings however were pretty mediocre, so perhaps just stick to their pizzas.
author: Howcan Eats

restaurant_name: Xiang Xiang Hunan Cuisine 湘香湖南菜 @ Mandai Zoo
review_text:
Highly recommend this place. One of our favourite restaurants that we go regularly. Everything on the menu is amazing! We especially loved the stir fried pork which is their signature. And we also ordered a few non spicy dishes like claypot tofu stew and olive french beans.
Service here is amazing with friendly stuff and free flow ice cream and snacks. There is also a no question asked exchange policy if you are not satisfied with the food. Prices are very reasonable as well for the quality and quantity of food. They spare no effort ensuring you have a great dining experience.
author: Jux

restaurant_name: Xiang Xiang Hunan Cuisine 湘香湖南菜 @ Mandai Zoo
review_text:
We randomly discovered Xiang Xiang Hunan Cuisine on my way to Night Safari, and I’m so glad we decided to give it a try. We checked the menu first and found it really interesting, which convinced us to go in.
From the moment we walked in, we felt very welcomed. The restaurant has a modern and clean atmosphere, and ordering was very easy using the QR code system.
What truly stood out was the service. The staff were extremely helpful and attentive. One staff member noticed that my partner was having difficulty using chopsticks and immediately brought him a fork without us even asking. That’s what I call excellent service.
A wonderful dining experience overall — highly recommended!
author: Phoebe Tran

restaurant_name: Xiang Xiang Hunan Cuisine 湘香湖南菜 @ Mandai Zoo
review_text:
I was drawn to this restaurant by its impressive 4.9-star Google rating, but my experience fell far short of that high standard. The food was mediocre at best. While the location in a tourist area means there's often a queue, don't let that fool you into thinking the food is worth the wait.

The dishes were far from authentic. The beef was incredibly tough and chewy, and the stir-fried pork (小炒肉) was poorly executed, lacking the signature wok hei (breath of the wok) and flavor that defines good Hunan cuisine.

If you're looking for genuinely delicious and authentic Hunan food in Singapore, I strongly recommend skipping this place and finding a more reputable spot.
author: Zhou Liqiang

restaurant_name: Xiang Xiang Hunan Cuisine 湘香湖南菜 @ Mandai Zoo
review_text:
Visited this outlet on a weekday lunch and there was no crowd nor queue. Very pleasant visit

The food was good. Probably the taste of the century egg and eggplant can be more savoury or flavourful. A bit lighter than what was tasted in branch of Holland Village.

The rest were piping hot when served and the sour and spicy fish was the boom. This fish dish is citrusy, a little sweet, savoury and the tofu is infused with the soup. A pity that cheap fish was used.

The usual dish such as stir fried chilli with pork, braised tomato beef were typical. All dishes goes well with their unique carb.

Will I visit this branch? I think I will only visit this branch for their pleasant and less crowded experience. Food is pretty consistent across other branches.

And yes, free flow of mingo ice creams and crackers!
author: Fat Bear

restaurant_name: Xiang Xiang Hunan Cuisine 湘香湖南菜 @ Mandai Zoo
review_text: One of the best Chinese food chain restaurants in Singapore. The food is delicious. There are lots of spicy dishes, you have option to adjust the spice level. There are also plenty of non-spicy food too. The service is good. Food serves very fast.
author: Mandy Wan

review_text:
Had a wonderful dining experience at Sushiro – Mandai Wildlife outlet. The sashimi was exceptionally fresh and truly melt-in-the-mouth — every bite tasted clean and high quality.

What made the visit extra special was the large interactive TV ordering system. The games played in between orders were such a hit with my girls and kept them entertained throughout the meal. Ordering was fun, though I must admit my arm got a little sore after a while from reaching up to the big screen — but it was still part of the experience and gave us a good laugh.

Great food, family-friendly fun, and a lively atmosphere. Definitely a place we’ll return to again.
author: Jc Foo

review_text: Extremely fun dining experience but dangerous for your wallet! We got so caught up with clicking away your order on the giant monitor. Upon end of meal and checking out, had a shock of our lives with the final bill. Can’t deny we had fun while stuffing our face silly with the fresh sushi.
author: Calbee Cracker

review_text: First time trying out the restaurant. It is quite big. Though the queue was long, we did not wait very long. What impressed us in particular was the super fast delivery of the dishes despite so many tables, and the super big touch-screen for viewing of menu and ordering of food. More importantly, the quality of the food was good. As for room for improvement, think Sushiro’s prices are on the higher side, plus the rice of the sushi was a bit loose (instead of “packed”), which made it a bit tricky when eating.
author: Joseph Lum

review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
A very kids-friendly sushi spot with a fun and modern vibe! The ordering system is fully digital, with a large touchscreen menu and automated sushi delivery, which really adds a high-tech touch to the dining experience.

The food is fresh, delicious, and well-presented, offering a wide variety of sushi and side dishes that cater to both adults and children. My little one loved watching the sushi arrive on the express lane!

Perfect for families visiting Mandai Wildlife Reserve — great service, great food, and a great experience overall. Highly recommended! 🍣✨
author: JAO JAO

review_text: Overall 5 stars! The staff were so friendly. The food was prepared and served really fast which is important for families with kids like us. The self ordering system was easy to use. The location within Mandai Wildlife Reserve was great! It was really value for money, although the food quality could have been a little bit better our kid still really enjoyed it. Thank you, hope to be back again soon! 🙏🏻
author: Ashley Liew

restaurant_name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh Mandai Wildlife East (Non-Ticketed Area)
review_text:
We didn't really expect much cause we were just looking for an affordable place to eat and was pleasantly surprised. Everything tasted so good, even the sambal. Best sambal I've ever had. Supposedly made in house and was not available to buy :(

Pork bone soup really tender. Meat was especially good dipped in the soy sauce and sambal. Soup refill was amazing.

Pig intestine yum. Chinese broccoli yum.
author: Giao Nguyen

restaurant_name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh Mandai Wildlife East (Non-Ticketed Area)
review_text:
Always one of the go to place when we are craving for bkt.

The braised trotter was well done and the intestine was cleaned without any smell.

The garlic fried chicken is a welcoming dish along with the yuzu icy drink which we’ll balance the greasiness of the trotter.
author: ethan chew

restaurant_name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh Mandai Wildlife East (Non-Ticketed Area)
review_text: The soup is incredibly delicious and comes with refills. I love its peppery flavor! I'm surprised my child enjoyed it so much and drank it all! They also offer a kid's meal at this location, which is very cute and well worth it. The staff is friendly and welcoming, too. I will definitely visit again!
author: Deng AnQi

restaurant_name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh Mandai Wildlife East (Non-Ticketed Area)
review_text:
After finishing a walk along the Mandai broadwalk on a Tuesday evening, we were tired and hungry. Around 7 PM, we passed by Song Fa Bak Kut Teh and saw the restaurant was full — but to our surprise, there was no queue and we were lucky to get the last available table!

There’s nothing more comforting after a long walk than a hot bowl of Bak Kut Teh. The soup was rich and peppery, the pork tender and flavorful — and best of all, the soup refills are unlimited! It was such a satisfying and heartwarming meal. Truly one of life’s small joys.

Highly recommended for anyone craving a taste of Singapore’s iconic comfort food.
author: Pebble Hong

restaurant_name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh Mandai Wildlife East (Non-Ticketed Area)
review_text: Good food, great taste! I especially love the claypot pork tenderloin, ngoh hiang and dough fritters. Yum!
author: May

restaurant_name: Watami Japanese Dining (Mandai Wildlife EAST) (Free To Visit)
review_text: I always enjoy having lunch here when I visit the zoo. I appreciate the consistent kindness I receive during my visits. The service is commendable, and the prices are quite fair. I particularly recommend considering a membership, as it offers numerous advantages. If you anticipate visiting more than twice annually, a membership can indeed be quite beneficial. This is a lovely restaurant to visit with children, as the staff is friendly and the food is delicious. I wish you continued success.
author: John Han

restaurant_name: Watami Japanese Dining (Mandai Wildlife EAST) (Free To Visit)
review_text:
Here’s a polished and natural-sounding English version of your review:

---

This restaurant is really great — all the dishes are delicious 😋😋. The eel, which is my favorite, is always fresh. The kids’ meal was also surprisingly good; my child finished everything without wasting any food. If you’re visiting the zoo in the afternoon, this is definitely the place to come back for a meal.

A special thanks to Guo Huang and Chris for their warm services. They were absolutely amazing!
author: Sdeve Chin

restaurant_name: Watami Japanese Dining (Mandai Wildlife EAST) (Free To Visit)
review_text:
We are member and often go to watami pasir ris. We like that this outlet beside the zoo
- does not inflate the prices
- has many big tables for families
- has a card to remind you to get your dessert from the set meal
- has better (less salty) beef sukiyaki hot pot soup
Try if this QR code can be scanned to get a queue number, might help you beat the crowd. Take note it was crowded at dinner time, had to wait about 20 mins to get a table
author: Mr Chew

restaurant_name: Watami Japanese Dining (Mandai Wildlife EAST) (Free To Visit)
review_text: I enjoyed a delicious meal at Watami Japanese Dining (Mandai Wildlife EAST) with fresh ingredients and generous portions. The cozy atmosphere at Watami made it a pleasant dining experience after visiting Mandai Wildlife.
author: Peter Tay

restaurant_name: Watami Japanese Dining (Mandai Wildlife EAST) (Free To Visit)
review_text: The food was well portioned and delicious. After our broad walk trail, they made us feel relaxed and happy. I enjoyed their service especially their patience with our queries about the alcohol. I ended up buying four sake bottles! I like auntie Dorothy and Kind Kris Lady for their attentiveness! The air con was cooling, the staffs were all in their smiles, and best, it's a nice environment to be at just when we needed to feel humanity! 💕
author: Yixinn

review_text: First time here, came on a Friday morning. There wasn’t any crowd, and I was pleasantly surprised by the bright, spacious café interior. Service was friendly and welcoming. Food was okay. A nice spot to take a break before or after visiting the Zoo, River Safari, or Mandai Boardwalk.
author: S S

review_text:
We have been visiting this place for breakfast almost every weekday after our morning walk at the Mandai Boardwalk and for lunch occasionally since the place was opened this year.

The place is very comfortable with its spacious and clean setup, nice aircon environment with full height window scenery of lush garden and pond landscaping.  It serves restaurant standard food at reasonable prices.  Most importantly we always feel very welcome with their outstandingly friendly staff.

Once we came here to celebrate my wife's birthday. When he saw us with a big cake and candles, the restaurant manager ,Ashok, approached us and volunteered to sing to her a birthday song. Ashok together with his staff gave us a very heartwarming and cheerful birthday song. That was indeed a very pleasant and memorable surprise.

Our morning visits were without fail greeted cheerfully by the restaurant staff as well as some zoo staff who also use the place for their meetings. As we have been regular customers for their breakfast sets, the cashier, Husna, took pains to remember and type our orders every time.

When we collect our food, we were again greeted cheerfully by the sweet staff,  Sichuan, Hu Fang and Jaya. Hu Fang also took effort to check with us our preference and gave us very generous toast spreads, and fried our Yam Cake to our preferred level of crispiness. At times if Sichuan noticed that our orders were different from usual, she would take pains to verify with us if there was a mistake before preparing.

The Courtyard is therefore a great place to eat/drink when you visit the Mandai parks.
author: Tiong San Toh

review_text:
Chanced upon this restaurant and I will highly reccomend the satay served here.

The meat portion per stick is generous, grilled to perfection. Paired with rice and the peanut sauce. The cucumbers and onions are fresh sweet as well.

The team hospitality and a shout-out to Allfian, the grill master behind the Satay!

Dessert in the cups were delicious with the cakes as well.

Overall a pleasant experience. I will definitely try their Asian buffet or Indian buffet soon.
author: Jun Nan Wong

review_text:
Great and ample space to sit. Air conditioned everywhere. Strongly recommend anyone coming here to eat/drink:

1. Curry chicken
2. Kopis and its friends

The kids’ meals are not recommended as there is only 2 small piece of veg and lots of macaroni. The macaroni soup is not recommended too.
author: Joyfully blessed boy

review_text: First time trying this place. Spacious with a nice ambience! Had a relaxing and yummy breakfast here with my daughter after our lovely walk at the Mandai BoardWalk. Good vibes all around 😊
author: Joseph Lum

review_text: Mustn't miss on any zoo visit
author: Domagoj Pribanic

review_text:
The cafe is located opposite Tram Station 4. Please alight and head down to Level 1 where the cafe is situated.

We are a group of children and educators visiting the zoo on a weekday, and during lunch, I had a truly pleasant experience at the cafe. When I entered, Guek Teng, the supervisor of the cafe, warmly welcomed me and was extremely accommodating when I requested a bulk order. She immediately arranged a designated seating area for our group of children and adults, ensuring everyone was comfortable.

To my surprise, she even offered a small souvenir pouch for every one of us. Guek Teng and her team showed excellent teamwork and efficiency in preparing such a large number of meals, and the food was absolutely delicious.

I am deeply grateful for Guek Teng's kindness and warmth toward us. The cafe felt wonderfully cozy, especially after a long and tiring day outdoors.

Thank you very much, Guek Teng and the entire team. I truly appreciate your outstanding service.
author: Xinyi Lee

review_text:
I’m a regular at KidzWorld Cafe and this place never disappoints. I usually order an iced latte and fruit cups, and they’re always fresh and delicious. The latte is smooth and refreshing, and the fruit is nicely prepared every time.

The staff are friendly and welcoming, and the atmosphere is great — especially for families. It’s always a pleasant experience, which is why I keep coming back. Highly recommend!
author: REANZ TV

review_text: Omg🤩Absolutely delicious meal! The chicken donburi was perfectly cooked and incredibly flavorful, and the miso soup and juice complemented it wonderfully. The presentation was also top-notch. Beyond the fantastic food the staff provided excellent service they were friendly, attentive made the whole dining experience truly enjoyable😄Highly recommend😊
author: 王亚臣

review_text:
Great latte art and food is nice and hot! Was very impressed by the nicely grilled and chard teriyaki chicken in the rice bowl.

Service staff were all also very friendly and welcoming.
author: Isabelle W

review_text:
I love the pit stop here with my kid ! (The fast food chain KFC above was way too crowded and 1/3 of the area was closed off. )

Hence visiting the Kidsworld Cafe was totally worth it !

Plus point, Im a Vegetarian and they had plant based options ❤️

The food were warm, freshly cooked. Impossible dish was good and the drinks came in a large glass with is worth the price.

Every table had a baby high chair which is definitely friendly for babies. Parents with Prams will definitely find this place family friendly.

All food seem to be Halal / Muslim friendly except the beer bottle drink in the menu option. All else are good !

Lovely warm smile from the employee taking order over the counter.

Great atmosphere, service, cleanliness and delicious food.
author: Vivi Ayu

review_text: Think it’s quite new . Always having kfc visiting the zoo, now got mcd . The quality here like solid only. Fries really hot, golden brown and crispy. Easily my fav mcd . Will meet friends for mcd here in the future.
author: Liang Weizhe

review_text:
This McDonald is quite a new addition. Location outside the Singapore Zoo and other parks, it provides a quick and more affordable meals for park goers. It's inside a building (Discovery Cove) so there is an aircon. I can attest that this is much needed for Singapore weather especially after walking around in the park or boardwalk.

The food is quite pathetic though, but it could be the case for other branches as well. The big breakfast comes with very unappetizing scramble egg, limp patty and bread while the burger is tinier than ever.

Since it cost 9 dollar for big breakfast meal and 7 for burger meal McD the quality of the chain is getting more and more dissapointing.

The environment is okay, as I was there not during lunch hour (8am and 2pm on different weekdays). There are quite a number of tables to choose from.

Order through the machine and have the option to get it delivered to the table or pick it up youself.
author: Buren

review_text: Newly opened at Mandai Curiousity Cove. Very crowded so good luck trying to find seat. No playground on site. No washroom but only a handwash area.
author: Siah Hx

review_text: Finally and about my time!! A McDonald’s located within the Singapore Zoo compounds! This outlet is located within the curiosity cove area which is the newly opened shopping area within the zoo compounds.. and definitely very convenient a location and glad that there is more food offering now. Consistent food offering but wait time was really long took about 20 mins before it was delivered and we did see many complains about time served so hope that can be improved in time to come.
author: Abraham Lee

review_text: Staff are polite, worked fast and hard ytd when we visited. Price is reasonable.
author: Gary Ng

review_text: Excellent breakfast spread. The bacon is so addictive, super thin and crispy! Fresh waffle maker machine, cute kids corner, good spread of local and western dishes. DIY juice bar with healthy ingredients! Their spread dispenser is so cool! Lovely spacious interior.
author: Calbee Cracker

review_text: Mostly hotel guests dine here. It's quite a quiet , nice, relaxing place. Food variety is not alot but taste is ok. Like the desserts. However, the seats were not very clean. Found food crumbs and hair on the chairs. Plates were not removed promptly. Some food were not labelled correctly or without labels.
author: Rei Rei

review_text: Visited Planter’s Shed at Mandai Banyan Tree Resort for a weekday buffet dinner. Ambience is quite nice with a rustic, nature-inspired setting that fits well with the resort vibe. Not too noisy and crowded as well. Food quality was decent, though not particularly memorable — portions were moderate and flavors were fairly standard. The Laksa was a true standout for me. The salad bar and cold dishes were pretty good too with good variety and mostly very fresh. Service was polite and really efficient. Prices are on the slightly higher side, which is expected given the resort location. Overall, an okay dining experience if you’re already staying there, but not something I’d go out of my way for definitely as there is nothing really truly special or unique that will draw me back.
author: Xin Hao

review_text: Very good selection of food, fresh and clean. Well done to the kitchen. We particularly love the salted baked seabass with lemongrass, rendang and naan. Concierge staff was friendly but the services to fill up water and clearing up used plates were slow and not quite attentive. Hence, I’m giving a 4-star as such service is not expected in this resort.
author: Bluesnow

review_text:
If you are visiting the zoo, take a 5-minute walk to this restaurant for lunch. The food is good, and the environment is much better than when you dine at the Ah Meng restaurant in the zoo.
Of course the price is high, as it belongs to the 5-star resort.
I walked in on the day of my Sunday visit, as it is not popular and unknown to the public yet.
author: Don Chan

review_text:
First visit to the restaurant (and Mandai Resort) for lunch. We ordered one set lunch and two high tea sets. The restaurant is quite hidden, which explains why directions are sent in advance. And all the hotel staff at Mandai Resort were extremely helpful in guiding us to the location.

The restaurant offers a lovely view overseeing Seletar Reservoir and it serves good food. We enjoyed the complimentary cheese bread, and the cappuccino was excellent. I ordered the chicken for my main, which was well prepared and tasty.

The service was warm and welcoming. Special mention to Haryono, who took the time to engage with us, asked about our visit, made us feel very comfortable, and even helped us take some great photos. Thank you for the wonderful experience!
author: Yuan Li Kwok

review_text:
Dining here felt like an exclusive experience. Truly a gem nestled away in this resort sanctuary. Immaculate vibes, impressive food.

I had the 8-course menu and the food was really delicious - from the sourdough & cheese bread, through every single course. Each course was innovative and layered with complex flavours, using sustainably sourced or home-grown ingredients. Chef Marcus & team hit the spot and set the bar high!

Impeccable service by Khang - most thoughtful, proactive, and attentive to detail. Top-notch!

This restaurant definitely deserves to be shoulder to shoulder among the best.
author: Royce Chan

review_text:
An exceptional dining experience at Forage.
It’s refined, thoughtful, and beautifully executed from start to finish.

The menu truly lives up to its “guided by nature” philosophy. Each course was elegant and well-balanced with flavours. Highlights included the skipjack tuna with pistachio and nori cream, the delicate Beijing cabbage with foie gras and shiitake broth, and the perfectly cooked miso black cod with yuzu. The Boston lobster with green curry was especially memorable! I want to eat it again :) The Wagyu striploin was outstanding, cooked just right and paired wonderfully with seasonal mushrooms and black shallot.

Desserts were equally impressive, light and refreshing, ending the meal on a graceful note.
Service was attentive without being intrusive, and the overall pacing of the meal felt just right.

A truly polished and memorable experience at Forage. Highly recommended for a special occasion or when you want a dining experience that’s both soulful and sophisticated.
author: Evon Tan

review_text:
Had a really good time dining here. The food was good, service was excellent & the whole experience felt genuine.

A special touch was the head chef coming out to greet us & the manager taking the time to give us a tour of their farm upstairs — it really brought their farm-to-table concept to life. Nice seeing where some of the ingredients come from, including their own honey 🍯 🐝

Thank you Team Forage for the wonderful hospitality. A wonderful escape from the city & a memorable evening overall 😊
author: L Chan

review_text:
The afternoon tea at this restaurant was absolutely delicious! My partner and I were very satisfied with both the food and the service.

The staff were incredibly patient in explaining each dish to us and even helped us take photos. Their service was warm and thoughtful.

The environment was quiet and cozy, making it a perfect place for couples to enjoy a romantic date. Highly recommended!
author: Pei Yun Tan

review_text:
One of the best Zi Char within Bukit Panjang Neighbourhood

Any specific request you can make known during ordering

New dish 菜圃河粉， absolutely delicious if you are Chay Poh lovers.
author: Asta Andrew

review_text: I ever order so much cost $500 over. It seems like the aunty boss didn’t bother to answer and reply messages. Cut the queue & ordered are not wrong. Cook my two dishes and waited for 3rd dish for 20mins. The other dishes also cold already right! What kind of service saying don’t serve me next time 🤣 ok I am anything. 🤣
author: neo anna

review_text: At many times when we are lazy to cook our meals we will eat in or pack our meal from this zichar stall. Agree with another review that food is good and taste like Malaysian style. If I have to dine alone, I always asks “whats the specialty for solo meal today” haa. Makes me feel like home when the lady boss or her husband tells me what they have to offer.  My daughter said she felt sad when this stall stopped serving lunch. I gave 4 stars for atmosphere not becoz it is unpleasant but coz this is afterall a coffee shop not restaurant, dont expect too much. Today I have to dine alone. They have solo meal pork rib curry rice and Stew Chicken with Black fungus.  I ordered the latter for $9 and finished the whole plate of rice in order to clear up the chicken dish. Too hungry to take a photo of the food to share. Most importantly I never feel too thirsty after consuming their food.
author: Teo Judy

review_text: Never visit again. Do careful with the green t shirt uncle. Extremely bad customer service. He will scold any customer if the shop is busy and he is not able to handle his staff
author: Vincent Yap

review_text:
Boss is very nice
Food is amazing 10/10
Would recommend petai sotong and fish head steamboat!!
author: Mervin Ng

review_text:
No doubt the Nasi Sambal Goreng is one of the best around! Absolutely delicious and worth trying! Just a heads-up! They only accept CASH, so make sure to bring some CASH with you. No PayNow or contactless payment options available. I know there is a sign that says "CASH ONLY" but it was my first time. So this is for first timer. The staff didn’t seem too pleased when I mentioned I didn’t have cash on me, so it's best to come prepared. NO ATM AROUND TOO!

BUT BEST NASI SAMBAL GORENG IN BP I WOULD SAY! KUDOS!
author: Sayyid Fadhil Hamzah

review_text:
I've been a fan since the begining. Their food has this warm, comforting vibe – like a delicious home-cooked meal. Plus, it's all very affordable and they don't go overboard with the seasoning, which is perfect for me.

My usual go-to orders are the Nasi Lemak and Mee Soto. The Nasi Lemak standard set is just $4, and pictured here, I added on otah and bergedil for another $3. The coconut rice is fragrant and light, and pairs well with the crispy fried chicken wings. The chicken wings move fast so you can be assured that it is always warm. Otah is a little pastey to my liking and bergedil is hit & miss. Freshly fried ones are fantastic, but if they've been sitting for a while, they can get greasy.

Tip:  they often sell out by 1pm, so be sure to get there early!
author: Touristmouse

review_text: Unwrapping mixed rice from Selera Umi stall directly from Segar Gardens. Ample chuck of rice with mixed sambal goreng, quail eggs & potato begedil in one packaging. Super tasty, extremely flavoured cooking zest. Most choice will be gone after breakfast period.
author: #janjiHalal

review_text:
Mee rebus is so expensive - $4.70 and was so spicy max
One of the malay aunty scolded me in malay words.
author: Wong Qi Yuan, Jeffrey

review_text: Delicious sambal tumis! Sometimes a bit too spicy but it hits the palate nicely. The mi siam, mi rebus and mi soto all delectable too. Glad they are around to whet a good halal food option ard here.
author: T Tee

review_text:
Absolutely one of the best chicken rice spots in Bukit Panjang! This stall delivers consistently tender, flavourful chicken with great texture, and the rice is fragrant without being overly oily. Portions are generous, prices are very reasonable, and everything tastes clean and comforting.

The chilli is a standout, perfectly balanced with just the right kick  and the overall experience feels old-school, honest, and satisfying. Service is efficient and friendly, even during peak hours.

If you’re looking for no-frills, top-tier boneless chicken rice done right, this place is a must-try. It's become my go-to chicken rice place everytime i develop a craving.
author: Darren

review_text: I must say this is the best chicken rice stall in Bukit Panjang! The rice is fragrant and fluffy as it should be. The chicken was tender and fresh while the chilli was spicy yet nice. All eaten together...shiok. I have been coming back almost monthly to get my chicken rice craving fixed.  Stall owners are friendly and nice too. Their service is prompt too.
author: Rex Tan

review_text:
Great service and chicken rice. I really liked the chicken breast meat a lot. Great option for those who need to meet their protein intake. Starting price ranges from $2.80 to $4.80. The only bumper is that they only serve oil rice.

This is a no frills chicken rice store, if your
expect succulent meat and flavourful rice, then I’m sorry that it doesn’t live up to that. But I must say it’s a very decent and enjoyable meal.
author: Shengyang Yu

review_text: Tucked in a less accessible area of segar/Bukit Panjang, this chicken rice is better than Michelin-rated chicken rice you often found in other parts of Singapoe.
author: Lee Wee Lee

review_text:
Decent chicken rice at neighbourhood area. Best pricing of chicken rice. Cater to masses. Want cheap and good? Go for $2.50 portion chicken breast rice. Want better part of the chicken meat? Go for $3.50 or $4.50 chicken thigh or drumstick rice. Very friendly boss.

Wish Auntie could help uncle more. She only takes orders. Uncle has to do everything himself, including cut chicken, take rice, put chicken on rice and 包 himself and cook vegetables. Every time he has to take out his gloves in and out to do that lol.
author: Chew Wenhua

review_text: Ordered via grab, thanks the owner for giving extra sauce to try. First time ordering, tried the build own platter: crab Rangoon and tater tots. Not very oily and not jelak. Crab Rangoon and tater tots came warm too. Crispy and good. Crab Rangoon fillings very full also. The truffle mayo taste very good, the chilli padi mayo is also good, paired very well with the crab Rangoon.
author: Jovial Pang

review_text: Ordered fried chicken cutlet with brown sauce and chose cheesy omelette and fries as my sides. The chicken cutlet was not dry at all! The cheese to egg ratio was also perfect and not jelak. The truffle mayo tastes like a standard, good o truffle mayo and did not disappoint. But I prefer the lemon pepper mayo as it goes super well with the fried items!! I loved it. 🫶 Only suggestion would be to add less salt to the fries ❤️
author: c h a r l y n n

review_text:
Stall is a Home based take away joint. Overall this place deserves two thumbs up. 👍👍

Main: Chicken Chop
Sides: Scrambled eggs with cheese, Coleslaw
Sauce: Chilli Padi Mayo, Truffle Mayo

Cheese on the scrambled eggs are legit. Scrambled eggs are done to perfection.
The chicken chop is oven baked and is delicious even without any sauces.
Truffle Mayo Sauce truffle taste is decent and not overpowering. It can be easily paired and went well with the chicken chop.
Never thought I’d like the chilli padi mayo but it’s definitely good. The spiciness will not kill you and it’s addictive.
author: Samuel Wong

review_text: highly recommend the sauce truffle mayo, cheesy scramble egg, mash potato. Value for money with great quality food!! The FISH are thick, not your usual thick batter with little meat. TQ for the free sauce to try will definitely reorder from you 😉
author: Yuki Seah

review_text: Not tasty at all it's oily and over price (grilled chicken) . Force to buy sauce I know u gave free too but if I'm buying a meal alrd just give la like this also charge . Tater tot way to ex I'm not expecting charge $1-$2 etc but close to $10 for sides ...?Home base should be reasonable pricing but it's ok u r the boss mahh u create your own pricing..

The Burger is acceptable, though greasy too.
author: Angelina Tian

author: Putra Danish

review_text: Ordered 3 thosai, two masala and 1 plain. This is not the first time. Sometimes no chilli or chutney at all.
author: Farhanah Rashid

Also worth noting that it can be hard to find seats at the coffeeshop, especially during mealtimes and weekends.

review_text: Nice zi char but just one small complain. Their cereal prawn looks like this. So if u are ok with this kind. For my I expect the cereal to coat the prawn. But other dishes so far ok.
author: Chua Ellen

review_text: I am not sure why the review is so poor. I have eaten here 3x and food is consistently good. 排骨王 is tender, fish head steamboat is very tasty and the chef deep fried the pomfret bones which makes it v yummy in the soup (on the salty side that makes me feel thirsty after dinner but I can deal with it), salted egg chicken is the best I've had (non greasy and super crispy, bite size). Dried hor fun is bland and has room for improvement, 干香lala is too heavily seasoned and too thick sauce, hotplate toufu is normal.
author: wei K

review_text: Really strong flavoured and fragrant har cheong gai, with very flavourful chili to complement it. Can feel a bit greasy but it’s a worthwhile indulgence
author: Marcus Lee

review_text: Zichar in the Segar neighbourhood of Bukit Panjang New Town, situated about 20m from Segar LRT Station in a spacious Badaling Kopitiam. I loved the ginger chicken, Claypot Kangkong and Hotplate Tofu that wife has ordered. Very savoury and not too oily. I would recommend seafood if you fancy a different kind of protein.
author: Danny Lee

review_text: Those review that is negative i'm not sure is it last time different management and different chef/cook, i have been enjoying their food so far, getting bette and better. Service also very good, sometimes they get very busy and you have to be patient too, don't rush them as i know they take order and cook quite fast and won't miss your orders, and will shout ur order once ready. So i am giving 5 stars for this neighbourhood zi char, not the ultimate best, but yes its  place i will go again. I like the salted Fish dice chicken fried rice (add their sambal chilly, if take away rmb to take 3 packet, haha)
author: Wil Heng #不会抖哥哥

review_text:
Had a few terrible experiences with the malay staff lady as shown in the picture.

One of the incidents was, I ordered lemon chicken rice, but the counter screen showed chicken rice (likely from the previous customer). To avoid any mistake, I calmly reconfirmed my order and repeated that it was lemon chicken rice. Instead of responding politely or clarifying, the staff member shouted “I KNOW I KNOW” in an aggressive and rude tone, completely unprovoked.

There was no need for the hostility. a simple confirmation would have sufficed. Judging from the reviews here, I’m clearly not the only one who has had a negative experience with the same staff member.

author: honey pooh

review_text:
I recently tried a few dishes from this shop with mixed results.

The Mushroom Chicken Feet Noodle ($6.50) was decent. It had a hint of alkaline but could benefit from more sauce. The chicken feet were cooked just right. Mushrooms had a nice earthy flavor - they would have been even better if simmered in the sauce for more depth.

The Ayam Penyet ($9.00) fell short.
Tofu cubes were a highlight - lightly fried on the outside and juicy on the inside.
Unfortunately the rice lacked fragrance.
The chicken wasn't flattened as it should be.
Stale greens topped with a barely edible chilli didn't help.
For $9 I expected more authenticity and flavors.

Fried Wanton (Regular $6.50) was nearly burnt. Overpowering Turmeric powder dominated the dish. Unusual spices added to the disappointment.

Roasted Chicken Rice ($5.50) was a basic but satisfying option.
The portion was generous.
Condiments were plentiful.
However no cutlery was provided.

Overall this shop is decent for a quick meal if you're in the area.
Just don't expect to be blown away.
author: KasperxP

review_text:
Ordered thru Food Panda Delivery.
This is the worst Chicken Rice I ever eaten before, all bones and no meat. The Chef indeed very clever at covering by chopping all the bones covered the meat, which is not found.
author: Genia Wee

review_text:
Cons: Quite a few times requested for breast meat but still give thigh meat.
Pro: free soup

review_text:
(Meal was almost done before remembered to take photo)
Ayam Penyet always doesn't dissapoint. Staffs are very nice. Free soup, ayam penyet chilli taste good. Chicken meat taste good. Veggies are fresh. Hearty meal!
author: wella figueroa

review_text:
I stumbled upon this stall ("Teochew Fishball Minced Meat Noodle" at Food Hub) and ordered their dry Fishball Minced Meat Noodles with Mee Pok.

​The Verdict:
It is very good, but you need to know what you are eating. This is NOT Bak Chor Mee (BCM); it is a proper bowl of Teochew Fishball Noodles.

​The Difference: Don't come here expecting the vinegar-forward punch or the distinct savoury depth of tee poh (dried sole fish) that defines a classic BCM. The chilli is also different—it's not the typical BCM sambal style.

​Why it's still great: Despite not being BCM, it stands on its own merits. The Mee Pok was cooked perfectly al dente—springy with a great bite. The sauce mix was flavourful and savoury, coating the noodles well.

​The Ingredients: The toppings are generous—bouncy fishballs, sliced fish cake, minced meat, and fresh crispy lard croutons (you can add more on you own, there's a box of it next to the utensils) that add a wonderful texture.

​It was so satisfying that after finishing my bowl, I immediately ordered 4 more packets to take away for my family. If you appreciate a solid, traditional Teochew Fishball noodle, this gets my stamp of approval.
author: Wiz Yeo

review_text:
Just a bowl of noodles cooked well. Simple taste with fresh ingredients. My favourite noodles in BP. Auntie has memory of a supercomputer. She can remember 100 orders at a time lol. Even after you order and anyhow stand around, she will remember you and your order. Just amazing.

Auntie cooks in the early morning and just before stall closes in the evening. Uncle’s skills is better than hers. So I prefer uncle’s version.
author: Chew Wenhua

review_text: Amazing memory. Great taste. For older folks, remember to tell her to make softer.
author: Paul Young

review_text: Used to have this 2-3 times a week when I stayed in the area. Not the best but definitely better than average. Love the minced meat and usually add an additional $2 of minced meat.
author: Patrick Poh

review_text:
This is a very underated teochew fishball bak chor mee stall. 每一次吃都很香, even though I have moved from this area for many years, I still come back and support them from time to time!

Fishball, minced meat, noodles, condiments and garnishes have always maintain the same standards. No fishy, no smelly pork smell. One of my favourite stalls for bcm in singapore. Even my daughter also whack finish one bowl 🥣 🤣

author: Lala lala

review_text:
One of the best rojak I've eaten by far. The owner is very clean when he handles the food, he is generous with his portion and the beat part to it, he communicates proficiently in English. Which is hard to get these days.

Even after migrating, the first thing I ate after arriving in Singapore, is his rojak.

Keep doing what you are doing!

The owner takes pride in his food preparation! The fried fritters are toasted perfectly all the time ensuring a crunchy bite that is not too hard or too soft. All other ingredients are added generously including the peanuts topping. The rojak paste is also perfect in consistency and taste.

review_text: This is by far the best rojak I ever had in sg. Uncle is very hygienic and friendly. Rojak always prepare upon ordering. Sadly to say, this stall was not known by many.
author: Lee Yee Teng

review_text: Delicious rojak! This stall used to be at Petir, now has moved to Segar. It is so good, would recommend.
author: Paepae S

Uncle prepares food and serves customers with his heart and sincerity. Always humorous :D
Rojak is always fresh, crispy, and delicious!
