author: oXRYSTALo Ong

review_text:
1st time trying En Tan. Photo was taken after ate🤣. Really hungry. Anyway, service is good, very fast, variety of food choices, spacious.

ordered Fried Chicken Cutlet Rice at $5, Dine In, affordable price and HALAL. TBH, you can't really find any HALAL stall with this price. 👍👍👍👍👍.
author: SAM LYNN

restaurant_name: Canton Paradise 樂天小香港 at Compass One
review_text: My family are regulars at this restaurant. Love the taste of the food. Always consistent regardless of how many times we visit. Our go-to dish is the crispy flounder in soy sauce ($27+). Thick cut and is absolutely delicious. Their crispy rice roll with BBQ pork filling is also amazing ($8.90+). I went Hong Kong and had the authentic one but for some reason, this tastes better haha. The service provided by the waiting staff is great as well! Really enjoy the homey vibes
author: Hui Shan Tan

restaurant_name: Canton Paradise 樂天小香港 at Compass One
review_text:
Very long queue at Hotpot Paradise hence settle for Canton Paradise. Good deals of 40% for dim sum dishes.
Most of the dishes we ordered were delicious and satisfying.
Our favorite would be the radish cake. Spend $59.69. Wonderful meal.
19.12.25
author: FRan

restaurant_name: Canton Paradise 樂天小香港 at Compass One
review_text:
Food quality are great. Portions are just right.
The Red rice roll is rather interesting and nice. Noodles have good texture.
Friendly staff and atmosphere.
author: A鏸

restaurant_name: Canton Paradise 樂天小香港 at Compass One
review_text: Repeated patrons, food is good, service is good. The staff remembered us especially when I brought my little one to have tea or dinner here. Nice welcoming atmosphere and attentive and food is always warm or hot. We love the dim sum here.
author: Nana Cox

restaurant_name: Canton Paradise 樂天小香港 at Compass One
review_text: Service is 5 star. Speed of serving food is fast too. Siew mai, har gou is always our favourites all the time - they never fail. Portion of condiments is generous too! Servers are v friendly
author: Yixuan Adeline

review_text:
Paid meatball porridge, waited so long… and it came without the meatballs. Amazing.

Two cashiers there, which is great but the aunty was busy asking “what this lady want?” while I was literally just waiting for my paid porridge.

Ended up with meatless porridge. Joke of the day.
author: Vanessa Lim

review_text:
Due to today last day of cny, many people queued for the tangyuan. After queuing for 50mins was told the beancurd base out of stock and giving only beancurd milk. But no changes to the price, how can that be?? The price was for ginger with beancurd and ended up with only ginger water but same price.
Both being charged beancurd price but without beancrud.
Please look into it.
author: chua ling

review_text:
Ordered the cheap all day porridge for $2 . The service was good, the staff was polite and the time to receive my food wasn't too long. 👍

This is the first time I'm trying this porridge, the food I received isn't as glamorous as the one in the promo pic but regardless the taste is more important. The meal is also only available on weekends, not sure why.

The porridge tasted alright, it has a nice mix of ingredients. The peanuts and vegetarian floss made the taste less bland. 👍 The fried dough (youtiao) didn't have much taste, it's small in portion and didn't have a soft texture. 😕

But overall, the food is worth as much as you paid for. I don't think it was filling for either kids or adults maybe elderly people will like it.

This place does sell tasty pancakes though which is what I usually get. I definitely recommend the pancakes and soy milk instead👍✨
author: Besharps

review_text:
Follow us on IG @toofoodtomiss for more foodie content!

National Day is around the corner! 🇸🇬 To commemorate SG59, Mr Bean has launched a new range of pancakes to Go Local and feature some local flavours. Here’s what we got to try from their selection ❤️🤍

𝗢𝗿𝗵 𝗡𝗲𝗲 𝗠𝗼𝗰𝗵𝗶 𝗣𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗮𝗸𝗲 ($𝟮.𝟵𝟬) 🍠☁️
Just look at the flowing orh nee and that mochi pull 🤩, Mr Bean’s mochi is the perfect amount of sweet and chewy and we really liked there were taro bits and chunks to give the filling some texture! However, with the whole pancake consisting of starch and flour-based ingredients, the orh nee could have used a stronger flavour profile.

𝗣𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗻 𝗖𝗵𝗲𝗲𝘀𝗲 𝗣𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗮𝗸𝗲 ($𝟮.𝟱𝟬) 🌿🧀
The pandan aroma was fragrant but not overpowering, and paired nicely with the gooey cheese to coat the pancake. We loved the vibrant pandan green and just wish we had more of that filling!

𝗢𝘁𝗮𝗵 𝗘𝗴𝗴𝘄𝗶𝗰𝗵 ($𝟯.𝟳𝟬) 🐟🍳
Fans of eggwich now have a fiery option to spice up their day. The combination of otah, egg and pancake was delicious, and is a great addition to their line of savoury eggwiches!

𝗚𝗿𝗮𝘀𝘀 𝗝𝗲𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗕𝗲𝗮𝗻𝗰𝘂𝗿𝗱 ($𝟮.𝟵𝟬)
The black and cooling grass jelly went well with Mr Bean’s signature beancurd.

We love how Mr Bean constantly innovates to incorporate seasonal flavours into delicious pancakes 🫶🏻. (P.S. Do try to have their pancakes warm!) Head down to your nearest Mr Bean and try their SG59 specials before they’re gone! ☝🏻
author: toofoodtomiss

review_text:
This place has always been my go-to shop when I crave soya milk.

They serve a ton of menu items, most being healthy; that's also another reason I like coming here.

Service standard is alright most of the time, kind and all. However, I wish they could adopt a new convenient queueing system, because the classic trend of waiting in line isn't the most attractive thing to frequent/new customers.

I've tried some products in the past several years I've visited this place, and most never fail to amaze me.

The rice ball and classic beancurd weren't my cup of tea when I first tried them. The former just wasn't what I really enjoyed in general, and for the latter: the beancurd was too plain to eat, and was only flavourful when consumed with the special soya bean, which becomes exhausting.

Not that I wouldn't encourage people from buying this though. They're still good dishes for anyone!

Anyway, my favourite product is the rice bowl. The balanced mixture of beans (hollow), broccoli, carrots, rice and choice of topping was what topped this dish amongst the local street food I'm used to eat. Even the sauce mixed with the rice was an eye-opener!

Not to mention their truly outstanding (literally) drinks, which are tasty in their own flavours. Although there are limited options now in this era, they can satisfy me still. My favourite drink personally is their limited-time Thai Milk Tea, which is undoubtedly the best thing after rice bowl. Besides that, I prefer Taro Soya Milk over the rest!
author: awesome zinyew

review_text:
Enjoyed the pastries and a quiet place to chill after a hard day's work. I appreciate the service as the staff is attentive to what I want to order and I never tire of coming here over and over again.

Special shoutout to Helmet Spa SG for the machine and the awesome neon glow to give Shell a retro vibe.
author: Alex Ong

review_text: Cashier and pump attendant are very courteous and helpful. They even help to look out traffic to marshal me when i exit after the transaction. A very pleasant visit.
author: Ant Tan (Ant)

review_text: Run of the mill petrol station. Uncle very helpful to offer to pump the petrol. If you say "full tank", he really pump in full for you. After the auto stop, he still squeeze in a few liters so don't say full tank if you meant auto stop. Surprisingly quite crowded during lunch time. Had to wait a bit.
author: E

review_text:
Thanks to Raymond the cashier counter who greeted everyone good morning and able to collect my shopee parcel at shell here easily.
Thanks for making a day great!
author: diana peh

review_text: Ivy was super polite can tell she loves what she does. Customer service 100%
author: Chrishen Bijay

review_text:
If you're around Fernvale, the Salmon Mentai Don and Chicken Cutlet Mentai Don are absolute must-tries! The salmon is seared to perfection, topped with creamy, flavorful mentai sauce that adds the perfect kick to the tender fish. As for the chicken cutlet, it’s crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside, with that same heavenly mentai sauce elevating the dish to the next level.

Don’t forget to grab a side of Mentai Fries—they’re addictive! Crispy fries drenched in that signature mentai sauce—what’s not to love? And if you’re feeling like something lighter, the Tamago Mentai is the perfect bite-sized treat, with the fluffy tamago perfectly complementing the rich sauce.

Highly recommend giving these a try if you're nearby!
author: Bei

review_text:
The shop is good for a hawkers place; a bit pricy compared to local food, but it’s also worth spending a bit for a Japanese food treat.

They give generous serving of sauce (mentai and teriyaki).  The chicken mentai don is very good, while the saba teriyaki don is also good (just be careful of few bones).

We felt the Mentaiya Fries is better than Genki Sushi (and we also got it for only $2, promo price until end of May 2024.  So grab it now!)

Overall, a satisfying Japanese dinner.
author: F L

review_text:
Affordable and delicious!

Ordered the Salmon Mentai Don, Mentai Fries, and Spicy Mentai Soft Shell Crab.

The salmon don was of a good portion and had a generous amount of mentaiko sauce.

Unfortunately, their fries were soggy as compared to their punggol outlet which was very crispy and on par with macdonald's fries.

Their Spicy Mentai Soft Shell Crab was really flavorful and had a good amount of meat.
Generally, other soft shell crabs I've had did not have as much meat as theirs.

Would definitely revisit someday!
author: Jo

review_text: Seen this on Grab, so came to try it out. Very friendly owners. The Chicken Mentai Don ($7.80) is super crispy and quite tasty but I think the Katsudon might be better. The Salmon Mentai Don ($8.80) is definitely worth the dollar more. The Mentai dressing is generous and the rice is Japanese rice. So overall, pretty good value.
author: Catherine Ling

review_text:
Affordable quality Japanese food found in Sengkang coffeeshop. Prices are less than $10. Love their mentaiko speciality. Mentaiko lovers pls try! Even if you do not fancy mentaiko, other available options are good as well. Friendly and polite staffs. Would recommend to try!

** New updated menu with soft shell crab and mentaiko udon!
author: elina

review_text:
One of the best traditional Korean meals🍲🍜🍛 I’ve had in Singapore. Located in the heartlands, this stall serves truly authentic Korean food without the need to travel far.

The menu is extensive—ginseng chicken soup, bibimbap, tofu soup, bulgogi, japchae, grilled saba fish soup, jajangmyeon, and more. Every dish is made with fresh ingredients and tastes excellent.🥘

Prices are very reasonable and well worth it. A real hidden gem—highly recommended.👍🏻
author: KEN MANG Lor

review_text: Food here is consistently delicious. Quality always maintained, price factor is excellent. During peak hours might need to wait, pls be prepared, nothing to complain. Their ginseng chicken is a must try, their hot bowl bibimbap is delish.
author: Mike Ng

review_text:
Must try Ginseng soup, tofu soup, all their soups. Authentic nice flavours, side dish fantastic, owner happy to give free refill.
Ordered all these & loved them, well priced. Definitely favourite spot
author: Tango Tang

review_text: Absolutely love this godsend korean ginseng chicken soup in my neighbourhood. It's even better than most restaurants and it's in a coffeeshop near me! Beyond blessed to be able to have this on a regular basis. It's really nourishing and so delightful to have, especially with such hot, sweltering weather. We tried their hot stone bibimbap as well which is really generous with ingredients, and their other stew sets but the ginseng chicken is still my ultimate fave, especially with the glutinous rice stuffed inside- just gooey earthy and heavenly goodness that's so satisfying and comforting. Highly recommend and hope they continue to prosper and do well in this trying fnb climate!
author: Audrey Tan

review_text:
Authentic Korean food at affordable prices! I love how generous they are with their side dishes (banchan), which were high quality too! Thank you, will definitely recommend and be back.

If you’re visiting this coffee shop, the homemade barley from the drinks stall is also a must-try 😊
author: Emily Teo Goralewski

review_text:
While I find it strange they charge extra $2 juts for hums for their laksa.

Their mince meat meepok dry was decent. Tasty and reasonable amount. Noodle was cook perfectly. Firm but not hard.

Would hv probably given 4 stars if not for the $2 surcharge for hums.
author: Mikail Yah

review_text: I opted for the minced meat mee pok instead of their signature fishball noodle. While the mee pok was generous with ingredients, the sauce unfortunately fell short. Overall, it was an average bowl of mee pok.
author: LP Pua

review_text:
To be honest, I think the noodles were a bit soggy. The sauce used in the minced meat noodles were slightly more vinegary for my taste. Minced meat and liver were cooked just enough.

When it was my turn, I heard they just ran out of Fishballs, so I think I will give the Fishball noodles a second chance. Hope it gets  better on my next try.
author: Henry Cheng

review_text: Staying nearby so this is my nearest fishball noodle stall. I understand from the owner this is their second stall, first in Serangoon Gardens. The uncle owner takes a lot of effort in the morning, in preparing the ingredients. I particularly like their fishcake, the skin is crispy and makes their fishball noodles stand out. They have other stuff like laksa as well.
author: Zhi Ming Ng

review_text: Great kway teow mixed yellow noodles soup. Added $1 kway teow and this bowl noodles cost $5.
author: Ling Ying Ho

review_text:
If you’ve been craving that famous Mount Austin-style Lala soup, you don’t have to cross the border anymore. The broth here has that same rich, thick flavour, especially after we added a splash of Hua Diao wine (highly recommend doing that!). It even has a hint of wok hei from the charcoal base, which gives the soup extra depth.

The ingredients were fresh, especially the prawns and lala. We went for ala carte, so the bill was higher since we over ordered for two pax but still reasonable given the quality and freshness. Price wise… of cos can’t compare with ringgit lah but for a kopitiam setup, it’s considered value for money.

The open air seating was surprisingly airy and comfortable, not stuffy at all even with the hotpot boiling away. You can also go for their set if you prefer an easier choice.

Overall, a solid find and definitely worth a try if you love seafood soup with a smoky twist. I actually think it tastes even better than Mount Austin haha..
author: Dwell Doodle

review_text:
I have a wonderful and enjoyable dinner at Lala Story Claypot, ingredients are fresh, the soup is very yummy goes with my favourite noodles. After drinking the soup, I won’t feel thirsty.
Like it when a wide variety choices of ingredients is available. Thanks a lot.
author: Chan Yee Ping

review_text: Meat and add-ons were fresh, and the broth was really tasty. I also like that their lala soup is quite affordable - 500g for $16 and 1kg for $28. They give free soup top-ups too. I will say it is worth a visit! Prawn paste is highly recommended!
author: Elleen Chong

review_text:
8th Nov 2025, around 8.30pm

Food: 10/10
Service: 1/10
Group size: 7 adults

I have to emphasise that their quality of food is really good. The soup broth is flavourful and sweet. The lala and prawns we ordered were fresh. Overall, the food quality is worth revisiting. I am confident that anyone living on the other end of Singapore would be more than willing to travel down for it.

However, I would rather visit Lok Fu Lala Pot at Geylang even if it means we would have to dine outdoors with no fan in a humid climate like ours.

Storytime: WE WERE LEFT ALONE WITHOUT CHARCOAL AND RAW FOOD. They literally closed their shop sharp at 9.30pm. Owners took their bag and left without checking in with us. When they informed us about the last order, they did not check in with us if we needed more charcoal or soup. They just took their bags and left us STRANDED. WE HAD TO CONTINUE OUR MEAL WITH ANOTHER TABLE’S CHARCOAL. Can you imagine the helplessness that we go through while dining?

In addition, when we were placing our order, there were some food items that were out of stock which is understandable as we were there around 8pm+. When we asked for a refill of the spring onions at the sauce station, she told us that we took ALOT of it but mind you, there wasn’t even much left when we went to take! The spring onion left in the container before we took any of it wasn’t even enough to fill the bottom of the container. Furthermore, only 2 of us went to take the sauce before asking for a refill.

I get it if you want to close on time because it is not easy to be a hawker or to be in the FNB industry. The least you can do is to inform us that you will be closing at 9.30pm and check in with us if we need anything else like the sauces, charcoal, soup etc. before you leave. Or, if your preferred way of operating is to have all customers leaving at 9.30pm, then inform us. As customers, these are things we won't have in mind as we are enjoying our meal. It was a really good meal too!

To make matters worse, the contact number they left on Google is NOT IN SERVICE. Only a cleaner was around who wasn’t trained to replace the charcoal. We ended up using the charcoal left behind by another customer that was seated right beside us.

We might have been overcharged too but to be confirmed.

PS: The photos I took were not justifiable as I was caught off guard with how their service went. I didn’t think much at first until the point of no charcoal.
author: t.evelina

review_text:
Recommended by friend to try this stall n we love it. The soup taste is very gao 👍 ingredients also very fresh. Staffs all very friendly. Conveniently located near Kupang lrt. They provide free flow condiments too n our favourite is their homemade chilli. It added special flavour to the hotpot. Try it once & u will be craving for more. Will sure come again 🤗

Pstt… they hv live crab (don’t worry abt freshness) but we don’t order cz we’re too lazy to peel it since it’s alr late night haha.
author: Lets Dance

review_text: Absolutely disappointed with the prawn + shredded chicken hor fun. The image on the menu showed a good amount of prawns and shredded chicken. I ordered takeaway and came back to see the pathetic portion of chicken/shredded chicken. For $7.30, this is a real rip-off as the amount of protein barely makes up the size of my palm. I don't leave reviews often, but this disappointed me so much that it is imperative I warn others. Do not be deceived by the good reviews of this store.
author: Wee Liang Kai

review_text:
The noodles are superb, have the traditional feel and taste.
Green chilli and red chilli are not to be missed.

Crunchy green chilli and homemade red chilli greatly compliments the dish...

Their first outlet in SG!
Originally from JB
3rd generation family recipe and run by family members!

Eat to feel the homely feel and taste!
author: Kenny Q

review_text: I love the noodles here! It’s authentic malaysia style!!! :)))) I want this place to be here for a long time please :”) hidden gem
author: Stefanie Peh

review_text: Tasty wanton noodle and Seafood Horfun, with generous amount of meat. Good hidden gem in vicinity of Fernvale. The set meal looks value for money, but by the time we came, they run out of snack and beverages.
author: Alexander Reinaldo

review_text:
Tasty wonton noodle with great texture! Reminds me of home.

Also, must try their wonton in red sauce! The spicy chili oil adds an extra kick to your tastebuds!
author: Edy Liew

review_text:
I have the opportunity to organise our recent two pickleball friendly matches recently at this fabulous relatively new air-conditioned venue at Fernvale Village@61 Fernvale Link.

The place is well organised n spacious equipped with proper seats for players n guest plus showeing facilities as well.

Surrounding the venue, there are many nice F&B outlets for players to get their carbo reload n hunger pans fixed!

The venue manager Sunyun is super friendly n accommodating.
He and his staff Madu run the venue like clockwork n are very well organised. Above all he delivers what he promises.

I have no second thought of organising future n further friendly matches there the next time.

Thanks Sunyun n team for the great job! Well done n keep it up :)

Stephen Tan
Pickleball United
Team Captain
author: Stephen Tan

review_text: Nice place to play, with air cond just sometimes too cool so cannot rest too long. Boss also helpful, i booked wrong timing able to transfer. For sure will play this place often. Just take not must early book as many people like to book this courts as well
author: Sean Star Studio

review_text:
I recently visited the newly opened badminton courts at Fernvale, and I’m really excited about this addition to the area! The facility boasts 10 well-maintained courts, which are spacious, well-lit, and have excellent flooring—perfect for both casual players and serious enthusiasts. I was there for a free trial session, and the experience was fantastic. The ambiance is welcoming, and it felt great to be back on the court pursuing my hobby of playing badminton.

One thing that stood out to me was the friendly staff. During my visit, a staff member approached me to confirm my booking details, and they were very polite and helpful. It’s always nice to feel welcomed and well taken care of, especially when trying out a new place.

That said, I haven’t tried booking a slot yet, but I’m hoping it’s easy and convenient. As someone who loves badminton, I know how challenging it can be to secure a court at popular facilities, so I’m keeping my fingers crossed that this won’t be an issue here. If the booking process is smooth, this place will definitely become my go-to spot for regular games.

Overall, I’m really impressed with the facility and the service. If you’re a badminton enthusiast in the area, I’d highly recommend giving this place a try. Here’s to hoping I can book a slot soon and continue enjoying my favorite sport!
author: William Lu

review_text: Nice rubber court which is green colour, also gives a good contrast to the shuttlecock for easy spotting. Place is maintained at a good temperature with air conditioning. Toilet is clean and have 2 shower cubicle available. Courts are consider quite near each other, that's to squeeze 10 courts into the confine space. Parking is at the nearby HDB parking. Some food options available for a quick snack
author: EQ Xavier

review_text: It's a wonderful place to play badminton, no draught from the air-conditioning, no glares from the lightings and nice contrasting background/walls.....Me and my kakis really had a good time there. Also not to forget the nice toilets with hot water and rain showers. It's just awesome 👍
author: Edmund Tan

review_text: My go-to whenever I'm at Root8Rise. Love the chicken breast & thighs, super tasty and tender. Portions are hearty! Regular gets u 1 standard protein, 3 toppings, 1 "carb". Love that they let me mix so I usually get salad veg+potatos/sweet potato. I like the wakame seaweed, honey mustard sauce.
author: J M

review_text: Takeaway the steak and avocados. Additional 3 bucks each. Steak was really tough and dry, avocados were not ripe and quite crunchy, not the proper texture. Wouldnt visit again considering the price equivalent from those sold elsewhere.
author: alvin chan

review_text: Ordered this on grab, delivery was fast. Portion is huge and super tasty. I ordered the smoked duck and chicken thigh and love them! I will have this again! Must head down to the shop and check it out one day. For now, out of convience I’m glad it’s on GrabFood. :)
author: Dolly Huang

review_text: Found a salad bowl place in sengkang with reasonable price. Normally had to get my bowl in cbd area. Portion is good and tasty.
author: Arthur D

review_text: Tried De'Salad and was pleasantly surprised! 🥗 The portions are really hearty, so you definitely get your fill. Everything tasted fresh and delicious — a great balance of flavors that makes it satisfying from start to finish. Will definitely be coming back for more!
author: C. Chng

review_text: Good vegetarian spot near Fernvale. They have enough choices on the menu. It's mostly for takeout, but they do have 2 tables with 8 seats, which is fine. Not the best place to eat in, but great for grabbing food to enjoy at home. Right now, it's PayNow only, so it'd be awesome if they added more payment options.
author: Karthick Rao

review_text:
AVOID this place unless you enjoy wasting your money. This is easily one of the worst Indian meals I’ve ever had. Every single gravy — vegetable kurma, mock curry, and channa masala — was a disaster. Oily on top, completely watered down underneath. The channa masala wasn’t even a curry, it was literally channa soup.
This isn’t bad cooking — this feels like deliberate cost-cutting by diluting everything to stretch portions. The standard is pathetic. Zero authenticity, zero quality control, zero pride in the food.
Save your money and eat somewhere else.
author: rashvin ravindran

review_text: This restaurant is only surviving on its brand name. I ordered two sets of food, but only one set was delivered, and even that was in very small quantity. The staff were extremely rude and irresponsible when I asked about the missing food. The quality was terrible—the food looked unhygienic, as if someone had already eaten from it. I will not recommend this place.
author: Kalaiselvan

review_text: Glad to see Komala's in the neighbourhood. Vadai was really delicious and the masala thosai was decent too. Unfortunately the chuntney was watery and not up to the usual standard of other Komala's outlets - hope they can improve on this.

Had not tried other dishes yet, thus can't comment much.

Overall, the service provided to me was very good and I would love to try these other nasi sambal, nasi lemak and prata dishes (except for beef and pork) from the other Combo Nasi Lemak outlets such as Canberra Street and Sumang Walk in the future.

review_text:
Yuan Ji Chicken Rice (Fernvale Road): Delicious Roasted Chicken! 4 out of 5 stars

Donkey and I cycled over to 464A Fernvale Road for dinner, and I decided to give Yuan Ji Chicken Rice a try. I was initially set on the Soy Sauce Chicken Noodle, but sadly it was sold out. No worries, I opted for the roasted chicken noodle ($4.50) and added a portion of white chicken ($1.80) so I could try both.

The chicken was delicious, tender, and flavorful. I really enjoyed the noodles too; they had a nice texture and complemented the chicken perfectly. While the soy sauce chicken noodle was unavailable, the roasted chicken was a great alternative. The overall experience was positive, making it a worthy four-star rating. I'll definitely return to try the soy sauce chicken next time!

review_text: Very good. I always eat here. Served by two nice Chinese ladies. Love their roasted chicken rice. Can use CDC vouchers. $4 for roasted chicken rice is really affordable! The rice is fragrant, chicken is tender and chili is spicy enough. Highly recommended!

review_text: Ordered mozzarella sticks and fish fingers. The mozzarella stick was about inch long only, and $2.50 for pieces, which is almost daylight robbery. author: Jovita Cyprian Ho

restaurant_name: Tenderbest Makcik Tuckshop @ Sengkang Riverside Park (No reservations only walk-ins)
review_text:
There was nobody eating around 1pm+ and staff gave us an extra menu when my partner and I sat down. Inside the menu, it was full of ants crawling on the spine.

We ordered the turkey bacon aglio olio, potato salad, bbq chicken brioche burger which came with truffle fries, set A and set B. The mushroom soup had a very strong onion taste which was nice. The aglio olio was slightly spicy, but very normal. The potato salad was amazing. The potatoes still had some texture to them while being doused in the creamy mayo sauce. The burger was drizzled with bbq sauce and was crispy, topped with a fried egg. The burger was alright, but the truffle fries made it better. The bandung was also slightly too sweet for my taste T watermelon mojito was sour and salty, with a hint of artificial watermelon flavouring.

We sat next to 2 people talking and since there was nobody else around, their conversation was extremely loud and heard very clearly by the entire room.

There is also a self-serve bar for cutlery, seasonings, kids’ utensils and even takeaway containers and plastic bags.

Service was lacking, albeit there were only 4 staff there. It took a bit for the staff to come to the register to order, but the food came out super quick.
author: Jas Koh

restaurant_name: Tenderbest Makcik Tuckshop @ Sengkang Riverside Park (No reservations only walk-ins)
review_text: 4/12/25, surprisingly the food was good. My colleague suggest this place as we were working around Sengkang area. The place set over the Sengkang garden with indoor / outdoor dining. It is more like a fast food chain except there r plenty of variety options to choose from the menu. We decide on the lunch menu (they have breakfast too). Order a Teriyaki chicken chop sedap Lemak and a crispy chicken sedap Lemak both slightly over 10 dollars with 3 dollars earl tea to go along. My teriyaki was very good, chicken tender and the chilli with rice was great. Service was fast and can top up your tea, place was ok. Good place to eat relax and talk. Recommend.

review_text: Affordable local western food. Mai hiam bei pai la. I mean you're not paying $20 for atas cafe food so don't complain so much? Just coffeeshop standard food at slightly more than coffeeshop prices but still affordable.

restaurant_name: Tenderbest Makcik Tuckshop @ Sengkang Riverside Park (No reservations only walk-ins)
review_text:
Okay, here's the review updated to include both you and Donkey:

Tenderbest (Sengkang Riverside Park): Relaxing Ambiance and Decent Seafood - Perfect for a Casual Outing! 4 out of 5 Stars

Ratings:

•	Food: 3.5/5 (Good seafood, sauces could use more punch)

•	Service: 5/5 (Attentive and efficient)

•	Atmosphere: 5/5 (Relaxing, open-air design, great views)

•	Overall: 4/5

Donkey and I recently visited Tenderbest at Sengkang Riverside Park, and it's a great spot! The service was on point, and the vibe was just right. We enjoyed the Golden Seabass and Spicy Thai Chilli Baked Fish – both were good, though we agreed that the sauces could have used a bit more punch. The open-air design, combined with the greenery and warm lighting, makes it a fantastic place to unwind after a walk in the park. Definitely worth a visit!
author: oXRYSTALo Ong

restaurant_name: Tenderbest Makcik Tuckshop @ Sengkang Riverside Park (No reservations only walk-ins)
review_text: Not a bad place for the early morning. Food is a little expensive but acceptable for a lazy morning. Garden is by the side for a after meal walk under the Singapore hot sun. Very spacious eating place that I like.

The courses served were familiar yet innovative, and every dish was enjoyable from beginning to end. I especially liked the pine nut panna cotta - something I've never seen on other menus. It was a fresh take on desserts that worked. My picture doesn't do it justice (it was taken half eaten) but it was a bite worth coming back for!

Value for money.

review_text:
Standard drop.

I USED to eat the fried kway tiao every few days, and have been a fan of the food. Hor fun is nice too.

BUT recently, I visited the store again in the day with my sister. The staff was sitting at the counter with his phone. As we approached the counter, he looked at us with the “what do you want” expression. We pointed to the menu on the table and ordered 1 fried chicken and rice, and cheese wedges, 2 chicken wings.

Perhaps there was some miscommunication, he prepared cheese fries instead of cheese wedges for us instead. I was going back to the counter and before I even reach, he said, “You said cheese fries just now.”

Nevermind.

I began eating and only when I was getting into the inner part of the chicken, I realised it was RAW.

The uncooked meat, coupled with bad customer service (i.e. sitting down as he took our orders, speaking to us as if he wants to start a fight) made me feel really disappointed.

I don’t think I’ll patronise this particular store as much as in the past.

Side note, when his co-worker arrived at work and began preparing other dishes, this staff was just seen sitting down texting on his phone smiling. Hm. It’s okay to take a break from work. But at least be serious enough to make sure that the food you serve is cooked?

review_text:
I walked in the sun for this...FYI it's nearer to Fernvale than Thanggam; don't trust Google Maps if they point you to Thanggam.

It's decent for the coffee shop price ($12.80) la but definitely not like what some other reviewers say...it's not "like Tonkichi." Not "restaurant-quality." Definitely doesn't "remind me of Japan"; the breadcrumbs are similar for sure. But that's where the resemblance ends.

Just don't expect the above and it's a pretty decent coffee shop find! The miso soup & rice are not bad. I had the pork fillet set, meat was slightly tough but still not bad. Will go back to try the black pork next!

Ordered the black pig tonkatsu, which comes with a generous amount of salad and a bowl of white rice. Not forgetting a small bowl of miso soup. The thick-cut black pig has a perfect ratio of lean meat to fats, deep fried in panko bread crumbs to attain a golden crispy skin…meat is tender and juicy…

Can eat!

review_text: Impressed with the Pork Katsu Set. They serve yellow wasabi. Really brings me back the memory I had in Japan. I would say its a very decent plate of Katsu. Miso soup was great too. For the price of 11.80, I would definitely come back again for more when I am craving for this! I feel this is on par with Japanese Restaurant in Singapore!

It was $9.8 for the pork curry and $1.50 extra for the cabbage and miso soup. Can skip the cabbage and miso soup actually. Too much sesame sauce in the cabbage for my liking.

Great portion size though. Thick juicy and crispy tonkatsu. Perfect for my sudden tonkatsu craving.

review_text:
Came here with my parents and girlfriend and we absolutely loved the food!

The sweetness of the acai was just nice and the bowl came with generous fresh fruits toppings. The bowl came with a good amount of acai in it and the fruits were fresh. I think the peanut butter on top perfectly complimented everything else.

We also tried the coconut, chocolate and durian ice-cream and were simply amazed by the taste. The coconut ice-cream was a perfect combination of coconut, fragrance and sweetness. It was a unique blend which I have never tasted elsewhere before. The durian ice-cream was creamy and it felt as if I was eating a real durian, without the durian taste being overpowering. Highly recommend to all durian lovers who are looking for a durian sweet treat.

My father seldom eats sweet stuff but actually got an additional scoop of coconut ice-cream after we had finished eating. The owner was very friendly too. We'll be back! :)

review_text:
Dulang Kampung is such a cozy spot to makan – simple, clean and really feels like home. The space is not very big, so it can get a bit full during peak hours, but that also shows how many people love eating here. The food is the main hero: their asam pedas and daging salai are really the stars – rich, flavourful and satisfying every time I come.

Just one small suggestion: I really hope they can use a bigger dulang or prepare more dulang at one time and put telur masin. Almost every visit I only manage to grab two pieces on the tray before it’s finished, so it would be nice if there were more available for customers.

We ate that for rm24 with limau ais and ais kosong.. Quite reasonable price.
Other than that, the place is clean, comfortable, they have a toilet and even a surau, so it’s very convenient for Muslims to stop by, eat and pray. Overall, a nice kampung-style place to enjoy good food – just wish there was more of it!

review_text:
Just had lunch at Dulang Kampung, and I must say what a satisfying experience! The menu offers a wide variety of authentic kampung-style Malaysian dishes. I ordered the ikan cencaru sambal, and the moment I took the first bite, it brought back warm memories of my late mum’s home-cooked meals. The sambal was rich, perfectly balanced, and full of flavour  truly comforting.

Another bonus is the convenience: there’s a car wash service right next door. So while enjoying a delicious lunch, I managed to get my car cleaned too. Great food, nostalgic vibes, and efficient service all in one stop. Definitely worth coming back!
author: Ronny Iskandar

author: Ini kamil punya Ok

review_text:
Masarap JB (Gelang Patah / Mutiara Rini area) good food potential, but service timing really killed the vibe.

First impression: the place looks simple and quite clean, with open-air seating (plastic chairs, tables outside) and a dessert display cabinet near the counter. I like that they’re organized with table numbers + QR code menu/order, and there’s a clear No Smoking sign too. Menu-wise, it’s quite a “many things in one place” spot,  you can see they offer Char Kuey Teow, Laksa Goreng, Nasi Ayam, Nasi Lemak, Buttermilk, Creamy Salted Egg, Bubur Berlauk, Western Meal, Desserts, Kids Meal, and even seasonal items like Asam Pedas / Nasi Ambang / Murtabak (Ramadhan).

Now the honest part: service was painfully late. We came around 5:05pm, but the char kuey teow cook only arrived about 5:30pm, so we ended up waiting much longer than we should for a place that’s already open. If you know your main cook comes later, please put a sign early, or update customers upfront, it saves everyone’s time.

Food wise: when it finally came, the dish was sedap, the gravy was rich, spicy, with seafood/prawns and toppings that made it super appetizing. I also like that they have proper cutlery and the dining area feels airy.

But what really needs fixing: staff attitude. Some staff looked unhappy/angry face, and the vibe felt awkward (even small things like body language matter when customers are already waiting). It doesn’t need to be “over-friendly,” but at least be polite and calm — customers can feel it.

Final thoughts:
If you come when everything is ready, you’ll probably enjoy it because the menu is wide and the food can be satisfying. But if you hate waiting, avoid early opening time (or call first). With better staffing timing + friendlier service, this place could genuinely be a favourite.

Rating: 3/5 (food ✅, atmosphere okay ✅, service timing + attitude ❌)

Instead of being helpful or asking what wrong, the server muttered to themselves, went to the kitchen, and returned to tell me—very firmly—that the drink was "fine" and could not be replaced because I had already sipped it. This outlet clearly requires serious corrective action and closer supervision, especially in terms of order management, staff communication, and customer service. This level of service is unacceptable for a well-known fast-food chain like KFC.

The tables weren't cleaned up from previous guests (unsure why visitors to a fast food restaurant can't clean up after themselves tbh but it seems many can't) but there was space to sit, even at 1pm on Saturday.
Meat quality wasn't great, as is frequently the problem with Subway but otherwise good value for money.
We all had a decent lunch and would return if in the area. Thanks.
author: Mrs E

review_text: Just yesterday me and wife decided to dine in at subway in medini mall and the guy in the picture started with asking us if we're going to dine in or take away and we said dine in to which he replied no dine in cause we're closing at 8 and we were there around 7:30pm but I still don't get why he asked us that if they're only doing take aways. So anyways while he was taking our order I asked him if they had the garlic bread to which he replied no we only have Italian and honey oat in a rude way and I didn't get him so l asked him a second time and he literally turned the bread oven towards me and said no we only have this which was so rude cause I don't remember asking him to pay for my food. After that we still paid and got our food and we still had like 10-15mins to 8pm so we decided to eat there cause we were so hungry, while we were eating the staffs were literally clearing up the tables and chairs like so rude but there was still people inside the store. I really hope the management or the owner takes action on their staffs rude and poor behaviour. Kalau tak nak kerja tak payah kerja lah, nak balik awal baik duduk rumah je.
author: Sarvin Naidu

review_text:
We were really disappointed with our recent visit. Everything we ordered turned out to be deep fried – even the satay, which was quite shocking and honestly unacceptable especially here in Malaysia where satay is a signature dish that should be grilled, not fried.

On top of that, the prices are on the higher side and the quality doesn’t match. The cake slice we ordered was ridiculously small – barely two bites – and yet it cost RM13.50. The portion size has clearly been reduced compared to before, which makes it feel like very poor value for money.

Overall, the food quality, authenticity, and value were very underwhelming. Definitely not what we expected from Secret Recipe.
author: Sheelaa S

review_text: Tried Secret Recipe near Legoland in Mall of Medini - ordered the curry mee and satay. the curry mee was super yummy and really hit the spot! the satay was juicy and not dry at all. Just heads up though, they charge for a glass of warm eater. But overall, foods worth it.
author: Mostly Harmless and Curious

review_text: A small outlet of SR restaurant. The waiter doesn’t really understand what I said though since he is a foreigner. We asked which menu would be the fastest to serve as we were in a hurry but he just said “all of the menu is available” 😅 Taste wise, same as all other outlets.
author: Miey

review_text:
I decide to nom nom here because i saw bichi mao

So cute i wanna own that bichi mao plushie

I ordered many things include 2 slice of cake to get that bichi mao..

Overall food was below expectation

Restaurant was clean and neat.. but they put plastic for the under chair legs.. it makes chair slippery i saw kid fall from chaie bc of it.. i forgot to tell the restaurant manager about it but i hope they read this and do the improvement..
author: Netty Mustika

review_text:
Location inside medini mall. Indoor and outdoor seating available.

Food is usual nothing exemplary. Like the usual taste from hawkers in Singapore. Good for the hungry.

Service was terrible. The food came so late like 50 mins for a salad. Granted they were short handed. But they should've given a heads up that service would be long or an update to the least.

Price was reasonable.

If not only with its location close to legoland and other shops being full,  maybe we wont have dined in.

But I've wanted to praise one male service staff (didnt get his name) for being so lively on serving. Maybe its the kitchen staff that was short handed.
author: Ef Si

restaurant_name: O'Briens Irish Sandwich Cafe @ Gleneagles Medini Hospital
review_text:
Sandwich is great, service is poor.

To the lady cashier who serve me during the afternoon shift:

Obviously you saw me I was carrying a baby with both hands, I need some help to see the menu.

When I said "tak nampak", why u so astonished, and replied "TAK NAMPAK?!" in such a high tone?

You seriously need to manage your attitude well lady.
author: Ng Chin Thai

restaurant_name: O'Briens Irish Sandwich Cafe @ Gleneagles Medini Hospital
review_text: Visited this shop for third times again, there is no changes for their dishes especially wrap chicken. Eventhough no chilli or sauce to dip with it, the taste so great and crispy. Honestly, I have ordered for 2nd wrap chicken for my spouse and mother in law. They prepared the sandwiches freshly and we can visually check on their foods. I do like this style of food preparation because transparency.The environment in this shop not noisy because they are inside the hospital.
author: Kim Long Wong

restaurant_name: O'Briens Irish Sandwich Cafe @ Gleneagles Medini Hospital
review_text:
Very disappointed with the O’Briens outlet at Gleneagles Medini. According to Google, they close at 7:00 PM — yet for two days in a row, they were already refusing customers well before that. On May 6th, I arrived at 6:30 PM and was told they were done for the day, with everything packed up. Today, May 7th, I came even earlier at 5:45 PM, only to find the staff already stopped taking order and the staff start cleaning up.

If your closing time is 7:00 PM, why are you shutting down over an hour early? Either update your official hours on google and your website or train your staff properly. This kind of laziness and disregard for customers is unacceptable. I hope the management takes this seriously — clearly, the staff are not doing their jobs.
author: Hasrin Mohd

restaurant_name: O'Briens Irish Sandwich Cafe @ Gleneagles Medini Hospital
review_text:
No hair nets, No aprons,
disappointing hygiene measures.
I did feedback last time, but no improvement when I re-visit this store.
author: Lay Lee

restaurant_name: O'Briens Irish Sandwich Cafe @ Gleneagles Medini Hospital
review_text: Excellent sandwich cafe. It's situated within the Gleneagles Hospital but has its own space and outdoor seating. They have excellent ingredients and they serve coffee too. It's above average priced but it seems worth it because of the quality of servings.
author: Pavan Kumar

review_text:
First time trying and the food did not dissapoint! We came around 7pm and were the only customers so the food arrived quickly.

We ordered:
- Cajun beef pasta 8/10
- Chicken and mushroom pasta 9/10
- Pepperoni pizza 8/10
- French Onion soup 10/10

The pasta had generous portion of meat and mushroom and the taste is on point. Personal preference is the chicken one rather than beef cajun. but both are above average good.

Pizza’s crust was made by hand and freshly made per order. Super airy but with the right thickness making it soft but filling to the tummy. Even my 1 year old enjoying the pizza!

Wanting to try the other French food staples like Steak fries and the other pizza selections for another time. Keep up the good work to DP team!

p/s: currently they have buy 2 pasta free 1 pizza offer.
author: Maryam Zamberi

review_text: It is not an authentic French restaurant, lets just get that out of the way first. They seem to serve more of what that is Italian - pizza and pastas. Not French dishes. Putting a French-sounding name on a menu item does not make it French. 😅Nevertheless still willing to give this a chance. First impression - need to fix staffing issues. It was 7pm, dinnertime, but there was only 1 person manning the entire restaurant. Yes. Kitchen, orders, cashier, everything. He was busy making another family's order that he did not even come to ask for my order. I waited for around 10mins before I decided to walk over and just tell him my order. Then, it was a long wait for food. Another person who was waiting also cancelled his order and left. Finally I just told him to takeaway my pizza instead of dining in because this is taking too long. Really not the staff's fault... he was very nice and kindly. Just cannot cope alone. The pizza oven they are using is also not a woodfire oven, even though it looks like there is one, it was not functioning. Instead he was using this little metal pizza stove to cook the pizzas. I ordered a blue cheese turkey pizza. Again... another mismatch. When you order a blue cheese pizza... normally it is expected to be served with a white sauce / cream sauce. Not tomato sauce. So this was an absolute "huh" moment for me when I saw the pizza. The flavours as a result was just strange. Just wrong. The turkey also is just regular turkey ham actually.  Really sorry... I felt it did not justify the pricetag either.  But I hope they can brush up their service and improve over time.  Especially fix staffing issues.
author: Kimberley Howarth

review_text:
Amazing concept in the quiet neighbourhood. Definitely something different than dining at the malls or fast foods.

Came here & expecting a long waiting time for the food but everything came out tasty & rather quick(depending on how much you ordered).

Despite running a 'Buy 2 pastas, get 1 pizza' promo, the food they put on out is exceptional. Portion for me, & I'm a guy who need his carbs, is more than enough if not more.

5 minutes away from Legoland, this was my
first option when I clicked on Google Maps(& I rarely come in to this part of Johor).
author: Ibni Sharin

review_text:
It was 10/10 both taste- and experience-wise. We can taste the truffle from the pizza, unlike other places. The mushroom chicken spaghetti is definitely a must for first-timers; it was very creamy and they are very generous with the amount of chicken pieces.

They also entertained my request to change the prawn to chicken, as I'm unable to eat prawn.

We will definitely repeat this!
author: Marinah Haziqah

review_text:
Ordered truffle pepperoni pizza, chicken momo & beef Cajun pasta.
Pizza was super soft and sooo good! Second time here with family — loved it
author: Alyana

restaurant_name: Restoran Al Falah JB ( nasi kandar mamu ar)
review_text:
Affordable price and big portion.
VIP naan is cheese naan covered in chocolate sauce (abit unusual in my opinion), other than that service is good, waiting time took about 15-20mins for 6 packs of food.
author: Ardiana Ichsan

restaurant_name: Restoran Al Falah JB ( nasi kandar mamu ar)
review_text:
Had good experience
Staff were good
Vegetarian Maggi Goreng among the best in Malaysia (I ordered 4pm) as chef may differ at other timings.
Second time having Maggi goreng Vege here at 4pm ish, same good taste
author: Prem Ananth T Selvarajah

restaurant_name: Restoran Al Falah JB ( nasi kandar mamu ar)
review_text: Its ok. The place is clean and well ventilated. Staff are pleasant and friendly. Food is ok. Not bad, but also not amazing. Prices reasonable... just a quick and easy place to come fill your tummy in a rush. Convenient and easy to  find parking.
author: Kimberley Howarth

restaurant_name: Restoran Al Falah JB ( nasi kandar mamu ar)
review_text: I had difficulty speaking English with them but the staffs are patience to listen to my order. After repeating several times, there is still 1 order not ordered but can see their effort into in for us. Ordered a beehoon goreng, it was the wok hey taste. Prata is freshly make on the spot. Naan is my disappointment. I ordered a garlic naan, it doesn’t hv garlicky taste at all and it wasn’t bake till crispy.
author: Clo’s Laobu

restaurant_name: Restoran Al Falah JB ( nasi kandar mamu ar)
review_text:
Overall nice and great food! Staff are friendly! Clean environment.

Nasi Kandar with mixed sauced poured onto your rice! Not bad, i love the ayam kicap but the onions on the telur kicap was going bad.

Recommend to visit earlier so that the food are fresh! We went after 4pm.. so abit in between meal times...

slightly under RM50 for our 2 plates of rice with delicious dishes, 2 coke and 1 watermelon juice. Feels a little pricey but we did have 2 meat each and taste good!
author: Qistheena Lok

review_text: The food was superb. Fast service and got plenty of menus also considering it’s a newly opened place. Will definitely come here again
author: Amirah Tasnim

review_text: Good morning this is my second visit here and we like, love all the experience that we have everything is very excellent service All the server was very friendly and accommodating, the foods quality are very good, most specially the place is so vibrant and refreshing. Most recommended to all family, friends, and relatives to dine with ❤️ 💯
author: Janet Acutem

review_text: Nice cafe in a quiet town. All the dishes I ordered are nice. The sambal chili is awesome. Surprisingly the fried chicken is tender n not dry type. The seafood noodle soup is delicious. Will come again next round.
author: Terence LIM

review_text: Great place to eat with a comfortable atmosphere. The staff were attentive and polite, making the dining experience very pleasant.
author: Lisa Surachi

review_text: Nice place, seems like newly opened. Wide variety of local food to choose. The prawn noodles broth is quite spicy, not as flavourful. Wouldn’t order this again.
author: Hedge Jey

review_text: The nasi lemak served on banana leaf looks delicious! 🍚 The dish includes fragrant rice, fried chicken, egg, and sambal. They also have other breakfast dishes we manage to get a bite on the toast , Mee Siam and also some kuih. Not forgetting the pulut panggang is too die for . Overall taste was awesome – flavorful and satisfying. Definitely recommend trying this traditional Malaysian breakfast! 👍
author: Reen Khan

review_text: The food was enjoyable. The sambal served with the nasi lemak and sambal kerang was well balanced—flavourful without being overly spicy—making it suitable for diners of various ages who can tolerate some heat. The teh tarik was well prepared and not overly sweet. Overall, the pricing was reasonable for the quality offered.
author: Nurazlina Shamsudin

review_text:
Wide variety of food and beverages, all well-prepared and full of flavour.

The ambience is cozy and inviting, complemented by swift and attentive service that makes the dining experience even more enjoyable ❤️
author: nysa ramly

review_text:
You can have indoor and outdoor seating for your snacks/meals. Meals can be ordered via the QR application provided on the table.
We came in late morning and noted that the quiet number of food on the displayed tray has been consumed.
Each table is provided with 4 wooden stools, and additional stools or comfort chairs are required. Aircon and fan is provided within the premises.
Staff are friendly and helpful in getting additional chairs and high chairs for kids.
Service is fast after the order has been made via QR application.
Two toilets provided with 2 wash basin available outside the toilet.  Musollah is available before the WC.
author: Zulkifli BMO

review_text: breakfast. The presentation, taste, and variety were excellent, with so many delicious options to choose from. I found this place on Google and liked it so much that my family and I went back for 2 days in a row during our vacation. The food and drinks were great, and the place itself was comfortable and clean. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to enjoy an authentic Malay breakfast. Proce very reasonable, cost us only rm26 for nasi lemak kerang, mihun chicken, 4 types of kuih, drinks for 2.
author: Fira Saiful

review_text: Very clean and comfy eatery. Nice ambience too. Food was great; for the mains, I had Nasi Goreng Kampung followed with Cucur Udang and Goreng Pisang. Didn’t disappoint, food tasted great and the portions were just nice too. Before leaving, bought the kueh bakar, Pandan, Pisang and Lauk. BEST! 👍🏽👍🏽👍🏽🔥🔥🔥
author: Hafiz Salem

review_text: This café is a great place for kuih bakar lovers. They offer lots of flavours, and each one is delicious and fragrant. The kuih bakar is soft, moist, and perfectly baked. Every bite tastes fresh and homemade. Definitely worth visiting if you want to try different varieties of kuih bakar in one place. 👍✨
author: Sri Devi Ramalinggam

review_text:
Came here a few months ago for breakfast, courtesy of a generous friend (always the best kind of visit). The outlet was impressively clean and nicely decorated, clearly curated to match the theme. Points for aesthetics!!

They serve local Malay breakfast items like cokodok. Do be mentally prepared; this is not your roadside-stall pricing. It’s a rather premium cokodok experience, shall we say. That said, the taste stays true to its traditional roots, which I actually enjoyed, so at least the flavour didn’t get “modernised” along with the price tag.

I had a cup of kopi kampung (if memory serves me right), which did its job well. The kuih bakar is the main attraction here and very much the hype item. My friend even bought two varieties for me to take home. Unfortunately, one of them leaned a bit too dry and didn’t quite win over my taste buds.

Overall, it was a different breakfast experience. Might come back again… mainly to see what else on the menu is living up to the hype. 😌
author: zeta omar

review_text:
Ordered 2 nasi goreng takeaway today for buka puasa and this is the portion i got. seems like 3-5 spoonfuls for RM30!! this is unacceptable. The portion is way way way lesser compared to other shops like mamak or Kanteen31 which costs much lesser for a huge portion.

my last time here. do not support this shop!
author: t cl

review_text: Loved the lauk kampung in mangkuk tepen, so nostalgic! Breakfast and lunch were tasty and the kueh bakor is a must-try. Nice family spot, but staff service could be better and internet is weak.
author: Hasymah

review_text: Keep driving past this place and keep meaning to come and try their ayam penyet. Today I finally made it, but they told me their ayam has already sold out. And it was just 11am+... haha. Oh well no luck. They are very efficient... everything is done thru a QR code. Ordering and even paying! So I could just order and pay together straightaway in one easy go. The staff is very pleasant and friendly. I ended up trying the daging salai masak lemak, which was a real treat in itself. The sauce was thick and creamy. The portion size is also large for 1 person. Lots of smokey beef inside, and green beans. It was VERY SPICY however! Great for chili lovers.
author: Kimberley Howarth

review_text:
Ayam Penyet Banjir at Versis Medini is a fantastic spot for fans of authentic Indonesian-style smashed fried chicken.

The ayam penyet here is crispy on the outside and tender inside, generously topped with their signature sambal banjir — spicy, aromatic, and full of flavour.

The sambal really brings the dish to life, especially when paired with the fragrant rice and fresh sides.

The staff are friendly and service is quick, making it a pleasant dining experience whether you’re eating in or taking away. A must-try if you love bold flavours and hearty, satisfying meals at reasonable prices.

#AyamPenyetBanjir #VersisMedini #JBFoodie #IndonesianCuisine #SpicyFoodLovers #JohorEats #ComfortFoodMY #AyamPenyet
author: Brian Wong

review_text: So happy to find another nice penyet house around the area! I tried cili hijau and lemak cili api with ikan keli, and they both tasted very good! Both cili not too spicy so it’s great for me and people who couldn’t consume too much spiciness. Their tempe has daun selasih if I’m not wrong, which tastes even better than others. Lemak cili api goes very well with plain rice. Ikan keli fresh. And the teh  tarik, at first too sweet although I ordered kurang manis but after their staff adjusted for me it’s spot on. Rare nice teh tarik you could find around here (better than the mamak next to it I would say). So overall very recommended.
author: Dion L

review_text:
Lemak Ciliapi 👍
Very fragrant and distinctive aroma.

Ayam Penyet 🫲
Nice presentation. Chicken not bad. Sambal chilli lacked punch.

Assam pedas 🫲
Gravy was flavourful and well balanced. But ikan pari was dry and overcooked. Rm17.50 for 3 tiny pieces of fish not worth it.

Bakso 🫲
Soup was good but the meat balls were of low quality.

Teh tarik 👎
author: Victor Ng

review_text: Best nasi ayam penyet around. Friendly owner and staffs. Regular there, their udang Lemak chili padi and fish head curry,highly  recommended.
author: RAbdul 32

review_text: Tried their nasi ayam penyet with cucur bilis, both were actually good. The chicken was crunchy (loved that!) and the sambal was really spicy. They have a wide range of menu options, from local to western, plus snacks. You can sit indoors with air-conditioning or outside, the indoor area just feels a bit cramped. Overall, not bad for a quick meal.
author: Hasymah

review_text: The authenticity and boldness of the flavors are breathtaking. Each dish delivered a perfect punch of taste that was both exciting and deeply satisfying. The atmosphere was cozy and inviting perfect for long catch-up. Service was friendly, prompt and attentive.
author: Jadal Mustapha

review_text:
Tried their Claypot Sambal Udang. Prawn was fresh and firm, while the sambal is delicious. Cucur pisang also was good alongside my hot kopi o.

Will surely come here again!
author: Zulasyraf Muhammad

review_text:
Ikan merah asam at Nenda Plates never disappoint your weekend dinner.The aromatic of daun kesum,spicy comfort food that represents Johor’s robust cooking style. Not for the faint of heart, but unforgettable when done right.
Cozy place & intimate.Nice lighting,clean place & relaxing.
author: Nurain Mohd Alip

review_text: Perfect! Came for Iftar for three timessss becoz the service is super tiptop and the owner and the waiters are so super nice and kind and polite. I didn’t make mistakes for choosing this place for Iftar unlike the place that I went for Iftar in pontian (D TAMBAK CORNER- very POOR services with very BAD attitude from the owner and workers). So blessed to get a great Iftar in nenda plates. Kudos to the owner! May you have more rizq in your life for being such a good person ☺️😊 my husband lovessssss the food here so much! Hahah
author: Азхар야니

review_text: I ordered from here via ShopeeFood and the whole process was very smooth and fast. It was my first time trying this place and I was pleasantly surprised by how delicious everything was. I really loved the mashed potatoes, the chicken was super crispy, and the burger bun was very soft. Totally worth every penny, especially when paired with the drink — such a perfect combo. 10/10 experience, I’m very happy. Thank you for the great food!
author: Aireen

review_text: I had a great experience at Richeese Factory. The food was delicious, especially the chicken and cheese sauce — rich in flavor and very satisfying. The service was good, and the staff were friendly and helpful. The place was clean and comfortable, making it a nice spot to enjoy a meal. Overall, I really enjoyed my visit and would definitely come back again.
author: De Raa

review_text: I always come here to complete my assignment. There's a lot of choise of food and for those who dont like spicy , do not worry guys ! richeese will fix you. They have non-spicy choice also. The servise also friendly like they will match ure vibes AHAHAHAH. I will come again
author: shyki .s

review_text: Very large and spacious outlet, clean and pleasant too. Quite a lot of people were doing takeaways, and the staff at the counter were visibly very busy getting orders ready. Orders are made at a self-service kiosk, where you can pay with card or e-wallet. I had some questions about the menu (as I heard Richeese Factory is famous for extra spicy foods), so I had to interrupt a member of staff to ask for help. She was very sweet and friendly, and in spite of running around busy preparing orders, she still took the time to stop, help me, and give me a recommendation too! (Atomic is level 1 spicy and Nuclear is level 3 spicy haha). I ordered a Rich chicken burger and a Fire beef burger, Atomic level sauce. Food arrived very fast in spite of the rush! And I must say it is very delicious. The beef burger was quite thin and small... but the taste was good. The Rich chicken burger had a thicker, juicier patty and was just as delicious. Overall a very good experience indeed.
author: Kimberley Howarth

review_text:
I recently had a meal at Richeese Factory, and honestly, it was so satisfying! The moment I walked in, the place smelled amazing — that mix of cheesy and spicy aroma that instantly makes you hungry.

I ordered their famous Fire Chicken with the Cheese Dip, and wow, the flavor didn’t disappoint at all. The chicken was crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside, and when dipped into that warm, creamy cheese — it was pure heaven. The spiciness level was just right for me; enough to give that kick but not too overwhelming.

The staff were friendly and helpful too. They served my order quite fast, even though the place was a bit crowded. The restaurant was clean and cozy, making it a nice spot to enjoy a casual meal with friends or even alone.

I also tried their pink lava drink, and it was surprisingly refreshing — sweet, creamy, and a perfect balance to the spicy chicken. Overall, it was a great experience. I’d definitely come back again for the Fire Chicken and Cheese Dip combo!

If you’re craving something cheesy, spicy, and finger-licking good, Richeese Factory is definitely worth it!
author: Khairun Najmi

review_text: Been trying to come here, but everytime I visit, even tho the sign says open, the place looks closed with the lights off and nobody there. Today I took a chance and shouted "Hello?" And someone came out and turned on the lights and a/c. 😅 haha.... oh well. The menu seems to be largely Indian... even tho they advertised as a Tex-Mex restaurant. I ordered a steak quesadilla, as that was what I came for... I was craving some Mexican food. The staff were very friendly. Food took a bit long to arrive... and when it did, it did not look like a quesadilla at all and more like a burrito. Haha. But actually the taste is not bad. Everything is nicely presented. The sauces and condiments taste really good actually. It came with a side of rice and fried potatoes too. The steak unfortunately was very tough and overdone... so perhaps this dish is better with chicken, as I see it is a cooking issue. They do try quite hard I think, the waiter was very attentive and made sure I had everything I needed. Perhaps worth giving them a 2nd try.
author: Kimberley Howarth

review_text:
Came for lunch. First time trying cuz craving for Mexican food. We were a bit skeptical because there wasn’t anyone around BUT the food was delicious!

It all tastes freshly made. All hot. Spices were great. My friend complimented on their fries & the patty.

This place is really a “Don’t judge a book by it’s cover” vibe. Wanna try more foods.

The waiter gave good service. Will come again. Will recommend.
author: Allysha Dennis (Allys)

review_text:
Went for Mexican food but we ordered a mix of North Indian and Mexican food. We found out the restaurant has a mixed menu.

Quesadilla was flavourful and loaded with olives and cheese. The pull was legit. It was so good we wolfed it down and we only managed to get a half eaten photo of it. Althought there were only 3 pieces, they were rich portions. We were expecting more portions because of the price point.

Our favourite was their chicken tikka masala and garlic butter naans. Chicken was so tender we thought it to be fish fillets and the peppers and thick gravy complemented each other. The naan had a generous topping and was fluffy yet crispy thin.

The chocolate ice blended was too thick for my liking but my partner liked it.

We ordered add on mexican rice, chicken soup and chilli soup for RM 5 (which got us curious) but I just realised now as I was typing my review that we we not served this.

Their salsa condiment was rather strange. It tasted more like an Asian ginger chilli paste than a diced tomato salsa condiment we are used to. Maybe this is another style of making salsa?

The loaded french fries was a portion fit for 2-3 and they had a nice dust of chilli powder though it was not overpowering. I would suggest maybe more paprika /chilli dust  to suit the local palate?

Price wise, it is definitely not cheap because each dish is between RM 20-30. But you would expect similar price range from other restaurants of this quality.

Other dishes that caught our eyes were their fajitas and rogan josh which we plan on trying next time.

We liked their taste and although did not order much Mexican food to give a solid review for now, I can easily vouch for their Indian/Pakistani food here. It was rich and flavourful.

Thanks to the waiters for being so mindful. He even offered me drinks upon realising I did not order any for myself. I was just too full that day.
author: Ganeswaran Dev

review_text:
Very nice dinner experience here. Owner and staffs were attentive, helpful and hospitable. Since we're not used to Mexican food, the staff helped explained which dish is nice and consist of what.

We really loved the taco dish as our appetizer, the taste is on point, and the condiment (which has cilantro in it) tasted sooo good. The casadillas, and chicken soup with tortilla were all tasty and splendid. Not an expert on Mexican food, but good food is, well, good food. Our casadillas was ordered with mexican rice and chilli as sides. The chili tasted awesome, but the mexican rice is so-so. Personally, I would order the chili dish separately next time to get bigger portion, it was that good. The mexican rice, I would skip.

As for the cajun chipotle pasta, tasted great but I personally preferred a bit more cajun spices and salt. The heat level is on the upper level, so those who like spicy food, this is for you.

There are kid menus too, so we ordered mac and cheese with chicken fingers. The chicken fingers were too spicy for my kids (they have zero tolerant to heat unfortunately), but a blessing, because they were really juicy and flavourful, us parents gladly finished them all off. I think cajun spice was used.

Beverages that we ordered; avocado and mango smoothies were great. Very pleasantly surprised the drinks are not packed with sweetener. So we got to let our kids enjoyed the fruit smoothies guilt-free.

Overall, very satisfied with the food and service. Price is in the middle range but totally worth it for the authentic Mexican food experience. All the best and keep up the good work for the owner and crews!
author: Maryam Zamberi

review_text:
Service was good and server was attentive, but imo the food can be mediocre.

We ordered beef fajitas and the beef was super overdone and dry. You literally have to eat the cuts of beef WHOLE as it was too tough to bite. The other sides were average.

Garlic naan is standard, tandoori chicken is juicy but slightly too sour for my liking and small in portion size.

review_text:
Came here with and on the recommendation of an actual Vietnamese friend for dinner at 7pm. She says this restaurant offers the most authentic Viet food in JB.

She also remarked that it tastes even better than the original outlet at Skudai :-D

Restaurant was mostly empty on a Saturday evening, though it became half-full by 8pm.

The cashier is a young Vietnamese-Chinese mother. Her ~10yo son takes orders in Chinese (and some English), but customers can request the mom to help out if there's a need to customize a dish order.

Food quality and portion were excellent.

We ordered the following for 3 adults:

S01 Fried Spring Roll (RM 12.9 for 16 bite-size pc) - really airy crispy @@

S05 Viet Pancake (RM 15.90) - no water is provided in the rice paper container. Just use the moisture from the fresh veg to soften the rice paper.

S08 Sour&Spicy Green Papaya Salad (RM 15.90)

B5 Banh Mi Thit Heo Nuong (Lemongrss Grilled Pork Viet Baguette)(RM 13.90) - Really crispy bun with moist delicious meat filling!

P1 Pho Bo (Beef Noodle Soup)(RM 12.90) - solid but not overly salty soup

V1 Bun Thit Heo Nuong (Lemongrss Grilled Pork Vermicelli) (RM 14.90) - excellent frying of the pork

M4 Mi Xao Thit Heo Nuong (Lemongrss Grilled Pork Fried Noodles) (RM 15.90)

D7 Peppermint Lime (RM 7.90)

D05 Thai Green Milk Tea (RM 5.90)

D8 Avocado Smoothie (RM 10.90) - BIG. Enough for 2-3 pax

Note
----
Drinking Water (RM 0.50)

Tissue paper from white boxes attached to the wall.

Takeaway charge (RM 1)

They are available on GrabFood too.

Toilet is outside the eatery. Turn left after leaving main exit.

Plenty of parking

Baby chairs available.

Wide aisles between tables.

review_text:
The Pizza Mania restaurant inside Legoland offers the comfort of an indoor, air-conditioned setting, which is a welcome relief from the heat, especially after a day of exploring the park. However, be prepared for a bustling atmosphere, as the restaurant is typically packed with families and children, making it a lively but crowded dining spot.

The highlight of the meal was undoubtedly the pizza, which is freshly made and served hot. The crust was crisp, and the toppings were flavorful, making it a satisfying choice for a quick meal. However, the experience was marred by the disappointing quality of other menu items. The mushroom soup, in particular, was a major letdown. It was so watered down that it tasted more like mushroom-flavored water than a proper soup. The lack of richness and flavor made it one of the worst soups I’ve ever had.

Additionally, if you’re planning a late lunch, be aware that many food items tend to sell out by that time. This can limit your options and might leave you with fewer choices than expected.

Overall, while Pizza Mania delivers on its main attraction—the pizza—the overall dining experience is somewhat diminished by the crowded environment, poor quality of side items like the mushroom soup, and the limited menu availability during late lunch hours. If you’re looking for a decent slice of pizza, it’s a solid option, but be prepared for some disappointments along the way.

review_text:
A Flavorful Feast at Tasty King Cafe

If you're on the hunt for a culinary experience that combines comfort with excellence, Tasty King Cafe is the place to be. Their menu boasts a delightful array of dishes, but two standouts that truly shine are their Chicken Cutlet and Chicken Chop.

Chicken Cutlet:

The Chicken Cutlet at Tasty King Cafe is nothing short of perfection. This dish features a succulent, perfectly seasoned chicken breast, lightly breaded and fried to a crispy golden-brown. The cutlet's exterior offers a satisfying crunch, while the inside remains juicy and tender. Accompanied by a tangy, homemade dipping sauce, this dish is a testament to the cafe's commitment to quality and flavor. The balance of seasoning is spot-on, allowing the natural taste of the chicken to shine through without being overpowered.

Chicken Chop:

The Chicken Chop is another standout on the menu, offering a different but equally delicious experience. The chop is generously portioned and grilled to perfection, with a smoky char that enhances the savory flavors. The seasoning is robust yet harmonious, making each bite a flavorful journey. Served with a side of creamy mashed potatoes and crisp, fresh vegetables, this dish provides a satisfying and well-rounded meal.

Other Delights:

Beyond these highlights, Tasty King Cafe offers a range of other delectable dishes that are worth exploring. From their vibrant salads to hearty sides, every item is crafted with the same attention to detail and commitment to flavor. The cafe's cozy atmosphere and friendly staff further enhance the dining experience, making it a perfect spot for both casual meals and special occasions.

In summary, Tasty King Cafe is a gem that delivers on taste and quality. Whether you're indulging in their Chicken Cutlet, savoring the Chicken Chop, or trying any of their other mouthwatering offerings, you're in for a treat. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy a memorable meal in a welcoming setting.
