review_text:
The restaurant at the Legoland Water Park can get quite busy during lunchtime, often leading to long queues as visitors line up for food. Be prepared for a bit of a wait, as the time it takes to get your meal can be longer than expected, especially during peak hours.

Despite the wait, the food quality is somewhat mixed. On the positive side, the fried chicken and onion rings stand out, offering a surprisingly delicious and satisfying option. The fried chicken is crispy on the outside and juicy inside, while the onion rings are golden and crunchy, making them a great choice for a quick meal.

However, the Nasi Lemak, a popular local dish, falls short of expectations. It's fairly average in taste.
author: Wesley Wong

review_text: Great staff and great food.
author: Md Scid

review_text: The fast food restaurants inside the amusement park had decent food, but the prices were twice the normal rate. It was extremely hot and humid at lunchtime. Both restaurants in the park sold the same food; there weren't many choices.
author: iMax

review_text: The menu is interesting, nasi lemak and chicken rice are very delicious. The quantity and quality are also the best but the prices are a little steep. Keep up the good work guys.
author: shah putel

review_text: Not much of choice but very expensive, everything that you will expect from a monopoly in-house theme park restaurant. Crowded, strong aircond, food taste mehhhh, simple menu, expensive, self-service….all these are on the list. Seriously I hope they can take some initiative to improve the food quality please. There is also not too much menu for customer to see when they are in the queue, everyone spend some time at the cashier counter to check the menu and ale order, basically making the order time longer and the queue longer plus not all cashier counters are opened even during weekend. So…. You know la… long wait.
author: siauhwa tew

review_text:
I think this is the best place to eat at Legoland. We tried Roast chicken and tasted so good, we dont have any regret buying above usual price (as expected on theme park restaurant). The serving and taste honestly justifies the price.
We also got one drink and ice pop in the package.
author: Achmadhana Putratama

review_text:
Love this place! Very spacious, full of cute Lego statues as it’s venue decoration!

The food price is reasonable at this tourist locations. Food is still alright but the kids love the ice cream that comes from the food package :)

All in all, the experience is really great!
author: Ivan Phay

review_text: The roast chicken we had was tasty and serving size is good. I can say that you can come and grab a meal here if you want to eat something to make you full.
author: Carla Carlota Manauis, DMD

review_text:
One of the largest, if not largest restaurant in Legoland, offering Asian & Western Cuisine (in Lego City)

Expect long queues, not just for the food, but also tables and chairs.

Ordering system - CONFUSING. You first need to queue to order and pay at the cashier counter BEFORE you queue to collect food from the long collection counters with TV menu displays. We were confused and ended up queueing 20 min at the collection counter before we were told we first need to pay at the cashier!
SUGG to Management: Put up CLEAR signages on the procedure for ordering and collecting food.

Combos come with a dessert and/or soft drink and generally offer better deals:

- Mac & Cheese combo (RM 37)
- Pasta Vegetarian (RM 35)
- Pasta Vegetarian combo (RM 38)
- Turkey Toast Carbonara (RM 34)
- Roast Chicken Rice (RM 36)
- Roast Chicken Rice combo (RM 40)
- Biryani Chicken Rice combo (RM 42)
- Fish & Chips (RM 35)
- Fish & Chips combo (RM 42)
- 6pc Chicken Nuggets + 9pc Smiles Fries Fish fingers (RM 23)
- 5pc Fish Fingers + 9pc Smiles Fries Fish fingers (RM 23)
- Baked Spring Chicken Confit w Green Pea Mashed Pumpkin (RM 48)
- Fruit Cups, desserts & ice-cream
author: Yong Hui, Ronny Tan

review_text: Just today I visited this cafeteria the Cafe. Really wonderful 😊 delicious 😋🤤 moments with a cup of hot mocha and tempting tiramisu with good quantity and tastes good 😊. If you visit Legoland Definitely can try your favorite coffee ☕ varieties and pastries and patisseries of your favorite at the Cafe.
author: Adhil Arshath

review_text: Food was surprisingly good for a theme park. Price was high for Malaysia standard but normal for theme park. Service was okay. Very crowded during lunch time and we packed and eat outside in the theme park.
author: K J

review_text: honestly i didn't expect their food to be so good when I first got here. they have a pretty decent selection of food. ordered a  lasagna and a chicken wrap. both have a quite large portion for me, and both tasted great!!! it's a bit pricey here, but considering it's inside a theme park, then i think it's ok. note that there's a discount for annual pass holders.
author: Adi

review_text: Service is good. Food is ok but nothing special as you cant expect good food inside theme park. We ordered lasagna & spaghetti which are ok and our kids can enjoy them.
author: Roland Permana

review_text:
International place. Danish prices and I guess the cook is an Englishman.

If I visit Legoland Malaysia again I will not eat here.
author: Erik Öberg

review_text: 1st time here... thank you. the Black thorn is nice.. and the family enjoy it! service was great. the price is affordable. Both the bosses they give quality fruit and very helpful. No pressure sell.
author: Ayu Azame

review_text: we ordered black thorn only for rm 115 , so good so nice ,service by the guy very good
author: nur suhada

review_text: So convenient to have this right outside the carpark of Legoland Hotel. Staff and nice and patient and explains to us the different durians. Ample seating and there’s hand gloves available too. The MSW we had today was fantastic! Will come back again tomorrow
author: Denzil Kiang

review_text: The young boss and the lady staff are very friendly, The service is excellent, they picked the most suitable durian for my family. We fumbled on our payment method, and they are very patient with us. The eating area is brightly lit with fan to cool us down. Tissue box and plastic gloves are provided for our usage too. The durian is very high quality and value for money. Must come again and again.
author: ada lian

review_text:
I got my hands on some Musang King durian, and it absolutely lived up to the hype. The flesh was a beautiful golden yellow, soft and creamy with a slightly fibrous texture. The taste was rich with a perfect balance of sweetness.

What really made the experience even better was the outstanding customer service. The staff were friendly, knowledgeable, and incredibly patient in helping me choose the best durians. They explained the differences between varieties, and even replaced one piece that wasn’t up to standard, no fuss at all. It’s clear they care about quality and customer satisfaction.

Clean seating area, prompt service, and a great atmosphere. This wasn’t just a durian stop, it was a memorable experience. Highly recommend both the durian and the team behind it!
author: MASRURAH ADENAN

review_text: The workers were very friendly and welcoming. The lamb had a touch of char and is very well done by the chefs. The pepperoni pizza was probably the best pizza I have ever tasted and the matcha late was exquisite and the mushroom soup was creamy and delicious. The place is very fancy and peaceful. I suggest going to the restaurant on weekdays to avoid a queue.
author: Selina

review_text:
The only restaurant you will ever want to eat while staying in Legoland hotel Malaysia. The first dish serve, which is the carbonara caught us surprise as we weren’t expecting a resort hotel restaurant food to be good (after the Hong Kong Disneyland experience….) but it was really good, than the pizza served next was also fantastic, the crust texture taste a bit like machi….. the cod first taste was a bit plain though, most likely due to the fish was kept too long or did not froze (or defrost) properly 🤔 but the side was fresh and fantastic.  Hence the culinary was good, but the freshness of the ingredient might degrade it 🤣
Overall, definitely give it a try if you are staying in the hotel, you won’t regret it (compare to the other 2 options….)
author: Uncle Kiang

review_text: I usually consider hotel restaurant only as last resort, i.e. bad weather, etc. but this was very good, beyond my expectations.
author: Kah Man Leow

review_text:
Very nice restaurant inside Legoland.
Staff is professional and responsive.
The food is great, we arrived at 5pm and no waiting time.
Carbonara, Pizza and Fillet Beef all great.
Dessert Tiramisu is perfecto.
Highly recommended.
author: Dick Lai

review_text:
Overall, it’s an average especially at this Italian restaurant. However my family members like their pasta. If it’s only by me I’ll perhaps give a 3⭐️

The kids love their bolognese pasta, he finds if nice and he finished everything. I find the taste abit charred.

My mum likes the carbonara, finds it flavourful but I felt it lack the intensity, like the carbonara sauce was just pouring onto the pasta instead of sautéing it to add on the flavour.

My wife likes the seafood aglio olio, she likes it too. However I find it lacks flavour and intensity as well. I don’t taste the olive and the garlic, more intensity comes from the seafood, rather been fresh seafood umami, it’s more of boiling seafood taste.

The 4 cheese Pizza doesn’t look nice, however it taste yummy. One of the dish I enjoyed for the day.

But as long as the family likes it will do.

Great service from the staff. Kudos
author: Lionel Lee

review_text: Omg if I can give 10 stars I would! The food here is amazing! The economy mutton briyani is so delicious, the mutton is melt in your mouth and flavorful! The mango lassi is so smooth and rich you would think it’s made in Ritz Carlton. The masala tea is deliciously creamy and even without sugar it tastes so authentic. The paneer briyani is tasty and lovely. Sometimes the service is a little slow but I think the staff are all very nice friendly and patient. The papadums are fresh and Crispy.
author: Belle Lee

review_text:
My very honest review :
I came alone and ordered Gobi 65 (Fried Cauliflower) as appetiser and mutton Briyani for my main dish. There was 4 option in menu for Briyani (Vindaloo Briyani, dum Briyani, hydrebadi Briyani and economy Briyani).
I asked the waitress for a suggestion and she asked me to take the economy Briyani since the rest 3 Briyanis were orders for 2 and more people, only the economy one was for 1 pax. When the Briyani arrived, I couldn’t believe my eyes. There were 5 small small pieces of mutton and I had around 5 mouths of feed until I realised that’s all of the food. The portion is extremely little, like a child eating. See, now I have no problem paying expensive for meals, I have always been staying in JB. But the price is nothing worth it to the food served. 5 mouths and 5 small pieces of mutton for RM30 can you imagine? For RM30 I would have gotten a feast!
Moving forward, the gobi 65 was served. I swear I have not eating something so terrible like that. It was tasteless and I felt like want to vomit after eating. I just kept it unfinished for this dish amounting RM22. This is the first and last time I am coming here. Putting the prices like this is fine, but make sure it is served with the quality! The worst! Total damage for this shop was RM53.90 including tax just for one pax just appetiser and main dish (no drink no dessert). I normally spend a lot for my food. For this price, I would have gotten a very much stomach and heart filling meal. This is too much for the food served. IT IS NOT WORTH IT AT ALL. I would never go to Vindaloo again and I wouldn’t recommend anyone who is going here.
author: Paveerna K.Vijayan

review_text: Great experience! The service was excellent and the staff were very friendly. The food was delicious, and the ambience was lovely. Very close to Legoland and perfect for families. Highly recommended.
author: Aruna Mathialagan

review_text: We had a wonderful experience dining here. The food was absolutely delicious, and every dish was prepared to perfection. What truly stood out was the excellent service the staff were attentive, warm, and genuinely caring. They really took very good care of us throughout the entire meal, making us feel comfortable and valued. Highly recommended, and we will definitely be back!
author: Saravanan Rajendran

review_text: Food at Restaurant Vindaloo was absolutely delicious—authentic flavors and generous portions! The ambience was cozy and inviting, perfect for a great dining experience. The staff were friendly, attentive, and provided excellent service. Everything from start to finish was top-notch. Highly recommended—I’ll definitely be back with friends! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
author: Suresh Shanmugavel

restaurant_name: 锦亦轩中餐厅 - JIN YI XUAN RESTAURANT SDN BHD
review_text: We were a family of 6 (with 2 kids) and we had a whole peking duck, sweet and sour chicken, fried rice and Chongqing noodle. All the food was so good and service was good too. Happy to find a nice restaurant that I can visit agin in JB 👍
author: Anne S.

restaurant_name: 锦亦轩中餐厅 - JIN YI XUAN RESTAURANT SDN BHD
review_text:
On our second visit, the VIP room is grand and comes with a minimum spend requirement. The room is equipped with a karaoke system, Netflix, YouTube, and a mahjong table. Overall, the food is good and offers a new experience.
______________________________$

A newly opened Chinese restaurant with beautiful decor. The staff were very friendly and took the time to recommend their signature dishes. The Peking duck stood out for me — it was quite different from the versions I’ve tried in Malaysia. The chef personally explained the details while carving the duck in front of us, mentioning that the duck was imported from China. As the dish takes about 90 minutes to prepare, it’s best to call ahead for a reservation. The fried Chinese yam with umbrella mushrooms was also excellent. Overall, the food was delicious, though the prices are on the higher side.
author: Ong NN

restaurant_name: 锦亦轩中餐厅 - JIN YI XUAN RESTAURANT SDN BHD
review_text: Not too bad. Food is good, tasty.  Just that it’s too oily to my liking.
author: Jiunchyi Chong

restaurant_name: 锦亦轩中餐厅 - JIN YI XUAN RESTAURANT SDN BHD
review_text: Environment here is nice and the service is good, food especially the roasted duck is really delicious😋!
author: aishah lim

restaurant_name: 锦亦轩中餐厅 - JIN YI XUAN RESTAURANT SDN BHD
review_text: Peking duck ...delicious !
author: terence teoh

review_text:
08 Mar 2024.

Came down for breakfast. Was queuing in another cafe but saw the pricing, got a shock. Then I saw this cafe. Visited the chain at Eco world area.

Ordered a simple egg muffin breakfast with a cup of tea. Taste ok, no surprise.
author: Cheewee Kok

review_text:
2nd review
Came back here again last week but we didn’t order food , as we have appointment. I ordered Teh C kosong and it’s reallyyyyy good.

Honestly I m looking forward to have the food again when I know I have an appointment. Boss, if you see the review, I truly thank you so much for preparing nice food. We always have a good time in your place ❤️

1st review
The food is a very delicious, and must try scrambled eggs. OMG I have never thought I had the best scrambled eggs in town !! We even ordered second time.

Boss is very nice and being patient when I request some changes on the food for my father. I always come to here when I visit Gleneagle Hospital, will keep coming back again  in the future 💪🏻💪🏻

review_text: Good food inside medini iskandar hospital, healthy and delicious
author: Imm Lee

review_text: the 9.90 breakfast is awesome. the kopi oriental so good!
author: Habibfikri Hadzir

review_text: Good and Service!! 🥰🥰
author: Rufina Irene Frida

review_text: Tried the ayam percik. Portion is large and proportionate with the price.  My order includes teh tarik. Nice to have such a place for a quick bite.
author: mingqle

review_text: Cashier ordering is bad. Order was One fried kuey teow + 1 fried chicken became kuey teow + 1 korea plate chicken costing rm46. Waited 45 mins for the food. And Food was tasteless too! The server didnt even say " sorry for the delay" . face black like hell.
author: Shane Ng

review_text:
This restaurant inside the Gleneagles hospital, price for food from RM14+ to RM20+, open area, around here got others restaurants, just like a food court. Neat and clean.
The special fried rice portion big, chicken rice portion just nice for lady. Self service.
author: Carol Chen Li Yen

review_text:
If the pricing does not, then food definitely does a good job at chasing customers away. (one piece roti telur for RM 7)

We ordered a few items today:

Nasi lemak ayam. The nasi lemak was severely lacking in lemak, rice was served cold on a cold plate. Also, the freshly fried chicken appeared juicy, but the "juice" was mostly oil.

Meehoon was slightly undercooked and obscenely dry. It was rather bland, and dehydrated, but the colour did look good, fooling me into ordering it.

Roti Canai and Teh tarik set, something you'd expect to be half decent, wasn't good at all. The roti was tough and doughy, and the Teh tarik tastes like it's been made out of an instant packet; I wouldn't be surprised if it was haha.

Overall the ambiance was nice, we enjoyed the cooling sheltered alfresco with a gentle  morning breeze. The service was good as well, they brought the food to our table so we didn't have to pick it up at the window. However I wouldn't come back for the great fear of disappointing food 😱
author: Kel Vin Chong

review_text:
Recently they’re lacking on everything
Order taking should need to look into.
So many dishes not available especially the promotions.
Taste,platting,portioning to temperature need to look into as well compared to those few years back.Ayam percik taste so plain,the pasar malam ayam percik taste 10 times better.
Hopefully the top management of
Gleaneagles hospital look into as terrace is the only restaurant serving all type of dishes for the diners.
author: Anthony Paul

review_text:
hot hot malay food….
memey sedak dok oh
author: Danish Fauzi

review_text:
Breakfast (buffet).

Avoid at all cost UNLESS you really desperate.
You’re better off ordering GRAB food and save RM25 per pax for breakfast.

Nasi lemak - horrendously salty sambal, soggy ikan bilis,  murdered (smashed) hard boiled egg
Omelette- basically scrambled egg without any condiments
Soft boil egg - came raw, not cooked 1st time, returned & came back as hard boil egg
Latte or cappuccino  - pay separately (tea & coffee from a flask available)

Dare not try anymore after sampling some of the above…
author: Chris Koh

review_text:
Serves breakfast for Somerset Medini Iskandar Puteri.

Food was a total disappointment, basic food could be done in a more respectful manner. Flies hovering around.

The floor was sticky.

Floor staff wasn't able to respond to different ability needs.

Avoid this place at all costs. There are better choices at the nearby hospital, which are walking distance.
author: chew eb

review_text: It's a small restaurant to cater growing working population in Medini. Lunch set starts from RM10 with ice lemon tea. Totally worth it!
author: Abdul Wahab

review_text: Poor quality food for quarantine. Use cheap nuggets most of the time. Food seems cooked long time ago and not even reheated.
author: Chen Ee Song

review_text: Average vegetarian food for quarantine. Slightly oily and too often use of ginger in dishes.
author: sueanne lim

review_text: 5/5 stars! Medini City Burger is a game-changer for Ramly patties! The burgers are juicy, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. The service is top-notch, and the atmosphere is cozy and inviting. Can't wait to come back and try more of their delicious menu items! Highly recommend!
author: Ronald Chun

review_text: This. This is the definitive Ramly burger street vendor. Burgers better than anything you can get from a dine-in restaurant and for less than a fast food place. The only problem is that one doesn't have enough tummy space to eat all the various iterations they have on the menu. You can even WhatsApp your order to them and then come to collect.
author: Kenny Tay

review_text: Medini city burgers a well known for their delicious 😋 and most yummiest delicies they have more the 50 varieties of burgers and other add on . Supper good fingers licking .  Woooola can wait to eat their burgers again . Coming soon .
author: Shanker Velusamy

review_text: I hv tried so many burgers but this is the one of the best burger in the city I would say. The portion , quality and service worth for the price. I will definitely recommend to my family and friends.
author: Divya Vaishli

review_text: Came here on a whim and was blown away. The patties were perfectly seasoned and cooked juicy every time. Great value too!
author: Yb Dinesh

review_text: Very delicious bacon fried rice and bacon Carbonara spaghetti. Siew Yuk Aglio Olio also good. Definitely the place to enjoy a porkylicious meal nearby Legoland. Good portions. Deli concept. Located inside BIG non-halal section and can purchase drinks from the BIG grocer.
author: Adrian Yeoh

review_text:
The meal was incredibly delicious.
The meat was so tender it practically melted in my mouth.
The fries were perfectly crispy.
Highly recommended!
great meal after lego land!
author: 暴力熊

review_text:
17 Jun 2024.

We have been shopping many times in this place but for the first time having dinner here.

Ordered some rostered pork (crispy) as starter and collar chop as main. Both taste good.

Not many customers having meals so quite relax. Good place to revisit.

MSG level: ok
author: Cheewee Kok

review_text:
We went to Publika's BIG and we were excited to visit BIG at Medini Mall.

There is big variety of premium ingredients and food. What interest us is the food offer at BIG.

We came for the fresh oysters and seafood, but to no available. So we decided to try their pork selection.

The staff are friendly and professional. They recommended roast pork with rice and grilled Iberrico Collar to us. We tried both and we like them. The roast pork is cruncy and nicely marinated, the chilli and gravy goes well with the pork and white rice. And the herbal taste of the Iberrico collar is simply irressitable. :)
author: Lennox Cheok

review_text: roasted pork is delicious. The meat is tender, smells good and the seasoning is just appropriate. Minimum purchase is 100g, around rm11 (the photo is after makan half portion). the beer taste great, thick with smoked. The beer  or drinks need to buy from the other department which can be long queue. If this can be purchased at the same time, then would be very convenient
author: Ong NN

review_text: So far the best western dish i had in johor..... truly under rated not sure if it's expensive but to me i get what i pay for.... great cuts you can choose satisfactorily executed ..... definitely my go to place if i have cravings for western cuisine.... won't say great ambience cos it's within a grocery but i'm sure those who loves food for the food not anything else will love this place
author: haikal rohaizat

review_text: It can be a long wait during dinner time but they did put a disclaimer poster that the wait can be long during peak hours. The food was mid and good enough to fill in hungry tummies. The prices are surprisingly reasonable.
author: Eva Ruth

review_text:
We had the grilled meat platter of 79.90RM

1. Mashed potatoes - normal
2. Sausages - basic
3. Salad - the sauce is really weird. Didn’t like it
4. Chicken breast - thin and dry.
5. Lamb - they did not give but replaced with beef that is not a good cut. Does not taste fresh.
6. Beef - not a good cut. Not fresh and had to spit out as it is nauseating.
author: dawn sun

review_text:
The food was really tasty with good value for money.I want visit!!
I recommend!
author: 지부

review_text:
Place: an aircon restaurant that specialises in western cuisine with a touch of some local cuisines. I must say this place cooks excellent steaks, chicken chops and fish fillets. A forgotten corner that caters mainly for Legoland visitors. One could get raw and fresh fish, chicken or steaks from Ben's Independent Grocer and have them cooked here at The Grocer's Kitchen for a small reasonable fee. One could also choose from their vegetable bar such as broccoli quinoa salad, potato salad and Ceaser salad.

Service: self order at counter and once ready the buzzer will ring for self pick-up. Can't go wrong here. Staff are friendly and helpful too.

Food: I've been here multiple times (more than 10x, and I MUST SAY they cook very consistently!)
1. Honey mustard chicken fillet (bought from B.I.G., cooked here): wonderfully cooked to perfection. Occasionally a tad overcooked depending on the chef at work. But still acceptable. Verdict: 4.0-4.6/5

2. Burgers: nice and moistly cooked to juicy perfection. Wonderful. They usually get the wellness spot on. Verdict: 4.3-4.6/5.

3. Fried local cuisine: wonderfully flavourful and a true reflection of locally cooked dishes. Excellent for those who love a flavour punch to their palates. Verdict: 4.2-4.6/5
author: C RM

review_text:
Super yummy food with lovely presentation 😍
The place is so cozy and comfortable, it instantly makes me feel relaxed ✨
Had such a sweet dining experience and can’t wait to come back again 💕🥰
author: Yue Xuan Er

review_text: A new cafe in the area! Their food was very nice and yummy! Glad to have passed by this cafe and the young staff was outside happened to show me the menu. Felt that the price was reasonable and definitely worth it for the food we had! Look at how appetising the food was displayed too! Do try this if you pass by!
author: See Lian Koo

review_text: Food was very good!! Worth a visit if you’re here at Legoland.
author: HK

review_text: Amazing experience! The staff were super friendly and attentive, and they made us feel really welcome. The food was fantastic too
author: Jaymeeh Sundiang

review_text: First time eat at GlowLand Cafe! I was attracted to the Nasi Lemak on offer, but ordered other food which were very nice! I ordered Ocean Feast Lemak and it was nice!! The coffee also nice! Thanks for the friendly service to my family! My 2 young kids finish their kids' food! Amazing!
author: Anthony Yap

review_text:
Had an absolutely enjoyable time at Hiss Hiss Cold Beer. The place has a great vibe, relaxed, comfortable, and perfect place to chill. The beer was perfectly cold, just how it should be, and the overall atmosphere made the experience even better.

A special mention to Muru, who provided excellent service throughout the evening friendly, attentive, and always making sure we were well taken care of. Also, big compliments to Manager Kumar for his professionalism and hospitality. You can really feel the good management in the smooth service and welcoming environment.

Truly a place that values good service and customer experience. Will definitely come back again and highly recommend Hiss Hiss Cold Beer to anyone looking for a great bar experience 🍺
author: Mythlli Beevi

review_text: A great place for a cold beer when visiting Legoland with the kids. Its a new place and hard to find: look for the Starbucks and it is right there. Friendly service and like the name says - the beer is ice cold. I liked it.
author: Perivale Boy

review_text: good food, good vibe muru is such a flirt . his amazing!!!  look for muru it u wanna have fun.
author: Rishan Silvam

review_text: "Great spot for a satisfying Thai lunch! We ordered a variety of dishes to share. The standout was definitely the giant crispy omelet and the fish curry. The ingredients felt fresh and the portions were generous. Nice, clean ambiance and good service. Will definitely be coming back."
author: Wok Jinn Liang

review_text: Food is great! Lata and the other staff was very helpful.
author: Ej Claudio

review_text: Food yummy, staf were friendly and good service
author: Amyrul Fahmy

review_text: The food and service is great. 10/10 would suggest this restaurant. Special thanks to muru and pomz for an spectacular service
author: daniel martinez

review_text:
Had a wonderful experience at Lemora. The ambience is lovely and comfortable, making it a great place to relax and enjoy a meal. The food tasted great and the prices are very reasonable for the quality served. Service was also impressively fast.
Special shoutout to Mr. Adslan who did a fantastic job ensuring everything was in order. He was very attentive and made sure we were well taken care of throughout the visit. Truly great service! Highly recommended
author: Farah Zulkafli

review_text:
Found out about Faaz Bistro because of Legoland. This restaurant is located at Mall of Medini, which is just right in front of Legoland so naturally it is very easy and convenient for Legoland visitors.

Price is considered reasonable compared to other food available around that area.

My favorite is the maggi goreng. The maggi noodle is the thin type and I love it because they fry it just nice and the noodle is not too soft or soggy. I ate twice and the quality is consistent.

The murtabak ayam is pretty nice too but the portion is really really big! Although it cost RM15, this can be easily shared by two person!

Next the biryani rice is quite okay but the downside is they don't really heat it up so it feels cold when served. This is where I deduct one star. Could have easily been 5 stars. I ordered the Biryani Kambing set, the kambing served to me has lots of hard tendon area and only a small portion of nice tender meat.

All in all, one of my favourite restaurants at Mall of Medini. Will definitely return again next time. Not sure why this place has such a low rating but whenever I visited this place there are always customers around as well.
author: Kevin Yeoh

review_text:
Food quality actually not so bad, it's just so many flies interrupting our lunch time i think it's because we eat in the outside area
Staff services so confusing, when we look at the menu the lady(number 23) tells us that the restaurant soon gonna be closed (12 PM) so we order immediately but after we finish at 12.30 PM there's no sign of they're gonna closed anytime soon, even after we finished playing around at Legoland around 19.30 PM they still operate (what's her point rushing us to ordered?)
Atmosphere also not comfortable since there are so many crows flying near tou to get some of your meals
author: Mico Yohanes

review_text:
☀Located right at the entrance of Mall of Medini to LEGOLAND. Really spacious to sit in and out. Cool in the summer rain ☔
🥘 Local food with a lot of options with rice, especially to Asians. There is also options for vegetarians. But the rice is plain rice which is not really tender and sticky.
💸 About ~15 MYR/dish depending on the food
author: Jessica Lam

review_text:
AVOID. One plate of mix rice consist of:

1. Economy fried rice with tiny bits of Ikan bilis and egg
2. One fried chicken drumstick
3. One fried egg
4. Stir fry cabbage

Normal serving size! Cost a whopping RM 17.50 for a breakfast 🙄

Was shocked when hear the price and asked how much is the chicken he said RM7.00/pc wow (normal size not very big)

Feel like it’s a place to chop cabbage of singaporean tourist.
author: E L

review_text:
Service crew was friendly and was able to take our order properly. We did not understand the menu as they are in malay but the staff was kind enough to explain it to us. They also served the food fast including Roti Cheese which was newly cooked.

Didn’t know that that bananas got charge, we first thought it was complimentary as they were already set in the table. Also, they have manual payment system and is only accepting cash. They didn’t gave us a receipt for the breakdown of what we ordered, hopefully they can upgrade or accept credit cards as this is a tourist spot.

Overall, food was nice and the experience is alright.
author: Rhobel Santos

review_text: Had a wonderful dinner buffet here with a wide variety of dishes, and surprisingly, everything was delicious. I tried the buttermilk prawns, chili crab, oyster vegetables, chicken skewers, black pepper lamb, and seafood on ice. The desserts were all delightful as well. The hospitality was excellent, thanks to Fizi and the team for their warm service.
author: Isabella Abba

review_text: Visited Kai Sushi for lunch and dinner at Bricks restaurant for dinner on 24 Nov, was happy with the service. Had the Tori karage bento at Kai Sushi and staff Hafizzi was thoughtful to switch the TV programme to Monkey King animation and turned the TV angle for my son as he noticed he was watching the show. He also provided him some colouring materials for my son to pass his time while waiting for food. The Tori karage tasted fresh and was not oily and that was a good start for our first meal in Legoland hotel. We also had a sumptuous breakfast buffet with wide variety and the staff took note of food supply and replenish food quickly. The staff at Bricks were helpful and will take note to offer kids colouring materials upon seated and also checked with us how is the food. Will recommend Bricks restaurant and Kai Sushi for dining and thanks to the staff for a pleasant dining experience. You can also book a birthday celebration experience with a fee at the restaurant for a Lego mascot to drop by to greet ur child.
author: Lynn Lin

review_text: The thigh is dry but others are ok. Foods are on sweeter side to cater children taste
author: SS Chan

review_text: Had a good experience in this restaurant for breakfast. Our kids really enjoy this place. The food that stands out a lot is the nasi lemak and also the patisserie. We hope they do add ice cream, more choices of coffee in the future.
author: Roland Permana

review_text:
The food here is expensive yet mediocre. Drinks menu is super limited at lunchtime, don't even have teh tarik or other local drinks.

The food menu seems to try to do a mix of everything but doesn't really intice us. Hainanese chicken rice was a disappointment.

Sirloin steak was so tough and not cooked well, we couldn't even finish it because it was bad. Club sandwich was okay - could have toasted the bread little, but the wedges that came with it were very good. Their Buffalo wings (?) were just coated KFC style fried chicken? Tasted okay but just felt like fried frozen food.

We were able to order from the Japanese restaurant as well - ramen and udon were okay - decent but not fantastic.

The saving grace was the rack of lamb. Absolutely delicious, while it's a bit pricey at RM69, it was so worth the pricetag. 3 pieces of mutton perfectly cooked. Tender and savoury. Easy to tear from the bone. And doesn't have the gamey taste at all. 100/100 highly recommend the rack of lamb.

We loved the decor and theme of the restaurant. Someone was celebrating their birthday here as well, which I think is a brilliant idea. Also appreciate the fact that there is a vegetarian menu, thanks for being inclusive.
author: Loki

restaurant_name: Re:Pure TauFuFa 純粹豆花 - Medini Mall
review_text:
I found this TauFuFa stall by accident and I’m so glad I decided to give it a try. It’s not the usual TauFuFa — this place has a lot of variety.

I asked them to recommend something, and they told me their best sellers are the Burnt Tofu Pudding and the Jumbo Tofu Pudding. So yes, I ordered both.

It was delicious! One thing I like here is that they give you a small bottle of soybean drink and the black sugar separately, so you can add it according to your taste.

The TauFuFa was very soft, and the burnt caramel was crispy. I simply love the contrasting texture between the two.

I’ll definitely make sure to try them again whenever I’m back at this place.

review_text: It's a nice corner bar for relaxation at night. We had the carbonara and ribeye steak. Carbonara was great, so creamy and pasta was al dente. Chef was really nice, he personally came out to take the order and mentioned that he can cook the medium rare steak a little more if we decide we prefer it a little more cooked. review_text: Had a quick staycation near this cafe, food was served hot, very delicious and service was great.

review_text: The pasta and quesadillas were absolutely delightful. The waitresses were very kind.

review_text: The Food Was So Delicious And The Staff Were So Friendly Overall  Experience Was Great Will Come Again Soon
author: Kuberan 93

review_text:
Service is warm, friendly and attentive!

The food is so authentic and tasty!
All the banchan dishes were so yummy. I especially like the kimchi spring onions and radish! The spring onions are so fresh and whets the appetite.

The steamed egg is so fluffy and has a great cheese pull! The bottom of steamed egg is slightly charred which adds a nice texture towards the end.

The seafood pancake is crispy on the outside yet soft in the inside. The sauce that comes with it has so much umami flavour!

The cold buckwheat noodles are so satisfying! Esp after a hot day. It is so refreshing. Think there's yuzu in the ice sauce. I had the spicy one and it is very good. Esp with the 2 slices of pear. Really refreshing. Yearned for more pear tho.

The staff gladly gave us second helpings of the banchans that we liked.

At the end of the meal, we were served with free chilled barley drinks. Again so refreshing after a very hot day at legoland.

Highly recommend this place!
author: Kelvin Goh

review_text: Visited this place for dinner and it did not disappoint, the food was super delicious. Many options are available. The seafood pancake was a must try! The sides are also delicious and free flow! The staff were very friendly and attentive asking us how the food was! Recommended to drop by if you are in the area.
author: Lee Yue Ming

review_text:
The atmosphere is lovely—the decoration is clean, simple, but very modern and nice. It felt comfortable and welcoming.
A great sign of authenticity: the restaurant was filled with lots of Korean customers during our lunchtime visit, which always tells you you're in the right spot! The meat quality was high, and everything was cooked perfectly.
Highly recommend it if you're looking for delicious, authentic Korean BBQ that won't break the bank! We will definitely be back!
author: serene sheng

review_text:
We randomly wandered to this restaurant situated in the vicinity of Almas and Teega suites in Puteri Harbour.

There is another Korean food joint selling almost the same type of food nearby, we decided to give Myung Ga a try because of its pleasant atmosphere. The menu looks uninteresting at first glance, it offers the “standard flair” like Korean BBQ, Kimchi stews, Fried chicken, etc.

We decided to go for a two person meal that includes BBQ (pork and beef), a soy base stew, chive pancake and an egg pot.

What came next took us by surprise. Never would we have thought that we can get such authenticity, first in presentation, then in service for the meal, especially for a Korean meal in Malaysia! These had us blown away…

Of course, the most important part is the food itself, the side dishes, eleven of them are simply delicious. We learnt that these are fully hand made by the lady boss and not bought (commercially) ready like most other restaurants. The chive pancake is a good addition to the meal, coupled with the extra fluffy and “fully packed” steamed egg. Finally, the BBQ, like a good Korean restaurant, we didn’t have to do it ourselves, these are meticulously prepared by a nice waitress. This adds up to a perfect dining experience in Myung Ga.

A big shoutout to the Bangadeshi waiter (we are sorry we didn’t catch your name), he speaks very good English and possess good knowledge on all the food the restaurant serves, we can also feel the sense of pride he has in his work as a representative of Myung Ga. Simply excellent! The other staffs are also well trained and very courteous, kudos to them and the management/owner.

Give Myung Ga a try if you are in this area, you won’t be disappointed!
author: bh

review_text:
I had a wonderful dining experience at Myung Ga. The food was absolutely delicious, with every dish prepared to perfection and full of authentic Korean flavours. You can really taste the quality of the ingredients and the care put into the cooking.

What made the experience even better was the friendly and attentive service. The staff especially Mr Nayeem were warm, welcoming, and always ready to assist with a smile, which made us feel very comfortable throughout the meal.

Overall, it was a very enjoyable visit and I will definitely be coming back again. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great Korean food and excellent service in Johor Bahru.
author: YEANLOONG yong

review_text:
Just tried this place today and I was very impressed. I lived in South Korea for 4 years, so I have been looking for a place that had the authentic taste I was missing. Crispy Crown is almost exactly the same! The spicy red sauce has the legit KorFC taste, too.

Another thing I love about this place is that they make the chicken to order unlike KFC or other chains. You get fresh, crispy, out-of-the-fryer chicken, and the chicken is cooked to perfection.

As for the staff and dining area, everything was very clean (couldn’t eat-in due to MCO) and the staff were very friendly.

My only complaint is minor, and it has to do specifically with my order. I ordered the Korean Chicken set (~RM46), but you have to pay extra for sauce. This may be a franchise policy, but I feel that for a large order of chicken, at least 1 sauce should be included. Other than that I was extremely satisfied!
author: James Elliott

review_text: well done! very tasty. hard to find korean fried chicken in jb this good. Plus point for ambience of this place. definitely will recommend to my friends n family
author: Aida Bieber

review_text:
A nice cool place to have a really good chicken meal! The fries are good and so was the seasoning sauce (red spicy). You might need to wait a while for your food so don't go there if you're absolutely starving.

I'm happy to see reusable cups, trays, and utensils. However, please, no need for plastic straws.
author: Leonard Teo

review_text: Nice environment feels like in Korea cause the owner is Korean. Soy fried chicken is very recommended. Now having chicken burger promo till 31 December. Will come again if I'm around the area. No pork and no lard and the ingredients come from halal place.
author: Abdul Wahab

review_text: The chicken breast set was so nice. I enjoyed having it at home even i was not able to dine in due to MCO 2.0. Restaurant staff was so nice and they followed the SOP given by Malaysia Govement. If im not wrong they also do delivery service. Try them and you will never regret.
author: Genesis John Dibble

review_text: I recently dined at Jeju Almas, and it was a wonderful experience. The food was absolutely tasty and well-seasoned — every dish was fresh and satisfying. What I really appreciated was that the staff were attentive and helpful, especially with the BBQ. They assisted with grilling the meat perfectly, so we could just sit back and enjoy our meal. There was also a great variety of appetizers, giving us plenty of options to try different flavors. The environment was quiet and relaxed, making it a comfortable place to enjoy a meal with family or friends. Overall, Jeju Almas offers delicious Korean food with excellent service in a cozy atmosphere. I would definitely visit again!
author: JW RollsRoyce

review_text: Had a wonderful dining experience here. The staff were incredibly friendly, attentive, and made us feel very welcome from start to finish. Service was prompt without being rushed, and they were always ready to help with grilling and recommendations. The food was excellent — high-quality meats, well-marinated, and very flavorful. Overall, a great Korean BBQ spot with both great food and great service. Will definitely come back again!
author: Kai Jun Lim

review_text:
Growing up eating Korean food, many restaurants serving Korean food does not make the cut for me. Jeju Almas BBQ is an exceptional gem serving authentic unpretentious Korean and it has been maintaining its standard every time we are here. You have the option of indoor & outdoor seating as well as cooking the bbq meat at your table or having the food served to you cooked from the kitchen.
For dinner, we ordered the kimchi jijae, stir fried octopus & Beef marinated ribs. Yummilicious!
author: Nick Sim

review_text: Amazing experience at this Korean bbq. We had really enjoyed our time here. We had went to a lot of k-bbq but this one is by far the most authentic one we had. All of our family are picky eater and seeing them enjoy this k-bbq with whole heart made me to recommend this k-bbq spot. Their meat were fresh and cooked under heated coal made this bbq a memorable one for us. The ban chan came in different varieties and we're refillable. Not to mention that the mackerel were fresh and crispy. Their service was also excellent. The staffs were really helpful and grilled our meat to perfection. All in all, we definitely had an amazing experience at this k-bbq and was definitely worth of our money. We will come back for sure ❤️
author: SANAM SANAM

review_text:
Had an amazing experience at this Korean BBQ restaurant! The quality of the meat was excellent. Fresh, well-marinated, and nicely marbled. You can really taste the difference. The side disheswere generous and constantly refilled, which made the whole meal even better.

The staff were attentive and friendly, always checking in and helping with the grilling when needed. Service was fast even during peak hours, and the atmosphere was lively but still comfortable for conversation.

Overall, great food, great service, and great vibes. Definitely worth the price and I’ll be coming back again soon. Highly recommended for anyone craving authentic Korean BBQ! 🔥🥩
author: Izz Adli

review_text: Nice place to space out, chill and do nothing. Great view overlooking the sea if you sit upstairs. Love the peace here. Dessert is great here, the colours make me happy.
author: Wai Lin Chan

review_text: Small little cafe at the end of the Puteri Harbour broadwalk. Got a coconut juice and nice view from the top, good music (Reggae, Disco, Light rock etc...), A cool and relaxing spot with good service!
author: SPNH2233

review_text:
I recently visited the Caribbean Juice Bar, and it was a delightful escape from the city’s hustle. Located by the harbour, the bar offers a tranquil atmosphere with a beautiful view of the water and lush greenery. The wooden rustic decor perfectly complements the laid-back, tropical vibe, making it an ideal spot to unwind.

The drinks were a highlight of the experience. I tried two of their refreshing beverages, each served in a stylish glass with metal straws, which added an eco-friendly touch. One drink was a vibrant red juice garnished with an orange slice, bursting with tropical flavors, while the other was a refreshing watermelon cooler with a hint of lime. Both drinks were chilled to perfection and tasted incredibly fresh.

Sipping on these flavorful drinks while enjoying the river view made for a perfect afternoon. The combination of great drinks, scenic surroundings, and cozy seating makes the Caribbean Juice Bar a must-visit spot for anyone looking to relax with a cool drink in hand.
author: Saveendra Ekanayake

review_text:
I came across this juice bar in Johor Bahru on TikTok, and I’m so glad I decided to check it out. Apparently, all their desserts are vegan-friendly (not entirely sure, but we gave it a try). The cake was really, really good, and the chocolate milkshake was exceptional. The watermelon juice was sweet and refreshing.

We sat on the upper deck, which faces the sea. There were no issues with flies, and the place was clean. We even caught the sunset, which added to the beautiful experience.

For the price, the food, and the stunning view, this place is definitely a steal.
author: YT

review_text: Fully vegan and eco friendly. I love the all natural smoothie without sugar added. They play great reggae music and the view is calming. Great place to chill.
author: Red Bean Mochi

review_text:
Wonderful Christmas dinner experience!
Celebrated Christmas dinner at Rockafellers Puteri Harbour and it was fantastic. The festive atmosphere was warm and inviting, the food was delicious and beautifully presented, and the service was attentive throughout the evening. Enjoying a great meal with the lovely harbour view made the night extra special. A perfect place for a memorable Christmas celebration. Highly recommended! 🎄✨
author: kelvin Tam

The staff are super friendly and knowledgeable the shop is clean
My seafood bisque was super rich in prawn taste 👅 and the angus beef pie with gravy was very beefy taste the beef filling was right consistency and has balance amounts of beef and mash potatoes

Like many others, I checked the reviews before coming, 50% were good, 50% not so great. Decided to gamble and give it a try.

I ordered Maggi goreng with fried egg, 2 plain roti canai, 1 roti bom, 1 roti telur, iced Nescafe, and iced tea O. Despite the crowd, everything was served within 20 minutes. Staff were friendly and attentive.

The total came to only RM26, very reasonable for the portion and variety!

Great for a quick meal before heading to Legoland.
author: Faris Pakri

review_text: You can get tasty food for low prices here. Some dishes can be quite spicy, though. Not sure how much it costs to get a plate with your choice of meats and vegetables, but it may be a better option if you’re feeling hungry, as portions can be small for the items on the menu. Prices are low, so you can’t expect the largest portions, but the servings are decent value.
author: Patrick N.

review_text:
It’s been 5 days straight since I’ve eaten this nasi lemak and I’ll probably continue eat again throughout my stay nearby.

Been so long since I’ve eaten such an Amazing but simple nasi lemak. All the components, nasi santan, ikan bilis, kacang, Ayam goreng and sambal is very balanced and authentic.

Highlight is definitely the sambal. Truly amazing! Will definitely miss it when I don’t stay near here anymore.

And the interior of the restaurant is awesome! I loved dining here.😊💯👍👍👍 Definitely I am visiting again!

review_text:
It was a very disappointing experience. My husband and I are big fans of mee tarik. We just moved to this area and decided to try JWD Mee Tarik because my husband was craving it and wasn’t feeling well (he had a cough and fever), so we thought mee tarik would be comforting. I’m also pregnant and was craving fried noodles.

We ordered through Grab, but when the food arrived, the order was completely wrong. We didn’t receive the fried noodles at all. Instead, we were given two soup noodles, and only one had soup. The other one was dry and definitely not fried.

On top of that, the scallion pancake looked nothing like the photo advertised. I’ve had really good scallion pancakes at other mee tarik places, and the photo shown looked similar to those. However, what we received was thin and crispy like a keropok, I’m not even sure what it was made of. It was very disappointing.

Sadly, this was our first and will be our last time ordering. Tried to make a report in Grab and only refund RM3 for that freaking RM23 wrong noodles. Worst experience. I’ve attached photos as evidence.
author: Fyra Sharifudin

review_text: This is the best halal noodle shop that I have ever tried in Johor. That first sip of the broth was so jam packed with flavour that I was physically taken aback! The tender braised beef complements the silky smooth noodles perfectly. 100/10 I would come here again just for the soup because oh my God, it is memorable.
author: Mikail Idris

review_text:
Noodles is good.

Meat nothing much.

Chicken too tough.

Lamb too tough.

There's better food options nearby.
author: Alex Lim

review_text: Ordered their signature beef noodles soup and scallion pancake. Taste good and big portion.
author: genomax tech

review_text:
I love the food here! The portions are big, so if you're a small eater, you might want to share. The beef noodle soup is packed with beef, and you can really taste it in the broth. It’s served hot, and if you like a bit of heat, adding chili oil makes it even better.

The fried rice is really tasty. I couldn’t stop eating it 😀 I just wish it was served a bit warmer. The dumplings are soft and go so well with chili oil, but again, I would’ve liked them to be hotter when served.

One thing you shouldn’t miss is the Chinese tea.. It’s sweet, served hot, and packed with herbs and flowers like chrysanthemums, goji berries, longan, and red dates.

The service is pretty fast, which is great. I just wish some of the food came out hotter, but overall, I’d still recommend this place
author: Nurul N

review_text:
Our family had a very satisfying dinner at this restaurant.
The staff were all kind and helpful, offering great recommendations and clear explanations of the menu.
All the dishes we ordered were fresh and delicious.
Our family doesn’t usually enjoy food that is too salty, sweet, or strongly seasoned, but the flavors here were light and well-balanced, so we never felt tired of the food even by the end of the meal.
Our 7-year-old child also enjoyed every dish.
We would love to visit again.
author: Taekyun Im

review_text:
Came with my family for a quick lunch. We were the only ones in the restaurant.

I didn't expect much but the food was much better than what I expected.

Price is alright. Service is good.
Only gripe is that they are not open sometimes and closes earlier than advertised.

I would definitely visit here again for light lunch or dinner.
author: Changsu Siris Woo

review_text:
Been here a few times.
This bistro started with western cuisine . The quality of food and the ambience are great for a nice meal. They also serve beer, wine and some hard liquor. Good with the steak and such.
Tried their tomahawk. It was rightly cooked and served together with a bottle of champagne. The texture and taste was great. My friends and I finished in no time.
Highly recommended.
author: foxplayz 132

review_text:
My recent visit to this lovely bistro was an absolute delight. The location is stunning—right by the water, with views that make any meal feel like a special occasion.

The food was fantastic. We tried the Burger were fresh, beautifully cooked, and full of flavour . Even the side dishes and desserts felt carefully prepared.

Service was warm, attentive, and genuinely friendly. The staff made great recommendations and kept everything running smoothly without feeling rushed.

Best of all? The prices were very reasonable, especially considering the quality of the food and the incredible setting. You get great value here.

Highly recommended for a relaxed lunch, a romantic dinner, or just a drink with a view. We’ll definitely be back!
author: situ weiqiang

review_text: Very cool atmosphere, good ambiance. Karaoke set for lively music, sing any songs you want
author: Kenneth law

restaurant_name: 中国穆斯林自助火锅BUFET STIMBOT MAKSNAN CINA MUSILIM
review_text: I have eaten the best Chinese Muslim hotpot restaurant here. The owner is a Chinese Muslim. The environment in the store is very good and the taste is great. I highly recommend everyone to come and taste the food.
author: MARUI MARUI

review_text:
Came here for a romantic dinner with my partner! We had Yuri Matcha Latte, Chicken Roulade, Trout Salmon and Grilled Shrimp with Cocktail Sauce. I personally liked the chicken the most as it’s tender and juicy! The shrimp was my next favourite dish as they were fat and juicy! We found the salmon average though.

I also loved the aesthetics of the restaurant, from the interior design to its strategic location overseeing the harbour. This allow diners to sit at tables beside the harbor to admire its view.

Lastly I would like to commemorate the service of the restaurant! My partner was feeling cold so she wanted the air con to be tuned up, however the server kindly explained that the staff couldn’t adjust the central air con temp, instead he suggested for us to get their speciality tea, which was nice and kept my partner warm :)
author: Liau Yuan Wei

review_text:
The place has excellent vibe and ambience.

The food was delicious. The meat doneness was on point.

We came at lunch time, only 3 tables filled. Quiet. The glass window seat was hot. They will attentive and turn on the fan for cooling.

All was excellent except one of the staff when he was serving us, we could smell an odour.

That sort of affected the overall experience.
author: Alex Lim

review_text:
I visited The Veil for dinner as we were looking forward to the window-side ambience and wanted to take some photos.

We arrived at around 7pm and were told that the window seats are on a first-come, first-served basis. There were already two groups waiting, and we were the third group in line, so we queued as advised.

After the first two groups were seated, another group who arrived later was invited to take the window seats. We checked with the staff and were informed that another table would be leaving soon and we could wait a little longer. Initially, the seat offered to us had part of the view blocked by the sofa, while the later-arriving group was seated at the full floor-to-ceiling window.

As we had come mainly for the atmosphere, this was a little confusing from our perspective. However, after speaking with the staff, they kindly rearranged and moved us to a window table.

For one of the chicken dishes, the inside appeared quite pink and soft when we cut into it. We checked with the staff and were told it was due to the marinade. As we were personally unsure about the doneness, we chose not to continue eating it.

Overall, just sharing our experience for reference.

Update / Follow-up

After my original review, I contacted the restaurant via Instagram to clarify about the chicken. Initially, the staff at the restaurant said it was marinated, causing the pink color. But the restaurant later told me it’s actually sous vide cooked, not marinated.

During my visit, the staff did not offer to replace the dish, and even said a new portion would still be pink. When I requested a refund, the restaurant claimed a replacement was offered and I “declined.” My experience on-site and the restaurant’s explanation completely don’t match, which felt very frustrating.

Sharing this as an update so others have the full context.

Highly recommended for any roasted duck/ pork enthusiast seeking an affordable and satisfying meal in the area! ✨️

To cater to the more spiced up palates of the locals we chose Sichuan dishes too like 辣子鸡 which didn’t numb our tongues. review_text:

The food was the true highlight—each dish was thoughtfully crafted, rich in flavor, and beautifully presented. You can taste the quality and freshness in every bite. It’s rare to find a place where every item on the table exceeds expectations, but this restaurant managed to do exactly that.

The environment was spotless and well-maintained, creating a comfortable and pleasant atmosphere for dining. It’s the kind of place where you can truly relax and enjoy your meal.

Given the exceptional food quality, impeccable service, and clean environment, the prices are more than justified.
I wholeheartedly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a memorable and satisfying dining experience. A must-visit! 👍
author: Chin Yuan Chong

review_text:
If you like your Chinese HongKong style roast meats, Dian Xiao Er restaurants (they are in many locations in Singapore) is the place to go for more upmarket style roasts.

The roast duck with beautifully crispy skin is offered in 3 signature flavours - Angelica, 10 wonder herbs, and ginseng. The herbal flavours are subtle rather than overwhelming, and you can intensify the herbal flavours with the complementary sauce.

The roast pork is also beautifully glazed and very tender. But do note that when the menu states “pieces”, one piece = one ~ 1 cm wide slice. Piece here does not refer to the whole piece hung on hooks in the window!

Other dishes worth trying here are the Marmite Chicken - fried, battered chicken glazed with a Marmite (British Vegemite) sauce. It’s subtle and not overpowering - and the slightly spicy from black pepper Mongolian pork ribs. The Mongolian pork ribs are meaty too, if you’re wondering.

Prices are on the higher side especially when the GST and Service charge are added in for eat-in but are IMHO worth it for the upmarket tweaks. Do NOT compare this to the cheap cafe and food court roast meats as that’s comparing apple and oranges.

Not very happy with how the pizza. Feel shortchanged

author: Denis Lee

review_text:
This has got to be the most pathetic excuse for customer service I’ve ever witnessed at Pizza Hut. My order was scheduled for 5:18 PM, and by 7:15 PM I still had absolutely nothing in my hands. Staff told me to “wait 30 minutes,” but I ended up wasting 2 hours only to walk away empty-handed. That alone is already unacceptable, but the situation inside was even worse.

There were around 20 people crammed into a tiny 3m x 4m waiting room, all frustrated and waiting endlessly. Every 10 minutes, a staff member would shuffle out to hand one single order to one person, while the rest of us stood there helpless. The worst part? We could hear them at the back laughing and joking while customers were packed like sardines in a suffocating space, starving, sweating, and being completely ignored. The attitude was careless, unprofessional, and downright insulting.

This isn’t just a service failure — it’s a complete collapse of basic respect for customers. Pizza Hut should be ashamed to let their name be associated with this level of incompetence. People don’t spend their hard-earned money just to be lied to, treated like garbage, and left hungry after hours of waiting. If this is what Pizza Hut calls “service,” then it’s a disgrace to the brand and a slap in the face to every single paying customer. Zero stars would be too generous.

We all got conned by this company. I would never buy from hereeEVER again. Even Dominos is better than this crap.
author: Tan Hong Yeh

review_text: I would like to commend the outlet manager fhenix for the courtesy of calling to inform me in advance about the delay with my order. This is proactive approach demonstrates excellent customer care, transparency and respect for customers time. Thank you and greatly appreciated!! Kudos!!
author: John Wiki

review_text:
I usually review food places to compliment them, but this outlet is just disappointing. Have been ordering pizza hut for years, there's usually someone to call you to inform the order will be late. This place has consistently disappointed me in multiple occasions, not just late delivery (like 1.5 - 2 hours from placing an order) but also a lack of communication.

Today's pizza came close to 2 hours after ordering, and all the pizzas arrived cold.

I wouldn't get delivery from this place again.
author: Huang Yida

review_text: I am extremely disappointed with my recent order. I placed an advance order for delivery by 7:30 PM, yet by 8:30 PM the pizza had not arrived, and the outlet did not call to inform me of the delay. I tried calling your hotline multiple times, but it was always busy. On the few occasions I got through, the agents merely said they would inform the outlet and that someone would call back—yet no one did. Eventually, I reached the outlet directly, spoke to Iqbal, and mentioned that I would cancel if the delivery did not arrive. His response was simply “okay?” Meanwhile, my children were crying from hunger. This is by far the worst service I have ever experienced. I am extremely dissatisfied and will not order from Pizza Hut again.
author: Joyceey Teh

review_text:
Have been ordering from them a lot during my NS Reservist at Woodlands HQ. Out of the 30 pizzas I had, today(9 Sep 2025) was the first time seeing them breach their food safety by dropping a red capsicum into my pizza, which classified chicken not supposed to have. Note that capsicum allergy exists in this world and people could potentially pass away from medical complications if taken in orally.

The staff on duty needs to learn customer service. After he packed all the pizzas for pickup into the boxes, and a customer showed up in his face at the counter with no one else, he is supposed to serve the customer first. Pickup order was ready to go but had to watch him do his packing, it’s not like he is busy with handling pizzas which I could totally understand. He chose to pack pizzas into plastic bag when the pickup isn’t even here.
author: Kong Wen Sheng

review_text: Pizza was fresh out of the oven within 10 mins of ordering, friendly staff, and pizza was very delicious! Had difficulty using the app, kind staff helped me! Extremely lively atmosphere, definitely recommend to anyone who works nearby, or just wants to eat pizza!
author: John

review_text:
Been patronizing Dominos nearly a decade and this is the first time it is so disappointing.
1. Pizza is over cooked - most likely oven is too hot.
2. Point 2 can be related to point 1, where there is insufficient sauce, and the extra cheeze topup on one of the pizza ? no where to be found. and the sauce is dried up, almost like eating a biscuit.

author: Daerious James

review_text:

author: sarah foo

review_text:
Absolutely ridiculous experience with Domino.
First time ever receiving the WRONG pizza order, and your customer service is a complete joke — no follow up on my request.

author: Ng Wan Wen

review_text:
7 Feb 2026 2pm Unexpected detour that we met this halal gem. Delicious food n good vibes. Chicken salad is tender n seasoned well. Mash potato on point. Pasta with right amount of sauce n flavours....yummy....quench with lemongrass tea....refreshingly awesome! Staff is friendly n fast service. Friendly lady boss too. Oh btw we came via walk in n thank god there is a table for us yeay! Almost full house!
Just hope they change their system to order n pay at the same time upon order via QR code as business in 2026 hard to stay a float in Singapore. Would be sad to have this kind of local halal gem lost.
Recommended!
Sorry to missed out the good portion of chicken salad...my MIL already dive right in after the sight of the mouth watering chicken hehe....
They are at the entrance at Active SG Gym
author: Sang Semut

review_text: Recently，I came here to eat lunch. The food was really delicious. The turkey bacon and chicken ham carbonara is perfect for kids or adults. The chocalate lava cake just melts in your mouth！It is really good and I really recommend it. The waitress was really friendly too. The atmosphere was just right，not too loud or too quiet. It was also really clean. Do come here soon.
author: zheng

review_text:
Recently visited Citrus by the Pool and had a pleasant dining experience. The environment is comfortable and relaxing, suitable for casual meals with friends or family. The location is also convenient, alight at Marsiling MRT, then take a short bus ride of two stops to reach the restaurant (except Bus 913).

We ordered a variety of dishes and overall the food was very enjoyable:

Homemade Mushroom Soup: rich and flavorful, with noticeable mushroom bits.

Truffle Fries: served crispy, with a nice truffle aroma.

Baked Salmon: tender and not dry.

Creamy Seafood Pasta: fresh seafood, creamy and satisfying.

Seafood Aglio Olio: strong garlic aroma, appetizing and flavorful.

OMG Burger (Beef & Lamb): generous, hearty fillings.

Molten Chocolate Lava Cake: cutting into it released a rich flow of chocolate.

Passionfruit Americano: refreshing, with a good balance of fruity acidity and coffee bitterness.

All this for just SGD 6.90 for lunch set, excellent value for money.

Highly recommend checking this place out if you’re in the area.
author: Jiaanee Wong

review_text:
The menu fuses Western dishes with Southeast Asian flavors—super tasty and affordable. Definitely added to my hidden gems list! ✨

Their weekday lunch sets (Mon–Thu) are amazing value—just over $10 for starter + main + drink.

Starters:
•	Snack Attack Platter – Big sharing platter with crispy fried chicken, fish, and sweet potato fries.
•	Fried Chicken with Thai Chilli Sauce – Boneless, golden, tender, with a spicy kick.

Mains:
•	Green Curry Pasta – Surprisingly good combo; curry rich but not heavy.
•	Shiok Burger – Huge fried chicken patty with chili crab-inspired sauce, juicy and flavorful.
•	Grilled Free-Range Chicken – Slow-cooked then seared; tender, juicy, with seasonal salad & mashed potatoes.

Desserts:
•	Molten Chocolate Lava Cake – Gooey chocolate heaven.
•	Croffle with Ice Cream – Warm croissant-waffle, caramel sauce & ice cream—perfect balance of hot & cold.

Highly recommend for tasty, affordable Western food with a twist!
author: Milly

review_text:
Had a really nice time dining here. Cozy, welcoming spot that’s great for a chill meal or hanging out at night. Staff were friendly and made us feel comfortable throughout the meal.

Everything we ordered was good, but the Thai Green Curry Seafood Pasta was the standout, creamy, fragrant, and not too spicy. Loved the baked salmon, and the Eggploding Burger was messy in the best way. Pineapple fried rice had a nice sweet-tangy balance, and the Snack Attack Platter was perfect for sharing. House salad was fresh with a nice kick from the Cajun chicken.

Drinks and desserts didn’t disappoint either, milkshakes were great, iced latte was smooth, and the lava cake was warm and gooey.

Overall, good food, good vibes, and a comfy place to chill. Would come back!!
author: Xling Tang

restaurant_name: PastaMania - Italian Casual Dining @ Causeway Point
review_text:
Located inside the Mall on Basement 1.
Ample seats available.
You could order using the QR code. Wide variety of pasta to order from.
Prices were reasonable and also the portion was alright. Lunch set available too.
Food was served fast.
The mushroom baked rice was good, heavily coated with the right amount of cheese. Yummy.
Overall experience was good.
author: DR DAVY GOH

restaurant_name: PastaMania - Italian Casual Dining @ Causeway Point
review_text:
It’s been more than 10 years since I had pastamania and I’m really surprised and impressed by the revamp and how amazing their tomyum pasta tastes? Tangy, spicy, creamy. Sauce isn’t too thin too. Really lovely. They also can accommodate customisations (I didn’t want clams). Only sad part is they didn’t give me more prawns in return 🤣

The calamari was soft and tender and the batter was tasty and savoury. The tartar sauce that came along with it complemented it really well.

Also thank you to the super bubbly and friendly server Rae and the cute cashier lady (sorry did not catch your name) but your upbeat attitude and smiles made all the difference! Thank you!
author: Veena Ang

restaurant_name: PastaMania - Italian Casual Dining @ Causeway Point
review_text:
We had a wonderful time at Pastamania! They offered a fun kids activity where the children could decorate and draw on cookies — such a creative and enjoyable idea that kept them excited throughout the meal.

A special shout-out to Warni, who was very friendly and professional. She was patient with the kids and made sure we had everything we needed. Her warm service really made our visit even better.

Thank you Pastamania and thank you Warni for making our family outing such a great experience! We will definitely come again!

restaurant_name: PastaMania - Italian Casual Dining @ Causeway Point
review_text: After renovations, the restaurant is much brighter and welcoming. Used to feel stressed eating here, now it's much more friendly and relaxing. Everyone is friendly, and the food is served hot and delicious.

review_text:

Diana was amazing. Her positive attitude, quick service, and attention to detail really stood out. Thank you for the great experience!

review_text:
We enjoyed our meal here very much. The kids always loved Swensen's. Food was great and ice cream fantasticas always. Staff are polite.

author: Mia Yap

review_text:
Its been a long while since I've dined in a Swensen's. Our recent visit was a stark contrast to the Swensen's that I used to know. Hoping for a reliable meal, we came in for an early lunch. Unfortunately, the experience was lacking from the start. Despite being one of only two tables, our order was forgotten and we had to follow up.

The main issue was the food. I ordered the Christmas special Crayfish Linguine, and it was deeply underwhelming. The "special" sauce was confusing and off-putting, making the dish a turn-off. I felt compelled to share my feedback with the manager, but his dismissive shrug was a disappointment.

It's a shame to see such a decline. Based on this experience, I cannot recommend dining here if you're expecting the quality Swensen's was once known for.
author: rockerfellas

review_text: I had a great experience here with my girlfriends and our kids. The service was excellent – Bharat the store Manager and his team were friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was just right. The food came out quickly, and everything was fresh and flavorful. It’s always nice to dine somewhere that makes you feel welcome. Definitely a place I’d recommend and look forward to visiting again. 👍🏻😄
author: Alice Tan

review_text: Thank you to the Swensens service staff for making our meal such a pleasant one! They offered great service despite our large group size. The food and desserts were all great and served promptly after ordering!
author: J Choo (Jchuuu)

review_text:
I redeemed 2.80 coffee here at night around 8ish.It could be due to weekend customer traffic, I waited patiently for my Frappuccino to be ready.
This outlet was located away from hustle and bustle of causeway point away, which I think it was ideal for customers whom prefer a more quiet ambience.

Requested to divide the cup of cappuccino into  2 cups and to help cut the scone. Barrister Haziq did the job very nicely and we appreciate it. Had a pleasant time there.

Ordered the oat milk latte and the orange juice.

review_text:
price has become very expensive!
bought set drink + cheese cake but i was not given the cup, reminded the server, like not happy gave one kind of a look. not worth the money in terms of food quality versus price paid.
The cheese cake was super small!
author: J “Nobita” O

review_text:
overall:4.6
fast servings of meats, limited choice of drinks available, DIY ice cream. spacious and bright lighting.
limited choice of self service hotpot ingredients. there's a timer on the order page after you scan the QR code.

went for dinner on cny eve cuz there's no queue.
chosen wagyu set for 3 adults, it comes with unlimited meats (as long as you can finish), there is pork, chicken & beef available. self-service hotpot ingredients, refillable drinks (need to add on for $2.50 and comes with DIY ice cream).
meat quality and soup base are great.

but location isn't near my house, will visit again if I'm near place.
author: Owena

review_text:
Always an enjoyable dining 🍽️ experience at Shabu Sai Causeway Point .

Shabu Sai is one of my favourite buffet restaurants cos of their excellent customer service, value for money buffet with wide range of ingredients including including free flow of soda and hot beverages + delicious soft serve 🍦 ice cream. They didn’t provide fresh fruits though. It would be another plus point if they have fresh fruits.

Didn’t catch the name of the staff but the tall male , dark skinned … seemed to be Chinese server who brought us to our table was extremely friendly and helpful . He also immediately provided a new bottle of chocolate syrup when I was getting my
soft serve 🍦 ice cream and discovered the chocolate syrup had ran out.

The manager Mr Tamil, who handled the payment transaction for us, was also very friendly.

Looking forward to going back there again.
author: Eileen LKY (Hungry Mama)

review_text: Nothing crazy special to be honest. The food is decent. The service from my experience was really good, really nice staff. But the main thing is good value for money.
author: D

review_text:
Shabu Sai Overall, Shabu Sai at Causeway Point offers a pleasant dining experience, the pork, beef, and chicken are nicely sliced, thin, and fresh, making them very appealing for hotpot. The vegetables are also fresh and well-kept, and the ice cream is a delightful way to end the meal.

The only downside is the 70-minute dining limit, which can feel a bit rushed, especially since hotpot takes time to cook and enjoy. Thankfully, the staff didn’t chase us out even after we exceeded the time limit. It would be wonderful if they could extend it to 120 minutes(two hours) would be just right for a comfortable and satisfying hotpot experience.
author: Koko

review_text: Shabu Sai Woodlands is a hidden gem in my view and a regular spot for my family, especially as a meat lover. The variety of meats and vegetables is impressive, and the quality is consistently fresh. Service is always superb, and while there can be a short wait during peak hours (usually around 10–20 minutes), it’s well worth it. The seating is comfortable, making the dining experience relaxed and enjoyable. Personal highlights include the Japanese beef curry and the ice cream corner, which are always a satisfying finish.
author: SANJAY

review_text: Great customer service. Staff is friendly and patient while waiting for me to decide. An array of varieties of donuts to choose.
