The must haves are the fried fish, fried stone, fried pineapple rice and tom yam soup.

so yummy and as per their usual practice, food is served super efficiently like fast food and all dishes within 10 min.
author: John Chua

review_text:
The total damage for all four dishes was just $53, very reasonably priced. Do take note that they only accept cash payment.

The pineapple fried rice is a must try in my opinion, it was really very good. The pork rib was amazingly good as well.

The tom yum soup, however, was a bit average and underwhelming in my opinion.

Although they are called Taste of Thailand, I felt the food leaned more towards a Chinese style. Service was super fast.
author: Master GC

review_text:
I’d heard a lot about this place, so I came to try it out.

Honestly, despite the name Taste of Thailand, the food didn’t quite reflect authentic Thai flavors. Most of the dishes tasted more Chinese than Thai… the only exception was the seafood sauce, which had a distinctly Thai taste.

For example, the cereal prawns, you won’t find that dish in traditional Thai cuisine. I’d say this is more of a Chinese restaurant with a Thai fusion twist.

P.S. The toilet was very dirty, which was disappointing.
author: nina e

review_text: Had chicken briyani, murtabak, prata and Maggi goreng and it was fantastic. Even the teh tarik had great tea flavor with the right amount of milk and sugar. Fortunately (or unfortunately) the teh tarik had a hint of ginger which enhanced the taste. Maybe the spoon had some ginger powder from previous order. Still good though!
author: J.K. Chua

review_text: Best go to for late night meals. Prata was freshly made upon order, that explains the crispiness and piping hot. Other than fish curry, there’s a sauce that similar to Ayam masak merah to go with, simply chef kiss! Teh Halia was good too! Strong ginger taste and not too sweet
author: Xing Ting

review_text: Ordered 5 plain prata with 2 Teh Halia for breakfast of 2.  The prata were freshly made.  The top was flaky and crispy but the bottom was hard.  Seems that it was not cooked throughly.  The standard had dropped.  Teh halia is still ok.
author: Susan Tay

review_text: A hearty $5.10 breakfast featured crisp, fluffy prata (egg and kosong) paired with curry chicken sauce and a rare sambal dip reminiscent of cross border up north breakfasts, plus a comforting frothy teh halia that rounded off the meal perfectly.
author: Yang

review_text:
The coin prata was particularly thick and doughy. Not at all nice. The gravy though is not too bad.
The maggi goreng was quite nicely fried, with lots of chicken meat and bones. But at $9, it should be. Would be nice to have more vegetables for a balance.
author: A Lin

review_text:
Nicely air-conditioned and comes with a small complimentary starter ‘shot’ of a drink. The staff were polite and the service was fast. We ordered the chicken nasi briyani.

The portion size felt slightly on the smaller side, but it was decent for me since I am on a diet. The taste was good, pretty decent, and it came with three different types of sauce to try.

Total $36 for 2 pax (2 chicken biryani and 2 drinks)
author: Master GC

review_text:
Date- 23- Jan - 2026

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Paradise Briyani🎉✨️

Excellent Kerala restaurant with amazing food.

The parotta, beef curry, and biryani were outstanding and truly authentic.

The service was professional and attentive, and the ambience was clean and comfortable.

Prices are slightly on the premium side, but the quality, taste, and overall experience make it worth it.

Highly recommended!

Excellent hospitality & great dine in experience.
author: Arul Honest Raj

review_text:
Very fragrant nice byriyani.
Khaima/jeera rice is $1 more than usual basmati rice, both are fragrant enough so not much diff to me. Mutton and chicken in byriyani are tender and nice. Butter chicken gravy is delicious, but the chicken inside slightly dry however covered with gravy ok.
author: KKT

review_text: My dining experience at this establishment was exceptionally satisfying. The culinary offerings were uniformly delicious 🍲, each dish presenting a distinct and superbly executed flavor profile. I had the opportunity to sample a diverse selection from their menu, and every item exceeded my expectations in terms of taste and preparation. The overall quality of the food underscored a commitment to gastronomic excellence. This restaurant is highly recommended for individuals seeking an outstanding meal in a pleasant setting. The consistently high standard across all sampled dishes makes it a noteworthy culinary destination 💯. I plan to revisit this location to explore more of their impressive menu. The ambiance further enhanced the positive impression, contributing to a truly delightful and memorable visit. ✨
author: Akki

review_text:
This place turned out to be a hidden gem as we dont live in Yishun. Really loved the mutton dum biriyani, even tho its prolly lamb meat (like most places in sg), the meat was very tender. It was juicy and so was the masala it was cooked with. We also had masala tea which was good. Bamboo chicken biriyani was good too, a different touch in presentation. We loved the vegetable pakoda too.

Very few places in SG has thick milk masala tea and its one of them!

Good service, good atmosphere. The location is a bit far off but for those in Yishun, definitely come here! Finally a proper dum biriyani place.
author: manas nag

review_text: Very tasty veg chicken rice with generous serving of rice. Soup has some herbal taste too.
author: JAMES LIM

review_text: Wide variety of vegetarian options nestled in a heartland coffeeshop. Porridge was warm and tasty while the noodle was wanton was freshly deep fried. Portion was decent and filling. Staff supports one another well. Worth a try.
author: andyloe

review_text: Quite a spread of vegan options. Best vegan food in sg, IMHO! Good balance of soy and greens and other ingredients! Best curry puffs in sg, chicken rice!!!
author: Lai Meng

review_text:
1st order Veggies uncooked.
2nd order. Delicious
3rd order. Delicious
author: LING SEAH

review_text: Ordered their signature vegetarian noodles sans noodles $4.50 as I wanted to reduce carb intake. Clean and good vegetarian food. Soup was great. Look forward to coming back again.
author: Rise&Shine

review_text: A variety of noodles and porridge. See frequented customers getting from the stall and decided to give it a try. No regrets. Fish porridge was well blended and served hot! Portion was filling and the sliced fish were fresh! Chilli padi to porridge is my ritual! The chilli padi were freshly cut unlike some that keeps overnight. Do go for it if you are there!
author: andyloe

review_text: $7 big bowl of dry chili ban mian malay flavor. Would prefer the  normal chili but aunty didn't say
author: Oh Ming Feng

review_text: Loved the tom yum noodles! The sourness and spiciness were just right for me. It wasnt too spicy or too sour either :D The handmade noodles were were really bouncy which goes well with the soup. The portion was also quite big despite it’s affordable price. Would come back again :)
author: Louiselle Wong

review_text: The handmade noodles from the hawker stall are an absolute delight. The fresh, perfectly textured noodles infused with aromatic flavors, combined with succulent meat and thoughtfully chosen garnishes, create a culinary masterpiece. A must-visit for noodle lovers seeking a heavenly and satisfying comfort food.
author: Caihong

review_text:
I loved how bouncy their fishballs were, like little flavor bombs exploding in my mouth.

Their homemade noodles are awesome too! The food is perfect and the owner is super friendly!. I wholeheartedly recommend everyone to come and try it. You won't be disappointed!
author: Yu Ying

review_text:
The staff who took my order very friendly and no pushy. Contactless payment friendly.
All the food ordered was awesome & my kids love it. Hope the seaweed fries can be better to put more seaweed & powder more.  Will return again 👍
author: Mc_zz

review_text:
THEY GO BY CASHLESS!

The food is actually quite okay but can consider using unsalted cheese? Cause it’s a bit salty for my liking and i believe the pasta itself also has seasoning which includes salt.
author: Sad Potato

review_text:
(Disclaimer: Order at the Counter; Service N.A.)

First time here, after recommended by my mom in law. The sweet potato fries are amazing! The mains are huge! Great job to this small crew!
author: Jannah Monjiat

review_text: First time here, the coffee shop is spacious, clean & bright, ordered their Signature Chargrilled Chichen Chop, meat is tendered, taste even better when dipped into the black pepper sauce, fries a bit oily, overall is quite a filling meal.
author: Jacklyn Tsang

review_text: The steak here is horrible. When I ordered the Ribeye steak for 20.90, I expected a decent sized that tastes better than most coffeeshop steaks. However, the steak was smaller than expected and extremely tough despite it being medium rare, and I struggled to cut it into smaller pieces with metal cutlery. Furthermore, the steak had a weird taste, indicating lack of freshness. Variety of side dishes is also limited, and the other Margherita pizza I ordered was barely satisfactory. Overpriced and worse than average.
author: Daisuke

review_text:
when opening the store: there was promo buy one get one prata. but please improve your prata, or just use frozen prata from market. then rojak sauce need to improve. havent try other menu since i already upset with the prata as the basic menu. lets we see next year is there any improvement

update:
i asked my husband to buy rojak for the second time from this stall (after few months). i asked him to try 4 rojak only, and today we are satisfied the rojak sauce is much better than before. tasteful, and we can enjoy our rojak so well. will comback again for rojak. i hope not change
author: Zahra Alvenia

review_text: hi i loveeee the rojak here pleaseee bring it back.. i love the sauce especially 😭😭😭 pls pls im begging.. i come here everyday and i buy it everyday, but then it’s gone whoever is the boss pls bring the rojak back
author: Nurul Solehah

review_text: Worst stall ever I order nasi briyani  @ 9.40am waited 2h++ and the people say 10am after that I ask again then people say 30min more I still waiting after that they tell me 5min more still not yet done not recommend to come I received my order at 11.06am
author: Lee Thanissorn

review_text: Super fresh, steamed yummy mayam. Best mayam in sg. Must tried!!!!
author: Lai Meng

review_text: i am very hungry but i couldn't complete the foods. it not nice at all. I should have ordered other food in the coffeeshop
author: Simon Kinn

review_text: Saw video on Tiktok so came to try. Had their fishhead steamboat, salted egg pork ribs and rice. Total damage $48.60 ( after CDC vouchers with 10% discount) for two persons. Food wise was normal and nothing outstanding. Fish meats were tough and dry and very little yam. The salted egg pork ribs were also a little tough though the sauce was acceptable. The coffee shop was clean and tidy.
author: Henry Heng

review_text: Food here was very good, got hidden menu need to ask boss / employees for recommendation. Must order the fish head steamboat! V fresh, soup made w sole fish v tasty but not overly salty. The black pepper crab and truffle white pepper crab is must try, crab texture was firm v good!! Then the salted egg pork belly claypot was v yummy too. Place was clean and well lit. Great for gatherings
author: Jeslyn Chew

review_text:
Ordered the lunch fish head soup set meal during dinner hour for lunch price of $50. So $12.50 pax for 3 dishes and one fishhead soup. Quite okay.

For what it is worth the side dishes were actually pretty decent. fu rong egg was so-so but kang kong and prawn paste chicken were great. Kang kong was well stirred fried in term of taste while prawn paste chicken crust was super crispy.

The fish head soup not so. Seems to be missing yam. Not thick. Fish skin was rubbery and worst of all not descaled well. Taste wise it only get salty towards the end but they can refill if you want. However the soup was already mild so i doubt that is a good idea. Maybe their curry fish head will be better 🤔.

But difficult to find this pricing these day and it feeds 4 to 5 pax.
author: Super Fragrance

review_text:
I have been following thia chef wherever he go.. i always like the special menu provided by him.  This time round, brought my 2 friends for lunch! Thumbs up man!! 👍👍👍👍

Dishes ordered was : fish sauce white beehoo , curry fish head, 4 heavenly king (4 大天王）and the special dish fried cuttlefish with dried shrimp .. power👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼

Folks… try if u nearby
author: elaine chiau

review_text:
Long wait time for the tzechar - only ordered the fish head steamboat but waited 40mins on a Sunday night,8pm.

Paid $40 but you barely get more than 10 slices of fish slices, not much ingredients inside the pot also🥲
author: SL L

review_text:
Disappointing experience due to incorrect order.
Visited on New Year’s Day to redeem a Christmas present, a simple meal out with my daughter that we were genuinely looking forward to.

Unfortunately, the food served did not match our order. I specifically requested no pig skin, yet my bowl arrived with a noticeable amount of pig skin placed directly on top. This was a clear request and should have been observed.

My daughter also ordered extra char siew (additional $2), but none was visible when the dish was served. Only after eating halfway through did we manage to find about four small pieces, which is disappointing considering the extra charge of $2.

The curry itself tasted alright, but order accuracy matters, especially when special requests are made and paid for. On a day meant to be a small but meaningful treat, this experience fell short.

Hope the stall improves on order checking and consistency, as it affects customer trust and the overall dining experience.
author: Rachel Neo

review_text:
I always going around with my family to look for good Ipoh Curry mee. Today 20/10 visited this stall. Before i was excited but after ordering i was deeply dissappionted. Firstly the staff who take order, his attitude is extremely bad, after ordering, we waited 22min for the food. Ordering time i told the black face to add extra chilli, but look at it, i get none.
Frankly, even though the food is good on the slurry, but the staff... i would come back here forever and will not recommend to my friends
To the boss, you can visit this place 1, Yishun Industrial street 1. You will know the different.
author: Richard Lo

review_text: The curry is very nice n smooth. Don’t have the eat n rough throat feel. Price is reasonable. Service staff seems ok. Worthy eat. Best eat on the spot while it’s hot.
author: Teng Andrew

review_text:
🥴Just a very NORMAL & SIMPLE Curry Noodles, there is no WOAH factor. Can easily get much better tasty yummilicious curry noodles in any corner of Singapore. Especially HL market. Price are reasonable, right portion. Staff are really need more customer service orientation la, please! Served with sulky face, are they overloaded with underpaid?!? 🥴How to expect the food to be nice?!? Must cook with LOVE ❤️
😃🤪Curry noodles with charsiew & siobak + taupok & long beans. And curry chicken 🐔 breast meat beehoon. Both中規中矩. I waited my order in front of the stall to avoid the broth “不燒”. 🤪Overall is just a very ordinary curry noodles. 😀
author: ten 10

review_text: Real authentic Ipoh taste with curry soup, Ipoh kueh teow (怡保河粉） & a lot of fried item. The curry was flavourful and refreshing. Delicious
author: Yap CT

review_text: Service is attentive. Environment is bright. Food is to my liking but spice level a bit challenging for me. Many choices to choose from and price is reasonable. Ordered both dry curry version of chicken and prawn. Chicken one is more interesting. The mutton soup is a bit bland but mutton is tender and the soup is potent.
author: Adrick Loh

review_text: Today I had food in your restaurant. Me and my 3 friends said biryani dum today. Why did you eat biryani? I ate jookun branchil in your restaurant. It was good. But here it was bad. We waited 20 minutes for each biryani. We ordered lemon juice  very worst over salt and waited 16 minutes. We waited 24 minutes drink water melon juice.
author: Vicky07. 12.1995 Manojvicky

review_text:
Currently am having my food as I am posting. Food Is excellent..I am having veg biryani, my spouse is having chicken noodles.. the veg biryani two thumbs ..the fragrance of authentic biryani is there though veg.. the chicken noodles is very tasty according to my spouse ..
verdict place is fine place to dine in
author: weili HuaDi

review_text: We were in doubt before going there ,but proven me wrong.. Very decent food, staff is so friendly! Must try *** Tawa fish fry , Street style noodles .
author: Shiva Chandan R

review_text:
The service was excellent—waiters were attentive and ensured a pleasant dining experience.

I ordered the mutton meal set along with a mango lassi, and both were delicious. A nice touch was the complimentary top-up of appetizer snacks, which added to the overall experience.

Considering the reasonable pricing, I found it to be a great value for money. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for authentic Indian cuisine in Yishun!
author: Thae Pwint

review_text:
Ordered my meal right at 12pm through table service. Waited for 20mins still not served and realized something wasn’t right because the couple beside me came later already finished their meal. Went down to check and they said don’t have a record of my order. Food was served after 35 mins because of missing order.

Charlotte immediately attended to me and did her service recovery very well. Thank you for being attentive and being so helpful! She make the whole experience better. :)
author: Kristen Tan

review_text: Placed an order for one medium coke zero and thought it will be pretty quick as it is just filling up the cup with coke at the dispenser but somehow idk why it can take such a long time considering it wasnt really busy. Staff also appear to be blur and not sure which orders are ready and which are not. Mcdonalds please train your staff properly
author: YS T

review_text: They only have one type of toy and book for happymeal.The atmosphere is good but it is too noisy. The food was scrumptious and nice. So if you already have the hedgehog and green wings then dont come here.I m ten years old and i was hoping to have my toy.But sadly they don t have.
author: Gan Swat Peng

review_text: I am writing here and hope to get attention from Mcd management's concern. I was ordering one upsized set meal and one ala carte. When choosing the option of sides, I chose new product, Yuzu McFizz and Crinkle Cut Fries. However, when I received my meal, the drink and fries looked like normal size. I was wondering if the staff accidentally took normal size one for me. So I approached to counter and asked if the items were wrong. But the answer from the staff was "New item comes one size only, while the Crikle Cut Fries box is finished so we use the normal fries pack." I thought I heard wrongly so emphasised again to the staff that I paid more for upsized and was charged more to choose new products, and now I get nothing? The answer from the staff again was "Yes, you get nothing." How ridiculous is this!!! I can accept to pay more to try new item, but it is not reasonable that I pay for upsized meal for new product but at the end getting normal one and the answer is "Yes, you get nothing." What is the point I paid extra? Nice work McDonald's!
author: Wen Kai Ngor

review_text:
Come to this place often, their service is quite good tho a little slow on days where there's a lot of people and orders to fulfill. The staffs are friendly and would correct the order if you did not get your food or was given the wrong order without much fuss.

My suggestion for improvements is maybe to have a few staffs dedicated to certain tasks when it is on high peak days as most of the time there are orders that lack maybe one or two item but cant be sent out because the team is occupied with other orders and perhaps have a few staff that is dedicated to sending out table orders.
author: Eddie LZA

review_text: Their promotional set meals for both single and multi pax are worth the price. The cooking tastes good and sea foods are fresh. Tried many times and the quality remains consistent.
author: Wai Hoe Loke

review_text:
Update review: Ordered the promotional combo consisting of assam fish head, sweet & sour pork and fried chives with bean sprouts. Although the colour of the assam was a bit dark, all the flavours were there. Fish head was really fresh too so you won’t taste that fishy taste. I really love the sweet & sour - so crispy and yet tender with just enough sauce.

Tried 3 different dishes so far and I’m impressed so far all the dishes were really tasty and have just enough wok hei in them, especially the fried rice with chicken cubes and salted fish. First time I had such fried rice combination at a neighbourhood zhi char stall. The chicken cubes were crispy and not dry. Salted fish brings up the flavour to another level. Highly recommended dish. My personal comment is that I feel the prices are a bit on the high side.
author: Henry Cheng

review_text:
Orderd Hor Fun & Mee Hoo Hor Fun.

Honestly average . The Hor Fun already cook , just pour sauce over.

Worst no crowded at all.
😅
author: W8ll8AM S8M

review_text:
This zi char stall deserves to be better-known so that it doesn't close down! Rather quiet on a Saturday night and I'm sure the obscure location has a big part to play in that. But that's such a pity because this was one of the best zi char dinner experiences I've ever had!

We ordered the $39.90 3-dish set which comprises a fish head with a choice of preparation methods, a choice of meat and a choice of veg. Excellent value for money. The fish was fresh, cooked just nice and generously sized (half a large head) and the assam gravy we opted for was superbly appetizing. The meat (prawn paste deep-fried chicken mid-wings) and veg (garlic stir-fried baby kai lan) were equally well-cooked and delicious with generous portions. Very satisfying for our group of 3.

Other nice touches were the servers who were very pleasant, cheerful and friendly, and the coffeeshop environment which was exceptionally clean and modern, with the best-quality furniture I've ever seen in a HDB coffeeshop (sintered stone-topped tables and designer-looking chairs!)

Highly recommended and no, i wasn't paid for this review, i just want them to stick around for a long time haha.
author: D

review_text: Excellent tzi char with a good variety of dishes at reasonable prices. The food taste great, natural-flavoured and not salty. A gem tucked away in a relatively quiet coffeeshop.
author: Mulberry Gal

review_text:
The staff are friendly, and the atmosphere is nice and not too crowded, even though we went during the weekend dinner time.

The tom yum was not really to my taste (personal opinion), but the whole chicken was okay. Some parts were juicy while some were a bit dry (due to different parts), but overall it was decent.

The prices are very affordable. Most main dishes are around $10, and the environment is very comfortable and conducive for dining.
author: Master GC

review_text: Thai Minced Basil Chicken (less spicy) was flavourful, but the sauce was too sweet and the basil aroma was barely noticeable. Red Tom Yum Chicken Soup (less spicy) was okay, the first mouthful had a good balance of sour and spicy, but the chicken tasted like freezer burn.
author: Filtered Fork Guide

review_text:
Went to dine in at Siam Kitchen today because a friend of mine recommended this restaurant and said that the food was delicious, so I went to try.

And I absolutely agree with my friend. I've been to many Thai restaurants as I love eating Thai food, but the food here amazed me. The Tom yum mama chicken it was very flavourful, and the chefs accommodated to my requests that I indicated in my order. The Thai milk tea wasn't too sweet either, which was such a pleasant surprise for me because I was used to the milk tea being too sweet for me.

Highly recommend to come dine in here.
author: Moeha Tsuzuki

review_text: Dine in during my birthday. I was surprised with a few slices of brownie cake topped with a candle by the staffs.. Really appreciate it!!! Food was great and the quantity was just nice!!
author: Mohd Azhar

review_text:
All foods are great and service is fast.

Shawn and the team are very attentive and recommends food that are good for group and the portion.

They played a nice and lively birthday song for my team mate as well which we didnt experience outside. Normally when we asked for our food to be served, they just bring the cake thats it :( but this place brought my friend’s bday cake with a bang! 🥳🎉

The venue and ambiance is good but as the place is small and for family, it tends to be a bit noisy.
author: Gina Francia Mia

review_text:
Had a wonderful lunch set meal with family! Served with drink, soup, main course and ice cream. We were too eager to tuck in, didn't take photo of the delicious homemade mushroom soup with flavourful garlic bread. We had Crispy Fish & Chips, Handcrafted Beef Burger, Grilled Chicken Chop, Teriyaki Salmon Steak, dishes were tasty and satisfying meal for all of us. A varied choice of ice cream flavours available afterwards.
Conveniently located, just 5 minutes walk from Khatib MRT station.
author: Joann Foo

review_text: The 3‑Course Christmas Set Meal ($35.80) looked festive and came in generous portions, but the experience felt more average than memorable, especially at the price point. The chicken chowder, though warm and savoury with tender chicken and corn, was watery instead of thick and creamy and reminded me of canned soup rather than a rich, homemade version. The grilled chicken chop was large, with crispy skin that added flavour, but the meat itself leaned dry and lacked moisture. The carbonara pasta was creamy and filling, topped with turkey bacon, but the noodles were soft and the heavy cream quickly became jelak. The lychee drink was refreshing and pleasant, offering a sweet finish to the meal. Overall, while the effort and presentation were appreciated, the execution fell short — the set felt mid, not festive indulgence. With some refinement in flavour and texture, it could better justify its festive pricing.
author: Yang

review_text: Honestly this place deserves more attention. The waffles and ice cream is so good and worth it!! Me and my friends always come here. Even the food is super good and its open till 2am. It’s always clean and the place is a vibe. Should definitely give it a try. I’ve been here SO many times. 10/10
author: preethika kannan

review_text: I’ve visited this place a few times, and today I tried their Striploin. It was incredibly satisfying—the meat was succulent and tender. The cozy atmosphere also made it a great place for a hearty late-night meal.
author: U E

review_text: ate here a month back and i have the say the fish and chips were surprisingly very good, 2 big fillets that were in my opinion the perfect ratio of batter to fish. sides are a mild tasting coleslaw with good amount of fries, only thing i felt that cld improve is just the amount of sauce
author: aiden lim

review_text: Definitely my young time favourite place for burger & onion ring. Still as savoury as before, but have to try their king fusion biscoff soft serve ice-cream. It's was so creamy and yum, try it :)

review_text: Very clean environment, staff was very friendly and helpful in regards to my special order. Definitely recommend people to visit for a comfortable meal time! 😺

review_text: Stopped by Burger King for a quick meal.The location was convenient and the atmosphere was nice. The food was exactly what I wanted—tasty and satisfying, just as expected from BK.

review_text: Located at level 1 of HomeTeamNS, the burger king was renovated once. The decoration of the shop looks nice. Although sometimes I find the service slightly slow when it is usually quite empty at night but the food is nice most of the time.

restaurant_name: 津味云吞鸡爪面 (Jin Wei Wanton Chicken Feet Noodle)
review_text:
Im glad to stumble upon this well-loved wanton mee spot

Springy, al dente noodles like tok tok bamboo noodles, lean yet tender charsiew and silky-thin wantons packed with juicy, well-seasoned filling. 🌟

The chilli packs a sneaky punch, while the braised chicken feet is fall-off-the-bone tender with sweet, herbaceous flavors.The dumpling soup is light yet flavorful, with plump, prawn-filled dumplings that hit the spot.

They are cash only stall and sells out early (usually by 2pm) —so come quick! 💰🔥
author: elle ary

restaurant_name: 津味云吞鸡爪面 (Jin Wei Wanton Chicken Feet Noodle)
review_text:
Chance upon this stall selling wanton noodle at the coffeeshop under the blk 807 Yishun Ring road. This coffeeshop is walking distance away from Khatib MRT station. Reached there around 2plus in the afternoon and the coffeeshop wasn’t packed. Upon reaching the stall, I was able to order. The stall is operated by 2 Vietnamese lady. Apparently this place is popular for the braised chicken feet. Apart from the standard wanton noodle, they also sell shredded chicken, dumpling and braised chicken feet noodle. They also have array of sides dishes to choose from.

Ordered the wanton noodle which was SGD$3.50, comes with the standard charsiew and normal wantons. Requested to swap it to the fried wanton but was declined. Noodle was nicely cooked, texture of the noodle was springy. Noodle was on the dry side, could do with more sauce. Charsiew was below average, quite dry and bland.

Overall, noodle was average. The staff could be more friendly and approachable.
author: Sean Goh

restaurant_name: 津味云吞鸡爪面 (Jin Wei Wanton Chicken Feet Noodle)
review_text:
We went there for breakfast and ordered #1, 2, 3 and 4. Basically tried almost everything that they have :).

The noodles is very nice - cook just nicely and tossed in nice savoury sauce. Unfortunately they don't have pork lard but they substitute it with garlic oil.

As for the chicken feet please note that the style here is the more herb aromatic type. It is not my style but other people like it. The chicken is also super tender.

I was won over by the noodles :).

At night he does not serve the biryani so its mainly prata and maggi options.

Overall the food here is good so please do try to support this uncle if you do enjoy his food!

review_text:
5/12/2025 Takagi Ramen visit during lunchtime.
I have been a loyal fan of Takagi Ramen from since their days at that little stall in the back corner of that Ang Mo Kio  coffeeshop until now they're a multiple-shops business. Been hooked on their delectable noodles, Japanese charsiew & tonkotsu soup & gyoza from when I was an aspiring young adult with dreams of proving my worth in my job career till now I'm wheelchair bound after I am discharged from hospital recently in Oct 2025.

Now that I'm wheelchair bound, I'm very glad that there's a Takagi Ramen very close to my home in Chong Pang.
Though even then it's been 2 months since I visited Chong Pang's Takagi Ramen & the last time I was there celebrating my cousin's promotion, I was still walking around on my 2 legs & I'm not sure if their shop (& staff) is wheelchair friendly this time round. & Even then to reach Chong Pang's Takagi Ramen from my home from opp Yishun Secondary School is an uphill labour achievement now I'm in wheelchair & it's not an electric/motorized wheelchair.

I'm just super happy on that 5 Dec 2025 visit to meet part-timer Nana who served me when I arrived at the ordering kiosk outside of Chong Pang's Takagi Ramen.
I'm not able to reach the ramen item choice on the menu & she not only help me with taking my order, there's a small hiccup with entering the shop with the slope at the entrance being too steep for my wheelchair to enter without flipping over behind. I'm very happy she respected my wish to try to push myself in on my own first, taking into regards my dignity before we both see the slope's issue after I tried  & she offered help to steady & push me in in a warm, friendly manner.

Her service is warm, homely & compassionate without bias or prejudice towards me as a wheelchair bound customer which I find rare as I have faced stigma & prejudice in the face of others in other f&b establishments especially with regards to the 'extra needs & issues' faced by single wheelchair bound person when traveling outside without family/helper.

Kudos to the management for training & instilling such good values in your staff even ur part-timer are so well mannered & humane. Pls 🙏🏻 help me thank & reward her for such a happy unforgettable visit, which I finally have my craving satisfied after 2 months being hospitalized & my heart healed by the care & service shown by her.
Thank you for the wonderful ramen & warm homely service.

review_text:
To an average singaporean, the words ‘porridge’ and ‘$7.50’ might be a little shocking. But here, the porridge was packed full of ingredients. My mom and i got a porridge, a side and a youtiao each, you might think, ezpz right? No! 😂 we were such deep food coma after our meal if you placed a bed we could be snoring in seconds. The porridge was really comforting and so so hot, which meant that it was still warm even after some time under the cold air conditioning. The claypot liver was enjoyable, no weird tastes or smells and the fried intestine was lowkey giving taiwanese fried chicken in taste. The youtiao was warm and crispy. The ingredients all seemed really fresh and the whole meal was satisfying.
The food came really quickly as well. There were 11 orders ahead of us when we ordered but we got our food in like ten minutes.
I usually get anxious whenever i visit these kind of fast paced, busy ahh shops, worried that the staff member might rush me for my order, but everyone here was really patient and nice.
This was a really pleasant experience! No wonder they’re so famous, well deserved!
author: jareau

review_text:
Delicious bowl of fish porridge that I had.
There were plentiful of fish slices. The fish was flavourful - clearly cooked in lightly salted broth prior.
The porridge is more towards the Cantonese style. Quite 烂 and you can only see some grains. I find it not consistent though. Some days it is saltier and some days more bland. I would prefer it even more 烂 like Chai Chee pork porridge.
It doesn’t come with you tiao by default unlike other porridge places. You’ll have to add with additional cost.
Red chili wasn’t available when I was there.
The waiting time isn’t very long. During weekend peak lunch hour, I waited for 10-15min even though there were 20 numbers ahead of me.
There’s indoor and outdoor seating. It was full indoors so I had to sit outside but it wasn’t too warm because there were large fans, which also helped to cool down my porridge quickly for consumption.
I love that you can customise your own porridge.

Pork intestine : okay

Had the dried bak kut teh at this place. Please note that the smallest portion was $15 for 2 persons. It comes with a bowl of soup. Rice is additional 80cents.

The bak kut teh has nice thick sauce. There was also dried squid to give the extra omph. Although the price was quite high but I find the portion quite big. Lots of ribs and belly meat.

The soup was thick and really nice. Packed with flavor and unami.
author: Kwong Fei Yee

review_text:
Order a Xing Zhou fried noodle waited 30 minutes with no disclaimer even given. Lol every 3 minutes tell me I’m next

If I may suggest maybe let the ppl ordering know roughly how long is the wait before taking the order because some ppl are rushing for time
author: Ze wei Tay

review_text: Poor service, rice not even cooked. Food just mediocre. If you have patience to wait for 1 hour, then you can try their zichar.
author: Jolene Yee

review_text: Terrible price increase even before 10 days of Cny 2025. Greedy owner. Fish horfun asking $7.50
author: derrick pwa

review_text:
729 Vegan (Yishun): A Surprisingly Delicious Vegan Find After a Long Cycle! 4/5 Stars

After a long cycling journey from Kukup, Donkey and I, along with two friends, were starving. Luckily, one of our friends, who's vegetarian, found 729 Vegan in Yishun, boasting an impressive 4.7-star Google rating. We were all pleasantly surprised!

The self-service system (order at kiosk, return trays) keeps things simple and efficient. Donkey opted for the Mushroom Rice and a Coffee and was surprised by how flavorful the rice was, even for a meat-eater like him! I chose the ABC Ban Mian Soup and a Genmai Cha, and really enjoyed it. Our friends ordered the Chilli Dry Ban Mian, Chilled Green Tea, and another Genmai Cha, and everyone seemed happy with their choices.

Even though I'm not vegetarian myself, I found the food at 729 Vegan incredibly tasty and satisfying. The cozy atmosphere and affordable prices made it the perfect pit stop after a long day of cycling. We'll definitely be back!

Ratings:

• Mushroom Rice: 4/5 (Surprisingly Flavorful - Donkey Approved!)

• ABC Ban Mian Soup: 4/5 (Delicious and Comforting)

• Chilli Dry Ban Mian: 4/5

• Drinks (Coffee, Genmai Cha, Chilled Green Tea): 4/5

• Value: 5/5 (Affordable)

• Atmosphere: 4/5 (Cozy)

• Overall: 4/5 (Highly Recommended, Even for Non-Vegetarians!)
author: oXRYSTALo Ong

review_text: Five stars! The flavors were bold, food was hot served , the portions were generous, and the service was lightning-fast(Self service). The spicy dumpling soup had the perfect kick. If you’re looking for authentic comfort food, this is the spot.You can play board games by side and enjoy your food .. I’ll definitely be back to try the rest of the menu.
author: sandhya sandy

review_text: Our cycling group, consisting of me, Kitty, and our two friends, had just completed a long journey from Kukup, Malaysia, back to Singapore. We were starving and in need of a good meal. Luckily, one of our friends, who is vegetarian, found 729 Vegan in Yishun, a place with a great 4.7-star Google rating. We decided to check it out, and it turned out to be a fantastic decision. The restaurant is self service, so you order at a kiosk and return your trays when you're done, which keeps things simple and efficient. I opted for the Mushroom Rice and a Coffee, and I was pleasantly surprised by how flavorful the rice was, even for someone who usually eats meat. Kitty chose the ABC Ban Mian Soup and a Genmai Cha and seemed to enjoy them. Our friends ordered the Chilli Dry Ban Mian, Chilled Green Tea, and another Genmai Cha, and everyone seemed happy with their choices. Despite being a non-vegetarian myself, I found the food at 729 Vegan tasty. It was a cozy, affordable, and satisfying experience overall, making it the perfect pit stop after a long day of cycling.
author: Doraemon

review_text:
This is a weird place.. The kitchen is sealed from the dining area. No staff seems to come that side when customers are present.

The noodles are DELICIOUS, the veggies tasty, I love it!!
author: Gam (gamov)

review_text: Been wanting to try this. The rice options were all sold out when I visited. Nevertheless the ABC Ban Mian Soup did not disappoint. Quite tasty and goes will with the chilli. It’s air conditioned and quiet. Even the other diners kept their noise to a minimum when I visited. Will be trying their rice on my next visit.
author: Steven Chow

review_text:
Hiiii...

My name is Ms Kalai and I visited your outlet on 14th Sept around 8.30pm.
I was served by Mr Fitri and Ms Mila.

The service and the sandwich was crafted so SPLENDIDLY. It was the MOST BEAUTIFUL Subway sandwich I've ever had in my life!!
And Ms Mila shared with me the upcoming promotion and was so pleasant.

I've NEVER had such a WONDERFUL service in any fast food restaurant and your crew deserve a big applause for their excellent service and the professionalism.

Thank you for making my day...(and sandwich!! ❤️)
author: Kalai Selvi K

review_text:
8 january 2026, my boyfriend went to buy subway for me in the evening.

The food was nice but apparently my boyfriend said he was talked to very rudely.
I have looked through the outlet reviews. This is not the first time. Why are the workers not talked to regarding their attitude, until it has to reach Google reviews? Dont establishments care the most about these reviews that pull their ratings down?
Seems like they cant be bothered to acknowledge and make changes for the better.

Anyway, the auntie was an old chinese auntie who gestured to my boyfriend and spoke in hokkien “ Dont have right? “ when he asked about the bread availability. Basically she was just entirely rude.

I am chinese and i speak hokkien so there is no racial biasness here.
author: C.

review_text: My friends and I walked into this branch to get our dinner for the night. From my knowledge, subway sandwiches are all toasted. However, the staff did not inform us that they were cleaning the toaster so instead, all of our bread and fries we ordered are microwaved. Resulting in a very unsatisfying and soggy meal. The staff should’ve at least informed us that the toaster was cleaning so that we at least have the option to decide if we still want to eat it. You can see how soft the bread is from the pictures. It is honestly disgusting and I hope something is done on your end.
author: Lim ZhengShun

review_text: Was craving for a signature soft cookie from Subway. So I popped in to grab a few. The cookies were stable and hard. Not like crisp. If that was the case it would have been acceptable. But it was rock stale hard. Could barely bite into it. Super bummed out Oatmeal & Raisin is discontinued too.
author: D. Lim

review_text:
Service was terrible. The staff was hard of hearing and I hard to literally repeat my orders multiple times at every station. Bread, toppings and sauces.

You guys should do a turnover at this outlet, located at Northpoint B2
author: AT TY

review_text:
ordered at 12:10, till now 12:55pm
still didn't get our food.
dunno wth they doing!  and still so many pol are waiting,  not just today,  every single sat noon!!!

update: by 13:02, thank god, we got our order!!! after 52mins of waiting,  and the order wrong somemore, they give 1 fries instead of 3,
author: Daniel Ding Yi

review_text:
Great ambience here - 24hrs! - so best time is after 12am.

My go-to place for a peaceful conducive cafe to clear the mind and work. Happy that’s it’s so conveniently located nearby!

SHOUT OUT to McD Staff Amir, Fadhil, Manager Hisyam, Riduan - you guys are great examples of customer service! Thank you for working hard in the wee hours of the morning making sure all the orders on site and delivery are done without any hitch.

Take care fam and will see you guys again! 🤟
author: G M

review_text:
On last Thursday, December 11, 2025 around 7:00 PM, I visited your here after fetching my son from an activity and ordered a Chicken McSpicy set.

After placing my order, I waited 36 minutes without receiving my food. Frustrated, I approached the counter to inquire about the status. It took another 5 minutes for a staff member to respond, only to inform me that I would need to wait an additional 25 minutes—bringing the total wait time to over an hour for a simple fast-food item!

This is absolutely unacceptable for a “fast food” restaurant like McDonald’s. I expect quick service, especially during dinner hours, but this experience was the opposite—slow, disorganized, and completely disrespectful of customers’ time.

In the end, I had no choice but to compromise and accept a regular McSpicy instead, just to avoid waiting even longer. I left feeling deeply upset and disappointed. Experiences like this make me question why I bother choosing McDonald’s when there are better options with reliable service.
I hope this feedback leads to improvements in staffing, preparation, or communication at this location, as I used to enjoy McDonald’s but this has seriously put me off returning.
author: Nash Siow

review_text:
Giving 5 star ⭐ for the welcomijg behaviour of staff.

I was made very much comfortable as a foreigner here.

Randomly walked here to look into the foreign menu of McD.

As I was heavy after my meal, just got a hot coffee ☕ here.
author: Sharad Kumar

review_text: I have never seen a Macdonalds with so many bad reviews. Apparently, they are for deliveries, which means they are safe from me, for the time being...... My experience dining in was pretty different from others, maybe due to the fact that I was eating in at 3am on a Saturday morning. The toilet was clean, and a staff was actually cleaning the toilet as I was using it. The interior of the restaurant was also clean although it was small. The ambience was clean and comfortable, and service was prompt and fast. Macdonald's food is pretty standard, so I am not going to review my food here. Overall, a pretty well rounded fast food restaurant that needs more indoor seating.
author: Hatsune Miku

review_text: Really crunchy and fresh Har Cheong gai wings. Rice portion is really huge for a big eater like me, and it’s not too oily (my preference). I really love how the Har Cheong gai are hot when I had it too🥹 Must pair your meal with their spicily shiok chilli!
author: Vera Koh

review_text:
This has been on my "must-try" list since pre-covid, so I was thrilled to finally get to try it when I was in the area. Since I'd already eaten, I opted for the minimum order of two wings for $4.40. Despite it being past the usual lunch rush, there was still a steady stream of customers, proving that chicken wings are truly a dish for any time of day! My order was ready in under 3 minutes, and I appreciated the thoughtful presentation, which even included a few slices of cucumber.
Taking my first bite, I was immediately impressed by the airy crunch of the batter, which surprisingly didn't feel greasy at all. Given that the wings were pre fried and refried upon order, the meat leaned slightly towards the drier side. However, I did appreciate the light marination of the wings, without being overly salty.  The accompanying chilli sauce, a classic chicken rice style garlicky chilli, complemented the wings perfectly.  Overall, while these might not be the absolute best har cheong gai I've ever had, they are certainly above average and definitely worth checking out if you happen to be in the area.
author: Touristmouse

review_text: One plate is $6.  Takeaway box 30 cents.  Total $6.30.  For 2 wings 1 drumlet and a piece of egg.
author: Cognoscente 696

review_text: Ah Tan Wings in Singapore is a must-try for fried chicken lovers. The chicken is super flavorful, thanks to a two-day marinade in a specially-developed paste. The wings are then deep-fried to a crispy perfection, and served with a side of chili sauce for an extra kick. The staff is friendly and the service is fast, making Ah Tan Wings a great option for a quick and delicious meal.
author: Super Aba

review_text: The fried chicken cutlet was nicely seasoned - skin was really crispy and the meat was nicely cooked. I think it can do with a bit more prawn paste sauce. Squeeze the lemon slice to add some lightness and acid to balance out the dish. Rice was fluffy but I think it can do with a bit more seasoning. Overall, quite happy with this plate of fried chicken with rice
author: Henry Cheng

review_text:
I would like to introduce a delicious Pao Fan at Stall 01-35A if you are dining at Yishun Park Market, 51 Yishun Ave 11.

Look for Chef Kelvin — he is very polite and courteous. The fried fish is freshly fried, and every grain of rice is fragrant and perfectly cooked.

Highly recommended if you are in the area!
author: Alice Bok

review_text:
FEB2026
Very limited available Muslim food.
Went there few times but managed to only patronise one indian mee goreng foodstall & one malay rice stall.  We like the drink stall that serves hot tea & sells young coconut drink.   Price wise its reasonable & cheaper than eating at Junction Nine.
author: HANA BODYWORKS AND POST-NATAL Massage Singapore

review_text: My family and I loved to eat at Kedai Kak Nur. The food all very nice and reasonable price. The owner also friendly.
author: Sri Anda Salleh

review_text: Ahtan wings is my go to meal when I come here for lunch. Be sure to download the Timbre app use it for payment to enjoy discounts. Only downside is cash in app cannot be withdrawn so weight your options for mode of payment if you are not coming back/often.
author: Terence Yeo

review_text: The place big, airy n spacious. The ceiling is very high. The satay n pork mushroom noodles are delicious!
author: Robin AGPC

review_text:
This is not my first time ordering Mee Goreng.
To my surprised, it came in fast but it’s half of the container.
My usual order , full container!
I am sure you ppl can do better as biz is as usual right?
author: Zauyah Othman

review_text: Ordered  thai-style chicken and price around $25, just to get a chicken chop like size with a LOTS of onions (Can see in the bowl next to the plate). I guess about 2 onions use for that dish? Overprice much! The rest of the food is ok especially the western stall.
author: Eylaa Chyntaa

review_text:
After renovating, I felt very disappointed and most of their rental foods store are closed. Not much choices of food avail.
The atmosphere and their lightings are soo glaring feeling uncomfortable for customers to seat-in.
author: Munir Khan

review_text: Ordered chicken fried rice but the chicken tasted stale and rice was tasteless. Ordered gong gong for $21 but received very little amount. We made a complain, they added empty shells to make it look more. The chilli was not given with the noodles we ordered, instead we had to request for it. The beef hor fun and beef kway teow was ok.
author: Aurelia Elira

review_text: Ordered sambal beef fried rice, but some of the beef was tough. The paprik sliced fish was even worse, with only 10% fish and the rest being thick fried flour. Be cautious when ordering this dish.
author: H Y

restaurant_name: AC Braised Duck and Kway Chap Food Enterprise
review_text:
From the first time I tried their food at 605 Yishun several years ago, I was immediately impressed. I initially fell in love with their kway chap, and later developed a strong appreciation for their yam rice as well.

Today, I visited their new stall at 414 Yishun and ordered my usual dishes. The lady boss, as always, served me warmly with her sweet smile, greeting me like an old friend. The portions remain generous, and the soup retains its rich, herbal flavor.

At $20 for everything I ordered, the meal was certainly worth the price. I would highly recommend AC Kway Chap to anyone who has yet to try it. It is an experience you will not regret.
author: Aaa

restaurant_name: AC Braised Duck and Kway Chap Food Enterprise
review_text:
I tried once few years back when they doing at Yishun 605. Not suit my taste.

Now moved to 414 and everything is also same taste like before. I really dont like it haha.. It also means they maintained the consistency. Good for those who appreciate their food.

Lor chap and kway chap and chilli were AliExpress standard. I struggled to give 3 stars I'm sorry.

Anyway I'm happy that they already moved out of that small kopishop. They're very friendly hawkers.
author: Lim Ray

restaurant_name: AC Braised Duck and Kway Chap Food Enterprise
review_text:
Highly recommended kway chap up in the north. Good move in relocating your store to 414 Yishun Ring Road as there are more seating available.

The food was outstanding-rich, well balanced, and incredibly addictive. Food was cooked to perfection,with flavours that linger and make you want more. Its the kind of meal that stays on your mind long after you've finished. A must try for food lovers.
author: Cai Shengda

restaurant_name: AC Braised Duck and Kway Chap Food Enterprise
review_text:
$12.60 for 2 pax, decently priced.

Kway chap soup is way too salty, tastes like simply salt rather than flavourful. Chili is average and pork skin has hair on them.

However, their intestines are very well done. Give it a try if you love intestines, otherwise you can pass.
author: Kosong Belly

restaurant_name: AC Braised Duck and Kway Chap Food Enterprise
review_text: The braised duck was rich in flavor and beautifully marinated, while the pork was melt-in-the-mouth tender with no hint of porkiness. Every bite was soft, savory, and deeply satisfying. The sides—tau pok, silky bean curd, flavorful braised eggs, and well-prepared intestines—added even more depth to the meal. Pair it all with a bowl of rice or silky kway chup, and you’ve got a feast that truly makes the day feel complete.
author: KC Wong

review_text:
Review for Huat Huat Steamed Fish! First time trying.

Portions are bigger than what I usually had at this price. $7 HK Seabass. Comes with a side dish (Kai Lan, Bean Sprouts or Okra). My favourite kind of sauce. Good taste, clean fish no funny smell. Fast and polite service. Check it out dude
author: H S.

review_text: Newly renovated coffeeshop. Used to be quite stuffy and hot inside the coffeeshop. Now is so spacious, clean and well ventilated. Had tried the cai peng, not bad. The prawn mee stall is still there. Worth trying out!
author: Aron Loh

review_text:
Reopened after renovation on 8 Dec with new stalls; braised duck (Kway Chap), roasted pork pepper siup (Bak Kut Teh) & Huat Huat steamed fish, but the latter is not open yet.

I tried the new Kway Chap. A fan of Yee Kee braised duck & kway chap, it would be unfair to benchmark its dark sauce, keay chap chilli sauce, and sambal chilli sauce. They have their own formulae. Most importantly, its duck meat tastes good, and unlike the popular prawn noodle that has 2 other competitors here, it is the one and only one Kway Chap in this vicinity.

Take note: slight change in menu of Wen Chang Kee roasted pork and chicken rice.
author: Annie Chow

review_text: Local neighborhood kopitiam. Do try the newly opened prata shop. The prata is dam crispy. Shop is always packed. Not comfortable dining inside cos the ventilation is dam lousy. Milo has no condensed milk or fresh milk in it at all. Told the auntie and still she wants to argue when I saw with my own eyes how the uncle made it. Unreasonable. Food getting more expensive here. Get the food but not the drinks. Drink stall uncle don't know how to use CDC. Force you to use cash or paynow.
author: P Y (Ahbobo)

review_text: The pancake is way better than the famous  multi chain store which originate in Yishun. Not sure why owner did not list in google map. Nice crispy , fair size and affordable.
author: Julian Ng

review_text: Although ordered fresh, both the thosai and onion Prata came soggy.. barely any oil used here. Thosai was exceptional tangy but the viscosity of the dhal just ruined the experience. PS, egg Prata is $2, onion Prata also $2.
author: Park Groove

review_text:
You will find Putu Mayam, one of my favourite breakfast varieties of my childhood days. You either eat it with fresh crushed coconut or orange sugar, or both. You vary the coconut-sugar ratio according to your liking. The stall is housed in a coffeeshop named Y418 Coffee Station, near Blk 417 playground.

I have shelved my craving for it since Deepavali on which they were closed. Today, I was lucky; to find Putu Mayam in stock, and dined in.
author: Annie Chow

review_text:
Prata is not oily with nice fish curry. Beehoon soto is good. Tried the mee rebus, as they ran out of soto, taste is average but a bit salty. Wide selection of items though.
10Jul23 entry - the Ikan Bilis Nasi Goreng is really nice. Very flavourful. Give it a try..
author: Ed Seet

review_text: One of my go to places for briyani because they are generous with the rice and meat. Rice is not as fragrant as some other outlets but good enough.
author: FoodieDirectory

review_text: Super shiok supper food. Bee Hoon Goreng, not dry and not too wet, justtttt right. Huge portion too, can share for 2 pax.
author: MC SM

review_text: Food was delicious and service was prompt. Do not hesitate to go for this if you are rushing for time but craving for local hawker fare
author: David Tan

review_text: Always eat noodles at this place. Today ordered their minced pork w kwayteow soup.. Like that they have braised mushroom in the soup.. There is 1 fishball, some pork slices, minced pork and a fried fish dumpling .. Their prices are okok, about $4+/$5+ if u go without the drink.. Overall not too bad place to catch a quickie meal
author: R Tan

review_text: A frills free place to have your craving fulfilled if you are into fish ball noodle. The fish balls are pretty fluffy and bouncy and good size too. Opt for fish balls only or mix of fish balls and fish cakes. Have it soup or dry per your preference. Set meal comes with hot coffee or tea. I usually add a fried round fish ball as side ☺️.
author: Delicious Myojo

review_text:
After order,payment was made with beep sound. Staff from Hell : eh no have hor
Wow I'm failed to con the 26 bucks meal.
Order dried kway teow,came soup kway teow instead.
Lan lan they changed.
My kopi o kosong came with sugar.
Mind drifting off lalaland.
If only no star can be used for ratings.
$$ spent elsewhere saves you from agony.
author: Tommy Lim

review_text: Very average. Sauce sweetish. I particularly dislike that the trays are dripping wet. I am afraid to say I won’t go back after my first visit there.
author: Keith Tan

review_text:
I celebrated my birthday dinner at COLLIN’S Northpoint, and it turned out to be a wonderful experience. The food was really good — well-prepared, flavourful, and served in generous portions. Every dish we ordered was satisfying, and you could tell that attention was given to both taste and presentation.

The atmosphere was cosy and comfortable, making it a great place to enjoy a meal with friends. The service team was friendly and accommodating, ensuring we had everything we needed throughout the evening.

Overall, it was a pleasant and memorable birthday dinner. I truly enjoyed the food and the warm dining experience. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a great meal at Northpoint!
author: Jameszedrick Bautista

review_text: Ordered the mixed grill set (chicken chop, pork chop and pork sausage) which comes with 2 sides of your choice. Chose the minestrone and grilled chicken salad both of which were good. The chicken chop was well seasoned and juicy. However I did find that the pork chop was a little tough. The roasted potatoes that came with the meat was really good with a very crispy extrior and fluffy inside.
author: Wei Jie

review_text:
We visited during lunchtime and were shocked by the lack of basic service. There was no one at the service counter, and after being seated, a menu was simply placed on the table with no explanation on how to order.

While we were still having our soup and starter, a staff member abruptly brought the main dish and demanded that we move our dishes to make space, despite carrying only one plate. His attitude was rude and completely unprofessional.

Despite this extremely poor level of service, a service charge was still imposed — which is frankly unacceptable.

When we were settling the bill, an elderly couple at the counter also raised complaints about the waiters’ bad attitude, confirming that this was not an isolated experience.

This was one of the worst dining experiences we have had. The service was careless, disrespectful, and far below acceptable standards. We will not be returning and would not recommend this place to others.
author: THET AUNG

review_text: It's always a pleasure to return. I love the wagyu snack which gave me foodgasm. My medium rare was so juicy and tender. To me, the chicken cutlets were too salty for me. Everything else is fine. Service was very fast. I didn't have to wait long for my food to arrive even at such peak hour. The staffs very attentive and focused. Very friendly too. Would come again.
author: Faith Lim

review_text: Northpoint Collin’s. Me & my friend arrived at slightly after 1.30pm & the place is not crowded as it’s a weekday. While looking through the menu, a very friendly staff by the name of Jenny came over to ask us about our food preferences. She’s good at recommending us the Beef steak with prawn & very thoughtful of her to help us decide what to top to share. She brought us 2 bowls knowing we are sharing the soup.The beef steak is juicy & the roast potatoes cubes are very delicious! Jenny’s excellent service attitude left us with a great impression. I hereby wish to compliment her & we will definitely come back again.
author: LM Kong

restaurant_name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh (Northpoint City)
review_text:
The Bak Kut Teh here is peppery, savory, and comforting—perfect if you’re craving a hearty, home-cooked style meal. Beyond BKT, the menu also features a range of equally delicious braised dishes, such as pig liver soup, braised intestines, claypot pork, and more.

What truly stands out is the service. The staff are consistently warm, friendly, and full of energy, creating a welcoming atmosphere from the moment you step in. They are attentive and quick to top up your soup without needing to be asked. A place that delivers both flavor and hospitality—highly recommended.
author: KC Wong

restaurant_name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh (Northpoint City)
review_text:
Went to many Song Fa outlets n even in Thailand...Taste is always the same...
Just luv the pepper soup compared to the herbal soup...maybe because I like spicy...

This outlet staffs service is very good ..even when the restaurant is crowded..👍 👍
Price is reasonable and affordable...

Will definitely be back again
author: Ricky Hwan

restaurant_name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh (Northpoint City)
review_text: The food was delicious and served quickly, and the service made it even better. Special thanks to waitress Deanna Ling, who was attentive, friendly, and made sure everything was perfect throughout our meal. Her warm attitude really stood out and made our visit enjoyable.
author: Lauren

restaurant_name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh (Northpoint City)
review_text: Reached the place around 6pm for dinner and no waiting time for a table. Ordered 1 braised pork belly with large intestines,  2 pork rib soup, 1 braised chicken feet and rice. Service is good as the staff are friendly and take the initiative to refill the pork rib soup for us. The plus point is the free flow of pork rib soup! However, I personally find the place quite hot though it is air conditioned.
author: GC Khor

restaurant_name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh (Northpoint City)
review_text: I had a wonderful breakfast today with my spouse at northpoint outlet. Food is top quality. Each of the waitress is experienced, polite and top notch in servicing customer.
author: Donald Chan

review_text:
The fried chicken is alright, quite moist and tasty.

Now for the bad, the rice has smell and below normal quality in my opinion.
And don't order the grill chicken. It's choke full of sweet dark sauce and the meat is dehydrated until there is no taste left. It like eating a week old cooked chicken.

Everything else feels like eating tasteless cake or overcooked food. Not worth the price.
author: Retroville Q

review_text:
Date of visit: 14/11 (3 pax)
Got the smashed fried chicken
Girlled boneless Milkfish
Pomfret with special sambal
And onion crackers
And soursop juice.

Free Matarbak given for every $50 purchase (we chose the peanut chocolate flavour which is too sweet for us)

The smashed fried chicken and pomfret is so crispy! The boneless milkfish is great too. Love the chili for the boneless milkfish and the smashed fried chicken as they really add a kick to the dish! Could do with more salt for all the dishes though. The onion crackers are so addictive!

Service of the staffs are top notch, makes it a pleasant visit!
author: Ong Hui Li

review_text:
Extremely disappointed with this order.
I ordered two boxes of Ayam Bakar via Foodpanda and both were unacceptable. In one box, there was an actual piece of charcoal inside the container. It was crushed and turned into black powder, which was mixed throughout the rice. This is a serious hygiene and food safety issue. Food should never contain charcoal fragments. I had no choice but to throw the entire box away.
The second box was just as bad. The chicken was completely burnt, overly charred to the point of being inedible, and mostly bone with barely any meat. The portion size was inconsistent and unacceptable compared to the other box.
Although Foodpanda refunded one box, this does not change the fact that both meals had to be discarded. This reflects very poor quality control and lack of proper kitchen standards. I hope the management takes this matter seriously and improves their food preparation process.
author: Rachel

review_text:
Thanks Nice foods..Alhamdulillah.
Was very very nice.. Especially the Ayam Bakar Penyet.. So tender and tasty. 5 Stars.
Recommend all here! (North Point - Yishun B1-54 - North Wing)
author: Mohamad Hisham Bin Mohd Idris

review_text:
Should have read review before ordering.
The supposed"tender beef" feels like I'm chewing on tree bark. The sauce is great, their chilli good but their meats are all terribly overcooked. Grilled chicken is very dry chicken breast. Smashed chicken is over fried as well. All the meats are very dry, although the flavours are excellent
author: Jun Yi Tay

review_text:
There is only one self-order machine, and it’s located right at the staff entrance, which feels like an odd place for customers to order. While I was ordering, the staff member was standing there watching and looked like she wanted to clock off as soon as possible 😑 It made the experience quite uncomfortable.

It would be much better if they also offered QR code ordering to make things smoother for customers.
author: Nao C

review_text:
Located in the heart of Northpoint City, Shihlin Taiwan Street Snacks remains a reliable go-to for anyone craving a quick and crunchy bite. The outlet maintains a high standard of cleanliness and efficiency, making it easy to grab your favorite snacks even during the busy dinner rush. The staff is generally quick on their feet, ensuring that your order is served piping hot and fresh from the fryer.

The food quality here is consistently good, with the signature XXL Crispy Chicken delivering that satisfying crunch and tender meat that fans have come to love. The seasoning is well-balanced, and the Handmade Oyster Mee Sua offers a comforting, savory depth that hits the spot every time. It’s a great representation of Taiwanese street food culture, providing a dependable taste that rarely disappoints those looking for a familiar snack.

However, as much as I enjoy the current menu, I can't help but feel it would be even better if they served the BBQ flavor similar to what is available in Jakarta. That specific smoky and sweet glaze found in the Indonesian outlets adds an extra layer of indulgence that would surely be a hit here. If the Northpoint branch ever decides to introduce that variety, it would definitely elevate the experience from a great snack to an absolute must-have.
author: Fernando Karnagi

review_text: The sambal chilli provided is far too little for the amount of rice — it’s not even half a portion, and there’s no way to request an extra tub. Please be more generous with the chilli next time.
author: SERENE LOW

review_text: There was no one in Q since i was there at 2+pm. The tuna crepe i ordered seems to be cooked anyhow. It was so watery & definitely doesn't look appetizing to eat. Definitely not returning anymore.
author: Shilah Shelly

review_text: I have been eating this NP store every weekend for 2 years. Their food is good and most importantly friendly and polite. Their service also fast and sweet:). Keep it up your hard work. Thanks for good service
author: Chuah Chong Yan

review_text:
The older man cashier was very friendly and patient when my mum was ordering. He also didn't mind clarifying the order again without getting angry. Even though the payment had a bit of issue, it was resolved quickly.

The drinks and toast are always very good no matter if take away or drinking there. The quality of food is awesome everytime. Good job, I really like to get my coffee from this branch. 🧡
author: Isabella mallare

review_text: Sometimes you lucky you get seats, sometimes you don’t but if you order takeaway they work pretty fast so overall is still okay! Love to have some Kaya toast and good coffee.
author: Gary Ng

review_text: Ordered the ice kopi here on a hot day. Then I realized the bottom of the drink is still warm when I received it. Shortly after all the ice melted. The standard is lower in this branch. I don't have this issue at other stores at they will ensure the temperature of the drink it mixed properly before serving it to the guests
author: EQ Xavier

review_text: Very small outlet for a good coffee and soft boiled eggs. The standard of the food maintained but the environment also remained the same for years. Time for a good renovation and design for more  seating space.
author: Happitel Apartment

review_text:
Terrible customer experience. I went to Ya Kun Kaya Toast hoping for a quick bite, but was told by the cashier—quite rudely—that they wouldn’t take my order until I found a table. It wasn’t just what she said, but how she said it—dismissive and unhelpful, as if I was a nuisance for even trying to order.

To make things worse, the place was packed and there was no proper system in place. You’re expected to fight for tables by standing around awkwardly, hovering over people who are still eating, and rushing to grab any seat the moment someone leaves. It was stressful and chaotic, with no effort from the staff to manage the situation.
author: Sandiv Athwal

review_text: I was greeted warmthly by Uncle Larry . His friendliness and professionalism make me want to return again . Attentive to my needs when I requested things . Thank you for your excellent service Uncle Larry ! Thumbs up !! Food was delicious too !
author: Rosniyati Sahad

review_text: The pasta here is really good and packed with a lot of flavour. I ordered meatball pasta and their tomato sauce was the main star. Larry was really kind and helpful, giving us all an even better experience. I recommend this place to anyone who wants to taste 9.5/10 food and experience splendid customer service
author: FerozWinz

review_text: Had a great experience here because of the staff here named Larry, who provided excellent service. He was friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect throughout the meal. His positive attitude really made our dining experience enjoyable. Will definitely be back again!
author: frena lim

review_text: Staff were efficient. Baked rice normal. Nice and clean but not a quiet environment for eating during peak period as the chattering sound bounces everywhere. Overall, still a decent choice for lunch.
author: Jasmine Wang

review_text: pretty decent food portion! 6 prawns in the pasta is really great to have! this is the only pasta restaurant i see with such many number of prawns in its pasta! love it! the waiting time is around 22 min for this… believe that they had to cook it freshly so not really a big issue
author: Evelyn Eng

review_text:
Tried the Mala Xiang Guo stall at Kopitiam today and honestly… I’m still a bit stunned. 🤯 I’ve eaten MLXG at soooo many places and this is the first time I asked for extra peanuts and got told, “加花生是要錢的.”

The tone was basically: “Bro, extra peanut need to top up.” I even thought she was already scooping it for me! In the end I just said “it’s okay, never mind” and walked away in shock. I’ve never seen “extra peanut = extra money,” not even at other Kopitiam outlets.

Taste-wise, not bad, but the 小辣 was… not辣 at all. 🌶️😅 And it was pretty pricey for Kopitiam — around $13++ for just 400g++. I only saw a sign saying extra coriander is $2, so the peanut situation really caught me off guard.

First time almost paying premium price… for peanuts. 🥲
author: Serena Siak

review_text: I tried to order the indian food as i want to eat them but they were so busy many customers were also complaining about their order missing i just stand there for a long time but no one even took my order so i just left. I ordered the taiwanese food but the person there was so rude and i told her i want pork noodles but she kept asking me things in chinese i told her i don’t understand but she showed me the board written in chinese with annoyed manner luckily the women next to me was nice she translate for me. The food was super horrible i forced myself to eat but really cannot finish it. Worst way to waste my money
author: Melody Sailo

review_text: This was the worst Taiwanese braised pork rice I've ever had. I didn't expect it was pre-prepared! It was awful and disgusting. Furthermore, the counter attendant was rude and impatient. Even in a noisy environment, she stood in the kitchen and told me my food would have to wait. And when I couldn't hear her and asked twice, her response was an increasingly impatient expression and uncomfortable attitude, rather than coming out to explain things clearly at the counter.
author: Jiaxian Kang

review_text: Put one cheater Machine that to deceive people to play but no tickets can be won ! Always show maintenance again and again. Played but no prize can be won ! Deceiving people to come here to eat and dine ! Sacked ! All prizes are just for show !Always display either "Please Come back Tomorrow" or "Under Maintenance" ! To attract people comes here to eat by using this machine ! Bad ! 👎
author: Elaine Li

review_text:
Blk 925 coffees next northpoint mall ,
There are only fish ball noodles and roast pork and roast duck rice here. These two are my favorites.
The dim sum sold here is inedible and unpalatable. Damn, this business has been able to last this long. 🥱🥱🥱
author: SOON ANN LIM (Steven Lim)

review_text: Delicious vegetarian croquet burger, with teriyaki fries and matcha latte. Was a smooth ordering experience.
author: Jordan Tan

review_text:
The Fish Burger here is always spot-on: Crispy with that satisfying crunch every bite. Fries come in good portions too, but what really keeps me coming back are the staff.

The aunty with glasses is always moving around making sure everything runs smoothly, and the younger lady in the kitchen always remembers my usual order.

Genuine service like this is rare. Sadly, I’ve seen customers and delivery riders lose their temper over small delays, but really, F&B staff like them already deal more than enough every day. A little patience goes a long way, and being decent is the least we can do.
author: Ren

review_text:
Wanted to get more chilli sauce and tissue paper, they like unhappy with me. Pointed already given.

Oh by the way, the new fish with cheese burger FAIL! Do not ever try. Expensive and not nice.
author: Jason Deng

review_text:
This outlet is located at the old wing of Northpoint city and has been around for a long time.

We are here for lunch and happen to see a promo new item in the menu. We then proceed to use the self ordering kiosk to place order and payment.

Once our ordered is called, we collect our food. Food taste good as usual.
author: Johnny Johnny

review_text: I ordered the fish burger through a food delivery service and was quite disappointed. The fish burger contained almost no onions, the fish patty was burnt, and its thickness was comparable to a slice of cheese.
author: Nictoh

review_text: This has been around for quite a while along McDonalds next door. The fengshui apparently better than the opposite that has always been changing. Anyway I have been eating Long John Silvers for the longest time, from overweight to obese, yet the staff for the rarest time, would hesitate when I requested for extra crumbs. Not being entitled but if this request cannot be fulfilled, I am glad to be informed of the rejection instead of facing the hesitation analysis and obvious judgement. If HPB secretly informed fast food chain to reduce calories to obese looking customers, it should be reflected with transparency.
author: Kong Wen Sheng

review_text: Genuine review as a person that dines here 4 times a week ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ I've switched allegiances - Long John Silver's has stolen my heart (and stomach!) from Popeyes (Which is just opposite) ! 🤯 The quality of the food is a GAME CHANGER. But it's not just the quality that's on point, it's the service. Chen, the superstar staff, served me with a SMILE (I could tell behind the mask!) 5 TIMES now at least. Her enthusiasm was infectious! 👏🏽 If you're on the fence, don't be - LJS is where it's at! 👌🏽
author: Narresh Dnuttzo

review_text: Honestly, one of the worst experiences I had in my life. The fish was raw, super oily and u can taste the fish was frozen and was left out for quite some time. The batter they used didn’t change cause my fish is super oily and it has a brown coating of oil. The fish taste super spoiled and the staff was just singing and not focused
author: Nelson Chan

review_text:
Alaskan Pollock fish's batter not fully cooked, liquidy inside when peeled open. Chicken, shrimp and fries tasted good in general. Cafe Au Lait did not came with stirrer and sugar, and had to be requested. Female staff was kind enough to give me more crumbs when requested, which I appreciated.
Table/Floor was dirty and did not looked to be wiped, seems to be understaffed because I saw staffs going into the kitchen, and out to the front counter, which could post hygiene issues.
Seeing the recent outlet closures, I hope Long John Silver's in NorthPoint can improve its overall standard for the longevity of it.
author: Xango

review_text:
I am a customer from your grab platform.
GF -546. I just ordered a 2 set meal. I would like a respond from you as to what is the standard amount of condiments(chilli sauce) that I should receive for my order? Getting just a packet of chilli sauce is pathetic. Are you in shortage of the supply or the packer is just unbothered? In the app I did attempt to request for extra but there was no option, thus i entrusted on the standards from LJS. But this is just nonsense and ruined the appetite. Not the 1st time experiencing a disappointing order from this outlet.
author: Dhiyyah Yasin

review_text: Still one of my fav sushi chain. We ordered the sashimi and Yakiniku don. The silver trevelli was tasty and fresh. The fried butterfly prawns were crispy and when dipped with the salad cream, they were even more tasty.
author: J Acksee

review_text:
In comparison with Ichiban, the prices are on the higher side for sushi, handrolls, and set. Taste wise is fine. Normally crowded during peak hours, so it is better to come earlier.

There are vegetarian options
author: Ling Sg

review_text:
After some errands, I decided to have an early dinner in NorthPoint City, Sushi Tei. I remembered I have to renew my membership and I have double points on my birthday month in April 🤗. I was amazed at the remarkable and friendly service of their staff Chen Jing and Wendy Kuan.

I was surprised that Chen Jing gave me a complimentary dessert as it was my birthday. First time ever to receive such warm gesture from Sushi Tei. I must compliment them for their service and hospitality. Normally, I patronise Raffles City outlet.
