author: Ericka Wong

review_text: Ordered online. Few six inch and footlong but the portion was so less including the salad
author: Indhira Subbiah

review_text: This restaurant in this area is totally providing bad service. I ordered a food at 13:55pm and it’s been 1 hour 15 mins, still they are preparing the food??? I mean a normal restaurant cooks and prepares quickly than expected but here? I just ordered one food without drinks and it’s taking them more than an hour to deliver! It’s 15:20pm and they’re still preparing the food. WOW! Totally bad service. People order food due to their hunger and it shows how careless you are towards it.
author: Yuvashree Pathmanathan

restaurant_name: Amaya Food Gallery at Amari Johor Bahru
review_text:
First time here.

A good spread of food and was spaciously displayed around the restaurant.

We like the huge oysters, satays, steam fish, laksa and prawn soup.

The desserts were extremely sweet.

The ambience was nice for dinner, there was live singing and they sang very well.

The staff were friendly and gave good service.

The downside was both of us had severe food poisoning.  Likely from eating the oysters.

First time and last time here.
author: Teck Chong Law

restaurant_name: Amaya Food Gallery at Amari Johor Bahru
review_text: Cosy and spacious seating. Service staff are polite. Buffet promotion for Ramadan. Value for money with variety
author: Jon Wan

restaurant_name: Amaya Food Gallery at Amari Johor Bahru
review_text: Pretty cool ambiance and a great place to spend time with family and friends. It was our first time at Amaya and we went with the à la carte menu, food was good, leaning more toward Thai flavors, with decent portions. The whole experience from start to finish was satisfying. Special shoutout to Theresa and Zawanah (hope I spelled it right!) for the great service. Will definitely be back to try their buffet spread. Cheers!
author: Kishore Singaraveloo

restaurant_name: Amaya Food Gallery at Amari Johor Bahru
review_text:
My family and I were at Amaya last Saturday 11/1/2025 for their buffet dinner. As usual the dinner was absolutely fantastic. The service from the Chefs and wait staff were just amazing. Everyone there was focus on keeping the food stocked and the guests comfortable. The food was fresh and inviting.
The musical entertainment was out of this world. The 2 gentlemen providing the entertainment were singing songs in English, Chinese, Hindi, Korean and others. Amazing!!!
It's no wonder why this has become one of our favorite places to eat.
author: R R

restaurant_name: Amaya Food Gallery at Amari Johor Bahru
review_text:
Visited the restaurant on Wed 7 Jan to make a reservation for their Extravaganza Crustaceans Seafood Buffet on Fri 9 Jan, 7pm. The staff in-charge took down my details and was helpful enough to send me the buffet menu in advance through Whatsapp right after I made the reservation.

Reached Amaya Food Gallery punctually on 9 Jan, and was told that the buffet was cancelled by a different member of the staff. When I showed her my reservation confirmation on Whatsapp, she told us that only ala carte dining was available. There was no notification that the buffet was cancelled beforehand. What made it worse was that there was even a standee beside the lifts advertising the Extravaganza Crustaceans Seafood Buffet being available every Friday and Saturday.

If you were to cancel an advertised buffet at the last minute, the least you can do is to inform the diners who have made a reservation and remove all advertising as not to mislead anyone.

A frustrating incident, which ended up being a waste of our time. We were not hotel guests, and we specifically made our way to Amari twice just to make and fulfill our reservation. We could have just chosen a simple meal at any of the nearby eateries and be 10x happier for it. Extremely disappointed at the restaurant's poor communications.
author: Weikun Huang

review_text:
Kimdo BBQ is one of the famous local BBQ spots in Johor Bahru. Now that they’ve opened at Johor Bahru City Square, it’s even more convenient to grab and go.
The food quality is always good and consistent. The BBQ is tasty and well-prepared every time. Definitely a nice and reliable place for BBQ in JB.
author: Dido Angel

review_text:
KIMDO BBQ in City Square is a great spot, though the place is small and you might wish for more seats. The design is clever, as you can hang your bag below the table for convenience. The skewers were delicious, and the one-bone chicken wings are a must-try! The staff was very helpful, which made for a smooth and enjoyable meal. It's a fantastic spot for a satisfying and fun meal.

Price and Cleaniness can be better
author: The Genesis Family

review_text: I really love their chili – it's incredibly tangy! They do a great job of fitting the ingredients onto the skewers. However, the broccoli could use a bit more cooking time, as it was a little too burnt and still a bit hard. Their location is very convenient but the shop is very squeeze for dine in.
author: Hiang Ar

review_text: This was our 5th time dining at KIMDO BBQ, and it’s still as good as ever! The meat is always fresh and well-marinated, and grilling it at the table makes the experience even more enjoyable. The side dishes are tasty and refill quickly, and the staff are friendly and attentive every time we visit.
author: Htet Arkar

review_text:
first time i tried the kimdo bbq and i’m addicted alrdy. everytime i enter JB, its a must for me to buy.

my favorites are oyster mushroom, chicken ham with enoki mushroom, smoky octopus, cheesy tofu and fishball.

the 2 chili is super tasty and spicy, thai sweet chili and good combination with the seafood.
best recommend to eat hot hot!!

SUPER TASTY AHHH HIGHLY RECOMMENDED. it is near to Old chang Kee, just walk straight. the drinks so far i havent try but the lemonade or lime looks good tho!!
author: ri fieschi

review_text: Cake is tasteless and dry. Even the cream is hard enough to hold my fork well upright. Cashier is kind enough to tell me there's a teatime set. But c'mon! Can you teach your staff not to put the cake on the thermal receipt like that? The ink is toxic.
author: Christine Lee

review_text:
We were starving and decided to have a late lunch at this restaurant, expecting decent food from a well-known chain. Unfortunately, it was a huge disappointment.

First, the Tom Yum Hor Fun came out, but the noodles were undercooked and super chewy, almost like gum. They took it back to reheat, which helped a bit, but when we peeled the prawns, the meat was soft and clearly not fresh.

Next was the grilled chicken chop rice. The chicken was so tough it felt like it had been sitting out overnight. The sauce was nice, but it couldn’t save the dry, hard meat.

Lastly, we had the chicken meatball spaghetti. It tasted okay, but the meatballs weren’t as fresh as what we’ve had at their Mid Valley branch.

Honestly, I wouldn’t bother coming back.
author: Cay Lim

review_text: Just buy the cake today ..but i got i don’t now ..the condition cake was not good mean was a several day agow not new one ..i think around 4-5 days cause the cake chocllate not melt it sticky like peeling skin 😕😕😕..
author: faris heartfilia

review_text: My visit to Secret Recipe at City Square was delightful! 🤩 The dishes were flavorful, and the staff provided good service. The atmosphere was pleasant, adding to a great overall experience. I enjoyed my meal there. 😋🍽️✨
author: Drolkaikypgen

review_text: I love the cakes here. I take away two fried rice with satay. The staff are friendly and helpful. Recommended!
author: Din Neo

review_text:
Bad service and very poor overall experience.

I went to the counter to enquire about an item and was ready to order, but the staff member assisting me kept looking at the self-service kiosk and clearly implied I should order there instead. When I asked if I could order at the counter, I was told to go to the kiosk.

At around 9:13 pm, most of the staff were chatting among themselves. I ordered a Signature Box with Zinger. The bun was clearly over-toasted to the point it was hard and crispy, which makes no sense for a Zinger burger. The chicken also did not taste like a Zinger at all.

Before 9:20 pm, staff were already telling customers that they only had chicken left, meaning no burgers or wraps, yet they were still taking orders earlier without informing customers properly. The restaurant was warm with no air conditioning, and drinks were served without ice and were warm. No one informed customers about this and they continued selling the drinks anyway.

This is not my first bad experience at this outlet. The service and quality have been consistently poor. Today’s visit was at around 9:15 pm, order number 634, check number 330136.

This will be my last visit. A complete waste of money.
author: Keith L

review_text:
🥣 Food & Taste: This KFC in the shopping mall is really no good. The fries are served COLD. The fried chicken super small piece, the size of 2-3 nuggets?! The tenders, one of the worst tasting ones. Even though it was hot, I have no idea how it is not crispy at all. The batter and the chicken also tasted very off, has a smell to it. Did not finish the meal.

📍 Place: The whole area is spacious.

🤵🏻 Service: Not bad. The staff are quite helpful and accommodating.

💰 Price: 24 MYR

🐣Waiting Time: Service is quite fast.
author: Wanga

review_text: Large Kfc, with lots of seating, Kiosk to order, stale/ dry burger buns with no flavor sadly, good deals on the Rm box though.
author: Bex Frew

review_text:
Kfc city square jb
Not bad zinger cheese buger ok the vegetable looks like not nice pls improve food quality
Popcorn chicken
And cheese wedges good
author: Abshar Ali

review_text: I  understand many customers waiting time abit longer.  But my waiting time about 30mins also not done yet.  I ordered chicken floss mantou waiting time super long.  About 20mins i ask the lady staff she only told me need to wait,  when 30mins ask the other male staff he told me need to wait cos man tou need to cook. ( I don't think cooking man tou need 30mins and above ) Then i ask need to wait how long more he didn't answer me i told him if take too long i need refund,  he show me bad attitude 😒  then said bagi dia refund. I was unhappy told the other staff  who refund to me if waiting time too long have to inform customer.  The important thing is i didn't hear any sorry about this? After i turn around walk out i heard they said  30mins  bla bla bla.  what kind of service is this? I was very hungry and after that i go to McDonald's they only take less than 10mins to serve me although they also many customer.
author: ching Ooi

review_text:
I remember trying Old Town many years ago at an airport during a layover, mainly because I was drawn to their white coffee. I hadn’t paid much attention to this branch after passing through security before, but this time we gave it a try and really enjoyed it.

The Kopi C was rich and delicious—way better than the one from that super crowded place upstairs with the long queue. My friend ordered the chicken shreds hor fun, which was very light and sweet. The rice noodles weren’t super chewy, but the texture was still really good. Highly recommended if you prefer lighter flavors.

I had the Asam Laksa, the kind from Penang—sour, spicy, sweet, and fragrant, with a fish-based broth. The only downside was that it wasn’t sour enough; it would have been perfect with a bit more tang.

The Nasi Lemak with rendang beef was also tasty. Overall, their flavors and portion sizes are great—highly recommended!
author: Tracy Zhang

review_text:
January 2026 - Was here around noon time to have coffee and a light snack before boarding our KTM train at JB Sentral. We just walked in and selected a table and subsequently facilitated our orders via their on-line menu by scanning the QR code displayed on the plastic placard on the dining table. Once our orders were completed, an Order ID and total payment notification was sent to our mobile device to be subsequently presented to the cashier's counter for payment to be completed and for our orders to be sent to our table. Less tech savvy  or elderly patrons can call upon any serving staff for a physical menu and facilitate a manual order process.
We ordered a Hot as well as an Iced White Coffee and an order of Kaya & Butter Toast. Both the Hot and Iced White Coffees were adequately good, the Kaya and Butter toasts were a disappointment as the bread was toasted completely on both sides in an oven to a crisp, instead of the traditional method of being slightly toasted on  the exterior with a soft interior. Curiously the total calorie count is indicated for each and every menu item. Cannot attest to it's accuracy though. LOL.
author: Rajen Arasu

review_text: Old Town is 1 of our favourite cafes in JB, staff is friendly, greeted customers coming in / going out. Their ice blended drinks is 1 of our favourite in Old Town, it is a good environment for a peaceful good meal given alone or with companions. Fried chicken tight is good, however dried mee siam is abit on the oily side, which I did not finished. Overall, environment, price and food is worth going back soon.
author: Sharon How

review_text:
Old Town needs to improve its ordering system and this branch especially needs staff to shape up.

We waited for 5 minutes at the entrance before being served, while there were a few tables visibly available. When a staff finally attended to us, he just pointed us to a direction without even leading us to the exact table, and looking annoyed when we sat at the table that he wasn’t referring to. When we eventually settled, we saw the inefficient distribution of tables, such as 1 man taking up 3 tables, resulting in the shortage of tables, and not because the store is at capacity.

We soon used the QR code to place our order, but was met with much difficulty as the link kept hanging and refreshing itself despite us having full connectivity. There was also inconsistent performance in the ordering, where some items prompted add-ons while others did not. When using the add-on prompt, the items were not registered in the final check-out page. After the arduous process of ordering, we realised that we had to walk over to make payment at the counter. Wouldn’t it be more sensible to build in one last page to collect payment details after the check-out?

Anyway, the food items were served inconsistently. The drink and chee cheong fun came within 5minutes, the toast came within 10minutes, and the wanton noodles never arrived. We had to remind the waiter at the kitchen area before the noodles were served after another 15minutes.

The store manager, who was seated there the whole time, was busy on the phone. We didn’t know that she was the manager initially, until we saw her Old Town checkered shirt with the logo and the tag that says “Manager”.

Simply atrocious. Please work on the overall service of this branch.
author: MH Tham

review_text: It's very popular coffee shop in Malaysia. I had a noodle. It was not bad, but I'm not sure if it's worth for the price. It cost me about 15RM. It's located in the shopping mall and clean environment, so I accept the price. It depends on what you pay for.
author: The MY World

review_text: The food was flavourful and staff were friendly. Love what we ordered - clear tom yam (spicy, tangy, great), seafood vermicelli salad (the best!, kway teow seafood (flavourful with wok hei taste!), drinks when asked for less sweet, it was really less sweet, love it! However, the only issue is quantity.. i don’t mind the price but the quantity was just small..
author: Serynna Ramly

review_text: The mango salad and glass noodles with seafood are super fresh, spicy, sour, and full of flavour — definitely a must-try! I also love their clear tom yum soup; it may look light, but the sourness and spiciness really pack a punch. Their Tom yum fried rice with seafood tastes average and Thai  milk tea is too sweet for me. There is no crowd and the food is served fast and there ample space. We order so many dishes at a reasonable price. Definitely will return again.
author: Jacelyn

review_text: The food came on time, not making a hungry customer waiting. The tom yum soup is must have! The waiters were very welcoming and friendly. It is a soothing and calm atmosphere to have your food. Overall, its a must visit for everyone! Bon appetit guys
author: Jaireen Jemitta Edward

review_text:
Are this many times it was fantastic. Today was crowded but sadly the food is sub par. Waited 20mins not served till I bring the menu myself .food came no cutlery. Please hire more quality waitor and waitress !!!!
Came  the food , presentation was different .no Thai taste, curry tastes bland . Sadly I've lost my favorite place. Lousy lousy service puts me off +lousy food no thanks.... No reason to go back
author: Puki Master

review_text:
The food were great and the service was amazing! Price is affordable. Quite spacious. Wheelchair & kids friendly.
I'd like to point out a thing here.
The front store looks crowded . The name Thai Express is too big + too many banners covering the interior. Also consider changing the lighting/wallpaper. Aside from that, everything is WELL DONE! ❤
author: Estel I

review_text:
This is the worst KFC i have ever dined at!! Ordered the original fried chicken because the hot and crispy ones had a waiting time of 20 minutes. The chicken served was COLD! Like it had been in the warmer that wasn't really warm for the longest time.
Observed all the other diners and looked like nobody really finished their chicken that day.
There was soda spill on the floor which was completely ignored by the staff! Horrible!
Try to get your KFC fix at a different branch. Not here!
author: I D T

review_text: This kfc not many crowded as city square. But the food is still very hot and fresh when serving. But maybe need to improve the kitchen ventilation due to the whole shop smelly.
author: Li Ying

review_text: A better KFC than Singapore one. Fried chicken was fried good and the mashed potato and coleslaw was good I shall say...
author: Keegan

review_text: The cashier lady attitude is very bad.
author: Han Hong Tan (Hanhong)

review_text: Shift manager not friendly, inpatient to serve customer, burger all run out, coleslaw run out, but the malay lady serve very fast
author: Kelvin Lee

review_text: We ordered the salmon belly miso nabe, spicy ebi roe sushi and a soft shell crab roll. Both sushi were good but not the miso nabe. The miso broth tasted weird. Food took a long time to arrive too. The good thing was the free flow hot green tea which we sipped while waiting the long wait....
author: Emily Ho

review_text:
I think this restaurant should get at least 4 star overall. Less than that does not do its justice.
Went there on a busy Saturday lunch time. Despite amount of people, service is good. Waiters respond to our request with patient.

We had some problem with our order and was responded well by the team. Overall experience was a pleasant one.
Keep up with good work
author: ahmingmh H

review_text:
Don’t order the toro salmon sashimi and chicken katsudon. For latter, you can smell the used oil in the chicken.

If really hungry, get the Gyuniku Nabe instead. At least this taste fresh.
author: S L

review_text: I have been here with my family and loved ones many times mainly for the food and despite repeatedly feeling that the service crew attitude needed improvement, I still decided to visit again. Unfortunately, this visit was the last straw. The service was extremely disappointing. I noticed a new staff member (the new in-charge wearing yellow) who was outright rude. When he wanted me to pass him the table slip that was placed at the corner of my table, he didn’t speak but merely pointed at it and expected me to understand his gesture. It felt rude and very uncomfortable. This kind of interaction was unexpected and unacceptable in any F&B establishment. Overall, the service crew consistently comes across as unfriendly and unwilling to be there like they are forced to work. As paying customers, it feels like we are inconveniencing them by dining in. Sadly, no matter how many times I have visited, the attitude has almost always been the same. As for the food, quality has clearly deteriorated. The salmon sashimi yesterday was especially bad. There was visible blood in almost every piece and I even noticed a black vein-like strand that looked completely out of place on the salmon. It was very off-putting. The udon was bland and tasteless. The beef was overly cooked and extremely tough. The teriyaki chicken was the same too, dry to the point that a family member even commented on how tough it was. We used to come back for the food despite the poor service but now that both the service and food quality have declined we won’t be returning as there are also other Japanese restaurants around in Komtar JBCC.
author: Michelle Michell

review_text: We came at about 12:30pm. Ordered at 12:40 & reached at 1:03pm. There wasn’t a lot of people but they couldn’t deliver my food on time. The head manager was silently rude to not respond to my really late order. He just kept quiet and walked away. It is best to not dine in here when you are in a hurry. The sense of urgency the staff has is not to a certain standard. If you have great patience then this place is for you. As i am typing this, i am at the restaurant and there’s food that have yet to arrive. For me to experience & for you to judge :)
author: Herudin Daint

review_text:
Very disappointing service experience.

On this visit, we ordered a 5-piece chicken combo and 12 egg tarts. Our queue number was 935. After standing for about 12 minutes, we noticed that customers with later numbers such as 937 and above had already received their food.

When we checked with the counter, we were told to wait another 20 minutes for the egg tarts. After waiting, no update was given. We tried approaching the staff multiple times, but were ignored. The two staff members circled in the photo repeatedly looked at us and then looked away instead of assisting us.

We attempted to get help three times at the food collection area, but again received no response. At that point, I requested a refund and went to the cashier, but was told to wait “5 more minutes.” During this time, we heard queue numbers such as 962 already being served.

The wait ended up being more than 11 minutes, and what was most upsetting was that other customers were served egg tarts before us, including orders around 968. We could clearly see the egg tarts available, yet no one packed our order until we raised our voice after being ignored repeatedly. Only then did the staff slowly go to the kitchen and finally prepare our order. Also no vouchers were given to us that was listed in the receipt since we spent more.

This entire experience took place from 8:10pm to 8:57pm, which is unacceptable. Being ignored by staff, poor communication, and unfair order handling made this a very frustrating visit. I hope management will seriously investigate this incident, especially the behaviour of the staff involved, and provide proper training to ensure customers are treated with basic respect.
author: Mr Tan

You all better just shut down this branch , pengalaman paling terokkkk , buat malu je KFC mcm ni buka dekat tourist attraction 🤦🏻‍♀️🤦🏻‍♀️🤦🏻‍♀️🤦🏻‍♀️

review_text: Buns for burger were hard and stale and the zinger burger itself didnt have much flavor, potato and gravy was a tiny serving, the complimentary tomato sauce was starting to go off and was fermenting
author: Kody S

review_text: I was a customer, I asked for chicken thighs and wings, but an Indian woman told me that if they had them, they would give them to me, but I clearly saw them on the shelf. They didn't ask what I wanted to drink, just gave me whatever I wanted, as if I was eating for free! The staff's attitude was casual, you can even see some staff sitting on the floor chatting casually, and then discussing in front of the guests why the guests were so troublesome. He directly said that if he was the waiter taking the order, he would directly ignore the customer's request for what kind of meat. I really feel sorry for this store with such employees!
author: yun wei Choo

review_text: I bought cheeky wrap in morning for. Breakfast.  No cheese sauce twice. The tomato is spoilt today. Idk why Malaysia kfc so problematic.  Can you check your staff if they don't wish to work in kfc. Change them hired someone very struggle. Very tired
author: Arree Venee

review_text:
Walkable via the R&F bridge. Soup has a mild herbal taste. You are able to mix and match ingredients to form your soup.

I order additional pig skins, beancurd, salted vegetables and chicken feets. All has the base.

Overall the bill came up to around 43RM. Pretty decent in my opinion.

Good to try if u like milder flavours.
author: Zi Liang Ng (Zi Liang)

review_text: Nice food and very good service. The price is also reasonable in an expensive city like JB. We spent less than RM60 for 2 person.  Was here 10+years ago and the food quality maintains the same. Thank you!
author: Michelle Tan

review_text: Very nice Bak Kut Teh soup, very different from pepper soup in Sg, has a taste of herbs and spices; Goes well with rice and you tiao. Nostalgic environment with very friendly staff. The pork kidney and liver were cooked just nice and tender.
author: Kay Shin Tan

review_text:
Ok, let's talk about the parking first - it is challenging. Not just in finding lots, but in navigating with other cars doing the same due to narrow lanes/ space.

The restaurant was nearly full house at 1pm on a Tuesday, but all diners were eating, and there wasn't a queue.

I got a table immediately, it required a clean up, the lady who did that was friendly, she also took my orders after I had a few questions.

I read a common complaint about this place, it's the price. And it was obvious to me that the lady did not stop me from over ordering.

Nevertheless, it surprised me that it took them 20 minutes to serve the food (which is basically a scoop/ assembly job, especially without any use of claypots).

The bak ku teh was maybe a tad about average, not massive on herbal flavors, but pretty tasty.

The "salted vege" was a lot more sour than salty, I didn't like it one bit.

The pig trotter, which the lady claimed is a 招牌, was way below average - it was chewy, under flavored. Also, they said it was their 'last bowl' and turned out it contained parts that were 90% skin, fats and bones. Also noticed that the flavoring is the same as the bak ku teh soup, only much thicker.

But there's a highlight, the chicken feet. Good flavor with a hint of chili 🌶️, nice texture too (deep fried before braising).

Ok, the lunch came out to be RM46. I commented to the lady at the cashier, that the pork trotter was all bones, fats and skin, and she acknowledged me, and asked if there was any meat at all, I said 1 small piece. But yes, lunch was still RM46 ;)
author: Leon Kwang

review_text:
One of the better ones I had eaten so far in JB! The ingredients are fresh and the chicken feet very soft!
Never a fan for salted vegetables but this one approve!!
author: Amy Song

review_text:
Kerala used to be sited in town centre, in its heydays, crowds gathered and queue for a table during lunch time.
It was sad to note that rents went skyhigh when property prices speculated and greedy landlords raised rents to the tune of 500% from the original prices. So kerala pulled itself OUT and moved here.
The place is much smaller, lesser tables arranged but the service and quality of the food remains consistent.
I always liked my banana leaf basic set while my brother liked his with mutton curry. The rice, gravy, papadoms and rasam were all very delicious and pleasantly light on the stomach. Staff were prompt and attentive!
Thank you for your service & good food. We shall be back again!
author: Jackie

review_text: BLR made a good lunch stop. The fish curry was the highlight, especially with the inji puli truly top-notch. The vegetables, however, were quite dry and just average. The mutton biryani turned out good, and the staff were attentive. The Bru coffee was okay, nothing exceptional.
author: Siva Mala Supramaniam

review_text: Pleasant experience here. Food was super tasty especially the fish. The fish skin was super crispy, size was big, and ideally the white rice is a better option if you are like me who can easily go into food coma if i eat that big size fish curry and all the veges with briyani haha. We came in a big group of 8 people and we enjoyed everything. Rassam was also nice. We dined in on the 2nd floor and it was pleasant place with a well air conditioned environment.
author: Farah Hana

review_text:
Spectacular south Indian banana leaf fare - fish was so fresh! Do yourself a favour and just go already.

Ps: Bear in mind lunch hour crowds on weekdays (worth the wait which isn't too long at any rate).
author: Anne

review_text:
One of the more loved Indian restaurants in Johor Bahru.

Food is superb. Drinks are also very, very good. The bread (usually in the morning) and the banana leaf rice (afternoon) are something I look forward to when my family decides to drop by. Portions are above-average. Just to inform you, it is on the pricier side of the spectrum - but you'll still walk away happy. Their bergedil is a special blend and their fried fish is excellent if you come for lunch.

Service is lovely. You always feel welcomed at the restaurant. Place is clean, restroom is clean too. The only downside I'd say is there's not enough tables for ground floor. So if it's a full house, you'll have to hike up to the 1st floor.

The ambience is good. Spacing is good enough not to feel cramped and you still don't feel weird if there's a huge crowd. Kids might not have space to run about though.

Overall, a solid ⭐⭐⭐⭐.
author: Nicholas (Nick)

restaurant_name: BAAN &Co. (Formerly known as Carabao Thai Restaurant - Stulang)
review_text:
Variety of thai combined with western dishes

Very nice and cozy restaurant

Let’s give a try and definitely will return !
author: Black Pearl

restaurant_name: BAAN &Co. (Formerly known as Carabao Thai Restaurant - Stulang)
review_text: The food is really good — you can actually taste Thai dishes you don’t usually see on chain Thai restaurant menus.
author: David Lee

restaurant_name: BAAN &Co. (Formerly known as Carabao Thai Restaurant - Stulang)
review_text:
Atmosphere is really nice, the decoration great and it’s spacious inside.

The service is just suck, the waitress is very rude and like from the forest without education, this is what I can say. Never trying to help out even you ask them to, especially when you need to pay, they are just like ‘pay if you want but you need to call them and wait, you can also leave without paying if you want’ kinda stuff

The food is really good to be honest. The squid is fresh, the way it cooked just right in time, not overcooked. Well done!
Stir fried chicken is amazing, flavorful and well prepared.
The vegetable in the balachan sauce is not really up to my expectation, I think Chinese restaurant did better

**My opinion for this restaurant is hiring better waitress or waiter in good working attitude, they don’t have to be exciting high quality service, but basic responsive will do. Not mad at every customers in that kinda way.
author: Audrey L

restaurant_name: BAAN &Co. (Formerly known as Carabao Thai Restaurant - Stulang)
review_text:
Walk-in for lunch . The environment was good , chill not to crowd. The staff also friendly . The food is good . All good . Keep it up 🤝🎊🙌🏻🎉

The price RM 170 . Refer attached picture

( 7 April 2025 : Monday )
author: Dianamohdnor 95

restaurant_name: BAAN &Co. (Formerly known as Carabao Thai Restaurant - Stulang)
review_text: Even though the restaurant looks more like a steakhouse, they serve authentic Thai flavors, and I was really satisfied with their food. My personal favorite was the lime juice steamed squid and lala, which had a strong lime flavor and spiciness. The seafood was fresh and delicious. The claypot glass noodle was pretty good too, cooked until sticky and flavorful. They also have a big parking space for customers.
author: Kee Kelven

review_text: I've visited this restaurant several times and have never had a disappointing meal. The food is prepared fresh and is seasoned just right! The staff is always cordial and at your service. Strongly recommended if you want a different experience in a Indian restaurant.
author: Eira Hamzah

review_text:
Re-opened in Jan 2024 . Less crowd. The village briyani taste still remain the same. However the prawn briyani not really nice.

Note to the owner. “Noted that you have increased the price. RM 41.00 ++ is quite expensive for signature briyani village briyani. Please consider local people cause for us , this is beyond our affordable price.. I used to be your fan and now we will give a miss until we see some improvement in term of pricing and food quality. I’m still giving 5 starts. Haha.”  thank you..
author: Palani Thangaveloo

review_text: I am glad Village Briyani re-opened for business. The northern indian food was good. We had the fried capsicum, chicken 65, butter chicken, some mutton and fish dish, plain briyani rice and mango lassi for dinner last night. We love coming here despite it being in Wadi Hana.
author: Adrian Tan

review_text:
I love the briyani here. To me it is one of best. Today we tried 3 different type of briyani which is mutton briyani, chicken briyani and another was dhilkush briyani (smoked chicken).
Their taste remains before and after MCO. The taste was superb.
author: Shanti Devi

review_text: Friendly staff. Food is good but on the expensive side (25RM++ per meal on average). Quite a big portion so I guess it is justified? The village naan is pretty good too. Village tea - not a favorite.
author: Chantal T

review_text:
I went here on 21 January 2026 (Wednesday) at 2PM. There’s not much people that day so there’s no wait time.

I ordered:
1. Fish and Chips (RM19.50): The fish is chunky & it doesn’t tastes or smell like frozen food. Kinda wish they give more tartar sauce tho. The potato has their unique flavour in it & the salad is nice too.

2. Grilled Chicken Chop Mushroom (RM19.50): Chicken is a little hard but it tastes nice. They covered the grilled chicken with mushroom sauce & I love it! The potato has their unique flavour in it & the salad is nice too.

The portion of the foods are good and price is reasonable. I’m not sure how packed it is on other days but you can call and reserve a spot before coming.

Oh, and if you ate the peanut when they you the menu, you need to pay for it. You can pay with cash, card and QR here!
author: Sammi

review_text: Best Chicken Chop in town referring to the fried chicken chop(cutlet). Okay, to be fair, we didn’t order the best combination. Fried Chicken Chop goes well with mushroom sauce and the Grilled Chicken Chop matches the black pepper sauce. We had a bowl of noodles and tried out their Sweet and Sour fish too, which were surprisingly decent! Anyway we ordered Root Beer Float but it came as Root Beer Flood 🤓
author: Kong Wen Sheng

review_text:
Indeed it's pretty good.
Taste wise overall was 👍

Kopi could be better but glad to come n try

Plenty of parking in the huge carpark ahead so no worries.
Very old school concept and overall it's a great meal.
author: Ars 3276

review_text: Was walking in the old street saw this cafe who said they have the best chicken chop in town. I walk in and give a try. Order their signature chicken chop with an ice tea. The portion is big you will feel super full. The fired chicken chop the flour is too thick and leck of flavor. This is disappointing, please check on the quality of the food. Price still ok.
author: Adrian

review_text:
The hailam mee is superb. Chicken chop is nice, must order with egg. The creamy egg yolk with the fried chicken chop is superb.

But the kopi is so bad, like 3 in one, way below average.

ps: son said mother and son eat together 🤪
author: Julian Song

review_text:
Ice kacang comes with chocolate sauce is nice. Ayam penyet & the chilli sauce also delicious.

Shop owner is friendly. Recommended to try.
author: salted fish

review_text: Tauhu Bakar with charcoal has an authentic taste of burn and is very delicious with kacang and sauce. Ice kacang and rojak are delicious too, a must-order list!
author: shawn Tai

review_text: We ordered fried rice, tauhu bakar, ice coklat and ice jelly. The food was very good. But the kedai itself not so comfy. When we visit, not so many people there. They have indoor and outdoor seating but the seat were limited.
author: ani mahadi

review_text:
Coming on a Friday at 12.30pm.
Same cosy place with busy friendly boss.
Less crowded cos nearby government offices are closed hence can easily get a seats, but it gets more ppl coming in later.
Order the usual delicious rojak with full of peanuts topping, the chocolaty ice kacang and the jelly ice with lots of jelly underneath the sweet and sour fruity top (my boy's favorite) and a special treat of very comforting pumpkin sago (item not in photo) from the boss which has become my must have list 😀
Enjoy it as always.
author: Agnes S

review_text: Wow. Best tauhu bakar I've ever tasted! Their ABC coklat was interesting and their ice jelly very refreshing. Not too sweet. Very balanced. ✌️💯
author: Azim Hulaimi

review_text: everything is good and the price is affordable ✨️ also the sizzling yee mee is recommended it have thick sauce 👍 (not in the picture)
author: nr adibah

review_text: A hidden gem in JB downtown. Affordable meals yet spacious dining area are good enough reasons to get your lunch fix here!
author: Sky Pang Shaofeng

review_text: Nice place for chill,and eat...bfast and lunch have so many option of masakkan kampung..
author: Amirul

review_text: Went to JCS Bistro after seeing great reviews on Google Maps, but what a waste of time. They haven’t listed their opening hours, and when we arrived, it was closed. It’s located in an office building with nothing else around, so we had to book another taxi to go elsewhere. Really disappointed — please update your info!
author: Butterfly with Purpose

review_text:
The food purrrrfectttttt!
Western food 😋

Kueyteow kungfu sedap 💯
author: Aizuddin Asmadi

review_text:
This place is usually quite crowded, especially during lunch hours. I visited around 2PM and was lucky to get a seat without having to queue. I decided to try it because of the many positive reviews.

Taste-wise, it is similar to regular chicken rice, with the highlight being the black soybean sauce chicken. The flavor is nice, though personally I feel the chili could be spicier to better complement the dish. They offer free refills of soup, chili, and sweet soybean sauce, which is a nice added touch.

The food is served quickly, and the staff are friendly and helpful. Prices are reasonable and standard for this area in JB.

The ambience is one of the highlights for me. The place has an old-house feel that gives a very authentic and cozy vibe. Parking can be a bit challenging during peak hours, but there is a small parking area nearby, and roadside parking is also an option.
author: Selvinia Nofy

review_text:
After saving this place for a while and not getting a chance to go (since it's in Johor and I'm in KL), I guess it was fate, I finally got to grab some of this famous Kee Chup Nasi Ayam!

The service was excellent. Even though the place was packed with people, the service was fast and the staff were very welcoming with a smile.

The Nasi Ayam itself tasted fantastic. The chicken was not dry and you could still see the appetizing kicap glaze coating the meat, and the smell was great! Taste-wise, the chicken and rice were perfectly complemented by the soup.

I'm so glad I finally got to try it!
author: Afina Hashim

review_text:
This place is a crowd favourite ~

Interesting chicken rice marinated w kicap sauce,
The chicken is fried tender and not overly power by the kicap flavour.
Rice was fragrant and chilli is not the very spicy kind. No wonder the locals love it !

Chicken rice plus a drink at just rm15 !
author: Wee Guan Kho

review_text:
The nasi ayam & drinks was delicious, with fragrant rice and juicy chicken, definitely the highlight for me.

We will also need to help ourself to take the soup, chili, and kee-chup sauce at the main counter, so do take note. Service can be a bit stretched when it’s busy, but overall the team was accommodating. Definitely a place I would come back to whenever I’m in JB.
author: A M Y R A

review_text:
Very good chicken rice. The chicken was tender and very tasty; well grilled. The rice was fragrant.
Service was pretty fast. Good meal!
Will certainly go back when in JB.
author: M Lau

review_text:
Near my working place. Heard some good/bad review about the place. I think its a cozy little village warung in the middle of town.
Most kelatanese food available here. Kuih muih and kelatanese traditional food are much sought after.

For Kelantanese and whoever like traditional dish & kuih muih, i recommend the warung. Try their nasi kerabu, laksam etc.
Thats my thought, go & try this estabishment. 😁
author: Hamam Hasan

review_text: Good food. Variety of choices. More toward east coast dishes. Lots of kuih for desserts.
author: syahrizan winardy

review_text: Great Kelantanese food, something I miss very much living in Singapore. Great selection of kuih muih as well. Only complaint is no ikan tongkol, daging salai..the selection here is more budget conscious, I.e. egg, smaller pieces of chicken, lots of types of vegetables.  Still all delicious.
author: christopher neoh

review_text: Come during late breakfast. The parking is quite limited. For cars. But the restaurant is huge and there is a lot of seating available. The choice of foods is also various. From lontong, nasi dagang, nasi kerabu, laksam, nasi berlauk to kuih kuih (mostly Kelantan cuisine). The food is just okay and the price is fair. The portion is also just nice and the service is good. Waiting did not take long. The environment is great like we have 2 different vibes in one place. A village vibes according to the restaurant condition and the city vibes due to its location in the middle of the town. Good hangout to bring family and friends for a breakfast and lunch spot.
author: Hafizun Mushtafa

review_text:
Very local spot, not the most hygienic place but don’t expect it to be hygienic. Local flavors, wide variety, affordable price.

Tips:
To eat here, find a table and grab yourself a plate and grab whatever you want. Go back to your table and a kind staff will calculate the total and you pay after you are done with your meal
author: Deon Jong

review_text: Awesome local pantai timur food with varieties of choices and very reasonable price
author: Khairul Ghani

review_text: Yesterday I ate at this shop 4/9/2022. The shop name is Umi Tomyam. Seriously, they have really hot dishes. The tomyam is like Thailand's. Highly recommended
author: Amar

review_text: Not tasty
author: Lee

review_text: Number 1
author: shafee shafee

review_text: Highly rated dinner option on GrabFood. Decided to try their salted egg fried rice and Tom Yam. The Tom Yam had good taste but somehow only chicken option was available, the rice was ok too but needs a bit more flavour. Maybe more salted fish in it. Good meal nonetheless, worth trying.
author: Ariff Suffian

review_text: Humble food with authentic taste. I like to come over here whenever I can come, however, this warung only open 5pm onwards. This is a family runs business, the staff there are nice and polite. For those who want to try out nice hot dishes, you can order the hot fried beef, soup tulang, soup ekor and seafood tomyum. Remember to request for their delicious chilly sauce.
author: Zhi Tsung Pang

review_text:
I went to Johari TomYam for the seafood Tomyam and with a side of steamed rice and was very happy with the meal. It was authentic and delicious. As it was early evening so there were plenty of tables available but the kitchen was busy preparing "grab" take aways
My iced coffee and meal was prepared quickly, no waiting for a long time.
If you are staying in JB and want great food, for a reasonable price give this resto a visit.
author: Dave Hughes

review_text:
Brother/sister, the food is delicious. Normally, I order from GrabFood... everything is good... but I have one request... please share a spoon every time... 😅😅😅
This is my 3rd time - it hurts every time.
Otherwise 🌹
Thanks...
author: ragu kalai

review_text: Every day the table is full, nothing is empty, the cook is still hungry
author: Mohd Fareez

review_text: Incredible food, freshly hand made. Nepolitana Pizza was baked in a wood / gas fired oven, and was served very quickly as the oven was red hot. Crispy and yet soft on the inside with a great gluten bounce to it. lamb skewer was bbq on the spot, and served with an off the menu bread which the pizza chef specially made. The lamb plate was beautifully decorated and it made the experience all the more enjoyable. Caesar salad was excellent as well. Price is reasonable, service was superb and this is beyond a 5 stars experience exceeding all expectations.
author: Jamie T

review_text: Everything is the best here... it's perfect for a special day meal. The price of the food is worth the size of the food and the taste is really Mexican... will definitely come again later.After eating, there are costumes provided and you can take pictures like Mexicans.
author: Syameerah Hisyam

review_text: It was an absolute pleasure dining at La Familia Restaurant. From the moment we walked in, the warm and genuine welcome from the staff made us feel right at home. Every dish we tried was bursting with flavour truly mouthwatering. Their pizza, in particular, was exceptional and easily one of the best we’ve ever had. My family and I enjoyed every bite and every moment spent here. We will certainly be returning again and again. Highly recommended!
author: Mohamed Lamchichi

review_text:
My family and I love the food and we will always want to return again to enjoy the scrumptious food.
Tacos, quesadillas, pizzas, creamy carbonara are our favourite. Don’t forget to add the mint tea in the pot.
author: Kai Ni

review_text:
The Most Delicious Italian Restaurant in Johor Bahru. Featuring a luxurious mix of Italian and Middle Eastern food. This restaurant used to be open in Taman Tasek but now moved to Persada Johor,. The location is very strategic and the place is very spacious and even though it is in the middle of the city, but the atmosphere is very quiet. The neat, decorated table setting and very cheerful colors made everyone amazed.

Most importantly is the food served was delicious. All food served is Hot and freshly cooked. As in the picture, I have tried several types of pizza. Wallahi, I like the Spinaci Pizza the most...🥰❤️ All of these pizzas are cooked in front of the customers by a handsome and very great Chef World class and very humble person.. I had a chance to chat with him and look at his Instagram..,🤣🤗🥰👍🏻 hehe..And a stern warning to all women, in Malaysia call  "don't itchy2" with him because his married. Ehehhe🤣🤣.. (Only this chef performs outside, the other chefs are in the closed kitchen)

The second choice of food is tacos ... The chef who cooked tacos for me was really great because he knew my tastes. The taste of spices and sauces that are combined are not found anywhere else, only here.  Third is Tagliatelle Alfredo and Lasagna, The deliciousness is indescribable. in fact once it enters your mouth you will definitely want more.

For drinks.., of course.... I truly love fruit mujito, blue lagoon and also شاي بالنعناع.. very delicious.!!

The food prices here are also very reasonable with large portions.

Anyway... FYI... I really LOVE eating here too because All the employees are very nice, very friendly and treat guests like family. Most importantly, they are handsome. 🤣🥰🤗❤️.. so we can "WASH EYE".. 🤣🤗🥰 The owner and manager are also very humble, not arrogant. They always keep in touch with customers and always want the best for customer...

overall, I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a memorable dining experience..
author: ELIANI ELIAS

review_text: It’s my 3rd time dining here but this time I brought my parents along. All of my family member enjoyed the food here and the customer service is really top notch. Also, they have other cuisines too like Mexican, Italian but their Arabic cuisine still remain present. Thank you Mr Mahmmud and team for the exceptionally good service . The food is really good and will be my go-to Arabic .
author: Amanda Lee

review_text: Very disappointed with the food. The shawarma was extremely bad — dry, tasteless, and nothing like what I expected. The place is expensive for nothing, and the overall experience was very poor. I don’t recommend it at all.
author: Akram Saad

review_text: The best food ever eaten literally felt like I was in Damascus! The food came quick and they had Arabic desserts and dates free flow for Iftar with iced water wow scrumptious homemade feeling. Masha Allah no wonder it was packed! Great work team.
author: K. F

review_text: food all good,location easy parking big spaces,inside very nice decor,good vibes n staff all very polite n accomodate,fully recommended must try👍
author: omg.alesha

review_text: Portions are generous, the presentation is on point, and the atmosphere feels genuinely Middle Eastern — perfect for both family dinners and casual hangouts.
author: ezry aa

review_text:
This place is closed as of March 2024 - very sad . Hope all is good for the owner.
We have tried shawarma across many countries and honestly this is the best !! this new place is run by two Syrian / Turkish with such hospitality and passion on sharing great food . The wrap is freshly made on the spot by one of the chefs. The chicken is grilled with such charred perfection , balanced with the salad and lemon-y garlic sauce . We went back twice in 2 days during our trip . This is how GREAT the food is. They cook from their soul !!! I feel it is like eating food from a mother’s kitchen - full of love and packed with yum. Please go and try for yourself, you won’t regret it ! They open daily except Monday . From 12 noon to 1 midnight .
author: Francesca Tang

review_text: One of the best Middle East restaurants with great authentic food! The rice dishes are all very very good. Highly recommend their lamb and rice Mandi.
author: Alan Lok

review_text: Stumble on this new restaurant and tried its shawarma, a Middle East dish with thin slices of chicken meat in a wrap with veggies and yogurt sauce. It is great-tasting and pretty filling. Hope they can serve lamb or beef meat cuts in future.
author: Rick Ng

review_text:
My 2nd visit to this place.. still maintain the quality of the food and i would show you all aftermath and damage done .. as most people would post before the meal i would love to show you all my after meal and you rate yo
urself how good the food was..
author: Zaq Zamri

review_text: Great food and atmosphere. Always here to eat lamb mandi.
author: Akhil

review_text:
Was here on a Friday night with my husband, the place is quite secluded & quiet. Im surprised its not even full. There were only a few tables occupied. The menu is quite extensive, they have middle eastern, italian & mexican.

I had the Chicken Shish Tawook, it was tender, flavourful, little bit spice, sour & char. My husband has the Lamb Mandi Rice, the portion was huge, juice & tender meat. The hummus, creamy texture, subtle tahini flavor, balanced acidity & no bitter after taste.

We also ordered Shawarmas to go, got portion of meat & size. I would come back again with my kids & explore more of the Mexican & Italian menu.
author: Azza Juliany

review_text: The service is very good. The atmosphere is very good. I had a really nice experience at this restaurant! The staff were all kind and friendly. The food was good, and I especially loved the apple juice—it was so tasty and refreshing! I would definitely come back.
author: Mellet Hannah

review_text: Nice , neat, clean and well decorated restaurant with both indoor AC and outdoor alfresco seats. Price is reasonable and food were good. Ordered the Aqda and an extra chicken and have enjoyed it. Would have been 5 stars should the lamb were served in the hot pot/plate as described in the menu.
author: Eng Siong Lee

review_text: Last night, my friend and I visited this restaurant. The place was spacious, and the staff were very friendly. We ordered kunefe, which was really good, and also enjoyed some Arabian tea—it tasted great as well. I took chicken mandi as takeaway for the next day’s lunch, and Alhamdulillah, it was also very good. Overall, it was a nice experience.
author: Ijaz Fazil Syed Ahmed Kabir

review_text: I had the lamb tacos and garlic prawns. The tacos were packed with flavor, especially with the garlic sauce, and I’d recommend pairing them with the fresh salad that comes with the mandy chicken. It adds just the right tang and freshness for balance. The prawns were fresh, served in a generous portion, and delivered exactly the taste you’d hope for. Great job to the chefs!
author: Sara May

review_text: Awesome. The best in JB. Congratulations!!!
author: Idaman Bujar

review_text: Good food. Nice service.
author: Adrian Akbar

review_text:
Variety of foods. All the food is delicious. Lala iced tea and kacang pol
👍👍👍👍 my fav restaurant in JB 😎
author: Mardhiah Hasan

review_text: Everything is delicious. The best is the Mee Rebus & Asam Pedas. Fuhh miss this cafe so much. Since my childhood 😘😘

review_text: Best
author: Roslina Bachok

review_text: Very cheap compare to others in this area for breakfast. Samosa really delicious. Got plenty of food such as nasi lemak, lontong, mee goreng etc. Roti canai also good. Recommended
author: Mohd Firas

review_text: Al Damascus? People say if you don't know, you don't love it. That's the right expression for anyone who wants something different to taste various arabian dishes menu. Everything is delicious. The location is the middle of the Johor Bahru city. Visit if you want to know what it tastes like
author: Abdul Hadi Che Lah

review_text: Here for our Farewell event. Come twice. So far so good. But only the Kerabu Seafood to little for a group of 60. Anyways thanks for the good service from Mr. Hakim
author: Nur Aishah Ramli

review_text:
My first visit with my family at this restaurant. We had lunch here.

The service crew were friendly and attentive. Escorted us to the seat and handed out the menu.

Buffett and Ala-carte menu is available here for dinners.

We didn't quite like the food as everything served was salty. Had high expectations for the food quality. There's a lot of improvement to be made.

Hope that the management looks into these areas to sustain their business
author: Vjay

review_text:
We ordered roti canai for three people, and had to wait almost an hour. If the place was packed, we’d understand but it wasn’t even busy.

Honestly, they really need to consider changing the person making the roti canai. You can clearly tell the person’s not skilled or trained properly.

If you’re planning to eat roti canai here, just skip it. Go for other food instead got many other options since it's a buffet style. Other dishes are okay, just… not the roti.
author: Iamneesa N5892

review_text:
What is decoupage craft?
Let's go to the HMA Niaga wakaf! 😊
author: jeea fazieha

review_text: 0 star if can, theres no even 1 customer in their restaurant. I made order online for self collection. I ordered pizza without pineapple as im pregnant. I got a pizza full or poineapple. Even when collection all the staff were in the kitchen and say ada customer but no one intend to serve. Worst customer sercive.  Even when making payment i confirmed with the staff if there's no pineapple and he said ye btl....  Careless humans
author: Shamita Paramananthan

review_text:
Ordered delivery, pizza is cold and not crispy. The sides are also cold, wedges not even slightly crispy. Garlic bread has very little taste, worse still we ordered 3 pizzas and a melts but not a single cheese or chilli flake sachets given!
You can even see from the box its moist and wet.
This shouldn't be the standard of pizza hut! Taste worse than frozen pizza. The chicken also soagy and in a lump 4 pieces all stick together.
Don't order from this outlet to avoid being disappointed.
author: jayden

review_text: Like to having lunch here. Food delicious 😋 but car parking fee a bit expensive. Parking car in outside pizza hut 1-2 hours around RM 10 parking fee
author: C4ndy 413-123

review_text: A small pizza hut outlet in UTC Johor, the table and floor is dirty and oily. Staff is not responsive, have to keep stand up and ask for attention. The food is order via QR code, limited menu here. Pizza taste like other outlet, not much different or delicious, it just so so only.
author: YW

review_text: City squre mall Pizza Hut restaurant lousy system for placing your order , their own Wi-Fi is not working . Overseas customers struggling to place their order while staff is not bothered or willing to provide any help .very callous attitude for the staff . Very poor service . Never recommended anybody to come here .
author: Himanshu Gupta

review_text:
Lepak Corner has truly set a high standard for local dining, and I cannot recommend it highly enough! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was welcoming, but what truly elevated the experience was the exceptional service.
The staff here are genuinely polite and pleasant. In particular, one of the servers was incredibly attentive throughout our meal. She noticed, even before I had to ask, that one of our dishes had been missed by the kitchen team. She immediately and discreetly reminded her colleagues, ensuring our food arrived promptly afterward. That level of proactive attention and care is rare and greatly appreciated.
Beyond the superb service, the food tasted great! The menu boasts lots of choices, catering to all tastes, but everything we ordered was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked.
If you are looking for delicious food paired with truly exceptional, caring service, Lepak Corner is the place to go. Highly recommended!
author: Lan Kovan

review_text: Had sahur at Lepak Corner this morning. The service was great and the staff were very welcoming. What spoiled the experience a little was that a couple of patrons were smoking nearby (vape and cigs). The shop also offers shisha so I’m not sure if that made some patrons assume they could smoke freely. Nevertheless, the food was great.
author: MAS

review_text:
The best eatery I came across downtown, open 24h and completely inexpensive. Great menu (incl. good Western options), quick friendly service and always lively—both day and night.

The iced coffee (kopi) is really good, and I ate (twice) their spicy chicken burger and fries (utterly delicious and contains a huge chunk of meat). Extremely good value. A large attractive outdoor terrace gives you many seating options—no matter how busy you should be able to find a seat. I also love the fab neon throughout.

Hugely recommended.
author: Chat Hall

review_text: The staff provide friendly and attentive service. The order preparation is efficient and of high quality. The food presentation is both visually appealing and appetizing. The outdoor dining area offers a casual atmosphere, with neatly arranged and clean tables. There is a small prayer room available for Muslim customers, and air-conditioned indoor seating is also provided. Overall, the experience offers good value for the price, complemented by excellent service.
author: 射线Mr R

review_text: 12 noon. Walked in. Asked the waitress do I sit and order from them? She said yes. Have a seat. I sat inside right in front of the cashier. Waited a good 10minutes and no one attended to me. Looked around, at least 12 staff were hanging around outside joking and fooling around near the drink stall. I’m hungry. I don’t care if your food is good or not, but if your service is such. No thank you. Learn from your mistakes first. So, blessing in disguise, walked a few minutes and found AMMA Restaurant. Air conditioned ‘Mamak’ greeted with smiles and spoken to with courtesy, Delicious food, clean space. Today’s blessing.
author: Paul Rizal Baird

review_text: Really authentic North Indian food! Delicious and suitable for Malaysia’s taste too. The owner here is friendly and welcoming. Will come again surely
author: Ks Kf

review_text:
Great Punjabi cuisine, some of the dishes resemble what I had in Jaipur, which was a great find in Malaysia. Value for money too. Naan and roti were all freshly baked in a tandoor oven, and mutton rara and paneer saffron tikka are highly recommended, alongside their authentic North Indian chaat such as Raj Kachori and samosa chaat which are hard to find in this region. They have a huge selection of sweets, and their Rasmalai is highly recommended.
However the gobi Manchurian is too salty (too much soy sauce), and the butter chicken we had was too sour.
author: Chua Mingxiu

review_text: food is here is authentic and tasty.. plenty of seating space.. must recommended punjabi food place to try while visiting JB
author: Ankit Gupta

review_text:
This was the best Indian food we have had in many years. The spice was just right and all the dishes were excellent. The chilli mushroom was amazing- not too hot at all. The samosa chat was also so tasty.
Would fully recommend.
author: Catriona Herbert

review_text:
I am still eating while writing reviews
I had an amazing experience at Golden Punjabi Restaurant in Malaysia. The food was absolutely delicious—I’m currently still eating while writing this review because I just had to share how good it is!

The vegetarian dishes are top-notch. I tried the Paneer Bhurji and Paneer Butter Masala, and they truly delivered that authentic Indian taste—flavorful

The music and overall vibes of the place added to the experience. It was little crowded but the service was consistently good throughout.

Also, it’s just a 5-minute walk from Amma Restaurant and about 20 minutes from RUD go kart place so easy to find if you’re nearby. Highly recommend for anyone craving real Indian flavors in a cozy, vibrant setting!
author: ankur sachan

review_text:
Food Review: Kafe Cendol dan Rojak (Galleria Kotaraya, UTC JB) – 19.8.2025

I had lunch at Kafe Cendol dan Rojak, located inside Galleria Kotaraya, UTC Johor Bahru. The environment was quite pleasant, with a glass door offering a nice view over Jalan Trus, giving the café a comfortable and open feel.

I ordered the Mee Goreng Mamak (RM10.00) and a Teh Tarik (RM2.80). The mee goreng mamak was served wet and well-cooked, but it carried an unusual rojak-like taste, which felt a bit off from the typical flavour profile I expected. The teh tarik, unfortunately, was below average and lacked the smooth balance of creaminess and tea strength that makes a good one stand out.

While the overall dining experience in terms of environment was decent, I experienced diarrhea about three hours after eating the mee goreng, which raised concerns about food hygiene.

Overall verdict: The place is just okay – nice setting but food taste and quality could be much better, especially considering the price.
author: vasu

review_text:
Nasi Lemak Ayam Goreng: 1/5. Teh O special: 5/5.
Sambal too salty and not spicy. Ayam too small. Telur was boiled not fried. Ikan bilis, missing. The only thing delicious was the keropok, which does not make sense considering it's supposed to be nasi lemak.

The only saving grace for this meal was the Teh O special.  Otherwise, I wouldn't have enjoyed the meal.

Server was kind.

For 18.50, this is abysmal.
author: Matin Kamal (Matin)

review_text: Dine here for breakfast meanwhile waiting for passport to be done. Their Nasi Lemak Telur Rebus soo delicious also the Nasi Goreng Ayam. Highly recommended if youre looking forward to explore local food. Will visit again. Thank you for the free teh-o 👍🏿❤
author: Sunshine

review_text:
Actual name: Kafe Cendol Pantai Lido

With unique mix of jelly and corns, cendol is still delicious!
author: HS Tan

review_text: It's Vegetarian restaurant. I visited here for breakfirst. I picked 3 kinds of vegetable on the rice, then it cost me 8RM. I'm not sure if it's cheap or not. If I compare to the one in Vietnam, probably it's double price, but here is the Malaysia, so I'm not sure. Anyway it's worth for the price, because it's vegetable!! It's difficult to have vegetable in JB, so it's worth. 8RM is cheap as the one meal in JB anyway.
author: The MY World

review_text:
Opposite the food court is the famous Johor Ancient Temple.

The vegetarian stall opens as early as 6 am, while the other stalls open at 7 am. I ordered Mee Hoon Kueh soup here.
author: J- Mei

review_text: This vege uncle is really kind-hearted 😭 He always helps anyone in need — even those who can’t afford it, he still packs food for them without hesitation. His food is tasty and affordable too! Such a humble and generous person. After this vege week, I’ll definitely go and support him again 🥹💚 Hope he stays healthy and happy always!
author: OOI

review_text:
Located near Galleria@Kotaraya , right opposite Johor Ancient Temple, this stall at [ T & L Sweet Coffee shop ] sells Chinese vegetarian food with vegan options, buffet style ( take as little/ much as you want).

My rice with generous portions, 2 veggies, 1 tofu, curry potatoes with mock meat & one piece of Tempeh cost only RM 12 ( ~ SGD 3.60 ) , a cheap and satisfying meal.
The coffee costs RM 3 ( ~ SGD 0.90 ), nice and not too sweet.
author: Yellow Bear

review_text: I came across this place in JB. Since then I keep going there to eat. The buffet of vegan and vegetarian food is amazing. So much selection. Mock meats, tofu and fresh veggies with rice. The malay curry is so good. And the price is so cheap. The owner Lim also feeds the homeless. The best place to eat in JB.
author: Jitatma Anand

review_text: Big portions for just RM 15 — got nasi goreng USA plus an iced Americano. The owner, a warm Indian Muslim, made the experience even better. Located right outside JB City Square mall. Plenty of food options here, and there’s even a convenience store nearby. Stays open till late at night.

review_text: Really delicious, excellent service.

The restaurant is v popular and have 5 stall fronts and lots of Malay customers when. I am there
author: Alfred Zhuo

I'm sorry to say the food here were not so good. I ordered the set for rm89 for 3 pax. The tom yam bowl was small, not enough for 2 even. The 3 rasa fish did not had the nice spicy, sour, sweet taste..the kangkung blacan was salty, the sotong goreng tepung was soggy. I ordered side dish of lala chili but was not spicy at all! Service : Staff very friendly

author: Lee Jia Fang

review_text:

The price is on the higher end but really food is good.
Oyster is plumpy.
Cuttlefish was savoury
Bee Hoon was tasty.

Chilli crab was alright.
Oil used to fried bun isn't fresh, has that over used oil taste.

Clams were OK.

Assam styled fish was not bad.

Fried chicken was good!  Tender!  The ginger was so thinly sliced and deep fried, seems more waffle like.

Can't recall the rest.

Not a glamour kinda place. Just a huge Chze Char or dinner place where you can order a variety of dishes.

The other dishes were yummy. The Fishhead curry is really good although the fish head could have been bigger with more gravy and vegetables.

restaurant_name: 老渔夫海鲜汤 Old Fisherman Restaurant - Stulang, Johor Bahru
review_text:
Feeling hungry after all that walking—time to cari makan! 🍽️
Tonight’s pick: 老魚夫海鮮湯 (Old Fisherman Seafood Soup).

Here’s what we feasted on:

🌶️ Dry Curry Fish Head – Rich, fragrant curry that soaked perfectly into the tender fish. Spicy, savory, and so satisfying we couldn’t stop even when sweating!
🥣 Shark Fin Lip White Soup – Milky, collagen-rich broth, naturally sweet and super comforting.
🐟 Famous Fish Cake + Meat Fish Cake – Springy, fresh, and packed with flavor, especially with their chili dip.
🍜 Handmade Noodles – Chewy, fresh, and the perfect carrier for all that delicious curry and soup!

This meal was literally “spicy till we sweat, fresh till we smile”—a true JB old-school gem.

If you love bold flavors and real-deal seafood, this place is a must-try! 🔥

📍 #OldFishermanSeafoodSoup #JBFood #CurryFishHead #HandmadeNoodles #SeafoodFeast #EatTillYouSweat #FoodieAdventure
author: Jodie Chai

restaurant_name: 老渔夫海鲜汤 Old Fisherman Restaurant - Stulang, Johor Bahru
review_text:
Nice eatery, recommended to me by a local PHV driver and while i was there, also saw a few locals coming in for lunch.

Ordered the seafood soup, chicken wings, seafood porridge, coffee and a free fish cake (given to us on the house).

The dishes were hits and misses. Of all these, seafood porridge is the one that i would recommend. Porridge taste fresh although some of the ingredients
can be better (e.g. the prawns were abit too mushy and the fishballs slightly fishy). However, the fresh fish slices in it more than make up for it.

Nonetheless, still an overall pleasant experience. And a place i might go back to if im in the area and want some comforting porridge.
author: Hong GZ

restaurant_name: 老渔夫海鲜汤 Old Fisherman Restaurant - Stulang, Johor Bahru
review_text: Their signature seafood soup is rich, fresh, and really comforting, packed with generous ingredients and natural sweetness from the seafood. The ambiance is very pleasant, clean and cozy, making it a nice spot for family meals or casual gatherings. There are plenty of paid parking spaces behind the restaurant which makes it convenient.
author: Winson Lee

restaurant_name: 老渔夫海鲜汤 Old Fisherman Restaurant - Stulang, Johor Bahru
review_text:
If you’re in JB and craving seafood, Old Fisherman 老渔夫 is a gem that has truly stood the test of time. We had a feast and amazed by both the quality and variety.

The highlight was definitely the Fish Head Pot the broth was rich, flavourful, and the fish so tender it melted in the mouth. The spread also included Tom Yum Seafood Soup, Signature Laksa, Fish Cakes, Prawn Rolls, Chicken Skewers, White Snapper Assam Steamed Fish, Handmade Fishball Soup, and even Shark Fin Soup. Every dish was cooked with care and tasted fresh.

To top it off, dessert was refreshing Longan Ai-Yu Jelly and Chendol, the perfect sweet ending.

Service was warm, portions were generous, and the price was incredibly wallet-friendly for the amount of food we got. Definitely worth the visit if you’re ever in Stulang, Johor Bahru. Highly recommend!
author: Woan Ying Ong

review_text:

Dry mee noodle also nice on its own. Also tried chendol, the gula melaka very nice with red bean and corn inside.

author: lean

review_text:
Ambience & Aesthetics: 10/10 ✨ Loved the vibe and the overall setup. Very Instagram-worthy! It felt like experiencing a Tamil movie scene.

Food: There were soooo many options in the Menu. I am definitely going back to try the other dishes. Ordered the 2-pax seafood sharing meal, which was more than enough for 3 people. They were very generous with the portions. The Crab Masala and Prawn 65 were cooked to perfection. The Egg Podimas was a bit too sweet due to the abundance of small onions. The Watermelon Juice was refreshing, but again on the sweeter side. Would recommend skipping added sugar or syrup to let the fruit shine.

Areas for Improvement: The Tawa Fish Fry was a disappointment. One piece was overfried, and both had a noticeable fishy taste and smell. It could benefit from better washing, marination with more lemon or spices and careful cooking on the Tawa to avoid overcooking.

Overall: A great spot for ambience and generous seafood portions, with a few dishes needing slight adjustments. Thank you for opening the shop near the causeway so that Singaporeans can try it too!

We shared the Tawa Fish Biryani and Lamb Biryani, both aromatic, flavourful, and not spicy. Served on banana leaves, the biryani was delicious and lingered on our taste buds. Tea in small glasses added the perfect Indian ambience.

The staff and setup are excellent, and the meals-for-two combo is a must-try. A delightful and memorable dining experience — highly recommend for everyone visiting JB!

review_text:
**Review for an Indian Muslim Restaurant**

I recently dined at MKR Bistro and it was an absolutely delightful experience. The rich, authentic flavors of Indian Muslim cuisine were perfectly captured in every dish. The menu offered a fantastic variety, from aromatic biryanis to Fajita (Must try), tender kebabs and hearty curries, all cooked to perfection with a balance of spices that was both bold and refined.

The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, with a sense of tradition in the decor that added to the charm. The staff were attentive, knowledgeable, and eager to ensure we had a great meal.

A standout dish for me was the mutton biryani—it was fragrant, flavorful, and the meat was incredibly tender. The naan and gravies paired wonderfully, and the desserts, especially the sheer khurma, provided a perfect sweet ending.

Whether you're looking for a casual family dinner or a special occasion, this restaurant is a gem. Highly recommended for anyone craving authentic and delicious Indian Muslim food!

restaurant_name: Lao Wang Northeast Iron Pot Stew
review_text:
The deliciousness of stewed meat in an iron pot lies in its rustic yet delicate flavor, its simple yet amazing quality, and the heartwarming satisfaction it brings.

1. The rising steam: "A thick, simmering broth fills the black iron pot, the ribs tremble and glisten with oil, the potatoes are stewed until they're almost mushy, and golden cornbreads cling to the pot's rim, half crispy and golden brown, the other half soaked in the broth, soft and chewy, coated with sauce."

2. The state of the ingredients: "With a gentle touch of chopsticks, the goose meat easily separates from the bone, revealing distinct fibers; the glass noodles are translucent, absorbing the savory aroma, glistening smoothly; the green beans are stewed until tender, yet still retain a touch of green."

3. The overall impression: "Served in a pot, steaming and fragrant, it's like a living oil painting—the savory sauce is the base, the meat is the main color, the green is the embellishment, and the golden brown is the border, vibrant and fragrant."

1. 1. **Aromatic Aroma:** "The moment the lid is lifted, a burst of steam—a mingled aroma of soy sauce, meat, and smoky wood—rushes out, filling the entire room and whetting your appetite."

2. **Complex Flavors:**

* **Savory Base:** "The first bite is a robust savory flavor, the rich, aged taste of Northeastern soybean paste."

* **Long-lasting Aftertaste:** "Then, the natural sweetness of the corn and potatoes melts on the tongue, subtly balancing the richness of the sauce, creating a savory-sweet balance."

* **Multi-layered Flavors:** "The broth is so thick it clings to the back of the spoon; every drop is concentrated with the essence of all the ingredients. One sip, and the richness of the meat, the freshness of the vegetables, and the aroma of the sauce explode in your mouth."

3. **Exquisite Texture:**

* **Meat:** "The meat is stewed until incredibly tender, melting in your mouth. Every fiber is soaked in the broth, neither dry nor greasy, just a mouthful of soft, rich flavor." Staple food: "The cornbread is the soul! The crispy side crackles with a satisfying 'snap,' releasing the most authentic aroma of grain; the side dipped in soup is soft, chewy, and savory—one cornbread offers two distinct flavors."

· Vegetables: "The potatoes were stewed until they lost their shape; a single mash with chopsticks turned them into a soft, mushy paste. Swallowing them in the broth, they were a more satisfying experience than meat."

"Eating iron pot stew shouldn't be reserved; you have to eat the meat heartily and drink the broth freely. A sip of hot soup warms you from your throat all the way to your stomach, spreading to every part of your body, instantly dispelling the winter chill."

"Sitting around the steaming pot, watching the food simmer before your eyes, listening to the bubbling sounds, chatting about everyday life. The flavor of this stew is half in the ingredients, and half in the lively, homey atmosphere."

"It lacks elaborate plating, but possesses the most solid sincerity; it doesn't use complicated seasonings, yet creates the most harmonious flavor. It's a rugged, direct, and carefree culinary joy that lets you leave all your worries behind."

The deliciousness of iron pot stew is a down-to-earth, heartwarming kind of deliciousness.

"A single pot stews all the world's delicacies, infusing everything with flavor."

"Slow simmering over a wood fire creates a world of flavors, a pot of rich aroma soothes the weary traveler." It's about hearty eating, savoring the fusion, and warming the body and soul. The moment the chopsticks touch the food, you know what "tender and flavorful" truly means; the moment the broth is stirred, you understand what a "rice-eating wonder" is. This pot isn't just stewing vegetables; it's embodying the warm, joyful spirit of family reunion.
