author: Perry Pacific

review_text: Food is relatively large in portion and reasonably priced. VIP membership grants you 10% discount with free fruit platter. Long queue expected during peak hours especially during weekends so prepare to wait. Service is excellent as well and the wait is not too long after seated. Highly recommended but on-site parking is a challenge.
author: Victor Tan

review_text:
A nicely Japanese restaurant along Pelangi, Johor Bahru.

Super Friendly Staffs, Helpful and Polite.

Extensive food and drinks menu items.

We had their 1800ml sake bottle, with balance to bring back

Reasonable prices, delicious food ...

The only short of a 5-Star is their overall presentation ....
But, then again  ... with a more "atas" environment,  prices may increase with lower traffic ...

So .. this is a 5-Star restaurant, with a modest 4-Star rating ....
author: Perry Tay

restaurant_name: 砂锅饭 Piao Xiang Claypot Chicken Rice
review_text:
Authentic food. No pretense. Came for the food.

They cook everything from scratch so do be patient. Some places, their rice have been previously cooked. Not this place. It was surely worth the wait.

My kids gobbled up the claypot rice along with the fried meat. My kids even asked for more. Testament to how delicious their food is.

They couldn't wait... saw the egg and dug into it before I could take a photo.
author: Ben Goh

restaurant_name: 砂锅饭 Piao Xiang Claypot Chicken Rice
review_text:
Service was not bad they were polite despite it's setting in a coffee shop.
Had the 1 pax set. They have different conbos. I took the one with veg and soup. Not sure if they change the type of soup? Mine was some melon carrot soup, it was ok but I would have preferred if the level of salt/msg can be reduced.
Rice for 1 pax personally I think it's a bit too little. It might not be enough for guys.
They do not have alot of rice sticking to the pot, so there's no rice wastage but also means there is a lack of the crispy slightly charred rice bits which is actually a key essence of claypot rice. The chicken that came with the rice was really nicely cooked and tender.
Vege was ok and normal, u have a choice from 3 types of vege. They only have green chilli but if they have some sort of tangy chilli sauce would be better.
author: Kampung Minion

restaurant_name: 砂锅饭 Piao Xiang Claypot Chicken Rice
review_text: Been here multiple times.. More than decent claypot rice, fried onion egg and Nanru ruo…got 2pax set at RM33 tonight.. as usual, enjoyed my dinner here 👍… on a separate note, interesting sign on the wall in front of table 17 😄…see my pic
author: Lewis G

restaurant_name: 砂锅饭 Piao Xiang Claypot Chicken Rice
review_text:
🐔🍲 Claypot Chicken Rice (1 Person Ala Carte) = RM9.00

This is a Famous 网红 Eatery that is heavily featured in many Food Blogs and Food Reviews. 🤔 It's actually a Small Stall within Restoran Kee Kim Huat Kopitiam and is a Claypot Shop run by what looks like a Pair of Young Couple. 👫 The Guy is a Silent Chap who has a Very Intense Serious Look doing the Cooking 👨‍🍳 while the Lady is Very Friendly and Genki and mans the Front Counter to take Orders. 💁

There are actually other Stalls in this Kopitiam, but this Claypot Chicken Rice completely DOMINATES the Place here. 😳 Almost Every Customer in this Kopitiam is here only for this. 🍲 Oh and there is a Very Adorable Cute Meow who's such a Sleepy Head roaming this place! 🐱😅 Because this Place is Popular, alot of their Dishes are sold out fast. 😳 I noticed that other than Claypot Rice, alot of Tables here also ordered their 炖汤 (RM6.00) 🍲 which looked like Lotus Root Soup. Unfortunately that was already Sold Out when I was there at 1.46pm. 🤔

While there were No Long Queues, I was informed that there will be a 30mins Wait! 😳 Normally, I would have just given up and moved on, but just nice it was Raining Heavily so I figured I might as well shunbian just wait out the Rain too. 🌧️😅 This is one of the Rare times I will actually wait so long tbh.

Due to Text Limit Constraints, I won't go into details describing every Ingredient here. If you are interested to know more, come visit my Food Blog. Google Search: "solofoodreviews at Blogger" to view the Full Review with Photos.

Thanks for Reading. Come join my Food Blog.
Google Search: "solofoodreviews at Blogger" to view the Full Review with Photos.
A Solo Singaporean's Guide to JB Foods (And More!)
author: Ryan YTH

restaurant_name: 砂锅饭 Piao Xiang Claypot Chicken Rice
review_text: Within a coffee shop. Flavorful, fragrant, soft, and tasty clay pot rice! Value set meal with soup and fried meat or veg and soup! Ala carte items like Chinese Sausage omelette or onion omelette. Available in 1, 2 or 3 pax portions. Brewed daily soup is nourishing and light. Shared seating spaces within the coffee shop, with other yummy stalls like chicken rice, Johor laksa, Kway Tiao (kway chap style) and fruits stall! Drinks store coffee is quite weak and mild, can skip. Definitely recommend! Payment by Touch & Go QR or Cash.
author: Vicki Tan

review_text: Friendly staff and good service. The car wash service is economic and good  where they wash, shampoo, rinse, wipe, vacuum and wax the tyre..
author: Frankie Lim

review_text:
Been visiting for many years (5>). Counter staff are super pleasant and friendly (Mizan, Mujib & team) They remember you after a while and greet you every visit.

Car wash not pushy and washes well. Wash + vacuum at ~13-15MYR depending on car size, they wash motorcycles too.

Always worth the extra 5mins from the Shell at B-point from CIQ.
author: Chris J.

review_text: Like the car wash here; They do quite a thorough job; Was a surprised find for me; Reg wash and vacuum Rm15.
author: Ray Tan

review_text: Hard selling a RM350 package to me. After repeating rejecting the offer and explaining I doesn’t need a detail washing as I drive my car daily and it get dirty easily. None of the staff wanted to wash my car. As such angrily reverse out of the station.
author: Nicholas Bong

review_text: He made our day! Service was superb and he was super patience and we have a fun chat with him. Did car wash at RM13 too. Not pushy. Love it.
author: Celeste Lim

review_text:
We had a very disappointing experience at Infusion Café while waiting for our hotel room to be ready. The café was completely empty, and before sitting down, we even checked with the lobby personnel, who told us it was okay to wait there.

However, a staff member named Melati, who was not in uniform, came to our table and spoke to us in a very rude and unwelcoming manner, telling us off and saying we were not allowed to sit or even rest there. Her tone and attitude were harsh, with no courtesy or compassion at all.

This was especially upsetting because KSL Hotel does not provide sufficient seating or lobby couches for guests who are waiting for their rooms. As hotel guests, we expected at least some basic understanding and humane treatment—especially when the café was empty.

Overall, this incident reflects very poorly on both the café and the hotel’s service standards. Hospitality should come with basic kindness and respect, and unfortunately, that was completely lacking here. I have spoken with Wati, the MOD to address this issue aswell.

I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and provides proper service training to their staff. Guests should be treated with respect and basic courtesy, especially when they are already staying at the hotel. This experience has left a very poor impression, and I sincerely hope no other guest has to go through the same situation.
author: Double U

review_text:
2-hr buffet (lunch cut-off 3pm, dinner fr. 1830). capacity of >100 but pretty much empty weekday/monday (walk-in). generally offers western/intl., msia cuisines.

highlights: flavourful local fav./ spiced up dishes.

special mention: quick brim-filled top up(s) by svc staff eg. clam/mussel, prawns. friendly front counter, well staffed restaurant.

others: creamy spaghetti, mashed potato beef, elaborate salad select, tiger-large-sized butter prawns, roasted chicken, cod/-similar fish sambal steak, mee soto, mee/nasi lemak select. crispy waffles, wedges, nuggets, fish finger fillet, mini cake select, etc.

ambience: weekday-quiet (29-Dec) & far fr. hotel lobby & mall crowds. window tables good view of below street.
author: J O

review_text: Many varieties of food. Dinner RM 50. Good value. Food average.
author: J

review_text: Breakfast buffet offered an extensive selection of international cuisines, including Malay, Chinese, Indian, and Western options. Highlights included live stations for Nasi Lemak, Mee Soto, Chicken Noodles, and eggs. A unique feature was the charcoal toasting station, where you could toast bread over a charcoal stove, giving it a crispy texture and smoky flavour. The Roti Bakar, served with coconut jam, butter, and soft-boiled eggs, was a standout. While most dishes were between subpar and decent, the toast and eggs were exceptional. The breakfast area was spacious with good service which make up for it i guess but seriously the food quality needs to be better.
author: Yang

review_text:
First time go there with family, hard to find as instruction not clear. Lucky ppl over there are friendly. Food quality not to my expectations. Some food are nice some is not. Beef are hard to chew, drink taste like plain water. Mushroom soup and fried food is nice.
No comment for spicy food as I don't take. Service is good as they let us walk in 5 min earlier. They clear the food very
Fast and ask politely.
author: Betty Lai

review_text: Took my friend there because I had good experience before. However, the experience was not good. We sat near the window. I did not find the Xio loong pow on the electronic menu which was not so well designed.  Ordered some food. Food not so tasty. Had to ask staff for cold water.  Found out later that chef was on leave n because of that no Xio loong pow. I ask the male cashier why it was so warm n stuffy where I was sitting. He just calmly said that because the air conditioning at my seat was spoilt. Did not bothered to tell us when we chose to sit there.
author: terence teoh

review_text: A little on the upmarket side, overall the food was good — especially the beef noodles.
author: Reno Quek

review_text: Nice Ambience, but food is salty. Would love to come back if they tone down the saltiness.
author: Peas 18

review_text: Nice 👍
author: Chai Chu Lai

review_text: Cozy and clean dining place.
author: Astrid Chung

review_text: had the worst jap food ever in my life here. worst chawanmushi ever. I've also never been served greyer salmon belly sashimi than what they serve here. hotate was ok but overly salted by the sauces. what's meant to be hot, isn't. What's meant to be crispy, isn't. freshness 0, taste 0.
author: Zoe Lin

review_text:
Hygiene is a big concern when the chef was talking and eating WITHOUT MASK while making the sushi at the same time. How can you be even eating while making the sushi?!

Manager attitude was one of the WORST, please look into it. Our chawanmushi was not served but i only realised it after paying the bill so when we raised it to her staff, the manager came, opened the cash register and hand me a $5 note without saying anything but with an irritated attitude.
author: Cute Oh

review_text:
Food No quality!!!Not Standard!!!
The Rice Are Not tasty!!!
The portions are different,worst service
will tell my friend and others won't going back again
author: Yannn Arh

review_text: The food did not appear fresh, the service was almost non-existent, and the overall environment was very disappointing.
author: 澤

review_text:
The staff are clearly not properly trained, especially the guy who is supposedly the head of department. I specifically asked him which item was the Unagi Don (single) because I wanted to redeem it, and he pointed me to the Jo Unagi Don. When I questioned why the name did not match what was shown on the menu, he insisted it was the same item and claimed only the picture had changed.
However, when I proceeded to the counter to make payment, the female staff told me that it was a completely different item. She then called another supervisor, who simply said there was nothing they could do about it.
author: Ann

review_text: Visited this place while waiting for my car to be washed and it turned out to be a great stop. The potato crisp was delightful and the teh tarik and fries were really yummy. We also ordered fried rice for the kids but it was way too spicy as we forgot to ask for non-spicy. They even had a live band which made the whole experience more enjoyable. A nice spot to relax while waiting and definitely worth a visit.
author: Jo Anna

review_text: Would not recommend for visitors, unfriendly staff, menu has pictures but food is completely different even ingredients - ordered a Caesar salad and got a very poor Greek salad instead, then was just pointed to small print that says ‘pictures are illustrations only’ also no beer to drink. Would move on if I was you to the next place
author: Annette Brosnan

review_text:
2nd visit here and it didn't disappoint.

1. Grilled chicken leg. It's a freaking chicken leg. Huge. Delicious. Marinated well. Mashed potatoe was just nice not salty. Gave this a 10/10. Came fast too.

2. Indo mee with fried chicken. This fried chicken batter was light and fluffy and delicious. But chicken piece a tad small. Gave this a 9/10.

3. Satay!!! Who would have thought beef satay tasted so nice. They used real lean meat. The seasonings, the less peanuty sauce and rice really made my tum tum go lalalalala. So delicious.

Ordering is from table. Digital payment available. Live band (malay), well ventilated. We loved it.
author: Kris Tan

review_text:
1. we ordered the shellout and it was really disappointing. the sambal and sotong was delicious. However, all the shellfish did not taste fresh (the prawn, mussels, clams,crab etc.

The satay was nice tho

2. the staff was friendly and warm but the food has to be improved
author: MdAmmar Khair

review_text: I recently dined at this restaurant. The Western dishes, while flavorful, leaned towards the bland side. The atmosphere was delightful, creating a pleasant dining experience. Despite a full house, the service remained prompt and efficient. The affordability of the prices was a notable highlight. The extensive menu offers a diverse range of delectable choices. Overall, a satisfying dining option with room for a bit more punch in the Western flavors.
author: Nadzirah Mustafa

restaurant_name: Tanba Japanese BBQ 炭马烧肉专门店(Twin Galaxy)
review_text: Ordered the A5 Japanese Wagyu Course. Good variety of beef cut and marinated flavour options. Recommend Salt and Pepper (do drink plenty of water after the meal) that brings out the best flavour in the wagyu. The Salmon sashimi is very fresh and sliced very thick. The Kimchi Jigae isnt too spicy but had a thick broth which is to my liking. Ordered Soju and watermelon juice which make the meal refreshing. The ambience is cosy and dim with very high ceiling that makes the restaurant feel grand. Overall a great place to dine-in  as long as you have a huge appetite. This is not the place for smaller eaters as the price for this restaurant is more expensive due to the type and quality of food served.
author: Pepper Koo

restaurant_name: Tanba Japanese BBQ 炭马烧肉专门店(Twin Galaxy)
review_text:
Didn’t know where to celebrate the birthday, so we wanted something special. My husband’s younger brother absolutely loves salmon sashimi—he ended up eating 100 slices+! Fortunately, sashimi stock is still available.....WOW

We chose the RM198+ buffet set, which came with beef slices. The beef was fresh, and the pork dishes were also unique and tasty. The barbecue flames rising up looked spectacular.

The atmosphere was vintage-inspired, carrying a nostalgic touch of the past.

The Japanese dishes were incredibly delicious. The highlight was the cake—infused with the fragrance of roses and presented with such artistic design. The rose-shaped salmon sashimi was also exquisite. Highly recommended!

The staff’s service felt very high-class and attentive. They understood my needs—when I accidentally ordered the premium ice cream (which had an extra charge), even though I only wanted the regular complimentary one, they came over to kindly remind me and asked if I really needed it. Very thoughtful.

They even arranged a very comfortable window-side seat for us.

Where else can you find such an awesome experience?
author: Jacqueline Liew

restaurant_name: Tanba Japanese BBQ 炭马烧肉专门店(Twin Galaxy)
review_text:
5 stars for food, service and atmosphere! I paid MYR198++ per adult for a bigger dinner on Friday.

Wide variety for choices. Fresh meat and vegetables. Green tea, water and desserts are free. Order via a tablet.

Warm, friendly service. Their staffs were thoughtful and hospitable. New, clean , modern and classy. Lively vibes.

Convenient to make reservations via WhatsApp. I recommend if you want to splurge for a special occasion.
author: Toh Bee Leng

restaurant_name: Tanba Japanese BBQ 炭马烧肉专门店(Twin Galaxy)
review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Perfect dinner experience at Tanba, Twin Galaxy. The food was absolutely solid every dish was well prepared, flavourful, and satisfying from start to finish. You can really tell the quality and consistency in what they serve.

What made the experience even better was the service. The staff were genuinely warm and attentive, especially Nick and Lisa, who took great care of us and made us feel very welcome. Their friendliness and professionalism truly elevated the night.

Highly recommend Tanba Japanese BBQ for anyone looking for great food and excellent service. Definitely a place worth coming back to.
author: work mail

restaurant_name: Tanba Japanese BBQ 炭马烧肉专门店(Twin Galaxy)
review_text: Opted for the Wagyu dinner buffet for our special occasion and the experience was great - The beef cuts and marbling was soooo good (this set has 5 different wagyu cuts to choose from) and taste-wise was so yummy, the service was so quick and attentive! The restaurant ambiance was cozy and cool. Would definitely come here again!
author: fionn swift

review_text:
Nasi Campur

Food was slightly below average. The sambal for the chicken can be slightly more flavorful.
author: Hang Ming Chung

review_text: Food was very yummy, price is reasonable. Kunafa was delicious 🤤. Must try.  Mutton briyani was good 👍.
author: Shakila Banu

review_text:
A fantastic restaurant for Mandi, kebabs, biriyani and more of its kind. Too many flavors, options with absolute taste.

Service is great and they recommended to choose our food according to our expectations. Price is also very attractive.
author: Chandramohan Devaraju

review_text: Middle Eastern restaurant in Pelangi Plaza that serves delicious food, very affordable pricing. Staff were efficient and friendly. Will definitely be back.
author: Ray Chan

review_text: Wonderful service and delicious food. Gathered as a group of 6 last week and had such a wonderful time.
author: Family Tok

review_text: Amazing food that should definitely get more people !! Their lamb hummus was amazing together with their mix platter
author: Abdul Rahman

review_text:
Really authentic Thai food.
Reasonable prices.

We like the mixed veg with oyster sauce, green milk tea, Tom yum seafood soup, basil pork rice, phat Thai. Yummmm

All for only rm77.

Greetings from Singapore!
Wish you all Huat Huat heng Heng.
author: Ju Elisha 朱莉雅 (Cactus)

review_text:
I suddenly got hungry in the middle of the night and wanted Thai food, so I randomly found this place on Google.
It was past midnight and there was no one else there, so the food came out quickly. Most of the dishes were delicious; I also ordered pickled squid and stir-fried kangkung. I didn't take pictures of some of the dishes because I was too hungry.
I'll definitely come back
author: Yoses Lim

review_text: Authentic and affordable thai food found in JB city centre, this place is a hidden jem. Lady boss is thai and all the food turned out great and quickly served. Tomyum soup packs a punch and prawns were fresh. Will be back to try more dishes, thank you.
author: Kosong Belly

review_text:
Authentic northern Thai food, something you won't come across so often in most Thai restaurants.

I Had the Gaeng om gai (soup), The chicken soup is spicy and sour, not too salty, with a slight herbal and roasted rice taste.

Gaeng hung lay pork curry, tastes like Japanese curry. I feel the flavor will be suitable for most people.

Cha Om omelette, very fragrant with a slight herbal taste. The omelette is not too oily and salty.

Pineapple fried rice. I can taste the curry used in it. The sweet and sour pineapple and the savory Chinese wax sausage used complete the entire dish.

Basil fried crispy pork belly. The pork belly is deep-fried before it is stir-fried with basil, chili, and garlic. The taste is good, not too salty, and doesn't feel too oily.

Overall, the food is great; I had a wonderful meal. The boss is very friendly and welcoming even though they are about to close for the day.

The prices for the dishes are not expensive; they are still affordable for the price paid, as the portion sizes are quite decent.
author: Raymond Lee

review_text:
Good Thai food. Quiet place. Many options, can choose between pork/chicken /seafood.

Tomyam was good, with good kick.

Service fast.
Portions all standard small size. Portion good enough for 2-3 persons.
Staff not good in English or Malay or dialects. Only mandarin or Thai.

Must try is the milk tea. Only cold. No hot tea.

Downside : no dessert. Also charge corkage if bring own liquor.

Ample street parking at night.
author: J Bz

review_text:
Nice bibimbap at a cozy steamboat restaurant.

Saw this steamboat restaurant which is not available in Kuala Lumpur, so me and my friends decided to give it a try. They provide kids’ biscuit at the entrance and I think this is a warm move.
The steamboat here more to personal style, everyone can enjoy their pot and it’s more hygiene. I ordered the spicy milk soup based and my friend order pork bone soup based.
I personally dislike the spicy milk soup based even though they said it’s signature as it tasted like china mala. I prefer the non spicy normal pork bone soup based instead. The fried salmon fish head is no good. Food portion is good and what amazed me the most is their bibimbap, it tastes great !

Food: 7.5/10
Price: 7.5/10
Service and Environment: 8/10 (quite comfortable and cozy place for gathering)
Accessibility: 8/10 (there are mid valley mall parking available)
author: Jin Hong

review_text: Excellent herbal hot pot steamboat place. Soup is refillable and offers a condiment bar. Hongkong sauce was a great balance between spicy and tasty. Staffs were  friendly and helpful👍
author: Sheena S

review_text: Came here for lunch, it’s the Arashi standard - great quality ingredients with great soup standard, we tried the Arashi Milk Base and Arashi Pork Bone Soup Base, both are fabulous, will come back again!
author: Daniel Lee

review_text: offers a satisfying hotpot dining experience with a variety of options to suit different preferences.
author: Google Map

review_text: very delicious, dishes are served quickly, I think there should be more dishes on the menu
author: Huang Jin

review_text:
Tried this place today as I don't know what to eat at KSL.
Food was okay but I don't like the taste of the ham in the carbonara. The staffs are nice so have to give 3 stars overall.
The noise mainly come from the phone accessories shop beside, they are quite load.
author: ZhanYuan

review_text: Was pleasantly surprised as I was just wanting a quick dinner. Food was well presented, served hot and tasty. Service was very efficient and all service staff were very hard at work and also attentive. Menu has a wide selection of food. Atmosphere was bright, clean and tidy. Well done guys.
author: Andy

review_text: The Cream sauce chicken lacked flavor and tasted quite bland to me. On the bright side, the mixed platter was decent and a nice way to try a variety of snacks. However, the mee rebus was a letdown and didn't really hit the mark. Overall, the food is average, but the service is good and the atmosphere is great
author: Ashiqah

review_text:
Should have checked the review before ordering. The menu and environment are all attractive.
Ordered chili garlic meehoonsoup with fresh clam, less spicy. At the end the soup is tasteless, only a bit ginger flavour without spicy. Asked for chili and garlic so I can add in my own, but kitchen said only got chili, no garlic. Gave me first round not fresh chili, i ask and informed that the chili is ald black, can give me a  chopped one and not black chili.  The photo attached is second round of chili, I had to took out the black one myself. Maybe kitchen no more garlic, that's why the soup no garlic at all.

The clam is pathetic and fried rice is too salty. The fish and cracker is not fresh with stinky oil smell.

Overall bad experience.  Only the yogurt drink is ok. :(
author: Melody Ng

review_text: Ordered the Lamb shoulder and Laksa. Generous amount of lamb, tasty sauce, adequate. The wait for laksa was slightly long but okay. Laksa tasted great, tasty soup, generous amount of ingredients and meat. Grilled chicken in the laksa was tender and well cooked. I think many poor reviews may have been during peak hours, our experience was good :)
author: JiaWei Lim (chacha)

review_text:
Soup is good, generous amount of fish, but the noodle is cold and stick together as it was prepack.

will visit again. Like the space of restnt, not crowded on a Thurs btw 2 and 3pm.

Price of $9.90 for a small bowl is quite pricey.
author: cheryl ng

review_text: I would like to file a complaint about your laksa shop. After eating there, I, as a pregnant woman, suffered from diarrhea, and my elderly father even vomited twice. This is extremely concerning and unacceptable, especially considering the health risks for both pregnant women and the elderly.
author: Shl Huiling

review_text: My favorite assam laksa since decades. This brand has a few outlets, personally feels that this branch cooked the soup base more flavourful. Tried other outlets at tebrau, quite bland.
author: TNJ Housing Solutions Pte Ltd

review_text: D'Laksa and Penang asam laksa can't be compared, they're two distinct flavours that happen to share some similar ingredients. D'Laksa offers its own unique take on asam laksa, which stands on its own. While both versions carry that signature sweet and sour profile, D'Laksa's broth is noticeably lighter in depth and richness. When I'm craving something tangy but Penang laksa is out of reach, D'Laksa is a satisfying alternative to curb the craving, giving a comforting and flavorful soup.
author: Cheiro Theorem

review_text:
The Asam Laksa is a burst of flavors - spicy, uniquely sour with a delightful prawn twist. The addition of sardines elevates it!

Must-try: Asam Fish Ball & Asam Lobster Ball soaked in Asam Laksa gravy!

Don't overlook their delightful Steamboat Paste - ideal for savoring at home with your favorite steamboat dishes.

However, it's worth noting that there used to be a generous serving of sardines and onions, but that has been reduced recently. Additionally, they now precook the noodles, which sometimes causes them to stick together. Still, the broth remains tasty!

Available for both dine-in and takeout.
author: Alvin Terence

review_text:
I ordered the Cheezilla Box, which came with a Zinger Cheezilla, one piece of chicken, whipped potato and a medium Coke, along with a Zinger Classic combo with fries and hot Milo.

Despite the outlet being quite empty, the food quality was disappointing. The items were not even warm when served, which affected the overall taste. The hot Milo was especially bad and had almost no flavour at all.

Overall, it was a poor dining experience, and the food did not meet expectations even for fast food standards.
author: Anson Chew

review_text:
Very bad experience at KFC City Square Mall.
The chicken was extremely dry, overcooked, and not hot at all. It tasted like it had been sitting for a long time. The coleslaw was also dry and served cold, which is unacceptable. Overall food quality was poor and not worth the money. Very disappointed and will think twice before coming back.
author: shatir shatir

review_text: Worst food in my entire life. I literally throw my money . Dirty atmosphere, raw food bad smell. Bad service. I tried to find a good part out of my chicken to eat but THAT WAS RAW AND SMELLY . I regret it. I just could ate the salad and potato because i was so hungry . Waste of money…
author: Betty Pakdel

review_text:
Honestly, I didn’t find the KFC here particularly nice. I’ve heard many Singaporeans say that KFC in JB tastes better than in Singapore, but personally, I don’t quite agree.
For me, the chicken wasn’t seasoned well enough, and the overall flavour just felt bland and underwhelming. Maybe it’s a matter of personal preference, but I’d say it’s nothing special and definitely not worth the hype.
author: Ming Shen Tham

review_text: The chicken I ordered was spicy but when it arrived it wasn't spicy and... the chicken was rotten... not worth eating. The bones inside were rotten.
author: Jabin

restaurant_name: B.O.D 包栈 @ KSL City Mall
review_text: For a fresh pau outfit, the quality here is pretty decent for the price. I really appreciate that you can see the team hand-making the pau right in front of you before they go into the steamer. It adds a level of trust and authenticity to the food. They carry a great range—from piping hot freshly steamed buns to cold and frozen options—which makes them perfect for grabbing a quick snack now or stocking up for an easy breakfast the next morning.
author: Flo Yeow

restaurant_name: B.O.D 包栈 @ KSL City Mall
review_text:
Tried their char siew bun. The skin is soft and nice but the filling is VERY VERY sweet. (I have a sweet tooth, so when I say it's sweet, it really is!)

Service, the staff at their cooked counter outside lotus are always not friendly and very impatient. They charge for small plastic bags while other restaurants or take away counters don't. BTW, the price is not cheap compared to other shops in jb and comparable to sg. I won't pay sg prices in jb. That's why their customers are all from sg. 🤣😁
author: Ms Lim

restaurant_name: B.O.D 包栈 @ KSL City Mall
review_text:
Bought the big pork bun, it was flavourful and nice.

Also bought siew mai and a pack of char siew bao.

The mini char siew bao was so yummy.

Will buy more next visit.
author: Evelyn Tan

restaurant_name: B.O.D 包栈 @ KSL City Mall
review_text:
This was my second visit to B.O.D, and once again, I was impressed! The frozen bao and other dim sums were very decent and perfect for quick meals at home. On my first visit, they ran out of cooler bags, but the staff went out of their way to help by keeping my order in the fridge until I could come back to collect it. Great customer service and a pleasant shopping experience overall. I’ll definitely be returning!

The cooler bag was cute too ☺️
author: Leslie Goh

restaurant_name: B.O.D 包栈 @ KSL City Mall
review_text:
Nice traditional steamed buns with meatless options like Red Bean Paste Steamed Buns.
Dough is soft and easy to swallow, and the filling is generous. Definitely worth a try.
author: Yellow Bear

review_text:
Came here twice and loved both my experiences very much! My Queen loves it too. We ordered the romantic beef platter which was a resemblance of roses and flowers for our anniversary. We were amazed that we finished them all up on top of other dishes. The atmosphere was great and we really had our best time here. Staff were friendly and allowed us to stay until closing hours.
So far we had tried the tomato and collagen broth which were both very rich and satisfying.
author: Kong Wen Sheng

review_text: Nice and delicious food. Tonkatsu is super good, meat and vegetables are fresh. Staff Maung Maung is very friendly too :) Great service and very satisfied. Will come back again.
author: Bao Zhu Tong

review_text: Portion seems to shrink. It's good for small eater, at least food is not wasted. I ordered pork cheek, with herbal soup hotpot, the meat is chewy. Soup taste is strong enough.
author: MJ Lim

review_text: Have been always patrons at this outlet whenever go to KSL. The food are variety to suit from kids to adults and staff are friendly with good service. Highly recommended
author: CK Oh

review_text: Thank you so much, best service Saw Win, very polite, very good. We've been eating here regularly for the last 10+ years.
author: Richard HARYONO

review_text:
Was a great pleasant experience, friendly and comfortable.
Their Fish Fillet with cream sauce is the best in the world. Their local and western food totally amazing.
author: Christine Tan

review_text: omg, i have been staying in impian emas for years and just newly found this hidden gem, the food is so nice and most importantly got beer to chill with good food! definitely visit again!
author: Ah Sheng

review_text: Love this place! For the food and atmosphere and of course the drinks! We always come here every other week. Highly recommend!
author: Khirthana Subramaniam

review_text: Jeorge is an exemplary staff. The whole group of staffs are brilliant, and served great food, beers, and also played rock n roll music from my request. Will sure come back again.
author: Cynthia Sing

review_text: Came here with hubs for the first time and loved the old school ambiance. We came here for a drink but decided to order their famous signature fried beehon to try and wowwww super delicious. Please keep you chef forever 😅😅 so that I can come and eat this dish again! Coming again for sure, great dish , cool oldskool ambience and friendly staff ✌🏾
author: Sunitha Sundrarajah

review_text:
Pleasant time here. If I would choose a word for their selling point, it'd be their service and atmosphere

We got the chicken chop, bechamel salmon pasta, calamari, mushroom croquettes, truffle mushroom bisque, hazelnut chocolate brownie, iced latte and honey green tea. It started strong with a tasty mushroom bisque that arrived at the same time. Then came the appetisers which were crisp, but unfortunately a tad bit too chewy for the calamari. The mains were alright.

*edit* I think some of their dishes don't do the rest of the menu justice. I've initially given a lower rating on the food based on the mains - it tasted alright, but nothing spectacular. However I wrote this review prior to trying their dessert. Their brownie cake was not just a spectacle to see, but also a lovely gastronomical experience. The tartness that was contrasted with the rich dark chocolate and the dense chocolate brownie (almost fudge like). To be fair, I wasn't too amazed by the mains, but the dessert itself deserved a good rating.

*Edit 2* another pleasant surprise, we were offered a free peach mille-feuille for a birthday celebration! I did not make this booking for a birthday, nor did we sing happy birthday loudly the first time round, but the staff came in towards the end to offer us an additional dessert with a candle atop it.

#Ltablefeast
author: Calvin

review_text:
We celebrated our 2nd wedding anniversary at this restaurant, and it was truly a memorable experience. The restaurant’s design is beautiful, cozy, and thoughtfully arranged, creating an intimate and relaxing atmosphere that is perfect for special occasions. The warm lighting and tasteful décor made the evening feel even more special and comfortable.

For the food, I ordered the Cajun Chicken Pasta, which was rich and creamy, with a perfectly cooked chicken cutlet on top. The chicken was incredibly juicy on the inside and crispy on the outside, making the dish very satisfying. My husband ordered the Authentic Tomato Fried Rice, which was full of flavor. The sambal complemented the dish well and was not overly spicy, making it enjoyable to eat together with the chicken. We also tried the Lemongrass Chicken, which was equally impressive. The chicken was very juicy, flavorful, and crispy, with a lovely aromatic lemongrass fragrance.

We were pleasantly surprised when the restaurant served us a complimentary mille-feuille to celebrate our 2nd anniversary, which was a thoughtful and generous gesture.

The service was exceptional throughout the evening. The staff were attentive and professional, always refilling our drinks before they were empty. They also kindly helped us take photos and greeted us with warm smiles, which added a personal touch to our dining experience.

Overall, our dinner here was wonderful, and we truly enjoyed every aspect of the experience. We highly recommend this restaurant for both special occasions and casual dining.
author: Vanessa Ubong Nicholas

review_text: Second visit for dinner, and it's been years! Noticed some changes in the beverage menu – no more alcoholic drinks. The Western food variety is impressive, and the overall quality is great with fast service. Definitely planning to return for a special occasion! 🍽️🥂 #Dinner #Food #Service #Occasion
author: jerry cheah

review_text: Nice food and cosy ambience! The place has a different vibe and cool decor. The Cajun chicken pasta could’ve used a bit more flavour, but it was still nice overall. Overall, the food tasted good and prices were fair. There’s a bakery downstairs too, we tried their pineapple cookies and ice cream, both were really good! Worth checking out if you’re in Johor.
author: Shamini Gunaseelan

review_text: Came here for Valentine’s Day. Food was good. Overall a worthy experience. Staff was friendly and accommodating too. Would return!
author: Vel1293

review_text: Probably the best 煮炒 in this market, yes better than the other more well known ones. Claypot noodles 砂锅面 is good as usual, but should stick to the usual small portion instead. Decided to try their black pepper crayfish, that's pretty good and really peppery. Saw the bunch of Lala 拉拉 squirting water in the basket and decided on it too.
author: Rio Wang

review_text: 22 Apr 2023. My love one family is here visiting us. So we bring them to one of our favorite stall in JB. The place filled with a lot of custimers as usual. The lady who did the order also as usual, keep asking people to wait or even saw her ask one customer to order from another stall. This time we ordered the seafood beehoon (without lala, as they couldn't get them). We also asked for sweet sour meat, squid kamheong and a soup.
author: Cheewee Kok

review_text: My family and I had a wonderful dinner at this stall. The stall owner was so busy but remained extremely happy. Her positive energy affected us deeply and I loved how she managed to spot that I was a first time customer in her 40-year stall history, lol. We loved the bbq stingray, sotong, clams, cockles. I will definitely come back again.
author: Darren Tee

review_text:
Super cheap and good! I hardly use the term cheap as thats relative. But it's only fair to describe my dinner here. 3 fresh seafood dishes + 1 veg, all for RM80! Come on...!
A regular eating place for my Malaysian foodies. But it's a hawker center, dont expect aircon and services. Also watch out for seedy characters. Keke
author: Andy Chua

review_text:
We have been here countless times! There’s no other objective but for the mere good food.
Today we ordered the claypot fish head (砂煲鱼头）clams with ginger and spring onion （姜葱啦啦）and the prawns （干煎虾绿）

There’s no beautiful ambience but the good food more than made up for the ambience!
author: Betty Yong

review_text: Must die die try their pepper pork stomach soup. Taste super great. As we try it 1st time in this restaurant, the staff introduced us their food and recommended which type set to select. We selected the red snapper fish with seafood, and the taste was super amazing.  The staff was friendly and nice, and they immediately to up soup when it was running low. Cons: slightly difficult to reach here as the restaurant's name cannot be found in the GRAB app. We had to copy the restaurant' address from Google map and paste in GRAB app in order to find a GRAB taxi for the transport service. Definitely will come again
author: Kokthye Lim

review_text:
My first time to Fat Fish with a friend. We ordered the seafood set and the pig stomach soup as soup based cos it’s the recommended. The soup was thick but it’s saltish and I believe there’s a lot of MSG, felt thirsty after the meal. We add on Tang Hoon and one glass of ice green tea.

Soup refilled was unlimited. Total price was RM230 after all the extra service charge. We didn’t feel the food for the set was enough to eat. We still felt hungry after the meal and with the price tag of RM230 is not value for money. We could have a good feast and better food quality in other place with lower price tag.

Not highly recommended.
author: Janson Eng

review_text:
I ordered seafood pot and tried pork pepper stomach as soup base and it is really good.
They are quite generous with seafood and for the price paid, I really feel it is worth it.

I went on a weekday early dinner and we were the only customers. Hope the restaurant can survived as it has quality good and reasonable price for the portion given.
author: A H

review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5

Visited Fat Fish JB on a Saturday night around 8pm. Even though many tables were filled, there were still a few empty ones and the four of us got seated immediately. The lady at the counter was very polite and friendly, and quickly brought us to our table. Another young staff who handed us the ordering tablet even asked if it was our first time here and offered to guide us through the menu.

We chose to order à la carte since we didn’t want everything in the bundle set. The staff explained it would be slightly more expensive but still okay — very honest and helpful. Throughout the meal, they refilled our soup three times without us even asking, which means they were really attentive and paying attention to our pot.

We were also offered disposable aprons and even a phone stand when they saw us using our phones — super thoughtful touches that made the experience even better.

Food-wise, everything was fresh and delicious. The tiger prawns were big and very fresh, and the pumpkin soup base was a huge hit with my kids — rich, flavourful and comforting. All the ingredients we ordered were tasty and good quality.

Overall, great service, great food, and great experience. We’ll definitely be back again next time!
author: Happy Belly Explorer

review_text:
Really fresh seafood  — probably one of the better spots in JB if you’re craving seafood.

The place can get a bit crowded during dinner, so best to make a reservation or come early. Price-wise it’s slightly on the higher side for JB, but still reasonable for the quality you get.

Overall, great for seafood lovers who want something fresh and well-prepared. Would definitely come back.
author: Yeoh Yuxian

review_text: where we had ours.........this place indeed got good foods and good works.........
author: Siambuddhas

review_text:
Located near Pelangi area, a stand-alone house, with hard to miss Signboard.

I like their layout, which is hospitable and gives a warm welcome after stepping in.

Their menu items are interesting and varied to cater to all types of diners.

Tried their signature stew, which was well-cooked, soft and flavoured. - comes with 2 slices of garlic bread, which complimented the stew sauce.

Their big breakfast dish was generous and delicious as well.

The chicken dish came with condiments,  meat was tender and juicy.

I will recommend you try their mint latte .... refreshing and nice !!!

Staffs are polite and helpful too.

A cosy place to catch a quick bite or meal ...
author: Perry Pacific

review_text: My wife and I were here this morning (8 DECEMBER 2025) for breakfast and we ordered the following:  an Eggs Benedict on Cado with Bacon and English Breakfast Tea for my wife, and a Cheesy Bacon & Egg Breakfast and an Americano for me. My wife enjoyed her breakfast choice. As for me, I loved mine as the "Cheesy Bacon & Egg" and there were two of them were like a cheesy egg in a pig's blanket and they came with two sausages, a huge dollop of mashed potatoes, two slices of toast and a side of salad side, which were all very good and generously portioned I thought. As regards the Americano, it was robust and not acidic, which is the way I like my coffee. Service here was very good - very courteous and attentive. The dining ambience was also very good - with the dining tables spaciously separated and the air-conditioning cool enough. I highly recommend this place for a lovely Western breakfast experience.
author: edtayjb

review_text:
Excellent cafe! Delicious food, great sourdough bread, clean and awesome staff! No 1 in JB~

Highly recommend the salmon steak and chicken chopN
author: Wee Keat Lim

review_text: The taste of the food items we ordered were not bad. The cafe setting and environment is cozy and service was good!
author: Angela Y

review_text:
The staff are foreigners but communicate well in English, and service was smooth. Food took around 15–20 minutes to arrive, which is acceptable. Vibe is good and they serve plain water, which is always a plus.

What surprised me was the variety on the menu — from Western breakfast, bagels, spaghetti, congee, toast, burgers, to dessert like waffles and pancakes. Quite a lot of options.

Le Breakfast – The bagel was honestly better than some of the famous ones out there. Crusty on the outside, fluffy inside. Omelet was buttery and soft. Comes with sausage and bacon, and overall quite worth the price.

Meatball Spaghetti – Really loved the meatballs. Nicely made with a good mix of fat and lean meat, so the texture is not too coarse. Tomato sauce paired well with the pasta, flavorful but not overpowering.

Matcha Lava – This was the best lava cake I’ve ever had. The crust was crisp, and the inside just melted perfectly. The matcha taste isn’t very strong though, so might go for the Belgian chocolate one next time.

Overall, a great find with solid food and a comfortable place to chill. Will definitely revisit.
author: Audrey L

review_text: The best nasi ayam penyet! Used to have a lots of crowd but recently after renovation seems number of customer has become significantly lesser. Hope others can support this local muslim owned restaurant which has been operating more than 20 years..
author: Hanafi Kamalol Ariffin

review_text: The food so far so good. The price is ok for me. Every food that I order the test is nice. Overall my dinner there is good. The food was serve in good way & fast. Everything came together. We family enjoy the food during our dinner.
author: ManPeace

review_text: I went for lunch on a working day and the place is almost full. Have an open area with a blasting fan and a close air-conditioning area. The food is nice with big portions that suit the price. Pecal Lele (big size keli@cat fish) RM10 and Bawal@Pomfret (can eat for 2 pax) RM20. The sambal is the best in town. Parking would be a bit of a problem during peak times. Overall, a good place to have a makan.
author: Mohd Haryzal Ismail

review_text: Waited for half hour for service but staff busy talking to each other. Only a handful of customer but still staff could not be bothered. We were their regular customer but after this incident, we will not step anymore at this place
author: Aga Khan

review_text: This the restaurant we used to go before covid. Were disappointed with the quality and taste. The bawal penyet wasnt fresh and wasn't cleaned well. The rice has no serai aroma nor taste. The ayam penyet was tough, feels like kept overnight & refried again. Very disappointed!
author: hazel frank

review_text: A place where u can chill out with some beers and dine here as well. Variety foods to order and this is a place you can watch football with beers and some finger foods. Of cos kids also suitable here and environment are great with well trained staffs. Price is consider mid high side
author: Albert J【顺亮乱乱拍】

review_text: Had lunch menu at 19-25RM. Comes with soup of the day and dessert. Food is fine. Its probably more happening in the evening. Looks like a good place to drink and hang out with a group of friends
author: Victor Ong

review_text: Atmosphere is pretty decent with a singer entertaining the diners. However, food is only okay, given the price it is not that worthy.
author: Sarah E

review_text: Nice n Cosy place, foodies quite good
author: Tai Kelvin

review_text: Ordered soup, salad, pasta, dory fish and chicken chop. I am not sure why they serve main dish first then soup and salad later?! Chicken chop is the best and the rest are quite average or below average. Rm30 salad only with 1 type of lettuce is quite disappointing. The waiters are mostly foreign workers and the service is not high class as the prices. The band is good so this is probably a place more for drink and chill.
author: Jake Ng

review_text: I ordered my pizza at 5:45pm, but it only arrived at 7:45pm and it was already cold 😔. Kudos to the rider though, he was the only one handling all the deliveries. I really hope the management can look into this because many customers are starting to complain.
author: Norhafizah Baharuddin

review_text:
1st order Via Grab Food, over 1hr just to get to my place which is only 7 minutes away! Pizza served cold!

2nd order on the same night directly to Domino's, check out the video & image of the pizza!

What happen here?
Very disappointed!!!
author: Syed K. ‘Attas

review_text:
Ordered for takeaway.
Small outlet but service is very efficient. Friendly crew. Pizza is nice, delicious and freshly made upon order, which is why need to wait for 20 minutes.
author: Brian Lee

review_text: First time receiving such horrendous quality from this outlet. The sauce on classified chicken pizza apparently were “CLASSIFIED” as picture shown. Not even covering half the pizza. And my order of mushrooms soup arrived just quarter of the cup. When i called the outlet regarding this issue , the outlet simply brushed me off with insane answers that they  are just following their SOP. I NEVER RECEIVED QUARTER CUP SOUP BEFORE! And the sauce on the pizza is abysmal!
author: Irfan Hasman

review_text:
Ordered since 9.45pm. Received at 10.47pm.

Called 15 times to Domino and when transferred to the outlet, it directly cut off the line.
