author: Vincent Tham

restaurant_name: Nam Moon Korean BBQ 南门 BBQ
review_text:
We have noticed that this place was frequent by a lot of local Korean, so, we made a point of checking it out.  To our surprise, this place is operated by Korean and hence we were able to immerse ourselves in true Korean experience.
The side dishes are just top class.  We love the quail eggs so much that we asked for a second serving.
The bibimbap is very good.  However, the ginseng chicken is something that is below our expectations, even though it was served piping hot!
The setting is very clean and minimalist, typical of traditional Korean eating houses.
There are a lot of seating around, although it was busy, we did not have trouble getting a table, without prior reservations.
author: Hui Lim

restaurant_name: Nam Moon Korean BBQ 南门 BBQ
review_text: I really enjoyed this Korean restaurant in JB. Before the main dishes arrive, they serve many small side dishes. There is a wide variety, and all of them are delicious. It makes the meal more enjoyable.
author: Yammers

restaurant_name: Nam Moon Korean BBQ 南门 BBQ
review_text: Probably made a mistake to order bbq over here. Their ala carte food seems to be alot better. Would recommend for local korean food but not bbq. Nonetheless, great service from the staffs
author: terence ng

restaurant_name: Nam Moon Korean BBQ 南门 BBQ
review_text: Amazing Korean food at ridiculously good prices. Huge variety of really tasty banchan. Excellent service, prompt and friendly, bringing more banchan and more barley tea really fast. They cook the meats in the kitchen so we don't smell, and there are no grills to take up lots of space on the table. We ordered a lot of stuff, and the only small criticism I have is that the pork collar was a bit tough. Everything else was amazing. Special shoutout to the sundubu jjigae for being the best I've ever had. Highly recommend, would come back.
author: A Chan

restaurant_name: Nam Moon Korean BBQ 南门 BBQ
review_text: The food here was great, not too oily and they were generous on the side dishes over 10 kinds of side dishes. Their marinated chicken was super good, a little scorch but it was seasoned well enough. Their soybean soup’s abalone mushroom wasn’t that fresh but I’ve been there several times, all of their dishes were good . The pancake wasn’t too oily too and they gave generous ingredients even prawns. Their kimchi pancake was a bit too oily but it taste good. Love their bbq marinated chicken it was tender and fragrant, their marinated pork was super delicious too. Love their pollack soup too it was served with generous ingredients. Their bimbimbap was super delicious, it was served super hot and there were lots of ingredients, paired with their special sauce perfect! Their cold noodles were delicious too, paired with the vinegar. Their kimchi fried rice was super flavourful too, not too spicy paired with the seaweed perfect. Their kimbap was great too, good ingredients many nutrients. Their ginseng chicken soup was full with ingredients too just the soup was less in my opinion.
author: xaxxolonch

restaurant_name: BAR WANG RICE 霸王饭 - Taman Pelangi
review_text: I find that their price on the signage they don't follow. Anyhow count base on their own. 1 fried chicken drumstick rm5, veggie each rm2, less rice .. Rm0.5 . Total rm9.5 x2 pax. But the signage written price nothing to match.  So if you put rm1. 5 vegetable why count me rm2? Some more the portion so little look at the brocolli. I will make a report about your business.
author: Piano Cover

restaurant_name: BAR WANG RICE 霸王饭 - Taman Pelangi
review_text: The place feels cool and clean. The ingredients are fresh and there is a good variety of dishes to choose from. They even provide complimentary drinking water. Prices are a little higher than the usual mixed rice stall, but fair considering the nicer setting.
author: Seng Chai Loh

restaurant_name: BAR WANG RICE 霸王饭 - Taman Pelangi
review_text: Chicken , potato luncheon meat , Thai tofu , rice ,rm9.80. Big portion. Can drinks are additional rm2. There is free water to drink too
author: Matthew Li

restaurant_name: BAR WANG RICE 霸王饭 - Taman Pelangi
review_text: Economical rice with free water and air conditioning. There is a good variety if dishes to choose from and while I was eating there, it has always been a queue. 1 egg, 1 veg and 1 chicken cost me RM7.90. Very reasonable consider the free drinking water and AC. Recommended.
author: Eng Siong Lee

restaurant_name: BAR WANG RICE 霸王饭 - Taman Pelangi
review_text: Affordable price with great variety of selections. Food aren't too oily or salty, portion is just nice. Ordered 3 vege and a rice for 5.20rm. Enough to fill your stomach, however the only downside at the shop is that it has no reception... Even has to step out of the shop to load my TNG to pay. Reception is super bad once u enter the shop, can't even reply whatsapp messages....
author: jayden

review_text:
If you’re someone who truly appreciates authentic, high-quality Japanese food, this hidden gem in Johor is the place to visit. The elderly chef—who is also the owner—puts in 100% effort into every dish. You can really taste the freshness and quality of the ingredients, and the flavours are incredibly satisfying.

That said, this is not your usual walk-in Japanese restaurant. They accept very, very limited customers, as the chef prepares everything personally and takes his time to ensure perfection. Be prepared to wait 30 minutes to 1 hour for high-quality sushi.

The environment is simple and the service can be extremely slow due to the chef working alone, but rest assured—the food quality and taste are absolutely worth it.
author: JOHNSON CHONG JENG

review_text:
Visited on 6 Dec 2025. Suddenly missed the food — especially the generous salmon belly — and came with my family. I didn’t know this would be my last meal here.

The owner shared that the coming weekend would be their final days of operation, and he may take a break after that. I even hugged the waitress before leaving.

For updates, please follow their Facebook page: New Tokugawa – Sushi Monzta.

All the best to you, Boss.
author: Goh Felicia

review_text:
I came here with my wife recently for lunch. We were pleasantly surprised at the freshness, quality and generous portion of the food which were great! The price we paid is very affordable value for the excellent quality of the food.

I saw some reviews here which mentioned the long waiting time for preparation of food. I would suggest for one to come here if you are willing to wait and not rushing for time.

Because, I still feel that excellent and very affordable Japanese food like this place offers, is still worth the time for the wait. We can spend one to two hours in a long queue waiting to buy from a popular nice food stall. I am sure we can be also patiently seated in the restaurant for a great serving of Japanese food at very affordable prices, worthy of the wait.
author: Jeremy Ow

review_text:
Food was freshly prepared and you can taste it from the Saba fish. The Tendon was perfect! The fried fritters were well-fried with a clean golden hue on the batter, and the restaurant was generous with its portioning.

Highly recommended to come here for everyday meal. Environment is clean and quiet, feels like those countryside Japanese restaurant.
author: Levi HW

review_text:
Came by for lunch, found their lunch set reasonably priced. But we selected their ala carte menu for dine-in and the lunch set for takeaway. Note, portions are generous. If you are unsure whether your order is sufficient, you can always ask the friendly staff.
The sashimi is sliced thick which is always an enjoyable way to taste the fish. Fresh fresh.
The sushi ordered is prepared with chef's own twist and makes the experience very unique.
The yakitori sticks taste very similar to what I experience in Japan restaurant. Flavourful and juicy.
Udon soup has strong notes of bonito in the soup. The fried Udon has lots of ingredients to it, 3 prawns, chicken pieces mushrooms...

Tip: due to the limited manpower, if you know what you are going to order, make your order in one go to avoid longer waiting.
author: Ron Ng

review_text: We intended to go to restaurant next door for dinner but was too hurry and have a quick bit here. Ordered chicken biryani & roti telur,  It is just average, too sweet, not for me.
author: Xiao Hao

review_text:
I am writing to formally lodge a serious complaint regarding a restaurant that I recently visited for supper. The conditions and practices observed during my visit raise significant concerns about public health, food safety, and service standards.

Firstly, the overall cleanliness of the premises was unacceptable. The dining area appeared poorly maintained, and basic hygiene standards were clearly not observed. The environment did not reflect the minimum level of sanitation required for a food establishment operating under Malaysian health regulations.

Secondly, the staff demonstrated unprofessional and disrespectful behavior. There was a lack of proper customer service and accountability when errors occurred. The food was served in the wrong order, causing unnecessary inconvenience, and no immediate corrective action or sincere apology was provided.

More alarmingly, I observed food handling practices that appeared unhygienic and potentially unsafe. Such negligence poses a direct risk to public health and should not be taken lightly. Food establishments have a legal and moral responsibility to ensure safe food preparation and handling at all times.

As a paying customer, I am deeply disappointed and concerned. This experience was not merely unpleasant — it was unacceptable and potentially hazardous.

I respectfully urge Kementerian Kesihatan Malaysia (KKM) to conduct an immediate inspection and take strict enforcement action if any violations of health and safety regulations are found. Public health must be prioritized, and establishments that fail to meet required standards should be held accountable.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this serious matter.
author: Vincent Purushothaman (Xen)

review_text:
1st visit here.
Nice nasi kandar...

Food tastes good.
Price normal..ok

Been here many may times.
Service here also good.
Many tables sitting.

Revisited many times for food here.
author: Jefry Liew

review_text:
Great place to have breakfast if you’re in Pelangi area.
The roti was made to order when we were there.
Teh was good.
Thank you.
author: Iskandar Abdul Kadir (Mr_ISK)

review_text: slow service. a restaurant without menu?? honestly this place needs to be checked by Johor’s government. food was not worth the price and cost a lot.
author: eizzman rosman

review_text:
Had the
- potato brinjal dish - delicious
- tofu pork belly dish (so good! Got mala essence!)
- steamed fish - very fresh and good
- sweet sour fried pork chop - crispy and delicious.

This shop is a hidden gem. We will definitely visit again to try their other dishes
author: Avril Yap

review_text: Portion is big and worth the price. Service is good. The dishes are good, except for dumplings... their meat is not chopped but blended too finely.
author: Clarissa Lee

review_text:
La zi ji 5/5
Fried cabbage 5/5
Stir fried beef w onion 3.5/5
The potion is very big value for the price.
author: ST

review_text:
The taste is really good, surprisingly good 👍 We're so impressed by the authenticity of the taste, because my colleague is from Dong Bei China. And verified by his taste buds ha ha ha

We went on Tuesdays which is another huge mistake, as there's a night market in front of it with terrible congested traffic
author: Simon Kam

review_text:
Our first time here and we love every dishes we ordered. Food were tasty and delicious. We will be back to try other dishes in the menu.

Steam chicken was tender, pickled vege pork belly potato noodle soup was appetising, bean curd was served cold and refreshing and eggplant dish was soft and tasty.
author: Carel Neo

review_text:
Thought dropped by with family to try some signature food.
Disappointed with the touted-crab meat soup. The taste is just ok for the meat ball. The soup is almost like plain water, very thin taste.
Service is average. Asked for cut chilli padi from the girl. I think she doesn’t understand or they don’t have them. She just left in a hurry. Either way, don’t think it’s impressive.
Atmosphere is simple and ok.
author: Louis Chua

review_text: very delicious soup and mee hoon. wanted local chinese dishes and this place is a gem with the wholesome soups and homecook style food which is not salty or oily. very sincere and friendly service too. environment is clean and air-conditioned.
author: MS Tan

review_text:
Recommended by our hair stylist director nearby this area as well. Can tell by the picture alot of locals come here. Many would order their crabmeat soup! First time trying and I would say is definitely interesting. Inside is filled with pork.

Ordered fried bee hoon, fried rice and pork tendon. Every dish is up to par ✨👍🏻
author: Carmen Phuah

review_text: The owner said this place has been around for 30+ years. Tried a few of their signature dishes — honestly just okay for me. Teochew-style food is usually on the mild side, but it does have its own charm. Still worth a try! (Total: RM120+)
author: Christy C

review_text:
Saw few reviews abt wok hei, but the bee hoon we tried do not have, disappointed.
The crab bowl although nice, crab flavour was absent.  The rest of dishes we tried were average.  Surprisingly yummy was the vegetable.
author: Jaws Lee

review_text: It's not the same as Indian Briyani. It's a traditional Malay Briyani. The meal is excellent. The Beriani rice is fragrant, and the recipes are delicious. My favourite dishes are their ayam merah and kambing, which were both delicious!!! They also offer complimentary acar, curry, and papadom. However, in comparison to the other briani place we visited, the piece is rather modest. They serve the Briyani in glass plate which remind me of my childhood.
author: Rajindran Raja

review_text: Can come here for an authentic Malay nasi beryani as well as Laksa Johor which is rare to find in Johor.
author: L MK

review_text: Had opportunity to visit here and very pleasant experience. As today public holiday, can expect big crowd but we get our food really fast. The waiter really helpful in ensuring all get their table and seat. The beriani kambing really tasty even much better than renowned restaurant in Batu Pahat
author: Abdul Razak Abdul Halik

review_text: Take away chicken and lamb beriyanyi. Unhappy because the lamb is almost all bone. Scrapped whatever is on the bone only a tablespoonful  of meat is left. The rice looks very plain with some colouring and hardly any spices was used. Gravy oily and very sweet.
author: Lim Ti Ngoo

review_text: I like the taste of nasi beriani here. The beriani they serve are Malay style beriani which I’d like a lot. But, it’s kinda overpriced for the small portions. One more thing I like here are the kuah and acar sayur. They taste right on the spot. This restaurant are usually crowded during lunch hour. So you better come at the right time. Their services are fast and good. They always keep the restaurant clean and organized. I would recommend this restaurant guys!!
author: Hamiza Ali

review_text: First time trying out this Italian restaurant. We had the set which was very reasonably priced. The spaghetti was al dente , flavorful and the beef steak was nicely done . Overall will recommend and we’ll be back.
author: Ariel Chia

review_text:
Chanced upon this place and decided to try - super glad I did!

Lunch deal was extremely value for money, food served tasted amazing as well! Loved everything from the our three course meal, especially our mains - carbonara and angus steak~

Tiramisu is one of the better ones I have tasted as well!!

A real hidden gem. Server was lovely and willing to accommodate to my special request in terms of food.
author: hej ale

review_text:
Didnt eat italian food for some time so decided to look for some. Came across this place and the reviews all recommended the lunch course so had to try.
Came post christmas, so the place was decorated very nicely.
Was the only customer at around 12pm.
Ordered the 3 course set.
They actually cooked the food in a fireplace, so looks authentic.
As it was chritmas time they had turkey, so had to try.
Food was just okay, not super fantastic.
Servers were kinda cold, maybe not in the mood because post christmas?
After paying and walking back to the car, walked past a shop a few lots away called Sweetwater. The course menu was almost identical to this restaurant, even the heading and font. Guess they are owned by the same parent company.
author: Kim Guan

review_text: Would preferred the lamb shank sauce to be thicker. Pasta was normal tasting. There were gaps between the dishes. Food finished but had to wait for the next dish to come out. Need to improve on this.
author: Reymond Yeo

review_text: Mushrooms soup super expensive at rm28 and taste below average. we ordered first and they serverd 10 tables of customers((not pre-reververed)) who came in after me. They serve big orders first ,unless you order a lot.
author: Francis Chew

review_text: Very good location store, highly visible from the main road that you can't miss. The car park is an inner lane which require you to drive past the residential behind to reach. The store layout is typical like their other stores. We love their 肉干 for years. They have pork and also chicken. Pricey but delicious. Personally prefer the pork one (not slice pork) as the meat is more tender.
author: EveC

review_text:
Easy to find at Taman Sentosa. Visited during CNY.  No trying.
It’s been a long time we haven’t bought Oloiya bakkwa. We find the taste has changed. A tad too salty. Maybe it’s CNY or recipe has changed over the years.
author: Yvonne Q

review_text: A lot of online KOL sang praises of Oloiya, even Steady Gang had a collaboration with them and recommended their bak kwa. Unfortunately, what I had was not up to what had been highly recommended. It was hard and the taste was really not as good compared to those of the traditional bak kwa.
author: Agnatta Teng

review_text: The Pandan puff is amazing, soft pillowy pastry with custardy moody sweeten but flavourful Pandan filling. Goes well with coffee and tea, surprise find, a humble shop in sentosa. Definitely worth buying
author: Star Carter

review_text: Suddenly craving for bak gua 😍 boss is nice. Explain with diff type of bak gua here , can buy one piece or per kg 👍👍👍 they have diff packaging to bring in sg too , very nice 👍👍
author: blue whale

review_text: A must foodie pit stop (closed on Mondays) when you’re in JB. It’s been around for years having its roots opposite The Store from its humble beginnings. I’ve been following them closely to 20 years. If I’m not mistaken … they now own the current premises. Pricey at first but when you know what you are getting… it’s worth it.
author: Captures Immortal

review_text: Awesome fish noodle, never miss a chance to get a bowl if I'm ever in town. The soup is super flavorful, noodles always cooked perfectly, the dry noodle sauce mix especially with the chili is divine. Been patronizing since 2016 and even a decade later the standard still holds, easy 5 stars and s strong recommend!!
author: Jun

review_text:
Very nice and comfy place to dine in clean and bright unlike some other eateries in JB.

Soup is really good and I like that it is mildly flavoured infused with natural flavours of the ocean nothing much you should be adding here. Kuay teow is also smooth and tasty.

fish cake is nice too, light crisp outside and warm inside very soft and smooth no clumps

Overall prices are very reasonable we paid $57 overall of a very satisfying meal.
author: Jack

review_text:
A very popular noodle place in JB. You can choose the soup or dry noodle version. Many different choices for the ingredients which are fresh. The pig kidney has slight smell but still acceptable.
Service is very fast.
author: Jacob TAN

review_text: Nostalgic taste, the kway teow soup is really light in taste, not much salt and msg just plain old kway teow and soup. The dry version is abit on the sweet side. Super crowded on a Sunday noon, have to wait for a table but the crowd clears fast.
author: Derrick L

restaurant_name: Chez Papa • French Bistro & Wine Bar
review_text: Came in on Valentine’s Day and even though the restaurant was busy the food and service were so good! My dad is not a big French food person but even he really enjoyed the meal. Must get the tiramisu, wagyu ribeye, lamb ribs and crab bisque.
author: Clarabelle Tan

restaurant_name: Chez Papa • French Bistro & Wine Bar
review_text:
(Delayed review)

We visited the restaurant in mid Oct, but it would be a miss to not leave a review!

I can't recall the exact names of the dishes anymore, but we remembered the awesome food and service. The octopus salad, sea bass risotto and crepe desert deserves a special mention, the restaurant should definitely consider putting them on the fixed menu!

The service staff observed that we were celebrating a birthday and offered a complimentary desert and cocktail.

10/10 would visit again for a special event when we're around the area.
author: Oel Nil

restaurant_name: Chez Papa • French Bistro & Wine Bar
review_text:
Located along Jalan Tebrau, JB.

Its along a row of shop houses and smaller hotels.

Serves French food, which was quite delicious.
Started with Onion Soup - nicely cooked and balanced in tastes.
We had their Lamb, which was cooked nicely, soft and tender.
Their Fish came with frangrant rice, topped with a nice sauce.
We had 3 Shrimp dishes.
Appetiser was simple Shrimp with sauce.
Their BBQ Shrimps were fresh, juicy and nice - i recommend !!!
A mixed seafood with cheese completed the shrimps list.
They serve a nice variety of wines ... we had the Malbec, which was reasonably priced and went well with the food.
A cosy place for couples,  families and groups.
Staffs were very helpful and attentive.
author: Perry Pacific

restaurant_name: Chez Papa • French Bistro & Wine Bar
review_text:
Really attentive service. Food was good and like the choice of the day!

They forgotten one of our orders but gave us 2 complimentary desserts ;)

Chicken Cordon Bleu was a bit too dry and hard.
author: Thammy Chong

restaurant_name: Chez Papa • French Bistro & Wine Bar
review_text:
Was impressed with the decor, ambience and service of Chez Papa. Food is definitely above 5 stars!

Don’t think I can have French onion soup at other place ever again! Other dishes ordered were equally good too! Really enjoyed my time here.
author: Zhaorong Long

review_text:
Discovered another shop in Sentosa and able to temporarily park car near shop to do the CNY promo purchase. The staff at cashier is friendly & helpful, so brought two sets. Now it’s frozen packs in a free cooler bag so for next visit to show cooler bag & they give 5% off standard price item.

Now I have two options places to buy and  may not drive & park at mid-valley southkey just to buy B.O.D only.

Join their free membership this time and purchase with above RM150 can redeem RM5 off non-promotional items but valid one month.
author: Thomas Saw

review_text: The bao here is soft, fluffy, and freshly steamed — absolutely delicious! The filling is flavorful and well-seasoned, with just the right balance between the bun and the stuffing. You can really taste the freshness in every bite. The seller is friendly, the service is quick, and the price is very reasonable for the quality. A perfect snack any time of the day — highly recommended!
author: Bunni Chai

review_text:
The food is great. I tried a bunch of menu, and they’re good. Some are different than what I usually had, but in a good way.
The staffs are very helpful, kind, and professional.
Recommend to try 👍
author: Crystalwing Bakaboe

review_text: A small shop located slightly of Sentosa Plaza. The buns are delicious and value for money. The Char Siew bun has a smokey BBQ flavour 👍. You can view the making process through the glass panel.
author: peter liew

review_text: Our family loves the har kow and gongfu bao, chive dumplings are great as well. The rice dumplings are a great buy during this time as well as they cost twice as much back home
author: L Luo

review_text: This restaurant is perfect for anyone who enjoys unlimited Korean BBQ and hotpot. The 2 hour all you can eat deal offers great value with a wide selection of meats and fried items. The ginseng abalone soup is highly recommended for its rich and naturally sweet flavor. The environment is calm and comfortable, making it an excellent choice for group dining.
author: Joey Hoong

review_text: You can enjoy both Korean BBQ and hotpot for one price! The BBQ meat selection is great, lots of choices, plus fish and various seafood are all included in the regular set. You also get 2 hours of all-you-can-eat. If you want sliced beef, go for the Superior set, it even includes oysters
author: yu wen

review_text: Aung was very helpful and provide excellent service. I really appreciate him checking with us so that we are eligible for the promotions - checking if any of us has his/her birthday 🎂 this month. Meat cuts are good, and well marinated. Free flow drinks and ice cream which the kids enjoy.
author: Steph

review_text: I’m giving Seoul Garden at KSL a full 5 stars, mainly because of their excellent service. We arrived a little late for dinner, with only about an hour until closing, and noticed that some of the food items were no longer available. Despite the late hour, the staff went out of their way to prepare fresh items for us. It was really considerate and made us feel valued as customers. The food itself was good, and the attentive service made the experience even better. Highly recommend if you’re looking for great service and a nice meal!
author: G A

review_text: The buffet spread at Seoul Garden is really impressive, with fresh meats and seafood that taste great whether grilled or in the hotpot. Perfect place to enjoy both BBQ and steamboat in one meal👍🏻
author: jenny

review_text:
So glad they recently revamped their restaurant because it was initially quite dark and had a lot of pillars. Now it looks so much better, brighter and well decorated and their BBQ meat sets are affordable with lots of good side dishes. It’s a good and reliable restaurant around the area and the seafood pancake also stands out! 👍🏻

No need to cook the meats as they are cooked for you and brought out, pork belly is decent, marinated ones are better. Ssamjang also pretty good. Friendly cashier service
author: Jo C

review_text: The food is not too bad. I like their seafood pancake. Prices are reasonable, especially the set lunches and service is prompt and friendly. The place is clean and tidy too, not awful smell like some Korean restaurants.
author: Rex Tan

review_text: Had a delightful dinner at this Korean restaurant tonight. The menu was full of tempting options. I may have gone a little overboard, but no regrets at all! Every dish, including the complimentary side dishes, was absolutely delicious. Portions were generous, and to top it off, the owner surprised us with a sweet prata filled with brown sugar at the end. So satisfying. The restaurant is spacious, making it a comfortable spot for conversation. Service was excellent. Easily one of the best Korean dining experiences I’ve had in JB.
author: Austin Ang

review_text: Went on friday lunch, first customers. The lunch set menu is cheap and good. Got some side dishes and seaweed soup. Fried chicken the size a bit small tho.
author: Javier Joe

review_text: My wife and I were here this evening for dinner at this IMO most excellent Korean restaurant in Johor Bahru. It was my first time here, but my wife has been here before and persuaded me to try it this evening - and boy, was I glad that she convinced me to do so. We ordered the following: a Pork Kimchi Stew (with a bowl of rice), a Kimchi Pancake, and a Korean Cold Soba Noodle. However before our order arrived, we were served the widest variety of banchan that I have ever encountered in Johor Bahru (see photo) and each banchan was very good. As for the mains, all of them were very good - but I would like to add that the Korean Cold Soba Noodle was the best that I have ever had, and I am no stranger to this dish, which I eat fairly regularly. The Korean Cold Soba Noodle here was very flavourful and came with a lot of garnishment that enhanced the flavour even more. Service here was very good - very attentive and very friendly. The dining ambience here was excellent - the seating here was very spacious and in air-conditioned comfort. I highly recommend this place if you are looking for the most excellent Korean food in Johor Bahru.
author: edtayjb

review_text: Had a wonderful dinner here. The burrata pizza was excellent with a creamy center and well-balanced flavors. The tomato burrata salad was fresh and light, perfect as a starter. We also tried the risotto, which was rich and comforting with a smooth texture. Overall a very satisfying dining experience. Would definitely come back again.
author: Elynn Wong

review_text: Have been coming to this restaurant for many many years now. Introduced this place to many friends as well. Their beautiful lady boss is very nice, attentive and friendly. Their food is truly delicious, the price is reasonable, the staff are exceptionally friendly, and they have a great variety of food choices. Today me and my friend came and enjoyed 6 dishes, totally contented with the amazing food. Everytime i try something new from their menu, so far i love all the food that i have tasted. Will always come here again and again. Highly recommended if you enjoy good food, good wine and a great ambience.
author: 涴之Grace

review_text:
Rosmarino JB is an Italian restaurant in Johor Bahru that offers a well-rounded dine-in experience, especially for special occasions. I visited during the Christmas period and chose the Christmas menu, which provided a good opportunity to experience the restaurant beyond its regular offerings.

The overall dining experience was comfortable and relaxed, making it suitable for a festive meal without feeling overly formal. The restaurant maintained a pleasant atmosphere, and the pace of service allowed the meal to be enjoyed without feeling rushed, which is important for a sit-down holiday dinner.

Food quality was the main highlight. The pizza was particularly enjoyable, with a well-balanced crust and toppings that did not feel overly heavy. The flavors were clear and satisfying, making it easy to appreciate each component rather than being dominated by cheese or sauce. The risotto also stood out, with a good texture and depth of flavor. It was cooked properly, neither too dry nor overly rich, which showed attention to technique rather than just presentation.

Pricing is on the slightly premium side compared to casual Italian restaurants in JB. However, considering the quality of the ingredients, the execution of the dishes, and the overall dining experience, the price felt justified. It is not an everyday dining option, but it works well for occasions where food quality matters more than budget.

Overall, Rosmarino JB is a solid Italian restaurant in Johor Bahru, especially for dine-in meals and seasonal menus. It is a good choice for those looking for well-prepared Italian food and a comfortable setting, and for diners who are willing to pay a bit more for quality that feels worth it.
author: Yuki Takei

review_text:
Prolly one of the best italian food i had in malaysia. I personally went italy before and i’d say the quality here beats most of the authentic one in italy.

Now the bad side.. i was only given an hour for a table. Because i initially only able to booked a bar table. But they gave me a table with one hour, thats fine but kinda rush.

And be sure to call and make a reservation, they are very hard to book….. and bo whatsapp or online method. Only accept local calls.
author: Wesley Wong

review_text: We chanced upon this Italian restaurant at dinner time and were attracted to see that it was almost full house. Gave it a chance and never regretted it. Very quality lobster bisque and pasta. We ordered the T-Bone, decent, but I’ve had better. So when I come back again, I will come for the pasta and pizza. Oysters were absolutely fresh and big. They were awesome
author: Jasmin Low

review_text: Had a lovely dinner here! The chilli crab was slightly sweeter than spicy, but still very enjoyable. The staff were friendly and attentive, and they kindly recommended portion sizes to help us avoid over-ordering and food wastage, which we really appreciated. Great service and pleasant dining experience overall. Will definitely visit again!
author: Candice Neo

review_text:
Came as a group with reservations and a private room was allocated to us. We had pre-ordered the food and they even printed the ordered menu. Food took some time to come for the first dish as the restaurant was packed. All the food were good. I love the steamed sea bass and the kampong chicken of all the dishes. The braised pig trotters were not soft enough though.
Complimentary serving of pineapple and water melon. Service is quick and friendly.
Parking is a problem here.
author: Jacob TAN

review_text: We are lucky to have a parking lot right in front of the shop on Saturday evening. Not too crowded when we reached there before 6pm. Service is good, patience in explaining each dishes. Ordered sharkfin soup, creamy and have real crab meat, kampung chicken is smooth and tender, toufu is soft, and asam prawn taste good, sour and strong. Their portion is a bit small though.
author: Xplorer SEA

review_text: Seafood restaurant with a long history serving great seafood around the Taman Sentosa area. We tried the pig stomach soup, char kway tail, drunken prawn, deep fried soon hock which were very good. Price is very reasonable but be sure to book a table in advance to avoid disappointment.
author: Chong Peng How

review_text: Limited space for parking lot and the service is always rushing. Before finished eating, the staff will come and want to keep the dishes plates. Food wise, taste so-so. The Assam prawn too sourish. The only up side is there is air-conditioned area in the restaurant.
author: Sky K

restaurant_name: 徐師傅Master Hsu Taiwan Restaurant HQ
review_text: Spacious Taiwanese restaurant with a welcoming vibe. The boss is super friendly, and the staff are attentive, which makes the whole experience feel personal. The food has that authentic Taiwanese taste comforting and flavorful. Honestly, Taiwanese cuisine rarely disappoints, and this place keeps that streak going strong.
author: Austin Ang

restaurant_name: 徐師傅Master Hsu Taiwan Restaurant HQ
review_text: It was me and my bf first time trying this place, and the food was a bit pricey. The flower tea hotpot wasn't particularly special, and didn't have the floral tea flavor I'd expected. It's not worth trying. The environment was nice, and the waiter was very attentive and helpful. He was always attentive and asked if the food was okay.
author: Kee Qian han

restaurant_name: 徐師傅Master Hsu Taiwan Restaurant HQ
review_text: Very authentic and pricing is reasonable will come back again esp the fried 🐔 chicken is must order 😋💪💯
author: Desmond Ho

restaurant_name: 徐師傅Master Hsu Taiwan Restaurant HQ
review_text: Cosy little spot serving Taiwanese food. Ordered the individual hotpot set — came with rice, cabbage, egg, and a pudding for dessert. Portion was decent and price quite reasonable. Taste-wise, it was just okay, nothing too special but still comforting if you're craving a simple meal. Wouldn’t go out of the way for it, but it’s a decent choice if you’re nearby. Overall, I’d give it 3.5 stars, rounding up to 4 for the nice ambience and value-for-money set meal.
author: Wei

restaurant_name: 徐師傅Master Hsu Taiwan Restaurant HQ
review_text: The food was decent, but the side dishes were a letdown. They served pudding as an appetizer, which was an unusual choice, and the taste was just average. However, the service made up for it—the staff was very attentive and provided a pleasant dining experience.
author: August Yang

review_text: Had a wonderful lunch at sweet water. Adil was super approachable and friendly. Chatted a while and I find that he is dedicated to his work. Constantly checking with us on our food. Great place and staff.
author: James Quah

review_text: The food here was a disappointment wasn’t too bad but the pizza was too hard to chew the ingredients were great tho, love their duck breast wasn’t too salty and the black olive were high quality. the boss and the waiter were all very polite which was super great. The tomato sauce spaghetti was good tho, the chicken was tender and juicy and the spaghetti wasn’t too oily, the sauce were flavoured well wasn’t too salty just classic. The lentil soup was great too, contains onion, carrots, black pepper, parsley and more which was delicious. The salmon salad was a big disappointment tho, the salmon wasn’t grilled well enough, a lot of scorch, the price was decent because of set lunch. The appetiser bread was also too hard like a stone, their vinegar was normal too.
author: xaxxolonch

review_text:
We were there for a private event and the food was nice, especially the beef rib eye. It was cooked nicely and tender.

The cheesecake was flavourful and light.
author: Alex Lao

review_text:
Afternoon lunch set meal is very very reasonable. Come with a live musician which makes the atmosphere even better.

Food is good, Best of the food I've ordered for this visit is fish steak.

Will recommend people to come.
author: zheng jie wang

review_text: The service was exceptional, staff were attentive and friendly. Food was quite good, decent flavours with generous portions. Overall it is a good experience dining here and definitely worth a visit.
author: Jk. Wong

restaurant_name: Restoran Ah Kaw 亚九咖喱鱼头店
review_text:
Good food.
Must order the fried bee Hoon, fishball soup and also the four seasons beans.

Especially the fishball soup, this is a childhood fave dish and hard to find authentic 1s nowadays.

Old style restaurant vibes.

Not a fancy cafe which r literally everywhere
author: Kay

restaurant_name: Restoran Ah Kaw 亚九咖喱鱼头店
review_text: Good tasting food. No AC. Might get a little hot. Curry fish head and prawn paste chicken very nice. Fried bee hoon too.
author: Elaine Tan

restaurant_name: Restoran Ah Kaw 亚九咖喱鱼头店
review_text: As far as a Malaysian local eating place goes, this one should be considered as one of the top places.  The price is very reasonable and the foods, of local dishes, is absolutely good.  I love the homemade fish balls soup.  The fish balls texture is very good and can bounce off the floor by almost one foot high!  The service is unpretentious; you get what you see.
author: Hui Lim

restaurant_name: Restoran Ah Kaw 亚九咖喱鱼头店
review_text:
My food rating guide:
2.5/5 ‐-------> Average taste
5/5 ‐--------> Scrumptious! (My comfort food! 🤩)

San low mee hoon was nice. Distinctive wok hey smell and taste. Texture was near to mee sua. Taste was good. The sambal chilli was great! It complemented well with the mee hoon and alleviated its taste. Nice sweet prawn.

Curry asam fish head was excellent! Fresh and soft tender fish head meat. The curry and asam mix was great. Thick creamy curry with mild asam tatse. The french bean, brinjal, lady finger and cabbage were fresh and soft.

The ice jelly drink was nice. Not too sweet. Low-high sourness.

The meal was a 4.6/5
author: Ray Sim

restaurant_name: Restoran Ah Kaw 亚九咖喱鱼头店
review_text: Decently priced food, jovial owner and the fried bihun is somewhat different hidden in a old style shop which just brings back old school memories. Simple dishes and nothing pretentious.
author: Mark Lee

review_text:
Had a wonderful experience at Grill Bar Steakhouse! The food was fantastic. Ordered the filet mignon and it was so juicy and tender. Loved the vegetables they came with. All so fresh. My wife had the salmon and it was so delicious too! I loved that the waiter/waitresses listened and paid attention to our order. The lobster bisque was really flavourful! It wasn’t too thick or thin, just nice! Chocolate Lava was melt in your mouth. Mmmmmm…. lol

One small thing I didn’t like was that there was no ice/warm water served. They only had still/sparkling which you had to pay for. The meal was already quite expensive, so I felt that they could just provide water. But the waitress was really nice and offered us a free tea instead, which I really appreciated. Oh, and they gave a free Cauliflower appetiser too! Yum yum!

Service, food and atmosphere here was excellent! I would highly recommend and I’ll definitely be back again! One of my best meal experiences in JB!
author: Ed Chua

review_text: This restaurant, situated just beside a noodle shop in the middle of a row if shop house in pelangi,  is good. Price wise is expensive, our bill come up to 700 for 2 dishes and 3 drinks. However, the portion is huge and we are over stuffed for our stomach. Beef is awesome.
author: kancilpl888 Jason Chang

review_text:
Great atmosphere n service + steak.
Lava cake n ice cream was delicious!
Good for sharing or those with good appetite can go for single 8oz.
author: Juliana Tan

review_text:
Really great find here in JB. Had their organic steak at medium rare, definitely seared to exactly the doneness I asked for! Slightly saltier in seasoning than I'm used to but definitely a great steak. The sides tasted great too and complement the steak.

I also had the lobster bisque, which was rich and flavourful, and had real lobster meat inside.

In all, a strong recommend but note the SG level prices charged here! 😆
author: Yi Jun Kwok

review_text: Other than the prices, this is a very enjoyable and great spot for steak and grill. The servers were very hospitable, offering complementary services and dishes and considerate for my liking, diet and allergies. Great mood and atmosphere for dates and any family occasions. Would come again.
author: Khairuddin Hussein

restaurant_name: Kinnokura Izakaya Japanese Restaurant 金の藏居酒屋
review_text:
I have not been to too many Japanese restaurants here in JB just because I don't think there is any good one here, although there are many.  However, Kinnokura Izakaya surprised me!  I rate it as among the top Japanese restaurant here, especially for an Izakaya.
Good quality ingredients for Japanese foods are not cheap, but this restaurant has managed to maintain the menu at reasonable prices.  I guess the owner works hard on it.  The house-sake is only RM38 for 300ml, nice!  Well done!
As far as the foods is concerned, they are presented well.  The tastes and textures of the foods are better than a lot of other places, here or anywhere else, definitely amongst the best for JB.
The service is excellent.  I like restaurant services to be unintrusive and this one nailed it.  Top job!
The best part of this restaurant, I find, is the decor.  The owner must have taken a lot of time and efforts to source all of them.  I did not expect such an authentic Izakaya decor here.  You could have mistaken where you are once you entered.
This restaurant has been in operation since 2014, so, through the Covid years.  The owner must be hard working to keep this place going through all the hard times.
I thank my old friend for recommending this place to me.  Now I can recommend this restaurant to everyone I meet.
We need more of this kind of restaurants here in Malaysia.

review_text:
This is my first time coming to this particular Mamak stall after living in Johor Bahru for so many years. I decided to give it a try because one day, when I passed by, the atmosphere and environment caught my attention. So, on this day, I came here and ordered a plate of white rice, an onion fried chicken, two vegetable dishes, and one Teh’O Limao Ais. I estimated it would cost around RM15, but when I paid, the total came to RM17.50.

I then asked the cashier very seriously, "How did you calculate this RM17.50? I really want to know." When he explained the price of each item, he paused and thought before saying each one: the chicken was RM6.50, the vegetables RM2.00 each, the rice RM2.00, and the drink RM3.00. I pointed out, "This doesn’t add up to RM17.50... Are you deliberately overcharging?" Even the amount he mentioned, RM15.50, seemed unreasonably expensive to me, but I decided to let it go.

So, here I am simply sharing my personal experience with everyone. I hope that when you come here and order their food, you will be cautious and avoid being unfairly overcharged by such unethical practices. Thank you.

restaurant_name: Kian Huat Chicken Rice 怡保仔燒雞飯咖啡店
review_text:
Kian Huat is a no frills, spartanly furnished coffee shop. Although the Chinese signboard at the stall indicated ‘怡保仔燒雞飯’ (Roasted Chicken Rice), it sells a variety of meat such as Char Siew (Chinese BBQ Pork) and Siew Yoke (Crispy Pork Belly). The stall is manned by a group of Vietnamese staff, though its owner is a Malaysian Chinese.

I had arrived late at 10 mins to its 1pm closing time. Regretfully, its popular Char Siew and Fried Chicken were sold out. As such, I can only content myself with the Roasted Chicken Rice. The meat was tender and had a slight natural chicken sweetness. I like the taste of the browned skin as it was savoury sweet and aromatic. The rice was tenderly firm, nutty, savoury and neither overly greasy nor wet.

A plate of Chicken Rice costs RM6.50. Like other reviewers had mentioned, do order the Ice Kopi from the drinks stall which costs RM2.90. It has a distinct smokey flavour, which I assumed to be brewed from Vietnamese Coffee Beans.

Don't come here expecting to get your socks blown off. It's just a place where people come in for an affordable, yet tasty Chicken Rice. I enjoyed my plate of Chicken Rice here and would love to return for their Char Siew and Fried Chicken.

review_text:
Lovely and comfortable restaurant setting, as compared to the competition which is a kelong setting, a few streets down. This is well appreciated as you are served restaurant-style, and there is no need to queue, bid and plea for seafood to be sold to you by rude vendors. We also appreciated the automated fly swatters on the table, despite the air conditioning already making things very comfortable.

There were lots of promotions going on, and we went for the Alaskan king crab promotion, rather than the lobster or mud crabs that had equally good deals.

We were invited to the aquarium area which was well kept and clean, to view the 2.7kg crab that we selected. We were recommended to try the crab in two different styles, which was refreshing!

The menu was extensive and there was something for everyone. This resulted in us over ordering, but that’s a happy problem.

Service was superb but also a little strange. We were served by an elderly aunty who has chosen her favourite in the family right from the start. She would only attend to her and the favouritism was a little too obvious. Nevertheless, all of us received great service from the entire team, and we received complementary prawn crackers as we were celebrating a birthday.

Overall a pleasant dinner!

review_text:
A Must-Try for Nasi Kandar Fans: Nasi Kandar Kota Lama

Nasi Kandar Kota Lama is a Johor Bahru institution, offering a fix of the classic Malaysian dish.

A No-Frills Feast:

Nasi Kandar Kota Lama prioritizes authentic flavors over fancy ambiance. Expect a traditional setting, perfect for a casual and satisfying meal.

Variety Galore:

One of the highlights is the extensive selection of lauk (side dishes) displayed in large pots. From spicy curries and crispy fried chicken to fresh vegetables and aromatic stews, there's something for every taste bud.

Build Your Own Plate:

Choose your favorite lauk to be served on steaming white rice, creating your own personalized nasi kandar experience. Don't forget to add a fried egg or some sambal (chili paste) for an extra kick!

Value for Money:

Nasi Kandar Kota Lama is known for its reasonable prices, making it a great option for a budget-friendly yet delicious meal.

Overall:

Nasi Kandar Kota Lama is a great choice for those looking for an authentic and affordable nasi kandar experience in Johor Bahru. While the setting might be basic, the delicious food and variety of lauk make it a must-try for any foodie.

Here’s a warm, natural-sounding review you can use:

⸻

On a rainy Sunday, I was looking for a comforting bowl of hot soup to warm up my body, and a friend recommended this old traditional restaurant. The moment we arrived, the place felt homely and full of nostalgic charm.

We ordered their signature Charcoal-fire Teochew Fish Head Steamboat, and it truly lived up to the recommendation. The fish soup was clear yet rich in flavour, naturally sweet and very tasteful—perfect for a cold, rainy day. You can really tell it’s been cooked with experience and care.

Besides that, we also tried vegetables and the mee hoon petai with chilli sambal sauce, which was a pleasant surprise. The sambal was fragrant with just the right kick, pairing beautifully with the mee hoon and petai.

Overall, it was a comforting and satisfying meal. A great place to enjoy traditional flavours, especially when you’re craving something warm and hearty on a rainy day.

Unfortunately, I recently encountered an issue with fuel contamination for their ron97 (water in the petrol) after refueling here on 20/5/25, which caused my car to break down almost immediately and require repairs. Thankfully, my mechanic was able to identify and document the problem, which we traced back to this station.

That said, I want to acknowledge that the station manager was very friendly and helpful. She assisted me in resolving and claiming back all the repairs related to this matter smoothly without much hassle, which I truly appreciate.

While I’m thankful for the support provided, I still feel it’s important to caution others to be extra careful when refueling here. I hope this was just an isolated incident and not a recurring issue.

If the management reading this review. I hope your restaurant would take action immediately. Because, your restaurant can be the best like the other nearest restaurant.
author: Johan M

restaurant_name: Nasi Lemak Berlauk Malam Indah Senibong
review_text: I have been quite a regular to this place but due to the pandemic, it has been a while that since I was last here. It appears that it has getting more run down by the day. As for the food, the nasi lemak here used to be one of the best in JB. But the recent trip was a little let down. Nevertheless, it is still a worthwhile trip here for the dinner. Best time to be here is about 6.30 pm. Then you get to wait for or having your dinner while enjoying the dawn by the seaside. The view can be idyllic and breathtaking. But don't just judge the place by the food alone. I have here many times, there are ups and down. Perhaps, due to the pandemic, the business has been badly affected. Hopefully, the owner will recover from here on and makes a better nasi lemak or at least as best as it used to be.
author: Chong Wei WONG

restaurant_name: Nasi Lemak Berlauk Malam Indah Senibong
review_text: The fried sotong is crispy but lacks flavor. Black pepper crab is more sweet than spicy. Cockles is tiny n overcooked. Sambal petai sting Ray is not bad but attract too many flies. The hands gets tired from chasing flies away. Also hv cats walking about. Totally unhygienic. Dirty and expensive. No next time.

review_text:
Coming here before departure from Johor.

Price is within standard range too, recommend.

review_text: The best shumai
author: CK Kim

review_text:
Fantastic place for gatherings. We have chosen to meet up at 6pm. We get to see sunset at the nice cove. Price was slightly higher than other drinking place.

Their dishes were all above average. We liked the trotter, sausage, chicken chop, lamb ribs and pizza.

During our weekday visit, it was 80% full. The service was slightly slow during the peak dinner time. Better service towards the latter of the night.
author: Lennox Cheok

review_text: The food here was normal and the price was high, the burger wasn’t what I expected but the cheesy stick was fried perfectly, crispy and cheesy. The drink was special too, it was sour yet not too sweet, refreshing. Love their pasta, fragrant and topped with perfect amount of fried garlic.
author: xaxxolonch

review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Harvests Bar & Grill, and it was an exceptional experience from start to finish! The ambiance is warm and inviting, perfect for a relaxed evening out or a celebration.

The menu offers a fantastic selection of dishes, and everything we tried was delicious. They also have an impressive range of cocktails, which were expertly crafted and a great complement to our meal.

The staff were attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable about the menu, which added to the overall experience. Service was prompt without feeling rushed, and the team made us feel right at home.

Whether you’re a local or just visiting Johor Bahru, I highly recommend Harvests Bar & Grill. It’s a perfect spot for quality food, great service, and a wonderful atmosphere. I’ll definitely be back!
author: Brian

review_text: This restaurant offers a delightful dining experience with its stunning waterfront views, creating an amazing atmosphere to enjoy a meal. The menu features standout dishes like the flavorful spaghetti with pasta sauce, and the mushroom platter provides a savory, earthy flavour.
author: Joey Lim

review_text:
One of the best Pork Knuckle I ever ate, worth the Price.
The Staff has also offered to cut the Knuckle & Sausages for ease of sharing.
Nice View.
Good venue for Family dining or Friends gathering/ drinking session.
author: MG (mingguan)

review_text: If you’re the one who wanna escape from the hectic environment, this is the place. The vibe of calm, relaxing while enjoying the food is really unmatched. The shiitake chicken chop is tender and delicious too.
author: Wan Safwan

review_text:
This is our first time here. We celebrated my mum's birthday. Relaxing atmosphere for dining, especially the outdoor area which overlooks the marina.

The cafe offers a mix of local and Western food. We have no complaints about the dishes we ordered - excellent food presentation (particularly the Briyani) and above average taste. My husband thoroughly enjoyed the Special Lamb Soup with Rice; meat was tender and flavourful broth which was not overly salty.

Definitely pleased with their service. Our cake was brought out with accompanying birthday song and they even played tambourines - mind you these were all male staff 😄👏

Thank you for making this a memorable birthday celebration!
author: Alanna

review_text:
Yew’s Café & Bistro – Scenic Spot with a Massive Menu

A Western-style restaurant that also offers a wide range of Malaysian local delights. If you enjoy dining with a view, the outdoor seating here is a great option—it offers a picturesque riverside scene, with houses lining both sides and yachts anchored nearby. The atmosphere is peaceful and romantic, making it ideal for a date.

However, the menu was overwhelming—a thick volume filled with too many options. Honestly, it gave me a bit of a headache. I would much prefer a concise page showcasing their best dishes.

The food was decent overall, and we’re open to coming back to try other items on the menu.
author: WanderWithWit

review_text: Very good customer service, and one of the stores that offers cooling aircon, good ambience to chill on a hot day by the sea. Friendly staff provide us more ice on a very hot afternoon. Drinks r nice.
author: ong MJ

review_text: I’m a big fan of steaks, but this one wasn’t great. I ordered medium rare, but what I got was closer to medium well—overcooked and too chewy, with barely any red left in the meat. It was also oddly served closer to room temperature, even though I ate it almost immediately after it was served. The greens on the side felt more decorative than meaningful. While it wasn’t the worst steak I’ve had, I can definitely think of many other places that do steak much better.
author: Darren Tee

review_text: Saturday 11am, the place was quite crowded. The fried vermicelli skin tasted okay, though the texture wasn’t to my liking. The siew mai was fresh and good. The steamed yam cake was too soft and can be skipped. The xiao long bao was nice when served hot, but the skin turned hard once it cooled (after leave it after 5 minutes). the restaurant’s prices are higher than average.
author: Ong NN

review_text:
What the best dim sum in JB I would say D'Shanghai. The taste of the food would be so close Hong Kong style cooking. If compare with Canton paradise or din tai feng this is hand down beat down to the two major restaurant.the staff are friendly would even explain the ingredients of the food and what is best to order . The wanton noodle is a must try overall it is nice but only issue is that to get there you need a car or grab down to location and lastly note this is not recommend to my Muslim friends since it not halal.

They serve your food very fast once you place your order
author: King Chemical

review_text:
Had breakfast here for a family gathering.

Most deep fried and steamed stuffs are average and passable. I personally think that the pork ribs were pretty ok.

What did not went well was the:

- Rice with chicken and Chinese sausage- the chicken was extremely salty
- Shanghai pan fried Bun - it's weird and hard to describe. If u have tried it personally in Shanghai, the buns here taste nothing like it, except bearing resemblance.
author: Stanley Pang

review_text:
Yummy dim sum in JB. Not a lot of choices for steam dim sum but all item served are very good quality.

虾饺 - Prawn dumpling is fresh and bouncy. Taste good by itself but I cant resist the very nice chili oil too.
松露小笼包 - Light truffle taste wrapping in minced pork with some kind of preserved vege. Hearty soup inside.
上海炒粉皮 - Version of stir fried radish cake but replaced radish cake with potato strip. Same wok hey, well seasoning, and the chewy texture of potato strip make it more interesting.
鸡丝粥 - The shop made version but a nice one.
宇角 - Crispy and not oily. Yam paste and meat filling matches well.
虾猪肠粉 - Nice soy sauce with smooth rice roll. Bouncy prawn.
烧卖 - Bouncy texture. Good taste

Tea choices are good too.
Highly recommended.
Food: 9.5/10, Price : RM 44 per pax
author: Eryn Ng

review_text: The shop atmosphere is pretty cozy, a bit ‘atas’ from local type. Dim sum to me is just so-so, we ordered a breakfast set that come with 4 dim sum: har kaur, siew mai, Xiao long bao and jiu chai gao.. and additional one prawn chong fen… a bit disappointed on the chong fen as the prawn seem overcooked and doesn’t taste so fresh.. Overall price is reasonable.
author: YL Chong

review_text:
I would like to provide some feedback regarding my recent order.
Firstly, the fries I received were excessively salty, most likely due to an overuse of salt. The saltiness was quite overwhelming and affected the overall taste.
In addition, I ordered a medium-sized hot chocolate, but I only received half a cup. Based on my observation, it seems that the staff may have overfilled the cup, causing excessive foam/bubbles to form, and then sealed the cup without allowing the foam to settle first. As a result, when I opened the lid to drink, the foam had settled and the actual drink content was only half a cup — as if I had received a small size instead of the medium I ordered.
I hope your team can look into this matter and take appropriate steps to improve, so that similar issues do not occur in the future.
Thank you.

author: Lo Teck Sin

restaurant_name: 褔記蘭花覇王鴨 Okid Barbecue House
review_text: Friendly service. Clean and tidy seating area (have indoor with aircon and outdoor). Despite me being a solo diner, the waiter directed me to the next available table (which could sit 8 persons). I appreciate this greatly. I ordered duck noodle with added meat. Roast pork was really good, skin to the correct crisp while balance on meat and fats, but the char sio was dry while duck was ok. The noodle texture was really al dente with a nice bite (I ordered the white type, they also have black sauced type). I enjoyed the bitter gourd with salted egg too. Overall good experience. Per the portion served, price on the higher side but flavour is good.
author: Little ES

restaurant_name: 褔記蘭花覇王鴨 Okid Barbecue House
review_text:
First time trying this duck restaurant and unfortunately it didn’t quite meet expectations. We ordered half a duck, but the portion was disappointing — mostly bones with very little meat, and strangely, no duck breast even though we specifically ordered half. The dipping sauce also had an odd taste that didn’t complement the duck well.

On the upside, the atmosphere was pleasant and the service was decent. The pricing is reasonable, but considering the portion and quality, it didn’t feel worth it. Not likely to return unless the portioning improves.
author: Charine S

restaurant_name: 褔記蘭花覇王鴨 Okid Barbecue House
review_text: The soup was firstly serve and complementary. I was really shock! It’s taste DAMN so good!! Just like those double boil standard. 😳. The Char siew was fat and lean! Roast pork skin crispy! The duck great too. Tofu is a must to order sia!!!  End up 3 adult not enough to eat. 🤣🤣… Fish taste special and veg taste great. I thro bitter gourd fry egg is good. But this is good too. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻 must come back again !!
author: LULU EVOX

review_text:
Came over for a "replacement" buffet, was pleasantly surprised.
Cost was pretty much what you'd expect for a hotel based buffet... Kids rates are reasonable.
Removed a full star as there was NO sashimi that day... It was the weekend dinner. So that was 1 down point.
River prawns and oysters were the highlight. The outdoor offering of grilled oysters and slipper lobster (or as some may call crayfish) was also not bad. The neat surprise was that they had DURIAN!! served and to be eaten only at the outdoor section, it was not too bad. However only the early birds to the thorny fruit would have had more options like the Musang King. The later lot was only just mediocre Durian which was in fact over-served. Wonder what they did with the leftovers. Desserts were a nice touch. Liked the offerings, and kids will definitely have a ball. Walnut cake was without a doubt a good thing to look out for. Teh Tarik on offer there was merely the packet type, not really authentic. Best to get your caffeine fix from the Nespresso machines. Cool thing available is that they give you a special cake and deco if it's your birthday. Wait staff will croon a loud song for you and promptly disperse! 😅😄

Will hope to return some time, possibly if they can confirm there will be sashimi!! 🐟🐳🦑
author: little blue penguin

review_text:
The buffet restaurant at the Renaissance Hotel is impressively spacious, offering a wide selection of dishes for its breakfast buffet. Guests can enjoy everything from classic Western options like eggs and pastries to hearty Indian dishes, flavorful Chinese items, and a variety of local Malay specialties. One of the standout features is the abundance of coffee stations, ensuring you won’t have to wait long for your morning cup.

During my weekend stay, the restaurant was very lively, with many families dining together. While this created a cheerful atmosphere, it also meant that the floor and buffet area occasionally became messy, which slightly affected the overall dining experience. On the positive side, the hotel makes a clear effort to cater to families—there was even a clown making balloon figures to entertain the kids, which kept them happy and added a playful touch to the morning.

Despite the busyness, the buffet experience was enjoyable overall. With its wide range of food options, family-friendly vibe, and attentive touches, the restaurant provides a satisfying start to the day for both hotel guests and visitors.
author: Wesley Wong

review_text:
Went there with my 2 buddy for a lunch buffet. A lot of varieties from seafood all the way to desserts.

The cost is RM 88 per pax.Food is made fresh. The sea bass steam fish was the star of the day said my buddies.

Staff was on point. They cleared the plates immediately when you are done. The place was clean too.

I didn't managed to take more photos as I was busy sampling all the food stations.

The only drawback is that the coffee was not good. Probably the coffee machine was not operational on that day.

Overall this cafe deserves your patronage. This cafe is within the Renaissance Hotel.
author: Lanz Jalal

review_text:
My wife and I were looking for a lunch buffet and decided to try this place for the first time. We were impressed by the wide spread of international dishes and found the price very affordable. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made our dining experience even better.

Thank you for the staff for " Happy Anniversary " complimentary.
author: Sazali Misri

review_text:

Oysters are fresh but not the top grade ones. Very sadly the sashimi was quite bad. The octopus slices are soggy so is the white fish and tuna. The only edible sashimi was salmon.

The cold crab legs are also ok.

Do try the bamboo mutton biryani.. it's good!

Fried durian roll dessert was crispy and tasty.

The fried big head riverhead prawn was a surprise.. not many buffet offers this .
author: Food lover

review_text: Love the food here! We tried the olive fried rice, fish porridge, butter kaya toast, cendol, jelly dessert & herbal chicken and rice😍 All the dishes were so tasty and flavourful😍 The gula melaka in the cendol was very fragrant and sweetness can be adjusted based up to you (served separately). Today, they accidentally included an extra pack of food in my order. I went to the outlet to pay for it, but the staff kindly informed me that it had already been settled by them. I felt bad for the staff member, but I really appreciated the honesty and professionalism shown.
I will always recommend this place for both the food and the wonderful service.
author: Dyna Nora

review_text:
I recently visited Tea Garden and had a pleasant dining experience. The atmosphere was cozy and comfortable, making it a nice spot to relax and enjoy a meal with friends or family.
The food was satisfying and well-portioned. Their local dishes have a nice homely taste, and the drinks selection is quite wide — especially their tea-based beverages, which are refreshing and nicely balanced in flavor. Service was fairly quick, and the staff were polite and attentive.
Overall, Tea Garden is a good place for casual dining, whether for breakfast, tea time, or dinner.

I celebrated my husband’s birthday here and it turned out to be an unforgettable evening! This was my second visit for a special occasion, and once again, Costa Beach Bistro exceeded my expectations.

The team was incredibly accommodating — they kindly arranged extra tables and chairs for my kids, making the evening comfortable for our family. The ambience was just perfect with a stunning sea view and beautiful fireworks lighting up the night.

What I love most is that they provide everything under one roof — from decoration, birthday cake, bouquet, and fireworks to capturing lovely videos to preserve our memories. Every detail was thoughtfully done.

Thank you, Costa Beach Bistro, for making our celebration so memorable! Highly recommended for anyone looking to celebrate a special occasion by the beach. 🌊🎂✨

Fresh, lip-smacking, and savory — everything you could ask for in good seafood. I brought my family here, and they all loved it.

The service was great too. Even though it was crowded, the waiters served us with a smile.

Honestly, I can’t think of anywhere else that serves seafood this good for dining in.
author: Hayalperest

review_text: Nice seafood n fresh crab,also got sambal very awesome,..bbq
author: Hafiz Zainal

review_text:
I've been here a few times. The first restaurant is good, the one with yellow chair or red table cover. Seafood was very fresh, and i was satisfied with what I paid.

The gerai no4 is totally suck. The squid is hard as tyre rubber. The butter prawn is too simple, like a normal fried prawn. I will not come again here. The price here also higher compared to gerai no1 or the first restaurant.
author: Ying-Noii

review_text:
Waiter/ waitress were helpful. Ordered their Ikan steam lemon, udang telur masin, sotong goreng tepung - they were really good. Except for their chili crab, was fresh, thick flesh but the chili paste or gravy was not so good - might be overwhelmed with the chili sauce and somehow the seasoning didn’t blend so well. Need to be improved I’d say.

Ambience wise was good. Came at 5pm and the crowd was manageable. Love that they got a lot of sinks as well.
author: nmusfirah iwani

review_text:
Wasted the fresh and good quality seafood with teribble cooking and taste. Please hire proper chef and someone whonis talented to cook seafood.
Went here on 20 November 2024.
Siakap Steam Limau - taste very teribble and  something very3x wrong. Not edible at all!!!
Siakap sweet hour- Tasteless sause taste.
Prawn butter - Overcook the big size prawn and no taste butter at all. Become dry and not buttery taste overfried butter look and taste like kriuk2 in mee sedap
Kupang sambal - tasteless sambal not spicey no garam no nothing
Sotong goreng tepung - ok vut tasteless butter
Kailan ikan masin - The Best winner, first i suspect we all one family have covid because all the meal tasteless.

Hardworking and friendly service but spoiled with the food taste. Dear towkey do something with your kitchen and chef!!!!
author: shah putel

review_text: My first visit was in 1990. Small seaside local restaurants offering seafood. Then, in 2014. And the recent visit, saw the atmosphere had much changed, much lively and Kg Senibong is probably one of the must visit venues for seafood lovers, looking at the crowd. Moderate price for seafood but depends on what you wish to eat. Ofcourse, king crab and lobster demand high prices but its up to your budget. We enjoyed our dinner 😃
author: Raziff Lokman

review_text:
Service was slow at first. A bigger group who arrived 10–15 minutes after us got their food earlier. But after we informed the staff, they quickly took action, served our table, and apologized. I appreciate that they admitted the mistake.

For the food, lala masak cili kering, the lala was not properly cleaned that I could see sand and some black dirt in the sambal, which ruined my appetite.

The sambal stingray tasted nice, but the fish was not fresh and the flesh was not sweet.

The fried squid was very tasty, but the portion was small. My husband even held back from taking more so I could enjoy it, since that was the only dish I really liked.

We paid RM100 for two people. It’s affordable, but not worth it for us because the seafood was not as fresh as expected. The staff mentioned that everything was fresh even if you choose from book menu, so no need to choose from the front, but we felt disappointed.
author: Dija

review_text:
Comparable to outdoor seafood eateries like Umbai and Muara Sg Duyong etc.

For me, its my first time here. And i found these suprising things in this restaurant:

1) So many customers in the restaurant but all the staffs and waiters are attentive and ready to assist me. This is during school holidays. This is rare since if u go to a full house restaurant, the service will be slow and it can be very hard to call for order. 5 🌟🎊😁.

2) Food came very fast eventhou with so many customers! Amazing and they r still well cooked.

3) Even while u r eating, a few staffs will drop by and ask you " ada order belum sampai?" ie. Any other orders you havent received yet? Amazing.

4) Fish and all other seafood are all fresh.

5) Despite the many customers, the staffs are still polite and friendly.

We have been at places where there were rude staffs especially when so many customers are sitting. Here the orders came reasonably fast.

Overalll, I'll come here again. Well done and keep it up! 👍🌟
author: Ismail Arifin

review_text:
Came here over 10 years ago, and I’m finally back again! The freshness is still amazing — especially the fish, prawns, chilli crab and black pepper crab. Definitely worth a try. Prices are very reasonable, roughly half of what you’d pay in Singapore. Big thumbs up for the freshness — from a Singaporean!
No aircon
author: Brandon Koh

review_text:
Seafood heaven and lovers shall try this restaurant and shall put in your bucket list.

We arrived early (before sunset - maghrib) as if you go after sunset (maghrib) it is packed and difficult to find parking. So you need to plan yourself.

The food is superb and the price is fairly reasonable. We have tried seafood at Melaka (don't have to mention the restaurant name here), but the freshness of the seafood (king crab, lobster, prawn, squid) is far better here! And the price is reasonably cheaper here than at Melaka.

We have king crab, sotong goreng tepung, lobster (our final menu as we decided last minute) and it is highly recommended and superb!

The view is amazing as well.

So enjoy yourself.

P/s: you can bargain the price with the owner! We did that!
author: Ir Rusman Abu Samah

review_text: It's good; the food isn't too strong in flavor, and it's worth a try.

review_text: It's located at Permas Jaya, hidden inside residential area. Another good choice for nice meal with big family.

Food not seasoned properly. The food topping was very little.  Salted egg no salted egg. When ask said never ask.. order was salted agg squid..  wouldn't recommend
