restaurant_name: Da Shun Restaurant 大顺菜馆
review_text: Food is consistently good. Food is zhichar or taichow type. Decor is simple and furnished in chinese coffee shop style but quite clean. Serving staff is ok, quite friendly.
author: Yut Kam Lock

review_text: The food was nothing special.
author: Hee Kok Ng

review_text: Came here on New Year’s Eve during dinner time and, despite the crowd, the atmosphere was great—lively and bustling in a good way. The weather was perfect, with a cool sea breeze that made the whole dining experience even more enjoyable. Food service was smoother than expected and didn’t take as long as some reviews had mentioned. The staff were friendly and welcoming, which added to the positive vibe. The food was tasty with decent portions, and the spacious surroundings made it a comfortable place to relax. A nice spot to chill with family or friends—my boys especially enjoyed walking around the area.
author: jianhao lee

review_text:
Visited on Sunday late afternoon. The place was quiet with only a few tables occupied, which was great for a relaxed, non-noisy meal. Service was exceptionally good, attentive and proactive. Nice waterfront view too, though there were some mosquitoes; staff placed mosquito coils, which helped.

We ordered garlic butter fried rice ($19), chawanmushi ($5.80), 7-pcs yakitori omakase ($30), raw oysters ($12.80), additional assorted skewers ($4.80–$5.80 each), and two draft beers. The food was good overall, with nice charcoal aroma and simple salt seasoning. Portions for some skewers, like bonjiri, felt a little small for the price.

The standout was the chicken liver skewer, creamy, smooth, slight bitterness, lightly seasoned to bring out its richness (not for everyone, but well done). Total bill came to about $136. Overall, a good experience and would recommend, especially if you prefer a quieter izakaya setting.
author: Melvin J.

review_text:
Ambience & environment was amazing - also very tranquil at night. Sea breeze was cooling, and the view of the strait was great.

Came on a Friday night around 9pm and it wasn’t crowded - maybe because it is also located sort of out of the way, rather inaccessible without a personal vehicle or via private hire.

Service was great and food was served pretty quickly - the platter was a little salty though and consisted more meat than greens. Oysters were very fresh but a little small in size. Large selection of Japanese alcoholic drinks - the highball was 👍🏻.
author: Chris J.

review_text:
My family went to this izakaya for lunch before we visited Sembawang God of Temple.
It’s located all the way inside the road that drives through Sembawang Camp.
Overall the food tasted very nice, though on a higher price set. All these combined $100++
author: Liau Yuan Wei

review_text:
Great ambience, warm and friendly staffs, nice decent food 👍🏻 not sure about the negative reviews but we just came on Sep 2025 and everything was good.

Cons : There can be lots of mosquitoes, but staff was nice and attentive enough to provide us with repellent and coils.

Overall : Great experience with unique vibe you can find in Singapore, worth travelling down 👍🏻
author: Eat PrayLove

review_text:
Had a really nice dining experience here! The restaurant is located right by the sea, and the view is absolutely beautiful, especially during sunset. The atmosphere is very relaxing and perfect for chilling with friends or family while enjoying the sea breeze.

The food was surprisingly good and reasonably priced. Portions were decent and everything we tried was tasty.

Definitely a great spot if you want to enjoy good food with a peaceful seaside view. Highly recommended!
author: Shu Yun

review_text:
Walked in on a weekend night, 8pm-ish.
No large crowd, but a decent amount of people haha.

The ambience is nice and there's even music playing in the background. Area is clean too.

Similar to other comments, the place did feel understaffed as in only about 2 to 3 waiters serving and taking orders for the entire large area. Staff are pleasant too, and when ordering did notify us that the food might take a longer time than usual.

The wait to get the menu and start ordering was rather long, but the wait for the food wasn't that bad that day.

Overall, food wasn't that bad. I think prices are fairly reasonable too. $13.50 for each pasta, and $25.50 for the grilled seabass. (Honestly it's only the $9.50 mushroom soup that's on the pricier side, not really worth it's portion as compared to other places)

Carbonara was creamy and filling, would really depend on personal preference if you like creamy stuff honestly.

Bolognese not bad! Tomato sauce was nice and tangy, good portion of beef too haha.

Grilled seabass was nice too, as compared to the image it's like thicker irl, tastes clean and fresh, not dry too!
author: allex

review_text: I really like this place, it has such a chill and relaxing vibe. They serve curry fish head, beer, Western dishes, and a variety of zi char options on the menu. The food tastes great, and the staff are very attentive. When she saw that I was carrying a birthday balloon, she immediately brought us to a VIP table. Such a thoughtful gesture!
author: PHENG

review_text:
Good set meal promotion, food is ok only. I didn’t really like the curry fish head, it tasted blend.

Beef steak isn’t really worth it at $33, might as well add another meat zi char dish from them.

Overall average.

Atmosphere is nice and windy, accepts cash and card payment.
author: Ryan P

review_text:
Try to make reservations if you come on weekend or holiday.

Food are delicious, especially the lamb rack(I like the most).  Staff are friendly and environment are chills and relax....

Nice place for gathering and chitchatting.
author: Tyler Ang

restaurant_name: Kin Kao Mai Thai Restaurant Sembawang
review_text:
I didn’t expect to find a Thai bistro hidden along the northern coast! Kin Kao Mai is right by the sea, and dining with the ocean breeze, a sea view, and good food instantly puts you in a relaxed mood. The atmosphere is absolutely on point.

They specialize in Thai cuisine, with classics like pineapple fried rice and tom yum soup. The flavors are perfectly balanced—sour and spicy in a very appetizing way, with rich layers of spices. The tom yum soup, served hot, was especially comforting to enjoy by the seaside. A really pleasant and memorable dining experience.
author: Milly

restaurant_name: Kin Kao Mai Thai Restaurant Sembawang
review_text:
A hidden gem up north! I was pleasantly surprised to stumble upon this Thai bistro. The location is fantastic, right by the sea, with a refreshing breeze and a view of Malaysia across the water.
The food was delicious: we had Pad Thai, Thai Basil Rice, pork skewers, and stir-fried kai lan. Everything was flavorful and reasonably priced.
Would recommend this spot, and parking is free just opposite the yacht club!
author: Damien Wong

restaurant_name: Kin Kao Mai Thai Restaurant Sembawang
review_text:
Nice place. Much better views and ambience than the neighbouring old bottle tree place there.

We ordered quite a number of thai dishes, all were great. Omelette, chicken, fried chicken, pine apple rice, pad Thai, all were good.

Great views and wind and ambience.

And free illegal parking available hahaha.
author: JJ Low

restaurant_name: Kin Kao Mai Thai Restaurant Sembawang
review_text:
We had a nice dining experience at Kin Kao Mai. The highlight for us was definitely the steamed sea bass with lime and garlic – fresh, flavorful, and perfectly balanced. The seafood salad and Thai-style grilled beef were also good, though the fish stood out as the star dish.

We paired our meal with gin & tonic, but do note that happy hour ends at 8:00 pm, so it’s best to come earlier if you want to enjoy the drinks at promo price.

Our total came to about $125.90 for food and drinks, including service charge and GST. Overall, a pleasant experience with good Thai flavors in a relaxing yacht club setting.
author: Jitya M.Topaz

restaurant_name: Kin Kao Mai Thai Restaurant Sembawang
review_text: The atmosphere here is very relaxing and cool because it's right beside the sea. Foods are good. Price is reasonable. Worth a try. Parking space should be more than enough but also depends on the timing you are there.
author: Poh Chee Wee

review_text: We booked the VIP Room at Muara Steamboat & Grill, Senibong for our team dinner (11 pax), and it was a fantastic experience! The all-you-can-eat steamboat, grill, and lok lok spread was generous and delicious. We especially enjoyed the complimentary Yee Sang and free-flow Sunquick orange. The private room was comfortable, air-conditioned, and came with a karaoke set—perfect for team bonding! Great value and great vibes. Highly recommended for group gatherings!
author: Muhamad 'MK' Kasan

review_text:
We recently held our Golden Years, Golden Hearts Long Service Award event for Spark Engineering Sdn. Bhd. at Muara Steamboat & Grill, and I can honestly say it was absolutely perfect!

The restaurant is beautiful, serene, and elegant, with a stunning sea view that added a truly special touch to the event. The ballroom was spacious and cozy, and even with 110 guests, it felt comfortable & not crowded at all.

A heartfelt thank you to Mr. Ahmad Daniel and his wonderful team for being incredibly helpful, friendly, and accommodating throughout. Mr. Ahmad Daniel truly lightened my load during the event, always ready to assist, never once complained, and ensured everything ran smoothly. He even arranged a special vegetarian corner as requested, which was perfectly done! some of my guests have different food preferences, but he managed to handle everything effortlessly and made sure everyone was satisfied. His professionalism and dedication were truly appreciated.

As for the food, it deserves a full 10/10  absolutely delicious and beyond expectations! Our guests loved every dish. And the best part? The price offered by Mr. Ahmad Daniel was very reasonable and affordable, especially for such excellent service and quality.

Thank you so much, Muara Steamboat & Grill, for making our event such a wonderful and memorable success. Highly recommended for any corporate or private event! 💖✨
author: Fyzah Juhair

review_text: Celebrate December babies birthday here. My friends took VIP room. Everything was set up for us. Food cooked to having karaoke system. The staff sang birthday song and brought slices of cakes. Service was great, atmosphere was relaxing and food was delicious.
author: Juriya HM

review_text:
Food:
Lots of choices. Just some food need to order if not on the long table like vege and instant noodle. For outdoor dining, the staff will grill for the customer. Also have delicious waffle and ice cream.

Booked 1 week earlier.

Service:
The staff are friendly and quite nice. The one with white shirt and black suit served proper.

Atmostphere:
Just across Singapore(Sembawang area), can see the ocean so its beautiful for sunset view.
author: Mist D Riq

review_text: Unlimited BBQ, hotpot and loklok with great variety. Halal-friendly, scenic views, indoor and outdoor seating, plus KTV rooms. Perfect spot for group gatherings and relaxed dinners with friends and family.
author: Ken de Jim

review_text:
Had a great dining experience at Reberto’s. The Petto di Pollo al Limone con Asparagi was tender and flavorful with a perfectly balanced lemon sauce, and the Barramundi Fillet was fresh and cooked beautifully. The Reberto drink paired well with the meal, and the Torino al Cioccolate dessert was rich and absolutely perfect.

Excellent service and cozy atmosphere — definitely will return! 😊
author: Htet Arkar

review_text:
Since Roberto’s is newly opened and receiving so many good reviews, I decided to give it a try — and here’s my full experience.

First of all, the place itself is really beautiful 😍 Perfect for relaxing, chilling, and gathering with friends or family. We stayed from 6.30pm to 10.30pm — a full 4 hours — for a birthday celebration 🎂 and the ambience was comfortable throughout.

One thing I really appreciate is that they provided a birthday word plate for the celebration. A nice thoughtful touch 💕

They also offer 1-for-1 wine promo or RM100 corkage, which is reasonable for an Italian restaurant.

Service-wise, Riyadh and the Indonesian girl were excellent — friendly, flexible, attentive, and made us feel welcomed the whole night. Even the toilet impressed me — clean with air-con, something many restaurants overlook.

Now, on to the food:

Margherita Pizza – Good to eat, soft crust, but lacking flavour.

Bruschetta – Sadly, flavour not there, expected more freshness and aroma.

Calamari Fritters – Honestly, don’t order. Not up to expectations even after they changed it.

Beef with Truffle Mash Potatoes – One of the better dishes. The beef was decent and the mash was nice.

Lamb Shank with Milanese-style Rice – Not flavourful, quite a disappointment.

Tiramisu – ⭐ THE SAVIOUR ⭐
Absolutely delicious! Rich, creamy, and the highlight of the night. Definitely must try.

Total bill came up to RM700+ for 6 pax, but only 5 of us were eating.
Considering the food quality, I find it quite expensive, especially when many dishes didn’t meet expectations.

⭐ Overall
Environment: Great
Service: Excellent
Food: Hit and miss, mostly miss
Price: High

Return? As a foodie, I won’t repeat again for the food, but the service and ambience are wonderful for gatherings.

A nice place to chill, celebrate, and enjoy the view — but food-wise, still has space to improve.
author: Mackaz Sajiaos Tan

review_text: I had a great dining experience at Roberto’s.The ambiance is cozy and stylish, perfect for both casual meals and gatherings with friends. The food exceeded my expectations—everything tasted fresh and flavorful, and the quality was excellent. Highly recommend this place if you enjoy good food in a pleasant environment.
author: Shu Mei Lim

review_text:
Roberto’s – Real Italian spot in Johor!
Authentic Italian restaurant in Senibong Cove, great vibe with both indoor and outdoor seating.
Everything tastes super fresh — amazing pizzas, great Aperol Spritz, and even vitello tonnato on the menu (rare to find here!).
On the pricey side, but totally worth it for the quality and authenticity.
Perfect for a nice dinner or weekend treat. 🇮🇹🍕🍹
author: laurent bergers

review_text: A lovely restaurant at Senibong Cove with attentive service from the staff. The pizza is the clear highlight—thin, crisp crust with a well-balanced sauce. The lamb shank is tender and unexpectedly pairs well with the risotto. However, the seafood salad and barramundi are rather average.
author: Wen Wu Tan

review_text: Great atmosphere! We enjoy all the restaurants that we visited so far and this one didn't disappoint except for the omelette.
author: Yan Naing Soe

review_text:
We came here today for dinner to this restaurant to celebrate my younger brothers 50th birthday. The ambience was ok but the food was so so. Unfortunately, we won’t be coming here for the Thai cuisine as the food was not authentic. This is coming from me (a person who has migrated to Thailand).

The tom yum soup was missing some ingredient, was too spicy and mostly comprised of mushrooms and a couple of prawns.
author: Adrian Tan

review_text: Satay chicken very tender and tasty. Ordered green curry and tomyam gong soup both were quite nice too. Just that if green curry a bit more spicy then shiok.
author: Piano Cover

review_text: Very nice restaurant. I've been visiting this place for how many times already. The food here is very delicious and the service staff are very professional. Must visit.
author: Nika D

review_text:
Had a great dinner on New Year’s Eve.
Food was relatively cheap and delicious. Various food options and exceptionally looking and tasting different when compared with the same in Singapore.
Parking may be a problem if you drive there after 8pm as per my observation.
author: chandana kulasingha

restaurant_name: 청춘비비큐Cheong chun korea bbq. K GLOBAL T&M S/B
review_text:
Having a late supper there few days ago. Found this place is very comfortable, spacious and chilling. The food choice is quite alot, they provide bbq, as well as main courses. The food we ordered, was very delicious, the ingredients were generous. The side dishes were tasty too, love all them so much, especially the marinated quails, super addictive. Highly reckon the bibimbaq, as they added unsalted butter into it, made the whole bowl of rice up to the next level, was heavenly yummy, even without the bean paste. And also, really appreciated that they helped me re-adjust the spiciness of the beef stew, so the soup was prefect.
The service was good too, the boss and the staffs were very friendly and helpful. Although there was some issues found during eating, we look forward to exploring more food at the near future.

update (16jan2026)
Overall performance remains the same, good service, good environment, good food! Trying out Naengmen, which is my current new lover. It is super duper tasty, and surprisingly they add on the sweet pear into it, makes it unique and aromatic. The kimbab is not a bad try too!

update (2feb2026)
Their BBQ is tasty! Trying out the pork belly and beef belly. Both are delicious. The texture is good and not to dry, very fresh! It comes with alot of side dishes, which is satisfying.
author: grassy

restaurant_name: 청춘비비큐Cheong chun korea bbq. K GLOBAL T&M S/B
review_text:
Great dining experience at this Korean restaurant! The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, with a cozy setup that feels perfect for both gatherings and casual meals. The side dishes were good and varied, and the BBQ meats were well-marinated and grilled to perfection.

But the highlight for me was definitely the chicken soup, rich, flavorful, and so comforting. The broth was nourishing and hearty, with tender chicken that just fell off the bone. It truly felt like a dish made with care, the kind that warms you from the inside out.

If you’re looking for authentic Korean comfort food with friendly service and a nice ambience, this is definitely a spot worth visiting. I’ll be back again soon, especially for that chicken soup!
author: Evelyn Lee

restaurant_name: 청춘비비큐Cheong chun korea bbq. K GLOBAL T&M S/B
review_text: Absolutely loved my experience at 청춘 BBQ! The grilled meats were perfectly cooked and flavorful, the pancake was crispy and delicious, and the spicy stew was comforting with a nice kick. The banchan came in a great variety and were all fresh and tasty. On top of that, the service was attentive and friendly, which made the whole meal even better!
author: Jack

restaurant_name: 청춘비비큐Cheong chun korea bbq. K GLOBAL T&M S/B
review_text: This is real Korean taste! It becomes my favorite Korean restaurant in JB! No need to visit Korea!
author: Hugo K

restaurant_name: 청춘비비큐Cheong chun korea bbq. K GLOBAL T&M S/B
review_text: Recommend their chicken soup and side dishes. As well as the chicken porridge after the meal. 🤩🤩
author: Lee

review_text: Had a casual dinner with my husband. We ordered quite a lot of food and really loved the sausage and mashed potatoes. The mushroom aglio olio was made to perfection. The mushroom soup was served piping hot, which I really appreciated. Last but not least, the watermelon & prawn salad was also delicious.
author: Z W

review_text: First time here, and gotta say, it was a pretty good experience! I've been to Senibong a few times, but never really thought about trying this restaurant. Turns out, it's actually really good though!
author: Milakrish

review_text:
First time tried Spain dishes in JB, RM69++ buffet worth the price! The food portion is big so it might not suitable for those who can't eat too much.

Sitting outside in the evening is a must! Enjoy atmosphere here while having the dinner~ Not too hot~
author: lieee

review_text:
The best food I had recently.
Those food that we ordered are all tasty and delicious. Good service and the ambience is nice 👍
author: Kavitha

review_text:
This is a perfectly fine restaurant in Senibong cove.
It is overpriced for the quality of food.
The food needs to be seasoned more, as the dishes are bland.
The service is good and they have good happy hour deals on beer.
author: Paul Allen

review_text:
Very disappointing and honestly quite shocking service experience.
Ordered a Kilkenny and a Piña Colada. The cocktail already took quite a while to prepare even though the restaurant was only about 30% full. But the real problem came with the service.
The server delivered my drink to the wrong table. He left it there for several minutes. Later, he returned, took the same drink from that table and handed it to me.
Imagine my horror when I realised the drink being given to me had already been sitting at another customer's table. I had absolutely no idea what happened to it during those minutes.
What was worse was the attitude — the server who delivered wrongly did not apologize, another server came to explain.  He simply said it was  delivered wrongly. No apology. No acknowledgement!  This was completely unacceptable.
I rejected the drink and ordered something else instead, which again took a very long time to arrive. There was no sense of urgency and the staff behaved as though nothing serious had happened.

At one point a female server was seen chatting casually with the ready drinks, she took her own sweet time to finish her conversation, holding the drinks. It seems that her own conversation had more priority! I don't expect her to run but to serve the drinks first maybe!

To be fair, the food was great as usual, but the bar service was terrible. Serving a drink that has already been placed on another customer's table is a basic hygiene and service failure.
Extremely disappointed
author: R Su

review_text: Nice place with a beautiful seaside view. The environment is relaxing and comfortable, good for chilling with friends or family. The food was tasty and the portion was reasonable. Overall, a good spot to enjoy food and drinks at Senibong Cove.
author: getha raja geetha

review_text: Brilliant ambience! Jidan was super friendly and helpful! Service was top notch. Thank you for the friendly chat and service! Will repeat in the future :)
author: Himadarshiny Rabindran

review_text: Ideal place to spend with family and friends Just imagine dad having his Pine of draught while mom indulge her ice cream craving next door & kids having fun in open space with buble toys..perfect happy hour's 😊
author: Praveen Devadas

review_text:
Very nice pizza and reasonable price!

The service level needs to be strengthened, especially on holidays. We notice restaurant stop accepting new customer but still needs to wait for more than one hour for our food.

The manager wrongly taken our order and still wish we can accept the order and pay for the bill if not we have to wait more for the new order.
author: Carine Fong

review_text:
Tried the lamb kofta briyani at Mr Briyani, and it was a very satisfying experience. The rice was fragrant and well cooked, with spices that were well balanced and not overpowering. The lamb kofta was tender, juicy, and nicely seasoned, which went really well with the briyani rice.
Portion size was generous and filling. The overall quality of the food met expectations, and the taste felt authentic and comforting. The place was clean, and the service was decent, making the dining experience pleasant.
Overall, a good spot for briyani lovers. Would definitely come back again to try other items on the menu.
author: Tivashini

review_text:
We ordered the Boneless Lamb Briyani and Chicken 65 Briyani, and both dishes were absolutely delicious. The lamb was soft, well-cooked, and packed with rich spices. The Chicken 65 had a nice kick and was perfectly coated with flavour. The briyani rice itself was fluffy and fragrant, and the portions were generous and very satisfying.

The brinjal pachadi complemented the briyani really well, adding a creamy and slightly tangy balance to the spices. The mango lassi was smooth and refreshing, and the pani puri shots were full of flavour.

We were also treated to complimentary black lentil paste (ulundu kanji) and a brownie for a birthday celebration, which was such a thoughtful touch. Plus, they offer a birthday discount when you sign up for their free membership, definitely a bonus!

A big shoutout to Mr Vijay for his warm and friendly service. He kept checking on us, made sure everything was good, and really took care of our table. His hospitality made the whole experience even better. Highly recommended 🫶🏻

review_text:
From the moment we walked in, the experience was nothing short of outstanding. The food was absolutely superb—each dish was thoughtfully prepared, beautifully presented, and bursting with flavor. What truly elevated the experience, however, was the exceptional service. The staff was warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming without ever being intrusive. They were knowledgeable about the menu, happy to offer recommendations, and ensured everything was perfect throughout our visit.

This restaurant strikes the perfect balance between incredible food and top-tier hospitality. Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or simply enjoying a night out, this is a place that delivers excellence on every level. Highly recommended—we will definitely be returning.

review_text:
I went for many seafood Zichar in JB, got a recommendation for this place. This is by far one of the more pricier ones I been to. It is seasonal pricing, on 4th Apr:
Crab: 24rm / 100g
Lobster: 58rm / 100g
Yes it is very pricey.

Let's talk about the food:
- Duck was dry and skin was not crispy, kind of bland too
- the butter sotong, veg and tofu craypot to me is normal, nothing amazing but decent.
- lobster, tried the steam garlic flavor, it was very fresh and delicious, one of the better ones. Then again the price was at 58/100g. The lobster in the pic was ard 1.2kg (700+rm - very meaty though.

Let's talk about the service:
- Fantastic - we didn't need to wait long for food, very attentive there was like 2-3 different staff serving us constantly.

Let's talk about the atmosphere:
There is a jetty view at least, you are not facing other tables if you are outside. In terms of the jetty view, nothing fantastic like that of other seafood houses near the coastal area. I did not go to their 2nd floor lounge, looks happening.

Conclusion:
If the seasonal price is around this premium of the price, I am afraid there are way more places with better price point, flavours and atmosphere.

review_text: My experience left me with mixed feelings. While some standout dishes truly delighted my taste buds, there were a couple of disappointments as well. First and foremost, the fresh Marble Goby fish at Delicious 8 deserves all the praise it can get. The succulent and tender flesh of the fish was cooked to perfection, and the flavours were simply outstanding. It was evident that the restaurant takes great care in sourcing the freshest ingredients, which truly paid off in this dish. The Double Flavour Chicken was another highlight, offering a delightful combination of flavours and textures that left me craving more. However, not all dishes lived up to our expectations. The Ostrich meat in Black Bean Sauce and the Venison with spring onions and ginger were let-downs. The meats in these dishes were overcooked and lacked the tenderness that one would expect. It was disappointing to see such premium ingredients not treated with the same care as the Marble Goby fish and Double Flavour Chicken. On the brighter side, I highly recommend trying the Dragon Supreme Platter. This dish was a true showstopper, with various flavours and ingredients working harmoniously. It was a culinary journey that I won't soon forget. Unfortunately, the Two Variety Bean Curd was a letdown. While it looked delicious on the menu, it was pretty tasteless. The flavours were bland, lacking the depth and complexity I had hoped for. Lastly, the Seafood fried rice left much to be desired. It was overly oily and, considering the quality, seemed overpriced. I expected a more balanced and flavourful dish.

The prawn and bacon carbonara was pretty average although the ingredients were fresh. Pork Satay burger was also decent but nothing too special. Fries was very well done though!

The staff spotted me looking at a dead fish floating in the tank and they went to fish it out. Hope it doesn't get served to someone.
Staff were abit bo chap in attitude but maybe that's how they are. They don't care about spilling your crab gravy on the table or wiping up. But they oblige if you want plate change.
It was really quite iconic being near the sea and you can see all the debris when it's low tide. Not as quaint as Kukup and you need to Grab there and back from JB Sentral. The drivers come pretty fast, about RM40 one way..

Drink - Had Masala tea and ginger tea. I was blown by the masala tea as the herbs taste was evidently there... My other half enjoyed his ginger tea.... Hard to find such authentic tea in JB.E
Environment - Decent indoor dining. Clean and cool... Very comfortable dining in. Even have wash basin to clean your hands n mouth afterthem mouth watering dishes!
Damage - RM$18 for 2x set poori (2 piece per set with 2xcondiments) and 1 masala tea and 1 ginger tea. Payment can be made via QR code - cashless payment.

Truly enjoyed the meal, made me felt back to kampung food in the 80s! Glad to find this and will be back for the masala tea again.

review_text:
(16/9/2025): The food came out quickly, in less than 10 minutes, and the owner was very polite. Unfortunately, the overall taste and attention to detail still have a lot of room for improvement; the current level isn't enough to make me want to come back.

1. Kung Pao Chicken Rice RM10: Not spicy at all. Some of the chicken pieces were okay, but others were completely tasteless. The overall flavor was unbalanced and tasted a bit strange. 🤨

2. Stir-fried Sweet Potato Leaves (Small) RM10: The portion was small enough for 3 people to share. The texture was too soft, and the flavor was too salty, lacking the desired refreshing taste.

3. Claypot Noodles (Small) RM9: When ordering, the owner described it as "flat yellow noodles," but what arrived was just regular round yellow noodles. However, seeing the many toppings—a prawn, mushroom slices, radish, and roast pork—I accepted it without requesting a refund. The raw egg that came with the noodles was still translucent. I immediately stated that I was pregnant and requested that it be cooked before serving. The second time it arrived, the yolk still burst out when I poked it. As a pregnant woman, this kind of handling is truly baffling. 🤷🏻‍♀️ Cooking really requires some basic common sense, especially when dealing with a clearly pregnant customer. Eggs must be fully cooked; it's impossible to risk eating undercooked eggs, especially not pasteurized ones. I reminded them a second time, and it was still the same—very disappointing. Overall, besides being salty, it lacked aroma. Even though the green peppers were seeded, they were still unbalancedly salty, not the expected sour and fragrant flavor. I couldn't finish it.

👉 Of the three dishes, if I had to order them again, only the Kung Pao Chicken would be acceptable; the worst was the clay pot noodles.

The whole restaurant reeked of strong cooking smells; even sitting at the entrance, the pungent odor made my nose run and was very uncomfortable. After eating, I really wanted to "escape as quickly as possible."

✅ Recommendation: It's good that the restaurant is polite, but if they want to operate in the long run, they need to pay more attention to food handling and basic food safety knowledge, and the taste must continue to improve.

The food has the aroma of Hokkien cuisine and the freshness of Teochew cuisine! The salted egg squid is made with real golden sand, not some random chemical sauce. It's perfect for hearty family gatherings and celebrations!

In the evening, the entire coffee shop transforms into a restaurant-style stir-fry place. The owner is very attentive, suggesting complementary dishes and portion sizes for customers. We felt the sincerity of the service and made a friend.

We dare say it's the best and most worthwhile stir-fry restaurant in the Setia Indah, Taman Daya, Dato Onn, and Austin area.

review_text:
This place does not deserve any rating at all.
From the cashier to the staff and possibly the owner’s son, everyone was extremely rude. They treated us as if we were stupid. If you cannot handle a large number of customers, then you should not offer buffet or allow dine-in with an à la carte menu.

When I wanted to pay first, the cashier told me to pay later and said she was busy, with a very unpleasant attitude. The Ramadan menu was also very confusing. If you want to dine in and eat à la carte, they only offer a RM100 set for four people.

I tried to ask one of the staff members, a Malay man with round glasses and curly hair but he ignored us and was very rude. When he finally explained the menu, I told him that I understood and that I wanted to place an order. However, he continued speaking to me in a rude tone, as if I did not understand what he was saying.

Then a woman (who I believe is his mother) came and said to me, “Are you the teacher? Why didn’t you show the parents’ faces to us? What if the parents of these kids steal the food and don’t pay?” She was accusing the parents of my students without any reason. She also said, “This tray is supposed to be for four people only.” Even so, it should be my choice how many people I bring to share the food. It is not a buffet.

For teachers who are planning to break fast here with their students, please reconsider. The service is extremely poor and the staff are very disrespectful.

9/3/2026
Update after speaking with my pupils who were there with me.

Apparently, the staff treated the students even worse when I was not paying attention. The staff kept commenting sarcastically whenever my pupils took kuih: “Why take so many?” “Who is that for?”

For your information, the kuih was supposed to be unlimited, and each group only took ONE plate. There were only three groups of students. They were not taking excessive food at all.
Even worse, one Malay auntie staff member deliberately bumped into one of my pupils. All of my students said the same thing.

A parent who was dining there also overheard the staff saying, “Next time don’t accept bookings from school kids.”

The irony? At the end of the night, the kuih they were so protective of earlier was not even finished. Suddenly they asked us to pack it.

Please remember: customers are PAYING customers, not people eating for free. Treating children this way is completely unacceptable.

Owner, please seriously reconsider your staff. Attitudes like this will destroy your business. Judging from the many 1-star reviews here, this is clearly not the first complaint.

And yes, the very rude Malay woman with the harsh attitude is apparently the owner’s sister. So that probably explains a lot.

review_text:
Visited this KFC for dinner with my wife after a long day at the nearby hospital. The branch is surprisingly spacious — wider seating layout, long rows of tables, and a clean interior with the familiar KFC design. Even during dinner hours, it wasn’t crowded, so finding a place to sit was easy and comfortable.

Ordering is done through the self-service kiosks at the entrance. The machines were functioning well, and the process was smooth. Once the order is placed, the counter team prepares the food, and the pickup area is clearly marked. Service speed was average — not too slow, not particularly fast — just what you’d expect from a typical KFC outlet.

One thing to note: the children’s playground area outside was closed, with signs indicating cleaning or maintenance. Families expecting to let kids play might be disappointed, but at least the area is properly cordoned off for safety.

Parking is available right in front of the restaurant, though depending on the time, it can be slightly competitive. The lighting inside is bright, and the dining hall feels open and airy thanks to the large windows.

Overall, this branch delivers the standard KFC experience, with the bonus of having more space and a quieter environment. Good for a quick meal, especially if you’re coming from the hospital nearby.

review_text:
Food Review: RM Stall Masai, Utama – 9.8.2025

I had breakfast at RM Stall Masai, Utama, located in Masai Utama, just the same row as TNB Masai and easily spotted from the Pasir Gudang Highway. This Indian stall came recommended by a friend, and it definitely lived up to the hype.

The stall serves a variety of Indian breakfast staples such as thosai, idli, appam, mee goreng, mee hoon, and roti canai. I ordered a thosai and a roti sardine. The thosai was tasty and paired perfectly with the fish curry served alongside. But the real highlight was the roti sardine crispy (garing), not oily, and packed with flavor. Truly “vera level” taste!

Interestingly, drinks are ordered separately from a Chinese vendor in the same restaurant, who also sells roti bakar and Chinese kuih giving the place a unique local blend of Indian and Chinese breakfast options under one roof.

The environment is modest but comfortable since the stall operates inside a Chinese restaurant. Prices are reasonable, and the food quality makes it worth every cent.

Verdict: This is one of the hidden gems for Indian breakfast in Masai. If you’re around Masai and craving authentic Indian breakfast at a good price, this is the spot. Highly recommended.

RM Stall Masai, Utama, , Pasir Gudang is easily recognizable from the highway. When we visited there recently, we found this stall to be a great choice for breakfast.

This stall serves a variety of Indian dishes including dosa, idli, appam, mee goreng, mee hoon, parot (roti canai).
The dosa with fish sauce was delicious. However, the roti sardine was the highlight. It was on another level. It was crunchy, not oily, and delicious.
For those who want to try a delicious Indian breakfast in Masai, RM Stall Masai, Utama is the best place to go. This place is sure to impress you with its taste, quality, and price.

📍Chuan Hiang Kopitiam

Located in the Masai Lama New Village area, Chuan Hiang Kopitiam retains the original wooden structure of its early shophouses.

The renovated interior cleverly blends modern minimalist style, preserving nostalgic details while catering to modern dining needs.

The surrounding atmosphere still retains a strong kampung (village) vibe, standing side-by-side with a century-old temple, creating a dialogue between the old and the new.

Sitting in a street-facing seat, watching the traffic flow by,

it's as if you're witnessing glimpses of everyday life in Southeast Asia over time.

The food is reasonably priced and the portions are generous. It retains some drinks that are increasingly rare in chain coffee shops, such as Milo, cereal, and rose syrup, evoking memories of childhood favorites.

Overall, Quanxiang is more than just a coffee shop; it's like a preservation of a scene—preserving the simplicity of flavors and the sense of time that belongs to the "old street."
